name: Almond-Crusted Chicken with Green Beans & Maple Sweet Potato Mash

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
When pan is hot, add almond meal and bread crumbs to dry pan. Toast, stirring often, until golden brown; about 2 minutes. Transfer the breading mix to a medium bowl and set pan aside to use later.
Add salt and pepper to the bowl with the almonds and bread crumbs and stir to combine.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Crack the egg into another medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork.

One piece at a time, dip chicken fillets in the beaten egg (letting the excess drip off), then in the almond mixture (pressing to adhere) and place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Cook in the center of the oven until golden brown and cooked through; about 18 minutes.

Peel and cut the sweet potatoes into 1-inch cubes; transfer to a small saucepan. Add water to the saucepan, covering the potatoes, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until they are tender when pierced with a fork, 8-10 minutes.
Trim and discard the ends of the green beans.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the beans, garlic, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the beans are tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
Once the potatoes are tender, remove from heat, carefully scoop out ¼ cup of the water and set aside. Drain the potatoes in a colander and return them back to the saucepan.
Add maple syrup, butter, salt, pepper and the reserved cooking water (if needed) to the potatoes; mash with a potato masher (or fork) until smooth.
To serve, divide the almond-crusted chicken, green beans, and maple mash between plates. Enjoy!

name: Almond Crusted Chicken & Kale Salad with Avocado & Poppyseed Dressing

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: In a bowl, beat the egg. In another bowl, combine almond meal, garlic powder, salt, pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Dip chicken fillets in the egg, then coat in the almond meal mixture.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together mayo, olive oil, vinegar, honey, salt, pepper, and poppy seeds. Set aside.

Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Slice or tear leaves apart into smaller pieces. Transfer to a large bowl. Drizzle with lemon juice and massage leaves with your hands for 2-3 minutes.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into a bowl.
Slice chicken into strips.
To serve, arrange kale on a plate, then add avocado slices and chicken strips. Drizzle with poppyseed dressing and enjoy!

name: Almond Dusted Sole with Balsamic-Parmesan Asparagus & Tomatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus and transfer to the baking sheet.
Add tomatoes to the baking sheet with the asparagus and spread veggies out in an even layer.
Cut butter into small pieces and sprinkle over the veggies; drizzle with vinegar, then season with salt and pepper.
Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until fork-tender, 12-15 minutes.
While the veggies are roasting, zest lemon into a medium bowl. (Reserve lemon for serving.)
Add almond meal, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon zest; stir to combine.
Working one by one, dredge fish fillets in the almond meal mixture, pressing lightly to adhere to both sides. Transfer fish to a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the fish and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven and sprinkle with Parmesan and half of the parsley; toss to combine. (Reserve the rest of the parsley for serving.)
To serve, divide fish and veggies between plates. Juice lemon over fish and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Almond Pesto Pasta Salad with Broccoli, Greens & Fresh Mozzarella

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, about 6 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Small dice mozzarella, place in a medium bowl, and set aside.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
When the pasta is almost done, add broccoli to the pan; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta reaches desired firmness and broccoli is tender, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, peel garlic and place in a blender.
Zest and juice lemon into the blender with the garlic.

Pick basil leaves off the stems; add to the blender along with nutritional yeast, almonds, water, oil, salt, and pepper. Blend on high until very smooth, 1-2 minutes. Add to the bowl with the mozzarella.
When the pasta and broccoli are done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes; add to the bowl, along with mixed greens, and stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Antipasti Pasta Salad with Crispy Prosciutto, Artichokes & Mozzarella

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.

Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Lay prosciutto in the skillet and cook until it browns slightly, about 1 minute per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Seed and slice bell pepper into thin strips. Peel and mince shallot.
Return skillet to stove over medium-high heat. Add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peppers, shallots, and salt; cook, stirring often, until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Add to the skillet with the peppers during the last 30 seconds of cooking. Remove both from heat and set aside to cool.
Combine oil, vinegar, Dijon, and spices in a large salad bowl and whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts; transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut cheese into ½-inch cubes; transfer to the bowl.
Halve olives and add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done cooking, drain and rinse under cold, running water. Transfer pasta, bell pepper mixture, and arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Chop or tear prosciutto into pieces.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls and top with crispy prosciutto. Enjoy!

name: "Antipasti" Salad with Prosciutto, Marinated Chickpeas & Mozzarella

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot into thin half-moons; place in a medium bowl.
Trim celery and cut crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl with the shallot.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Mince sun-dried tomatoes; add to the bowl along with the chickpeas, half the dressing (reserving the rest for serving), salt, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine and set aside to marinate.
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes and place on a plate.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the plate with the tomatoes, keeping them separate.
Medium dice mozzarella and add to the plate.
Cut or tear each slice of prosciutto into 3 pieces; roll each piece and add to the plate.
Add artichokes and olives to the plate.

To serve, divide mixed greens between plates or bowls. Place a scoop of marinated chickpeas in the center of the greens, then surround with tomatoes, bell pepper, mozzarella, prosciutto, artichokes, and olives. Drizzle with reserved dressing and enjoy!

name: Apple-Arugula Salad with Quinoa, Crispy Shallot, Prosciutto & Parmesan

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine broth, quinoa, and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until liquid is fully absorbed, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add prosciutto in a single layer and cook until crispy, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips.

Return skillet to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and starting to crisp, 3-4 minutes. Add to the plate with the prosciutto and set aside.
While the shallot is cooking, peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, honey, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, quarter, core, and thinly slice apple. Add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
When the quinoa is done, transfer to a baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool slightly, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, crumble or chop prosciutto into bite-sized pieces. Return to the plate.
Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Set aside.
Wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the cooled quinoa and pumpkin seeds, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, then top with crumbled prosciutto, crispy shallots, and Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Apple, Bacon & Cheddar Frittata

instructions.text: Wash, core, and thinly slice apple into ⅛ inch wedges. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.
In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, water, salt, and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Chop bacon into smaller pieces.
Add bacon to skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate, leaving the grease in the skillet.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack about 4 inches from the top.
Grate ½ cup of cheddar. Add ½ to bowl with eggs and mix.
Once bacon has been transferred, add butter and apple slices to skillet. Stir to combine, and cook until apples are slightly softened, 1-2 minutes.
Return about ½ of the bacon to the skillet. Spread out the apples and bacon evenly.

Pour in egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Sprinkle remaining cheddar and bacon over top. Place skillet in the oven until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and place on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Apple-Beet Slaw with Dill, Raisins, Almonds, Feta & Pan Fried Sausage

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the skillet is hot, add almonds and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with vinegar, oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate beet. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and coarsely grate apple. Add to the bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add toasted almonds, broccoli slaw, feta, and raisins to the bowl. Stir to combine the slaw.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Slice the sausages into bite-sized rounds.
To serve, divide the sausage and slaw between plates. Enjoy!

name: Apple-Cheddar Grilled Cheese Sandwiches with Arugula, Apple & Pecan Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Quarter the apple lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges. Transfer to a small bowl.
Coarsely grate 1 cup of cheddar and transfer to a bowl.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium heat.

Place the 4 bread slices on a flat surface and divide the mustard among them. Evenly top 2 of the slices with ½ of the apple (save the rest for the salad) and the grated cheddar; season with salt and pepper. Cover the sandwiches with the remaining bread slices, mustard-side-down.
Add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottom is golden brown, 2 to 4 minutes. Then, remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more butter to the skillet; return the sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side-up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a cutting board.
While the sandwiches toast, roughly chop the pecans.
Transfer the arugula, remaining apple slices, and pecans to a medium salad bowl.
In a small bowl, combine and whisk together extra virgin olive oil, apple cider vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Cut the sandwiches in half on the diagonal.
To serve, divide the salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!

name: Apple-Cheddar Grilled Cheese Sandwiches with Tomato Soup

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Quarter the apple lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section. Cut 2 of the quarters lengthwise into thin wedges and transfer to a small bowl. Medium dice the other 2 quarters and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and add to the bowl with the apple.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the apple and onion.
Once the saucepan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the apple, onion, and garlic to the saucepan; season with oregano, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the apple and onion are softened, 4 to 6 minutes.
Coarsely grate 1 cup of cheddar.
Add the diced tomatoes and broth to the saucepan; season with additional salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 8 to 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add butter to a nonstick skillet and heat over medium-low heat.
Place the bread slices on a clean, dry work surface. Divide the apple slices and cheese between 2 of the bread slices, then top with the remaining bread slices.
Once melted, spread the butter around the skillet, then season the bottom of the skillet with salt.

Place the sandwiches in the skillet and cook until golden brown and crispy on the first side, 3 to 4 minutes. Then, add more butter and salt, and carefully flip the sandwiches; cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese has melted, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a cutting board.
Using a hand blender, purée the soup until smooth. Alternatively, use a potato masher to mash the tomatoes and apples (the soup will be chunkier).
Cut the grilled cheese sandwiches in half diagonally.
To serve, divide the soup between small bowls and serve with the grilled cheese on the side. Enjoy!

name: Apple Chicken Burger with Cranberry Mayo & Roasted Broccoli

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.

Wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until broccoli is fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, wash, dry, quarter, and core apple; coarsely grate. Place in a medium bowl, along with chicken, bread crumbs, and spices, then mix with your hands until well combined. Form the chicken mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
While the burgers are cooking, mince cranberries. Place in a small bowl, along with mayo and spices, then stir to combine. Set aside.
Toast buns if desired.
Spread cranberry mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with burger patties, then close with the top half of each bun. Serve with roasted broccoli on the side and enjoy!

name: Apple-Glazed Chicken with Mashed Parsnips & Arugula-Pumpkin Seed Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Peel and medium dice parsnips. Transfer to a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until parsnips can be easily pierced with a fork, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Place leaves in a medium bowl along with flour and spices; stir to combine.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Add to the bowl with the flour mixture and turn to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use).
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Quarter, core, and slice apples into ½-inch wedges. Add to the bowl with the onion.

When the chicken is done, return the skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add onion and apple; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
Add broth, vinegar, Dijon, and maple syrup to the skillet, then stir to combine the sauce. Return chicken (and any accumulated juices) to the skillet and turn to coat. Bring sauce to a simmer.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the sauce is simmering, reduce heat to medium. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until apple is soft and sauce has thickened slightly, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.

Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place half in the reserved bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining garlic for later use.)
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add arugula and pumpkin seeds to the bowl with the dressing. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
When the parsnips are done, drain and return to the pan along with remaining garlic, milk, salt, and pepper. Mash until smooth.
To serve, divide parsnip mash, chicken, and salad between plates. Top chicken with apples and sauce from the skillet. Enjoy!

name: Apple Quinoa Salad with Celery, Almonds & Dried Cranberries

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry apples, celery, and parsley.
Core and medium dice the apples. Trim ends and medium dice the celery. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer ingredients to a large bowl.
Add almonds and cranberries to bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, lemon juice, oil, honey, salt, and pepper.
Uncover quinoa, fluff with a fork, and add to bowl.
Pour dressing over top salad and toss.
To serve, place salad on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Apricot Chicken Curry with Baby Spinach & Basmati Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Rinse rice in a strainer until water runs clear and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, stir, and cover. Cook until liquid is absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic and ginger. Medium dice apricots. Transfer everything to a plate.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Trim excess fat and slice chicken into strips. Season with salt and pepper.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add chicken and, stirring occasionally, cook until no longer pink, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Once chicken has been transferred, add more oil and onion to pan. Stirring frequently, cook until onion has softened, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry spinach and cilantro. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add apricots, garlic, ginger, paprika, coriander, and curry powder to pan. Stir with onions until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.

Return chicken to pan. Add coconut milk, spinach, and ½ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing). Stir until well combined. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until curry thickens, 5-10 minutes.
Uncover rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place the rice in a bowl, top with curry, and garnish with remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Apricot Chicken Salad with Spinach & Crusty Bread

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place chicken in a small saucepan. Season with salt and pepper. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-12 minutes. Remove from liquid and place on a plate.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by mixing together yogurt, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add almonds and, stirring constantly, cook until golden brown, 1-2 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry celery and green onions. Small dice celery and add to bowl with dressing. Trim and discard root ends, chop onions, and add to bowl.
Small dice apricots and add to bowl. Add almonds to bowl.
Wash and dry spinach.
Toast bread if desired.
Pat dry the chicken with paper towels, small dice, and add to bowl. Toss salad until well combined.
To serve, arrange a bed of spinach on a plate and top with chicken salad. Enjoy with crusty bread!

name: "Artichoke Dip" Smothered Chicken & Asparagus over Spinach Couscous

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of oil.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry spinach (skip if it came pre-washed); roughly chop half and transfer to a medium bowl. Set remaining spinach aside.
Drain and coarsely chop artichokes; add to the bowl with the spinach.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Cut cream cheese into small pieces and add to the bowl along with spices. Use a silicone spatula or spoon to mash and thoroughly combine the artichoke dip.

Place chicken on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Place cutlets in the baking dish and season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Spread artichoke dip over the cutlets.
Wash and dry asparagus. Using a clean cutting board, snap or cut off woody ends; divide and place on top of each cutlet.
Coarsely grate mozzarella; sprinkle over the chicken and asparagus.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until chicken is cooked through and golden, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Uncover the couscous and add remaining spinach. Gently stir spinach into couscous until slightly wilted.
To serve, divide couscous between plates or bowls and top with smothered chicken. Enjoy!

name: Arugula, Apricot & Chickpea Salad with Feta, Couscous & Pistachios

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with cumin, salt, and pepper.
Place in the oven and, stirring halfway through, roast until crispy, 15-20 minutes.
In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry arugula. Transfer to a large bowl.
Medium dice apricots and add to bowl with arugula. Shell pistachios and add to bowl.
Add feta to bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Grate 1 tsp of lemon zest. Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together zest, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, honey, cumin, salt, and pepper.
amounts: zest and juice of ½ lemon

instructions.text: Uncover couscous and fluff with a fork. Add couscous and chickpeas to bowl and toss salad until well combined.
To serve, place salad on a plate and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Arugula, Butternut Squash & Quinoa Salad with Goat Cheese

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Peel squash, scrape out and discard the seeds, and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a sheet pan.
Drizzle squash with oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat.
Place in the oven and roast until squash is tender, 10-15 minutes.
Wash and dry arugula. Transfer to a large bowl.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings. Add to bowl.
Add almonds and cranberries to bowl.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together lemon juice, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Cut remaining ½ lemon into wedges.
Crumble goat cheese into a small bowl.
Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork. Add quinoa and squash to salad and toss.
To serve, place salad on a plate, sprinkle with goat cheese, and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Arugula & Chickpea Salad with Cucumber, Avocado & Parmesan

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Transfer to a sheet pan.
Drizzle chickpeas with oil and season with cumin, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Place in the oven and roast until crispy, 15-20 minutes. Stir halfway through cooking time.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, lemon juice, oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Wash and dry arugula.
Wash and medium dice cucumber. Halve and pit avocado; scoop out and medium dice the flesh.
Shred ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
To serve, arrange a bed of arugula on a plate and top with chickpeas, cucumber, and avocado. Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Arugula, Mushroom & Quinoa Salad with Lemon-Chive Vinaigrette

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic. Wash and mince chives.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together the garlic, ½ of the chives, lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Wash and dry arugula. Transfer to a large bowl. Add the remaining minced chives.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Wash and slice mushrooms.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add pine nuts and, stirring constantly, cook until golden brown, 1-2 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Return skillet to stove and add more oil. Add mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Stirring occasionally, cook until just tender, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork. Add quinoa, mushrooms, and pine nuts to bowl with arugula. Toss to combine.
To serve, place salad on a plate and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Arugula Salad with Chicken, Chickpeas & Creamy Cilantro Dressing

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Place vinegar, honey, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Zest lime into another small bowl (reserve lime for later use). Add spices and stir to combine the spice mix.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with the spice mix.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add chicken and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems. Place stems and half of the leaves in a blender. (Reserve remaining leaves for serving.)

Juice reserved lime into the blender, then add yogurt, oil, water, honey, and salt. Blend on high until smooth. Add additional water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set dressing aside.
Drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Add chickpeas and arugula to the bowl, then toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Drizzle with dressing, then top with chicken, pickled onions, and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Arugula Salad with Pan-Fried Chicken, Butternut Squash, Apple & Feta

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and small dice. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until squash is golden brown and fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove chicken to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
While the chicken is cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, quarter, core, and small dice apple. Add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
When the butternut squash is done, remove from the oven and let cool, about 5 minutes.
Slice chicken into thin strips.
Add cooled squash, arugula, and feta to the bowl with the dressing and apple. Toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with chicken. Enjoy!

name: Arugula Salad with Pork, Spicy Charred Pineapple, Avocado & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice. Transfer to the baking sheet; drizzle with oil, toss to combine, and spread out in a single layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Thinly slice jalapeño into rounds and sprinkle on top of the pineapple. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until the pineapple is golden and slightly charred, 7-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, honey, and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the pickling liquid. Stir to combine and set aside.
When the pineapple is done, remove from oven. Carefully remove broiled pineapple from the baking sheet by lifting the corners of the foil and transferring the whole sheet to a flat surface.
Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on the baking sheet; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil the chops, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes.
While the chops are broiling, add oil, additional salt, and pepper to the bowl with the pickled onions. Stir to combine.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Right before serving, halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the onions along with the pineapple, jalapeño, arugula, and feta. Gently toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Thinly slice chops.
To serve, divide salad and chops between plates. Enjoy!

name: Arugula Salad with Sausage, Bell Pepper, Parmesan, Pine Nuts & Basil

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; place in a medium bowl.
Add oil, vinegar, and spices to the bowl with the basil; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, slice the sausages crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add sausage and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan and add to the bowl.
Add arugula and pine nuts to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with crispy sausage. Enjoy!

name: Arugula Salad with Smoked Salmon, Sweet Potato, Mozzarella & Ranch

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and cut sweet potato into ½-inch cubes; transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to combine; spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potatoes are golden brown and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, mince chives and place in a small bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the chives.
Add yogurt, mayo, and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing. If necessary, add water, 1 teaspoon at a time, to reach a drizzling consistency; set aside.
Medium dice mozzarella and transfer to a plate.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces; add to the plate with the mozzarella.
Quarter and core apple, then medium dice and add to the plate.
Roughly chop pistachios.
To serve, divide arugula between plates or bowls; top with sweet potato, mozzarella, salmon, apple, and pistachios. Serve with dressing on the side and enjoy!

name: Arugula-Tempeh Salad with Blistered Tomatoes, Avocado & Chive Dressing

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tempeh. Place in a medium bowl, drizzle with soy sauce, and stir to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tempeh and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 5-7 minutes. Transfer tempeh to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet and bowl for later use.)
While the tempeh is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to brown and burst, 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into the reserved bowl.

Chop chives into small pieces. Add half to the bowl with the lemon juice along with mayo, oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
Add arugula and cooled tomatoes to the bowl with the dressing. Gently toss to combine the salad.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and large dice. Season with salt.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with avocado, tempeh, and reserved chives. Enjoy!

name: Asian Chicken & Brussels Sprouts Stir Fry with Basmati Rice

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Slice chicken into thin strips. Transfer to a small bowl, drizzle with soy sauce, and toss to coat. Set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash, trim ends, and thinly slice brussels sprouts.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger. Wash and dry green onions; trim the root ends and chop.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken strips and cook until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Roughly chop peanuts. Set aside.
Return skillet to stove and add a little more oil. Add garlic, ginger, and pepper and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add sprouts and, stirring occasionally, cook until softened, 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, vinegar, honey, sesame oil, and water.
Add sauce to skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid thickens, 2-3 minutes.
Return chicken to skillet and add green onions. Toss and remove from heat.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place rice on a plate, top with stir fry, and sprinkle with peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Asian Chicken with Crunchy Carrot, Asparagus, Avocado & Sesame Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with soy sauce, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and maple syrup. Whisk to combine the sauce.
Add chicken to the bowl with the sauce and turn to coat. Transfer to a baking dish and arrange in an even layer.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping halfway though, until chicken is cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place mayo, vinegar, sesame seeds, oil, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears crosswise into thin coins. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl and gently stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Asian Chicken Fritters with Sweet 'n' Sour Sauce, Bok Choy & Peanuts

instructions.text: Wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a medium bowl.

Add chicken, bread crumbs, egg, chili-garlic sauce, oil, and spices to the bowl with the green onion. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Use a ¼-cup measure to form the chicken mixture into ½-inch thick fritters and place on a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fritters and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, place water, additional chili-garlic sauce, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, oil, and cornstarch in a small saucepan. Whisk to combine the sweet 'n' sour sauce.
Set pan over medium-high heat and bring sauce to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the sauce is cooking, wash, dry, trim, and cut bok choy in half lengthwise.

Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bok choy, cut-side down, then drizzle with soy sauce; cover and cook, flipping once, until tender and charred, 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, roughly chop peanuts.
To serve, divide fritters, sauce, and bok choy between plates. Top bok choy with peanuts and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Asian Chickpea, Eggplant, Pepper, Mushroom & Basil Stir-Fry with Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and quarter the eggplant lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add eggplant and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and medium dice onion; place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper into thin strips. Remove stems from mushrooms, halve, and cut crosswise into thin strips. Add both to the bowl with the onion.
When the eggplant is done, remove to a plate and set aside. Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are almost fork-tender, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
While the veggies are cooking, drain and rinse the chickpeas in a colander; set aside to drain further.

Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place in the reserved bowl along with soy sauce, water, peanut butter, maple syrup, cornstarch, vinegar, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and pepper. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Add chickpeas to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are tender and chickpeas are warmed through, 2-3 minutes more.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.

Add sauce, half of the basil (reserving the rest for garnish), and the cooked eggplant to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce is thickened and veggies are coated, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates; sprinkle with sesame seeds and reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Asian Chili-Garlic Salad with Grilled Chicken Thighs & Fresh Herbs

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once grill pan is hot, coat the bottom with oil. Add chicken and grill until cooked through and golden, flipping once, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Add oil, fish sauce, vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and honey to bowl with garlic; whisk to combine dressing.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
When the chicken is done, remove from the grill pan and transfer to a plate; cover with aluminum foil and let rest.
Using a julienne peeler (or regular peeler), peel the carrots into noodle-like sticks; transfer to the salad bowl.
Halve the tomatoes; trim ends from the cucumber, slice lengthwise, and cut crosswise into thin half moons. Add both to the salad bowl.

Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl and toss the salad to combine.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Roughly chop the peanuts.
Slice the chicken crosswise into strips.
To serve, divide the salad between plates and top with chicken, green onions, and peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Asian Ground Beef Stir-Fry with Green Beans & Carrots over Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice cooks, trim and cut green beans into 1-inch pieces; place in a small bowl.
Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into thin rounds; add to the bowl with the green beans and set aside.

Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in another small bowl. Add cold water (from the tap), soy sauce, cornstarch, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce to the bowl; whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring often, until starting to soften, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Add beef, salt, and pepper to the skillet with the veggies. Continue to cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.

Add the stir-fry sauce, half of the green onions, and sesame seeds to the skillet (reserve remaining green onions for the rice). Continue to cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens slightly, 1-2 minutes more.
When the rice is done, add reserved green onions and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice and beef stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Asian Noodle Salad with Broccoli Slaw & Creamy Peanut Sauce

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 6 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) spaghetti pasta

instructions.text: Peel and mince the garlic. To prepare the sauce, in a small bowl, combine and whisk together the garlic, water, peanut butter, vinegar, soy sauce, honey, oil, and crushed red pepper.
Toss the broccoli slaw into a large bowl. Wash and dry the cilantro. Shave the leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the broccoli slaw.
Wash and cut the lime into wedges. Roughly chop the peanuts.
Drain the pasta in a colander and rinse under cold water. Shake to drain excess liquid, then add to the bowl with the broccoli slaw.
Pour the peanut sauce over top and toss to coat.
To serve, divide the noodles between bowls (or containers) and garnish with peanuts and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Asian Pork Noodle Soup with Swiss Chard, Mushrooms, Cilantro & Lime

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.

While the pan heats up, fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves into bite-sized pieces and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in another medium bowl, reserving stems for the next step.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, mushrooms, chard stems, pork, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until the pork is cooked through and chard stems are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add broth, water, soy sauce, and fish sauce to the pan. Stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the broth is boiling, uncover, add rice noodles, and stir to combine the soup. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until noodles are almost soft, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the chard leaves. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
When the noodles are almost soft, add chard leaves, cilantro, and green onions to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Continue to cook until noodles and chard leaves are tender, 1-2 minutes more.
Juice lime into the pan, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls, then top with reserved cilantro and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Asian Pork Noodles with Lime, Basil & Spinach

instructions.text: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

When the water in the saucepan comes to a boil, uncover and season the water with salt, then add the pasta (snap the spaghetti into thirds as you add to the water); stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Once cooked, drain the pasta in a colander and set aside.
Peel and mince or press the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Cut the pork sausage open at one end. Sliding your fingers from the sealed to the cut end, squeeze the contents of the sausage into the skillet and discard the casing. Add garlic, and ginger to the skillet. Breaking the sausage apart with a spatula, cook until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Juice the lime into a small bowl.
Pick the basil leaves off the stems and discard the stems.
Turn the heat down to low and add the spinach and half the basil, stir until the spinach is wilted.
Add the pasta, lime juice, fish sauce, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring constantly, until ingredients are well combined.
To serve, divide the pasta between bowls and garnish with the remaining basil. Enjoy!

name: Asian Pork Stir-Fry with Pineapple, Bok Choy & Coconut Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and cut bok choy crosswise into 1-inch strips. Place in a medium bowl.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, wash, dry, and cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the bok choy and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch cubes. Season with salt and pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and stir-fry until golden and almost cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, place soy sauce, vinegar, cornstarch, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, and onion powder in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce and set aside.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bok choy and pineapple; stir-fry until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Return pork to the skillet along with the stir-fry sauce. Continue to stir-fry until pork is cooked through and sauce thickens slightly, 2-3 minutes more. Cover and remove from heat.
Just before serving, fluff rice with a fork. Add coconut and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Asian Rice Noodle Salad with Grilled Chicken, Jalapeños & Fresh Herbs

instructions.text: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl.

Thinly slice the jalapeño into rounds; remove seeds and add to the bowl with the garlic. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Juice lime into the bowl. Add soy sauce, sugar, fish sauce, and oil; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse under cold water.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add chicken and grill, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and julienne or coarsely grate the carrot. Transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces at an angle. Add to the bowl.
Halve the cabbage lengthwise and cut out the core; thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems. Pick mint leaves off the stems. Roughly chop leaves and add to the bowl.
Slice the chicken crosswise into strips. Add to the bowl along with the noodles and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide noodle salad between bowls and enjoy!

name: Asian Rice Salad with Crispy Tofu, Cilantro & Ginger-Peanut Dressing

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and spread it out on a baking sheet pan to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.

While the rice is cooking, cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Peel and mince ginger; transfer to a small bowl. Add peanut butter, vinegar, soy sauce, water, oil, and chili-garlic sauce; whisk to combine the dressing, then set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, large dice the tofu. Gently toss in a medium bowl with cornstarch.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and cook, turning every few minutes, until golden brown and crispy on all sides, about 10 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
While the tofu is cooking, trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Transfer to a large bowl.
Cut sugar snap peas crosswise into ¼-inch pieces and add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Transfer cooled rice to the bowl with the veggies and gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide rice salad between bowls. Top with crispy tofu and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Asian Salmon Zucchini Noodle Bowl with Carrots & Sugar Snap Peas

instructions.text: Wash the fresh produce.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger. In a shallow dish, whisk together the ginger, soy sauce, vinegar, and sesame oil.
Place the salmon flesh-side down in the marinade and turn a few times to coat.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.

Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add salmon skin-side down, reserving the marinade in the dish, and cook until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side depending on thickness. Transfer to a plate and allow it to cool.

While the salmon cooks, trim ends and, using a julienne peeler (or regular peeler), peel the carrots and zucchini into noodle-like sticks; transfer to a large bowl. Halve the peas on an angle and add to the bowl.
Once the salmon has been removed, add carrots, zucchini, peas, and reserved marinade to the skillet. Toss and cook until the noodles have softened slightly, 2-3 minutes.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Trim ends and chop the green onions on an angle.
To serve, combine noodles, peas, and avocado on a plate or in a bowl. Flake salmon over top and sprinkle with green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Asian Shrimp Tacos with Mango, Snap Pea, Avocado & Cilantro Salad

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with soy sauce, water, honey, chili-garlic sauce, cornstarch, and oil. Whisk to combine the marinade.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Add shrimp to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
Peel and mince shallot. Place in another medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the shallot. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Juice lime into the bowl.
Cut snap peas crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl along with salt and pepper. Gently stir to combine the salad and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add shrimp and marinade. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are opaque and sauce has thickened, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates; fill with a small portion of salad, shrimp, and reserved cilantro. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Asian Steak & Mango Salad with Bell Pepper & Romaine

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash, dry, and juice lime into a small bowl. Add ginger, oil, honey, and soy sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Wash and dry lettuce. Chop crosswise into 1 inch strips. Transfer to a large bowl.

Wash and dry mango, bell pepper, and green onions. Peel, cut flesh away from the pit, julienne (cut into thin strips), and add mango to bowl with lettuce. Seed, julienne, and add pepper to bowl. Trim and discard root ends, chop green onions, and add to bowl.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, arrange salad on a plate and top with steak slices. Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Asian Steak Salad with Cucumber, Napa Cabbage & Peanuts

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the lime into a small bowl.
Place the steak in a shallow bowl and pierce with a fork in multiple places.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Pour ½ of the lime juice (save the rest for the salad dressing) and soy sauce over the steak; turn to coat. Set aside to marinate for 10 minutes.
Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan warms up, peel and mince the garlic.
Coat the grill pan or skillet with coconut oil.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels, then place in the grill pan or skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Add the minced garlic, sesame oil, rice vinegar, crushed red pepper, and salt to the remaining lime juice and whisk together.
Cut out and discard the tough core of the cabbage; thinly slice the cabbage crosswise and transfer to a large bowl.
Trim and discard the ends of the cucumber; halve the cucumber lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise on an angle. Add to the cabbage.
Pour the dressing over the salad; toss until well combined.
Measure out the peanuts into a small bowl.
Slice the steak against the grain.
To serve, arrange the salad on a plate, place the steak slices on the side, and sprinkle with the peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Asian-Style Mushroom Frittata with Cilantro & Cucumber-Avocado Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the mushrooms.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, ginger, garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are tender, 6-7 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl along with eggs and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine and set aside.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.

When the mushrooms are tender, add green onions (reserving a small handful for serving), soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 3-5 minutes.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lime into a clean medium bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Sprinkle with reserved green onions and serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Asian-Style Pork Soup with Napa Cabbage, Potatoes, Carrots & Mushrooms

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Medium dice potato. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Add to the bowl with the potatoes.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl and set aside.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Add veggies to the pan. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 1-inch wide strips.

When the veggies are done, add cabbage, broth, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce to the pan; stir to combine the soup, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!

name: Asian-Style Salmon with Roasted Zucchini & Sweet Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice the sweet potatoes into ½-inch cubes; transfer to a large baking sheet.
Trim and discard the ends of the zucchini; medium dice the zucchini into ½-inch cubes and add to the baking sheet.
Peel and mince the garlic; sprinkle over the vegetables.
Drizzle the vegetables with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then arrange in a single layer.
Place the vegetables in the oven (even if it is not fully heated yet) and cook for 10 minutes while you prepare the salmon.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger; transfer to a medium bowl (that can hold the salmon).
Add soy sauce, olive oil, sesame oil, and honey to the ginger; whisk together.
Place the salmon in the bowl and coat with the sauce.
Take the baking sheet out of the oven and move the vegetables to the sides of the tray; place the salmon, skin-side-down, in the middle of the tray and pour any remaining marinade overtop.
Return the tray to the oven and bake until the salmon is cooked through and the vegetables are tender, another 10 to 12 minutes.
While the vegetables and salmon cook, trim and discard the ends of the green onions; chop the onions on an angle into ¼-inch pieces.
To serve, place the roasted vegetables and salmon on a plate and sprinkle with the green onions and sesame seeds.

name: Asian-Style Turkey Burger with Creamy Water Chestnut & Broccoli Slaw

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.

Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic along with turkey, bread crumbs, soy sauce, and spices; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, place mayo and chili-garlic sauce in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spicy mayo and set aside.
Zest and juice lime into a clean medium bowl. Add additional mayo, sesame seeds, honey, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the dressing.
Drain and roughly chop water chestnuts. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with broccoli slaw, and stir to combine. Set aside.
Toast buns if desired.
Spread spicy mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with burger patties and a small handful of slaw. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with remaining slaw on the side and enjoy!

name: Asian Tofu-Peanut Lettuce Wraps with Carrot, Cucumber, Cilantro & Mint

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into a small bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the shallot and cook, stirring often, until soft and golden, 2-3 minutes.

Crumble the tofu with your fingers into the skillet. Add half the lime mixture (reserving the rest for the sauce), sugar, chili-garlic sauce, and salt to the skillet; stir to combine. Cook, stirring often, until tofu turns golden brown, 8-10 minutes.
While the tofu is cooking, add soy sauce, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce to the bowl with the reserved lime mixture. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Peel, trim, and thinly slice carrot; place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumber; add to the bowl with the carrot.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems, roughly chop the leaves, and add to the bowl with the veggies. Stir to combine the salad.
Peel and mince garlic. Roughly chop peanuts.
When the tofu is golden brown, add garlic and peanuts to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Fill each wrap with salad and tofu-peanut mixture; drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

name: Asian Tuna Fritters with Spicy Mayo & Pineapple-Cucumber Salad

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Divide both between two medium bowls, then set one bowl aside for the salad.
Drain tuna, removing as much liquid as possible. Add to the remaining bowl with the ginger and garlic, then flake with a fork.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl, along with egg, mayo, bread crumbs, soy sauce, and crushed red pepper, then stir to combine.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, using a ¼-cup measure, form the tuna mixture into ½-inch thick fritters and place on a plate.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fritters and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.

Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the reserved medium bowl with the ginger and garlic, along with vinegar, sesame seeds, soy sauce, honey, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 1-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Juice lime into a small bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime juice, along with mayo, hot sauce, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the spicy mayo.
To serve, divide fritters and salad between plates or bowls. Drizzle fritters with spicy mayo and enjoy!

name: Asparagus & Chickpea Rice Bowl with Almonds & Lemon Vinaigrette

instructions.text: Rinse the rice in a colander and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears on an angle into 2-inch pieces. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until the liquid is absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Remove from the heat and let the rice stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel and halve the shallot lengthwise; thinly slice crosswise.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shallot and chickpeas to the skillet and stir to coat in the oil; cook, stirring occasionally, until the chickpeas are lightly browned and the shallot is softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions on an angle into ¼-inch pieces.

Add the asparagus and ½ of the onions (save the rest for garnishing) to the skillet; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the asparagus is bright green and tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic.
Juice the lemon into a small bowl. Add the minced garlic, olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Measure out the almonds.
Divide the rice between bowls and top with the asparagus and chickpea mixture. Sprinkle with the almonds and remaining green onions and drizzle with the dressing. Enjoy!

name: Asparagus, Egg & Bacon Salad with Walnuts & Dijon Vinaigrette

instructions.text: Place the eggs into a medium saucepan, fill about halfway with water, and bring to a boil. Once boiling, cook them for 5 minutes. Then remove to a bowl and cover with cold water or ice. Keep the saucepan on the burner for cooking the asparagus after.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Add the bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a cutting board.
Wash the asparagus and snap (or cut) off woody ends. Cut on an angle into 2 inch pieces.
Once eggs have been removed, add asparagus to the boiling water and cook until tender and bright green, 2-3 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to stop it from cooking further. Set aside.
In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Roughly chop the walnuts.
Peel the eggs and quarter lengthwise. Chop the bacon into smaller pieces.
