To serve, arrange asparagus, eggs, bacon, and walnuts on a plate and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Asparagus Frittata with Blue Cheese & Pecans

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Wash and snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus; cut into 2-inch pieces.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
When skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat bottom. Add the onion and garlic; cook, stirring frequently, until softened and lightly browned, 3-4 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, water, salt, pepper, and half the cheese.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Add more butter to the skillet, followed by the asparagus. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 2-3 minutes.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.

Spread out the asparagus evenly in the skillet. Reduce heat to medium-low and pour in the egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Sprinkle with the remaining cheese. Place skillet in the oven until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
Roughly chop the pecans.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and place on a plate; sprinkle with pecans. Enjoy!

name: Asparagus, Goat Cheese & Lemon Pasta with Pine Nuts & Chives

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Wash asparagus, snap off woody ends, and cut diagonally into 2 inch pieces. Add to pasta during the final 2-3 minutes of cooking time. Boil until bright green and tender-crisp.
Wash lemon and grate 1 tsp of zest. Wash and chop chives into small pieces.
Heat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add butter to saucepan and let it melt. Add flour and whisk until smooth.
Add broth and, stirring constantly, cook until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add zest, lemon juice, goat cheese, ½ of the chives (save the rest for garnishing), and salt. Stir until smooth. Remove from heat.
Drain pasta and asparagus and return to saucepan.
Add sauce to pasta and toss.
Cut remaining ½ lemon into wedges.
To serve, place pasta in a bowl or on a plate. Garnish with pine nuts, remaining chives, freshly ground pepper, and lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Asparagus Soup with Chicken Slices & Garlicky Grape Tomatoes

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash the asparagus and snap (or cut) off the woody ends. Cut off about 2 inches of the tips and reserve in a bowl. Chop the remaining stalks into 1 inch pieces.
Peel and thinly slice the shallots into rings. Peel and mince the garlic.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add butter to the saucepan and swirl to coat bottom. Add reserved asparagus tips and cook until slightly softened, 2-3 minutes. Transfer back to the bowl and set aside.

Once tips have been removed, add more butter to the saucepan followed by asparagus stalks, shallots, and garlic. Season with salt and pepper. Increase heat to medium-high and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
Wash and dry the spinach; set aside.
Wash the tomatoes. Peel and mince the remaining garlic.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Slice the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add oil to skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add spinach to the asparagus and mix. Pour in the broth and bring to a boil. Turn heat off and purée with a hand (immersion) blender.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add olive oil and garlic to the skillet; cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Reduce heat to low. Add the tomatoes and vinegar; cook, stirring frequently, until the vinegar has thickened slightly and the tomatoes have begun to burst, 4-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Slice chicken on an angle into bite-sized strips.
To serve, pour soup into a bowl, scatter the asparagus tips over top, and season with additional salt and pepper if desired. Place chicken slices on the side and top with tomatoes. Enjoy!

name: Asparagus, Strawberry & Arugula Salad with Goat Cheese & Almonds

instructions.text: Wash asparagus, snap off woody ends, and cut diagonally into 2 inch pieces.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add asparagus and, stirring occasionally, cook until tender and bright green, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry arugula. Wash, trim stem ends, and thinly slice strawberries.
In a large bowl, combine and toss arugula, strawberries, and asparagus.
To serve, arrange salad on a plate, crumble goat cheese over top, sprinkle with almonds, and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Asparagus, Tomato & Feta Frittata

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil.
Peel and mince garlic. Wash asparagus and snap off woody ends. Cut diagonally into 2 inch pieces. Wash and medium dice tomato.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, water, dill, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add asparagus and cook until tender crisp, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: about 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add tomato and cook for another 2 minutes.

Pour in egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 8-10 minutes.
Sprinkle feta over top. Place skillet in the oven under the broiler until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, cut frittata into wedges and place on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Avocado Caprese Salad with Grilled Chicken

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium heat.
Slice the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Coat the grill or skillet with oil. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel and mince the garlic. In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together the minced garlic, olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice the flesh crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Wash the tomatoes and basil. Halve the tomatoes. Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and thinly slice the leaves crosswise into ribbons.
Thinly slice the mozzarella.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) ball fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the mixed greens.
Slice the chicken crosswise on a angle.
Arrange a bed of the mixed greens on a plate, top with the tomatoes, avocado slices, mozzarella, and chicken. Sprinkle with basil and drizzle with balsamic vinaigrette. Enjoy!

name: Avocado Chicken Soup with Lime & Cilantro

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash jalapeño and tomatoes. Seed and mince jalapeño. Medium dice tomatoes.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add oil to saucepan and swirl to coat bottom. Add onion and jalapeño; cook, stirring frequently, until tender, 2-3 minutes.
Add garlic and tomatoes to saucepan; cook for about 1 minute.
Slice chicken in half horizontally into thin fillets.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add broth, cumin, salt, and pepper to saucepan.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Place chicken in liquid and bring to a boil. Reduce heat back to medium, cover, and cook until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Once cooked, transfer chicken to a plate.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and chop the leaves.
Halve and pit avocado. Spoon out the flesh and medium dice.
Shred or dice chicken and return to saucepan. Stir in ¾ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing) and lime juice.
Cut remaining ½ lime to wedges.
Serve soup in a bowl, stir in avocado, and garnish with remaining cilantro and lime wedges.

name: Avocado-Lime Chicken Salad & Cheddar Rolls

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place chicken in a medium saucepan. Cover with water by 1-inch and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot. Place in a small bowl along with the vinegar and salt; set aside.
Once the water in the pan is boiling, turn heat down to medium and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve and pit the avocado and scoop out into a medium bowl. Mash with a fork until smooth.
Juice lime into the bowl with the avocado.
Trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces and add to the bowl.
Coarsely grate cheese and add to the bowl.
Add yogurt and spices to the bowl and stir to combine.
Drain vinegar from the shallots and add to the bowl with the avocado mixture.
When the chicken is done, drain and shred with a fork. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
Divide chicken salad between tortillas and spread out in an even layer. Roll up tightly and slice in half.
To serve, divide rolls between plates and enjoy!

name: Avocado, Shrimp & Corn Salad with Cilantro-Lime Dressing

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals, then set the colander aside, allowing the shrimp to drain. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.)
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Trim off and discard the root end of the lettuce and remove any blemished leaves; halve the lettuce lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Transfer to a large bowl.
Halve the grape tomatoes lengthwise; transfer to a small bowl.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a small bowl.
Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry, then transfer to a medium bowl.

Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add ½ of the cilantro to the shrimp and transfer the other ½ to a small bowl (that you'll use for the dressing).
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add the garlic to the bowl with the shrimp.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, juice the lime; add ½ of the lime juice to the bowl with the shrimp and the other ½ to the bowl with the cilantro.
Season the shrimp with chili powder, salt, and pepper; toss to combine in the marinade.
Once the skillet is heated, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the corn to the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the corn is lightly browned and tender, 2 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a small bowl.
Add olive oil, salt, and pepper to the small bowl with the cilantro and lime juice; whisk together and set aside.

Once the corn has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet, followed by the shrimp. Cook until they are pink and opaque, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Once done, remove the skillet from the heat.
To serve, arrange a bed of the chopped romaine on a plate, top with the tomatoes, avocado, corn, and shrimp, and drizzle with the dressing. Enjoy!

name: Bacon-Blackberry Pita Pizza with Basil, Tomato & Peach Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place blackberries in a small bowl along with spices, then gently crush with a fork or potato masher. Set blackberry sauce aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Arrange pitas on a baking sheet pan. Spread blackberry sauce over each pita (leaving a ½-inch border around the edge), then top with cheese and crispy bacon.
Place pizzas in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until the pitas are crisp and cheese is melted, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter peach lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad (reserving a small handful for the pizzas).
When the pizzas are done, remove from the oven and sprinkle with reserved basil; cut into wedges.
To serve, divide pizzas and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Bacon & Brussels Sprouts Salad with Parmesan & Bacon-Maple Vinaigrette

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Chop bacon into smaller pieces.
Add bacon to skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Transfer the bacon to a large bowl and pour ⅛ cup of the fat from the skillet into a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. To prepare the dressing, add the minced garlic, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to reserved bacon fat. Whisk together until well combined. Set aside.
Wash brussels sprouts and trim rough ends. Shred by slicing thinly or using a mandoline slicer; add to bowl with bacon.
Roughly chop almonds and add to bowl.
Grate ¼ cup of Parmesan and add to bowl.
Add dressing to salad and toss until well combined.
Serve on a plate or in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Bacon, Goat Cheese, Onion Pizza with Balsamic Glaze & Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.

Place vinegar and sugar in a small saucepan over medium-high heat; stir until sugar is dissolved. Continue to cook, stirring often, until reduced by about half, or until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Coarsely chop bacon and transfer to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes.
While the bacon is cooking, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon from the skillet and transfer to a small bowl (leave cooking liquids in the skillet).
Return skillet to medium-high heat; add onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized, about 7 minutes. Remove from heat.

Place flatbreads on a baking sheet pan and drizzle with oil; top each flatbread with crumbled goat cheese, bacon, and onion. Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until flatbread become golden and crispy, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry arugula (skip if it came pre-washed). Transfer arugula to a medium bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper; toss to combine the salad and set aside.
Wash, dry, and slice lemon into wedges.
When pizzas are done, remove from the oven; top each with a small handful of arugula salad and drizzle on balsamic glaze.
Divide pizzas and remaining arugula salad between plates. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing over the salad. Enjoy!

name: Bacon, Lettuce, Avocado & Tomato Sandwich with Mixed Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, turning occasionally, until crispy, 6-8 minutes. Using tongs, transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl with the dressing.

Separate lettuce leaves; set aside 1 leaf per sandwich and chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add chopped lettuce to the bowl, along with broccoli slaw, and toss to combine the salad; set aside.
Slice tomato into thin rounds.
Halve and pit avocado; cut crosswise while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
Toast bread if desired.
Spread mayo over each bread slice; layer half of the slices with lettuce, tomato, avocado, and bacon. Place remaining slices on top to close sandwiches.
To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!

name: Bacon & Pineapple Hawaiian Pita Pizza

instructions.text: Peel and slice the onion into thin half rings.
Wash and dry the pineapple. Cut skin off pineapple, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Chop the bacon into small pieces. Add to the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-4 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and transfer to a paper towel lined plate.
Peel and mince garlic.
In a medium bowl, combine garlic, tomato sauce, and spices. Stir to combine and set aside.
Preheat your oven to broil.
Grate the mozzarella.
To assemble, top the pitas with a thin layer of tomato sauce, cheese, red onion, and pineapple. Place on a baking sheet and cook in the oven for 2-3 minutes, until the cheese melts.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
Remove from oven and top with bacon and cilantro leaves. Enjoy!

name: Bacon, Snap Pea & Asparagus Broth with Minted Ricotta Toast

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; place in a medium bowl.
Halve snap peas crosswise. Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch pieces. Add both to the bowl with the onion and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the pan is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes.
When the bacon is done, add veggies to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.

Add broth and spices to the pan; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, about 5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl along with ricotta, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Toast bread if desired; spread with half of the minted ricotta (reserve remaining minted ricotta for the soup).
When the soup is done, add the remaining minted ricotta, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide soup between bowls; serve with lemon wedges and toast on the side. Enjoy!

name: Bacon, Tomato & Dijon Grilled Cheese Sandwich with Mixed Greens Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Slice tomato crosswise into thin rounds.
Place bread slices on a flat surface. Spread half of the bread with Dijon, then layer with cheddar, tomato, and bacon. Cover sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more oil to the skillet. Return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes more. Once done, transfer to a cutting board and slice in half.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add mixed greens to the bowl with dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!

name: Bacon Wrapped Halibut with Roasted Potatoes & Brussels Sprout Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter potatoes and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet on lower rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until potatoes are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon juice, along with oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Pat halibut dry with paper towels, cut into portions (if necessary), and transfer to another baking sheet. Season with spices, then wrap 2 slices of bacon around each portion; drizzle with oil.
Place baking sheet on upper rack of the oven and roast until the fish is almost cooked through, about 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, thinly slice Brussels sprouts crosswise and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Finely grate Parmesan and add to the bowl.
Add almonds to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
When the fish is almost cooked through, change oven setting to broil on high, and continue to cook until the bacon is crisp and fish is cooked through, about 5 minutes.
To serve, divide halibut, potatoes, and Brussels sprout salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Bacon-Wrapped Mini Meatloaves with Roasted Asparagus & Bell Pepper

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Arrange racks in the upper and middle positions.
Cut bacon in half crosswise and place on a plate.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl along with beef, Dijon, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine.

Using 2 generous tablespoons per meatloaf, form the beef mixture into 8 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 3-inches long. Wrap each meatloaf with bacon and transfer, seam-side down, to a baking sheet pan.
Place baking sheet on the top rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until meatloaves are just cooked through, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; transfer spears to another baking sheet.

Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper; slice lengthwise into thin strips and add to the baking sheet with the asparagus. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet on the lower rack of the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the meatloaves are done, change oven to broil on high; broil until bacon is crisp, about 2 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide meatloaves and veggies between plates; enjoy!

name: Baked Beef Meatballs with Tomato "Red Sauce," Parmesan & Broccoli

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Place oven racks in the upper and middle positions.

Wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet on the upper rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until broccoli is golden brown and tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems. Mince the leaves and place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Finely grate Parmesan. Add half to the bowl with the basil. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)

Add beef, bread crumbs, egg, and spices to the bowl with the basil and Parmesan; use your hands to combine the beef mixture. Using a tablespoon measure, form the mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place tomato sauce and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the sauce.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning often, until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through).

Add tomato sauce to the skillet with the meatballs and stir to coat. Place skillet on the middle rack of the oven and bake until meatballs are cooked through and sauce is warm, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide meatballs and broccoli between plates or bowls. Top meatballs with reserved Parmesan and basil. Enjoy!

name: Baked Beef & Zucchini Meatballs with Smoky Bacon-Fried Cabbage

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of oil.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)

Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Add to the bowl with the parsley along with beef, Worcestershire, and spices; mix with your hands until well combined. Using a generous tablespoon measure, form the beef mixture into rounded meatballs. Transfer to the baking dish.
Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until golden and cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Place in a clean medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.
When the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and crispy, 4-5 minutes.
When the bacon is done, add cabbage and spices to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is tender, 6-8 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide meatballs and bacon-fried cabbage between plates or bowls. Sprinkle with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Baked Black Bean & Cheddar "Mexican Pizza" with Pico de Gallo

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F and coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Meanwhile, preheat a small saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add broth, tomato paste, and spices to the pan. Bring to a simmer, whisking frequently, and cook until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove sauce from the heat and set aside.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, drain and rinse the beans in a colander.
Place beans and spices in a medium bowl. Crush with a fork or potato masher until almost smooth, with some texture remaining; set aside.
Coarsely grate cheddar.
Place half the tortillas on the baking sheet and spread with bean filling; place remaining tortillas on top, pressing gently to adhere. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Spoon sauce over the tortillas and top with cheese. Place in the oven and bake until the cheese is melted and bubbly, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into the reserved bowl and add salt.
Small dice tomatoes. Peel and small dice onion; add both to the bowl with the lime.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the pico de gallo.
Remove pizzas from the oven and cut into quarters.
Divide pizzas between plates; top with pico de gallo and yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Baked Buffalo Chicken with Sautéed Carrot, Celery & Blue Cheese Sauce

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Place mayo and hot sauce in a small bowl, then stir to combine the spicy mayo.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Arrange on the baking sheet, then season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Spread spicy mayo over the top side of the chicken, then sprinkle with bread crumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and peel carrots. Using a clean cutting board, trim and slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash, dry, trim, and slice celery crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; sauté until fork-tender, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place blue cheese, yogurt, mayo, vinegar, sugar, and spices in the reserved bowl. Stir to combine the blue cheese sauce.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates. Drizzle with blue cheese sauce and additional hot sauce. Enjoy!

name: Baked Cajun-Spiced Cod with Bacon, Bell Pepper, Asparagus & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears in half crosswise. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper. Add to the baking sheet with the asparagus. Drizzle veggies with oil, season with salt and pepper, then spread out on one half of the baking sheet.
Pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into portions (if necessary). Season with spices on both sides. Transfer to the other half of the baking sheet.
Small dice bacon, then sprinkle over the cod.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake, stirring veggies halfway through, until cod is cooked through, bacon is crisp, and veggies are tender, 12-15 minutes.
Remove baking sheet from the oven, then juice lemon over the cod and veggies.
To serve, divide cod, veggies, and rice between plates. Enjoy!

name: Baked Cheddar Chicken Thighs with Mushrooms, Bell Peppers & Broccoli

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Place spices in a medium bowl and stir to combine.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Sprinkle half of the spices over both sides to coat. (Reserve remaining spice mix for the veggies.)

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and almost cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove mushroom stem and carefully scrape out the gills. Medium dice and add to the bowl with the remaining spice mix.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl.
Return skillet to medium heat. Add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and remaining spice mix. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut cream cheese into small pieces. Coarsely grate cheddar.
When the veggies are soft, add cream cheese to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until melted and combined.
Nestle chicken into the veggies and top with cheddar. Place skillet in the oven and bake until cheese is melted and chicken is cooked through, 7-8 minutes.
To serve, divide cheesy chicken and veggies between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Baked Chicken Katsu with Steamed Rice & Scallion-Cucumber-Apple Slaw

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk the egg. Place flour and bread crumbs on two separate plates.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Dredge chicken fillets in flour, shake off excess, then dip into the bowl with the egg. Let the excess drip off, then dredge the chicken fillets in the bread crumbs, pressing to adhere. Transfer to the baking sheet.

Place in the oven and bake for 12 minutes. Increase oven temperature to 450°F and continue to bake until the crust is golden brown and the chicken is cooked through, 4-6 minutes more. Watch carefully because the bread crumbs can burn quickly.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic; place in a large bowl along with vinegar, oil, honey, and salt. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; thinly slice into match-like sticks. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Core, quarter, and cut the apple into thin match-like sticks. Add to the bowl.
Trim off and discard ends of the green onions. Slice onions lengthwise into long, thin strips, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw.
In a small bowl, prepare the katsu sauce by whisking together ketchup, Worcestershire, sugar, and sesame seeds.
Slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide rice, chicken, and slaw between bowls and drizzle with katsu sauce. Enjoy!

name: Baked Chicken with Puttanesca Sauce & Parmesan-Pine Nut Kale Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add pine nuts and cook, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt on both sides.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until chicken is golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice garlic; mince the anchovy fillets. Place both in a medium bowl.
Halve olives. Add to bowl with the garlic and anchovies along with capers and crushed red pepper.

Return skillet to medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add olive mixture and cook, stirring frequently, until garlic is fragrant, about 1 minute. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Add tomatoes and salt to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until simmering, about 1 minute. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 12-15 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl, along with cooled pine nuts, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the puttanesca sauce and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving).
To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Top chicken with puttanesca sauce and reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Baked Chicken Thighs with Quinoa, Tomato-Pepper Ragout, Capers & Feta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry tomatoes; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Wash, dry, trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper; add to the baking sheet with the tomatoes.
Peel and large dice onion; add to the baking sheet.
Peel and mince garlic; sprinkle over the veggies.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides. Nestle chicken into the veggies on the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Transfer the baked chicken to a clean plate.
Sprinkle capers over roasted veggies and stir to combine the ragout.
To serve, divide quinoa, chicken thighs, and ragout between plates; top with feta and enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Baked Cod Fillet with Bread Crumb Topping, Zucchini & Tomatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.

Wash zucchini, tomatoes, and lemon. Trim ends and halve the zucchini crosswise; cut each ½ into 6-8 wedges. Cut the tomatoes and ½ of the lemon (save the rest for the topping) into wedges. Transfer to a sheet pan.
Peel, mince, and add garlic to the vegetables. Drizzle with oil and season with parsley flakes, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Place fish on top of vegetables and season with salt and pepper.
Grate zest from remaining ½ lemon. In a small bowl, prepare topping by mixing together zest, bread crumbs, oil, dill, salt, and pepper. Spoon topping over top fish.
Place in the oven and bake until fish is white and flaky, 10-15 minutes.
To serve, place on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Baked Cod with Peppers, Olives, Capers & Lemony Pine Nut-Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until peppers are charred in spots, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve olives lengthwise. Place in a small bowl along with capers and vinegar; stir to combine and set aside until the peppers are ready.
When the peppers are charred, remove from oven. Reduce temperature to 400°F.
Spoon olive mixture over the peppers and stir to combine; spread back out in an even layer.
Pat the cod dry with paper towels and arrange on top of the peppers. Drizzle with additional oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Return baking sheet to the oven and bake until fish flakes easily with a fork, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice half of the lemon into a medium bowl. Cut remaining lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with additional oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Add arugula and pine nuts to the bowl with the dressing, then toss to combine. Set aside.
Using a peeler, shave the Parmesan into curls. Set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. When the fish is done, remove from oven and top with parsley.
Divide peppers, fish, and salad between plates. Top the salad with Parmesan and serve with lemon wedges for squeezing over the fish. Enjoy!

name: Baked Curry Chicken with Creamy Coconut Sauce & Chili-Lime Veggies

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Add to the baking sheet with the cauliflower.

Peel and mince garlic. Add to the baking sheet along with oil, salt, and pepper (if coconut oil is solid, melt in a small saucepan over low heat). Stir to coat the veggies, then spread out in an even layer.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and season with spices on both sides. Nestle chicken into the veggies on the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring veggies and flipping chicken halfway through, until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and additional garlic. Place both in a small saucepan along with coconut milk and spices. Stir to combine the sauce.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Set pan over high heat and bring sauce to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until reduced by half, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.

While the sauce is simmering, thinly slice chili pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. (Be careful with chili peppers; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.) Place in a small bowl.
Zest and juice lime into the bowl with the chili pepper.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine.
Once the veggies are tender, remove from oven and transfer chicken to a plate. Sprinkle chili-lime mixture over the veggies and toss to coat.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates; spoon coconut sauce over chicken. Enjoy!

name: Baked Eggs with Eggplant-Basil Ratatouille, Feta & Garlic Toast

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and medium dice eggplant and zucchini; place both in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Roughly chop tomato; add both to the bowl with the eggplant and zucchini.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion lengthwise into strips. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring often, until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add veggies and spices to the skillet; reduce heat to medium and cover. Cook, stirring halfway through, until softened, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; set aside.
Peel and mince additional garlic.
Split rolls in half and place on a baking sheet pan, cut-side up. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with garlic and spices. Place in the oven and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes; remove from oven.
When the veggies are ready, stir basil into the ratatouille (reserving a small handful for garnish).

Using a stirring spoon, make a well for each egg in the ratatouille; crack an egg into each well. Cook until the egg whites are almost cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Cover skillet with a lid and cook for 1 minute more.
Divide ratatouille and eggs between plates or bowls; top with feta and reserved basil. Serve with garlic toast on the side and enjoy!

name: Baked Garlic-Herb Chicken Wings with Greek Salad with Feta

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 475°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Peel and mince garlic.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and transfer to the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil, sprinkle with garlic, and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince additional garlic; place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and slice shallot into thin rings; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; medium dice tomato. Add both to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Add olives and feta to the bowl; stir to combine the salad and set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Baked Gremolata-Crusted Cod with Potatoes, Zucchini, Peppers & Olives

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter potatoes and transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel, halve, and large dice onion. Add to the baking sheet with the potatoes, then drizzle with oil and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until the potatoes start to soften, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and large dice zucchini. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the zucchini and set aside.
Zest lemon into a small bowl. Juice lemon into another small bowl.

Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the lemon zest and half to the bowl with the lemon juice. (Set the bowl with the lemon juice aside for later use.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon zest along with bread crumbs, oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the gremolata topping.
Pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into portions (if necessary). Sprinkle cod with gremolata topping, pressing gently to adhere.

Once the potatoes have softened, remove from oven. Add zucchini and bell pepper to the baking sheet, stir to combine, and spread out in an even layer. Add cod to the baking sheet, nestling it into the veggies.
Continue to bake until veggies are fork-tender, gremolata topping is golden brown, and cod is cooked through, 8-10 minutes more.
Meanwhile, add yogurt, mayo, and salt to the bowl with the lemon juice. Stir to combine the sauce.
When the cod is done, remove baking sheet from the oven. Add olives to the veggies and stir to combine.
Divide cod and veggies between plates or bowls. Serve with sauce on the side and enjoy!

name: Baked Italian Salmon with Balsamic Tomato-Pepper & Basil Bruschetta

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F and position rack in the upper third of the oven. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean-up easier (optional).

Place vinegar and sugar in a small saucepan, then bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Remove balsamic glaze from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, pat salmon dry with paper towels. Transfer to the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, and season the top side with spices.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until salmon is cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the salmon is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve grape tomatoes. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Add both to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the bruschetta mixture and set aside.
When the salmon is done, change oven to broil on high. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Arrange bread on another baking sheet. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until lightly toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
To serve, divide salmon and toast between plates. Top toast with the bruschetta mixture, drizzle with balsamic glaze, and enjoy!

name: Baked Italian Sausage, Tomato & Mushroom Skillet with Sautéed Cabbage

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, quarter mushrooms; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Add flour to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, 1 minute more.
Add tomatoes, broth, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine, then bring to a simmer.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once simmering, nestle sausages into the veggies and place skillet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated). Bake, flipping sausages once, until golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard root end of the cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
Preheat another skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cabbage and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Once the cabbage is done, add pine nuts and parsley to the skillet; stir to combine. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
To serve, divide veggie skillet and sautéed cabbage between plates or bowls; top with sausages and enjoy!

name: Baked Lemon Garlic Tilapia & Red Peppers with Green Onion Hash Browns

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice half the lemon into a small bowl; slice the other half into rounds and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil and spices; whisk to combine.
Pat tilapia dry with paper towels and place on one side of a large baking sheet.
Seed and thinly slice the bell peppers. Add to the other side of the baking sheet, in a single layer.
Drizzle oil mixture over the fish and veggies. Place in the oven and bake until the fish is cooked through and the peppers are tender, about 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, peel and coarsely grate potatoes into a large bowl filled with cold water. Stir until the water is cloudy, drain, and add the potatoes back to the bowl. Cover potatoes with more cold water, stir, and drain once more. Pat dry with paper towels, squeezing out excess moisture.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add potatoes, half of the green onions, and spices; stir to combine, then flatten out in an even layer.
Cook potatoes, without stirring, until a brown crust forms on the bottom, 4-5 minutes. Stir and continue to cook hash browns until tender, 5 more minutes.
To serve, divide fish, bell peppers, and hash browns between plates. Garnish with remaining green onion and lemon slices. Enjoy!

name: Baked Mediterranean Salmon Parcels with Lemon-Dill Roasted Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut each potato lengthwise into 10-12 thin wedges, then transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Juice half of the lemon over the potatoes. Slice remaining lemon into thin rounds and set aside.
Using a knife, shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Sprinkle half of the dill over the potatoes and toss to coat (set remaining dill aside for garnish).
Place the potatoes on the lower rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.

Meanwhile, place two 12-inch x 12-inch squares of parchment, side by side, on a flat surface with a corner pointing up (in a diamond shape). If counter space is limited, you can overlap parchment corners by 3-4 inches, leaving a space in the center for each fish fillet.
Pat the fish dry with paper towels, then place one fillet, skin-side down, on top of each parchment square. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Peel and mince garlic, then sprinkle over each fillet.
Peel and thinly slice shallot; lay over each fillet.
Halve the olives lengthwise. Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes. Sprinkle both over each fillet.

Layer lemon slices over each fillet. Loosely pull the top and bottom corners of each piece of parchment towards the center, then roll and fold towards the center to seal. Loosely tuck the opposite sides of the parchment underneath each fillet; transfer fish parcels to another baking sheet pan.
Reduce oven to 400°F. Place fish on the upper rack of the oven and bake until opaque and easily flakes with a fork, about 12 minutes.
To serve, divide fish parcels and potatoes between plates. Open the parcels, garnish with reserved dill, and enjoy!

name: Baked Parmesan Cod with Parsley Mayo over Warm Lentil & Veggie Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (optional) and coat with a thin layer of oil.

Using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan; add water and salt. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove lid, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan and place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the Parmesan along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the topping.
Pat fish dry with paper towels and transfer to the baking sheet. Using the back of a spoon, evenly spread each fillet with the topping. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until topping is golden and fish is cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the fish is baking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince shallot; place in the reserved bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the shallot.
Trim and small dice cucumber; small dice tomatoes. Add both to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl and set aside. (Reserve remaining parsley for the next step.)
Place reserved parsley in a small bowl along with mayo and salt; stir to combine the parsley mayo and set aside.
When the lentils are done, drain in a colander and transfer to the bowl with the veggies. Add vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the lentil salad.
To serve, divide lentil salad and fish between plates; spoon parsley mayo over fish and enjoy!

name: Baked Popcorn Chicken with Sweet & Spicy Snap Pea-Broccoli Sauté

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional) and coat with a thin layer of oil.
Finely grate Parmesan. Place in a medium bowl, along with bread crumbs and pepper, then stir to combine. Set aside.
Place egg in another medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork until smooth.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, add to the bowl with the egg, and stir to coat.

Working in batches, use a slotted spoon to allow excess egg to drip off the chicken before transferring to the bowl with the bread crumb mixture. Turn to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Transfer breaded chicken to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until popcorn chicken is golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small bowl along with soy sauce, vinegar, honey, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and cornstarch. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper along with snap peas.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and stir-fry until just tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.

When the veggies are just tender, add sauce and half of the green onions to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is thickened slightly, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
To serve, divide the veggies and sauce between plates or bowls. Top with popcorn chicken and sprinkle with reserved green onions. Enjoy!

name: Baked Prosciutto-Wrapped Jalapeño Poppers with Spinach & Tomato Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil and coat with a thin layer of oil; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Using a box grater, coarsely grate cheddar and cream cheese into the bowl with the cilantro; add spices and mash with a fork or the back of a spoon to combine. Set aside.
Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)

Using a rounded tablespoon measure, fill each jalapeño half with the cheese mixture. Wrap one slice of prosciutto around each jalapeño half and place on the baking sheet, cheese-side facing up. (Wipe bowl clean with paper towels and reserve for later use.)
Place jalapeño poppers in the oven and bake until golden and crispy, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Right before serving, add spinach to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide jalapeño poppers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Baked Sesame Halibut with Apple-Cabbage Slaw & Avocado Mash

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Pat the fish dry with paper towel.
Combine flour, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. In another small bowl, whisk the egg.
Combine bread crumbs and sesame seeds in a third bowl.
Dredge fish in flour, shake off excess, then dip into the bowl with the egg. Let the excess drip off, then dredge fish in the bread crumbs, pressing to adhere. Place on the baking sheet pan.
Once oven temperature has been reached, place fish in the oven and bake until golden brown and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, whisk together vinegar, oils, and spices in a medium bowl.
Halve the cabbage lengthwise and cut out the core; thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Core and julienne or coarsely grate the apple; add to the bowl.
Trim off and discard tops and root ends of radishes; halve and thinly slice. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw.
Halve and pit the avocado; cut the flesh into cubes while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon into a small bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl, add oil and soy sauce. Mash with a fork until smooth.
To serve, divide slaw between plates, top with halibut and avocado mash. Enjoy!

name: Baked Shrimp, Broccoli, Zucchini, Garlic & Feta Medley over Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a large baking dish.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half rounds. Add to the baking dish with the broccoli.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the baking dish, reserving a small amount for garnish.
Juice lemon over the veggies.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the baking dish along with shrimp and spices; toss to combine.
Cut butter into small pieces. Sprinkle feta over the shrimp and veggies; dot with butter.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until veggies are tender and shrimp is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide rice, shrimp, and veggies between plates. Top with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Baked Spaghetti Squash with Kale & Cannellini Bean Sauté

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place the rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds; Rub each half with olive oil and season with salt and freshly ground pepper. Place halves, cut side down, on a baking sheet.
Place the squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender so a knife can easily pierce though the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Drain and rinse the cannellini beans in a colander, then set aside to drain further.
Cut out and discard the stems from each kale leaf; chop the leaves crosswise into 1-inch strips. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the garlic and crushed red pepper to the skillet and stir until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add the kale and ⅛ cup of water to the skillet; cook, stirring constantly, until the kale is wilted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Add the beans to the skillet and season the mixture with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the beans are just heated through, 1-2 minutes.

Remove the squash from the oven; allow squash to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Using a fork, scrape up the squash flesh to make spaghetti-like strings (use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand).
Finely grate ½ cup of Parmesan.

To serve, divide the bean and kale mixture between the squash halves. Alternatively, spoon out the squash and divide between plates, then top with the bean and kale mixture. Sprinkle with the Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Baked Spicy Cajun Chicken with Creamed Corn & Green Beans

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Combine flour and spices in a large bowl.
Coat chicken with oil. Add drumsticks one by one to the bowl with the spices, rolling and pressing to adhere on all sides. Place chicken on the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add corn to the colander and rinse under hot water for several minutes to defrost. Set aside to drain.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add flour and whisk until smooth. Slowly add cream, whisking to make sure no lumps form. Stir in corn, salt, and pepper. Cover pan; remove from heat and set aside.
Wash green beans and trim ends.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add green beans to the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook, tossing frequently, until bright green and tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes. Remove from the heat.
To serve, divide the chicken, creamed corn, and green beans between plates. Enjoy!

name: Baked Thai-Style Peanut Chicken with Green Beans, Mushrooms & Rice

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the lime.
Add peanut butter, water, soy sauce, maple syrup, chili-garlic sauce, and oil to the bowl. Whisk to combine the peanut sauce and set aside.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim and cut green beans into 1-inch pieces. Add to the baking sheet with the onions.
Quarter mushrooms and add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with additional oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.

Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl; season with salt and pepper, then add half of the peanut sauce. Stir to coat, then add the chicken to the baking sheet, nestling it into the veggies. (Set remaining peanut sauce aside for serving.)
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring veggies halfway through, until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide rice, chicken, and veggies between plates. Spoon reserved sauce over the chicken and enjoy!

name: Baked Tilapia with Creamy Dijon Sauce & Carrot-Zucchini Rice Pilaf

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice zucchini. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
While the veggies are cooking, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water.

Add rice and water to the pan with the veggies, stir to combine, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the liquid comes to a boil, cover the pan and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is mostly absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a baking dish.
Add cream, capers, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the baking dish with the lemon. Whisk to combine the sauce.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Pat tilapia dry with paper towels and add to the baking dish in a single layer. Turn to coat fish in sauce, then place in the oven and bake until the fish is cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide rice pilaf and fish between plates; spoon sauce over fish. Enjoy!

name: Baked Tofu Rice Bowl with Edamame, Cilantro & Spicy Peanut Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Meanwhile, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, place oil and spices in a medium bowl; stir to combine the spice paste.
Medium dice tofu, add to the bowl with the spice paste, and gently toss to coat. Transfer tofu to a baking sheet and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until tofu is golden brown, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place peanut butter, soy sauce, water, vinegar, oil, and chili-garlic sauce in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; place on a plate.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the plate with the bell pepper.
Peel and thinly slice shallot lengthwise; add to the plate and set aside.
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain further.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide rice between bowls; top with baked tofu, bell pepper, carrot, shallot, edamame, and cilantro. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

name: Baked Zucchini Noodles with Turkey, Feta, Tomatoes, Olives & Basil

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim zucchini, then run a vegetable peeler along the length of the zucchini to make ribbons. Transfer to the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until zucchini is tender, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, halve grape tomatoes. Place in a small bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
When the turkey is done, add tomatoes, olives, basil, tomato sauce, feta, and pine nuts to the skillet. Stir to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, remove from heat.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide zucchini noodles between plates or bowls. Top with sauce and reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Balsamic Chicken Drumsticks with Garlic & Parsley Sautéed Carrots

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger. In a medium bowl, prepare marinade by whisking together ½ of the garlic and ginger (save the rest for the carrots), vinegar, honey, soy sauce, and pepper.
Make a couple cuts in each of the drumsticks. Add to bowl with marinade and toss to coat. Transfer to a small baking dish, reserving marinade in bowl.
Place in the oven and bake for 10 minutes. Spoon reserved marinade on top of chicken and continue baking until cooked through, another 20-25 minutes.
Wash and peel carrots. Slice diagonally into ¼ in pieces.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add remaining garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add carrots and season with salt and pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until carrots are tender-crisp and slightly browned, 8-10 minutes. If skillet gets too dry, add a little water.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Stir ½ (save the rest for garnishing) into the carrots.
To serve, place carrots on a plate, add drumsticks on top, and garnish with remaining parsley. Enjoy!

name: Balsamic Chicken Wrap with Goat Cheese, Cranberries & Lemony Arugula

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces; season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and sauté, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, crumble goat cheese into a small bowl and add cranberries; stir to combine and set aside.
Using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons.
When the chicken is done, use a slotted spoon to transfer it to a plate (leaving cooking juices in the skillet).
Return skillet to medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 4 minutes.
While the onion is cooking, trim off and discard tops and root ends of radishes; cut into matchsticks and add to the bowl with the dressing.

Add vinegar and sugar to the skillet with the onion; continue to cook, stirring constantly, until the vinegar is reduced, about 1 minute. Return chicken to the skillet (along with any accumulated juices), stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and radish; toss to combine.

Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide balsamic chicken between them; top with a small amount of salad and sprinkle with the goat cheese-cranberry mixture. Roll tightly to close and cut in half.
Divide wraps and remaining salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Balsamic Grilled Chicken with Classic Caprese Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a medium bowl (that will be used to marinade the chicken).
To the garlic, add olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Pat dry the chicken breasts with paper towels and place in the bowl with the marinade; turn to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
