instructions.text: Carefully place the chicken breasts in the grill pan / skillet; cook until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through (check doneness with a thermometer or cut into the chicken with a knife), 6 to 8 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the chicken to plate.
Slice the tomatoes crosswise into ¼-inch-thick rounds and arrange on a large plate.
Tear the mozzarella into small chunks with your hands and add on top of the tomato slices.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Pick the basil leaves off the stems; tear the leaves into small pieces with your hands and scatter on top of the tomato slices and mozzarella chunks.
Drizzle the salad with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Slice the chicken crosswise into strips.
To serve, divide the salad and chicken slices between plates. Enjoy!

name: Balsamic Grilled Chicken with Fresh Mozzarella & Avocado Salad Bowl

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ¼ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
To finish the marinade, add balsamic vinegar, olive oil, maple syrup, dried basil, and salt to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Transfer chicken to a shallow bowl. Pour half of the marinade over the chicken and stir until well coated. Set the remaining untouched marinade aside to use as salad dressing.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook until cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside to cool.
Chop romaine crosswise into strips and divide between bowls. Halve grape tomatoes and add to the bowls with the romaine.
Cut the fresh mozzarella into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowls.
amounts: ¼ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out and add to the bowls.
Slice chicken into strips and add to the bowls.
Pick leaves off the basil stems, roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons and sprinkle over top of the salad.
Drizzle with remaining dressing and enjoy!

name: Balsamic Grilled Chicken with Peach, Tomato & Basil Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the tomatoes lengthwise and cut out and discard the stem ends; cut the halves into thin wedges. Transfer to a large salad bowl.
Quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard the pits; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges. Add to the salad bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a medium bowl (that will be used to marinade the chicken).
To the garlic, add olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Pat dry the chicken breasts with paper towels and place in the bowl with the marinade; turn to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Carefully place the chicken breasts in the grill pan / skillet; cook until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through (check doneness with a thermometer or cut into the chicken with a knife), 6 to 8 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the chicken to plate.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise. Add to the salad bowl.

Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves into a chiffonade by stacking them and rolling tightly into a cigar, then slicing crosswise into thin ribbons. Add to the salad bowl.
Drizzle the salad with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, then season with salt and pepper; gently toss until well combined.
Slice the chicken crosswise into strips.
To serve, divide the salad and chicken slices between plates. Enjoy!

name: Balsamic Grilled Chicken & Strawberries with Cucumber-Basil Salad

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 2-4 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim strawberries, thread onto skewers, and place on a plate; drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the strawberries directly on the grill pan.)
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, add skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until strawberries are tender and lightly charred, about 4 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.

Meanwhile, place vinegar in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce to medium-low and simmer until reduced by half, about 5 minutes; remove balsamic reduction from heat and set aside.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on another plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

When the strawberries are done, return the grill pan to medium-high heat and coat with oil; add chicken and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Add to the plate with the strawberries, re-cover with foil, and set aside.
While the chicken is cooking, place mayo, vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken, strawberry skewers, and salad between plates; drizzle chicken and berries with balsamic reduction. Enjoy!

name: Balsamic Portobello Burger with Caramelized Onions & Side Salad

instructions.text: Peel, halve, and thinly slice the onion into half rings.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onions and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and caramelized, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, and Italian seasoning. Whisk to combine the marinade.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Remove mushroom stems and carefully scrape out the gills. Add to the bowl with the marinade and turn to coat. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, combine mayo, oil, Dijon, garlic powder, and salt in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the aioli and set aside.

Once the skillet is hot, add mushrooms and cook until soft, 3-5 minutes per side. (Reserve bowl with leftover marinade for the next step.) When mushrooms are cooked, slice the cheese, place on top of mushroom caps, and reduce heat to low. Cover and let cook until cheese melts, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, add oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, and salt to the bowl with leftover marinade. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Separate the lettuce leaves. Set aside 1 large leaf per burger; chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Medium dice half of the tomato and add to the salad bowl. Thinly slice remaining tomato and set aside.
Trim and medium dice the cucumber; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired. Spread aioli on bottom half of each bun; layer with reserved lettuce, tomato, mushrooms, and caramelized onions. Close with the top half.
To serve, divide burgers and salad between plates and enjoy!

name: Balsamic Portobello Salad with Pear, Edamame, Walnuts & Avocado

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Place frozen edamame in a medium bowl, cover with hot water (from the tap), and let sit 5 minutes. Drain in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel and mince garlic.
In a salad bowl, whisk together garlic, nutritional yeast, vinegar, oil, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Remove the mushroom stems and carefully scrape out the gills. Transfer to the salad bowl and toss to coat.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and slice the onion into rings; add to the bowl with the mushrooms and toss to coat.

Using tongs, transfer the mushrooms and onions to the grill pan, leaving the excess marinade in the bowl. Cook until vegetables are tender, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove from heat and transfer mushrooms to a cutting board to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, core and chop the pear; add to the salad bowl.
Add mixed greens, edamame, and walnuts to the salad bowl.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise and lengthwise while still in the skin and scoop out into the salad bowl.
Add onions to the salad and toss. Slice mushrooms into long strips.
To serve, divide the salad between plates and top with sliced mushrooms. Enjoy!

name: Balsamic Roasted Chicken-Peach Rice Bowl with Arugula & Lemon Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the baking sheet with the onion.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Add to the baking sheet, then drizzle with vinegar and oil. Season with spices, stir to coat, and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until chicken is cooked through and peaches are tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a small bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, and spices, then whisk to combine the sauce. Set aside.
Pick basil leaves off the stems. Using a clean cutting board, roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the chicken and peaches are done, remove from the oven. Add basil to the baking sheet and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice, roasted chicken, peaches, and arugula between bowls. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

name: Balsamic Roasted Mushrooms with Cheesy Garlic & Kale Mashed Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil (for easy clean-up).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel the garlic. Mince 1 clove and add to a small bowl; set the other cloves aside.
Add oil, vinegar, maple syrup, soy sauce, and spices to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the sauce.

Quarter mushrooms and place on the baking sheet. Drizzle with sauce and stir to coat, then spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake, stirring halfway through, until tender, about 15 minutes.
Large dice the potatoes. Transfer potatoes and remaining garlic cloves to a medium saucepan, cover with water, put on the lid, and bring to a boil.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems, then thinly slice crosswise into shreds.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, remove the lid and cook until the potatoes are almost done, about 8 minutes. Add kale to the pan and cook 2 minutes more.
Grate the cheese.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Once potatoes, garlic, and kale are done, drain and return to the saucepan.
Add oil, milk, yogurt, parsley, and spices to the saucepan with the potatoes and mash until almost smooth.
Stir cheese into the mashed potatoes and return to medium-high heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until melted, 1-2 minutes.
Trim off the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
To serve, divide mashed potatoes between bowls. Spoon mushrooms and their cooking juices over the potatoes and sprinkle with green onion. Enjoy!

name: Balsamic Roasted Pork with Grapes, Carrot Fritters & Basil Yogurt

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve grapes and place in a medium bowl.
Pat pork chops dry with paper towels. Large dice and add to the bowl with the grapes along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Stir to combine, transfer to a baking dish, and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway, until pork is cooked through and grapes are soft, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place egg, milk, and oil in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine.
Add flour, salt, and baking powder to the bowl with the egg mixture. Whisk once more until the batter is just combined.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the batter and gently stir until incorporated.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; flatten slightly with the back of a spoon. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a small bowl.

Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the lemon juice along with yogurt and spices. Stir to combine the yogurt sauce and set aside. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Divide pork, grapes, and carrot fritters between plates. Sprinkle pork with reserved basil and serve with yogurt sauce on the side. Enjoy!

name: Balsamic-Sage Halibut with Roasted Potatoes, Carrots & Broccoli

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and slice carrot crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Medium dice potatoes and add to the baking sheet with the carrot. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until potatoes and carrots are starting to soften, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a medium bowl, drizzle with additional oil, and season with salt; toss to coat.

When the potatoes and carrots are starting to soften, remove baking sheet from the oven. Add broccoli and stir to combine. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes more. Remove from oven. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat halibut dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season both sides with salt and pepper.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add halibut and pan-fry, turning once, until fish is cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
While the fish is cooking, peel and mince garlic. Place in the reserved bowl along with vinegar, oil, water, maple syrup, and spices. Stir to combine the sauce.
Return skillet to medium heat. Add sauce and cook, stirring constantly, until reduced by half, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide halibut and roasted veggies between plates. Drizzle fish with sauce and enjoy!

name: Balsamic Sausage Lettuce Wraps with Zucchini, Bell Pepper & Lemon Mayo

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, sausage, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly and veggies are tender, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a small bowl. Add mayo and spices, then whisk to combine the sauce. Set aside.
When the sausage and veggies are done, add vinegar to the skillet and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; top with sausage and veggies. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

name: Balsamic Steak with Arugula, Peach & Feta Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a medium bowl (that can hold the steak).
Add balsamic vinegar and olive oil to the garlic; whisk together.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the steak on a plate and generously season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Transfer the steak to the balsamic marinade and turn to coat; set aside.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan/skillet warms up, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Place the arugula in a medium bowl.
Quarter the peach, twist to open, and remove the pit. Slice each quarter into 4 wedges and add to the arugula; toss to combine.
Once the pan/skillet is warm, add coconut oil and brush or swirl to coat the bottom.

Remove the steak from the marinade and place in the pan/skillet; cook until desired doneness, 2 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil; let it rest for 5 minutes.
Place the feta into a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: In a small bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Transfer the steak to a cutting board and thinly slice against the grain.
To serve, place the steak slices on a plate and the salad on the side. Sprinkle the salad with feta and drizzle with the dressing. Enjoy!

name: Balsamic Tofu Veggie Kebabs with Quinoa & Minted Yogurt Sauce

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.

Peel and mince garlic. Wash and dry mint. Pick the leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. In a large bowl, prepare marinade by whisking together ½ of the garlic and mint (save the rest for the sauce), oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Drain and medium dice tofu; place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with marinade and toss to coat. Set aside.
Wash and dry bell pepper and mushrooms. Seed and large dice the bell pepper. Halve the mushrooms. Peel and large dice onion. Add vegetables to bowl with tofu and toss.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Thread tofu and vegetables onto skewers. Alternatively, you can cook the tofu and vegetable pieces directly on the grill/skillet without skewers.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add tofu and vegetables; cook, turning occasionally, until tofu is browned and vegetables are tender, 8-10 minutes total.
In a small bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together yogurt, salt, pepper, and remaining garlic and mint.
To serve, divide quinoa and kebabs between dishes. Enjoy with yogurt sauce on the side!

name: Bangers & Cauliflower Mash with Onion Gravy

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash cauliflower and cut off the leaves. Separate into small florets and cut the thick stem into smaller pieces. Transfer to a bowl.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Add sausages to skillet and cook until browned on all sides, 2-3 minutes. Reduce heat to medium, add water, and continue cooking until cooked (or heated) through, 6-8 minutes. Alternatively, cook according to package directions. Transfer to a plate.
Add cauliflower to boiling water and cook until very tender, 6-7 minutes.
Thinly slice onion into half rings.
Once sausages have been transferred, add butter and onion to skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until onion is softened and caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic.
Drain cauliflower in a colander, then return to saucepan. Add water, garlic, butter, salt, and pepper. Blend using a hand/immersion blender or a potato masher. Cover and set aside.
Sprinkle onions with cornstarch and mix until cornstarch is evenly incorporated with the onions.
Pour in broth and cook until mixture is thickened, 4-5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and chop the leaves.
Return sausages to skillet on top of the onion gravy and turn until heated through.
To serve, place cauliflower purée in a shallow bowl. Add sausages and top with onion gravy. Garnish with parsley and enjoy!

name: Barbeque Pulled Chicken Sliders with Creamy Cabbage Slaw

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 6 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Place a large pot over medium heat. Add broth, vinegar, sugar, and spices; stir to combine and bring to a gentle boil.
amounts: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To make the dressing, combine mayo, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl and set aside.
Add chicken to the pot and cover with a lid. Poach until chicken is cooked through, 12-15 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim carrot ends, peel, and grate. Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; slice crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add carrots and onions to the bowl with dressing.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into shreds and add to the bowl with the carrots. Toss the slaw until well coated.

When chicken thighs are cooked through, use tongs to transfer them to a plate, leaving the liquid in the pot. Increase the temperature to medium-high and stir the ketchup into the liquid. Simmer, stirring frequently, until liquid is reduced by half and can coat the back of a spoon, 4-5 minutes.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack in the center of the the oven.
Using two forks, shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces. When the sauce is reduced, add the chicken back to the pot and stir to coat.
Halve the buns and arrange them cut-side up on a baking sheet; toast until golden brown, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide the buns between plates, top the bottoms with chicken and some of the slaw; close with the top half of the bun. Serve with remaining slaw on the side. Enjoy!

name: Basil-Balsamic Drumsticks with Broccoli, Bell Pepper & Sweet Potato

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a baking dish.
Juice lemon into the baking dish with the garlic; add vinegar, oil, and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Add to the baking dish with the marinade and turn to coat.
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel, trim, and small dice sweet potato; add to the baking sheet with the broccoli.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into ½-inch thick strips; add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Add veggies to the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until lightly charred and fork-tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide drumsticks and veggies between plates; drizzle with sauce from the baking dish and enjoy!

name: Basil-Balsamic Spaghetti with Shrimp, Eggplant, Tomato & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes; drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Trim and medium dice eggplant.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add eggplant and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add half to the bowl with the garlic. (Reserve remaining basil for garnish.)
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
When the eggplant is done, add shrimp, garlic, basil, tomatoes, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are opaque, 2-3 minutes.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add drained pasta to the skillet and toss to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls; top with feta and reserved basil. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Basil-Ricotta Polenta Bowl with Peach, Tomato, Arugula & Almond Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 20 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta in a thin steady stream, while whisking, until the polenta is incorporated into the liquid. Cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and the texture is creamy, 15-25 minutes.
amounts: 20 fl oz (2 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Place oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice each quarter and add to the bowl; stir to combine.
Roughly chop almonds and set aside.
When the polenta is almost done, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add half of the basil to the bowl with the tomatoes and peaches (reserve the rest of the basil for the polenta).
Add arugula and almonds to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
When the polenta is done, add ricotta, salt, and pepper; whisk until smooth and creamy.
To serve, divide polenta and salad between bowls; sprinkle reserved basil over the polenta. Enjoy!

name: BBQ Black Bean Sandwich with Creamy Vegan Slaw

instructions.text: Peel and mince the onion.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion and garlic to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; add to the saucepan with the onion. Stir to combine.
Add the ketchup, vinegar, soy sauce, Dijon, brown sugar, and spices to the saucepan. Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, while you make the slaw.
In a large bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, and onion powder. Set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and peel the carrot, then julienne or coarsely grate. Add to the bowl with the cabbage.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions into ¼-inch pieces and add to the bowl with the cabbage. Stir to combine the veggies with the dressing and set aside.
Toast the buns if desired.
To serve, place the bottom half of a bun on each plate. Top with bean mixture and some of the slaw; close with top half of the bun. Serve with remaining slaw on the side. Enjoy!

name: BBQ Cannellini Beans with Pork Sausage & Creamy Napa Cabbage Coleslaw

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Arrange sausages on a baking sheet pan and place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated); bake, flipping once, until sausages are golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry cabbage. Trim off and discard the root end, halve lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash, dry, peel, and coarsely grate carrot; add to to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw. Set aside.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Peel and small dice onion.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse beans.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and onion; cook, stirring often, until starting to soften, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place water, ketchup, vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire, Dijon, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the BBQ sauce.
Add beans and BBQ sauce to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring often, until liquid has reduced to a saucy consistency, about 5 minutes.
When the sausages are done, transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into rounds. Add to the skillet with the beans, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide slaw, beans, and sausage between plates. Enjoy!

name: BBQ Chicken Pita Pizza with Bell Pepper, Onion & Cilantro

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Wash, dry, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the baking sheet.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer. Place veggies in the oven and bake until tender, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and small dice.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and chicken to the skillet and sauté until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, place tomato sauce, ketchup, Dijon, sugar, vinegar, Worcestershire, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine.

Pour sauce into the skillet with the chicken. (Reserve bowl for later use). Stir and bring to a simmer over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese.
Wash, dry, and, using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, carefully transfer them to the bowl used for the sauce and set aside.
Place pitas on the baking sheet. Return to oven and toast for 5 minutes.
Top toasted pitas with saucy chicken, cheese, and veggies. Return pitas to the oven and bake until the cheese melts, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide pitas between plates, top with cilantro, and enjoy!

name: BBQ Chicken Thighs with Romaine, Avocado, Corn & Creamy Ranch Salad

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then turn to coat.
Once the pan is hot, add chicken and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, and spices in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Place ketchup, vinegar, Worcestershire, Dijon, and spices in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
When the chicken is done, add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide salad and chicken between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: BBQ Chicken Wings with Tomato, Peach, Corn, Jalapeño & Basil Salad

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F.

Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Drizzle with oil and toss once more to coat. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, place ketchup, vinegar, Worcestershire, Dijon, and spices in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in another medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the shallot and garlic. Add oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the bowl.
Place corn in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
When the wings are done, add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide chicken wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: BBQ Pork Chops & Napa Cabbage "Wedge Salad" with Blue Cheese Dressing

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Place ketchup, Worcestershire, sugar, vinegar, Dijon, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the BBQ sauce.
Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a broiler pan. Pour ⅔ of the BBQ sauce over the chops and turn to coat. Set remaining sauce aside.
Place pork chops in the oven and broil until the tops start to brown and caramelize, about 6 minutes.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and spices in another small bowl; whisk until smooth.
Add blue cheese and stir to combine the dressing; set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Remove pork chops from the oven, flip, and coat with remaining BBQ sauce. Return to the oven and broil until cooked through, 6-8 minutes more. Remove from oven, loosely cover with foil, and rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage. Cut cabbage in half lengthwise, to make two wedges.
Quarter, core, and small dice apple.
Chop chives into small pieces.
To serve, divide pork chops and cabbage wedges between plates; top wedges with dressing, apples, and chives. Enjoy!

name: BBQ Pork Skewers with Sweet Potato-Parsnip Mash & Kale Salad

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and medium dice sweet potato and parsnip. Transfer to a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until veggies can be easily pierced with a fork, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, place ketchup, Worcestershire, sugar, vinegar, Dijon, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the BBQ sauce.

Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board; cut into 1-inch pieces. Thread pork onto skewers and place on a plate; alternatively, you can cook the pork pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pour half the BBQ sauce over the skewers and turn to coat. Reserve remaining sauce for serving.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add skewers and grill, rotating every 2½-3 minutes, until browned and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
When the sweet potatoes and parsnips are done, drain, and return to the pan.
Add milk, oil, salt, and pepper to the sweet potatoes and parsnips; mash until smooth. Cover and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl. Add oil and mash with the back of a spoon until soft and combined.
Add vinegar, Dijon, sugar, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the dressing.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Finely chop leaves and transfer to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork skewers, sweet potato-parsnip mash, and kale salad between plates. Top skewers with reserved BBQ sauce and enjoy!

name: BBQ Roasted Sausage, Carrot, Zucchini & Pepper Medley with Couscous

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and cut carrots crosswise into thin rounds; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the baking sheet with the carrot.
Trim and slice zucchini crosswise into thin rounds; add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Add sausages to the baking sheet, nestling them into the veggies.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender and sausages are cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the couscous is cooking, place tomato sauce, Dijon, vinegar, Worcestershire, sugar, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the BBQ sauce.
When the sausages and veggies are done, transfer sausages to a cutting board and slice crosswise into thin rounds.
Return sausages to the baking sheet with the veggies; drizzle with BBQ sauce, toss to combine, and spread out in an even layer.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until veggies and sauce are caramelized, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide sausage, veggies, and couscous between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: BBQ Shrimp, Zucchini & Corn over Cheddar Cauliflower Grits

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 14 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and cut cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate cauliflower.

Place cauliflower, broth, polenta, and salt in a medium saucepan. Stir and bring to a boil over high heat. Cover and reduce heat to medium-low; cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and the mixture has thickened, about 20 minutes.
amounts: 14 fl oz (1 ¾ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, place tomato sauce, ketchup, Dijon, sugar, vinegar, Worcestershire, and spices in a small saucepan. Stir and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash, dry, trim, and medium dice zucchini.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add zucchini and corn to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are lightly browned and softened, 4-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine spices in a medium bowl. Add shrimp and toss to coat.
Add shrimp to the skillet with the veggies; cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Pour the sauce into the skillet and toss to combine; remove from heat.
Coarsely grate the cheddar.
Add cheese and butter to the pan with the cauliflower grits and stir to melt and combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower grits between plates or bowls. Top with vegetables and shrimp. Enjoy!

name: BBQ Turkey Meatballs with Mashed Potatoes & Tangy Coleslaw

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and large dice potatoes. Transfer to a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and return to the saucepan.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl along with turkey, bread crumbs, chili powder, and salt. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides, about 4 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Remove to a clean plate.
Once the meatballs have been removed, return the skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat. Add tomato sauce, vinegar, sugar, and spices; stir to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer.
Once the sauce is simmering, return meatballs to the skillet and turn to coat. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the meatballs are cooked through, about 6 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into another medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into shreds. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the coleslaw.
Add milk, oil, salt, and pepper to the saucepan with the potatoes and mash until smooth.
To serve, divide mashed potatoes, coleslaw, and saucy meatballs between plates. Enjoy!

name: Bean & Pasta Fagioli Soup

ingredients.name: cannellini (white kidney) beans
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can cannellini (white kidney) beans

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, about 8-10 minutes (or according to package directions). When done, drain pasta; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Peel and small dice the carrot. Small dice the zucchini and celery.
Heat a large pot over medium-low heat. Add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the minced garlic, carrots, zucchini, celery, and onion powder.
Cook, stirring well, until veggies begin to soften, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the broth, tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, basil, oregano, thyme, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce and simmer, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Drain and rinse the canned beans in a colander. Stir the cooked pasta and beans into the pot with the soup.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can cannellini (white kidney) beans

instructions.text: Use a vegetable peeler to shave the Parmesan cheese.
To serve, divide between bowls, garnish with Parmesan cheese and enjoy!

name: Beef & Broccoli Stir Fry with Basmati Rice

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash broccoli. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a plate.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings. Peel and mince garlic. Peel and mince or grate ginger.
Thinly slice steak against the grain into strips.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and stir fry until browned, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Coat skillet with more oil, then add onion, garlic, ginger, and crushed red pepper. Stir fry until onion is softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add broccoli and stir fry until bright green and tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Add steak, soy sauce, sesame oil, and pepper; toss to combine.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
Place rice in a bowl and top with stir fry. Enjoy!

name: Beef Burger with Balsamic BBQ Sauce, Portobello Mushrooms & Peppers

instructions.text: Place vinegar, ketchup, sugar, Worcestershire, Dijon, and spices in a small saucepan; stir to combine the BBQ sauce.
Bring sauce to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper; slice lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and slice mushrooms into ½-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl with the other veggies. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat.
Once the grill pan is hot, add veggies and cook, turning occasionally, until tender, 8-10 minutes. Transfer veggies to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve bowl for the next step).
Meanwhile, mince sun-dried tomatoes and capers; place both in the reserved bowl.
Add beef and spices to the bowl with sun-dried tomatoes and capers; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the beef mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on another plate.

Once the veggies are done, return the grill pan to medium-high heat and coat with oil. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and cook an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to the plate with the veggies.
Toast buns if desired.

To assemble the burgers, layer the bottom half of each bun with a patty, BBQ sauce, and a small portion of grilled veggies; close with the top half of each bun. (Reserve remaining veggies for serving.)
To serve, divide burgers and remaining veggies between plates. Enjoy!

name: Beef Burger Patties with Garlic Aioli & Roasted Carrot Fries

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 475°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel the carrots, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Halve the carrots crosswise, then cut into ¼-inch-thick sticks.
Place the carrots on a sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to thoroughly coat, then arrange in a single, even layer.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the carrots in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until browned and tender when pierced with a fork, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and mince the shallot. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
To the bowl with the shallot, add ground beef, salt, and pepper. Using your hands, mix well, then form into 2 equal patties.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the burger patties in the skillet and cook until browned and cooked to your desired degree of doneness, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Juice the lemon and divide the juice between a small bowl and a medium salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the small bowl with the lemon juice.
Add mayonnaise to the lemon juice and garlic; mix together.
Add olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the salad bowl with the lemon juice; whisk together.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the arugula to the salad bowl and toss to coat in the dressing.
To serve, divide the arugula salad, burger patties, carrot fries, and aioli between plates. Enjoy!

name: Beef Burger Patties with Garlic Aioli & Tomato-Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter the tomatoes lengthwise and cut out and discard the stem ends; cut the quarters crosswise into ½-inch-thick chunks and transfer to a medium salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ½-inch-thick pieces and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds and add to the salad bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
In a medium bowl, combine and mix together the ground beef, salt, and pepper. Form the mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the burger patties in the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Juice the lemon; add ½ of the juice to the salad bowl and transfer the other ½ to a small bowl.
Drizzle the salad with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the small bowl with the lemon juice.
To the lemon juice and garlic, add mayonnaise, salt, and pepper; mix together until well combined.
To serve, divide the salad between plates; place the burger patties on the side and serve with the garlic aioli. Enjoy!

name: Beef Burger Patties with Greek Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer ½ of the garlic to a medium bowl (that will hold the ground beef mixture) and transfer the other ½ to a salad bowl.
To the garlic in the salad bowl, add olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon, oregano, salt, and pepper; whisk together.

Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice ½ of the onion and transfer to the medium bowl with the garlic, then thinly slice the other ½ crosswise and add to the salad bowl.
Add olive oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: To the medium bowl, add the ground beef, ¼ pkg of the feta (save the other ¼ pkg for the salad), Dijon, oregano, salt, and pepper; mix until well combined. Form the mixture into 4 patties and place on a plate.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Place the patties in the skillet and cook until cooked through and golden brown, 4 to 6 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces at an angle. Add to the salad bowl.
Halve the grape tomatoes and add to the salad bowl.
Add the olives and remaining feta to the salad bowl; toss to combine.
To serve, divide the burger patties and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Beef Burgers with Paprika Mayo, Caramelized Onions & Kale Crisps

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F and place the rack in the center position. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper (optional).
Wash and dry the kale. Cut out and discard the stems; tear the leaves into large pieces and transfer to a medium bowl.
Drizzle the kale with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss with your hands until thoroughly coated with the oil. Transfer the kale to the sheet pan and arrange in a single layer.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the kale in the oven and bake until it is crisp and lightly browned around the edges, 15 to 20 minutes. Once done, remove from the oven.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, in a medium bowl, combine and mix together the ground beef, salt, and pepper. Form the mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Carefully place the burger patties in the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; halve the onion lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds.
Once the burger patties have been transferred, add the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until golden brown and softened, 4 to 6 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
In a small bowl, combine and mix together the garlic, mayonnaise, and paprika.
Halve the buns. Toast in a toaster if desired.
Top the bun bottoms with the mayo spread, cooked patties, and caramelized onions. Complete with the bun tops.
To serve, divide the burgers and kale crisps between dishes. Enjoy!

name: Beef & Carrot Stew with Mashed Potato Topping

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and halve the potatoes crosswise; transfer to a small saucepan.
Cover the potatoes with hot water (from the tap) by about 1 inch; bring the water to a boil over high heat.
Peel the carrots, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Medium dice the carrots (cut into ½-inch cubes) and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and add to the bowl with the carrots.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add the garlic to the bowl with the other vegetables.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, cook the potatoes until they are tender when pierced with a knife, 10 to 12 minutes.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the beef dry with paper towels, then cut into 1-inch chunks; transfer to a small bowl.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Season the beef with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Add the beef cubes to the pan in a single layer; cook, stirring occasionally, until the beef is browned but not fully cooked through, 4 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the beef to a bowl.
While the beef cooks, wash and dry the cutting board and knife.
Once the beef has been transferred, add butter to the pan, followed by the onions, carrots, and garlic. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the carrots begin to soften, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper to the sauté pan; stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pan, then sprinkle the beef and vegetables with flour and stir to combine.

Add tomato paste and broth to the pan and stir to combine; increase the heat to high and bring the liquid to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce the heat to medium, cover the pan with a lid, and cook until the carrots are tender and the liquid is reduced, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: One by one, holding a sprig of thyme at its top, run you fingers down it to remove the leaves. Discard the sprigs and chop the leaves; stir about ¾ of the thyme into the stew and save the rest for garnishing.
Once the potatoes are tender, drain most of the water, but leave some for mashing. Add butter, salt, and pepper; mash with a potato masher until smooth.
To serve, spoon the stew into a bowl, top with scoops of mashed potatoes, and garnish with the remaining thyme. Enjoy!

name: Beef & Cheddar Taco Bake with Jalapeños

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice onion. Seed and small dice bell pepper.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and bell pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until veggies begin to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add beef and spices to the skillet and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until beef is browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Meanwhile, grate cheese.
Wash and thinly slice jalapeño. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Whisk eggs in a large bowl.
Add beef mixture to the bowl with the eggs and stir to combine. Spread mixture into an even layer in the bottom of a small baking dish. Top with cheese and jalapeño slices.
Place baking dish in the oven; cook until egg is set and cheese is melted and bubbly, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide taco bake between plates and top with yogurt and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Beef Chili Mac & Cheese with Bell Pepper

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and transfer to a small bowl.
Add the ground beef to the skillet and cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer the beef to a bowl, leaving some of the juices in the skillet.
Once the beef has been transferred, add the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, while you prep the bell pepper.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Small dice the pepper and add to the onion.

When the water in the saucepan comes to a boil, uncover the pan and season the water with salt, then add the pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook the pasta, uncovered, for 11 to 12 minutes (or according to package directions). Once done, drain the pasta in a colander.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add the garlic to the skillet. Cook the vegetables, stirring frequently, until softened, 2 to 3 more minutes.
Return the beef to the skillet and season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Add the diced tomatoes to the skillet and bring the mixture to a simmer; cook until the pasta is ready.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Add about ¾ of the onions to the sauce and save the rest for garnishing.
Coarsely grate the cheddar.
Add the drained pasta and cheese to the sauce; stir until the cheese is melted.
To serve, divide the chili mac between bowls and top with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Beef Chili Stuffed Acorn Squash with Cheddar & Green Onions

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve acorn squash lengthwise, trim ends, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of each half with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Place in a small bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Once the pan is hot, add veggies, beef, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.

Add tomato sauce and water to the pan. Stir to combine the chili and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 10-12 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese.
To serve, divide squash halves between plates and fill with the chili; top with cheese and reserved green onions. Enjoy!

name: Beef Dip Sandwich with Sautéed Veggies & Oven-Baked Fries

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, peel, and slice potato into ¼-inch thick strips. Place on a baking sheet and toss with oil and salt.
Spread potatoes out in a single layer and place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated). Roast until golden brown, tossing once halfway through, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Thinly slice steak against the grain. Add steak and salt to the bowl with the onion and toss to combine.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak mixture and cook, stirring often, until steak is browned and cooked to desired doneness, 4-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry bell pepper and mushrooms. On a clean cutting board, thinly slice the mushrooms and pepper.

When the steak is done, transfer to a medium bowl and cover with aluminum foil. Return skillet to medium heat; add oil, peppers, and mushrooms. Cook, stirring often, until veggies are browned, 5-7 minutes. Add veggies to the bowl with the steak.
In a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking broth with cornstarch until smooth.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return skillet to medium-high heat; add the cornstarch slurry, additional broth, Worcestershire sauce, pepper, and any juices from the bowl with the steak. Cook, whisking constantly, until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Slice cheese.
Split buns in half and place on a baking sheet pan, cut-side facing up. Layer cheese over bottom buns. Place in the oven and toast until bread is golden brown, and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes.
Divide steak and veggies between bottom buns, drizzle with warm sauce and top with the other half of the bun. Serve with fries and remaining sauce on the side for dipping. Enjoy!

name: Beef 'Doner' with Cucumber, Tomatoes & Yogurt Sauce

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the tomatoes and cucumbers into ¼-inch cubes and transfer to a medium salad bowl.
Shave leaves off the parsley stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the medium salad bowl with the cucumber and tomatoes to make the salad.
Juice the lemon, add half of the juice to the salad and put the other half aside in a small bowl.
Add oil, salt, and pepper to the salad; stir to combine.
Peel and mince garlic.
Combine oil, cumin, paprika, salt, pepper, crushed red pepper, and two thirds of the garlic in an another medium bowl to make the marinade.
Peel and small dice the onion; transfer to the marinade bowl with the oil and spices.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the beef dry with paper towels, then cut into 1-inch chunks. Add to the bowl with the marinade; stir until well combined.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add beef mixture. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft and beef is cooked through, 4-6 minutes.
Toast pita bread if desired.
To the remaining lemon juice, add yogurt, salt, and one-third of the garlic. Whisk to make the dressing.
To serve, place pita bread on a plate and top with beef, salad, and yogurt dressing. Enjoy!

name: Beef & Eggplant Ragu with Rotini Pasta

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the eggplant; medium dice the eggplant into ½-inch cubes and transfer to a bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add the ground beef; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a bowl, leaving the juices in the saucepan.

When the water in the saucepan comes to a boil, uncover the pan and season the water with salt, then add the pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook the pasta, uncovered, for 11 to 12 minutes (or according to package directions). Drain the pasta in a colander, reserving ½ cup of the cooking water.
Once the beef has been transferred, add the eggplant to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, 4 to 6 minutes.
While the eggplant cooks, trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, oregano, crushed red pepper, and tomato paste to the skillet; stir until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the ground beef and tomato sauce to the skillet; season with salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 4 to 6 minutes.
Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Add the pasta, reserved cooking water, and about ¾ of the basil (save the rest for garnishing); stir until the ragu and pasta are well combined.
To serve, divide the pasta between bowls and garnish with the remaining basil. Enjoy!

name: Beef, Ginger, Mushroom & Bok Choy Stir-Fry with Jasmine Rice

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Thinly slice steak against the grain into strips. Transfer to a small bowl, add soy sauce, and toss to combine; set aside to marinate.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, thinly slice mushrooms; transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak strips to the skillet and stir-fry until just cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim ends and separate bok choy into leaves.
When the steak strips are done, transfer to a plate.

Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to brown, about 3 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the mushrooms cook, slice white stems of the bok choy crosswise into thin strips; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Transfer leaves to the reserved bowl.
Add bok choy stems to the skillet and stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic; add to the skillet and stir-fry until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add bok choy leaves to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Return steak strips (and any accumulated juices) to the skillet along with soy sauce and vinegar; stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Beef Meatballs with Melted Mozzarella, Basil & Spinach-Mushroom Sauté

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; place in a medium bowl (setting a small handful aside for garnish).
Add beef, egg, and spices to the bowl with the basil; mix with your hands until well combined. Using a tablespoon measure, form beef mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a baking dish.
Add tomato sauce and spices to the baking dish with the garlic; stir to combine the sauce and set the baking dish aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add meatballs and cook, turning often, until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer to the baking dish and turn to coat in sauce. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, thinly slice cheese.
Top the saucy meatballs with cheese slices. Place baking dish in the oven and bake until cheese is melted and meatballs are cooked through, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the meatballs bake, thinly slice mushrooms.
Return skillet to medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring often, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Season with salt and pepper, stir to combine, then remove from heat.
To serve, divide sauce, meatballs, and veggie sauté between plates or bowls. Top meatballs with reserved basil and enjoy!

name: Beef Meatballs with Tomato-Spinach Sauce & Creamy Polenta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 20 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Add broth to a small saucepan; cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 20 fl oz (2 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Finely grate ½ cup of Parmesan and transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a small bowl.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, egg, breadcrumbs, ¾ of the Parmesan, ½ of the garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper; mix to combine.

Once the liquid is boiling, slowly add the polenta in a thin steady stream while whisking constantly until all the polenta is incorporated into the liquid. Turn the heat down to low and continue whisking until the polenta has thickened. Cover the polenta and cook for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes or so.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, form the beef mixture into 10 to 12 equal-sized meatballs and transfer to a plate.
Once the pan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the meatballs to the pan; cook, turning occasionally, until they are browned but not cooked through, 4 to 6 minutes. Transfer the meatballs to a bowl, leaving the drippings in the pan.

While the meatballs cook, pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves into a chiffonade by stacking them and rolling tightly into a cigar, then slicing crosswise into thin ribbons.

Once the meatballs have been transferred, add the remaining garlic and the diced tomatoes to the pan; bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and crush some of the tomatoes with a potato masher; season the sauce with salt and pepper.

Return the meatballs to the pan and stir in about ¾ of the basil ribbons (save the rest for garnishing); cook until the meatballs are cooked through and the sauce is slightly thickened, 8 to 10 minutes.
Roughly chop the spinach leaves and stir into the meatball and sauce mixture.
Add butter to the polenta and season with salt and pepper; stir to combine.
To serve, divide the polenta between bowls, top with the meatballs and tomato sauce, and garnish with the remaining basil and Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Beef "Moussaka" Bowl with Eggplant, Zucchini, Pepper & Yogurt Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and halve eggplant lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl with the eggplant.

Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl, along with mayo and spices, then stir to combine. Transfer veggies to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until veggies are fork-tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, beef, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Add water and tomato paste to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until sauce is slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven. Add parsley to the baking sheet and gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide roasted veggies and beef between bowls. Drizzle with yogurt sauce and enjoy!

name: Beef & Mushroom Stroganoff with Fettuccine Pasta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off the discard the stem ends of the mushrooms; thinly slice the mushrooms lengthwise from cap to stem. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the mushrooms.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; halve the onion lengthwise, then thinly slice into quarter-rounds. Transfer to a small bowl.

When the water in the saucepan comes to a boil, uncover the pan and season the water with salt, then add the pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook the pasta, uncovered, for 11 to 12 minutes (or according to package directions). Drain the pasta in a colander.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels, then place on the cutting board and slice crosswise into very thin strips.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: One the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the steak slices to the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook, tossing occasionally, until the steak slices have a nice sear, 3 to 4 minutes total. Once done, transfer to a bowl.
Once the steak has been transferred, add more butter and the onion to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until the onion is softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and garlic to the skillet; season with paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the mushrooms are softened, 4 to 5 minutes.

Wash and dry the cutting board. Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add about ¾ of the parsley to the mushrooms and transfer the rest to a small bowl.
Sprinkle the flour over the mushroom mixture and stir to combine.

Add the broth and Worcestershire to the skillet; deglaze the pan by scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. Cook, stirring frequently, until the mixture is reduced by about half, 2 to 4 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Remove the skillet from the heat; stir in the yogurt, then add the steak slices.
