To serve, divide the pasta between bowls or plates, top with the beef and mushroom stroganoff, and sprinkle with the remaining parsley. Enjoy!

name: Beef & Ricotta Meatballs in Tomato Sauce with Warm Flatbread

instructions.text: Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
In a medium bowl, combine ½ of the onion and garlic (save the rest for the sauce), beef, bread crumbs, ricotta, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Mix until well combined.
Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Shape beef into meatballs, about 12, and place on a plate.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add meatballs and, turning frequently, cook until browned, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Return pan to stove and reduce heat to medium. Add remaining onion and garlic. Stirring frequently, cook until onion is softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add tomatoes, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and add meatballs. Cook until meatballs are cooked through and sauce thickens, about 10 minutes.
Wash and dry basil. Pick leaves off the stems; discard the stems and thinly slice leaves into ribbons. Stir ½ into the sauce while it cooks (save the rest for garnishing).
Toast flatbread and cut into wedges.
To serve, place meatballs and tomato sauce on a plate, garnish with basil, and have with warm bread on the side. Enjoy!

name: Beef Smash Tacos with Spicy Ketchup & Fennel-Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
Place ketchup, water, Worcestershire, and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spicy ketchup and set aside.
Peel and mince shallot. Place in another medium bowl, along with beef and spices, then mix with your hands until well combined.

Arrange tortillas on a flat surface, then divide the beef mixture between them (about 3 tablespoons per tortilla). Using a knife (or your hands), spread the beef mixture over the surface of each tortilla in an even layer.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add tacos, meat-side down. Cook, pressing down once with the bottom of a spatula halfway through cooking, until the beef is cooked through, about 3 minutes.
Flip tacos, beef-side up, and continue to cook until tortillas are golden underneath, 1 minute more. Transfer to a plate and carefully fold in half to form tacos.

Meanwhile, trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
Divide tacos and salad between plates. Serve with spicy ketchup on the side and enjoy!

name: "Beef Stroganoff" Mushroom Burgers with Honey-Parsley Roasted Carrots

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and trim carrots. Slice in half crosswise, then lengthwise into ½-inch thick sticks. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, honey, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.

Transfer carrots to a baking sheet pan and spread out in a single layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, mince half the mushrooms and place in the reserved bowl. Thinly slice remaining mushrooms, place in a small bowl, and set aside.
Add beef, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the minced mushrooms; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add the burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes. Flip patties and continue to cook until cooked through, 4-5 minutes more. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Return skillet to medium heat; add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion begins to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Add sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Sprinkle flour into the skillet and stir to combine. Add broth and bring to a simmer; continue to cook, stirring often, until the sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the sauce has thickened, remove from the heat. Add yogurt, Worcestershire, and half the parsley (reserving the rest for the carrots); stir to combine.
Once the carrots are done, remove from the oven, sprinkle with reserved parsley, and toss to combine.
Toast buns if desired.
Place bottom half of each bun on a plate, then top with burgers and mushroom sauce. Close with the top half of the bun and serve with roasted carrots on the side. Enjoy!

name: "Beef Stroganoff" Noodle Soup with Mushrooms, Carrot, Celery & Parsley

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 20 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and slice carrot crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, use your hands to break the pasta into 2-inch pieces.
When the veggies are soft, add flour to the pan. Cook, stirring frequently, for 1 minute.

Add pasta, broth, milk, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper to the pan; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until noodles are almost tender and soup has thickened, 10-12 minutes.
amounts: 20 fl oz (2 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the soup and set remaining parsley aside for serving.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Slice in half lengthwise, then cut crosswise (against the grain) into thin strips.
When the noodles are almost tender, add beef slices to the soup. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until beef and noodles are cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Beef Stroganoff with Portobello Mushrooms, Zucchini Noodles & Parsley

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles; place in a small bowl and set aside.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot; peel and mince garlic. Place both in another small bowl.
Cut mushrooms in half, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl with the shallot and garlic. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels, then slice crosswise into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak strips and cook, stirring occasionally, until just cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Using tongs, transfer the steak to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for the next step.)
Return the skillet to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot, garlic, and mushrooms to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, cut cream cheese into small pieces.

Once the veggies are soft, add cream cheese, broth, Dijon, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine and bring the sauce to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the sauce simmers, preheat another skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add zucchini and water. Cook, stirring frequently, until just tender, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the sauce is done, return steak (and any accumulated juices) to the skillet; add parsley and stir to combine the beef stroganoff. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide zucchini noodles and beef stroganoff between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Beef Taco Bowl with Cauliflower Rice, Tomatoes, Corn, Feta & Cilantro

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel and halve onion. Slice one half crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside. (Reserve remaining onion for later use.)
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Drizzle oil over the cauliflower and season with salt. Stir to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring cauliflower halfway through, until rice is tender and golden, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice the reserved onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion and beef; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Add whole tomatoes, corn, and spices to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes are starting to brown and burst, 5-7 minutes more.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.

When the tomatoes are starting to burst, juice lime into the skillet, then add water, hot sauce, and half of the cilantro. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
To serve, divide cauliflower rice between plates or bowls. Top with beef and veggies, feta, pickled onion, and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Beef Taco Salad with Cheddar & Catalina Dressing

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut tortillas into 8 triangles and place on a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat, then spread out in a single layer.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place in the oven and bake until golden and crispy, 10-12 minutes.
Add beef to the skillet and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until browned and crumbly, 2-3 minutes.
Add chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper to the beef. Reduce heat to medium, stir, and cook for another 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Wash and dry romaine. Chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Wash and medium dice tomato.
Grate ½ cup of cheddar.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, ketchup, olive oil, vinegar, honey, Worcestershire, onion powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
To serve, place lettuce in a bowl, crush tortilla chips on top, and add beef and tomatoes. Sprinkle with cheddar and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Beef Taco Stuffed Tomatoes with Cheddar, Lettuce & Greek Yogurt

instructions.text: Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Add ground beef and spices to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until crumbly and cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry tomatoes. Slicing from the top down, cut tomatoes into wedges, being careful to not cut completely through to the bottom; sprinkle with salt.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Wash and dry lettuce. Stack leaves, one on top of the other, halve lengthwise, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
To serve, divide tomatoes between plates. Stuff with beef and top with cheese, lettuce, and yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Beefy Broccoli & Cheese Soup

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add beef and spices to the saucepan and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Transfer beef to a plate and set aside.
Return saucepan to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add broth to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry broccoli. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Add broccoli to the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, until broccoli is tender, about 3 minutes.
Ladle half the soup into a blender and purée until smooth. Return to the saucepan along with the cooked beef.
Reduce heat to medium, add milk, stir, and cook 5 minutes more.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese.
Add cheese to the saucepan (reserving a small amount for garnish) and stir until melted.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with reserved cheese. Enjoy!

name: Beet-Carrot Coconut Soup with Ginger, Chili, Crispy Chickpeas & Pita

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and medium dice carrot and beets. Place both in a medium bowl and set aside.

Quarter chili pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and place in a small bowl. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince ginger, shallot, and garlic. Add all three to the bowl with the chili pepper.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, zest lime into the bowl. (Reserve lime for later use.)
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chili pepper, ginger, shallot, garlic, and lime zest; cook, stirring constantly, until softened, about 1 minute.
Add carrot, beet, sugar, and spices to the pan, then stir to combine. Continue to cook until fragrant, 1-2 minutes more.

Add broth, water, and coconut milk to the pan; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are very tender, about 15 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chickpeas and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until chickpeas are golden and crispy, 8-10 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside.
While the chickpeas are cooking, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are very tender, juice reserved lime into the pan, then add cilantro. Use a potato masher to crush the veggies. (Alternatively, use a blender if you prefer a smoother soup.)
Cut pita into wedges.
Divide soup between bowls, then top with chickpeas. Serve with pita wedges on the side and enjoy!

name: Beet, Orange & Spinach Salad with Goat Cheese & Chopped Walnuts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F.
Wash, trim root ends, peel, and thinly slice beets into half rounds. Transfer to a sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Place in the oven and roast until beets are tender, 20 minutes.
Wash and dry spinach and oranges. Peel and thinly slice oranges into half rounds.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Crumble goat cheese into a small bowl. Roughly chop walnuts.
To serve, arrange a bed of spinach on a plate and top with beet and orange slices. Sprinkle with goat cheese, walnuts, and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Beet Tartines with Goat Cheese, Jalapeño-Cilantro Sauce & Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Peel, trim, and slice beets into ¼-inch thick rounds. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Drizzle beets with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then arrange in a single layer. Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until beets are tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, set goat cheese on the counter to soften.
Juice lime into a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with oil, sugar, cumin, and salt; whisk to combine the lime mixture.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the lime mixture. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the jalapeño-cilantro sauce; set aside.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and thinly slice shallot into rings. Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Cut off skin and white pith from the orange; slice between the membranes to release segments. Add to the bowl.
Split rolls in half and place on another baking sheet, cut-side facing up. Place in the oven and bake until lightly toasted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Roughly chop almonds. Add to the salad bowl along with the mixed greens; toss to combine the salad.
Divide toasted rolls between plates; spread each with a thick layer of goat cheese, then top with roasted beets and jalapeño-cilantro sauce. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Bell Pepper & Feta Frittata with Swiss Chard, Apricot & Pine Nut Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into thin strips.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peppers and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and starting to brown, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, crack eggs into a medium bowl, then add salt and pepper. Whisk to combine.
Add feta to the bowl with the egg. Stir to combine and set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Mince anchovy fillet. Place in another medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.

Wash and dry chard; fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Add leaves to the bowl with the dressing and set aside. Reserve stems for the next step.
When the peppers are tender, add chard stems and smoked paprika to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add vinegar and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until absorbed, about 30 seconds.

Pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, about 5 minutes.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until top of the frittata is just set, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, thinly slice apricots. Add to the bowl with the Swiss chard, along with pine nuts, and toss to combine the salad.
Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Bell Pepper-Goat Cheese Polenta with Roasted Veggies

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 20 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice sweet potato; transfer to the baking sheet.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; add to the baking sheet.
Peel and medium dice onion; add to the baking sheet.
Drizzle oil over veggies and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake until veggies are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.
Pour broth into a small saucepan, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 20 fl oz (2 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, trim, seed, and mince bell pepper; add to the pan with the boiling broth.

Reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta to the pan in a thin steady stream, while whisking constantly, until the polenta is incorporated into the broth. Cook, stirring occasionally, until grains are soft and the texture is creamy, 15-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, crumble goat cheese into a small bowl.
Chop chives into small pieces.
When the polenta is done, add oil, goat cheese, and half of the chives to the pan and stir until smooth.
To serve, divide polenta and veggies between bowls. Top with remaining chives and enjoy!

name: Bell Pepper, Kale & Goat Cheese Frittata

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat the oven to the broil setting and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Fold each kale leaf lengthwise, slice away and discard the stems, and chop the leaves crosswise into 1-inch strips. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the kale.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Medium dice the pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the bell pepper to the skillet and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 4 to 5 minutes.
While the bell pepper cooks, in a medium bowl, combine and whisk together the eggs, water, salt, and pepper.
Add the kale and garlic to the skillet; cook, tossing frequently, until wilted, 2 to 3 minutes.

Pour the egg mixture into the skillet. While tilting the skillet with one hand, lift up the edges of the frittata with a spatula and let the eggs run underneath during the first few minutes of cooking. Cook until most of the frittata is set, but the top is still runny, 4 to 5 minutes.
Crumble the goat cheese overtop of the frittata.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and broil until the top is set and lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes.
To serve, separate the frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Bell Pepper, Olive & Sun-Dried Tomato Frittata with Parmesan

instructions.text: Wash and dry bell pepper. Seed and slice into thin strips.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Meanwhile, roughly chop the olives and sun-dried tomatoes.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add bell pepper and onions; cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes. Add olives and sun-dried tomatoes; stir to combine.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, spices, and half of the cheese.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Spread out the veggies evenly in the skillet. Reduce heat to medium-low and pour in the egg mixture.

As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Sprinkle with the remaining cheese. Place skillet in the oven and broil until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Better Than Takeout Chicken Fried Rice

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice onion. Wash and dry carrots and green onions. Peel and small dice the carrots. Trim root ends and chop the onions. Measure out peas.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and, stirring occasionally, cook until cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Return skillet to stove, increase heat to medium-high, and add more oil. Add garlic, yellow onion, carrots, and peas to skillet. Stir fry until tender, 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk egg.
Move vegetables to one side of the skillet and pour egg on the other side. Scramble egg until cooked and mix with vegetables.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
Add rice, chicken, and soy sauce to vegetables. Stir until well combined and heated through, 1-2 minutes.
Remove from heat and sprinkle with green onions.
To serve, place fried rice in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Biryani with Chickpeas, Cashews, Cauliflower and Jalapeño-Mint Chutney

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 10 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water. Set aside to drain.
Peel and mince garlic and onion.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, onion, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies begin to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the veggies are soft, add broth to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the broth comes to a boil, add rice, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Cut into bite-sized pieces.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower, chickpeas, broth, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, juice lime into a small bowl. Peel and mince ginger; add to the bowl along with the sugar. Whisk to combine.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Pick mint and cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the chutney.
To serve, divide rice and veggies between bowls. Top with chutney and cashews. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean & Bell Pepper Fajitas with Guacamole

instructions.text: Wash and dry bell peppers. Seed, slice into thin strips, and transfer to a bowl.
Peel, thinly slice into half rings, and add onion to bowl with peppers. Peel and mince garlic; add ½ to bowl with vegetables and place the other ½ into a small bowl for preparing guacamole.
Halve avocado and remove pit; scoop out the flesh into bowl with garlic.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ to bowl with avocado and save the rest for garnishing.
Add lime juice, salt, and pepper to avocado. Mash with a fork until smooth. Set aside.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add peppers, onion, and garlic from bowl. Stirring frequently, cook until peppers are tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Add beans to skillet with vegetables. Season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and cook until beans are heated through, 1-2 minutes.
Cut remaining ½ lime into wedges.
Place tortillas on a plate and top with fajita filling. Garnish with guacamole, remaining cilantro, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean, Bell Pepper & Quinoa Bowl with Peach Salsa & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa, salt, and water; bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes. Once done, remove the quinoa from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Small dice the pepper and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Add half of the onion to the bowl with the pepper and the other half to a separate medium bowl that will hold the salsa.
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the onion and bell pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables have softened, 4 to 6 minutes.
While the vegetables cook, quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard the pit; small dice the quarters and add to the salsa bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salsa bowl.
Add the beans to the skillet and season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper; cook until the mixture is heated through and well combined, 1 to 2 minutes.
Juice the lime and add to the salsa bowl.
Season the salsa with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
Place the feta in a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork.
To serve, divide the quinoa between bowls, top with the bean mixture and peach salsa, and sprinkle with the feta. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean Burgers with Avocado Spread & Mixed Greens Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Drain the beans (but don't rinse them) and transfer to a medium bowl. Use a potato masher or fork to mash them until they are mostly broken up, but there are still some whole beans left.
Coarsely grate the onion and add to the bowl.
Add the bread crumbs, chili powder, salt, and pepper to the beans and onion; stir until the mixture is combined.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Form the bean mixture into two patties.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the patties in the skillet and cook until they are browned and heated through, 4 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Toast the buns if desired.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Halve and pit the avocado; medium dice the flesh while it's still in the skin, then scoop out into a small bowl.
Add juice of ½ lime to the avocado and season with salt and pepper; mash with a fork until smooth.
Halve the grape tomatoes.

Place the bun halves on two plates (or one plate and one lunch container), top with the black bean patties, and add dollops of the avocado spread. Arrange the greens on the side, top with the grape tomatoes, and drizzle with olive oil and the remaining lime. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

name: Black Bean, Butternut Squash & Jalapeño Enchiladas

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 6 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash, dry, and peel the butternut squash; halve and remove seeds with a spoon. Small dice squash and place in a medium bowl; set aside.
Peel and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the squash.

Wash, dry, and quarter jalapeño lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until squash is fork-tender, about 6 minutes.
Meanwhile, measure oil into a small saucepan and place over medium-high heat. Once the oil is hot, whisk in the flour; continuing to whisk, cook the flour until lightly golden, about 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in tomato sauce, broth, and spices. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until thickened, 4-5 minutes. Remove enchilada sauce from heat and set aside.
amounts: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans. Grate mozzarella.
Add beans, half the cheese (reserving the rest for later), and yogurt to the skillet with the veggies. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
Spread a thin layer of the enchilada sauce over the bottom of a small baking dish; set remaining sauce aside.
Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide vegetable mixture evenly between them; roll up and place, seam-side down, in the baking dish. Top with remaining sauce and cheese.
Place enchiladas in the oven and bake until the cheese is melted, 5-10 minutes.
To serve, divide enchiladas between plates and enjoy!

name: Black Bean, Chickpea & Avocado Salad with Bell Pepper & Tomatoes

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Grate all of the zest from the lime, then juice the lime; transfer both to a large bowl (that will hold the salad).
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl.
Add olive oil, cumin, salt, and pepper to the bowl; whisk together.
Halve the grape tomatoes crosswise; add to the bowl.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Medium dice the pepper and add to the bowl.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Add to the bowl.
Add the beans to the salad, then toss until the salad is thoroughly coated with the dressing.
To serve, divide the salad between bowls and enjoy!

name: Black Bean & Mango Rice Bowl with Cilantro Vinaigrette

instructions.text: Rinse the rice in a colander and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until the liquid is absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Remove from the heat and let the rice stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Seed and small dice the bell pepper; transfer to a medium bowl.
Halve the jalapeño and remove the seeds; mince and add to the bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the bowl.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Drain and rinse the black beans.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the peppers and garlic; cook until the bell pepper is softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the black beans and season with cumin, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 2 to 3 minutes. Once done, turn off the heat.
Peel the mango and slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice the flesh and transfer to a bowl.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Stir ½ of the cilantro into the beans (save the rest for the dressing).
Juice the lime into a small bowl.
Add the remaining cilantro, olive oil, salt, and pepper to the lime juice; whisk together.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Divide the rice between bowls, then add the black bean and pepper mixture, mango, and drizzle with the cilantro-lime dressing. Mix together and enjoy!

name: Black Bean Penne Pasta with Mixed Vegetables

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and return to pot; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel the carrot and onion. Slice carrot into ¼-inch rounds; slice onion in half and then into thin half moons. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms; add to the bowl with the carrot and onion.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half rounds; add to the bowl with the veggies.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add veggies to the skillet along with the garlic and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are crisp tender, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, small dice the tomato and grate the Parmesean.
Shave leaves off the stems of the parsley; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, stir in the beans, diced tomatoes, half the parsley, oil, capers, and red wine vinegar; cook an additional 2 minutes. Reserve remaining parsley for garnish.
Transfer vegetable mixture to the pot with the pasta and toss gently to combine.
To serve, divide the pasta mixture between plates and top with Parmesean and remaining parsley. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean & Pineapple Hawaiian Pita Pizza

instructions.text: Peel and slice the onion into thin half rings.
Wash and dry the pineapple. Cut skin off pineapple, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel and mince garlic.
In a medium bowl, combine garlic, tomato sauce, and spices. Stir to combine and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil.
Grate the mozzarella.
To assemble, top the pitas with a thin layer of tomato sauce, cheese, red onion, pineapple, and black beans. Place on a baking sheet and cook in the oven for 2-3 minutes, until the cheese melts.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
Remove from oven and top with cilantro leaves. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean, Potato, Zucchini & Corn Soup in Creamy Coconut Broth

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel and medium dice carrot and potato; place both in a small bowl.
Trim celery and cut crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl with the carrot and potato.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and medium dice zucchini.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
When the veggies are soft, add beans, zucchini, thyme, broth, coconut milk, and corn to the pan. Stir to combine the soup, cover, and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Once the soup is simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are fork-tender, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Juice lemon into the soup and stir to combine.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!

name: Black Bean & Pumpkin Chili with Cheddar

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Medium dice the pepper into ½-inch cubes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the saucepan heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces and add to the bowl with the pepper.
Once the saucepan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the bell pepper and onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
While the vegetables cook, open the can of beans but don't drain.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin, and cinnamon to the saucepan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the beans, diced tomatoes, and pumpkin purée to the saucepan; season with salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Stir ¾ of the green onions into the chili and save the rest for garnishing.
Coarsely grate ½ cup of cheddar.
To serve, divide the chili between bowls and top with the cheddar and remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean Purée & Fried Eggs with Avocado & Grape Tomatoes

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
While the saucepan heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces).
Once the saucepan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the onion.
Drain and rinse the beans.
Add chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper to the saucepan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the beans and broth to the saucepan; bring to a boil, then mash the beans with a hand blender or potato masher. Remove from the heat and cover to keep warm.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add olive oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: While the skillet heats up, halve the grape tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Gently crack the eggs into the skillet. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 2 to 3 minutes. Once done, separate the eggs and transfer to a plate.
While the eggs cook, halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
To serve, divide the bean purée, eggs, and tomato-avocado mixture among plates; season with salt and pepper if desired. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean Rice Bowl with Spicy Cabbage Slaw, Yogurt Crema & Avocado

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water, cumin, and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

While the rice is cooking, juice half of the lime into a small bowl. Add yogurt and salt, then whisk to combine. Add water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set crema aside. (Reserve remaining lime for the next step.)
Juice reserved lime into a medium bowl. Add oil and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.

Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing, and using your hands, massage cabbage with dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw; set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add beans, hot sauce, and salt to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place half in another small bowl. (Reserve remaining greens onions for serving.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the green onions.
When the rice is done, add the green onions and cilantro, then stir to combine the rice.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
To serve, divide rice, beans, slaw, and avocado between bowls. Drizzle with crema and top with reserved green onions. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean Sandwich (Torta) with Blistered Jalapeños & Broccoli Slaw

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Add to the baking sheet with the onions. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)

Drizzle onions and jalapeños with oil and season with salt; toss to coat. Place in the oven and broil, tossing once, until veggies are soft and blistered, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside. (Keep the broiler on.)
Meanwhile, juice lime into a medium bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and grate the carrot. Add carrot and broccoli slaw to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw; set aside.
Drain and rinse beans; transfer to another medium bowl.
Add spices to the bowl with the beans. Crush with a fork or potato masher until almost smooth, with some texture remaining; set aside.
Grate cheese.

Remove broiled veggies to a small bowl. Split rolls in half and place, cut-side up, on the baking sheet. Spread bean mash over the bottom halves of the rolls and top with cheese. Place in the oven and broil until buns are lightly toasted, and cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, thinly slice tomato. Halve and pit the avocado; slice thinly while still in the skin, then scoop out.
Place the bottom of each roll on a plate. Top with tomato, avocado, onions, and jalapeños; close sandwich with top half of the roll. Serve with broccoli slaw on the side and enjoy!

name: Black Bean Soup with Feta & Kale, Apple & Pecan Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Small dice the pepper (cut into ¼-inch cubes) and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch cubes) and add to the bell pepper.
Once the saucepan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the bell pepper and onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, cumin, and crushed red pepper to the saucepan; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.

Add the broth and beans (with their liquid) to the saucepan; season with salt and pepper. Increase the heat to high and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a medium salad bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, apple cider vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Cut out and discard the kale stems; chop the leaves crosswise into ½-inch strips. Add the kale to the salad bowl and, using your hands, massage the dressing into the leaves.
Quarter the apple lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges. Add to the salad bowl.
Roughly chop the pecans and add to the salad bowl. Toss the salad to combine.
Using an immersion (hand) blender, purée the soup until the desired consistently is reached. Alternatively, mash the beans with a potato masher.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and garnish with feta. Serve with the kale salad on the side. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Black Bean Soup with Orange, Avocado & Red Onion Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Small dice the pepper and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.

Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice ½ of the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and add to the bowl with the pepper, then thinly slice the other ½ into quarter-rings and transfer to a small bowl.
Once the saucepan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the onion and bell pepper to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, cumin, and crushed red pepper to the saucepan; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.

Add the broth and beans (with their liquid) to the saucepan; season with salt and pepper. Increase the heat to high and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the soup cooks, using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.

Cut a small piece off both orange ends to reveal the flesh; place the orange on one end and, from top to bottom, slice off the skin and pith. Halve the orange lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-rounds and transfer to a small bowl.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; thinly slice the flesh crosswise (without piercing the skin) and scoop out.
Juice the lime into a small bowl (that will be used to make the dressing).
To the lime juice, add olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Using an immersion (hand) blender, purée the soup until the desired consistently is reached.

To serve, divide the soup between bowls, top with spoonfuls of Greek yogurt, and garnish with some of the cilantro. Arrange the orange slices, avocado, and remaining onion on plates. Drizzle the salad with the dressing and garnish with the remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean, Sweet Potato, Bell Pepper & Onion Bake with Cheese Sauce

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; place in a medium bowl.
Peel and cut sweet potato into ½-inch cubes; add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Peel, halve, and large dice onion. Add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper; toss to combine, transfer to a baking sheet pan, and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are golden brown and fork-tender, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate mozzarella and set aside.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat. Once the pan is hot, add oil and flour; whisk until combined, about 1 minute.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add broth and spices to the pan; cook, whisking frequently, until thickened, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add mozzarella and yogurt to the pan; whisk until cheese is melted and combined. Cover sauce and set over low heat, stirring occasionally, to keep warm.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven, add beans, and stir to combine. Return baking sheet to the oven and bake until beans are warmed through, 2-3 minutes more; remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
To serve, divide roasted veggies and beans between bowls; top with cheese sauce and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean-Sweet Potato Bowl with Mushrooms, Avocado, Feta & Cilantro

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potato. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Quarter mushrooms and add to the baking sheet with the sweet potato. Drizzle with oil and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are browned and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel and halve onion. Slice one half crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside. (Reserve remaining onion for the next step.)
Small dice the remaining onion. Peel and thinly slice garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the diced onion, garlic, cumin, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally until starting to brown, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.

When the onion is done, add beans to the skillet. Cook, mashing with the back of a spoon, until beans are broken up slightly and warmed through, 3-4 minutes. Add water, hot sauce, and half of the cilantro, then stir to combine. Cover and remove from heat. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Cut lime into wedges.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin pieces.
Divide beans and roasted veggies between bowls; top with avocado, pickled onion, feta, and reserved cilantro. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and additional hot sauce. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Black Bean Tacos with Pico de Gallo & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans; set aside to drain further.
Quarter the grape tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl (that will hold the salsa).
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the salsa bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salsa bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Add ½ of the onion to the salsa bowl and leave the rest on the cutting board.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the remaining onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the onion cooks, juice the lime and add to the salsa bowl.
Season the salsa with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
Add the black beans to the skillet and season with chili powder, salt, and pepper; cook until the mixture is heated through, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, remove the skillet from the heat.
Place the feta in a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wrap the tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until heated through, 15 to 30 seconds.
To serve, divide the black beans between the tortillas, then top with the salsa and feta. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean Tacos with Tomato & Avocado Salsa

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Small dice the tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and small dice the flesh. Add to the tomatoes.

Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add ½ of the cilantro to the bowl with the tomatoes and avocado and transfer the other ½ to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Transfer ½ of the onion to the bowl with the salsa ingredients and leave the rest on the cutting board.
Once the skillet is heated, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the remaining onion to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
While the onion cooks, drain and rinse the black beans in a colander.
Add more coconut oil to the skillet, followed by the beans and remaining cilantro.

Season the bean mixture with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the beans are warmed through, 2 to 4 minutes. Mash some of the beans with a fork is desired.
Wrap the tortillas in a damp towel and microwave until heated through, 15 to 30 seconds.
Juice the lime; drizzle ½ of the lime juice over the beans and add the rest to the bowl with the salsa ingredients.
Season the salsa with salt and pepper; mix together.
To serve, place the bean mixture into the tortillas and top with the salsa. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean & Veggie Quesadillas with Tomato & Avocado Salsa

instructions.text: Wash and dry tomatoes, jalapeño, and cilantro.

Medium dice and transfer tomatoes to a medium bowl. Seed, mince, and add ½ of the jalapeño to bowl (save the rest for the quesadilla filling). Halve and pit avocado; scoop out the flesh, medium dice, and add to bowl. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems, mince the leaves, and add ½ to bowl (save the rest for the quesadilla filling). Peel, small dice onion, and add ½ to bowl (save the rest for the quesadilla filling).
Drizzle ingredients in bowl with olive oil and lime juice; season with salt and pepper. Mix to combine and set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Wash, seed, and small dice bell pepper.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add remaining onion, jalapeño, and bell pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until vegetables have softened, 3-4 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans.
Add beans and remaining cilantro to skillet. Then season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir and cook until beans are warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.
Grate 1 cup of cheddar.
Wash and dry skillet. Heat over medium heat.
Place tortillas on a flat surface. Layer one half of each tortilla with ¼ of the cheese, ½ of the bean mixture, and another ¼ of the cheese. Fold tortillas over to close.
Coat skillet with oil. Place both quesadillas in the skillet, straight edges next to each other. Cook until golden brown on both sides and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes per side.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Transfer to a cutting board and cut into wedges.
To serve, place quesadilla on a plate and serve with salsa. Enjoy!

name: Black Bean-Zucchini Quesadilla with Zingy Greens & Lime Crema

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and thinly slice onion into half moons.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, chili powder, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander.

Add beans and tomato sauce to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until the beans are warm and the sauce has reduced, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl and wipe the skillet clean with paper towels.
Meanwhile, trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Transfer to the colander and sprinkle with salt. Set the colander in a bowl to catch the excess moisture.
Zest and juice lime into a small bowl; add yogurt, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the crema and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Place grated zucchini in the middle of a clean towel, bring the corners together, and squeeze out excess moisture.
To assemble the quesadillas, lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide beans, zucchini, and cheese between them, arranging it on one half of the tortilla; fold in half to close.
Return skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine oil, vinegar, and spices in another medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing. Add mixed greens and toss to combine the salad.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad and crema on the side. Enjoy!

name: Blackberry Glazed Drumsticks with Couscous & Roasted Brussels Sprouts

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Combine blackberries, water, vinegar, and sugar in a small saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, mashing berries occasionally with a spoon, until liquid begins to thicken and berries break down, 5-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat chicken drumsticks dry with a paper towel and place on a large baking sheet pan; season with salt and pepper.
Add butter and mustard to the saucepan; stir to combine until butter has melted. Transfer half the glaze to a small bowl and set aside.
Coat all sides of the drumsticks with the remaining glaze. Place in the oven and roast, flipping once, until the chicken is cooked through, 30-35 minutes.
Trim and halve Brussels sprouts; place in a large bowl.

Add oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the sprouts. Toss to combine and spread out in a single layer on the sheet pan with the chicken. Return to oven and roast until the sprouts are tender and chicken is cooked through, 15 minutes more.
Meanwhile, rinse and wipe out the small saucepan with a clean towel. Return to medium-high heat.
Add broth and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add half of the parsley to the pan with the couscous and stir to combine.
To serve, divide couscous, Brussels sprouts, and chicken between plates. Pour reserved glaze over the chicken. Garnish with remaining parsley and enjoy!

name: Blackened Salmon Cabbage Wraps with Coleslaw & Pecans

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place mayo, maple syrup, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise; add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl.

Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage. Carefully remove 12 whole leaves from the cabbage head and set aside. Halve the remaining cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into strips; add to the bowl.

Stack the reserved cabbage leaves on top of one another, then slice the leaves in half crosswise. Set the leafy upper portion of the leaves aside for the wraps; thinly slice the lower stem portion and add to the bowl with the rest of the cabbage; toss to combine the slaw and set aside.
Place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a plate; season with spices on the top-side.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add salmon, skin-side down, and cook, flipping once, until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side (depending on thickness). Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, roughly chop pecans.
Use a fork to break the salmon into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, pile reserved cabbage leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Divide slaw, pecans, and salmon between wraps. Enjoy!

name: Blackened Salmon with Cajun-Spiced Beans, Rice & Tomato Relish

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine the spice mix.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season salmon with half of the spice mix on both sides. (Reserve remaining spice mix for the beans.)

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place the salmon, skin-side-down, in the skillet; cook until the flesh is opaque and flaky, 3-4 minutes per side (depending on thickness). Once done, transfer to a plate and cover loosely with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic and onion. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add both to the bowl with the garlic and onion.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and remaining spice mix; sauté until soft, 6-8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, small dice tomato and transfer to the reserved bowl. Add oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the relish and set aside.
amounts: ¼ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add water and tomato paste to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, add beans and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide rice and beans between plates; top with blackened salmon and tomato relish. Enjoy!

name: Blackened Tilapia with Minty Zucchini Mango Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim ends, peel, and small dice zucchini. Small dice tomato. Transfer both to a large bowl.
Peel the mango and slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; small dice and add to the large bowl.
Seed the bell pepper, small dice, and transfer to the large bowl.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice the lime over the veggies; add oil and spices and toss until well coated. Set aside in fridge until ready to serve.
In a small bowl, combine the spices for the fish.
Using paper towel, pat the fillets dry, then rub with spice mixture on both sides.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the fillets to the skillet and cook, 3 minutes per side, until opaque and cooked through.
To serve, divide the salad between plates and top with blackened tilapia. Enjoy!

name: Blackened Tilapia with Pineapple-Avocado Salsa Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Cut off skin from pineapple, core, and small dice; place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince the shallot; add to the bowl with the pineapple.
Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh, small dice, and add to the bowl.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice half the lime into the bowl with the pineapple; add oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the salsa. Cut remaining lime into wedges.
Combine the spices in a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the fish dry with paper towel and place on a plate; rub fish all over with the spice mixture.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add fish to the skillet and cook, flipping once, until blackened and can be easily flaked with a fork, about 5 minutes per side.
To serve, divide the tilapia and greens between plates; top greens with pineapple salsa and place lime wedges on the side. Enjoy!

name: Blistered Cherry Tomato, Pesto & Ricotta Tartines with Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.

Transfer tomatoes to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and broil until soft and lightly charred, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems and transfer to a blender.
Peel garlic. Add to blender along with oil, salt, and pepper. Blend on high, adding water 1 tbsp at a time, if necessary, to form a semi-smooth pesto.
Toast bread.
Meanwhile, combine oil, vinegar, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and grate the carrot; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To assemble the tartines, divide ricotta between slices of toast and spread out in an even layer. Season with salt and pepper.
Layer tartines with tomatoes, pesto, and pine nuts.
To serve, divide salad and tartines between plates. Enjoy!

name: Blistered Tomato Frittata with Bacon, Cheddar, Chives & Dressed Greens

instructions.text: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 3-4 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate; set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add tomatoes and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to brown and burst, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, place eggs in a medium bowl, then add salt and pepper. Whisk to combine.
Coarsely grate cheddar. Add to the bowl with the egg, along with crispy bacon, and whisk once more to combine.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
When the tomatoes are done, transfer half to a small bowl and set aside for serving. Spread remaining tomatoes out in an even layer in the skillet.

Reduce heat to medium-low and pour the egg mixture into in the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, about 5 minutes.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until top of the frittata is just set, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, chop chives into small pieces. Place half in a clean medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserving remaining chives for serving.)
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates; top with tomatoes and reserved chives. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: BLT Lettuce Wraps with Avocado Slices & Garlic Mayo

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place 4-6 slices of bacon in the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining bacon.
Halve and thinly slice the tomatoes; transfer to a small bowl. Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin then scoop out with a spoon into a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic. In another small bowl, mix together the minced garlic, mayo, salt, and pepper.
Chop or crumble the bacon into smaller pieces.
To serve, grab a couple lettuce leaves, spread some mayo overtop, then add tomatoes, avocado, and bacon. Enjoy!

name: "BLT" Macaroni Salad with Crispy Bacon, Tomato, Lettuce & Bread Crumbs

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Small dice tomato. Add to the bowl and set aside.

When the bacon is done, remove all but 2 teaspoons of drippings from the skillet, then return to medium heat. Add bread crumbs and toast, stirring often, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Transfer toasted bread crumbs to a small bowl, then add garlic powder and salt; stir to combine and set aside.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies. Stir to combine the macaroni salad.
Separate lettuce into leaves and arrange on plates. Top with macaroni salad, bread crumbs, and crispy bacon. Enjoy!

name: BLT Pita Pizza with Caramelized Balsamic Onions & Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
While the bacon is cooking, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half moons.
