Remove all but 1 tbsp of bacon fat from the skillet and return to medium heat. Add onions, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring often, until soft and golden, about 6 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and thinly slice tomatoes.
Coarsely grate the cheese.
When the onions are soft, add vinegar and continue to cook until reduced, 1-2 minutes more.
Arrange pitas on a baking sheet pan and layer with tomatoes, onions, and cheese. Place in the oven and bake until cheese is melted, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
Whisk together oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Add the arugula and toss to combine.
Crumble or chop bacon into small pieces.
To serve, divide pizzas between plates; top with bacon and arugula. Enjoy!

name: "BLT" Quinoa Salad Bowl with Cucumber, Artichokes & Hard-Boiled Eggs

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Place eggs in a medium saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain eggs and transfer to a small bowl; add ice or run under cold water to cool. (Reserve saucepan for later use.)

Meanwhile, place quinoa and broth in a small saucepan, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the quinoa cooks, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl. Add mayo, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Medium dice tomato; trim and small dice cucumber. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl and set aside.
When the eggs are done, wipe the saucepan clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the pan is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate.
Transfer the cooked quinoa to a baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and roughly chop eggs; add to the plate with the bacon.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop the flesh out with a spoon and medium dice. Add to the plate.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-size pieces. Add to the salad bowl, along with cooled quinoa, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide quinoa salad between plates or bowls; top with bacon, egg, and avocado. Enjoy!

name: BLT Salad with Grilled Chicken & Avocado

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium heat.
Slice the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Rub both sides with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place the chicken and bacon on the grill or skillet. Cook until chicken is golden brown and cooked through and bacon is crispy, 3-4 minutes per side.
Peel and mince the garlic. In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together the minced garlic, lemon juice, mayo, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Wash the fresh produce.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Halve the tomatoes. Chop the lettuce crosswise into 1 inch strips.
Slice the chicken into strips and chop or crumble the bacon.
To serve, arrange a bed of lettuce on a plate, top with tomatoes, avocado slices, chicken, and bacon. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: Blue Cheese Burger with Cherry-Cranberry Sauce & Lemony Kale

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Place cherries, cranberries, vinegar, sugar, and spices in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.

Once boiling, gently crush the fruit with the back of a spoon to release juices. Reduce heat to a simmer and continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.

Wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl. Use your hands to massage the dressing into the kale until slightly softened; set aside.
Form the ground beef into 2 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and season with spices.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, place patties in the pan and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
If desired, place buns, cut-side down, on the grill pan to toast, 1-2 minutes.
Place bottom half of a bun on each plate, then top with burgers, blue cheese, and cherry sauce. Close with the top half of the bun and serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

name: Blueberry-Ginger Wings with Walnut, Goat Cheese & Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).

Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Drizzle with oil and toss once more to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Zest and juice lemon into a medium saucepan.

Peel and mince ginger. Add to the pan with the lemon, along with blueberries and sugar, then stir to combine the sauce. Set over medium heat and cook, stirring often, until blueberries burst and sauce is thickened, 6-8 minutes. Cover and remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Roughly chop walnuts. Add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
When the wings are done, remove from the oven. Place in another clean medium bowl, drizzle with sauce, and toss to coat.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl with the dressing. Add spinach and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Brazilian Chickpea Curry over Roasted Spaghetti Squash with Cilantro

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place the rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off and discard ends of the squash; halve squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds from each half. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange the squash halves cut-side-down on the baking sheet.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse the chickpeas; transfer to a medium saucepan.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the saucepan with the chickpeas.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk, and spices to the saucepan; stir to combine the curry and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Once the curry is boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Cut lime into wedges and set aside.

Remove squash from the oven; allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand.)
To serve, divide squash and curry between plates; top with cilantro, yogurt, and a squeeze of lime. Enjoy!

name: Brazilian Seafood Stew (Moqueca) with Shrimp, Cod, Bell Pepper & Lime

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lime into a medium bowl. (Reserve lime for later use.)
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lime zest along with chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the marinade.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry; add to the bowl with the marinade.
amounts: ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Pat the cod dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch pieces; add to the bowl and gently stir to coat. Set aside.
Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and halve bell peppers crosswise, then slice into thin strips; place in another medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 3 minutes.
While the veggies are cooking, medium dice tomatoes.

Add tomatoes and broth to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are soft, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Add marinated seafood and coconut milk to the pan; stir to combine, return to a simmer, and continue to cook until seafood is cooked through, 1 minute more.
When the stew is done, juice reserved lime into the pan, add cilantro, and gently stir to combine; remove from heat.
To serve, divide seafood stew between bowls and enjoy!

name: Bread Salad (Panzanella) with Tuna, Tomatoes, Mozzarella & Olives

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Cut or tear bread into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until croutons are golden and toasted, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Drain tuna, add to the bowl with the dressing, and flake with a fork. Stir to combine.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Large dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear mozzarella into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Add the cooled croutons and capers to the bowl. Stir once more to combine the salad.
To serve, divide panzanella salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Breadcrumb Crusted Halibut with Mushroom-Spinach Sauté & Quinoa

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small bowl, mix together lemon juice, bread crumbs, dill, salt, and pepper.
Place halibut in a small baking dish. Drizzle with a little olive oil and top with bread crumb mixture, patting lightly to help it adhere.
amounts: about 1 tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place dish in the oven and bake until fish is white and flaky, 10-12 minutes. Change setting to broil and continue baking until bread crumb mixture turns golden brown, 1-2 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic. Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Stirring occasionally, cook until softened, 4-5 minutes.
amounts: about 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry spinach. Add to mushrooms and toss until just wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place quinoa on a plate, add spinach-mushroom sauté, and top with halibut fillet. Enjoy!

name: Breaded Chicken with Yogurt Sauce & Warm Brussels Sprout-Orange Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and halve sprouts lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in a single layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sprouts are golden and fork-tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut off skin and white pith from the orange; slice between the membranes to release segments. Place in a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the orange and set aside.
Place bread crumbs and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine and set aside.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Transfer chicken to a plate, spread half of the mayo over the top side, and sprinkle with half of the bread crumbs (pressing gently to adhere). Carefully flip chicken and repeat with remaining mayo and bread crumbs. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, water, and spices in the reserved bowl. Stir to combine the sauce and set aside.
Add cooled sprouts and vinegar to the bowl with the orange and parsley. Stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and yogurt sauce between plates; top sauce with chicken. Enjoy!

name: Breaded Dijon Chicken & Green Bean Salad with Lemon-Parsley Gremolata

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Peel and mince garlic. Place half in a small bowl and half in a medium bowl. (Set medium bowl aside for later use.)
Add mayo and Dijon to the small bowl with the garlic. Stir to combine the Dijon mayo.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, place on a baking sheet pan, then season with salt and pepper on both sides. Spread out in an even layer.
Spread the Dijon mayo over the top side of the chicken, then sprinkle with bread crumbs, pressing gently to adhere. Drizzle with oil.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until chicken is golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water is heating, zest lemon into the bowl with the reserved garlic. Cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with additional oil and salt; stir to combine gremolata and set aside.
Trim green beans.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, add green beans and additional salt; cook until tender-crisp, 1-2 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool.
Add cooled green beans to the bowl with the gremolata. Toss to coat.
To serve, divide chicken and green beans between plates; squeeze lemon over top. Enjoy!

name: Breaded Mozzarella with Marinara & Lemony Carrot-Bell Pepper Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and slice carrot crosswise into thin rounds; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl and set aside.

Place tomato sauce and spices in a small saucepan, stir to combine, and place over low heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, about 3 minutes. Cover the marinara and remove from heat.
Meanwhile, whisk egg in a small bowl. Place bread crumbs on a plate.
Combine flour and spices in another small bowl.
Slice mozzarella into ½-inch thick rounds, pat dry with paper towels, and place on another plate; sprinkle flour mixture over both sides to coat.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Working one slice at a time, dip the floured mozzarella into the bowl with the egg. Let the excess drip off, then dredge in the bread crumbs, gently pressing to adhere; return slices to the plate.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Carefully place breaded mozzarella in the skillet and cook, flipping once, until golden brown, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove to a clean, paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, add mixed greens to the bowl with the veggies and dressing; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide breaded mozzarella and salad between plates; pour warm marinara over the mozzarella and sprinkle with additional Italian seasoning. Enjoy!

name: Breaded Pork Chop with Curry Roasted Cauliflower & Apple-Raisin Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Wash, dry, and separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then season with curry powder and salt; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until cauliflower is fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place bread crumbs and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels, place on a plate, and spread both sides with mayo. Sprinkle bread crumb mixture over both sides and press to adhere.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, quarter, and core apple; cut into matchsticks or coarsely grate. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with raisins, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chops, cauliflower, and apple salad between plates; enjoy!

name: British-Style Sausage with Mashed Potatoes, Onion Gravy & Kale Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until golden, about 5 minutes (the sausages will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer to a plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
While the sausages cook, peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion and cook, stirring constantly, until softened, about 2 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over onion and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until lightly golden, about 1 minute.

Stir in broth and spices, then bring gravy to a simmer. Once simmering, return sausages to the skillet, reduce heat to low, and cover with a lid; cook, turning sausages occasionally, until gravy has thickened and sausages are cooked through, 6-8 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: When the potatoes are done, drain in a colander and return to the saucepan. Add butter, salt, and pepper; using a potato masher, mash until smooth. Cover to keep warm.
Place vinegar, water, Dijon, and salt in medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage the dressing into the kale.
Halve tomatoes, add to the bowl with the kale, and toss to combine the salad.
Divide mashed potatoes between plates, then top with sausages and gravy. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Broccoli, Apple & Bacon Salad with Walnuts

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Wash broccoli, carrot, and apple; set aside.
Place bacon in skillet and cook until crispy and golden, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Peel and mince garlic. In a large bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together garlic, lemon juice, mayo, honey, salt, and pepper.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stem into smaller pieces; add to bowl with dressing. Trim, peel, and coarsely grate carrot; add to bowl. Core and medium dice apple; add to bowl.
Add cranberries to bowl. Roughly chop walnuts and add to bowl.
Chop bacon into small pieces and add to salad. Toss salad until well coated with dressing.
Serve in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Broccoli, Bell Pepper & Chickpea Salad with Feta & Zesty Lemon Dressing

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash broccoli, separate into bite-sized florets, and cut thick stems into smaller pieces.
Once water is boiling, add broccoli to saucepan and cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 1-2 minutes. Drain and run under cold water. Set aside to drain excess water.
Peel and mince garlic. Wash lemon and grate 1 tsp of zest. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, lemon zest and juice, oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper.
Rinse and drain chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
Wash and dry bell pepper and parsley. Seed and medium dice the pepper. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to bowl.
Add broccoli and feta to bowl. Toss salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, place salad on a plate or in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Broccoli & Cheddar Frittata

instructions.text: Peel and small dice the onion. Wash the broccoli and chop into bite-size florets.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Grate ½ cup of cheddar into a small bowl and set aside.
Add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the onion and cook, stirring frequently, until softened and lightly browned, 3-4 minutes.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs, water, ½ of the shredded cheddar, salt, and pepper.
Add more butter to the skillet followed by broccoli florets. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 2-3 minutes.
Preheat broiler and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Spread out the broccoli evenly in the skillet. Reduce heat to medium-low and pour in the egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Sprinkle with the remaining cheddar. Place skillet in the oven until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and place on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Broccoli Cheddar Melts with Sun-Dried Tomato & Pine Nut Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
When onion is soft, add broccoli, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until broccoli starts to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium and add water to the skillet; continue to cook until the water is evaporated and broccoli is tender, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Add mayo, vinegar, and half of the cheese to the skillet with the broccoli; stir to combine. (Reserve remaining cheese for later use.)
Split rolls in half and place, cut-side facing up, on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil until lightly toasted, about 1 minute.
Remove baking sheet from the oven and divide broccoli mixture between toasted rolls; top with reserved cheese. Return to the oven and broil until cheese melts, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with pine nuts and mixed greens; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide broccoli-cheddar melts and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup with Toast & Mixed Greens Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Peel and small dice the onion; transfer to a medium bowl.
Wash the broccoli; cut the head into bite-sized florets and small dice the stems. Add the diced stems to the onion and transfer the florets to a separate bowl.
Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion, broccoli stems, and thyme to the saucepan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion and broccoli is softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the onion cooks, coarsely grate 1 cup of the cheddar; transfer to a small bowl.
Cut the bun in half and toast (if desired).
Sprinkle flour over the onion and stir to combine.
Gradually add the broth and milk while whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Stir in the broccoli and season with salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook until the broccoli is tender, 6 to 8 minutes.
While the soup cooks, wash and dry the greens (skip this step if the greens came pre-washed); transfer to a salad bowl.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Drizzle the greens with olive oil and balsamic vinegar; toss to coat and set aside.
Add half of the grated cheddar (save the rest for garnishing) to the saucepan and stir until it is completely melted, 1 to 2 minutes. .
Divide the soup between two bowls (or one bowl and one lunch container) and sprinkle with the remaining cheddar. Serve with the salad and toasted bun on the side. Enjoy!

name: Broccoli & Edamame Fried Rice with Sesame Egg Roll

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Peel and mince the garlic. Chop the broccoli into small pieces. Transfer all to a medium bowl.
Trim off the ends of the green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Transfer half the onions to the bowl with the other veggies; set the other half aside to use as garnish.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over high heat. Add oil and swirl to coat bottom.
Crack the eggs into a medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork.

Add the egg to the skillet and gently swirl the pan so that the egg forms a thin layer coating the bottom of the pan. Cook until the egg is just set and the edges begin to turn golden, about 1 minute. Carefully slide the egg onto a cutting board and allow to cool for a few minutes.
Return the skillet to the stove and lower the heat to medium. Add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the bowl of veggies to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until broccoli turns bright green, about 3 minutes.
Add peas and edamame to the skillet and continue cooking for another 2 minutes.
Meanwhile, roll the egg omelet tightly and cut on a diagonal into ½-inch slices.
Add rice and soy sauce to the skillet and cook, stirring often, until well combined and heated through, 3-4 minutes.
To serve, divide fried rice between plates and top with egg slices and remaining green onion. Enjoy!

name: Broccoli Pork Egg Fu Young with Steamed Rice & Gravy

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 10 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Combine broth, soy sauce, vinegar, and oil in a small saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Combine additional broth and corn starch in a small bowl; whisk to combine a smooth slurry. When broth in the saucepan comes to a boil, add slurry in a steady stream while whisking quickly. Let boil for 1 minute, then cover and reduce heat to low; simmer the gravy for 30 minutes.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to another small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Remove casing from sausage and roughly chop.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.

When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage to the skillet and cook, stirring often, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Once done, transfer sausage to a small bowl, leaving sausage drippings in the skillet. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Slice mushrooms. Peel and thinly slice yellow onion into half rings.
Preheat oven to broil on high; position rack under the broiler.
Return skillet to stove over high heat and add more oil. Add the vegetables and salt; cook, stirring often, until tender-crisp, 5-7 minutes.
Crack eggs into a medium bowl; add vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk together.

Stir sausage back into the skillet with the veggies. Reduce heat to medium-high and pour egg mixture evenly over the top. Let cook, undisturbed, until the bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 4-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Place skillet in the oven and cook until top is set and golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove from the oven and slice into wedges.
To serve, divide rice and egg fu young between dishes. Pour gravy over the egg fu young and top with green onions. Enjoy!

name: Broiled Black Pepper Beef with Cucumber-Edamame Salad & Sesame Seeds

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, chili-garlic sauce, and pepper. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat steak dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the marinade, toss to coat, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Once the skillet is hot, add sesame seeds and cook, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool.
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Place in another medium bowl along with oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl, along with drained edamame and toasted sesame seeds, reserving a small handful of sesame seeds for serving. Set bowl aside.

Transfer beef and marinade to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until beef is caramelized and cooked until desired doneness, 5-7 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lime into another small bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice and stir to combine the sauce.
To serve, divide black pepper beef and salad between plates or bowl. Drizzle sauce over beef, sprinkle with reserved sesame seeds, and enjoy!

name: Broiled Caper Halibut with Cauliflower & Mushrooms

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6 inches under the broiler.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove leaves from cauliflower; cut into bite-sized florets and place in a large mixing bowl.
Cut mushrooms into quarters and add to the bowl with the cauliflower.
Drizzle cauliflower and mushrooms with oil and season with thyme, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
Place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Place baking sheet in oven and broil until golden, 6-8 minutes, tossing halfway through.
Shave leaves from parsley stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.
Cut lemon into wedges and set aside with parsley.
Drain and rinse capers.
Spread the oil over the halibut using a spoon or your hands and season with salt and pepper.
When cauliflower is golden, place fish on top and sprinkle with capers. Broil until the fish is opaque, 5-7 minutes.
When fish is cooked, sprinkle with raisins and broil until raisins are plump and hot, about 30 seconds.
Divide halibut and vegetables between plates and drizzle with vinegar and any accumulated pan juices. Top with parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Broiled Chicken Thighs & Mushrooms with Creamy Zucchini-Parmesan Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth, salt, and garlic powder to the pan; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the broth is heating, trim and coarsely grate the zucchini.

Once the broth comes to a boil, add zucchini and stir the mixture; cover the saucepan and reduce heat to low. Cook zucchini-rice until liquid is mostly absorbed, about 18 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan.
Halve mushrooms and add to the baking sheet with the chicken.
Drizzle chicken and mushrooms with oil and season with spices; toss to coat, then spread out in a single layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping the chicken halfway through, until chicken and mushrooms are golden brown and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, chop chives into small pieces.
Finely grate Parmesan.
When the zucchini-rice is done, add chives and Parmesan to the pan and stir to combine.
To serve, divide chicken, mushrooms, and zucchini-chive rice between plates. Enjoy!

name: Broiled Greek Cod & Avocado Cucumber Salad with Feta-Mint Dressing

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice half the lime into a small bowl. (Reserve remaining lime for later.)
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Mince the sun-dried tomatoes; add to the bowl along with oil and spices. Stir to combine the tapenade.
Thinly slice olives.
Pat cod dry with paper towels and place on the baking sheet; season with salt and pepper. Spread with tapenade and top with olives.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until the cod is almost cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice the remaining lime into a medium bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the dressing.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Remove cod from the oven and top with half the feta (reserve remaining cheese for the salad). Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until the fish flakes easily with a fork and the cheese is golden, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Trim and thinly slice cucumber crosswise; add to the salad bowl along with the reserved feta. Gently stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide cod and salad between plates; enjoy!

name: Broiled Lemon Cod with Bean, Corn, Cucumber, Cilantro & Feta Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean-up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Pat fish dry with paper towels and transfer to the baking sheet; drizzle with half of the dressing and turn to coat. (Set remaining dressing aside for the salad.)
Place fish in the oven and broil until the fish flakes easily with a fork, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Place corn in the colander, run under hot water (from the tap) to defrost, and add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with the feta, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide fish and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Broiled Paprika Pork Chop with Zucchini, Bell Pepper & Walnut Sauté

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Place pork chops on a broiler pan and season both sides with spices.
Place pan in the oven. Broil, flipping halfway through, until chops are no longer pink in the center and are browned at the edges, 12-14 minutes. Remove from oven and let rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim zucchini. Halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper; medium dice. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Roughly chop walnuts. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and thinly slice garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add zucchini, bell pepper, walnuts, and spices to the skillet with the garlic. Stir to combine, then cover and cook, undisturbed, until starting to soften, about 4 minutes.
Uncover skillet and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until zucchini and bell pepper are fork-tender, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pork chops and veggie sauté between plates. Enjoy!

name: Broiled Parmesan Tilapia with Sautéed Broccoli, Zucchini & Pine Nuts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (for easier cleanup), coat with thin layer of oil, and set aside.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl with the broccoli and set aside.
Juice lemon into a small bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with mayo and spices; stir to combine and set aside.
Pat tilapia dry with paper towels, place on the baking sheet, and drizzle with oil. Place fish in the oven and broil until almost cooked through, about 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add broccoli, zucchini, pine nuts, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring often, until veggies are tender-crisp, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.

When the fish is almost cooked through, remove from the oven. Spread the mayo mixture over the fillets. Return to the oven and continue to broil until topping is browned and fish is cooked through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide fish and veggies between plates. Enjoy!

name: Broiled Pork Chop with Green Beans, Peppers, Tahini Yogurt & Almonds

instructions.text: Preheat the broiler to high and position rack about 6 inches from the top.
Place pork chops on a broiler pan and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Place pan in the oven. Broil, flipping halfway through, until chops are no longer pink in the center and are browned at the edges, 12-14 minutes. Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, place yogurt, tahini, vinegar, and salt in a small bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add almonds and cook, stirring frequently, until golden and toasted, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Wash, dry, and trim green beans; place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper, then slice lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the green beans.
Return the skillet to high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until blistered and tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chops and tahini yogurt between plates; top yogurt with veggies and almonds. Enjoy!

name: Broiled Pork Chops with Sautéed Red Cabbage

instructions.text: Heat oven on broiler setting and position rack about 6 inches from the top.
Place pork chops on a broiler pan (or baking dish if you don’t have a broiler pan) and season both sides with chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Place dish in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through cooking time, until chops are cooked through and browned at the edges, 10-12 minutes.
Wash, core, and cut apple into thin bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a large bowl.
Wash cabbage, halve, and cut off core. Thinly slice crosswise into shreds and add to bowl with apple.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add onion and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add cabbage, apple, water, vinegar, salt, and pepper to skillet; stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is tender-crisp, 6-8 minutes.
Serve pork chops with cabbage on the side. Enjoy!

name: Broiled Salt & Pepper Pork Chops with Cauliflower "Potato Salad"

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Cut into small, bite-sized florets.
Once the water comes to a boil, uncover, add cauliflower and salt; stir for a few seconds. Cook until crisp-tender, about 3 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool.
Preheat the broiler to high and position rack about 6 inches from the top.
Place pork chops on a broiler pan and season both sides with salt and pepper.

Place pork chops in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through cooking time. Cook until chops are no longer pink in the center and are browned at the edges, 12-14 minutes, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F. Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes.
While the pork chops are cooking, add mayonnaise, Dijon, vinegar, and spices to a medium bowl; whisk together.
Peel and mince shallot. Small dice celery (reserving celery leaves for garnish); transfer both to the bowl with the dressing.
Using a knife, shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add dill and drained cauliflower to the bowl and stir to combine.
To serve, divide cauliflower salad and pork chops between plates. Garnish with celery leaves and enjoy!

name: Broiled Tandoori Chicken with Cucumber-Tomato Salad & Turmeric Rice

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and turmeric, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Juice lime and divide between two medium bowls. Set one bowl aside for the salad.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the remaining bowl with the lime juice along with yogurt and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.

Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Add to the bowl with the marinade and turn to coat. Transfer chicken to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer (spread with any leftover marinade in bowl).
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven and broil the chicken, flipping halfway through, until cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot. Add to the second medium bowl with the lime juice along with oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes crosswise. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl and stir to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
To serve, divide the rice, chicken, and salad between plates. Top with reserved cilantro and enjoy!

name: Broiled Tandoori Salmon with Green Pea-Rice, Tomato-Kiwi Salad & Mint

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, place oil and spices in a medium bowl, then stir to combine the spice paste.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, pat the salmon dry with paper towels. Add to the bowl with the spice paste and turn to coat. Set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean-up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in another medium bowl along with yogurt, water, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining mint for serving.)
Peel, trim, and medium dice kiwis. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Transfer salmon to the baking sheet. Place salmon in the oven and broil until fish flakes easily with a fork, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
When the rice is done, place peas in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the rice and gently stir to combine.
Divide rice, salad, and salmon between plates, then sprinkle with reserved mint. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Broiled Teriyaki Chicken Thighs with Bell Pepper-Cilantro Salad & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Place ginger, garlic, broth, soy sauce, sugar, and cinnamon in a small saucepan; whisk to combine. Place the saucepan over high heat and bring to a boil.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth. When liquid in the saucepan comes to a boil, add slurry in a steady stream while whisking quickly. Let boil for 1 minute, then remove from heat and pour the teriyaki sauce into another small bowl; set aside.
Rinse the saucepan and reserve for the next step.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to the reserved saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional) and coat with a thin layer of oil.

Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on the baking sheet. Pour half of the teriyaki sauce over the chicken (reserving the rest for serving) and turn to coat; spread chicken out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil the chicken, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the chicken is cooking, place oil, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and cut bell peppers into thin matchsticks; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts and add to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide rice, chicken, and salad between plates. Top chicken with reserved teriyaki sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Brothy Vegetarian Edamame & Potato Succotash with Toasted Flatbread

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice potato; transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the potato.
Trim and cut celery crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion and spices to the pan; cook, stirring often, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.

Add veggies, broth, edamame, corn, and sugar to the pan with the onion. Stir to combine the succotash and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, about 8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the succotash is cooking, halve tomatoes and place in the reserved bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes and set aside.
Toast flatbread if desired (optional), then slice into wedges.
When the succotash is done, add tomatoes, parsley, and cream to the pan; stir to combine and remove from heat.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide succotash between bowls and enjoy with warm flatbread on the side!

name: Brown Butter Pumpkin Mac & Cheese

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add pasta and salt, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
While pasta is cooking, melt butter in another medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Stir, cooking until butter has browned, 3-4 minutes. Watch it carefully so that it does not burn.
Remove saucepan from heat, stir in flour, whisking constantly, 1 minute.
Return saucepan to heat, gradually stir in milk. Bring to a simmer and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Wash and dry thyme. Slide leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
Stir in pumpkin, salt, pepper, and most of the thyme (reserve some for garnish).
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Grate cheese and add to saucepan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted.
When macaroni is done cooking, drain in a colander. Add to the cheese sauce and stir to combine.
To serve, divide the macaroni and cheese between plates or bowls and sprinkle with fresh thyme. Enjoy!

name: Brown Sugar Bacon Lettuce Wraps with Lime Aioli & Pickled Cucumbers

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 2-inch long pieces. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, halve bacon crosswise and place on a plate. Sprinkle with sugar on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and crispy, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in another small bowl.
Zest and juice lime into the bowl with the cilantro. Add mayo and spices, then whisk to combine the lime aioli. Set aside.
Slice tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; top with tomatoes and bacon. Drizzle with lime aioli and serve with pickled cucumbers on the side. Enjoy!

name: Brown Sugar-Sage Gnocchi Bake with Sausage, Peppers, Tomatoes & Onion

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash, dry, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the pepper.
Peel and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Add gnocchi, oil, sugar, and spices to the bowl; toss to combine.
Transfer veggies and gnocchi to a baking sheet pan and spread out in a single layer. Add sausages to the baking sheet, nestling them into the veggies and gnocchi.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until sausages are cooked through and gnocchi is golden brown, 20-25 minutes.
Remove baking sheet from the oven. Transfer sausages to a cutting board and slice crosswise into 1-inch thick pieces.
To serve, divide gnocchi, veggies, and sausage between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Brussels Sprout, Grape, Couscous & Goat Cheese Stuffed Acorn Squash

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place the rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve acorn squash lengthwise, trim ends, then scoop out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange the squash halves cut-side down on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
While the squash is cooking, place couscous in a medium bowl.

Pour broth into a skillet, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from heat, pour into the bowl with the couscous, and stir (reserve skillet for later use). Tightly cover the bowl with foil and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and spices; cook, stirring often, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
While the onion is cooking, trim and halve Brussels sprouts.
Add Brussels sprouts and water to the skillet; cover with a lid and cook until the sprouts are fork-tender, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve grapes.
When the sprouts are ready, juice lemon into the skillet and add grapes. Continue to cook, uncovered, until most of the liquid has evaporated and grapes are soft, 1-2 minutes more.
Add veggie-grape mixture and pumpkin seeds to the bowl with the couscous; stir to combine the stuffing.
To serve, divide squash halves between plates and fill with the veggie-couscous stuffing. Crumble goat cheese over top and enjoy!

name: Brussels Sprout-Kale Cobb Salad with Bacon, Tomato, Avocado & Egg

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 3-4 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate; set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
While the bacon is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add tomatoes and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to brown and burst, 4-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice Brussels sprouts. Add to the bowl.
Using your hands, massage the greens with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes. Set aside.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and large dice.
Peel and quarter eggs, then season with salt and pepper.
To serve, divide greens between plates or bowls. Top with bacon, eggs, tomatoes, avocado, and blue cheese. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

name: Brussels Sprout Salad with Roasted Chicken, Crisp Apple & Walnuts

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Combine oils, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Place in a baking dish, pour half of the dressing over the chicken and turn to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place chicken in the oven and bake, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; thinly slice crosswise and add to the large bowl with the remaining dressing.
Trim ends and thinly slice Brussels sprouts. Medium dice celery. Add both to the bowl.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle; add to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Core and thinly slice apple.
Roughly chop walnuts.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide salad between plates and top with apples, walnuts, and chicken. Enjoy!

name: Brussels Sprout Salad with Warm Chickpeas, Beet, Pear & Goat Cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice beets. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the baking sheet with the beets, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until chickpeas are golden and beets are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, maple syrup, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice Brussels sprouts. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice pear. Add to the bowl and stir to combine.
Just before serving, add pumpkin seeds to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with warm chickpeas and beets. Crumble goat cheese over top and enjoy!

name: Brussels Sprouts, Grape & Apple Salad with Walnuts & Parmesan

instructions.text: In a large salad bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together lemon juice, olive oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper.
Wash brussels sprouts and trim rough ends. Shred by slicing thinly or using a mandoline slicer; transfer to salad bowl and toss with dressing.
Wash grapes and apple. Halve and add grapes to salad bowl. Core, medium dice, and add apple to salad bowl.
Roughly chop walnuts; add to salad bowl. Grate ¼ cup of Parmesan; add to salad bowl.
Toss salad until well combined.
Serve salad on a plate and enjoy!

name: Brussels Sprouts, Mashed Potato & Sausage Bowl with Creamy Dijon Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, and halve Brussels sprouts; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Slice sausages into ½-inch-thick rounds; add to the baking sheet.

Drizzle sprouts and sausages with oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until sprouts are tender-crisp and sausages are cooked through, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add salt, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash, peel, and chop the potatoes into ½-inch cubes. Add to the saucepan and cook until very tender, 7-10 minutes. Drain and return to saucepan.
Meanwhile, combine oil, Dijon, mayo, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper in a small bowl; whisk until smooth.
Add butter, milk, salt, and pepper to potatoes and mash until smooth.
To serve, divide potatoes between bowls, top with Brussels sprouts and sausages; drizzle with creamy Dijon dressing and enjoy!

name: Buffalo Cauliflower & Chickpea Pita Pockets with Ranch Sauce

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Reserve ¼ cup of the chickpea liquid and place in a medium bowl, then drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Add half the chickpeas to the bowl with the bean liquid and mash well; stir in remaining chickpeas, leaving them whole.
Add vinegar, Dijon, chili-garlic sauce, and tomato paste to the chickpea mixture; stir to combine. Set aside.
To make the ranch dressing, combine mayonnaise and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine. Add additional water (1 tsp at a time) as needed to reach a drizzling consistency.
Remove leaves and thick stems from cauliflower; cut into bite-sized florets.
Peel and small dice onion and carrot.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add cauliflower, onion, carrot, and garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, 3-4 minutes.

Add chickpea mixture, salt, and pepper to the skillet and continue to cook until cauliflower is tender, about 5 minutes. Taste the chickpea mixture and add more garlic-chili sauce (¼ tsp at a time) to reach desired spiciness.
Small dice celery.
Cut pita in half and carefully open the pita pockets.
To serve, divide spinach, bean-cauliflower mixture, and celery between pita pockets. Top with ranch dressing and enjoy!

name: Buffalo Chicken Lettuce Wraps with Celery Sticks

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
In a medium bowl, combine and mix together the spices. Transfer ¼ tsp of the mixture to a small bowl for garnishing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the chicken thighs into ¼-inch strips. Add the chicken to the spice mixture and mix thoroughly with your hands.
Wash and dry the cutting board.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 7 to 10 minutes.
While the chicken cooks, halve the tomatoes and transfer to a plate.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Place the onions next to the tomatoes.

Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; thinly slice the flesh crosswise (without piercing the skin) and scoop out. Place the avocado slices next to the tomatoes and onions.
Trim off and discard the root end of the lettuce; separate the leaves and place on a plate.
Trim off and discard the ends of the celery sticks; cut the sticks crosswise into thirds.

To serve, scoop the chicken into the lettuce leaves, then top with the tomatoes, green onions, and avocado slices. Garnish with the remaining spice mix and serve with the celery sticks on the side. Enjoy!

name: Buffalo Chicken Wraps with Kale, Carrot, Celery & Blue Cheese Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Place chili-garlic sauce, vinegar, honey, Worcestershire, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the Buffalo sauce.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets; cut each fillet crosswise into 1-inch thick strips.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add chicken and buffalo sauce to the skillet, tossing to coat. Cook, turning strips occasionally, until cooked through; 4-5 minutes. Remove skillet from the heat and set aside. (Reserve sauce bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and grate carrots; add to the bowl with the kale.
Trim celery and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Place yogurt, blue cheese, water, Worcestershire, vinegar, and spices in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Place tortillas on a flat surface and spread with half of the blue cheese dressing. Divide chicken and half of the salad between them; roll tightly to close and cut in half.
Divide wraps between plates. Serve with remaining salad and dressing on the side. Enjoy!

name: Buffalo Shrimp Flatbread with Blue Cheese & Pickled Veggie Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Place vinegar and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel, trim, and halve carrot lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place shrimp in a medium bowl along with cornstarch, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp and cook, stirring occasionally, until just opaque, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat, add hot sauce, and stir to combine.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, place oil, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing. Add pickled veggies and arugula, then toss to combine the salad.
Top each flatbread with a small handful of the arugula salad, spicy shrimp, and blue cheese. Slice into wedges. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Divide flatbreads between plates. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Buffalo Shrimp Tacos with Creamy Napa Cabbage-Mango Slaw

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice half of the lime into a medium bowl; cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
Add yogurt, mayo, and spices to the bowl with the lime juice, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the slaw, and set aside.
Place flour and spices in another medium bowl, then stir to combine.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, add shrimp to the bowl with the flour mixture and toss to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp and cook until they are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side.
Remove skillet from heat, add hot sauce, and stir until sauce coats shrimp.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with a small portion of slaw and shrimp. Serve with remaining slaw on the side and lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!

name: "Buffalo" Turkey Stuffed Peppers with Blue Cheese-Celery Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; arrange cut-side down. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place mayo, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl with the dressing. (Reserve remaining green onions for the next step.)
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add remaining green onions, turkey, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.

Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with mixed greens and half of the blue cheese. Toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining blue cheese for the next step.)
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: When the turkey is done, add remaining blue cheese and hot sauce to the skillet. Stir to combine the filling and remove from heat.
Divide peppers between plates, then stuff with turkey filling and drizzle with additional hot sauce. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Bunless Beef Burgers with Sautéed Sweet Potatoes

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, Worcestershire, Dijon, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper; mix well.
Form the beef mixture into 4 patties.
Once the pan / skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the beef patties to the pan / skillet; cook until they are cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the potatoes.
Once the sauté pan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the diced potatoes to the pan and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and lightly browned, 6 to 8 minutes.
Slice the tomato into rounds.
To serve, arrange a bed of spinach on a plate and top with tomato slices, burger patties, and some mayo. Add the sweet potatoes on the side. Enjoy!

name: Burst Cherry Tomato, Basil & Shrimp Linguine

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: When the water in the pot comes to a boil, uncover the pot and season the water with salt, then add the pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook the pasta, uncovered, for about 10 minutes (or according to package directions). Drain the pasta in a colander.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom; add tomatoes and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes burst, about 8 minutes.

Add the shrimp, garlic, and crushed red pepper to the skillet with the tomatoes. Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the sauce begins to thicken and the shrimp is cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Finely grate Parmesan.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Stir into the sauce.
To serve, divide the pasta between bowls and top with shrimp, sauce, and Parmesan. Enjoy!
