name: Butter Chicken with Spinach, Cilantro & Baked Cauliflower Rice

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Season cauliflower rice with salt and pepper. Cut butter into small pieces and sprinkle over top.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring cauliflower rice halfway through, until tender and golden, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat chicken dry with paper towels, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: When the onion is done, add chicken to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 5-6 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small bowl.

Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic, along with tomato paste, water, garam masala, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the spice paste.

When the chicken is done, add spice paste to the skillet and stir to coat. Add broth and cream, then stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until curry has thickened, 10-12 minutes more.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Meanwhile, roughly chop spinach.
When the curry has thickened, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and butter chicken between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Butter Lettuce Salad with Beans, Mixed Fruit, Goat Cheese & Pecans

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans; set aside to drain further.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the beans, and toss to combine.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice pear; add to the bowl.
Halve grapes and add to the bowl along with the blueberries.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces, add to the bowl, and toss to combine the salad.
Roughly chop pecans.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and crumble goat cheese over top. Sprinkle with pecans and enjoy!

name: Butter Lettuce Salad with Tuna, Potato, Orange, Avocado & Olives

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Quarter potatoes and place in a small saucepan; cover with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook until fork-tender, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water to cool, then set aside.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl; add mayo, oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Peel orange, separate into segments, and roughly chop the flesh; add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives and add to the bowl.
Drain tuna, flake with a fork, and add to the bowl.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces, add to the bowl, along with the potatoes, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Buttered Scallops with Bacon & Brown Sugar Brussels Sprouts

instructions.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice the onion.
Once the bacon is cooked, transfer to a plate lined with paper towels; pat to remove excess oil. Crumble or chop into small pieces and set aside.
Return skillet (with bacon fat) to the stove over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally until softened, 3-5 minutes.
Wash, trim ends, and thinly slice Brussels sprouts.
Add the Brussels sprouts, vinegar, sugar, and salt to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned and tender, 4-6 minutes. Once done, transfer to a medium bowl; set aside.
Return skillet to medium-high heat and add the butter.
Pat the scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Carefully add scallops to the skillet in a single layer; cook until they develop a nice sear and are opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
To serve, divide the Brussels sprouts between plates. Top with the scallops and crumbled bacon. Enjoy!

name: Butternut Squash Fettuccine with Bacon & Baby Spinach

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Chop the bacon into small pieces.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.

Add the bacon to the saucepan and cook until crispy, 3-4 minutes. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel lined plate; remove the saucepan from the heat but leave the bacon fat in the saucepan.
Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and small dice the onion.
Wash the squash; trim off and discard the ends. Halve the squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds from each half; peel and small dice the squash. You should have about 1 ½ cups of diced squash.
Return the saucepan to medium heat. Add the onion, minced garlic, and butternut squash to the bacon fat. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes.
Add broth to pan with squash mixture, bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and let simmer, covered, until the squash is fork-tender, 15 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Finely grate the Parmesan cheese and set aside.

Once the squash mixture is cooked through, purée with an immersion (hand) blender or regular blender. Return the puréed mixture to the saucepan on low heat to keep warm. Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese, salt, and pepper.
Add pasta to the saucepan with the squash purée; toss to combine.
Add spinach to the pasta and stir, allowing the spinach to wilt into the pasta, about 3 minutes.
To serve, divide pasta between bowls and top with bacon. Enjoy!

name: Butternut Squash, Prosciutto & Blue Cheese Flatbread with Arugula

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Pick sage leaves off the stems; discard stems and finely chop the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.

Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and small dice. Add to the bowl with the sage along with oil, salt, and pepper; stir to coat. Transfer squash to the baking sheet and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until squash is golden and fork-tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons.
Once the skillet is hot, add prosciutto slices and cook until crispy, about 1 minute per side. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside.
Return skillet to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion, water, and salt. Cook, stirring frequently, until onions are soft and golden brown, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Crumble or chop the crispy prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
Carefully remove cooked squash from the baking sheet by lifting the corners of the foil and transferring the whole sheet to a flat surface.
Arrange flatbreads on the baking sheet; layer with onion, squash, prosciutto, and blue cheese. Place in the oven and bake until flatbreads are golden and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Meanwhile, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine.
When the flatbreads are done, remove from oven, and top each with a small handful of arugula. (Reserve remaining arugula for serving.)
Divide flatbreads between plates; serve with remaining arugula on the side and enjoy!

name: Butternut Squash Soup with Pumpkin Seeds & Arugula-Apple Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add onion and garlic; begin cooking while you prepare the squash.
Wash squash, cut off ends, and peel. Halve, scrape out seeds, medium dice the flesh, and add to saucepan. Stirring occasionally, cook until onion is softened, 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together olive oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add broth, salt, and pepper to saucepan. Increase heat to medium-high, cover, and cook until squash is tender, 10-15 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry arugula. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Wash, core, and cut apple into thin wedges. Add to arugula.
Purée soup using a hand or regular blender until smooth.
Pour soup into a bowl and garnish with pumpkin seeds. Place salad on the side and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Butternut Squash Soup with Spinach Salad & Lemon Poppy Seed Dressing

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and small dice the carrot. Peel and small dice the onion. Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the carrot, onion, and ginger to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are tender, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard the ends of the squash. Halve the squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds; peel and small dice the squash. You should have about 4 cups of diced squash.
Add the squash, broth, and spices to the pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a simmer and cook until squash is fork-tender, 10-15 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Juice half of the lemon into a large bowl; add the oil, honey, Dijon, onion powder, and poppy seeds. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Core and medium dice apple.
Roughly chop walnuts.
Add the spinach, feta, walnuts, cranberries, and apple to the bowl with the dressing. Toss to combine and set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Once the squash is tender, juice remaining lemon into the pot. Add the milk. Stir to combine and remove from the heat.
Pureé the soup with an immersion (hand) blender or regular blender.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and top with pumpkin seeds. Serve with the salad and enjoy!

name: "Cacio e Pepe" Grilled Cheese with Prosciutto & Creamy Asparagus Soup

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and medium dice carrots. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and medium dice celery. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Set aside.
When the veggies are softened, add flour to the pan. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until veggies are well coated, about 1 minute.

Add broth and milk to the pan; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until soup thickens slightly, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place half of the bread slices on a flat surface. Top with Parmesan, season with pepper, then layer with prosciutto. Cover sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes.

Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more butter to the skillet. Return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes more. Once done, transfer to a cutting board and slice in half.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with sandwiches on the side. Enjoy!

name: "Cacio e Pepe" Orzo Salad with Artichokes, Peas, Parsley & Parmesan

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add orzo, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Thinly slice green onions crosswise (at an angle). Add the white and pale green parts to the bowl. (Reserve dark green parts for serving.)
Place frozen peas in a colander and run under warm water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl.
When the orzo is done, drain in a colander, then add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies. Stir to combine and set aside to cool, 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, thinly slice snap peas crosswise (at an angle).
Finely grate Parmesan.
Once the orzo is cool, add Parmesan and snap peas to the bowl. Stir once more to combine the salad.
To serve, divide orzo salad between plates or bowls. Top with reserved green onions and season with pepper. Enjoy!

name: "Cacio e Pepe" Spaghetti Squash with Caesar Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim spaghetti squash, halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with butter, then season with salt and pepper. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for later use.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the Parmesan.
Juice lemon into the bowl. Add mayo, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince additional garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, cream, pepper, and salt, then stir to combine; bring to a simmer.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: When the cream is simmering, reduce heat to low and add reserved Parmesan to the pan. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
Remove squash from the oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.

When the squash is cooled slightly, scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand.) Place in a medium bowl, along with the sauce, and gently toss to coat.
To serve, divide spaghetti squash and salad between plates or bowls. Top spaghetti squash with additional pepper and enjoy!

name: Caesar Salad with Crispy Bacon, Mushrooms & Sautéed Asparagus

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Finely grate Parmesan into a medium bowl.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic; mince anchovy fillets. Add both to the bowl with the Parmesan.
Juice lemon into the bowl, then add mayo, oil, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch pieces.
Return skillet with drippings to medium-high heat; add asparagus and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
While the asparagus is cooking, thinly slice mushrooms and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
When the asparagus is done, remove from heat, add to the bowl, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with crispy bacon. Enjoy!

name: Caesar Salad Flatbread with Sun-Dried Tomato & Cottage Cheese Spread

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a blender.

Peel garlic. Add to the blender along with anchovy fillets, sun-dried tomatoes, Dijon, oil, honey, salt, and pepper. Blend on high until smooth. Transfer half of the dressing to a medium bowl and set aside for the salad.
Add cottage cheese and more oil to the blender with the remaining dressing. Blend once more on high until smooth. Set cottage cheese spread aside.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Medium dice tomato. Add to the bowl.
Drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl.
Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl and gently toss to combine the salad.
Spoon the cottage cheese spread over each flatbread, then top with salad.
To serve, cut flatbreads into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Caesar Salad with Tomatoes & Creamy Dijon Deviled Eggs

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Grate Parmesan into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to bowl with the Parmesan.
Mince anchovy fillet and add to the bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl; add mayo, oil, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Medium dice tomato and add to the bowl with the dressing; set aside.
When the eggs are cool enough to handle, peel and halve.
Scoop out the yolks and add to a small bowl along with mayo, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Using a fork, mash to combine, creating a smooth paste.
Spoon the yolk mixture back into the eggs and sprinkle with paprika.
Chop or tear romaine leaves into bite-sized pieces, add to the bowl with the dressing, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and eggs between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cajun Chicken & Avocado Burger with Baby Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium heat.
In a small bowl, prepare cajun rub by mixing together cumin, coriander, paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Rub with spice mixture on all sides.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken fillets and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry spinach. Save a small handful of leaves for the burgers; add the rest to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
Wash and slice tomato into rounds. Halve and pit avocado; thinly slice while still in skin and scoop out.
Toast buns on grill/skillet.
To serve, spread some Dijon on buns. Top with remaining spinach leaves, chicken, and slices of tomato and avocado. Serve with spinach salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Cajun Chicken, Cheddar & Spinach Salad with Scallion-Yogurt Dressing

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, trim green onions and place on a plate. Drizzle with oil and season with salt.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Once the grill pan is hot, add the green onions. Cook, turning once, until tender and lightly charred, about 5 minutes; return to the plate.

Meanwhile, place yogurt, oil, water, vinegar, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside. (Add additional water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if necessary, to reach a drizzling consistency.)
Place spices in another small bowl and stir to combine the spice mix.
Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on another plate; season with the spice mix on both sides.
Once the green onions are done, return grill pan to medium-high heat and coat with oil. Add chicken and grill, flipping once, until charred and cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, mince the grilled onions and add to the bowl with the dressing. Stir to combine and set aside. (Reserve plate for next step.)
Coarsely grate cheese and place on the reserved plate.
Halve tomatoes and add to the plate with the cheese.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the plate.
Slice chicken into strips.
Divide spinach between plates or bowls; top with cheese, tomatoes, avocado, and chicken. Serve with dressing on the side and enjoy!

name: Cajun Macaroni Salad with Kidney Beans, Corn, Peppers & Green Onion

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, sugar, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl along with the beans.
Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl.
Add cooled pasta to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Cajun Pork Chop with Pineapple Sauce & Spicy Cauliflower-Carrot Rice

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl with the cauliflower. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until cauliflower and carrots are tender and golden, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Sprinkle with Cajun seasoning on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate, cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in the reserved bowl along with water, soy sauce, maple syrup, cornstarch, Dijon, Cajun seasoning, and salt. Whisk to combine the sauce.
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the sauce.
When the pork chops are done, return skillet to medium-low heat. Add pineapple and sauce; cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Thinly slice pork chops.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and pineapple sauce between plates. Top sauce with pork and enjoy!

name: Cajun Pork Chop with Spicy Pan Sauce, Potatoes, Bell Pepper & Celery

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter new potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the baking sheet with the potatoes.
Trim and medium dice celery. Add to the baking sheet.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the baking sheet.
Peel and mince garlic, then add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until potatoes are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes. (Reserve skillet with drippings for the next step.)
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add flour and cook, whisking constantly, for 1 minute.
Add broth, hot sauce, salt, and pepper to the skillet, then whisk to combine the sauce. Cook, whisking frequently, until sauce is thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, divide pork and roasted veggies between plates. Spoon pan sauce over chops and enjoy!

name: Cajun Shrimp-Sausage Sauté with Celery, Zucchini, Bell Pepper & Rice

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut sausages crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy and cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer sausage to a plate, leaving the cooking juices in the skillet.
While the sausages are cooking, using a clean cutting board, trim and slice celery crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces; place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the celery.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons; add to the bowl.

When the sausage is done, return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add veggies, tomatoes, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, about 8 minutes.

When the veggies are tender, add sausage and shrimp to the skillet; stir to combine and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sausage is warm and shrimp are cooked through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the parsley to the skillet and stir to combine (reserve the other half for serving).
To serve, divide rice and shrimp-sausage sauté between plates. Sprinkle with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Cajun Shrimp Sauté with Bell Peppers, Green Onions, Pecans & Polenta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta to the pan in a thin steady stream, whisking continuously, until incorporated. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and creamy, 15-25 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl with the bell peppers. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl and set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, green onion, and garlic to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add shrimp and spices to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are just opaque and starting to color, 2-3 minutes more.
Meanwhile, roughly chop pecans.
When the shrimp are done, add pecans to the skillet and stir to combine. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.

When the polenta is done, add oil, salt, and pepper to the pan, then stir to combine. If the polenta is too firm, add hot water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until you reach a desired consistency. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide polenta between plates or bowls; top with shrimp sauté and reserved green onions. Enjoy!

name: Cajun Spiced Ribeye with Green Bean, Tomato & Basil Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Place in a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap).
Bring green beans to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook until fork-tender, 2-3 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool, then set aside to drain further.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; sprinkle Cajun seasoning and salt on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
While the steak is cooking, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with the cooked green beans, and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: California Club Sandwich with Lemony Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and bacon. Cook chicken until it is golden brown and cooked through and bacon until it is crispy, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels and pat dry the bacon.
Toast buns or rolls.
Wash and dry spinach. Wash and slice tomato into rounds. Halve and pit avocado; cut into slices while still in skin and scoop out.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, mix together mayo with ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the salad dressing).
In a small bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Thinly slice chicken into strips.
Spread garlic mayo over the bottom halves of bread in each pair. Layer with spinach leaves, chicken, avocado, tomato, and bacon. Top with remaining slices of bread.
Place sandwich on a plate and serve with remaining spinach on the side. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: California Cobb Salad with Dijon Vinaigrette

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Heat a skillet over medium-low heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Cut bacon strips in half crosswise.

Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and bacon. Cook chicken until golden brown and no longer pink inside, 4-5 minutes per side. Cook bacon until crispy, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer both to a plate lined with paper towels.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together the garlic, olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Wash lettuce and chop crosswise into 1 inch strips.
Wash and halve tomatoes.
Scoop out the avocado flesh and medium dice.
Cut chicken into cubes. Roughly chop bacon. Peel and roughly chop eggs.
To serve, arrange a bed of lettuce on a plate, then add tomatoes, avocado, chicken, bacon, eggs, and blue cheese in rows over top. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

name: Cannellini Bean Sauté with Mushrooms, Leeks, Pine Nuts & Goat Cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off the root ends and the dark green tops of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add garlic and leeks to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, quarter the mushrooms.
Chop chives into small pieces.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.

Add mushrooms, chives (reserving a small handful for garnish), beans, tomatoes, tomato paste, and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and veggies soften, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, crumble goat cheese into a small bowl.
Roughly chop pine nuts.
To serve, divide bean and veggie sauté between bowls; top with goat cheese and pine nuts. Enjoy!

name: Cannellini Beans, Roasted Tomatoes & Basil over Polenta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F and position rack in the center.

In a small saucepan, bring broth and water to a boil. Reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta in a thin steady stream, while whisking constantly, until the polenta is incorporated into the liquid. Cook, stirring occasionally, until grains are soft and the texture is creamy, 15-25 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Drain and rinse beans. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Wash tomatoes and add to beans.
Peel and mince garlic; add to beans and tomatoes. Drizzle with olive oil and season salt and pepper; toss to combine.
Place in the oven and roast until tomatoes collapse slightly, 10-15 minutes.
Wash basil. Pick leaves off the stems; discard the stems and thinly slice the leaves crosswise into ribbons.
Add salt and pepper to polenta and stir to combine. If polenta is too firm, add a little more water and stir.
Remove beans and tomatoes from oven. Sprinkle with basil and drizzle with vinegar; gently toss.
Place polenta into a bowl and top with beans and tomatoes. Enjoy!

name: Caprese Frittata with Fresh Mozzarella & Basil Ribbons

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Wash the fresh produce. Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves crosswise into ribbons. Slice the tomatoes into rounds. Peel and mince the garlic.
Slice the mozzarella into rounds.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Preheat the broiler and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.

Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Reserve 5 or 6 tomato slices for later while adding the rest to the skillet. Cook until tomatoes begin to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs, water, ½ of the basil ribbons (save the rest for garnishing), salt, and pepper.

Reduce heat to medium-low and pour in the egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm by the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Top frittata with mozzarella and remaining tomato slices. Place skillet in the oven until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and garnish with remaining basil ribbons and freshly ground pepper. Enjoy!

name: Caprese Frittata with Spinach, Mozzarella, Prosciutto & Balsamic Glaze

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Place vinegar and sugar in a small saucepan; bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the skillet is hot, add prosciutto in a single layer and cook until crispy, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, place eggs, milk, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine. Chop or tear mozzarella into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Halve grape tomatoes. Divide between a small and a medium bowl, then set the small bowl aside.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the medium bowl with the tomatoes.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, then add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes, shallot, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Roughly chop spinach. When the tomatoes are tender, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook until spinach is wilted, then spread veggie-spinach mixture out evenly in the skillet.

Reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 3-5 minutes.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until top of the frittata is set, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, remove basil leaves from stems; discard stems. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the small bowl with the tomatoes along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine.
Crumble or chop prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Drizzle with balsamic glaze, then top with tomato-basil mixture and crispy prosciutto. Enjoy!

name: "Caprese" Gnocchi Bake with Mozzarella, Tomato, Basil & Balsamic Glaze

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the baking sheet with the bell pepper along with tomatoes and gnocchi. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until gnocchi is golden brown and tomatoes begin to burst, 18-20 minutes.

While the gnocchi is baking, place vinegar and sugar in a small saucepan; bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until reduced by half, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, chop or tear mozzarella into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.

When the gnocchi is done, remove from the oven. Add arugula and half of the basil to the baking sheet. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer, then top with mozzarella. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to bake until arugula is wilted and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide the gnocchi bake between plates or bowls. Drizzle with balsamic glaze and sprinkle with reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Caprese Pasta Salad with Arugula & Balsamic Vinaigrette

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic.
Peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds.
To make the dressing, add garlic, shallots, balsamic vinegar, olive oil, salt, and pepper to a small bowl. Whisk to combine; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Halve the grape tomatoes lengthwise and add to a medium bowl.
Cut the fresh mozzarella into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: When pasta is done, drain in a colander, and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside to drain further.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half of the basil to the bowl with the tomatoes and mozzarella; reserve the rest for garnish.
Add the pasta to the bowl and toss to combine.
To serve, divide the arugula between plates or bowls, and top with pasta salad. Drizzle balsamic vinaigrette over salad and sprinkle with remaining basil. Enjoy!

name: Caprese-Style Spinach Salad with Grilled Apricots, Tempeh & Mozzarella

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Slice tempeh crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces and place in a medium bowl. Add soy sauce, vinegar, and Italian seasoning. Gently stir to coat and set aside to marinate.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, halve apricots lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Season the cut-side with salt and pepper.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add apricot halves, cut-side down, and grill until charred and soft, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice shallot crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the shallot along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tempeh in a single layer (leaving any excess marinade in the bowl) and cook, flipping once, until browned and warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the tempeh is cooking, halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
Cut or tear mozzarella into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: When the apricots are cool enough to handle, thinly slice. Add to the bowl, along with spinach, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with seared tempeh. Enjoy!

name: Caramelized Onion Grilled Cheese with Creamy Honey-Mustard Mixed Salad

instructions.text: Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and caramelized, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, place mayo, honey, water, and Dijon in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim ends of the cucumber; quarter lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl and set aside.
Grate mozzarella.
When the onions are done, add vinegar and Worcestershire to the pan, stir to combine, then remove from the heat.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, place the bread slices on a flat surface. Evenly top half of the slices with the onions and mozzarella. Cover the sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes.
While the sandwiches are cooking, chop the lettuce into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing and veggies. Toss to combine the salad.

Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more butter to the skillet; return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side-up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes more. Once done, transfer to a cutting board and slice in half.
To serve, divide the salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cardamom-Pork, Spinach, Sweet Potato & Cherry Salad with Goat Cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, peel, and medium dice sweet potato. Place in a large baking dish along with cherries, oil, and spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until cherries are soft and sweet potatoes are fork-tender, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with spices on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
While the chops are cooking, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with additional oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
When the sweet potatoes and cherries are done, remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, thinly slice pork chops.
Wash and dry the spinach. (Skip this step if it came pre-washed.) Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the cooled sweet potatoes and cherries. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, then top with pork. Crumble goat cheese over top and enjoy!

name: Caribbean Black Bean Stew with Mango Salsa & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Seed and small dice bell pepper.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and bell pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies begin to soften, about 3 minutes.

Meanwhile, peel and chop sweet potato into ½-inch pieces. Add to the pan with the veggies along with the beans, broth, and spices. Stir and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Peel mango and slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; small dice and place in a medium bowl.
Trim and mince green onions; add to the bowl with the mango.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeño with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Juice lime into the bowl and stir to combine the salsa.
To serve, divide rice, stew, and mango salsa between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Carrot, Beet & Goat Cheese Salad with Lemon Poppy Seed Vinaigrette

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Wash and dry the fresh produce (skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed).
Juice the lemon into a small bowl.
Add the oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and poppy seeds to the bowl with the lemon juice. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel the carrots and beet, then trim off and discard the ends. Use a julienne peeler or box grater to coarsely cut or grate the carrots, followed by the beet; set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and coarsely chop the leaves.
Peel and quarter the eggs lengthwise.
To serve, divide the mixed greens between plates, top with hard boiled egg, carrots, beets, crumbled goat cheese, and parsley. Drizzle with poppy seed vinaigrette. Enjoy!

name: Carrot Ginger Soup with Cranberry-Almond Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and roughly chop the carrots and potato.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince shallot; add to salad bowl.
Once the saucepan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Combine the chopped carrots and potatoes, honey, and salt in the saucepan.
Peel and mince or grate ginger; add to the saucepan. Reduce to medium heat, cover, and stew for 10 minutes; stirring occasionally.
Add broth, bring to a boil; cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 12 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In the salad bowl, whisk together olive oil, vinegar, honey, sesame seeds, salt, and pepper.
Using an immersion (hand) blender, purée the soup until smooth.
Measure out cranberries and almonds.
Shave the leaves off parsley stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add the spinach to the bowl with the dressing. Add ¾ of the parsley, the cranberries, and almonds; toss to combine.
To serve, pour soup into a bowl, garnish with remaining parsley and arrange salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Carrot Ginger-Turmeric Soup with Bacon, Onions & Parsley-Buttered Pita

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Peel, quarter, and thinly slice onion. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the pan is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until the bacon is starting to brown, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

When the bacon is starting to brown, add half of the onion to the pan. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until bacon and onions are crispy and golden, 2-3 minutes more. (Reserve bowl with remaining onion for later use.)
Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon and onions to a paper towel-lined plate; set aside. (Reserve pan with drippings for later use.)
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the remaining onion.
Peel, trim, and large dice carrots. Add to the bowl.
Trim and large dice zucchini. Add to the bowl.
Return pan (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies begin to soften, 3-4 minutes.

Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half of the leaves in a small bowl along with additional butter and salt. Mash with the back of a spoon to combine the parsley butter. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
When the veggies are done, add broth to the pan; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until veggies are tender, 6-8 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: When the soup is done, using a hand blender, purée until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pan.)
Spread pita with parsley butter and cut into wedges.
Divide soup between bowls, then top with crispy bacon, onions, and reserved parsley. Serve with pita on the side and enjoy!

name: Carrot-Pear Soup with Cheddar & Nutty Strawberry-Orange Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter, core, and small dice pear. Place in a medium bowl. (Reserve a small handful of pear for serving.)
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Trim and small dice celery. Add both to the bowl with the pear.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pear, veggies, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lime into a clean medium bowl. Add honey and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.

When the veggies have softened, add broth to the pan; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer; cook, stirring occasionally, until pear and veggies are tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the soup is cooking, trim and quarter strawberries lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel orange, separate into segments, and roughly chop the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop walnuts and dates. Add both to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese. Set aside for serving.
When the pear and veggies are tender, using a hand blender, purée the soup until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pan.)
Divide soup between bowls, then top with cheese and reserved pear. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Carrot Salad Lettuce Wraps with Hard-Boiled Eggs, Mayo & Capers

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, honey, Dijon, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Peel and halve the eggs. Season with salt.
Place mayo, water, and additional salt in a small bowl. Whisk to combine.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with carrot salad and eggs. Spoon mayo sauce over eggs, top with capers, and season with pepper. Enjoy!

name: Cauliflower-Asparagus Baked Penne with Ricotta, Mozzarella & Parsley

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Roughly chop into ½-inch pieces.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, uncover, add cauliflower, pasta, and salt; stir for a few seconds. Cook until pasta is almost tender, about 7 minutes.
Meanwhile, snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus and cut into 1-inch pieces. Set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the garlic (reserving the rest for garnish).
When the pasta is almost tender, add asparagus to the pan; continue to cook until the pasta and veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, add tomato sauce, ricotta, and spices to the bowl with the garlic and parsley; whisk to combine the sauce.
Coarsely grate mozzarella.
When the pasta and veggies are done, drain in a colander. Add pasta and veggies to the bowl with the sauce; stir to combine.
Transfer the saucy pasta to a baking dish, spread out in an even layer, and sprinkle with cheese. Place baking dish in the oven and bake until cheese is melted and bubbly, 10-12 minutes.
To serve, divide pasta bake between bowls and top with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Cauliflower-Bacon "Mac & Cheese" Gratin with Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Cut into bite-sized pieces.
Once the water is boiling, add cauliflower and cook until tender-crisp, 6-8 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
While the cauliflower is cooking, preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels, crumble or chop into small pieces, and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Cut cream cheese into small pieces. Coarsely grate cheddar; set both aside.
Return skillet (with bacon fat) to medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add milk and spices; whisk to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, add cream cheese, a few pieces at a time, whisking until melted and combined, 2-3 minutes.
Add half the cheddar to the skillet and whisk until melted.
Add cooked cauliflower to the skillet and stir to combine. Sprinkle with remaining cheddar and place in the oven; broil until the top is golden and bubbly, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the spring mix (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Divide cauliflower between plates and sprinkle with bacon. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Cauliflower Bisque with Fresh Thyme, Red Pepper & Parmesan Crisps

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut off the cauliflower leaves. Roughly cut into florets and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces.
Peel and mince or press the garlic.
Holding the thyme at one end, slide leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add butter and warm until butter foams, about 1 minute.
Add garlic, salt, pepper, and half of the thyme. Cook, stirring often, until the garlic begins to brown, 4-5 minutes.
Add the cauliflower and the broth to the pot and cover with a lid. Cook until cauliflower is fork tender, 14-18 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Grate Parmesan cheese. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Measure out 1 tbsp of the grated Parmesan and place in a pile on the sheet. Repeat with remaining cheese, keeping the piles a few inches apart.
Place in the oven and bake until lightly browned, 5-7 minutes. Watch carefully because they can burn quickly. Once done, remove from the oven and let them sit for a couple of minutes.
Cut the bell pepper into quarters lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membrane. Finely dice the pepper and set aside.
Juice the lemon and add to the pot.
Purée soup until smooth using a hand or regular blender.
Turn the heat down to low and stir in a ½ cup of cream.
To serve, spoon the soup into bowls and garnish with olive oil, red bell pepper and thyme; arrange Parmesan medallions on the side. Enjoy!

name: Cauliflower & Chickpea Coconut Curry with Couscous

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash cauliflower and tomatoes. Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets. Medium dice the tomatoes.
Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince onion and garlic.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add onion and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Drain and rinse chickpeas.
Add garlic and curry powder to pan and stir with onion until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add cauliflower and chickpeas and stir until heated through, 1-2 minutes.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cover. Cook until cauliflower is tender and liquid thickens, about 10 minutes.
In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry cilantro. Shave the leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Stir ½ into the curry (save the rest for garnishing).
Uncover couscous and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place couscous in a bowl, top with curry and garnish with remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Cauliflower Macaroni & Cheese with Lemon-Parsley Butter Lettuce Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil.
While the water is heating, cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, uncover, and add cauliflower, pasta, and salt; stir for a few seconds. Cook until pasta reaches desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the parsley to the bowl with lemon juice (reserving the rest for the pasta).
Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheddar. Cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add milk, cheddar, cream cheese, and spices. Cook, whisking frequently, until cheeses melt and combine, 2-3 minutes; remove cheese sauce from heat.
When the cauliflower and pasta are done, drain in a strainer, and return to the pan. Add cheese sauce and stir to combine the cauliflower macaroni & cheese. Cover and set aside.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide cauliflower macaroni & cheese and salad between plates. Top pasta with reserved parsley and crushed red pepper. Enjoy!

name: Cauliflower, Quinoa & Chickpea Salad with Mushrooms

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry cauliflower and mushrooms. Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets and transfer to a sheet pan. Quarter the mushrooms and add to pan.
Drizzle cauliflower and mushrooms with oil and season with thyme, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Place in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until tender, about 20 minutes.
In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Drain and rinse chickpeas; place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to bowl.
Add almonds to bowl.
Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork. Add quinoa, cauliflower, and mushrooms to bowl and toss.
To serve, place salad on a plate or in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Cauliflower & Red Lentil Soup with Avocado and Cilantro Yogurt

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice the carrot and onion; place both in a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem of the cauliflower, then roughly chop it into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl with the carrot and onion.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince or grate the ginger; peel and mince the garlic.
Coarsely chop the tomato.
Once the veggies are soft, add the ginger, garlic, and tomato to the pan. Cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Stir in broth, water, lentils, and spices. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until lentils are tender, about 15 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Place cilantro, yogurt, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Using an immersion (hand) blender, process the soup until smooth. Alternatively, transfer soup to a regular blender and blend on high until smooth.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and top with yogurt and avocado. Enjoy!

name: Cauliflower Rice Bowl with BBQ Flank Steak, Mushrooms, Corn & Arugula

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Halve mushrooms and add to the baking sheet with the cauliflower. Drizzle with oil and season with salt. Stir to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until cauliflower rice and mushrooms are tender and golden, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place ketchup, vinegar, sugar, Dijon, Worcestershire, chili powder, and salt in a small bowl. Stir to combine the BBQ sauce and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board; slice crosswise into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and stir-fry until just cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, cut half of the lime into wedges and set aside for serving. (Reserve remaining lime for the next step.)
Juice remaining lime into a medium bowl, then add oil, Dijon, and salt. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw.
Divide cauliflower rice, steak, corn, and arugula between bowls; drizzle steak with BBQ sauce. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Cauliflower Steaks with Kalamata Vinaigrette & White Bean Tomato Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F. Using a paper towel, lightly coat a sheet pan with oil.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash cauliflower, cut off leaves, and trim stem. Slice lengthwise into ¾ inch steaks.
Place steaks and loose florets on sheet. Rub with oil on each side and season with salt and pepper.
Place in the oven and roast for 15 minutes. Flip and continue roasting until tender and browned, another 5-6 minutes. Then broil for 2-3 minutes to create a golden crust.
Peel and mince garlic. Finely chop olives.
In a small bowl, mix together garlic, olives, lemon juice, oil, and salt. Set aside.
In a medium bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Drain and rinse beans; place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with dressing.
Wash, quarter, and add tomatoes to bowl. Toss salad.
To serve, place cauliflower steaks on a plate, drizzle with vinaigrette, and have with salad on side. Enjoy!

name: Celery-Apple Quinoa Salad with Peanuts, Dates, Parmesan & Parsley

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, maple syrup, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel and slice shallot crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts and dates. Add both to the bowl and set aside.
Transfer the cooked quinoa to a baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl, along with the cooled quinoa, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Charbroiled Beef Kebabs with Curried Vegetables & Basmati Rice

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt, add water and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
Season steak with salt and pepper and cut into 1 inch cubes.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the liquid with the rice comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel the onion, cut it into quarters and separate it into slices; place in a medium bowl.
Trim off the ends of the zucchini then cut in half lengthwise; Cut into 2 inch pieces and add to the bowl with the onion.
Cut peppers into quarters, remove seeds and membranes; cut in half crosswise and add to bowl with zucchini and onion.
Add oil, curry powder, pepper and salt to the bowl with the veggies, toss to coat.
Thread beef, onion, squash and peppers onto skewers and place onto the broiler pan. If you don't have skewers, spread veggies and steak on the broiler pan.
Broil in preheated oven, turning every 3 minutes, until done, about 12 minutes. If you aren't using skewers simply toss the vegetables and beef every 3 minutes.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork; gently fold in minced cilantro, reserving 1 tbsp for garnish.
To serve, divide rice and skewers between plates and garnish with reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Charred Broccoli Bowl with Chicken, Edamame, Almonds, Cilantro & Lime

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high; position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Separate broccoli crowns into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; place in a large bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, and toss to combine; transfer to a baking sheet and spread out in a single, even layer. Reserve bowl for later use.
Place broccoli in the oven and broil, turning halfway through, until broccoli is crisp-tender and lightly charred around the edges, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest the lime into the large bowl, then juice half the lime into the same bowl. Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside.
Peel and mince the shallot and garlic. Peel and grate or mince the ginger; transfer everything to the bowl with the lime juice.
Add fish sauce, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar to the bowl and whisk to combine the sauce.
When the broccoli is done cooking, remove from the oven and transfer to the bowl with the sauce; stir to combine.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and place in a medium bowl. Add cornstarch, salt, and pepper to the bowl and gently toss to coat the chicken.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
