Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the chicken and cook, stirring often, until golden and almost cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the broccoli.

Add edamame to the skillet with the chicken and continue to cook, stirring often, until chicken and edamame are cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to the bowl with the broccoli, making sure to scrape all of the chicken juices into the bowl; toss to combine.
To serve, divide the broccoli mixture between bowls or plates; top with almonds and garnish with lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Charred Broccoli Flatbread with Lemony Ricotta, Chili Honey & Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping once, until golden and slightly crispy, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove from oven and set aside.

Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; transfer to another baking sheet. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to coat; spread out in a single layer.
When the flatbreads are done, place broccoli in the oven and broil, tossing halfway through, until crisp-tender and lightly charred around the edges, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the broccoli is cooking, place honey, vinegar, crushed red pepper, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine the chili honey and set aside.
Zest lemon into another small bowl (set lemon aside for later use).
Add ricotta, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon zest; stir to combine the lemony ricotta. Set aside.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Spread lemony ricotta over each flatbread, then top with the charred broccoli. Slice flatbreads into wedges.
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Divide flatbreads between plates and drizzle with chili honey. Serve with mixed greens on the side and enjoy!

name: Cheddar, Apple & Onion Quesadilla with Arugula-Radish Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft and golden brown, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, quarter and core apple, then thinly slice.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide onion, apple, and cheese between them, arranging the filling on one half of each tortilla; fold in half to close.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add quesadillas and cook until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden, 2½-3 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Cheddar Chicken Smash Burger with Sautéed Bell Pepper & Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Divide the parsley, shallot, and garlic between two medium bowls. Set one bowl aside for the salad.
Add chicken, Dijon, and spices to the remaining bowl. Use your hands to combine the chicken mixture. Form into 2 equal-sized "meatballs" and place on a plate. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper and salt; sauté until charred and tender, 2-3 minutes. Transfer peppers to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)

Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs to the skillet, spacing them out; press down with the bottom of a spatula to form ½-inch thick patties. Cook, undisturbed, until golden on one side, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, thinly slice cheese.

When the burgers are done on one side, flip and top with cheese. Continue to cook until cheese melts and burgers are cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Add burgers to the plate with the bell pepper and re-cover with foil.
While the burgers are cooking, add additional oil, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the remaining parsley, shallot, and garlic. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with the mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired.
Spread additional mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with a cheesy chicken patty and sautéed bell peppers. Close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide smash burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheddar Crusted Chicken with Mashed Sweet Potatoes & Roasted Broccoli

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional), then coat with oil.
Coarsely grate cheese into a medium bowl; add bread crumbs and spices. Stir to combine the coating.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Spread mayo over both sides of the cutlets, then dredge in the bread crumb coating, pressing firmly to adhere. Transfer cutlets to one side of the baking sheet and drizzle with oil.
Wash and dry broccoli; using a clean cutting board, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the other side of the baking sheet with the chicken.
Drizzle broccoli with oil, season with salt and pepper, then toss to coat; spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping chicken and tossing broccoli halfway through, until chicken is cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, peel, and medium dice sweet potato; place in a medium saucepan. Cover with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the liquid in the saucepan is boiling, reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer until sweet potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
When the sweet potatoes are done, drain in a colander, and return to the pan. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then mash until smooth.
To serve, divide mashed sweet potatoes, chicken, and broccoli between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheddar Halibut Fish Sticks with Lemony Dill, Cabbage & Kale Coleslaw

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of olive oil; set aside.
amounts: ¼ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Finely grate the cheese into a medium bowl; add bread crumbs and salt. Toss together with your hands until well combined, breaking up any cheese lumps. Transfer to the baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Reserve bowl.

Place pan in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until golden, about 8 minutes. Watch carefully so the crumbs don't burn. Remove from the oven and let cool. Leave the oven on.

If using halibut with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.
Pat the fish dry with paper towel, then cut crosswise into 1-inch strips; transfer to a plate.
Combine flour, salt, and pepper in a small bowl; stir together. In another small bowl, whisk the egg.
Scrape the cheese mixture back into the reserved bowl, then break it up into fine crumbs with a fork or by hand. Reserve the baking sheet pan for the next step.

Dredge fish strips in flour, shake off excess, then dip into the bowl with the egg. Let the egg drip off, then dredge fish strips in the cheese crumbs, pressing to adhere. Place on the baking sheet pan, spacing them 1-inch apart.
Place fish sticks in the oven and bake until cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice 1 lemon into a medium bowl. Cut remaining lemon into wedges and set aside.
Add mayonnaise, oil, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices to the bowl with the lemon juice; whisk to combine the dressing.
Fold the kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Finely chop leaves and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl with the dressing.

Using a knife, shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage the shredded greens with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide fish sticks and coleslaw between plates. Garnish with lemon wedges and enjoy!

name: Cheddar-Panko Crusted Pork Cutlets with Bell Pepper & Broccoli Slaw

instructions.text: Place egg in a medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork until smooth. Set aside.
Grate cheese into another medium bowl. Add bread crumbs and spices, then stir to combine. Set aside.
Pat pork dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chops in half horizontally to form thin cutlets.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, dip the cutlets into the beaten egg (letting the excess drip off), then into the bread crumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere. Transfer to a plate.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the breaded cutlets and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
While the chops are cooking, place mayo in a clean medium bowl. Add vinegar, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry bell pepper; using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and slice lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the broccoli slaw, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide slaw between plates or bowls. Top with pork cutlets and enjoy!

name: Cheeseburger Quesadilla with Pico de Gallo & Greek Yogurt

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter the tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl (that will hold the salsa).
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the salsa bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salsa bowl.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Add ½ of the onion to the salsa bowl and leave the rest on the cutting board.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the remaining diced onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Juice the lime and add to the salsa bowl.
Season the salsa with salt and pepper; mix together and set aside.

Add the ground beef to the skillet and season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until the beef is browned and crumbly, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer the mixture to a bowl.
While the beef cooks, coarsely grate 1 cup of cheddar.
Once the beef mixture has been transferred, remove any leftover bits from the skillet.
Place the tortillas on a flat surface. Layer one half of each tortilla with ¼ of the cheese, ½ of the beef mixture, and another ¼ of the cheese. Fold tortillas over to close.

Place both quesadillas in the skillet, straight edges next to each other. Cook until golden brown on both sides and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the quesadillas to a cutting board.
Cut each quesadilla into 4 wedges.
To serve, divide the quesadillas between plates and serve with the pico de gallo and Greek yogurt. Enjoy!

name: "Cheesesteak" Bake with Peppers, Mushrooms, Onions & Melted Mozzarella

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Slice mushrooms into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the baking sheet with the peppers.
Peel and mince garlic; peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons. Add both to the baking sheet, toss to combine the veggies, then spread out in an even layer.
Cut butter into small pieces and sprinkle over the veggies; season with salt and pepper.
Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
While the steak is cooking, coarsely grate mozzarella.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven. Turn oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.

Thinly slice steak against the grain. Arrange steak slices over the roasted veggies and sprinkle with cheese. Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until cheese is melted, about 1 minute. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide the cheesesteak bake between plates and top with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Asparagus Lemon Chicken Bake

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
In a small bowl, mix together the spices.

Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Place chicken fillets in a baking dish and season with the spice mixture (save the bowl to use later).
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Cut (or snap off) and discard the woody ends of the asparagus. Divide asparagus and arrange on top of each chicken breast.

Grate the zest from the lemon and transfer to the bowl used for the spices. Juice the lemon into the same bowl. Add oil and whisk to combine. Pour the lemon oil mixture over the chicken and asparagus.
Grate mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle the cheese over the asparagus and place in the oven; bake until chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
A few minutes before the end of the cooking time, change setting to broil and continue baking until the chicken and cheese are golden, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide the chicken topped with asparagus between plates and garnish with parsley and crushed red pepper. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy "Baked Beans on Toast" with Mixed Greens & Celery Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander, then transfer to a small baking dish.
Peel, halve, and mince shallot; add to the baking dish along with tomato sauce, maple syrup, Dijon, Worcestershire, and spices. Stir to combine.
Place baking dish on lower rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until beans are soft and sauce has thickened, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Place yogurt, mayo, water, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces; trim and medium dice cucumber. Add both to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheddar.
Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet pan; place on upper rack of the oven and toast, flipping once, until golden, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the baked beans are done, remove from oven and stir well. Divide beans between toast slices and top each with an even layer of cheese.
Return baking sheet to upper rack of the oven and bake until cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Just before serving, add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Divide "baked beans on toast" between plates and serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Baked Salmon with Cabbage, Snap Pea & Carrot Slaw

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F and arrange rack in the upper third of the oven. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Juice lemon and divide between a small and medium bowl. Set the medium bowl aside for the slaw.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the small bowl with the lemon juice along with mayo, Dijon, and spices. Whisk to combine.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Pat salmon dry with paper towels. Place on the baking sheet, skin-side down, and top with sliced onions. Spread mayo mixture over top, then sprinkle with cheese, gently pressing to adhere.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until salmon is cooked through and cheese is melted, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the medium bowl with the lemon juice along with mayo, Dijon, oil, maple syrup, poppy seeds, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl.
Cut snap peas crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the slaw, and set aside.
When the salmon is done, change oven to broil on high. Broil until the cheese is golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide salmon and slaw between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy BBQ Chicken Wrap with Cabbage, Carrot & Apple Slaw

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Place in a medium saucepan, along with salt, and cover with water by 1 inch.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Set chicken over high heat and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat and simmer until cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate and let cool, 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place yogurt, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot. Add to the bowl.
Quarter, core, and coarsely grate apple. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the slaw, and set aside.
Place ketchup, vinegar, Worcestershire, Dijon, and spices in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
Coarsely grate cheese. Add to the bowl with the sauce.
When the chicken is cool, use two forks to shred it into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the cheesy chicken filling.
Place tortillas on a flat surface, then divide cheesy chicken filling and a small portion of slaw between them. Roll tightly to close. (Reserve remaining slaw for serving.)
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates. Serve with remaining slaw on the side and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Beef & Cilantro-Lime Cauliflower Rice Burrito Bowl

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add ground beef and spices. Cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Once the beef is done cooking, add the garlic and stir to combine. Transfer to a medium bowl and loosely cover with foil.
Peel and small dice onion.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring often, until it begins to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower.
Add cauliflower and spices to the skillet with the onion. Continue to cook, stirring often, until cauliflower is lightly golden and cooked through, 5-7 minutes more.
Grate the cheese.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Cut half the lime into wedges, reserving the rest for the cauliflower rice.
When the cauliflower rice is done, juice remaining lime into the skillet. Add cilantro and beef; gently stir to combine and continue to cook until heated through, 1-2 minutes more.
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes. Halve and pit avocado; slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice mixture between bowls or plates and top with grated cheese, tomatoes, and avocado. Garnish with lime wedges and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Beef-Mushroom Burger with Pickled Veggies & Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Trim and thinly slice cucumber into rounds; place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and halve bell pepper lengthwise; thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Peel and thinly slice shallot into rings; add to the bowl.

Place vinegar, water, sugar, and salt in a medium saucepan; stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, add veggies, and stir to combine. Set aside to marinate. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Using a box grater, coarsely grate the mushroom and place in the reserved bowl. (Alternatively, you can mince the mushroom.)
Add beef, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the mushroom; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the beef mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, slice cheese.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add burger patties to the pan and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, top with cheese, and grill an additional 3-4 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, place mayo in a clean medium bowl; add 1 tablespoon of the pickling liquid to the bowl and stir to combine the dressing.
Transfer ¾ of the pickled veggies to the bowl with the dressing; add mixed greens and toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining pickled veggies for the burgers.)
Toast buns if desired.
Spread additional mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with cheesy burger patties and reserved pickled veggies. Close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Beef Rice Skillet with Peppers, Zucchini, Avocado & Yogurt

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the water for the rice comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Small dice the bell pepper and zucchini; transfer to a medium bowl.

Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeño with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl with the bell pepper and zucchini. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Place a skillet over medium heat, add the ground beef; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-7 minutes.
While the meat cooks, peel and small dice the onion and peel and mince (or press) the garlic; add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the meat is done, transfer to a bowl, leaving juices in the skillet. Return the skillet to medium heat.
Add the veggies in the bowl to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are tender, 5-7 minutes.
Add the tomatoes with their juices, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Stir to combine and let simmer on low, 3-4 minutes.
Coarsely grate the cheddar.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Fold the cooked rice, cooked beef, and grated cheese into the skillet.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
Divide into bowls and top each bowl with sliced avocado, yogurt, and chopped cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Black Bean Sauté with Bell Pepper, Jalapeño & Tortilla Chips

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Stack the tortillas, then cut in quarters and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping chips halfway through, until golden and crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse beans.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, beans, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese. Place in the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the cheese and set aside. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)

When the veggies are done, add cheese, cilantro, and tomato sauce to the skillet, then stir to combine the bean sauté. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide tortilla chips and cheesy beans between plates. Sprinkle beans with reserved cilantro and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Broccoli Quinoa Patties with Tangy Cucumber Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and spread onto a baking sheet in a thin layer to cool.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion; set half aside in a medium bowl for the salad.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the other half of the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Finely mince the broccoli (you should have about 2 cups). Add to the skillet along with the onion and cook another 3-4 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and set aside.
Grate the cheddar.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, onion, broccoli, cheese, panko, and eggs.
Form the quinoa vegetable mixture into patties using a ¼-cup measure, firmly pressing the mixture together between your hands.
Wipe out the skillet with a paper towel and heat over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place the patties in the skillet and cook for 5-6 minutes; flip and cook another 2-3 minutes, until golden brown on both sides.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Trim the ends of the cucumber, then thinly slice.
Add cucumber, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the onion. Stir to combine.
To serve, divide the quinoa patties and cucumber salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Buffalo Chicken Tostadas with Cucumber Salsa & Ranch Dressing

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Place broth in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, drizzle both sides of the tortillas with oil and sprinkle with salt; arrange on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and bake, flipping halfway through, until tortillas are golden brown and crispy, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Once the liquid is boiling, add chicken to the pan and reduce heat to medium-low. Cover and cook until chicken is cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the chicken is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Small dice tomato. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the tomato.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl, along with salt and pepper, then stir to combine the salsa. Set aside.
When the chicken is done, transfer to another medium bowl. Using two forks, shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Coarsely grate cheese. Add to the bowl with the chicken, along with yogurt, hot sauce, and spices. Stir to combine and set aside.
Place additional yogurt, vinegar, mayo, and spices in a small bowl, then stir to combine the ranch dressing. Add water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set aside.
Halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
To serve, divide crispy tortillas between plates; top with Buffalo chicken, lettuce, and salsa. Drizzle with ranch dressing and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Cauliflower Nacho Bites with Turkey, Cilantro, Avocado & Yogurt

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (for easier cleanup).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Remove leaves and thick stems from the cauliflower, then cut into bite-sized florets. Transfer to the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat, then spread out in a single layer.
Place cauliflower in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing once, until golden and fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ground turkey and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and no longer pink, 5-7 minutes. Stir in the garlic and remove from the heat.
While the turkey is cooking, small dice tomato and place on a plate.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the plate with the tomatoes.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the plate.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon. Add to the plate.
Coarsely grate cheddar.
When the cauliflower is done, top with an even layer of ground turkey and cheese. Return to the oven and bake until the cheese is melted and turkey is warmed through, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut lime into wedges.
To serve, divide cauliflower bites between plates; top with tomato, green onion, cilantro, avocado, lime wedges, and yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Cheddar Broccoli & Chicken

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Wash the broccoli and cut into bite-sized florets; transfer to a large pot. Fill with just enough water to cover florets and add salt to season.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook until the broccoli is fork-tender, 5-6 minutes.
Add yogurt, mayo, curry powder, salt, pepper and garlic powder to a medium mixing bowl.
Coarsely grate the cheddar, set aside.
When broccoli is done, drain well in a colander and add to a baking dish.
Pour yogurt mixture over broccoli and top with cheddar cheese. Bake in the oven for 10 minutes.
While broccoli mixture cooks, heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towel and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Carefully place the chicken breasts in the skillet; cook until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side.
To serve, divide broccoli and chicken between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Chicken Asparagus Bake with Sun-Dried Tomatoes & Olives

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; place in a baking dish, arranging the spears in an even layer.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season both sides with spices and arrange on top of the asparagus in an even layer.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl.
Mince sun-dried tomatoes and olives; add both to the bowl with the garlic, along with cream cheese, and mash with the back of a spoon to combine. Spread over the top side of the chicken cutlets.
Finely grate Parmesan and sprinkle over the chicken.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon over the chicken, then drizzle with oil.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until the asparagus is tender and chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
When the chicken is done, change oven setting to broil on high; continue to cook until topping is golden, 1-2 minutes more.
To serve, divide asparagus and chicken between plates; drizzle with sauce from the dish and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Chicken & Pepper Baked Spaghetti

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add chicken and salt to a medium saucepan. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Turn heat down to medium and simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Snap the spaghetti into 2-inch pieces. Once the water boils, uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Slice the mushrooms.
Peel and small dice onion. Small dice the pepper.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the peppers, mushrooms, onion, garlic, and spices. Cook for 4-5 minutes, until veggies begin to soften.

Sprinkle flour over the veggies and stir until fully incorporated. Then pour in the milk, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. Let simmer, stirring often, until slightly thickened, 3-4 minutes.
Preheat the oven to the broil setting and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Grate the cheese.
When chicken is done, drain, and shred with a fork. Add to vegetable mixture along with the cooked pasta and half of the cheese. Stir to combine.
Pour the spaghetti mixture into a baking dish. Top with remaining cheese and broil for 3 minutes until cheese on top melts and becomes golden brown.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Divide between plates, garnish with parsley, and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Chicken & Portobello Burger with Sun-Dried Tomato Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with the chicken, bread crumbs, mayo, Worcestershire, and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined; set aside.
Wash and dry portobello mushrooms. Remove stems and carefully scrape out the gills. Rub with oil, then season with salt and pepper; place cap-side down on a plate.
Using your hands, divide chicken mixture between the insides of mushrooms, spreading evenly to the edges. Gently press to adhere.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thinly slice cheese.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add burger patties, chicken-side down and cook, undisturbed, until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Flip patties, top with cheese, and cook until mushrooms are golden brown and fork-tender, 6-8 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice shallot crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the shallot along with oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Toast buns if desired.
Spread mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with cheesy burger patties and a small handful of salad. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Chicken, Spinach & Mushroom Pita Pockets

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: When the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring often, until chicken is cooked through, about 7 minutes. Transfer chicken to a medium bowl and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince the garlic. Thinly slice the mushrooms; transfer both to a medium bowl.
Peel and small dice the onion.
Return skillet to medium-high heat and add more butter; swirl to coat. Add the onion and cook until slightly softened, 2-3 minutes.
Add garlic, mushrooms, chili-garlic sauce, and salt to the skillet. Cook until mushrooms begin to soften, 2-3 minutes.

Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Once wilted, add the flour and cook, stirring often, until the spinach mixture thickens, 2-3 minutes.
Grate the cheese.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Stir chicken, cheese, and parsley (reserving some for garnish) into the spinach mixture; cook until heated through, about 2 minutes.
Slice pita in half and carefully open them using your fingers. Fill each pita bread with an equal portion of filling.
Divide filled pita pockets among dishes and sprinkle reserved parsley over the top. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Chicken Taquitos with Pico de Gallo Corn Salad & Yogurt Crema

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Cut chicken into bite sized cubes.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken to the skillet and season with spices. Stir-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional), 15-30 seconds.
Coarsely grate cheddar.
Coat baking sheet with a thin layer of oil to prevent sticking.
Fill tortillas with chicken and cheese. Roll tightly and place seam-side down on the sheet pan. Place in the oven and bake until golden and crispy, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place corn in a colander and run under cold water to thaw. Pat dry with paper towels and transfer to a medium bowl.
Using a clean cutting board, halve tomatoes. Peel and small dice onion. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince leaves. Add everything to the bowl with the corn.
Juice half the lime into the bowl with the corn, season with salt, and toss to combine the salad.
Juice the other half of the lime into a small bowl, add yogurt, and whisk to combine the crema.
To serve, divide taquitos between plates, top with pico de gallo salad, and drizzle with yogurt crema. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Chicken Tortilla Bake

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
Add chicken and salt to a medium saucepan. Cover with water and bring to a boil.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Turn heat down to medium and simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a second saucepan over medium heat.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to second preheated pan.

Wash and dry bell pepper and jalapeno. Seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Be careful, with jalapenos, not to touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.
Small dice all peppers and add to the pan.
Season with chili powder, cumin, and salt. Cook until vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Drain diced tomatoes; discard juice and add tomatoes to the pan.
Add yogurt, mayo, and flour to the pan, stirring to combine. Bring mixture to a boil and then reduce heat to minimum.
When chicken is done, drain and shred with a fork. Add to vegetable and yogurt mixture.
To assemble, place a tortilla on the bottom of a baking dish. Cover with half of the chicken mixture. Add a second tortilla and remainder of the chicken mixture.
Top with cheese. Broil for 3 minutes until cheese on top melts and becomes golden brown.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide the tortilla between plates, top with green onions, cilantro, and a drizzle of yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Chicken Tortilla Burger with Special Sauce & Side Salad

instructions.text: Place chicken, bread crumbs, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Divide the chicken mixture into 2 portions and form into ½-inch thick patties; place on a plate and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats, up thinly slice cheese.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, until golden underneath, 3-4 minutes; flip patties, top with cheese, and cook an additional 3-4 minutes, until cooked through. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Slice one tomato crosswise into thin rounds; medium dice remaining tomato. Place slices on another plate and add diced tomato to the bowl with the dressing.

Separate lettuce into leaves. Set aside a few leaves per burger and chop (or tear) remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add whole leaves to the plate and chopped lettuce to the bowl. Set the plate aside.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Place mayo, ketchup, Dijon, and cayenne in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the special sauce and set aside.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).

To assemble the burgers, place half of the tortillas on a flat surface, then top with cheesy burger patties, lettuce leaves, tomato slices, and special sauce. Close with the remaining tortillas and cut in half.
To serve, divide chicken burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Egg Toast with Lemony Dill, Spinach, Radish, & Mixed Pea Salad

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Place peas in a colander and run under cold water to thaw; set aside to drain.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and shallot. Add both to the bowl with the lemon, along with oil, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice radishes and celery; add both to the bowl.
Cut sugar snap peas crosswise into ½-inch pieces; add to the bowl, toss to combine, and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Peel and mince additional garlic; place in a small bowl along with mayo, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Peel and coarsely grate eggs. Coarsely grate cheese; add both to the bowl with the mayo and stir to combine.
Split rolls in half and arrange, cut-side up, on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil until lightly toasted, 1-2 minutes.
Remove toasted rolls from the oven and spread with cheesy egg mixture. Return to the oven and broil until warmed through and cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the veggies, along with thawed peas and spinach; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide cheesy egg toasts and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Flatbread with Lemony Arugula, Parmesan & Toasted Pine Nuts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add pine nuts and cook, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until flatbreads are warm, about 4 minutes.
While the flatbreads warm up, wash, dry, and zest lemon into a medium bowl (reserve lemon for later use).
Coarsely grate mozzarella. Add to the bowl with the lemon zest and stir to combine.

Remove flatbreads from oven and sprinkle with the lemon-cheese mixture. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to bake until flatbreads are crispy and cheese is melted, 4 minutes more. Remove from oven. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in the reserved bowl.
Juice reserved lemon into the bowl with the shallot. Add oil, pepper, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Using a peeler, shave the Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl, along with the pine nuts, and gently toss to combine the salad.
Top each flatbread with a small handful of the arugula salad, then slice into wedges. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)
Divide flatbreads between plates. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Cheesy "French Onion" Beef & Potato Skillet with Sautéed Spinach

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Wash, dry, and quarter potatoes; place in a medium saucepan, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Add beef and spices to the skillet. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the beef is cooking, coarsely grate mozzarella.

When the potatoes are done, drain and add to the skillet with the beef and onions. Gently crush some of the potatoes using a fork or potato masher. Add broth and Worcestershire to the skillet and stir to combine. (Reserve pan for later use.)
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Sprinkle mozzarella over the beef and potatoes. Place skillet in the oven and bake until the mozzarella is melted and golden, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the spinach. (Skip this step if it came pre-washed.)
Return the saucepan to medium heat.

Once the pan is hot, add additional butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Season with salt and pepper, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide beef-potato skillet and spinach between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy "French Onion" Chicken Thighs with Mushrooms, Thyme & Parsley

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken to the skillet and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet with drippings.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons.
Return skillet to medium heat. Add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and caramelized, 15-20 minutes.
While the onions cook, peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms and add to the bowl with the garlic.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems and add leaves to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the onions are done, add garlic, mushrooms, thyme, half of the parsley (reserving the rest for garnish), broth, and Worcestershire to the skillet; stir to combine. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is reduced by half, 4-5 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, thinly slice mozzarella. Finely grate Parmesan.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

When the veggies are done, nestle chicken into the mushrooms; top chicken with mozzarella and Parmesan. Place skillet in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide veggies and chicken between bowls or plates. Top with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Fried Shallot Burger with Lemony Asparagus & Peppers

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot into very thin half-moons. Place in a small bowl and sprinkle with salt; using your hands, massage the shallot until it starts to soften. Set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus; trim, seed, and slice bell pepper into thin strips. Transfer both to a baking sheet pan, spreading them out in an even layer.
Peel and mince garlic. Sprinkle garlic over the veggies and drizzle with oil. Squeeze lemon over top, then season with salt and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until crisp-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from the oven.
While the veggies are roasting, grate cheese into a medium bowl.
Add beef and spices to the bowl with the cheese; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the beef mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the shallots. Divide shallots into 2 portions, then press into the top of each burger patty.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add patties, shallot-side down, and cook, undisturbed, until shallots are golden, about 4 minutes.

Using a metal spatula, carefully slide underneath the shallots and flip the patties (place any loose shallots back on top of the burgers); cook an additional 4-5 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, toast the buns if desired. Slice tomato into rounds.
Place bottom half of each bun on a plate, then top with sliced tomato and burgers. Close with the top half of the bun and serve with roasted veggies on the side. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Garlic Chicken with Broccoli & Spinach

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and place over high heat.
Wash and dry the spinach. (Skip this step if it came pre-washed.)
Wash and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add the spinach, and stir. Cook 30-60 seconds, then remove to a colander with a slotted spoon. Rinse spinach under cold water, then press out excess water with the back of a spoon or your hands; transfer to a small bowl.
When the water in the saucepan returns to a boil, add the broccoli, cover, and reduce heat to medium. Cook until broccoli is fork-tender, about 4 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Coarsely grate the mozzarella.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add chicken and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic. When the chicken is done, add the garlic to the skillet and cook 1 minute more.
Add spinach, broccoli, mozzarella, and ricotta to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring frequently, until cheese is melted and starting to bubble.
To serve, divide chicken sauté between plates, sprinkle with crushed red pepper, and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Ground Beef & Mushroom Sandwiches with Arugula-Radish Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Thinly slice mushrooms and place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, onion, and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 6-8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
When the veggies are tender, add beef and cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
While the beef is cooking, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Coarsely grate cheese.
When the beef is done, add vinegar, stir to combine, and remove from heat.

Split buns in half and place, cut-side up, on the baking sheet. Top with beef mixture and sprinkle with cheese. Place in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and radish; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Ground Beef "Taco" Stuffed Peppers with Lettuce & Tomato Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then arrange cut-side down.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 5-6 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add beef and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the beef is cooking, juice lime into a medium bowl. Add oil and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the dressing (reserving the other half for the beef).
Coarsely grate cheese.
When the beef is done, add reserved cilantro and half of the cheese (setting the rest aside for topping the peppers) to the skillet; stir to combine the filling.
Divide beef mixture between pepper halves and top with remaining cheese. Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, halve lettuce lengthwise, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips; add to the bowl with the dressing and cilantro.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide stuffed peppers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Ground Sausage, Butternut Squash & Fennel Skillet with Sage

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds and medium dice. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and sausage; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until sausage is browned and crumbly, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
When the sausage is done, add fennel to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fennel is softened and caramelized, about 5 minutes. Transfer sausage, onion, and fennel to a plate.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add squash and spices to the skillet. Cook, undisturbed, until the squash is just starting to brown, 2-3 minutes.
Add broth to the skillet and stir to combine. Cover and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has evaporated and squash is tender, 4-5 minutes more.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Finely grate Parmesan. Place in a small bowl and set aside.
Pick sage leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince half of the leaves. (Reserve remaining sage for serving.)
When the squash is done, return sausage, onion, and fennel to the skillet along with minced sage. Stir to combine, then top with Parmesan.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden, 3-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide skillet between plates or bowls. Top with reserved sage and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Italian Turkey, Mushroom & Kale Sauté with Spaghetti Squash

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim spaghetti squash, halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile thinly slice mushrooms; place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, garlic, turkey, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Place in the reserved bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the kale (reserving a small handful of parsley for serving).

When the turkey is done, add kale and parsley to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the greens to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring frequently, until kale is tender, 3-4 minutes. Transfer turkey-greens mixture back to the bowl.
Coarsely grate cheese. Set a small handful aside for serving and add remaining cheese to the bowl with the turkey mixture.
Remove squash from the oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.

Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands (use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand). Add to the bowl with the turkey mixture, then toss to combine.
To serve, divide the turkey, greens, and spaghetti squash mixture between plates or bowls. Top with reserved cheese and parsley. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Lasagna-Style Gnocchi Bake with Spinach & Fresh Basil

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add gnocchi and salt, and stir for a few seconds. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and roughly chop the spinach (skip washing if using pre-washed spinach). Transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and shallot.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and shallot to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat and set aside. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine and set aside.
Wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Place ricotta, egg, and spices in the reserved bowl; whisk until smooth. Add the cooked spinach and half the basil (reserving the rest for garnish); stir to combine.

Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and coat the bottom with oil. Transfer half the gnocchi to the skillet and spread it out in an even layer. Spoon half the spinach-ricotta mixture over the gnocchi, followed by half the tomato sauce. Repeat this process once more, creating two layers.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Coarsely grate mozzarella and sprinkle on top of the gnocchi layers.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until cheese is melted and gnocchi is heated through, about 10 minutes.
To serve, divide gnocchi bake between plates and garnish with reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Macaroni Bake with Turnips, Bread Crumbs & Honey-Lemon Spinach

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil.
While the water is heating, peel, trim, and medium dice turnip.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, uncover, then add salt, turnip, and pasta; stir for a few seconds. Cook until turnip is just tender and pasta reaches desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut cream cheese into small pieces. Coarsely grate cheddar. Place both in an ovenproof skillet.

Add milk, Dijon, and spices to the skillet with the cheese. Set over medium-high heat and bring to a simmer, stirring often. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring frequently, until sauce is combined and thickened, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
When the pasta and turnip are done, drain in a colander, and transfer to the skillet with the sauce. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Sprinkle bread crumbs over the cheesy macaroni. Place skillet in the oven and bake until bread crumbs are golden, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Add spinach to the bowl with the dressing, then toss to coat.
To serve, divide cheesy macaroni and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Mango, Bell Pepper & Prosciutto Flatbread with Balsamic Arugula

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until flatbreads are slightly crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a plate.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the plate with the mango.
Chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces. Add to the plate and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.

Divide cheese between flatbreads, then top with mango, bell pepper, and prosciutto. Return prepared flatbreads to the oven and bake until warmed through and cheese is melted, 5-7 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
When the flatbreads are almost done, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Cut each flatbread into wedges.
To serve, divide flatbreads between plates and top with a small handful of arugula. Serve remaining arugula on the side and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Mashed White Beans with Sautéed Kale & Fried Eggs

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Fold each kale leaf lengthwise, slice away and discard the stems, and slice the leaves crosswise into ⅛-inch strips and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic and transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
While the saucepan heats up, drain and rinse the beans.
Finely grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Once the saucepan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add ½ of the garlic to the saucepan (save the rest for the kale); cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Add the beans and ½ of the broth to the saucepan; bring to a boil, then mash the beans with a potato masher.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add the remaining broth, most of the Parmesan (save a little for garnishing), salt, and pepper to the bean mash; stir to combine. Remove the saucepan from the heat and cover to keep the mash warm.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Gently crack the eggs into the skillet. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 2 to 3 minutes. Once done, separate the eggs and transfer to a plate.
Once the eggs have been transferred, add more oil to the skillet.
Add the remaining garlic and kale to the skillet; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the kale is wilted, 3 to 4 minutes.
Juice the lemon and pour over the kale; stir to combine.
To serve, spoon the mashed beans into a bowl, top with the kale and fried eggs, and sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Mexican Turkey-Pinto Bean Skillet with Avocado & Cilantro

instructions.text: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the bell pepper.

When the turkey is done, add bell pepper, onion, and garlic to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate cheddar. Set aside.
Drain and rinse beans. Place in the reserved bowl.
Medium dice tomato. Add to the bowl with the beans.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Add beans, tomato, cilantro, yogurt, and water to the skillet with the turkey. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once simmering, remove from heat.
Sprinkle cheese over the skillet, then place in the oven and broil until cheese is golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice lengthwise into thin pieces.
To serve, divide skillet between plates or bowls, then top with avocado and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Mushroom Pita Pockets with Roasted Parsnip, Carrot & Beet Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons. Peel and mince garlic. Transfer both to a medium bowl, then add oil, honey, and spices.

Peel, trim, and dice beet, carrot, and parsnip into ½-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the onion. Toss to combine, transfer to a baking sheet pan, and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place mixed veggies in the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until fork-tender and golden, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the marinade.
Remove mushroom stems and scrape out the gills; thinly slice and transfer to another baking sheet. Drizzle with the marinade. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place mushrooms in the oven and bake until golden brown and tender, about 10 minutes.
While the mushrooms are cooking, peel and mince additional garlic; transfer to a small bowl. Add mayo and whisk to combine the aioli. Set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Remove mushrooms from the oven, toss, add sprinkle with cheese. Return to the oven and continue to bake, until cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, halve olives and transfer to the reserved bowl along with the pine nuts.
When the roasted veggies are done, remove from the oven and transfer to the bowl with the olives; toss to combine the salad.
Cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets. Spread with aioli and stuff with cheesy mushrooms and spinach.
To serve, divide pita pockets and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy One-Pot Gnocchi with Italian Sausage & Spinach

instructions.text: Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion. Peel and mince the garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes.

Use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of the sausages. Peel off the casings and discard. Add the pork to the pan and break apart with a spoon. Cook, stirring occasionally, until pork is browned and crumbly, 5-7 minutes.
Coarsely grate the mozzarella. Finely grate the Parmesan.
Add gnocchi, diced tomatoes with their juices, water, Italian seasoning, and salt to the pan. Cover and cook on medium heat until gnocchi is cooked through, 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Wash and dry the spinach (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.) Add spinach to the pan; stir until wilted and the ingredients are combined, 1-2 minutes.
Sprinkle both cheeses over the gnocchi and cover. Let sit for 3-5 minutes until cheese is melted.
To serve, divide gnocchi between bowls and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Orzo Skillet Bake with Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Basil & Eggs

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and orzo, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and small dice zucchini. Place in a small bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the zucchini and set aside.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until onion begins to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add zucchini and bell pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring often, until veggies are tender, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the veggies are cooking, coarsely grate cheese. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Add cooked orzo, tomato sauce, and half of the basil to the skillet (reserve remaining basil for serving). Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Using a stirring spoon, make a well for each egg in the orzo. Crack an egg into each well.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until egg whites are just set, 3-4 minutes. Top with cheese and continue to broil until melted, 1 minute more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide orzo and eggs between plates or bowls; top with reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Penne with Zucchini, Corn & Basil

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Once the pasta is finished, drain and return to pot and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet, stirring frequently, cook until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Add the frozen corn to the skillet, stirring frequently, cook until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes.
Trim zucchini; halve lengthwise and cut crosswise into thin half moons.
Add the zucchini and spices to the skillet. Increase heat to medium-high and sauté, stirring frequently, until the vegetables are soft and golden, 6-8 minutes.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; set aside.
Reduce the heat to low and stir the tomato sauce into the skillet, simmer for 3-4 minutes.
Grate the Parmesan and mozzarella.
Add the sauce and veggies to the pot with the cooked pasta, along with the Parmesan, mozzarella, and fresh basil (reserving a small amount for garnish); stir to combine.
To serve, divide between plates and garnish with reserved basil; enjoy!

name: Cheesy Pinto Bean, Carrot & Potato Soup with Lemon-Dijon Side Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice potatoes. Place in a medium saucepan.
Peel, trim, and medium dice carrot. Add to the pan with the potatoes.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the pan.
