Add broth, beans with their liquid (do not drain), and spices to the pan; stir to combine the soup, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies and beans are tender, 12-15 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add mayo, Dijon, soy sauce, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
When the soup is done, remove from the heat. Use a hand blender to purée the soup until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pan.)
Coarsely grate cheese. Add to the soup and stir until melted and combined.
Divide soup between bowls. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Polenta Bowl with Bacon, Fried Egg & Tomato-Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta to the pan in a thin steady stream, whisking continuously, until incorporated. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and creamy, 15-25 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Using a clean cutting board, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place half in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices. Stir to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.

When the polenta has about 5 minutes left, return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper.

When the polenta is done, add cheese and spices to the pan, then stir to combine. If the polenta is too firm, add hot water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until you reach a desired consistency. Remove from heat.
Add spinach to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Divide polenta between bowls, then top each with bacon, a fried egg, and reserved green onions. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Polenta Bowl with Pinto Beans, Pico de Gallo Salad & Avocado

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta in a thin steady stream, while whisking, until the polenta is incorporated into the broth. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and the texture is creamy, 15-25 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a medium bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot into half-moons; add both to the bowl with the dressing.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl. Trim, halve, and slice radishes into thin half-moons. Add both to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Preheat another small saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, drain and rinse beans in a colander.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beans and spices to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until beans are warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Cover and remove from heat.
While the beans are cooking, coarsely grate the cheese.
Add cheese, salt, and pepper to the polenta and stir to combine; if the polenta is too firm, add hot water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until you reach a desired consistency. Cover and remove from heat.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide polenta, beans, and salad between bowls. Top with avocado and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Pork Sausage & Bell Pepper Quesadilla with Lettuce & Tomato

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, pork, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese.

To assemble the quesadillas, lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide pork and bell pepper between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla. Top with cheese and fold in half to close. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, chop lettuce crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Transfer to another plate.
Small dice tomato. Add to plate with the lettuce.
To serve, cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates; top with lettuce and tomatoes. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Pork Stuffed Peppers with Crispy Bread Crumbs & Dressed Arugula

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; arrange cut-side down. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the pork is cooking, juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, honey, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the dressing and set aside. (Reserve remaining parsley for the next step.)
Finely grate Parmesan. When the pork is done, add Parmesan to the skillet, along with the reserved parsley, and stir to combine the filling. Remove from heat.
Stuff peppers with pork filling, then top with bread crumbs. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to broil until bread crumbs are toasted, 1 minute more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
To serve, divide stuffed peppers and arugula between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Portobello Mushroom Burger with Blueberry BBQ Sauce & Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Juice half of the lemon into a blender. (Reserve remaining lemon for the dressing.)
Peel garlic; add to the blender along with blueberries, ketchup, sugar, soy sauce, and spices. Blend on high until very smooth, about 1 minute. Set BBQ sauce aside.
Remove stems from the mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills; place on a plate.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, peel and slice onion crosswise into ¼-inch thick rings; add to the plate with the mushrooms. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the grill pan is hot, add the veggies and grill, undisturbed, until tender and lightly charred on one side, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve plate for later use.)
While the veggies are grilling, thinly slice cheese.

When the veggies are charred on one side, flip, then top each mushroom with cheese; continue to grill until veggies are tender and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes more. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, juice the remaining lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl along with mixed greens and almonds; toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Toast buns if desired.
Spread half of the BBQ sauce over the bottom half of each bun; layer with mushrooms, onions, and remaining sauce. Close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Portobello "Smash" Burger with Avocado, Sprouts & Romaine Salad

instructions.text: Place mayo, ketchup, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the special sauce and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, remove stems from portobello mushrooms. Place on a plate, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add mushrooms, cap-side down. Cook until starting to soften, about 3 minutes. Flip and continue to cook, occasionally pressing down with the bottom of a spatula, until golden underneath, 2-3 minutes more.
While the mushrooms are cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Thinly slice cheese.
When the mushrooms are golden underneath, flip once more and top with cheese. Continue to cook until cheese melts and mushrooms are fork-tender, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Slice one tomato crosswise into thin rounds; medium dice remaining tomato. Place slices on a clean plate and add diced tomato to the bowl with the lettuce and dressing; toss to combine the salad.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice lengthwise into thin slices. Add to the plate with the tomato.
Toast buns if desired.

Spread special sauce over the bottom half of each bun; top with cheesy portobellos, then layer with tomato, avocado, and sprouts. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Prosciutto Chicken with Grape Tomato Pan Sauce

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Finely grate Parmesan. Place in a medium bowl along with almond meal and Italian seasoning; stir to combine.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Spread mayo over both sides of each cutlet, then dredge in the parmesan mixture, pressing to adhere. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Place chicken in the oven and bake until golden brown and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic.
Place garlic, broth, tomato paste, oil, and spices in an ovenproof skillet. Whisk to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve tomatoes.
Wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves (reserving a few whole leaves for garnish).
Chop prosciutto and mozzarella into bite-sized pieces.
Preheat oven to broil on high.
Once the sauce is simmering, add the tomatoes and basil, then stir to combine. Place chicken on top of the tomato mixture and sprinkle with prosciutto and mozzarella.
Place the skillet in the oven and broil until cheese is bubbly and slightly golden, about 5 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken and pan sauce between plates and garnish with reserved basil leaves. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Prosciutto, Tomato & Leek Frittata with Lemony Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the shallot. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add half to the bowl with the dressing and set aside. Place remaining tomatoes in another medium bowl.

Trim off the root ends and dark green tops of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the second bowl with the tomatoes.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes, leeks, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften and brown, about 8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the parsley.
Add eggs, salt, and pepper to the bowl. Whisk to combine and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Chop (or tear) prosciutto into bite-sized pieces. When the veggies are done, add to the skillet and stir to combine.

Reduce heat to medium and pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, about 5 minutes.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until the top is set, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and tomatoes. Toss to combine the salad.
Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Prosciutto-White Bean Skillet with Tomato, Leek, Carrot & Toast

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl with the leek.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the veggies.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate cheese. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.

When the veggies are softened, add beans, tomato sauce, water, and Worcestershire to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is slightly thickened, 3-4 minutes more.
While the beans are cooking, chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
When the sauce is slightly thickened, top skillet with cheese and prosciutto. Place in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and prosciutto is crispy, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.

When the skillet is done, arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until lightly toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and cut in half. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
To serve, divide cheesy bean skillet and toast between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Pumpkin Sourdough Toasts with Apple & Arugula-Cranberry Salad

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate cheese. Place in a medium bowl along with pumpkin, egg, and spices, then whisk until smooth. Set aside.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Divide cheesy pumpkin mixture between toast slices, spreading it to the edges. Return toast to the oven and broil until topping is golden around the edges and warmed through, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a clean medium bowl. Add oil, honey, Dijon, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Add arugula and cranberries to the bowl with the dressing, then toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apple.
Divide cheesy pumpkin toasts between plates and top with apple slices. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Sausage "Pizza" Skillet with Peppers, Mushrooms & Cauliflower

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms and add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower and add to the bowl. Set aside.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until starting to brown, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic.
When the pork is browned, add veggies and garlic to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are soft and pork is cooked through, 6-7 minutes more.
While the veggies cook, coarsely grate mozzarella.
Roughly chop olives.
Once the veggies are soft, add tomato sauce and spices to the skillet; stir to combine. Remove from heat and sprinkle cheese and olives over pork and veggies.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until cheese is melted and bubbly, about 10 minutes.
To serve, divide "pizza" skillet between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Scrambled Eggs on Toast with Basil Pesto & Tomato-Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Mince pine nuts and place in a small bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the pine nuts.
Add oil and spices to the bowl, then stir to combine the pesto. Add water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if needed, to make a spreadable consistency. Set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Finely grate Parmesan. Set aside for the eggs.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, crack eggs into another medium bowl, then season with salt and pepper. Whisk until smooth.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are no longer runny. Remove from heat, add Parmesan, and stir to combine.
Meanwhile, halve the tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing along with the arugula. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and toast between plates. Spread toast with pesto and top with cheesy scrambled eggs. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Shrimp "Enchilada" Skillet with Zucchini & Bell Pepper

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a small saucepan over medium-high heat. Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add flour and cook, whisking constantly, until lightly golden, about 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in tomato sauce, broth, and spices. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until thickened, 4-5 minutes. Remove enchilada sauce from heat and set aside.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Quarter jalapeño lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and place in a medium bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add both to the bowl with the jalapeño.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the veggies.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate cheddar, place in the reserved bowl, and set aside.
Chop shrimp into small pieces. When the veggies are done, add shrimp to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until opaque, 2-3 minutes.

While the shrimp cooks, using a clean cutting board, cut the cream cheese into small pieces. Add to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until melted and combined, 2-3 minutes more.
Meanwhile, slice tortillas into 2-inch long strips. Add to the skillet, along with the enchilada sauce, and stir to combine; remove from heat.
Top skillet with cheddar and place in the oven; broil until the cheese is melted and bubbly, 3-5 minutes.
To serve, divide enchilada skillet between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Shrimp, Mushroom & Tomato Stuffed Peppers with Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then arrange cut-side down.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, thinly slice mushrooms and place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the mushrooms.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry, then roughly chop into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add shrimp, mushrooms, onion, garlic, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender and shrimp is cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, medium dice tomato and place in the reserved bowl.
Coarsely grate cheese; add half to the bowl with the tomato (reserving the rest for topping the peppers).
When the shrimp and veggies are done, add tomato and cheese to the skillet; stir to combine the filling. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
Divide shrimp filling between pepper halves and top with reserved cheese. Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until cheese is golden, 2-3 minutes; remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Add mixed greens and pumpkin seeds to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide peppers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Smashed Potatoes with Bacon, Mushrooms, Tomato & Green Onion

instructions.text: Wash potatoes; transfer to a medium saucepan, add salt, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 450°F.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, grate the cheese.
Wash and dry the remaining fresh produce.
Thinly slice the mushrooms.
When the bacon is done, remove and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate. Transfer the bacon fat to a small bowl and set aside, leaving about 1 tsp in the skillet.
Return skillet to medium heat. Add mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring often, until tender, 3-4 minutes; remove from heat and set aside.
Crumble or chop bacon into small pieces.

When the potatoes are done, drain and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Using a fork or potato masher, gently crush each potato, flattening them to a 1-inch thickness. Drizzle with 1 ½ tbsp reserved bacon fat and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Sprinkle cheese, mushrooms, and bacon over the potatoes. Place in the oven and bake until cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard ends of green onions, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Small dice the tomato.
To serve, divide smashed potatoes between plates or bowls. Top with green onion, tomato, and yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Spaghetti Squash with Chickpea-Tomato Ragù & Parsley

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash, dry, and trim squash, then halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
While the squash is roasting, peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the bowl with the onion.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, crushed red pepper, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to brown, 6-8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas.

Once the onion is starting to brown, add chickpeas, tomatoes, and more salt to the skillet; stir to combine the ragù. Reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the squash is done.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.
Remove squash from the oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.

While the squash is cooling, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half of the parsley to skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)

Once the squash has cooled slightly, scrape the inside with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands (use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand). Add squash to the bowl with the Parmesan and gently toss to combine.
To serve, divide squash and veggie ragù between plates or bowls. Top with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Spinach & Rice Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry mushrooms; remove stems and carefully scrape out gills, making sure not to damage the rim of the mushrooms. Place on a baking sheet and rub with oil; set aside.
Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add garlic to the skillet and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Wash and dry the spinach. (Skip if it came pre-washed.) Add to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Finely grate Parmesan.
Add Parmesan, yogurt, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine; remove from the heat. When the rice is done, add to skillet and stir to combine.
Fill mushroom caps with equal portions of the rice mixture. Place in the oven and bake for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, grate mozzarella.
Remove baking sheet from oven and top mushrooms with mozzarella. Bake for another 5 minutes, until cheese is golden and melted.
To serve, divide mushrooms between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Spinach & Scallion Enchiladas

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into small pieces. Roughly chop the spinach.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add spinach and half of the green onions to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally until spinach is wilted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Once hot, add the oil. Let the oil heat up for about 30 seconds, then whisk in the flour. Continuing to whisk, cook the flour for another 2 minutes.
Slowly whisk in the broth and tomato sauce. Stir in the spices. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer the enchilada sauce for 4-5 minutes, until thick. Remove from heat.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Grate the cheese.
In a large bowl, combine the spinach mixture, ricotta, yogurt, and salt.
Spoon ¼-cup of the spinach mixture onto the center of each tortilla. Roll up and place seam side down in a baking dish. Pour enchilada sauce over top and sprinkle with the cheese.
Place in the oven and bake for 10 minutes, until cheese is melted.
To serve, divide enchiladas between plates and top with remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Sweet Potato "Tostadas" with Beans, Mango Salsa & Tangy Arugula

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the middle of the oven. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard ends of sweet potatoes; peel and slice lengthwise into ½-inch thick pieces. Discard any small, outer slices, then place remaining slices on the baking sheet.
Drizzle sweet potato slices with oil and season with spices on both sides.
Place sweet potatoes in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until fork-tender, 8-12 minutes. (Keep a close watch on the sweet potatoes to avoid burning.)

Meanwhile, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and place in a medium bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince garlic and shallot. Add both to the bowl with the jalapeño.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Small dice and add to the bowl.
Seed and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice half the lime (reserving the rest for the salad) into the bowl; add salt and stir to combine the mango salsa. Set aside.

Drain and rinse beans. Divide beans between sweet potato slices, spreading them out in an even layer; season with salt. Return sweet potatoes to the oven and broil until beans are heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic; place in another medium bowl.
Juice remaining lime into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing. Add arugula and toss to combine the salad.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Divide sweet potato "tostadas" between plates; top with mango salsa and crumbled goat cheese. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Taco Smash Burger over Napa Cabbage, Carrot & Bell Pepper Sauté

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel and trim carrot; using a peeler, peel the carrot into noodle-like strips. Add to the bowl with the cabbage.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Place beef, tomato paste, and spices in another medium bowl. Use your hands to combine the beef mixture. Form into 2 equal-sized meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs to the skillet, spacing them apart; press down with the bottom of a spatula to form ½-inch thick patties. Cook, undisturbed, until golden on one side, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, thinly slice cheese.

When the burgers are done on one side, flip and top with cheese. Continue to cook until cheese melts and burgers are cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Transfer burgers to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
While the burgers are cooking, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the veggies.

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. When the veggies are done, add cilantro to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide vegetable sauté between plates or bowls, then top with cheesy burgers and yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Tex-Mex Beef, Carrot & Zucchini Noodle Skillet with Yogurt

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim zucchini and carrot; use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Place both in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the veggie noodles and set aside.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion, garlic, beef, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, grate cheddar and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
When the beef is done, add veggie noodles, bell pepper, and water to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has evaporated and veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, medium dice tomato.
When the veggies are tender, add tomato and tomato sauce to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, remove from heat and sprinkle with cheddar.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide skillet between plates or bowls and top with a dollop of yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Tofu Marinara Melts with Mixed Greens & Salsa Verde Vinaigrette

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Cut the tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and shallot. Mince capers. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice the tofu.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the tofu, soy sauce, and Italian seasoning. Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Grate cheeses, combine in a small bowl, and set aside.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Mince sun-dried tomatoes.
Add garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, and tomato sauce to the skillet with the tofu. Continue to cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Split rolls in half and place, cut-side facing up, on a baking sheet. Place in the oven and broil until lightly toasted, about 1 minute.
Remove rolls from the oven and top with half the cheese. Divide tofu mixture between rolls and cover with remaining cheese. Return to the oven and broil until cheese melts, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash and dry the spring mix. (Skip if it came pre-washed.) Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: To serve, divide tofu melts and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Tortilla, Black Bean & Corn Frittata with Pico de Gallo

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a small bowl. Small dice tomato and add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeño with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl with the lime juice. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in the bowl with the lime juice; set the other half aside in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince onion; add ⅓ of the onion to the bowl with the lime juice. Season with salt and stir to combine the pico de gallo. Set aside.
Seed and slice bell pepper into thin strips. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add remaining onion, bell pepper, garlic, corn, and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring often, until veggies are soft, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Grate the cheddar.
Add eggs, salt, pepper, and half the cheese to the medium bowl with the cilantro; whisk to combine.

Drain and rinse the beans in a colander. Cut or tear tortillas into bite-sized pieces. Add both to the skillet with the veggies and stir to combine. Continue to cook until heated through, 1-2 minutes, then spread out evenly in the skillet.

Reduce heat to medium-low and pour in the egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Sprinkle frittata with the remaining cheese. Place skillet in the oven and broil until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
Cut the frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with pico de gallo on the side and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Tuna, Bell Pepper & Zucchini Noodle Skillet Bake

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash, dry, and trim zucchini; run a peeler along the zucchini to make long, noodle-like strips. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper; small dice and add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, drain tuna, place in the reserved bowl, and flake with a fork. Set aside.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Finely grate Parmesan.
When the veggies are done, add tuna, Parmesan, and cream to the skillet. Stir to combine and continue to cook until heated through, 1-2 minutes more.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Meanwhile, coarsely grate mozzarella and sprinkle over the skillet.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until the mozzarella is melted and golden, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide skillet between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Turkey & Rice "Unstuffed-Pepper" Skillet with Cilantro & Yogurt

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in a small bowl.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the bell peppers and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until almost cooked through, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the bell peppers and garlic (reserving a small handful for serving).

When the turkey is almost cooked through, add bell peppers, garlic, and cilantro to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until turkey is cooked through and bell peppers are softened, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
While the turkey and bell peppers are cooking, coarsely grate cheese.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
When the rice is done, add to the skillet, along with tomatoes, then stir to combine. Top with cheese and place in the oven; broil until cheese is melted and golden, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide skillet between plates or bowls. Top with reserved cilantro and a dollop of yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Turmeric Chicken Bake with Prosciutto, Green Beans & Quinoa

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place chicken in a baking dish and season with spices on both sides.
Using a clean cutting board, cut or tear prosciutto into pieces and place on top of the seasoned chicken.
Wash, dry, and trim beans; divide into loose bundles and arrange on top of each cutlet.
Crumble cheese over the beans.
Wash and dry lemon. Zest and juice it over the chicken stacks; drizzle with oil.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
When the chicken is done, change oven setting to broil on high and cook until the chicken and cheese are golden, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide quinoa and chicken-bean stacks between plates; drizzle with sauce from the dish and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Vegan Broccoli & Cashew Quinoa Burrito with Sun-dried Tomatoes

instructions.text: Boil water in a kettle. (If you do not have a kettle, boil water in a saucepan, starting with hot tap water.) In a small bowl, pour boiling water over cashews and set aside to soak.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat. Add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onions and garlic to the skillet and sauté until the onions are tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and medium dice celery and broccoli.
Roughly chop the sun-dried tomatoes.
Increase the heat to medium-high and add the celery, broccoli, and sun-dried tomatoes to the skillet. Sauté until broccoli is tender, about 8 minutes.
Drain the cashews and transfer them to a blender.
Peel garlic. Add to the blender along with almond milk, nutritional yeast, Dijon, vinegar, salt, and onion powder. Blend until smooth; add water, 1 tbsp at a time, if needed, to make a thick sauce.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) almond milk, unsweetened

instructions.text: Add the cooked quinoa, pumpkin seeds, and sauce to the vegetables in the skillet and stir to combine.
Lay the tortillas on a flat surface and divide vegetable mixture between them. Roll tightly to close, folding in the ends.
Return the skillet or a grill pan to medium-high heat.
Place wraps on the grill and flip every 1-2 minutes, until tortilla is crispy and golden.
To serve, cut wraps on an angle and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Vegan Burrito Bowl with Spanish Rice, Beans & Pico de Gallo

instructions.text: Peel and small dice onion. Place half in a small bowl and set aside for the pico de gallo.
Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.

Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add rice, onion, and spices; cook, stirring constantly, until onions are soft and rice is golden and toasted (you should hear a slight sizzle and pop from the rice), about 3 minutes.

Add garlic, water, corn, tomato sauce, and salt to the saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir, cover, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into the bowl with the onion.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeño with a spoon. Finely mince and add to the bowl with the onion. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Small dice tomato. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with salt, and stir to combine the pico de gallo. Set aside.

In a small saucepan, combine almond milk, oil, nutritional yeast, arrowroot starch, Dijon, onion powder, and garlic powder; whisk until smooth. Place the saucepan over medium heat and cook, whisking constantly, until the sauce becomes thick and stretchy, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the heat.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) almond milk, unsweetened

instructions.text: Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander.
When the rice is done, add beans to the saucepan and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice and bean mixture between bowls or plates. Top with pico de gallo, avocado, and cheesy sauce. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Vegan Pizza with Mushrooms, Sun-dried Tomatoes & Basil

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Add tomato sauce and spices to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine and set aside.
Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and slice the mushrooms.
Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes.

In a small saucepan, combine almond milk, oil, nutritional yeast, arrowroot starch, Dijon, onion powder, and garlic powder; whisk until smooth. Place the saucepan over medium heat and cook, whisking constantly, until the sauce becomes thick and stretchy, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the heat.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) almond milk, unsweetened

instructions.text: Spread tomato sauce over each flatbread. Spoon the cheesy sauce over the tomato sauce, then top with mushrooms, sun-dried tomatoes, and Italian seasoning.
Place prepared flatbreads back in the oven and bake, until mushrooms have softened, 5-7 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry basil. Pick leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
To serve, slice flatbread pizzas into wedges and divide between plates. Garnish with basil and enjoy!

name: Cheesy White Bean-Kale Sauté with Fried Eggs & Sourdough

instructions.text: Wash, dry, and halve grape tomatoes. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl with the tomato.
Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, drain and rinse beans.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, beans, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheddar. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.
Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.

When the veggies are soft, add kale to the pan in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add cheese and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the kale is fully wilted and cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat, then season with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, toast bread if desired.
To serve, divide bean-kale sauté, eggs, and bread between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy White Bean & Kale Skillet with Toast Points

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise, slice off stems, and finely chop leaves.
Peel and thinly slice garlic.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Grate cheese and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add kale, garlic, and tomato paste; cook, stirring constantly, until kale softens, 2-3 minutes.

Add beans, hot water (from the tap), and spices to the skillet; stir to combine. Bring to a boil, then sprinkle with cheese and place in the oven; broil until cheese has melted and is browned in spots, 3-4 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, cut bread slices on the diagonal and place on a baking sheet pan in a single layer; drizzle with oil on both sides.
Place bread in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until nicely toasted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Divide white bean mixture between plates or bowls. Serve with toast for dipping. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy White Bean "Pizza" Skillet with Mushrooms, Olives & Basil

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans. Set aside to drain further.
Roughly chop olives.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place in the reserved bowl along with the spinach (setting aside a small handful of basil for serving).

When the veggies are soft, add basil and spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the greens to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add beans, olives, and tomatoes, then stir to combine the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, reduce heat to medium. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is thickened slightly and beans are tender, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate cheese.
When the beans are tender, sprinkle cheese over top. Place skillet in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide pizza skillet between plates or bowls. Sprinkle with reserved basil and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Zucchini Fritters with Lime Crema & Mexican "Street Corn" Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Transfer to a colander and sprinkle with salt. Place the colander in a bowl to catch the excess moisture and set aside.
Zest and juice lime. Divide between a small and medium bowl. Add yogurt and spices to the small bowl, then whisk to combine the lime crema. Set aside. (Reserve medium bowl for the next step.)

Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the medium bowl with the lime along with additional yogurt, mayo, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Coarsely grate mozzarella. Place in another medium bowl along with egg and spices. Stir to combine.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-low heat.

While the skillet heats up, use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated zucchini. Transfer to the bowl with the mozzarella mixture, along with flour, and stir once more to combine the batter.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; flatten slightly with the back of a spoon. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl (reserving a small handful of green onions for serving).

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl, along with feta, and stir to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide salad and fritters between plates or bowls. Top fritters with lime crema and reserved green onions. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Zucchini Noodle Lasagna Skillet

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince or press garlic.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add ground beef and garlic. Break apart the beef with a spoon until crumbly. Stirring occasionally, cook until beef is browned, 4-6 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and broth. Increase the heat to high and bring to a rapid simmer.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Shave leaves off the parsley stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Put some of the fresh herbs aside to use as garnish.
Add the parsley, basil, spinach, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook for another 4-5 minutes.
Trim ends of the zucchini. Using a vegetable peeler, peel zucchini into thick noodle-like strips.

Remove the tomato sauce from the skillet, and set aside in a bowl. Arrange the half of the zucchini in a flat layer that covers the bottom of the skillet. Pour half of the tomato mixture over top of the zucchini noodles. Then arrange a second layer of zucchini noodles, followed by a second layer of sauce.
Thinly slice the mozzarella cheese. Finely grate the Parmesan cheese.
Cover the top layer of sauce with the mozzarella slices and sprinkle with Parmesan, place in the oven for 10-12 minutes. Put the oven to broil for the last few minutes to brown the top if desired.
Divide between plates, garnish with remaining fresh herbs, and enjoy!

name: Cherry Glazed Wings with Roast Potatoes & Fennel-Parmesan Salad

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve new potatoes. Transfer to one half of a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.

Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Add to the other half of the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, toss to coat, and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing potatoes and turning chicken halfway, until potatoes are tender and wings are cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a clean medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl.
Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl and gently toss to combine the salad. Set aside.

Rinse cherries under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Place in a blender along with ketchup, vinegar, hot sauce, and spices. Blend on high until smooth, 1-2 minutes. (Add water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency.) Set sauce aside.
When the potatoes and chicken are done, remove from oven. Drizzle wings with sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide potatoes, saucy wings, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cherry Tomato & Garlic Shrimp Sauté with Cornmeal Drop Biscuits

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
In a medium bowl, combine flour, cornmeal, baking powder, sugar, and salt; stir to combine.

Using a box grater, coarsely grate cold butter into the bowl with the flour. Using two hands, combine the flour and butter by rubbing the mixture between your thumbs and fingers until it looks crumbly. Add the milk and stir to combine.
Using a scant ¼-cup measure, drop portions of batter onto a baking sheet pan, spacing them 2-inches apart. Place in the oven and bake until lightly golden, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Transfer shrimp to a plate and season with salt and pepper on both sides; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard ends of the green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Halve tomatoes crosswise.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and thinly slice garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions, tomatoes, garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring often, until tomatoes have softened, about 2 minutes.
Add shrimp to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through and opaque, about 4 minutes. Juice lemon into the skillet and stir to combine; remove from heat.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide shrimp and biscuits between bowls or plates and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Adobo with Rice & Garlic Green Beans

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and sear until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim green beans. Transfer to a medium bowl and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat. Place garlic, broth, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and pepper in the skillet; stir to combine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return chicken to the skillet and and turn to coat in the sauce. Add green beans, cover, and simmer until chicken is cooked through and green beans are tender-crisp, 8-10 minutes.
To serve, divide rice, chicken, green beans, and sauce between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Apple & Squash Skillet over Couscous with Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Sprinkle with flour, salt, and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Place in a medium bowl.
Quarter, core, and slice apple into wedges; add to the bowl with the onion.
Trim and peel squash. Halve lengthwise, scrape out seeds, and medium dice; add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the veggies and apple (reserve remaining parsley for garnish).

Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, apple, parsley, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
While the veggies are cooking, place vinegar, oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.

When the veggies and apple are soft, add broth, vinegar, honey, and Dijon to the skillet; stir to combine and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until apple and squash are tender, 4-5 minutes more.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, halve tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the spinach, and toss to combine the salad.
Return chicken to the skillet with the veggies and apple; continue to cook, turning the chicken occasionally, until warmed through, 1-2 minutes more.
To serve, divide couscous, chicken skillet, and salad between plates. Garnish with remaining parsley and enjoy!

name: Chicken, Bacon, Cabbage & Portobello Mushroom Stir-Up with Walnuts

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
While the bacon is cooking, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Return skillet with drippings to medium-high heat; add chicken and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is golden and cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Wash and dry cabbage, then trim off and discard root end; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the garlic.
Wash, dry, and halve mushrooms, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick slices; add to the bowl.
When the chicken is done, add veggies and additional salt to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are fork-tender, 5-6 minutes more.
Meanwhile, roughly chop walnuts.
When the veggies are done, drain off any excess cooking liquid from the skillet, then add crispy bacon, walnuts, and vinegar. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-up between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Chicken Bacon Ranch Bowl with Roasted Zucchini, Bell Pepper & Mushroom

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl, along with spices, and stir to combine the spice mix. Set aside.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half-moons. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the baking sheet with the zucchini.
Halve mushrooms. Add to the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, then sprinkle with half of the spice mix. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve remaining spice mix for later use.)
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 3-4 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
While the bacon is cooking, cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: When the bacon is done, return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, add mayo and vinegar to the bowl with the reserved spice mix. Whisk to combine the ranch dressing. Add water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency.
To serve, divide roasted veggies and chicken between plates or bowls. Top with crispy bacon, drizzle with ranch, and enjoy!

name: Chicken-Bacon Succotash with Corn, Peas, Tomatoes & Parsley

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate, leaving the drippings in the skillet.
Meanwhile, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces; season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Return skillet to medium-high heat; add chicken and stir-fry until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the chicken to a plate, leaving the cooking juices in the skillet.
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons. Peel and mince garlic.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat; once the skillet is hot, add onion, garlic, corn, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are tender and starting to brown, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise.
Add tomatoes and peas to the skillet, stirring to combine the succotash; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, about 4 minutes.
While the succotash is cooking, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Chop or crumble bacon into pieces.
Return chicken (with any accumulated juices), bacon, and parsley to the skillet (reserving a small handful of parsley for garnish). Stir to combine and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes.
To serve, divide succotash between plates or bowls. Top with remaining parsley and enjoy!

name: Chicken, Bell Pepper & Cashew Stir-Fry over Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger. Peel and mince garlic.
Place soy sauce, oil, cornstarch, vinegar, and sugar in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.
Seed and medium dice bell peppers.
Cut chicken thighs into ½-inch pieces.
Heat a large skillet over high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add chicken and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes. Add ginger, garlic, and bell peppers; continue to cook, stirring often, until veggies begin to soften, 2-3 more minutes.
Pour sauce into the skillet. Reduce heat to medium-high and cook, stirring often, until the sauce thickens, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim green onions on a clean cutting board and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Add cashews to the skillet and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice between bowls; top with chicken stir-fry and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Bell Pepper Fajitas with Guacamole & Butter Lettuce

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry bell peppers. Seed, slice into thin strips, and transfer to a bowl.
Peel, thinly slice into half rings, and add onion to bowl with peppers. Peel and mince garlic; add ½ to bowl with vegetables and place the other ½ into a medium bowl for preparing guacamole.
Halve avocado and remove pit; scoop out the flesh into bowl with garlic.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ to bowl with avocado and save the rest for garnishing.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets, then thinly slice fillets crosswise into strips. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken strips and cook until no longer pink, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Add lime juice, salt, and pepper to avocado. Mash with a fork until smooth. Set aside.
After chicken has been transferred add more oil to skillet. Add peppers, onion, and garlic from bowl. Stirring frequently, cook until peppers are tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Wash and dry lettuce.
Cut remaining ½ lime into wedges.
Return chicken and any juices to skillet. Season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and cook for 1-2 minutes.
To serve, fill lettuce leaves with fajita mix. Garnish with guacamole, remaining cilantro, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Bell Pepper Fajitas with Guacamole

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry bell peppers. Seed, slice into thin strips, and transfer to a bowl.
Peel, thinly slice into half rings, and add onion to bowl with peppers. Peel and mince garlic; add ½ to bowl with vegetables and place the other ½ into a small bowl for preparing guacamole.
Halve avocado and remove pit; scoop out the flesh into bowl with garlic.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ to bowl with avocado and save the rest for garnishing.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add lime juice, salt, and pepper to avocado. Mash with a fork until smooth. Set aside.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets, then thinly slice fillets crosswise into strips. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken strips and cook until no longer pink, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Return skillet to stove and add more oil. Add peppers, onion, and garlic from bowl. Stirring frequently, cook until peppers are tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Cut remaining ½ lime into wedges.
Add chicken and any juices to skillet. Season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and cook for 1-2 minutes.
To serve, place tortillas on a plate and fill with fajita filling. Garnish with guacamole, remaining cilantro, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Bell Pepper & Goat Cheese Panini with Arugula Tomato Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb boneless skinless chicken breasts

instructions.text: Coat grill/skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Wash, seed, and cut bell pepper into short strips.
Return grill/skillet to stove. Add pepper and cook until tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to plate with chicken.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare the spread by mashing together garlic, goat cheese, vinegar, and oregano.
Slice buns/rolls in half.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.

Spread ¼ of the goat cheese mixture onto each of the 4 bun/roll halves. Top bottom halves with a few arugula leaves, chicken, and ½ of the bell pepper (save the rest for the salad). Close with top halves.

Place sandwiches on grill/skillet and carefully flatten using a panini press or something heavy. Cook until browned and crispy on the bottom, 1-2 minutes. Carefully flip and continue cooking until browned on the other side, another 1-2 minutes.
In a large bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry arugula and tomato. Cut the tomato into thin wedges. Add arugula, tomato, and remaining bell pepper to bowl with dressing. Toss salad.
