To serve, cut panini in half and place on a plate with salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Bell Pepper Quesadilla with Pico de Gallo

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Peel and mince onion. Wash, seed, and small dice bell pepper.
Wash and dry tomatoes, jalapeno, and cilantro. Small dice tomatoes. Seed and mince jalapeño. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
In a small bowl, prepare salsa by mixing together the tomatoes, ½ of the onion, ½ of the jalapeño, ½ of the cilantro, lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally into thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add oil to skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.

Return skillet to stove. Add more oil, bell pepper, and remaining onion, jalapeño, and cilantro. Season with cumin, salt, and pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until vegetables have softened, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to plate with chicken.
Slice chicken crosswise into strips.
Coarsely grate 1 cup of cheddar.

Place tortillas on a flat surface. Layer one half of each tortilla with ¼ of the cheese, ½ of the chicken and vegetable mixture, and top with another ¼ of the cheese. Fold tortillas over so they are closed.
Wipe skillet with paper towel and reduce heat to medium. Add oil and swirl to coat.

Place both quesadillas in the skillet, straight edges next to each other. Cook until golden brown on both sides and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board and cut into wedges.
To serve, place quesadilla on a plate and serve with salsa. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Breast & Pan-Roasted Cauliflower with Parsley & Pine Nuts

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Pat dry the chicken breasts with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the chicken breasts in the skillet; cook until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through (check doneness with a thermometer or cut into the chicken with a knife), 6 to 8 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the chicken to plate and tent with foil to keep warm.
While the chicken cooks, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the cauliflower and remove the core and leaves; cut the halves into bite-sized florets and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Once the chicken has been transferred, increase the heat to medium-high and add more olive oil to the skillet.
Add the garlic to the skillet and stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the cauliflower to the skillet and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until it is browned and tender when pierced with a fork, 7 to 10 minutes.
Place the pine nuts in a medium bowl.
Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add the parsley to the bowl with the pine nuts.
Grate all of the zest from the lemon and add to the bowl with the pine nuts and parsley, then cut the lemon into wedges for serving.
Add the pine nuts, parsley, lemon zest, and crushed red pepper to the cauliflower; stir to combine and remove from the heat.
To serve, place the chicken and cauliflower mixture on a plate and garnish with the lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Brussels Sprouts & Apple Salad with Toasted Walnuts & Cranberries

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Roughly chop the walnuts.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towels and place on a plate; rub with olive oil and season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the walnuts to the skillet and toast, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl. Wipe out the pan.

Once the walnuts have been transferred, reduce the heat to medium and place the chicken breasts in the skillet; cook until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through (check doneness with a thermometer or cut into the chicken with a knife), 6 to 8 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the chicken to plate.

While the chicken cooks, trim off and discard the stems ends of the Brussels sprouts, then remove the outer layer of leaves; halve the sprouts lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise. Transfer to a large salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds and add to the salad bowl.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add the Brussels sprouts and shallot to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer back to the salad bowl.
While the sprouts cook, quarter the apple lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; large dice the apple into ¾-inch cubes and transfer to the salad bowl.
Add the toasted walnuts and dried cranberries to the salad bowl.
In a small bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
When cool enough to handle, large dice the chicken breasts into ¾-inch cubes. Add to the salad bowl.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Caesar Salad with Yogurt Dressing & Garlic Croutons

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Cube bread and transfer to a sheet pan.
Peel and press or mince garlic. Drizzle bread with oil and sprinkle with ¾ of the garlic (save the rest for dressing), parsley flakes, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Place in the oven and bake until golden brown and crispy, 8-10 minutes.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb boneless skinless chicken breasts

instructions.text: Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
Wash and dry lettuce. Halve lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1 inch strips.
Grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.

In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, 2 tbsp of the grated Parmesan (save the rest for garnishing), yogurt, lemon juice, oil, Dijon, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper.
Cut remaining ¼ lemon into wedges. Slice chicken into strips.
To serve, arrange a bed of lettuce on a plate and top with chicken and croutons. Drizzle with dressing, sprinkle with remaining Parmesan, and serve with lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Cauliflower Fried 'Rice' with Carrots & Peas

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash cauliflower and cut off the leaves. Rice (grate) using a hand grater or in a food processor.
Wash carrot and green onions.
Trim ends, peel, and small dice carrot; transfer to a medium bowl. Trim ends and slice green onions on the diagonal into ¼ inch pieces; transfer to a small bowl.
Measure out peas and add to bowl with carrot.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and mince ginger. Transfer both to a small bowl.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cube chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and freshly ground pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and stir-fry until browned, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Add more oil to skillet followed by garlic and ginger. Stir fry until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add carrot and peas; stir-fry until tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
Add cauliflower rice, mix well, and stir-fry until tender, 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk egg.
Move all the ingredients to one side of the skillet and pour egg on the other side. Scramble egg and mix with everything else.
Return chicken to skillet and add coconut aminos and green onions; stir to combine.
Serve in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Chicken Cordon Bleu with Lemon-Dijon Sauce & Roasted Asparagus

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash, dry, and snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus. Place on a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Place baking sheet in the bottom half of the oven and bake until tender-crisp, 10-15 minutes.

Meanwhile, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season the cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat broiler on high, leaving the asparagus in the bottom of the oven until it is finished cooking.
Place flour in a shallow dish; lightly dredge the chicken in the flour, shake off excess, and place on a plate.
Wash and juice the lemon into a small bowl. Add broth, Dijon, and flour; whisk until smooth.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add breaded cutlets to the skillet and cook until lightly golden, about 2 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, slice the cheese.
Add garlic to the skillet and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add broth mixture and whisk, scraping up the browned bits, until mixture thickens slightly, about 1 minute.

Return the cutlets to the skillet. Place two slices of prosciutto on each cutlet and top with cheese. Place skillet in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden and chicken is cooked through, about 3 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken cutlets, sauce, and asparagus between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chicken with Curried Tomatoes & Peppers (Country Captain) over Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place flour and spices in a medium bowl; stir to combine.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels. Transfer to the bowl with the seasoned flour and toss to coat, shaking off any excess flour.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until cooked through and golden brown, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, peel and mince onion and garlic; transfer both to another medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and small dice celery; add to the bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 5-7 minutes.
Add tomatoes, raisins, curry powder, and salt to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, continue to cook until flavors meld and raisins are plump, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide rice, chicken, and veggies between plates. Top veggies with almonds and enjoy!

name: Chicken Cutlets with Lemony Brussels Sprout, Cranberry & Walnut Sauté

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and halve Brussels sprouts; transfer to a medium bowl and set aside.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, sprinkle flour over both sides of each cutlet and press gently to adhere.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cutlets and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot and garlic.
When the chicken is done, remove to a plate and cover loosely with aluminum foil.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add additional oil, and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add shallot and garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add Brussels sprouts, broth, cranberries, and salt to the skillet; cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until Brussels sprouts are fork-tender, about 5 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the bowl used for the Brussels sprouts.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the parsley.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl.
Uncover the skillet, then add the parsley, lemon juice, and walnuts. Stir to combine and remove from the heat.
To serve, divide chicken and Brussels sprout sauté between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Drumsticks with Spicy Maple-Roasted Cauliflower & Mushrooms

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Place chicken in a medium bowl, drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and golden, 30-35 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place maple syrup, oil, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and paprika in a clean medium bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.
Cut off leaves from the cauliflower, separate into small florets, and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces; add to the bowl with the sauce.
Quarter mushrooms, add to the bowl, and toss to combine. Transfer veggies to a baking dish and spread out in an even layer.
Add baking dish to the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until the veggies are fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the veggies are roasting, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates; top with green onions and enjoy!

name: Chicken, Eggplant & Feta Stuffed Peppers with Creamy Basil Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; arrange cut-side down. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and small dice eggplant.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add eggplant, chicken, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until meat is crumbly and eggplant has softened, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Add mayo, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the basil. Whisk to combine the dressing.

Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with mixed greens and half of the feta. Toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining feta for the next step.)
When the chicken and eggplant are done, add remaining feta to the skillet. Stir to combine the filling and remove from heat.
Divide peppers between plates, stuff with chicken filling, and top with reserved basil. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Chicken Fingers & Avocado Dip with Greens & Grape Tomatoes

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F and position rack in the centre. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk the egg in a small bowl.
In a medium bowl, mix together the almond meal, shredded coconut, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Cut the chicken into strips.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Dip the chicken strips into the egg, then transfer to the dry mixture and turn to coat. Shake off excess and place on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place in the oven and bake until the crust is golden brown and the chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes.
Halve and pit the avocado; cut the flesh into cubes while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon into a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic. Add the garlic, lime juice, salt, and pepper to the avocado. Mash with a fork until very smooth.
Wash the mixed greens and tomatoes.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: To serve, place chicken strips on a plate and arrange greens and tomatoes on the side. Drizzle the greens with a little olive oil. Serve with avocado dip and enjoy!
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

name: Chicken Florentine Pasta with Mushrooms, Grape Tomatoes & Spinach

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain once cooked.
amounts: 6 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) linguine pasta

instructions.text: Wash and dry spinach. Wash tomatoes and mushrooms. Halve the tomatoes. Quarter the mushrooms. Peel and mince garlic.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside.

Return skillet to stove, reduce heat to medium, and add more oil (if needed). Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Cook until tender, 3-4 minutes.
Grate or shave ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
Add broth and cook until reduced by about ½. Remove pan from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return chicken to skillet and add tomatoes, spinach, and pasta. Toss until ingredients are mixed and spinach is wilted.
To serve, place pasta on a plate or in a bowl and sprinkle with Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Fresh Mozzarella Sandwich with Avocado & Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, prepare marinade by whisking together oil, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Add to bowl with marinade and toss to coat.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
Wash and slice tomato into rounds. Halve and pit avocado; thinly slice ½ (save the rest for the salad) while still in skin and scoop out.
Slice mozzarella into rounds.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Place buns or rolls, cut side up, on a sheet pan. Top the bottom halves with avocado slices, chicken, tomato slices, and mozzarella. Leave the top halves as is so they get crusty.
Place in the oven and broil until cheese melts, 3-4 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by combining garlic, oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, and remaining avocado. Mash together until smooth.
Wash and dry spinach. Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
To serve, place sandwiches on a plate and have with spinach salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Fricassée with Creamy Mushroom-Spinach Sauce, Parsley & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken to the skillet and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, onion, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over veggies and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly golden, about 1 minute.
Stir in broth and cream, then bring the sauce to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low continue to cook and cook until thickened, 3-4 minutes more.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside a small handful for serving.
When the sauce has thickened, add remaining parsley and spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, sauce, and chicken between plates. Sprinkle with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Chicken, Gnocchi & Vegetable Soup with Lemon-Basil Gremolata

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the veggies, chicken, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies start to soften and chicken is almost cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Add broth to the pan, stir to combine, and bring to a boil.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the soup is boiling, reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic; add to the bowl with the basil.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl; add oil and stir to combine the gremolata. Set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: When the veggies and chicken and done, add gnocchi to the soup and continue to simmer, uncovered, until gnocchi start to float to the surface, about 4 minutes.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with gremolata. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Green Apple Curry with Basmati Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
While the sauté pan heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Cut into 1-inch pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Once the pan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken to the pan; cook, tossing occasionally, until the pieces are browned but not fully cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes total. Once done, transfer the chicken to a bowl and set aside.
While the chicken cooks, wash and dry the cutting board. Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet followed by the onion. Cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Quarter the apples lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; large dice the apples into ¾-inch cubes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic and curry powder to the pan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the apples to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, 1 to 2 minutes.

Return the chicken to the pan and pour in the broth; season with salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until the chicken is cooked through and the apples are tender, 4 to 6 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls and top with the curry. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Green Bean Casserole with Mushrooms & Thyme

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water and bring to a boil.
Wash green beans and trim ends. Add to boiling water. Cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Wash and slice mushrooms. Transfer everything to a plate.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in skillet. Add chicken and cook until no longer pink, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Melt more butter in skillet. Add onion, garlic, and mushrooms. Stirring occasionally, cook until vegetables are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Grate ¼ cup of Parmesan. In a small bowl, mix together bread crumbs and Parmesan. Set aside.
Wash thyme and slide leaves off the stems.
Sprinkle flour over top vegetables; stir and cook for about 1 minute. Add thyme, chicken, yogurt, salt, and pepper to skillet. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
Transfer mixture to a small baking dish, add green beans, and stir to combine. Sprinkle with parmesan mixture over top.
Place in the oven and cook for 10 minutes. Then broil for 1-2 minutes until topping is slightly browned.
Serve in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Chicken with Grilled Peaches, Melted Fresh Mozzarella & Lemon Arugula

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, halve the peach lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the halves to separate. Remove and discard the pit.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Grill peach halves, cut-side down, until lightly charred, 2-3 minutes. Remove to a plate.

Meanwhile, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Coat the grill pan with additional oil. Place chicken on the grill and cook, until charred on one side and almost cooked through, 3-5 minutes.
While the chicken cooks, using a clean cutting board, slice mozzarella into rounds.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Thinly slice grilled peaches.
Flip the chicken, top with mozzarella and peach slices, and continue to grill until the cheese is melted and chicken is cooked through, about 2 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and grilled chicken between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Jalapeño Enchiladas with Creamy White Sauce

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Place chicken in a medium saucepan; cover with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and let simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-12 minutes. Remove chicken from the saucepan and place on a plate; discard cooking liquid.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Quarter the jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeños with a spoon. Finely dice and set aside. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Heat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the jalapeños, onion, garlic, chili powder, and salt to the saucepan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables have softened, 4-5 minutes.
Grate the mozzarella cheese.
Transfer cooked vegetables from the saucepan to a medium bowl. Shred the chicken and add to the bowl with the vegetables. Stir to combine and set aside.
Return small saucepan to stove over medium heat. Melt the butter, then add the flour. Whisk for 1 minute.
Add the broth and salt to the saucepan; whisk until thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the heat and let cool, 3-5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil.

Grease the bottom of a baking dish with oil. Place ⅓ cup of chicken filling in the center of each tortilla. Top chicken with 1 tbsp of cheese. Roll tightly and place seam-side down in the baking dish.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add yogurt to the pan with the sauce and whisk until smooth. Pour the sauce over the tortillas in the baking dish. Top with the remaining cheese. Place baking dish in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, small dice the tomato and green onion.
Divide the enchiladas between plates and top with tomato and green onion. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Kale & Cauliflower Skillet with Melty Mozzarella

instructions.text: Wash, dry, and separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the cauliflower.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add cauliflower, garlic, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the cauliflower has softened, 6-7 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and place in the reserved bowl.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, cut into bite-sized pieces, and season with salt and pepper.
Add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Return cooked veggies to the bowl and set aside. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom; add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Using a clean cutting board, cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Coarsely grate mozzarella.
Return veggies to the skillet and add cream cheese; cook, stirring occasionally, until cream cheese is melted and everything is warmed through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Top skillet with mozzarella and place in the oven; broil until the cheese is melted and bubbly, 3-5 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken and veggie skillet between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Kale, Grapefruit & Mint Salad with Thai Peanut Dressing

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut off skin and white pith from grapefruit. Slice between the membranes to release segments, transfer to a small bowl, and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl, along with oil, peanut butter, vinegar, honey, fish sauce, and soy sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add the chicken and grill until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side; remove from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the kale and toss to combine the salad.
Roughly chop peanuts.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with grapefruit segments, grilled chicken, and peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Katsu with Sautéed Bok Choy & Lemon Mayo

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim the bok choy ends and cut in half lengthwise. Transfer to a bowl.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger. Transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the ginger.
Crack the egg into a medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork.
Place the flour and bread crumbs on two separate plates.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season the cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add coconut oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.

One piece at a time, thoroughly coat the seasoned chicken cutlets in the flour (shaking off any excess), then in the beaten egg (letting the excess drip off), then in the bread crumbs (pressing to adhere). Transfer to a plate.
Place the breaded chicken cutlets in the skillet; cook until they are golden brown and cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate and wipe the skillet.
Add the mayonnaise to a small bowl.
Juice the lemon and add about ½ to the mayo to start; whisk together. Add more lemon juice if needed.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet.
Add the ginger and garlic to the skillet; cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the bok choy to the skillet; cook, tossing frequently, until the bok choy is wilted and tender, 3 to 5 minutes.
To the bok choy, add soy sauce and sesame oil. Toss to coat, then remove from the heat.
To serve, divide the chicken cutlets and bok choy between plates; drizzle the chicken with the lemon mayo. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Kebabs with Greek Salad & Tzatziki Sauce

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Peel and mince the garlic.
In a small bowl, whisk together the minced garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Cube the chicken and transfer to a medium bowl. Pour half of the dressing over top (save the rest for the salad) and toss to coat.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Thread the chicken onto 2 skewers. Alternatively, you can cook the chicken pieces directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.
Add the chicken to the grill or skillet and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Finely dice ¼ of the cucumber. Peel and mince the remaining garlic. In a small bowl, prepare the tzatziki sauce by mixing together the cucumber, garlic, lemon juice, yogurt, and salt.

Chop the lettuce crosswise into 1 inch strips; transfer to a salad bowl. Quarter the remaining cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into chunks; add to the bowl. Halve the tomatoes; add to the bowl.
Add the olives, feta, and reserved dressing to the salad and toss.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, place salad on a plate and add a chicken skewer on top. Serve with tzatziki sauce and enjoy!

name: Chicken Kofta over Turmeric Rice with Cucumber, Tomato & Mint Raita

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and turmeric, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel, halve, and mince onion. Place half in a medium bowl and half in a small bowl (set small bowl aside for the raita).
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the medium bowl along with the chicken, bread crumbs, and spices. Using your hands, mix until well combined.
Using a ¼-cup measure, form the chicken mixture into 6 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 4-inches long; place kofta on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add kofta and pan-fry, rotating every 2-3 minutes, until browned and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into the small bowl that was set aside for the raita.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumber; add to the bowl.
Small dice tomato; add to the bowl.
Add yogurt, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine the raita.
To serve, divide rice, kofta, and raita between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Korma with Cauliflower Rice

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels, cut into bite-sized (1-inch) pieces, and set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince (or press) garlic.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Wash, peel, and mince or grate ginger.
Once the saucepan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onions, garlic, and ginger; cook, stirring constantly until onions are softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the spices and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30 seconds.
Add canned tomatoes, chicken, salt, and pepper; stir until well combined. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat to medium, cover and cook until chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
While the chicken cooks, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Wash the cauliflower and remove the leaves. Using a food processor or box grater, grate to rice-like texture.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower and cook, stirring occasionally, 5 to 7 minutes.
Meanwhile, add the heavy cream and almond flour to the chicken mixture. Uncover and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Set some cilantro aside to use as garnish.
When cooked, remove the cauliflower from the heat, add remaining cilantro, salt, and pepper and stir to combine.
To serve, place cauliflower rice on a plate and top with chicken korma. Garnish with cilantro and enjoy!

name: Chicken with Lemon Dill-Artichoke Sauce, Roasted Potatoes & Broccoli

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve potatoes and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until the potatoes start to soften, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a medium bowl, drizzle with additional oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove chicken to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)

When the potatoes are starting to soften, remove from the oven. Add broccoli, toss to combine, and spread out in an even layer. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until the veggies are fork-tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, zest and juice lemon into the reserved skillet.

Add broth, cream, and garlic powder to the skillet with the lemon; stir to combine the sauce and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 6-7 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: While the sauce is cooking, drain and roughly chop artichokes. Place in the reserved bowl.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the artichokes.
When the sauce has thickened, add artichokes and dill, then stir to combine. Continue to cook until warmed through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates. Spoon sauce over chicken and enjoy!

name: Chicken Milanese with Couscous, Pickled Cucumber-Radish Salad & Ranch

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a small saucepan, add water and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Once the water is boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, honey, salt, and crushed red pepper in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Trim and halve cucumber crosswise, then run a vegetable peeler along the length of each cucumber half to make ribbons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl, gently toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Place bread crumbs, salt, and pepper in a small bowl, then stir to combine.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Transfer chicken to a plate, spread half of the mayo over the top side, then sprinkle with half of the bread crumbs, pressing gently to adhere. Carefully flip chicken, then repeat with remaining mayo and bread crumbs. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, juice the reserved lemon into the reserved bowl.

Using a clean cutting board, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice, along with yogurt, mayo, and spices, then whisk to combine the ranch dressing. Set aside.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide pickled salad and couscous between plates or bowls. Top with chicken, drizzle with ranch, and enjoy!

name: Chicken Milanese & Italian Pizzeria Salad with Creamy Oregano Dressing

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place flour and bread crumbs onto two separate plates. Season each plate with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, whisk the egg.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.

Dredge chicken fillets in flour, shake off excess, then dip into the bowl with the egg. Let the egg drip off, then dredge the chicken fillets in the bread crumbs, pressing to adhere. Set aside on a plate.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add chicken to the skillet; cook until it is cooked through and golden brown, 3-4 minutes per side. Once chicken is done, remove from skillet and place on a paper-towel lined plate.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together mayonnaise, vinegar, oil, and oregano.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Chop or tear the lettuce into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice the bell pepper and add to the salad bowl.
Trim the ends of the cucumber; halve lengthwise, then thinly slice into half-moons. Add cucumbers to the salad bowl.
Halve the olives lengthwise and add to the salad bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Finely grate Parmesan.
To serve, divide the chicken and salad between plates. Top with grated Parmesan and enjoy!

name: Chicken & Mushroom Alfredo over Zucchini Pasta

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash the zucchini and mushrooms. Trim the zucchini ends and using a julienne peeler (or regular peeler) peel into noodle-like sticks; transfer to a large bowl. Thinly slice the mushrooms; transfer to a small bowl. Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Slice the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Melt butter in the sauté pan and swirl to coat bottom. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Coarsely grate ½ cup of Parmesan.
Once the chicken has been removed, melt remaining butter in the sauté pan. Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Add the cream and bring to a simmer. Stir in the cheese, salt, and pepper.
Add the zucchini noodles to the sauce and gently toss until well coated.
Slice the chicken crosswise on an angle.
To serve, place fettuccine alfredo in a bowl or on a plate, top with chicken, and garnish with freshly ground pepper. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Mushroom & Green Pea Skillet with Quinoa

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa, water, and salt; bring to a boil.
While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cover; cook for 15 minutes. Once cooked, remove from heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside.
Slice the mushrooms and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince the shallot; add to the mushrooms.
Measure out the green peas and transfer to a bowl.
Pat dry the chicken; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the chicken in the skillet and cook until browned, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add the shallot and mushrooms to the skillet. Season with salt and black pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the mushrooms have softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Add the broth and vinegar to the skillet; let the liquid simmer for 1 to 2 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Place the chicken back in the skillet and cook until it is cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the peas and half of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing) to the skillet; stir until well combined.
Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork.
Divide the quinoa between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container) and top each with the chicken and vegetables. Sprinkle with the remaining parsley. Enjoy!

name: Chicken with Mustard Cream Sauce & Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add butter to skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Peel and mince shallot.
Once chicken has been transferred, reduce heat to medium. Add more butter and shallot; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Add broth and vinegar; scrape skillet to loosen any browned bits. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the liquid is reduced by about half, 4-5 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add Dijon and butter; stir until well combined and continue cooking for 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and freshly ground pepper.
Wash and dry spinach.
To serve, arrange spinach and chicken on a plate; drizzle with mustard sauce and enjoy!

name: Chicken Noodle Soup with Carrots, Onions, Celery & Parsley

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken in a single layer and cook, flipping once, until golden brown (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through), about 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Transfer the chicken to a clean plate and set aside. Add more oil to the pan, along with onion and garlic. Cook, stirring often, until softened, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel carrots, trim ends, and cut crosswise into ¼-inch rounds. Cut celery crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add both to the pan with the onions; continue to cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add chicken back to the pan, along with broth, pasta, and spices. Cover and bring to a boil; reduce heat and let simmer until pasta and chicken are cooked through, about 8 minutes.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, slice lemon into wedges and set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Remove chicken from the pan using tongs and transfer to a clean plate or cutting board.
Shred chicken using two forks. Use one fork to hold the chicken and the other fork to pull and shred the meat. Add shredded chicken back to the pan and stir to combine.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Sprinkle parsley over top and garnish with lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Chicken-Orzo Pasta Skillet with Tomato, Zucchini & Parmesan

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and orzo, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and spices; cook, stirring frequently, until chicken is golden and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, small dice tomatoes. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice zucchini. Add to the bowl with the tomato.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add cooked orzo, chicken, and broth to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed, 7-8 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the orzo skillet is done, remove from heat. Add Parmesan and basil, then stir to combine.
To serve, divide skillet between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Parmesan with Baby Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
In a bowl, mix together ½ of the Parmesan, bread crumbs, and salt.
In a different bowl, whisk egg.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Dip each fillet into the egg, then in the bread mixture, pressing gently to adhere. Place in skillet and cook until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side. (The chicken will finish cooking in the oven.)
Grate ½ cup of mozzarella.
Pour ½ of the tomato sauce in a small baking dish, add chicken, and pour remainder of the sauce over top. Sprinkle chicken fillets with mozzarella and remaining Parmesan.
Place in the oven and bake until chicken is cooked through, cheese is melted and sauce is bubbly, 10-15 minutes.
In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry spinach. Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide chicken and spinach salad between plates and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!

name: "Chicken Parmesan" Meatballs & Arugula with Lemon-Shallot Dressing

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide parsley between two medium bowls.
Finely grate Parmesan. Divide between the two bowls.
Coarsely grate mozzarella. Add all of the mozzarella to one of the bowls, stir to combine, and set aside.

Add chicken, bread crumbs, egg, oil, and spices to the remaining bowl with the parsley and Parmesan; use your hands to combine the chicken mixture. Using a tablespoon measure, form the mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place tomato sauce and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the sauce.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning often, until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Remove from heat.

When the meatballs are browned, pour tomato sauce over top, stir to coat, then sprinkle with reserved parsley and two-cheese mixture. Place skillet in the oven and bake until cheese is melted and meatballs are cooked through, 7-8 minutes more. Remove from oven. (Reserve medium bowl for next step.)
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into the medium reserved bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide meatballs, sauce, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Pasta Salad with Apple, Pecans, Greens & Orange-Dijon Dressing

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Juice orange into a medium bowl.
Add oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the orange juice; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken to the skillet and pan-fry until cooked through and golden brown, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot into half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apple; add to the bowl.
Coarsely chop pecans and add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; add to the bowl along with the mixed greens. Toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls and top with sliced chicken. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Peach & Spinach Salad with Feta & Balsamic Vinaigrette

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Transfer the spinach to a large salad bowl.
Quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard the pit; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season the cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the chicken cutlets in the skillet; cook until they are golden brown on the outside and cooked through in the center, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate. Cook in batches if necessary.
To the garlic, add olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add feta to the salad bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Slice the chicken crosswise into strips.
To serve, divide the salad between plates and top with the chicken strips. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Pineapple & Bell Pepper Quesadilla with Creamy Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and small dice the flesh. Divide pineapple between two medium bowls.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to one of the bowls with the pineapple (set the other bowl of pineapple aside for the salad).
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion; add to the bowl with the pineapple and bell pepper.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pineapple, veggies, chicken, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies have softened and chicken is cooked through, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lime into the bowl with the remaining pineapple.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl along with yogurt, maple syrup, chili powder, and salt. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.
To assemble the quesadillas, lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide chicken and veggie filling between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla. Top with cheese and fold in half to close.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, add spinach to the bowl with the pineapple and dressing. Toss to combine the salad.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates; serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Chicken Pot Pie with Parmesan Potato Crust

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 6 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Slice potato, using a mandoline or knife, into very thin rounds. Coat the bottom of a baking sheet pan with oil. Add potatoes in a single layer, and bake until tender; 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice the carrot. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim and discard ends of the celery; small dice and add to the bowl.
Peel and small dice the onion. Add to the bowl.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add carrots, celery, onion, and spices to the pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, while you prep the chicken.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and add to the pan with the vegetables. Cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through, 5-7 minutes.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add peas, corn, and flour, stirring to coat. Add broth and Worcestershire sauce; bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Finely grate Parmesan.
Carefully pour chicken and vegetable mixture into a small baking dish and use tongs to top with the sliced, par-baked, potatoes. Cover potatoes evenly with Parmesan.

Place in the oven and bake for 6 minutes, then increase oven temperature to broil on high. Broil for 2-3 minutes or until bubbly and potato topping is golden brown. Remove from oven and let rest 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide pot pie between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Quinoa Bowl with Kale, Pickled Radish & Lemon-Tahini Sauce

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, toss to combine, and set aside to marinate.
Peel and mince garlic; place in another small bowl.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic; add tahini, water, oil, and salt. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken to the skillet and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; transfer to a plate.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the plate with the carrot.
Roughly chop pistachios.
Slice chicken into thin strips.
To serve, divide quinoa between bowls; top with chicken, carrots, kale, pickled radish, and pistachios. Drizzle with lemon-tahini sauce and enjoy!

name: Chicken-Rice "Paella" Bake with Bell Pepper, Asparagus & Artichoke

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch pieces. Place both in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the bell pepper and asparagus; set aside.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add chicken and cook until golden, about 2 minutes per side. Once golden, transfer to a clean plate (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Reserve skillet with juices for later use.
Meanwhile, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and rice; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, about 2 minutes.

Once the veggies are soft, add broth, tomato sauce, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, return chicken (and any accumulated juices) to the skillet and nestle into the veggies and rice; cover the skillet with an ovenproof lid or aluminum foil.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Place skillet in the oven and bake until rice has fully absorbed liquid and chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Slice lemon into wedges.
When the chicken and rice are done, add artichokes and half of the parsley to the skillet; stir to combine the "paella." (Reserve remaining parsley for garnish.)
To serve, divide paella between plates or bowls; sprinkle with reserved parsley and squeeze lemon over top. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Salad with Kale, Roasted Squash, Goat Cheese & Walnuts

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, trim, and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Drizzle squash with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until squash is golden and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken cutlets and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Wash and dry kale. Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Finely chop leaves and add to the bowl. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl.
Once the squash is cool, add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with chicken. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Saltimbocca with Buttery Potatoes & Asparagus

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 6 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Small dice potatoes; transfer to a large pot, cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes.
Set aside one sage leaf per serving as garnish; mince the remaining leaves.

Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper. Sprinkle one side of each fillet with the minced sage, pressing to adhere.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Wrap the prosciutto around the chicken fillets, pressing to adhere.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken fillets to the skillet and cook for 3-5 minutes per side, until chicken is cooked through. Transfer chicken to a plate and cover with foil.
Peel and mince the shallot.
Return the skillet to medium heat. Add the shallot to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 2 minutes. Whisk in the flour and cook for 1 additional minute.
Whisk in the broth, scraping up the brown bits from the bottom of the skillet. Bring to a simmer, then cook, stirring often, for 2-3 minutes until the sauce is thickened.
amounts: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves; add to the skillet and stir to combine, reserving some for garnish.
Juice the lemon into the skillet and whisk to combine. Return the chicken to the skillet and simmer for 2 minutes.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus. Add asparagus to the pot with the potatoes during the last 3 minutes of cooking.
When the asparagus is done, remove with tongs and set aside on a plate. Drain the potatoes and add back to the pot along with the butter and salt; stir to combine.
To serve, divide the potatoes, asparagus, and chicken between plates. Spoon the sauce over the top of the chicken and veggies. Garnish with fresh sage leaves and minced parsley. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Satay Bowl with Peanut-Zucchini Noodles, Cucumber & Tomato

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger. Place both in a small bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl (reserving the rest for garnish).
Juice lime into the bowl. Add peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce; whisk to combine the sauce.

Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels, cut into bite-sized pieces, and place on the baking sheet. Spoon half of the sauce over the chicken, toss to coat, and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve remaining sauce for later.)
Place chicken in the oven and bake until golden brown and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim zucchini ends and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add zucchini and remaining sauce; cook, stirring constantly, until just tender, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Trim and large dice cucumber. Large dice tomato; set both aside on a plate.
Roughly chop peanuts.
To serve, divide zucchini noodles between bowls; top with chicken, veggies, peanuts, and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Satay with Creamy Peanut Sauce & Thai Cucumber Salad
