instructions.text: Peel and mince ginger. In a medium bowl, whisk together ginger, peanut butter, water, vinegar, soy sauce, honey, lime juice, turmeric, and crushed red pepper. Transfer ½ of mixture to a small bowl (to use as sauce) and set aside.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ (save the rest for the salad) to the medium bowl.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Add to medium bowl and toss to coat.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Thread chicken onto 6 skewers and place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the chicken pieces directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add skewers and cook until chicken is cooked through but still juicy, 3-4 minutes per side.
In a medium bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together remaining cilantro, lime juice, vinegar, soy sauce, honey, and crushed red pepper.
Peel and thinly slice onion. Wash, trim ends, halve lengthwise, and thinly slice cucumbers into half rounds. Add everything to bowl with dressing and toss.
To serve, place chicken skewers on a plate, add salad, and have with peanut sauce on the side. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Sautéed Kale with Roasted Beet & Orange Slices

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 500°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim the ends and peel the beets; slice crosswise into ⅛-inch-thick rounds. Transfer to a baking sheet.
Halve the orange crosswise. Slice one half into rounds and add to the beets. Juice the other half into a bowl and set aside for later.
Drizzle the beet and orange slices with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Place the sheet in the oven and roast until the beet slices are tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
Fold the kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Roughly chop the leaves and transfer to a medium bowl. Cut the stems into 1-inch pieces and transfer to a separate bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the chicken in the skillet and cook until it is browned and cooked through, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add more olive oil to the skillet. Then add the kale stems and season with a little salt; cook until they begin to soften, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the garlic to the skillet and stir with the kale stems until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the kale leaves and pour in the orange juice. Season with more salt and pepper. Stir well and cook until the leaves wilt, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Divide the chicken, beet and orange slices, and the kale sauté between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container). Enjoy!

name: Chicken Shawarma Lettuce Wraps with Avocado & Lemon-Garlic Mayo

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place spices in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the spice rub.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the spice rub.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken breast dry with paper towels and cut into thin strips. Add to the bowl and toss to combine.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions and chicken; cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic, then add mayo, oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Small dice tomato.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice.
To serve, separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with chicken, tomato, and avocado. Drizzle with lemon-garlic mayo and enjoy!

name: Chicken Skewers with Roasted Strawberry, Arugula, Basil & Feta Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and quarter strawberries lengthwise. Transfer to a small baking dish, drizzle with honey, and season with salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until strawberries are soft, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, zest lemon into a medium bowl (reserve lemon for later use). Add mayo and spices to the bowl, then whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the marinade and stir to coat.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thread chicken onto skewers and place on a plate. (Alternatively, you can cook the chicken pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.)
Once the pan is hot, add the skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Juice half of the reserved lemon into the bowl with the shallot. Add oil, pepper, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining lemon for serving.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the bowl along with arugula, cooled strawberries, and feta. Gently toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide skewers and salad between plates. Squeeze reserved lemon over the skewers and enjoy!

name: Chicken "Smash Burger" Tacos with Cheese, Tomato & Special Sauce

instructions.text: Place mayo, ketchup, Dijon, and cayenne in a small bowl. Stir to combine the special sauce and set aside.
Place vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and slice shallot crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing, stir to combine, and set aside.
Place chicken in another medium bowl along with oil, Worcestershire, and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined.

Arrange tortillas on a flat surface, then divide the chicken mixture between them (about 1 ½ tablespoons per tortilla). Using your hands, spread the chicken mixture over the surface of each tortilla in an even layer.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, coarsely grate cheese.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tacos, meat-side down. Cook, pressing down once with the bottom of a spatula halfway through cooking, until the chicken is cooked through, about 2 minutes.
Flip tacos, chicken-side up, and sprinkle with cheese. Continue to cook until cheese has melted, 1 minute more. Transfer to a plate.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash, dry, and halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide tacos between plates. Top each with a small handful of salad and drizzle with special sauce. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Chicken Soba Noodle Salad with Edamame, Cilantro & Peanut Dressing

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place chicken, salt, and pepper in a medium saucepan and cover with water by 1-inch; bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes; transfer chicken to a plate to cool.
Meanwhile, fill another medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add noodles and edamame; cook noodles according to package directions, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water; set aside.

While the noodles and edamame cook, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with soy sauce, vinegar, oil, peanut butter, and honey; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and thinly slice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Once the chicken is cool, shred using two forks; use one fork to hold the chicken and the other fork to pull and shred the meat. Add to the bowl along with noodles and edamame.
Roughly chop peanuts and add to the bowl; toss to combine the noodle salad.
To serve, divide noodle salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Chicken Soup with Toasted Orzo Pasta, Fennel, Tomato, Carrot & Parsley

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and medium dice.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through and golden, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and slice carrot crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Add to the bowl with the fennel.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 7-8 minutes.

Meanwhile, return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add orzo and cook, stirring frequently, until golden and toasted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.

When the veggies are soft, add chicken, toasted orzo, broth, and tomatoes to the pan. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until orzo is tender, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the soup is cooking, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the soup and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
To serve, divide soup between bowls and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Spinach Salad with Orzo Pasta, Artichokes, Olives & Parmesan

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, about 8 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool, then set aside to drain further.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes and olives. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Drain and roughly chop artichokes. Add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the dressing and marinated veggies.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl, along with the orzo and spinach, then toss to combine the salad.
Slice chicken into thin strips.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with chicken and enjoy!

name: Chicken Stew (Cacciatore) with Bell Pepper, Zucchini, Olives & Quinoa

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add both to the bowl with the onion and garlic; set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Sprinkle with cornstarch and season with spices on both sides.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 3-4 minutes. (The chicken will not be cooked all the way through.)
Add veggies and spices to the pan with the chicken; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, roughly chop olives.

When the veggies are done, add tomatoes, broth, and olives to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until stew has thickened and chicken is cooked through, 6-8 minutes more.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the stew is simmering, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the stew is done, add half of the basil to the pan; stir to combine and remove from heat. (Reserve remaining basil for garnish.)
To serve, divide quinoa and chicken stew between bowls; top with reserved basil and enjoy!

name: Chicken, Strawberry & Avocado Salad with Spinach & Almonds

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and discard the stem ends of the strawberries; cut the strawberries into quarters lengthwise and transfer to a plate.
Halve and pit the avocado, then scoop out the flesh and cut crosswise into slices; transfer to the plate with the strawberries.
Measure out the almonds into a small bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Place the chicken on a cutting board and holding a knife parallel to the board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper, then rub with olive oil.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place the chicken in the grill pan or skillet; cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3 to 4 minute per side. Once done, transfer to a cutting board.
While the chicken cooks, in a small bowl, combine olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper and whisk together.
Slice the chicken crosswise into bite-sized strips.
To serve, arrange a bed of the spinach on a plate and top with the avocado, strawberries, and chicken. Sprinkle with almonds and drizzle with the dressing just before serving. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Stuffed Portobellos with Blue Cheese & Apple-Pecan Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove stems from portobello mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, rub with oil, then season with salt and pepper on both sides; arrange cap-side up.
Place mushrooms in the oven and broil until starting to soften, about 6 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the chicken is cooking, place additional oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Using tongs, carefully flip the mushrooms, cap-side down. Fill with chicken mixture and top with blue cheese.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to broil until the mushrooms are soft and cheese is melted, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apple. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pecans, add to the bowl, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide stuffed mushrooms and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chicken & Sweet Potato Curry with Coconut Milk & Spinach

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and cut the sweet potatoes into ¾-inch cubes; transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat the sauté pan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on the cutting board. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Once the pan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion and chicken to the pan and season with salt and pepper; cook, tossing occasionally, until the onion is softened and the chicken is browned, 5 to 6 minutes.
Wash and dry the cutting board and knife.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger; transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the ginger.
Add the ginger, garlic, curry powder, and turmeric to the pan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.

Add the sweet potatoes and coconut milk to the pan; season with salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer, cover the pan, and cook until the sweet potatoes are tender, 12 to 15 minutes.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Stir about ¾ of the cilantro into the curry and save the rest for garnishing.
Once the sweet potatoes are tender, add the spinach to the curry and stir until wilted, then remove the curry from the heat.
To serve, spoon the curry into a bowl and sprinkle with the remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Tacos with Spicy Mango, Bell Pepper & Cilantro Salsa

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and place in a medium bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince shallot and garlic; add both to the bowl with the jalapeño.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; small dice and add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl; add salt and stir to combine the mango salsa. Set aside.
Remove lettuce leaves from head, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with chicken, lettuce, and mango salsa. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Tagine with Apricot & Chickpea Cauliflower Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat. When the pot is hot add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add chicken to the pot and sear, flipping once, until golden brown on both sides, about 6 minutes. Once seared, remove chicken from the pot and set aside on a plate.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice the onion and carrots.
After removing the chicken, add onion and carrot to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Peel and mince the garlic and ginger.
Add garlic to the pot and cook for 30 seconds. Add ginger and spices and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add broth and scrape any brown bits from the bottom of the pot. Return chicken to the pot, fitting the pieces into a single layer. Increase heat to high and bring liquid to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 8 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower and transfer to a large bowl.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Small dice apricots.
Using tongs, remove chicken from pot; transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Add cauliflower, chickpeas, almonds, and apricots to the pot. Increase the heat to medium-high and cook for 5 minutes.
Use a slotted spoon to dish the cauliflower mixture onto plates, leaving any excess liquid in the pot. Top with chicken and enjoy!

name: Chicken Tenders with Honey Mustard Dip & Roasted Green Beans

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F and position rack in the centre. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk the egg in a small bowl.
In a medium bowl, mix together the almond meal, shredded coconut, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Cut the chicken into strips.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Dip the chicken strips into the egg, then transfer to the dry mixture and turn to coat. Shake off excess and place on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place in the oven and bake until the crust is golden brown and the chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes.

Wash the green beans and trim ends. Add to the boiling water and cook until bright green, 3-4 minutes. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water to prevent further cooking. Set aside to drain further.
Peel and mince the garlic.
In small bowl, prepare the dip by whisking together ⅓ of the minced garlic (save the rest for the green beans), mayonnaise, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper.
Wipe the saucepan dry and return to the stove over medium heat. Add oil and swirl to coat bottom. Add the remaining minced garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add the green beans and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
Place the chicken tenders on a plate, arrange the green beans on the side, and serve with the honey mustard dip. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Tenders with Roasted Vegetables & Spicy Maple Mustard

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F and position rack in the center. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the sweet potatoes in half lengthwise, then cut each half into ½-inch planks, then into sticks. Add to a medium bowl.

Drizzle sweet potatoes with oil and season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper and toss until evenly coated. Spread out in an even layer on one of the prepared baking sheets and place in the oven, cook for 10 minutes. Set the bowl aside for the broccoli.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into strips. Add to the bowl used for the sweet potatoes and toss with oil and spices. Set aside.
Meanwhile, measure out the cornstarch in a medium bowl for dredging.
In another medium bowl, whisk the egg.
In a third medium bowl, mix together the almond meal, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and cayenne pepper. Stir to combine.
Cut the chicken into 1-inch thick strips.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: First, dredge the strips in cornstarch, shaking off any excess. Then, dip the chicken strips into the egg. Finally, dredge in almond meal mixture, pressing gently to adhere. Shake off excess and place on another prepared baking sheet. Place in the oven for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, in small bowl prepare the dip by whisking together Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and cayenne. Set aside.
When the potatoes have baked for 10 minutes, remove from oven and spread broccoli evenly over top. Return to oven and bake for another 15 minutes, until potatoes are fork tender.
Once the chicken has cooked for 10 minutes remove from oven and flip. Return to oven and bake an additional 8-10 minutes.
Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves.
To serve, arrange chicken tenders, wedges and broccoli on a plate. Garnish with parsley and serve with the maple mustard dip. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Tenders with Tangy Japanese Tonkatsu Sauce & Nutty Kale Slaw

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Place bread crumbs, oil, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the breading mixture and set aside.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then slice lengthwise into 1-inch strips. Place in a medium bowl along with mayo, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add breading mixture to the bowl with the chicken and toss to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Transfer chicken to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer. (Reserve small bowl for later use.)
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place peanut butter, oil, vinegar, sugar, and spices in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces; add to the bowl. Using your hands, massage kale and cabbage with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the slaw, and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger. Place in the reserved small bowl, along with ketchup, soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar. Whisk to combine the tonkatsu sauce.
Divide chicken tenders and slaw between plates. Serve with tonkatsu sauce for dipping and enjoy!

name: Chicken Tenders with Za'atar Yogurt & Minty Arugula-Pistachio Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Place mayo and spices in a medium bowl, then stir to combine.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then slice crosswise into ¾-inch strips. Add to the bowl with the mayo mixture and toss to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add bread crumbs to the bowl with the chicken and turn to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Transfer chicken to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer.
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the za'atar yogurt and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the bowl.
When the chicken is almost done, add arugula to the bowl, and toss to combine the salad.
Divide chicken tenders and salad between plates. Serve with za'atar yogurt for dipping and enjoy!

name: Chicken Thighs with Orange-Thyme Pan Sauce, Crisp Green Beans & Quinoa

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 2 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat; add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken to the skillet; pan-fry until cooked through and golden brown, 5-6 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice the shallots into rings.
Wash, trim, and discard the ends of the green beans.
Wash, dry, and zest half the orange into a small bowl; juice the whole orange into the same bowl.
When the chicken is done, transfer it to a plate, cover loosely with foil, and set aside.
Return skillet to stove; reduce heat to medium and add the shallot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 3-4 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the skillet with the shallots.
Add the broth, any accumulated drippings, orange zest and juice, salt, and pepper to the skillet; scrape up any brown bits from the bottom of the pan.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add beans to the skillet and bring to a simmer; continue to cook until sauce is reduced slightly and beans are tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
Wash the thyme and slide the leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the butter and thyme.
To serve, divide quinoa, chicken, beans, and pan sauce between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chicken, Turnip & Mushroom Stew with Garlic Bread

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Peel and medium dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Wash turnip and mushrooms. Peel and medium dice turnip. Slice mushrooms.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Medium dice chicken. Season with salt and pepper.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add chicken and cook until lightly browned, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Add more oil to saucepan, then add onion, garlic, turnip, and mushrooms. Cook, stirring frequently, until onion is softened, 4-5 minutes.
Preheat the broiler and position rack about 6 inches from the top.
Wash rosemary and slide leaves off the stems.
Wash and dry spinach.

Add chicken, rosemary, spinach, and broth to saucepan. Season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until turnips are tender, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Peel and mince remaining garlic. In a small bowl, mix together garlic, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Place halves of bun or roll cut side up on a baking sheet pan. Spread the oil mixture over top. Place in the oven and broil until bread in golden brown, 2-3 minutes.
Pour stew into a bowl and enjoy with garlic bread!

name: Chicken Waldorf Salad with Yogurt Dressing & Romaine Lettuce

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place chicken in a small saucepan. Season with salt and pepper. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-12 minutes. Remove from liquid and place on a plate.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together yogurt, lemon juice, honey, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Roughly chop walnuts.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add walnuts and, stirring constantly, toast until golden brown, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat to cool.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash apple, celery, grapes, and chives. Core, medium dice, and add apple to bowl with dressing. Trim ends, medium dice, and add celery to bowl. Halve grapes and add to bowl. Chop chives and add to bowl.
Wash and dry lettuce. Chop crosswise into 1 inch strips.
Pat dry the chicken with paper towels, medium dice, and add to bowl. Toss salad until well combined.
To serve, arrange a bed of lettuce leaves on a plate and top with salad. Enjoy!

name: Chicken-White Bean Skillet Bake with Mushrooms, Spinach & Goat Cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with spices on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the chicken and sear until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Remove to a clean plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Thinly slice mushrooms and place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl.
Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, beans, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 4-5 minutes.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Nestle chicken into the veggies and crumble goat cheese over the top. Place skillet in the oven and bake until cheese is melted and chicken is cooked through, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide chicken and veggie skillet between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Wings with Broccoli, Radish, Date, Feta & Pistachio Salad

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.

Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and spices, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet, spread out in an even layer, and drizzle with additional oil.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add broccoli and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until broccoli is tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
While the broccoli is cooking, roughly chop dates.
When the broccoli is done, add dates and sesame seeds to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until dates have softened, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a clean medium bowl. Add oil and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the bowl, along with feta and cooked broccoli, then toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chicken Wrap with Curried Pineapple-Apricot Chutney & Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and small dice the flesh. Place half in a small saucepan. (Place the remaining pineapple in a medium bowl and set aside for later use.)
Small dice apricots and add to the pan with the pineapple.

Add water, vinegar, sugar, and spices to the pan. Stir to combine the chutney and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
While the chicken is cooking, add oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the pineapple. Stir to combine the salad dressing.

Using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
Place tortillas on a flat surface; spread each with a layer of mayo and chutney. Top with chicken and a small portion of salad. Roll tightly to close. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Chicken Wrap with Feta, Dates, Lettuce, Parsley & Curried Carrot Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with yogurt, oil, Dijon, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove chicken to a plate; set aside. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing, stir to combine, and set aside.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons.
Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
While the onion is cooking, roughly chop dates.
When the onion is soft, add vinegar to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until vinegar is reduced, about 1 minute.
Return chicken to the skillet, along with any accumulated juices, then add the dates and feta. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.

Place tortillas on a flat surface, then divide chicken-feta mixture and lettuce between them. Top with a small portion of carrot salad and roll tightly to close. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Chicken with Zesty Bacon Ranch & Broccoli

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the lemon; juice it into a small bowl.
Add mayonnaise, yogurt, and spices to the bowl with the lemon juice; whisk to combine the ranch sauce.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add the bacon. Cook until the bacon is crispy, 3-4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate lined with paper towels.
Wash broccoli. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Pour off all but about 1 tablespoon of bacon fat and return skillet to medium heat. Add cutlets and cook until golden brown, 1-2 minutes per side.
Peel and mince garlic.
When chicken is browned, add garlic and cook 30 seconds more. Add ranch sauce to the skillet; when the sauce begins to bubble, remove from the heat.
Add broccoli to the skillet, cover with aluminum foil, and transfer to the oven; bake until the broccoli is fork-tender and chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop the bacon.
To serve, divide the chicken, broccoli, and sauce between plates. Top with bacon bits and enjoy!

name: Chicken-Zucchini Meatballs with Rice, Cucumber, Tomato & Feta Yogurt

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Transfer to a colander, then sprinkle with salt and toss to coat. Place the colander in a bowl to catch excess liquid and set aside.
Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Place in a medium bowl along with chicken, egg, bread crumbs, and spices.

Use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated zucchini. Add to the bowl with the chicken and mix with your hands until well combined. Using a scant ¼-cup measure, form the chicken mixture into meatballs. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until golden and cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl along with feta, yogurt, water, and spices. Stir to combine the feta sauce and set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Place on a plate.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the plate with the cucumber.
To serve, divide rice and meatballs between bowls. Top with cucumber and tomato, then drizzle with feta sauce. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Broccoli Slaw Salad with Creamy Peanut Sauce and Steamed Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel and mince the garlic and ginger. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together the minced garlic and ginger, peanut butter, soy sauce, water, vinegar, curry, and pepper.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with dressing.
Add broccoli slaw to bowl.
Wash and dry bell pepper and green onions. Seed, julienne (cut into thin sticks), and add pepper to bowl. Trim and discard root ends, chop onions, and add to bowl.
Toss salad until coated with dressing.
To serve, divide rice and salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea Chicken Salad with Cucumber, Almonds, Feta & Citrus Dressing

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add almonds and cook, stirring frequently, until golden and toasted, 3-4 minutes. Transfer almonds to a small bowl and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Return skillet to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice lemon and half of the orange into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining orange for the next step.)
Cut off skin and white pith from reserved orange; slice between the membranes to release segments. Cut flesh into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, along with chickpeas, almonds, and feta, then gently toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with chicken and enjoy!

name: Chickpea, Egg & Avocado Chopped Salad with Balsamic Vinaigrette

instructions.text: Place the eggs in a small saucepan and cover with cold water by about 1 inch. Cover with a lid and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the root end of the lettuce and remove any blemished leaves; halve the head lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1-inch pieces and transfer to a large salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; large dice the cucumber (cut into ¾-inch cubes) and add to the salad bowl.
Halve the grape tomatoes and add to the salad bowl.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and large dice the flesh. Add to the salad bowl.
Once the water is boiling, remove the pan from the heat and let the eggs sit, covered, for 6 minutes.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; medium dice the onion (cut into ½-inch pieces) and add to the salad bowl.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then place on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry; add to the salad bowl.
Once the eggs are done, place them in a bowl of cold water to stop the cooking process and set aside for 2 to 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper.
Peel and roughly chop the eggs; add to the salad bowl.
To serve, spoon the salad onto a plate or into a bowl and drizzle with the dressing. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea-Guacamole Toasts with Spicy Mango, Cucumber & Cilantro Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime and divide between two medium bowls.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and divide between the two bowls. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)

Shave cilantro leaves off the stems. Mince half of the leaves, add to one of the bowls, and set aside for the guacamole. Roughly chop remaining leaves, add to the remaining bowl, and stir to combine the dressing.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl, along with oil and salt, then stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl for the guacamole.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Add to the bowl, along with salt, and mash with a fork or potato masher until guacamole is semi-smooth.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl with the guacamole and lightly mash chickpeas until semi-smooth and combined.
Arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Divide toast between plates and top with chickpea guacamole. Serve with mango-cucumber salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Kale Caesar Salad with Pumpkin Seeds

instructions.text: Wash and dry the kale leaves and lemon.

One kale leaf at a time, cut along the sides of the tough center ribs, then pull out and discard the ribs. When all the leaves are trimmed, chop them crosswise into 1-inch pieces and transfer to a large bowl.
Finely grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Cut the lemon in half; juice one half into a small bowl (that is big enough for making the dressing) and cut the other half into wedges for serving.
Add ½ of the grated Parmesan (save the rest for garnishing), minced garlic, yogurt, Dijon, soy sauce, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice; whisk together until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the kale and toss to combine. If the kale is tough, massage it with your hands to soften it.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the bun or roll into ¾-inch cubes.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add the bread cubes to the skillet; sprinkle with salt and toss to coat in the oil, then arrange in a single layer. Toast the bread, tossing occasionally, until the bread cubes are golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the croutons to a bowl and return the skillet to the stove.
While the bread cubes cook, drain and rinse the chickpeas, then transfer them to a clean towel (or paper towels) and pat dry.
Once the croutons have been transferred, wipe out the skillet with a paper towel and heat over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add the chickpeas to the skillet; season with salt and pepper and toss to coat in the oil. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chickpeas are golden brown and crispy, 5 to 7 minutes. Once done, remove the skillet from the heat.
Measure out the pumpkin seeds and place in a small bowl.
To serve, arrange a bed of the kale on a plate and top with the croutons, chickpeas, pumpkin seeds, and remaining Parmesan. Garnish with lemon wedges for squeezing over the top.

name: Chickpea-Kale Sauté with Raisins, Couscous & Toasted Pine Nuts

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add pine nuts and cook, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 2 minutes. Transfer toasted nuts to a small bowl. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion crosswise into half-moons. Peel and mince garlic.
Return skillet to medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
While the onion is cooking, drain and rinse chickpeas.
When the onion is soft, add chickpeas to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chickpeas are golden and warmed through, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.
Add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add broth, raisins, and spices to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until raisins have softened and sauce has thickened, 3-4 minutes more.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add vinegar to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide couscous and chickpea-kale sauté between plates or bowls; sprinkle with pine nuts. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea Lettuce Wraps with Tomato, Feta & Soy-Glazed Pumpkin Seeds

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Place pumpkin seeds, soy sauce, and maple syrup in a medium bowl; stir to combine. Transfer seeds to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring seeds halfway through, until golden and toasted, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool (the seeds will harden as they cool).
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into the reserved bowl. Add oil, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve or quarter tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander. Add to the bowl.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl.
Break apart the cooled pumpkin seeds. Add to the bowl, along with feta, and stir to combine the chickpea salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with chickpea salad. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea Panzanella Salad with Cucumber, Bell Pepper & Tomatoes

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Cut bread into cubes.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add bread cubes, season with salt and pepper, and toss to coat. Stirring occasionally, cook until golden brown, 4-5 minutes.
amounts: about 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Drain and rinse chickpeas; place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.

Wash and dry cucumber, tomatoes, bell pepper, and basil. Medium dice the cucumber and tomatoes. Seed and medium dice the pepper. Pick the basil leaves off the stems and thinly slice into ribbons. Peel and medium dice onion. Add to bowl.
Add bread and toss salad.
To serve, place salad in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea Tacos with Avocado Cream

instructions.text: Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Seed and small dice the bell peppers; set aside.
Peel and small dice onion.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the bell peppers, onion, garlic, and chickpeas. Cook until the chickpeas are slightly golden, stirring occasionally, about 3-4 minutes.
Add soy sauce, chili powder, and paprika to the chickpeas and sauté for 5-7 more minutes, until golden brown.
Add the avocado, water, and salt to a blender. Juice the lime into the blender. Purée until smooth.
Wrap the tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until heated through, 15-30 seconds.
To assemble, add the chickpea vegetable mixture to each tortilla. Top with a drizzle of the avocado cream. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea-Tomato Noodle Soup with Kale Caesar & Breadsticks

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place half the garlic in a medium bowl and set aside for the salad dressing.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot and remaining garlic to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add broth, tomato sauce, pasta, and spices to the pan; stir to combine. Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to medium, cover, and cook until noodles are just tender, about 8 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, cut flatbread into 1½-inch wide strips, place on a baking sheet pan, and drizzle with oil. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside.
While the breadsticks are baking, wash, dry, and juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add mayo, Dijon, soy sauce, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.

Wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad and set aside.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Once the pasta is tender, add chickpeas to the pan and stir to combine. Continue to cook until heated through, 1-2 minutes.
Finely grate cheese.
Ladle soup into bowls and serve with salad and breadsticks on the side. Top soup and salad with cheese and enjoy!

name: Chickpea Waldorf Salad with Apples, Celery, Grapes & Walnuts

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then set aside to drain further.
In a large salad bowl, combine and whisk together yogurt, apple cider vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper.
Quarter the apple lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; medium dice the apple (cut into ½-inch cubes) and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the celery; medium dice the celery (cut into ½-inch cubes) and add to the salad bowl.
Halve or quarter the grapes (depending on the size) and add to the salad bowl.
Roughly chop the walnuts and add to the salad bowl.
Add the chickpeas to the salad bowl; toss the salad until thoroughly coated with the dressing.
To serve, divide the spinach between plates and top with the salad. Enjoy!

name: Chickpea & Zucchini Sauté with Couscous, Feta & Almonds

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the ends of the zucchini; halve the zucchini lengthwise, then cut the halves crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-rounds at a 45° angle. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Halve the grape tomatoes; transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; medium dice the onion (cut into ½-inch pieces).
Once the skillet is heated, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until it has softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
While the onion cooks, using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Add the broth to a small saucepan; bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add the garlic and cumin to the skillet and stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the zucchini and broth to the skillet; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the zucchini is tender, 6 to 8 minutes.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid in the saucepan comes to a boil, add couscous and salt; give it a stir and cover with a lid. Remove from the heat and let it stand for 5 minutes.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas in a colander.
Measure out the feta into a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Measure out the almonds into a small bowl.
Add the chickpeas, tomatoes, and parsley to the zucchini. Stir and cook until the mixture is heated through, 1 to 2 minutes.
Uncover the couscous and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place the couscous into a bowl or on a plate, top with the zucchini and chickpea sauté, and sprinkle with the crumbled feta and almonds. Enjoy!

name: Chili Beef Meatballs with Spicy Tomato-Pepper Sauce & Corn Tortillas

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.

Place beef, bread crumbs, egg, and spices in a medium bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the mixture into meatballs and transfer to the baking sheet.
Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place in a small bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, cilantro, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, 4-5 minutes.
Add tomatoes and tomato sauce to the pan, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens slightly, 5-6 minutes more. Remove from heat.
When the meatballs are done, add to the pan with the sauce and stir once more to combine.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide meatballs between plates or bowls. Top with reserved cilantro and serve with tortillas on the side. Enjoy!

name: Chili Crunch Shrimp Noodle Bowl with Carrot, Cucumber & Bell Pepper

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes (or prepare according to package instructions). Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place white and pale green parts in a small bowl. Place remaining (dark green) onion on a plate and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the green onions.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions and garlic; cook, stirring frequently, until onion is golden and crisp, 2-3 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)

Add crushed red pepper, sesame seeds, sugar, and salt to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Transfer to the reserved bowl, along with soy sauce and vinegar, then stir to combine the chili crunch. Set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)

If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel and trim carrot; using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the carrot into noodle-like strips. Add to the plate with the reserved green onions.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the plate.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the plate.
To serve, divide noodles, shrimp, and veggies between bowls. Top with reserved green onions and drizzle with chili crunch. Enjoy!

name: Chili-Lime Chicken Wings with Curried Cauliflower "Potato Salad"

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into a medium bowl.

Quarter chili pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the lime. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl along with oil, sugar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the sauce.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and add to the bowl with the sauce; toss to coat. Transfer wings to the baking sheet, drizzle with any sauce left in the bowl, and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water heats up, separate cauliflower into small bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.

Once the water is boiling, uncover and add cauliflower and salt; stir for a few seconds. Cook until crisp-tender, about 3 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside to drain further.
Meanwhile, place mayo, Dijon, vinegar, and spices in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl along with the cooked cauliflower and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Sprinkle over the wings and toss to combine.
To serve, divide wings and cauliflower salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chili-Lime Hot Wings with Rice & Sugar Snap Peas

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 475°F. Line a baking sheet with foil.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat chicken wings dry with paper towels.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Combine baking powder, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Add chicken wings and toss to coat.
Transfer wings to the baking sheet and spread out in a single layer. Place in the oven and bake, turning halfway through, until crispy, about 20 minutes.
Wash and dry the lime. Juice half into a small skillet; slice remaining lime into wedges and set aside.
Add chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce, butter, and honey to the skillet with the lime juice. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook until slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes.

In a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth. Add to the skillet in a steady stream while stirring quickly. Cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes. Transfer sauce to a clean medium bowl and set aside.
Return skillet to the stove over medium-high heat; once hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Wash and dry snap peas. Add to the skillet along with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
Remove chicken wings from the oven and transfer to the bowl with the chili-lime sauce; toss to coat.
To serve, divide rice, wings, and snap peas between plates. Garnish with lime wedges and enjoy!

name: Chili-Rubbed Halibut with Black Beans, Peppers & Cilantro-Lime Crema

instructions.text: In a small bowl, mix together the spices.
Pat the fish dry with paper towels and place on a plate; drizzle with olive oil and rub both sides with the spice mixture. Set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and slice onion into half rings. Slice bell peppers into strips.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Drain and rinse beans.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add garlic, onion, bell peppers, and beans to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lime into a blender.

Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeño with a spoon. Roughly chop and add to blender. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and add leaves to the blender.
Add yogurt, salt, and garlic powder to blender. Purée until smooth, about 30 seconds.
Remove vegetables from the skillet and set aside on a plate, cover with foil to keep warm.
Return skillet to medium-high heat. Add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place the fish on the skillet; cook until it is opaque in the center, 3-4 minutes per side.
To serve, divide the vegetables and fish between plates. Drizzle with the cilantro-lime crema. Enjoy!

name: Chili-Rubbed Pork Chops with Apple Salsa & Sweet Potato Mash

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice the sweet potatoes into ½-inch cubes; transfer to a small saucepan.
Add water to the saucepan, covering the potatoes, and bring to a boil. Cook until they are tender when pierced with a fork, 14 to 16 minutes.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, combine and mix together chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels, then place on a plate; rub both sides with the spice mixture.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the pork chops in the skillet; cook until browned and cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate and let them rest for 5 minutes.
While the pork chops cook, core and small dice the apple into ¼-inch cubes; transfer to a medium bowl.
Quarter the jalapeño lengthwise, then remove and discard the seeds and white membranes; finely dice the pepper and add to the bowl.

Trim and discard the ends of the green onions; chop the onions into ¼-inch pieces. Add ¾ of the onions to the apple and pepper mixture and transfer the rest to a small bowl (for garnishing the sweet potato mash).
Once the potatoes are tender, scoop out ¼ cup of the water and set aside, then drain the potatoes in a colander and return them back to the saucepan.
Add the reserved cooking water, coconut oil, salt, and pepper to the potatoes; mash with a potato masher until smooth.
Juice the lime and add to the bowl with the apple and jalapeño.
Add olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper to the apple salsa; toss to combine.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: To serve, place the pork chops and sweet potato mash on a plate. Spoon the salsa overtop the pork and sprinkle the mash with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Chili-Rubbed Salmon with Warm Zucchini & Corn Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the ends of the zucchini; using a box grater, coarsely grate the zucchini. Transfer to a colander (with a bowl underneath) and season with salt; set aside to drain.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon fillets dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the salmon, skin-side-down, in the skillet; cook until the flesh is opaque and flaky, 3 to 4 minutes per side (depending on thickness). Once done, transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
While the salmon cooks, trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and mince the shallot. Transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle and transfer to a small bowl.
Once the salmon has been transferred, reduce the heat to medium. Add more oil and the shallots to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 30 to 60 seconds.
Once the shallots have softened, add the corn to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until warmed through and lightly charred, 1 to 2 minutes.
Cut the lime into 4 wedges.

Add the drained zucchini and about ¾ of the green onions (save the rest for garnishing) to the skillet; season with chili powder, salt, and pepper. Increase the heat to medium-high and cook until the zucchini is heated through, 2 to 3 minutes.
To serve, divide the zucchini and corn salad between plates or bowls, top with the salmon fillets, and garnish with the remaining green onions and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Chili-Rubbed Striploin Steak with Avocado-Cucumber Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, combine chili powder, salt, and pepper.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; rub with the spice mixture on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
Halve the cucumber crosswise, then quarter lengthwise and slice crosswise at an angle; transfer to a salad bowl.
