Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh with a spoon and medium dice; add to the salad bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Juice the lime and pour over the salad.
Drizzle the salad with olive oil and season with cumin, salt, and pepper; toss to combine.
To serve, divide the steak and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Chili Salmon Tacos with Orange-Avocado Slaw, Cilantro & Lime Crema

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice half of the lime into a small bowl. Add yogurt and salt; stir to combine the crema and set aside. (Reserve remaining lime for later use.)
Place oil and spices in medium bowl, then stir to combine the spice oil.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Pat salmon dry with paper towels. Cut into 1-inch thick fingers and add to the bowl with the spice oil. Stir to coat, then transfer to the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until salmon is cooked through, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Juice reserved lime into the bowl with the shallot, then add oil and salt. Stir to combine the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel oranges, separate into segments, and roughly chop the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl, along with the broccoli slaw, and gently stir to combine.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with salmon and a small portion of slaw; drizzle with lime crema. Serve with remaining slaw on the side and enjoy!

name: Chili Shrimp Lettuce Wraps with Asparagus, Broccoli & Sweet Potato

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place mayo and spices in a medium bowl, then stir to combine.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the mayo mixture.
Peel and halve sweet potato lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl.

Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut crosswise into 3-inch pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine. Add bread crumbs to the bowl, then gently toss once more to coat. Transfer veggies to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer; drizzle with oil.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until veggies are golden and fork-tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place shrimp in a clean medium bowl, along with cornstarch, and toss to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp and cook, stirring occasionally, until just opaque and starting to color, 2-3 minutes.
Add chili-garlic sauce to the skillet and stir to combine. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
Meanwhile, place soy sauce, additional chili-garlic sauce, and sugar in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with veggies and shrimp. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

name: Chili-Spiced Pumpkin Soup with Pork, Cauliflower, Cilantro & Lime

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the bowl with the cauliflower (reserving the rest for serving).
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add pork and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the cauliflower and cilantro.
When the pork is done, add veggies to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.

Add broth and pumpkin to the pan; stir to combine and bring the soup to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the cauliflower is soft, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: When the soup is done, juice lime into the pan, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and sprinkle with reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Chili-Style Beef Soup with Pinto Beans, Veggies, Avocado & Yogurt

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Place in a small bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; trim and thinly slice celery. Add both to the bowl with the green onion.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add beef and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
When the beef is done, add veggies and salt to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
When the veggies are soft, add spices to the pan and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add beans, water, and tomato sauce to the pan; stir to combine the soup, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender, 12-15 minutes.
While the soup simmers, cut lime into wedges.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh.
Divide soup between bowls; top with avocado and yogurt. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing over top. Enjoy!

name: Chilled Yogurt Soup with Chickpeas, Cucumber, Radish & Tomato Toast

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Preheat a small skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic and shallot.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, shallot, cumin, and salt to the skillet; cook, stirring constantly, until soft and golden, about 2 minutes. Once done, transfer to a medium bowl.
Add yogurt, broth, sugar, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic and shallot. Whisk to combine the soup base.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the soup base.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and small dice cucumber; trim and small dice radishes. Add both to the bowl along with the chickpeas and stir to combine the soup. Cover and place in the refrigerator until ready to serve.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a small bowl along with oil and salt; stir to combine the garlic oil.
Slice rolls in half and place on a baking sheet pan, cut-side up; drizzle with the garlic oil. Place rolls in the oven and broil until golden, 1-2 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, slice tomatoes into thin rounds. Arrange tomato slices over the toasted rolls and season with salt and pepper.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with tomato toasts on the side. Enjoy!

name: Chimichurri Chicken & Grilled Vegetable Kebabs

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 6-8 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave parsley and cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves; transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and add to the bowl.
To make the chimichurri sauce, add olive oil, red wine vinegar, and spices to the bowl with the fresh herbs and garlic. Stir to combine. Pour half of the sauce into a small bowl and set aside.
amounts: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Cut chicken into 1-inch cubes. Add to the medium bowl with half of the chimichurri sauce and stir to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Peel and chop onion into 1-inch pieces and add to another medium bowl.
Seed the pepper and chop into 1-inch pieces. Halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 1-inch half rounds; halve the mushrooms. Add veggies to the bowl with the onions.
Add oil, salt, and pepper to the veggies and toss until well coated.
Thread chicken and veggies onto skewers and place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the chicken and veggies directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.

When hot, coat grill or bottom of grill/skillet with oil; add the kebabs (as many as will fit). Cook until vegetables are tender, and chicken is cooked through, 4-6 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil. Repeat with remaining kebabs.
To serve, divide kebabs between plates, and top with the remaining chimichurri sauce. Enjoy!

name: Chimichurri Shrimp with Mashed Potatoes & Garlicky Sautéed Spinach

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley and cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place herbs in a small bowl.
Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Add both to the bowl with herbs along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Stir to combine the chimichurri and set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place shrimp in a medium bowl, along with half of the chimichurri, and stir to coat. (Reserve remaining chimichurri for serving.)

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp and cook until they are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer shrimp to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Season with salt and pepper, stir to combine, then remove from heat. Cover to keep warm.
When the potatoes are tender, drain in a clean colander and return to the pan. Add milk, oil, salt, and pepper, then mash until smooth.
To serve, divide mashed potatoes between plates or bowls, then top with garlicky spinach and shrimp. Drizzle with reserved chimichurri and enjoy!

name: Chinese Chicken Salad with Napa Cabbage, Carrots & Tortilla Strips

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cut tortilla into thin strips and transfer to a sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to coat. Arrange in a single layer.
Place in the oven and bake until golden and crispy, 10-12 minutes.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, ginger, oil, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, honey, and crushed red pepper.

Wash and dry cabbage, carrot, and cilantro. Thinly slice cabbage into shreds. Trim ends, peel, and coarsely grate carrot. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add everything to bowl with dressing and toss.
Slice chicken into strips.
To serve, place salad on a plate and top with tortilla chips and chicken. Enjoy!

name: Chinese Egg, Tomato & Green Onion Stir-Fry with Sesame Seeds over Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic, then set aside.
Crack eggs into another medium bowl. Add salt, then beat with a whisk or fork until smooth.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions (reserving a small handful for serving) and cook, stirring frequently, until beginning to soften, about 30 seconds.
Add eggs to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until just set, about 3 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes and soy sauce; cook, stirring occasionally, until beginning to soften, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, place water, ketchup, cornstarch, and sugar in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
Once the tomatoes have softened, reduce heat to medium. Add sauce and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until sauce thickens slightly, 2-3 minutes.
Return eggs to the skillet, using a spoon to break them up. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Top with reserved green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Chinese-Style Spicy Chicken Rice Bowl with Napa Cabbage & Carrot Slaw

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel carrots into thin noodle-like sticks. Add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl, toss to combine the slaw, and set aside. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and large dice. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, place mayo, chili-garlic sauce, and vinegar in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
When the chicken is done, add sauce to the skillet and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, chicken, and slaw between bowls, then top with reserved green onions. Enjoy!

name: Chopped Veggie Salad with Sun-Dried Tomato Dressing & Breadsticks

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic. Mince the sun-dried tomatoes. Add both to a large salad bowl.
Zest and juice half the lemon into the salad bowl. Thinly slice remaining lemon into rounds and set aside for garnish.
Add oil, honey, Dijon, and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.

Drizzle 1 tbsp dressing over the flatbread, then cut into 1½-inch wide strips and place on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and thinly slice the onion. Peel and thinly slice carrot into rounds. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim celery, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Medium dice tomato; add both to the bowl.
Halve romaine leaves lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into shreds; add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the bowl.
Drain and rinse the beans; add to the bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates and top with feta. Serve with breadsticks and lemon slices. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Chunky Beef Bolognese Sauce with Zucchini Noodles & Basil Ribbons

instructions.text: Wash the carrot and celery. Trim ends, peel, and small dice the carrot. Trim ends and small dice the celery. Peel and mince the onion. Peel and mince the garlic. Alternatively, place the vegetables in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add all the diced and minced vegetables. Cook, stirring frequently, until vegetables soften, 4-5 minutes.
Push the veggie mixture to the side of the skillet, then add in the ground beef. Cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until beef is browned and no longer pink.

Add diced tomatoes and tomato sauce to the beef and veggie mixture. Season with crushed red pepper, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat to medium-low and let simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Wash and dry the basil; pick the leaves off the stems and slice into ribbons. Add about ½ to the sauce towards the end of cooking time and save the rest for garnishing.
Wash and dry zucchini; trim ends. Using a julienne peeler (or regular peeler), peel zucchini into noodle-like sticks. Leave raw or warm up in a skillet with a little olive until slightly softened.
Finely grate ⅛ cup of parmesan.
To serve, arrange zucchini noodles in a bowl and top with the bolognese sauce. Sprinkle with grated parmesan and remaining basil ribbons. Enjoy!

name: Chunky Vegetable and Bean Chili with Cool Greek Yogurt

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add onion and garlic.
Wash celery and bell pepper. Medium dice and add celery to a saucepan. Seed, medium dice, and add pepper to saucepan. Stirring frequently, cook until vegetables have softened, 4-5 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans.
In a small bowl, mix together chili powder, cumin, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.

Add spice mixture, beans, tomatoes, and broth to saucepan. Stir to combine and bring to a boil. Then reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer until vegetables are tender and chili has thickened, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash green onions, trim and discard root ends, and chop. Stir ½ into the chili and save the rest for garnishing.
Serve chili in a bowl, garnish with remaining green onions and spoonfuls of yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Cilantro Burger with Spicy Mayo & Jalapeño-Lime Zucchini Sauté

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems. Place half of the leaves in a small bowl and set aside for serving; mince remaining leaves and place in a medium bowl.
Add beef, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the minced cilantro; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the beef mixture into 2 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place mayo and chili-garlic sauce in another small bowl; stir to combine the spicy mayo and set aside.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and cook an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Place in another small bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Small dice and add to the bowl with the zucchini; set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add zucchini, jalapeño, water, salt, and pepper to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice radishes.
When the veggies are done, juice lime into the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Toast buns if desired.

Place bottom half of each bun on a plate; spread with spicy mayo, then layer with burger patties, radish, and reserved cilantro leaves. Close with the top half of each bun and serve with sautéed veggies on the side. Enjoy!

name: Cilantro Lime Chicken Salad with Mango, Avocado & Bell Pepper

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Peel and mince the garlic.

Juice the lime into a small bowl, then add ½ of the cilantro (transfer the rest to a small bowl and save for garnishing), minced garlic, olive oil, honey, crushed red pepper, salt, and pepper; whisk together. Pour ½ of the sauce into a medium bowl and set the rest aside.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add the chicken to the medium bowl and coat with the sauce; set aside to marinade for 10 minutes.
Seed and cut the pepper into strips lengthwise; transfer to a plate.
Peel the mango and cut the flesh away from the pit; medium dice the flesh. Add to the plate next to the pepper.
Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the plate next to the pepper and mango.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Halve the lettuce lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1-inch strips; transfer to a medium bowl.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and pat dry with paper towels; place the fillets in the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Slice the chicken crosswise into strips.

Divide the lettuce between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container) and layer the peppers, mangoes, avocado, and chicken over top. Drizzle with the remaining sauce and garnish with the remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Cilantro-Lime Chicken Thighs with Avocado-Tomato Salsa

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl.
Juice the lime; add half of the juice to the bowl with the chicken and the other half to a separate medium salad bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add half to each bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the chicken.
To the bowl with the chicken, add olive oil, salt, and pepper. Turn the chicken until well coated with the marinade. Set aside for 5 minutes.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the chicken marinates, halve the grape tomatoes crosswise. Add to the salad bowl.
Once the grill pan / skillet is hot, add the chicken and cook until it is golden brown and cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes per side.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and small dice the flesh. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Add to the salad bowl.
Add olive oil, salt, and pepper to the salad bowl; toss to combine.
To serve, divide the chicken between plates and top with the salsa. Enjoy!

name: Cilantro-Lime Grilled Chicken with Thai Mango Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the cilantro. Shave the leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer one half to a medium bowl and the other half to a large bowl.
Grate zest from half of the lime. Add the lime zest and juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper to the medium bowl with the cilantro; mix together.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Place in the marinade and turn to coat. Set aside for a few minutes.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash the mango and bell pepper.
Coat the grill/skillet with oil. Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Peel and julienne (or cut into thin sticks) the mango; add to the large bowl with the cilantro. Seed and julienne (or cut into thin sticks) the bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Peel and mince or press the garlic. In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together the minced garlic, lime juice, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, water, and crushed red pepper.
Pour the dressing over top the salad and toss to combine.
Serve the grilled chicken with salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Cilantro Shrimp Fritters with Spicy Cabbage Slaw & Avocado Corn Salsa

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic. Divide between two medium bowls and set one bowl aside for the fritters.
Juice half of the lime into the remaining bowl with the garlic. Add yogurt and salt; stir to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining lime for later use.)

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Roughly chop and add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw. Set aside.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the other bowl with the garlic. (Reserve remaining cilantro for later use.)

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Roughly chop shrimp into small pieces. Add to the bowl with the garlic and cilantro along with egg, bread crumbs, cornstarch, salt, and cayenne pepper. Stir to combine the batter.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place corn in a clean colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Set aside to drain further.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; press down with a spatula to form round, ½-inch thick fritters.
Cook fritters, carefully flipping once (the fritters are delicate but will firm up as they finish cooking on the other side), until golden brown, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, juice the reserved lime into a small bowl.

Using a clean cutting board, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with the reserved cilantro, corn, and salt. Stir to combine the salsa.
To serve, divide salad and shrimp fritters between plates. Top fritters with avocado-corn salsa and enjoy!

name: Citrus Chicken Quinoa Salad with Avocado & Orange

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Cube chicken into 1 inch pieces. Season with paprika, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken pieces and cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Halve and pit avocado. Scoop out the flesh, medium dice, and transfer to a salad bowl.

Slice off top and bottom from orange, then cut off the skin and white pith from the sides so you can see the orange flesh. Cut in between the thin membranes to release the segments and add to salad bowl.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to salad bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, lime juice, olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper.
Rinse quinoa in a stainer if there is excess water and add to salad bowl. Add chicken and pour dressing over top. Toss to coat.
Serve in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Citrus Marinated Chicken over Quinoa Salad with Berries & Oranges

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest orange into a medium bowl (set orange aside for later use). Juice lime into the same bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lime juice, along with soy sauce, oil, and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Place chicken in the bowl with the marinade, turn to coat, and set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Juice lemon into another medium bowl; add oil, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, trim and cut celery and green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice strawberries; add to the bowl along with the blueberries.
Remove peel from the zested orange; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and marinade to the skillet; pan-fry until the chicken is golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, transfer the cooked quinoa to a baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes.
Add cooled quinoa to the bowl with the salad and gently stir to combine.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide quinoa salad and chicken between plates. Enjoy!

name: Citrus-Soy Glazed Strip Steak with Pineapple & Bell Pepper Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, juice orange into a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the orange juice along with soy sauce, honey, oil, salt, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the glaze and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and thinly slice against the grain. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add steak and half of the glaze; cook, stirring occasionally, until steak is just cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet and remaining glaze for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the green onions.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.

Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, return to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions, pineapple, and bell pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until pineapple softens, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
When the rice is done, add to the skillet, along with reserved glaze, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide pineapple rice and steak between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Classic Beef Burger with Chopped Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
In a medium bowl, combine and mix together the ground beef, Worcestershire, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Form the mixture into 2 patties and place on a plate.
Once the grill pan or skillet is hot, coat the bottom with coconut oil.
Place the beef patties on the grill pan or skillet and cook until desired doneness, 4 to 6 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the patties to a plate.

While the patties cook, rip off a couple lettuce leaves for the burgers and place on a plate. Then, trim off and discard the root end of the remaining lettuce and remove any blemished leaves; halve the head lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Transfer the chopped lettuce to a medium salad bowl.

Slice one of the tomatoes crosswise into ¼-inch-thick rounds for the burgers and add to the plate with the lettuce leaves. Halve the other tomato lengthwise and cut out and discard the stem end; large dice the tomato and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces on an angle and add to the salad bowl.
In a small bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Toast the buns if desired.
To serve, assemble the burger and add any desired condiments. Serve with the salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Classic Beef Chili with Avocado & Crusty Bread

instructions.text: Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Wash, seed, and mince jalapeño.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add onion and jalapeño. Stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans.
Add garlic, chili powder, and cumin to saucepan. Stir and cook for 30 seconds.
Add beef and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until crumbly and browned, 2-3 minutes.
Add beans, tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until chili thickens, about 10 minutes.
Scoop out the avocado flesh and medium dice.
Toast bread if desired.
To serve, place chili in a bowl and garnish with avocado. Enjoy with bread!

name: Classic Beef Stew with Potatoes, Carrots, Celery & Crusty Bread

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine flour, salt, and pepper.
Cube steak, add to bowl, and toss to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry potatoes, carrots, celery, and green onions. Peel and medium dice potatoes and carrots. Trim ends and medium dice celery. Trim root ends and chop onions. Peel and mince garlic.
Heat a small saucepan over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add beef and cook until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes total.
Add potatoes, carrots, celery, onions, and garlic. Stir and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add broth, water, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until vegetables are tender, 10-15 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Toast bread.
To serve, place stew in a bowl and have with crusty bread. Enjoy!

name: Classic Lentil Soup with Zucchini, Carrot, Celery & Breadsticks

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
While the onion is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to the pan with the onion.
Add broth, diced tomatoes, and spices to the pan; stir to combine, cover, and bring soup to a boil over medium-high heat.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the soup is heating, peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Trim and slice celery crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add both to the soup.
Trim and medium dice zucchini; add to the soup.

Peel and mince garlic; add half the garlic to the soup (reserving the rest for the bread sticks) and stir to combine. Once the soup comes to a boil, reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until veggies and lentils are tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 425°F.
Place reserved garlic in a small bowl along with oil and spices; stir to combine the garlic oil.

Drizzle garlic oil over the flatbread; cut into 1½-inch wide strips and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from the oven.
When the soup is done, add vinegar and stir to combine.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with breadsticks on the side. Enjoy!

name: Classic Sloppy Joes with Zesty Broccoli Slaw

instructions.text: Peel and small dice onion. Wash, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Peel and mince garlic.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add onion and pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add beef and garlic. Breaking apart with a spoon, cook until meat is browned and crumbly, 2-3 minutes.
Add tomato sauce, vinegar, honey, soy sauce, Dijon, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Stirring occasionally, reduce heat to low and simmer until sauce thickens, 10-15 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add broccoli slaw to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
Toast buns or rolls if desired.
To serve, fill buns or rolls with sloppy joe mixture and enjoy with broccoli slaw on the side!

name: Classic Spaghetti Bolognese with Parmesan & Basil

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 5 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) spaghetti pasta

instructions.text: Wash and dry carrot, celery, and basil. Small dice carrot and celery. Pick basil leaves off the stems and thinly slice into ribbons. Transfer to a plate.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and mince onion and garlic.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add onion, garlic, carrot, celery, and crushed red pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until softened, 5-6 minutes.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Increase heat to medium-high and add beef. Breaking apart with a spoon, cook until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
Add tomatoes, ½ of the basil (save the rest for garnishing), Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Stir and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes.
Grate or shave ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
Drain pasta, return to saucepan, and drizzle with a little olive oil to prevent sticking.
To serve, place pasta in a shallow bowl or plate and top with bolognese sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan and garnish with remaining basil. Enjoy!

name: Classic Spaghetti & Meatballs with Tomato Sauce

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer half of the parsley to a medium bowl and the other half to a small bowl.
Peel and mince the onion.
Peel and mince the garlic; transfer half of the onion and garlic to the medium bowl with the parsley and the other half to another small bowl.
Add the ground beef, bread crumbs, and spices to the medium bowl with the parsley, onion and garlic mixture. Mix with your hands until well combined.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Using a tablespoon measure, form the meat mixture into rounded meatballs.
Add olive oil to the pan and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Once the water is boiling, season with salt and add the pasta. Cook the pasta until desired firmness, 8 to 10 minutes. Once done, drain in a colander.
amounts: 5 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) spaghetti pasta

instructions.text: Place the meatballs in the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are browned on all sides and almost cooked through, 4 to 5 minutes total. Once done, transfer to a bowl or plate.
Once the meatballs have been transferred, add more olive oil to the pan, followed by the remaining onion and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until the onion is softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, and spices to the pan. Return the meatballs to the pan, reduce the heat to medium-low and cook until the meatballs are cooked through and the sauce is slightly thickened, 6 to 8 minutes.
Finely grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Add the spinach to the sauce and fold in until it is wilted. Remove pan from the heat.
To serve, divide pasta between bowls, spoon the sauce and meatballs over top, and sprinkle with the remaining parsley and grated Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Coconut Chicken Salad with Honey Mustard Dressing

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Slice chicken into 1-½ inch strips; season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: In a small bowl, combine the shredded coconut, breadcrumbs, and garlic powder.
In another small bowl, whisk the egg with the water.

Dip the chicken tenders into the egg and then into the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 30 minutes, turning once, halfway through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Dijon, oil, honey, and vinegar; set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce (Skip spring mix if it came pre-washed).
Medium dice the cucumber. Halve the grape tomatoes.
Trim and peel the carrots, then julienne or coarsely grate them.
To serve, divide the spring mix, cucumbers, tomatoes, and carrots between bowls. Top with baked chicken strips and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Coconut Chicken Tenders with Thai Dipping Sauce & Cabbage-Mango Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Place bread crumbs, coconut, and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the breading mixture and set aside.
Place mayo and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then slice lengthwise into ¾-inch strips. Add to the bowl with the mayo and toss to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add the breading mixture to the bowl with the chicken and turn to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Transfer chicken to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer.
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small saucepan along with honey, vinegar, water, and crushed red pepper. Set over medium-high heat and bring sauce to a boil.

Once the sauce is boiling, reduce to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened slightly, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat, then transfer ⅓ of the sauce to a clean medium bowl. Set remaining sauce aside for serving.
Juice lime into the bowl with the sauce, then whisk to combine the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; slice into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide chicken and salad between plates. Serve with reserved sauce for dipping and enjoy!

name: Coconut Curry Red Lentil Dahl with Tomatoes, Cilantro & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel and mince ginger and garlic; place in a small bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and small dice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, jalapeño, onion, and spices to the pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is soft, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, rinse the lentils in a colander or strainer.
Add lentils, broth, and coconut milk to the pan. Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook until the lentils are just tender, 15-20 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: While the lentils are cooking, quarter tomatoes.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the lentils are done, add tomatoes and half the cilantro (reserving the rest for garnish) to the pan; stir to combine and continue to cook until heated through, 1-2 minutes more.
To serve, divide lentils and rice between bowls; top with reserved cilantro and enjoy!

name: Coconut Curry Shrimp with Carrot Rice

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
If using frozen shrimp, place in a bowl and cover with cold water to thaw. Set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry green onions. Trim root ends and chop.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

Drain and rinse shrimp under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Return to empty bowl. Add lime juice, ½ of the green onions (save the rest for garnishing), and pepper. Toss to coat.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger. In a small bowl mix together garlic, ginger, curry powder, salt, and water.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add curry mixture and cook for about 1 minute. Add coconut milk, stir, and cook 2-3 minutes.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Add shrimp and cook until opaque, 4-5 minutes.
Wash, trim ends, peel, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to rice and stir to combine.
To serve, place rice and curry on a plate and garnish with remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Coconut-Pecan Crusted Cod with Orange Fennel Salad & Rice

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, mince pecans. Place in a small bowl along with coconut and crushed red pepper, then stir to combine the topping.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

While the rice is cooking, pat cod dry with paper towels, season with salt and pepper, then transfer to the baking sheet. Spread top side with mayo, then sprinkle evenly with the topping, pressing gently to adhere.
Place cod in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the fish is baking, place oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash and dry fennel; trim off root end and dark green stalks, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Wash, dry, and peel orange; separate into segments and cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, along with cranberries, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide fish, rice, and salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Coconut-Pork Meatballs with Cilantro Sauce, Greens Beans & Carrots

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim green beans and transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long pieces; add to the baking sheet with the green beans. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place pork, coconut, and spices in a medium bowl; using your hands, mix well to combine.
Using a tablespoon measure, form the pork mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the meatballs are done, add broth, cream, and cilantro to the skillet, then bring sauce to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly and coats meatballs, 3-4 minutes more.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Juice lime into the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide veggies, meatballs, and sauce between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Coconut Shrimp Tacos with Spicy Pineapple, Avocado & Jalapeño Salad

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Place mayo and spices in a medium bowl. Stir to combine.

Add shrimp to the bowl with the mayo mixture and stir to coat. Add bread crumbs and coconut to the bowl, then gently toss once more to coat. Transfer shrimp to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer; drizzle with oil.
Place shrimp in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice half of the lime into a clean medium bowl, then add oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing. (Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.)
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice. Add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Roughly chop and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with shrimp and a small portion of salad. Serve with remaining salad and lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!

name: Coconut-Turmeric Rice Noodles with Edamame, Veggies & Cilantro

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions; drain in a colander and rinse.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and cut carrot crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Add to the bowl with the broccoli.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, about 5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Peel and small dice shallot.
When the veggies are done, return them to the reserved bowl.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, ginger, and shallot to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add coconut milk, water, fish sauce, honey, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Once the sauce is simmering, add drained rice noodles, edamame, and cooked veggies to the skillet; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until noodles are warmed through and sauce has thickened slightly, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut lime into wedges; set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add cilantro to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide saucy noodles and veggies between bowls; top with a squeeze of lime and enjoy!

name: Cod à la Meunière with Roasted Green Beans & Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F and place the rack in the center position.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the potatoes lengthwise, then cut each half lengthwise into 6 wedges; transfer the wedges to a baking sheet.
Place the sheet in the oven and cook the potatoes for about 10 minutes (while you prepare the green beans).
Trim and discard the ends of the green beans; transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Remove the sheet from the oven; add the green beans and garlic to the potatoes.
Drizzle the vegetables with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
Return the sheet to the oven; cook the vegetables, tossing once halfway through cooking time, until they are tender, another 10 to 15 minutes. Once done, remove from the oven.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Pat the cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the fish in the skillet; cook until it is browned and crisp, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
While the fish cooks, juice the lemon into a small bowl.
Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves.

Once the fish has been transferred, add butter to the skillet and let it turn a light brown, then remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the lemon juice and ½ of the parsley (save the rest for the green beans and potatoes).
Sprinkle the green beans and potatoes with the remaining parsley; toss to combine.
To serve, place the fish on a plate, spoon the butter sauce overtop, and add the roasted green beans and potatoes on the side. Enjoy!

name: Cod, Chickpea, Tomato & Fennel Stew with Toasted Sourdough

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Add to the bowl with the fennel.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are starting to soften 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander.

When the veggies have started to soften, add chickpeas, broth, and tomatoes to the pan, then stir to combine the stew. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat and simmer until veggies and chickpeas are tender, about 5 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the stew is cooking, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
When the veggies are tender, add cod to the stew. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the cod is opaque and cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Divide stew between bowls and serve with toast on the side. Enjoy!

name: Cod Poached in Fresh Tomato Sauce with Roasted Asparagus

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 425°F and position rack in the center.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; transfer the spears to a baking sheet.
Drizzle the asparagus with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then spread out in a single layer. Set aside.
Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Medium dice the tomatoes; add to the garlic.
Place the asparagus in the oven and roast until tender-crisp, 10 to 12 minutes.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion; transfer to a small bowl.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it softens and browns, 2 to 3 minutes.
While the onion cooks, measure out the olives and capers and add to the bowl with the tomatoes and garlic.
Add more olive oil to the skillet, followed by the tomatoes, garlic, olives, and capers. Season with salt and pepper.
Place the fish in the skillet and sink into the sauce; cook until it is opaque and flakes easily, 4 to 5 minutes per side.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add most of the parsley to the skillet (save a little for garnishing) and stir into the sauce.
To serve, divide the asparagus between plates and place the fish fillets on top. Spoon the tomato sauce over top and garnish with the remaining parsley. Enjoy!

name: Cod, Spinach & Cilantro Coconut Curry with Spicy Mango-Cucumber Salad

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Roughly chop spinach and transfer to a medium bowl; set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and ginger.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and ginger; cook, stirring constantly, until golden, about 1 minute.
Add spices to the pan and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 1 minute more.
Add coconut milk, then bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: While the coconut milk is heating up, pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch pieces.
Once the coconut milk is boiling, reduce heat to medium-low, add cod, and simmer, undisturbed, until the fish is cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, zest and juice lime into another medium bowl; add oil, sugar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Medium dice and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim cucumber, halve lengthwise, and thinly slice crosswise into half-moons; add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl (reserving the rest for the curry) and stir to combine the salad.
When the curry is done, add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide the fish curry between bowls and sprinkle with reserved cilantro. Enjoy with mango-cucumber salad on the side.

name: Cod Spinach Florentine with Couscous & Garlic-Parmesan Green Beans

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Once the water in the pan is boiling, uncover, then add salt and spinach. Stir until wilted, 30-60 seconds, then drain in a colander and rinse with cold water to cool. (Reserve pan for the next step.)

Place water and salt in the reserved pan and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
Meanwhile, using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can, then transfer to a cutting board. Roughly chop spinach and place in a small bowl.
Zest lemon into the bowl with the spinach. Cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Peel and mince garlic. Add half to the bowl. (Set remaining garlic aside for later use.)
Place cottage cheese in a colander or strainer and press with the back of a spoon to remove excess liquid. Add to the bowl, along with spices, and stir to combine the topping.
Pat cod dry with paper towels and arrange on one half of a baking sheet pan. Season the top side of the fish with salt and pepper, then spread with spinach topping. Drizzle with oil.
Trim green beans. Add to the other half of the baking sheet, then drizzle with oil. Sprinkle with reserved garlic, salt, and pepper, then stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring the green beans halfway, until fish is almost cooked through and beans are fork-tender, about 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.

When the fish is almost cooked through, remove baking sheet from the oven and sprinkle green beans with Parmesan. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until fish is cooked through and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide couscous, cod, and green beans between plates. Squeeze lemon over top and enjoy!

name: Cod Tikka Masala over Pilau Rice with Cucumber, Tomato & Mint Salad

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water, turmeric, and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring often, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add tomatoes, cream, and sugar to the pan. Stir to combine the tikka masala sauce and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 4-5 minutes more.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: While the sauce is cooking, pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into 2-inch pieces.
When the sauce is done, use a hand blender to purée until smooth. Alternatively, use a potato masher to crush the veggies (the sauce will be chunkier).
Return the sauce to medium-low heat. Add the cod and cook, stirring occasionally, until opaque and flesh flakes with a fork, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the shallot.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumber; add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl along with salt and pepper, then stir to combine the salad.
Divide rice between plates and top with cod tikka masala. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Coriander Beef Meatballs with Blueberry Yogurt Sauce & Spinach Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.

Place beef, bread crumbs, egg, and spices in a medium bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the mixture into meatballs and transfer to the baking sheet.
Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Zest and juice lemon into a small saucepan.

Add blueberries and sugar to the pan with the lemon, then stir to combine the sauce. Set over medium heat and cook, stirring often, until blueberries burst and sauce is thickened, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with spinach, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
When the blueberry sauce has cooled, add yogurt to the pan and stir to combine.
To serve, divide salad and blueberry yogurt sauce between plates. Top sauce with meatballs and enjoy!

name: Coriander Chicken Thighs with Leeks, Snap Peas, Peppers & Cumin Toast

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off the root ends and dark green tops of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces and place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; zest lemon. Add both to the bowl with the leek and set aside. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add chicken and cook until golden, about 2 minutes per side. Once golden, transfer to a clean plate and cover with aluminum foil (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Reserve skillet (with juices) for the next step.

Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leek, garlic, lemon zest, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until the leek starts to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; cut snap peas in half crosswise. Place both in the reserved bowl.
When the leek is soft, add bell pepper, snap peas, and broth to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once simmering, return chicken to the skillet (along with any accumulated juices) and nestle into the veggies. Place skillet on lower rack of the oven and bake until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.

While the chicken is cooking, split buns in half and place on a baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil and season with spices. Place on upper rack of the oven and toast until golden, about 4 minutes. Remove from oven.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: When the chicken is done, remove from oven and juice reserved lemon over top.
To serve, divide chicken, veggies, sauce, and toast between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Coriander-Ginger Tomato Soup with Crispy Chickpeas, Cilantro & Yogurt

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-low heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, coriander, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and pat dry with paper towels.
Add whole (unpeeled) garlic cloves to the baking sheet with the chickpeas. Drizzle with oil, then season with additional coriander and salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring chickpeas halfway through, until crispy and golden, 15-18 minutes.
While the chickpeas are roasting, wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger.

When the onions are golden, add ginger, tomatoes, water, and coconut milk; bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 10 minutes.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in a small bowl.

When the chickpeas and garlic are done, remove from oven. Carefully transfer roasted garlic to the cutting board. Using the back of a spoon, press on the cloves to remove the skins. Set aside the crispy chickpeas.

Add roasted garlic and half of the cilantro to the soup, stir to combine, and remove from heat. Use a hand blender to purée the soup until smooth. Alternatively, use a potato masher to crush the veggies (the soup will be chunkier).
To serve, divide soup between bowls; top with yogurt, crispy chickpeas, and remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Corn Soup with Chicken, Bell Pepper, Avocado & Chili-Garlic Yogurt

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 7-8 minutes. Remove to a plate and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
