Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)

Return the saucepan (with cooking juices) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion, garlic, bell pepper, and jalapeño to the pan; cook, stirring often, until veggies soften, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the veggies cook, juice lime into the reserved bowl. Add yogurt, chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the yogurt sauce and set aside.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; transfer to a plate.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the plate with the green onions.
Add broth, corn, salt, and pepper to the pan. Cover and bring to a boil; once boiling, reduce heat and let simmer for 5 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, using two forks, shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces.

Transfer half the soup to a blender and purée until smooth. Return puréed soup to the pan, add the shredded chicken, and stir to combine. (Alternatively, use a hand blender to partially blend the soup directly in the pan.) Continue to cook, stirring often, until warmed through, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Top each bowl with yogurt sauce, green onions, and avocado. Enjoy!

name: Cottage Cheese Flatbread with Bell Pepper, Tomato, Basil & Hot Honey

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, tomatoes, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and starting to brown, 5-7 minutes.

Meanwhile, arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
While the flatbreads are baking, place cottage cheese in a strainer to remove excess liquid. Transfer to a small bowl, season with salt, and stir to combine. Set aside.
Place honey, hot sauce, and salt in another small bowl. Whisk to combine the hot honey and set aside.
When the veggies are done, add vinegar to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the skillet with the veggies and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Spread the cottage cheese over each flatbread, then top with veggies.
To serve, cut flatbreads into wedges and divide between plates. Drizzle with hot honey and top with reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Cottage Cheese Toasts with Hot Honey-Butternut Squash & Kale Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until squash is golden and fork-tender, about 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, place cottage cheese in a strainer to remove excess liquid. Transfer to a small bowl, season with salt, and stir to combine. Set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the Parmesan. Add oil, honey, salt, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing and, using your hands, massage kale until wilted, 1-2 minutes. Set aside.
When the squash is done, remove from the oven, then drizzle with honey and hot sauce. Stir to coat and set aside to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Change oven to broil on high.
Arrange bread on another baking sheet. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.
Spread the cottage cheese over each piece of toast, then top with hot honey squash.
To serve, divide cheesy toasts and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Couscous Greek Salad with Spring Greens & Feta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Mince olives and transfer to a large bowl.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the olives.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl along with oil, vinegar, honey, and salt; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings. Add to the bowl and toss to combine.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Seed and slice bell pepper into thin strips; add to the bowl.
Once the couscous is done, transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer to cool.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems, mince leaves, and add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse chickpeas; add to the bowl.
Add couscous and feta to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide mixed greens between bowls. Top with couscous salad and enjoy!

name: Couscous-Romaine Salad with Warm Peaches, Almonds, Feta & Dill

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring water and salt to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil, Dijon, sugar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and small dice cucumber. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl and set the salad aside. (Reserve remaining dill for serving.)
When the couscous is done, transfer to a baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool slightly.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into ½-inch thick wedges.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, roughly chop almonds.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peaches, almonds, sugar, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until peaches are golden brown and fork-tender, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add cooled couscous to the bowl with the salad and gently toss to combine.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with warm peaches, almonds, feta, and reserved dill. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Cream of Chickpea Soup with Toasted Rosemary Pita

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the saucepan heats up, peel and mince garlic. Place half in a small bowl and set aside.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add veggies, remaining garlic, and spices to the saucepan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are soft, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas; transfer to a blender, along with broth, and blend until smooth.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Trim and medium dice zucchini.
Add chickpea mixture and zucchini to the saucepan, stir to combine, and bring soup to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high.
Place pitas on a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with reserved garlic, salt, and rosemary. Place in the oven and broil until golden and toasted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Cut pitas into quarters.
Divide soup between bowls and drizzle with oil. Serve with pita on the side and enjoy!

name: Cream of Fennel Soup with Potato, Leek, Celery & Pumpkin Seeds

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim off root end and dark green stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the leek.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice potato.

When the veggies are soft, add potato and broth to the pan. Stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the soup is boiling, reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender, 12-15 minutes.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: When the potatoes are tender, using a hand blender, purée the soup until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pan.)
Add cream to the pan and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until just warmed through, 1 minute more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide soup between bowls. Top with pumpkin seeds and enjoy!

name: Cream of Mushroom Soup with Leeks, Croutons, Chives & Broccoli Slaw

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, cut bread into 1-inch cubes.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread cubes and cook, stirring occasionally, until croutons are golden and toasted, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl, then season with salt and pepper. (Reserve pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the leeks.

Return pan to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leeks, mushrooms, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and mushrooms release their liquid, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
When the veggies are soft, add flour to the pan. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.

Add broth to the pan, stir to combine the soup, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are very tender 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, chop chives into small pieces. Place half in the reserved bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
Add broccoli slaw to the bowl with dressing, then stir to combine. Set aside.
When the mushrooms are tender, using a hand blender, purée the soup until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pan.)
Add cream to the pan. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until soup is warmed through, 1 minute more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Divide soup between bowls; top with croutons and reserved chives. Serve with slaw on the side and enjoy!

name: Creamy Avocado Fettuccine with Corn & Cherry Tomatoes

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Add the frozen corn within the last 4 minutes of cooking. When the pasta and corn are finished, drain, return to pot, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Pick basil leaves off the stems and place in the blender. Reserve several leaves for garnish.
Juice the lemon into the blender.
Halve avocado and remove pit; scoop the flesh into the blender.
Peel the garlic and add to the blender.
Finely grate Parmesan and add to the blender along with the olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Blend the ingredients until smooth, 30-60 seconds.
Add the sauce from the blender into the pot with the pasta and corn; stir to combine.
Halve the grape tomatoes and add to the pasta, stir once more to combine.
Divide the pasta mixture between bowls, garnish with reserved basil, and enjoy!

name: Creamy Avocado-Shrimp Wrap with Tomato, Cucumber & Basil Salad

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are just opaque, 2-3 minutes. Remove to a plate and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lime, then divide between two medium bowls. Set one bowl aside for the shrimp salad.
Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to the remaining bowl with the lime. Whisk to combine the salad dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Add mayo and spices to the reserved bowl with the lime. Whisk to combine the creamy dressing.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice. Add to the bowl with the creamy dressing.
Roughly chop cooled shrimp, add to the bowl, and stir to combine the shrimp salad.
Place tortillas on a flat surface, divide shrimp salad between them, then top with sprouts. Roll tightly to close and cut in half.
To serve, divide wraps and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Bacon Cheddar Baked Cauliflower

instructions.text: Wash cauliflower and cut off the leaves. Separate into small florets and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces; transfer to the saucepan. Add approx, 1-inch of water in the pan, cover and bring to a boil over high heat; steam until fork-tender, 8-10 minutes.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Chop the bacon into 1-inch pieces. Add to the skillet and cook until crispy, stirring occasionally 3-5 minutes.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
Coarsely grate the cheddar.

When the cauliflower is cooked, drain water and set aside, uncovered, to allow moisture to evaporate for 1-2 minutes. When most of the moisture has evaporated, mash cauliflower until it resembles the consistency of mashed potatoes.
Add the butter, yogurt, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Add the cauliflower mixture to an ovenproof baking dish or individual ramekins, top with cheese and place under the broiler until cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes.
Wash and trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Carefully remove the cauliflower from oven and top with crispy bacon and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Beet, Potato & Apple Soup with Crispy Prosciutto

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice beets and carrot. Place both in a medium bowl.
Peel and small dice potatoes. Add to the bowl with the beets and carrot.
Quarter, core, and small dice apple. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl (reserve remaining parsley for garnish).
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, apple, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
When the veggies are soft, add broth and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook until veggies are very tender, 10-12 minutes more.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add the prosciutto and cook until crispy, about 1 minute per side. Remove prosciutto to a plate and set aside.
When the soup is done, remove from heat and add cream. Use a hand blender to purée the soup until smooth. Alternatively, use a potato masher to crush the veggies (the soup will be chunkier).
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Crumble or chop prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide soup between bowls; top with crispy prosciutto and reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Bell Pepper, Jalapeño, Onion & Corn Sauté with Warm Tortillas

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers. Cut into ½-inch thick strips and transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Wash, dry, and halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Slice into thin strips and add to the baking sheet with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Drizzle the mixed peppers with oil and season with spices; toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, tossing halfway, until peppers are soft and begin to brown, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place corn in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw; set aside to drain.
Cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Add cream cheese, yogurt, cream, and broth to the skillet with the onion; cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce is smooth, 1-2 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream
4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: When the peppers are done, add them to the skillet along with the corn; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide creamy veggie sauté between bowls; serve with warm tortillas on the side for dipping. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Black Bean, Kale & Bell Pepper Stuffed Acorn Squash

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve acorn squash lengthwise, trim ends, then scoop out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil, then season with salt and pepper; arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the kale.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add kale, bell pepper, and garlic to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring often, until the veggies are tender, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans.
Cut cream cheese into small pieces.

When the veggies are done, add beans, cream cheese, broth, and spices to the skillet; stir until cheese is melted and combined. Bring to a simmer and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, divide squash halves between plates, stuff with filling, and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Black Bean Wraps with Sautéed Bell Peppers & Mango-Cabbage Slaw

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a medium bowl and half in a blender.
Juice half of the lime into the bowl with the cilantro; juice remaining lime into the blender and set aside.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the cilantro. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and cumin; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter the cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and add to the bowl. Stir to combine the slaw and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim, seed, and thinly slice bell pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add bell pepper and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; add to the blender with the cilantro and lime juice.
Peel garlic; add to the blender along with water, pumpkin seeds, and spices. Blend on high until smooth.
Place tortillas on a flat surface and spread each with an even layer of black bean spread. Top with bell peppers and a small portion of slaw (reserving the rest for serving); roll tightly to close.
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates; serve with remaining slaw on the side and enjoy!

name: Creamy Buffalo Chicken Rotini Pasta with Carrot, Bell Pepper & Celery

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ¼-cup pasta water before draining.)
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.
Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Add parsley (reserving a small handful for serving), cream cheese, and hot sauce to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until cream cheese melts, 2-3 minutes.

Add cooked pasta, reserved pasta cooking water, and chicken to the skillet; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until the pasta and chicken are warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Top with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Creamy Cajun Chicken with Bell Pepper & Kale Sauté

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add chicken to the skillet and pan-fry, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
While the chicken cooks, using a clean cutting board, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a medium bowl; set aside.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips.
Once the chicken is done, remove to a plate and cover with foil. Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add peppers to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add tomatoes, broth, and spices to the skillet. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Once simmering, reduce heat to medium. Add cream cheese, a few pieces at a time, and stir until melted and combined, 2-3 minutes.
Add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Return chicken to the skillet and turn to coat in the sauce. Continue to cook, until heated through, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Cajun Orzo Pasta with Butternut Squash, Mushrooms & Bell Pepper

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and small dice. Add to the baking sheet with the bell pepper.
Quarter mushrooms and add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with oil, then sprinkle with Cajun seasoning and salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until veggies soften, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.

Add broth, orzo, and spices to the skillet with the onion; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside a small handful for serving.
Add roasted veggies, remaining parsley, and cream to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until thickened, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide orzo between plates or bowls. Top with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Creamy Cajun-Style Shrimp Scampi with Bell Pepper & Spaghetti Squash

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim squash, halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of each half with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into thin pieces. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the other veggies and set aside.
About 10 minutes before the squash is done, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Add shrimp to the skillet and cook, stirring often, until just cooked through, about 3 minutes.
Add parsley and cream to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until simmering, 1 minute more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Remove squash from the oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand.)
To serve, divide squash, shrimp, veggies, and sauce between plates. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Cashew Zucchini Noodles with Vegan Sausage, Artichoke & Spinach

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Boil water in a kettle. (If you do not have a kettle, boil water in a small saucepan, starting with hot water from the tap.) In a small heat-safe bowl, pour boiling water over cashews and set aside to soak.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes (or cook sausages according to package instructions). Remove to a plate and cover with foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
While the sausages are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles; place in a medium bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts; add to the bowl with the zucchini and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic.
Return skillet to medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add zucchini, artichokes, and spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the veggies to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain cashews and place in a blender.
Juice lemon into the blender with the cashews. Add broth, nutritional yeast, flour, and spices to the blender; purée on high until the sauce is smooth.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Cut sausages crosswise into 1-inch pieces.
Add sauce and sausage to the skillet; stir to combine with the veggies. Continue to cook, stirring often, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide veggies, sauce, and sausage between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Cheddar-Tuna Pasta with Sautéed Broccoli & Zucchini

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and transfer to a small bowl, reserving saucepan for later use.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in another small bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl with the broccoli.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add broccoli, zucchini, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring often, until veggies are tender-crisp, 6-7 minutes. Cover, remove from heat, and set aside.
Meanwhile, cut cream cheese into small pieces; coarsely grate cheddar.

Once the pasta has been drained, place both cheeses, milk, salt, and paprika in the reserved saucepan. Set over medium heat and bring the mixture to a simmer, whisking frequently, until cheeses melt and combine, 2-3 minutes.
Drain tuna and flake with a fork; add to the cheese sauce along with the cooked pasta. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: To serve, divide pasta and veggies between plates or bowls. Top pasta with crushed red pepper and enjoy!

name: Creamy Chicken, Apple & Almond Salad in Lettuce Cups

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the chicken in the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside to cool.
While the chicken cooks, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the lemon into a large bowl, then add the mayonnaise, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Cut the apple into 4 wedges lengthwise, core, and medium dice; add to the bowl.
Trim and discard the ends of the celery; medium dice and add to the bowl.
Trim and discard the ends of the green onions; chop on and angle into ¼-inch pieces and add to the bowl.
Measure out the sliced almonds and add to the bowl.
Separate the lettuce leaves and arrange into two-leaf stacks. Alternatively, you can chop the lettuce.
Once the chicken has cooled, pull apart with your hands or medium dice; add to the bowl. Mix the salad until well combined.
Spoon the chicken salad onto the leaf stacks and divide between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container). Alternatively, arrange the chopped lettuce on plates and top with the salad. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Chicken & Mushroom Soup with Rice

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 20 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice onion. Transfer both to a large bowl.
Slice mushrooms and add to the bowl.
Peel and slice carrots into thin rounds. Trim and small dice celery. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add veggies to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, medium dice chicken and season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard stems.
Add chicken and thyme to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, 3-4 minutes.
Add flour to the pan and stir to coat the vegetables and chicken. Cook, stirring frequently, about 1 minute.
Add broth, milk, rice, and salt to the pan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until rice is soft and chicken is cooked through, 10-15 minutes.
amounts: 20 fl oz (2 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!

name: Creamy Coconut Noodles with Tofu, Bok Choy, Bell Pepper & Lime

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the water in the pan is boiling, remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse under cold water; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim bok choy and cut crosswise into 1-inch strips; place in a medium bowl.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the bok choy.
Trim, halve, seed, and thinly slice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince ginger and garlic; add to the bowl with the veggies.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Add coconut milk, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook until sauce thickens slightly, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Meanwhile, medium dice tofu.
Add noodles and tofu to the skillet; gently toss to combine. Continue to cook until heated through, 2-3 minutes.
Juice lime into the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide creamy noodles, tofu, and veggies between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Coriander Chicken, Bell Pepper & Celery Sauté with Red Lentils

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add chicken and sauté until cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer chicken to a plate, cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
While the chicken is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring often, until veggies begin to soften, 4-5 minutes.
Add tomatoes and broth to the skillet. Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 6-7 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return chicken to the skillet, stir to combine, and simmer until heated through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in cream.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide lentils and chicken sauté between bowls. Garnish with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Creamy Coriander Chicken "Enchilada" Skillet with Spinach & Mushrooms

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a small saucepan over medium-high heat. Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add flour and cook, whisking constantly, until lightly golden, about 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in broth, salt, and coriander. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove sauce from heat and set aside.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Medium dice tomato; thinly slice mushrooms. Place both in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the veggies and set aside.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies, chicken, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies have softened and chicken is cooked through, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate mozzarella.
Add yogurt to the pan with the sauce and whisk until smooth.
Using a clean cutting board, slice tortillas into 2-inch long strips. When the chicken is done, add tortillas and sauce to the skillet; stir to combine.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
Top skillet with cheese and place in the oven; broil until the cheese is melted and bubbly, 3-5 minutes.
To serve, divide "enchilada" skillet between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Creamy Corn Chowder with Potatoes & Bell Pepper

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off the root ends and dark green tops of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice into ¼-inch thick pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Place half in the bowl with the leeks (reserve the rest for garnish).
Seed and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Small dice potatoes and add to the bowl.
Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add bowl of prepared veggies and corn to the pot. Cook, stirring frequently, until vegetables soften, 4-5 minutes.

Add flour to the pot, stir to coat vegetables, then pour in the broth. Season with spices and bring to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender and chowder has thickened, 10-12 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add cream and, using a potato masher, gently crush some of the potatoes to further thicken the soup.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Top with reserved green onions and enjoy!

name: Creamy Corn Fettuccini with Seared Scallops, Tomatoes & Basil Pesto

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add pasta and salt, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl along with oil, salt, and crushed red pepper; whisk to combine.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Finely chop pine nuts and add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the pesto. Set aside.
Remove husks and silks from corn. Using your hands, snap each ear in half. Working over a medium bowl, coarsely grate corn off of the cob, catching all of the kernels and juices in the bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl with the corn. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; rub with oil and season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add scallops in a single layer; cook until they develop a nice sear and are opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with foil.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse in a colander.

Return the large pot to the stove over medium heat. Add grated corn, tomatoes, and any juices left in the bowl, along with water, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the corn thickens and becomes fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add pasta and half of the pesto to the pot; toss to coat. Continue to cook until warmed through, 1 minute more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta and scallops between bowls or plates. Top with remaining pesto and enjoy!

name: Creamy Corn Pasta Salad with Cucumber, Basil, Chives & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a large bowl.
Add mayo, feta, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine the dressing.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Trim and small dice cucumber; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl.
Chop chives into small pieces; add to the bowl.
Add corn to the pot with the pasta during the last 3 minutes of cooking.
When the pasta and corn are done, drain and rinse under cold water; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between bowls and enjoy!

name: Creamy Dijon Chicken Skillet with Spinach, Leek & Potatoes

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Quarter new potatoes and place in a medium bowl.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces and add to the bowl with the potatoes. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels, then season both sides with spices.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook until golden, about 2 minutes per side (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer chicken to a plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the potato and leek.

Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add potato, leek, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until leeks are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Add broth to the skillet and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook until the potatoes are just tender, 10-12 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Uncover skillet, then add spinach in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine.

Return chicken (with any accumulated juices) to the skillet, along with cream and Dijon. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Continue to cook until sauce thickens slightly and chicken is cooked through, 5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide creamy chicken skillet between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Dijon Kale-Peach Salad with Walnuts, Goat Cheese & Bread Crumbs

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, roughly chop walnuts.
Once the skillet is hot, add walnuts and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)

Return skillet to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and cook, stirring frequently, until golden and crispy, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to the bowl with the walnuts and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, Dijon, oil, water, honey, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.

Wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Wash, dry, and quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pit. Medium dice the flesh and add to the bowl with the kale.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl and gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls; top with walnuts and crispy bread crumbs. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Dill Chickpea Salad Sandwich with Strawberries

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Drain and rinse the chickpeas; transfer to a medium bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add mayo, Dijon, vinegar, and spices to the bowl.
Use a fork or potato masher to crush the chickpeas, making a semi-smooth spread. Set aside.
Peel, trim, and julienne or coarsely grate the carrot.
Slice the tomato.
Place bread slices on a flat surface. Spread half of the slices with a thick layer of chickpea salad and top carrots, tomato, and spring mix. Cover sandwiches with remaining bread slices.
Slice strawberries in half.
To serve, divide sandwiches and strawberries between plates and enjoy!

name: Creamy Dill Pasta with Seared Scallops & Zucchini

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim zucchini. Halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half-moons.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add zucchini and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until zucchini starts to soften, about 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Add to the skillet with the zucchini and continue to cook, stirring often, until soft, about 1 minute.

Add broth and cream to the skillet. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens slightly, 2 minutes more. Transfer zucchini and sauce to a medium bowl and cover with foil. Set aside.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wipe skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; rub with oil and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add scallops in a single layer; cook until they develop a nice sear and are opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry dill. Shave leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Once the pasta is done, drain and return to the pan. Add dill, zucchini, and sauce to the pan; toss to combine.
Return pan to medium heat to warm through, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide pasta and scallops between plates. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Feta, Chickpea, Tomato & Peach Toasts with Warm Spinach Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil and spices; stir to combine the marinade.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl with the marinade.
Quarter peach lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pit. Medium dice the flesh and add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the chickpea mixture.

Transfer the chickpea mixture to a baking sheet pan, then spread out in an even layer. Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until tomatoes are soft and chickpeas are golden, 12-15 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, place feta, water, and oil in a small bowl. Mash with a fork until semi-smooth and combined; set aside.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place in the reserved bowl, along with the spinach, and set aside.
Split rolls in half and arrange, cut-side facing up, on another baking sheet. Add rolls to the oven and toast until golden, about 4 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the chickpeas are done, remove from oven and let cool slightly, 3 minutes.
Transfer ⅔ of the chickpea mixture to the bowl with the basil and spinach. Add vinegar and toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining chickpea mixture for the next step.)
Spread toasts with the creamy feta, then top with remaining chickpea mixture.
To serve, divide salad and toasts between plates; drizzle toasts with additional vinegar. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Garlic-Parmesan Tuna Pasta & Peas

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add garlic to the pan and stir until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add peas and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until peas are heated through, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Add cream to the pan with the peas and bring to a simmer. Once pasta is done, drain and add to the pan along with the Parmesan.
Drain tuna, add to the pan, and gently stir to combine.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: To serve, divide pasta between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Goat Cheese Linguine with Tomatoes, Spinach, Onion & Garlic

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve ½-cup of pasta cooking water before draining.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice onion.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the garlic and onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion begins to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and small dice tomatoes.
Add tomatoes, salt, and pepper to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring often, until tomatoes begin to soften, 3-4 minutes.
While the tomatoes are cooking, wash, dry, and roughly chop the spinach (skip washing if the spinach came pre-washed).
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Crumble goat cheese into the skillet; add cream and stir to combine. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring often, until the sauce is melted and combined, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Add drained pasta to the skillet and toss to combine; add reserved pasta water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency.
To serve, divide pasta between bowls and enjoy!

name: Creamy Green Pea Soup with Carrot, Celery, Cilantro & Smoky Tofu

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 5-7 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place cornstarch, soy sauce, maple syrup, smoked paprika, and salt in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Large dice tofu. Add to bowl with marinade and toss to coat.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu (leaving any excess marinade in the bowl) and pan-fry, turning occasionally, until browned and crispy, 7-8 minutes. Wipe bowl clean with paper towels, then return cooked tofu to the bowl.

While the tofu is cooking, add broth and peas to the pan with the veggies; stir to combine the soup and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are very tender, about 5 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the soup is done, use a potato masher to crush the veggies. Alternatively, use a blender if you prefer a smoother soup. Add cilantro (reserving a small handful for serving), cream, and soy sauce, then stir to combine. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide soup between bowls; top with the smoky tofu and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Herbed Pumpkin Pasta with Garlic Green Beans

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Wash the green beans and trim ends.
Add water to a large skillet and bring to a boil, covered, over high heat.

Once the water is boiling, uncover and stir in the beans, oil, butter, and half the garlic. Simmer until beans are tender and water has evaporated, 4-5 minutes. Season with salt, then remove from heat and set aside.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add remaining garlic to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, then add the tomato paste and cook for an additional 30 seconds, stirring frequently.
Add the pumpkin, milk, and spices to the saucepan. Whisk to combine and let simmer for 2-3 minutes.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Grate the parmesan.
Add the parmesan cheese (reserving a small amount for garnish) and red pepper flakes to the saucepan; stir to combine. Remove from the heat and set aside.
Once the pasta is done, drain and return to the large pot. Pour the sauce into the pot with the pasta and stir to combine.
To serve, divide the pasta and green beans between plates. Top pasta with remaining Parmesan and enjoy!

name: Creamy Italian-Style Sausage & Mixed Vegetable Soup with Basil

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until brown and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer sausage to a small bowl. (Reserve pan with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice carrot; place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl with the carrot.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
When the sausage is done, return the pan (with drippings) to medium heat. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
Add broth and tomatoes to the pan; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the soup is boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are soft, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the soup is done, add half of the basil to the pan (reserving the rest for garnish). Purée with an immersion or regular blender (return soup to the pan if using a regular blender).
Add cooked sausage to the soup along with cream, salt, and pepper. Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Leek & Bacon Pasta with Goat Cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Cut the bacon crosswise into ¼-inch-thick strips.

When the water in the saucepan comes to a boil, uncover the pan and season the water with salt, then add the pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook the pasta, uncovered, for 11 to 12 minutes (or according to package directions). Drain the pasta in a colander, reserving ½ cup of the cooking water.
Add the bacon to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but not crispy, 2 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a bowl, leaving the drippings in the skillet.
While the bacon cooks, trim off and discard the ends of the leeks; thinly slice the leeks crosswise.
Once the bacon has been transferred, add the leeks to the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 6 to 8 minutes.
Finely grate 1 cup of Parmesan and transfer to a small bowl.

Add the pasta, bacon, goat cheese, ¾ of the Parmesan (save the rest for garnishing) and reserved cooking water to the skillet; cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture is smooth and thoroughly combined, 1 to 2 minutes.
To serve, divide the pasta between bowls, sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan, and garnish with black pepper. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Leek, Bacon, Tomato & Cucumber Sandwich with Dressed Arugula

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, turning occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)

Meanwhile, trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into thin pieces.

When the bacon is done, return the skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add leek and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly, 2-3 minutes.
While the leek is cooking, slice tomato crosswise into thin rounds. Place on a plate.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the plate with the tomato and set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan. Place in a medium bowl along with yogurt, vinegar, honey, and Dijon, then stir to combine the yogurt dressing.
Once the leeks have cooled, add to the bowl with the yogurt dressing. Stir to combine the leek spread and set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Toast bread if desired.

Place bread on a flat surface. Divide leek spread between half of the slices and spread out in an even layer. Top spread with tomato, cucumber, bacon, and a small handful of the arugula, then close sandwiches with remaining slices of bread. Cut in half. (Reserve remaining arugula for serving.)
To serve, divide sandwiches and reserved arugula between plates. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Leek, Prosciutto & Pea Linguine with Parmesan

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve 1 cup of pasta cooking water before draining.)

Meanwhile, trim off the root end and dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ½-inch half-moons.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leeks and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until leeks are soft, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut the cream cheese into small pieces and set aside.
Roughly chop prosciutto into bite-sized pieces. Once the leeks have softened, add prosciutto to the skillet, and cook, stirring often, until slightly crispy, 1-2 minutes.
Add cream cheese, peas, and a ½-cup of the pasta cooking water to the skillet. Reduce heat to low, and continue to cook, stirring often, until cream cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes.
Finely grate Parmesan and add to the skillet (reserving a small handful for garnish); stir to combine.
Add drained pasta to the skillet and toss to combine; add additional pasta water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency.
To serve, divide pasta between bowls and garnish with remaining Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Lemon Dill Shrimp with Butter Lettuce-Radish Salad & Bread

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Slowly add cream to the pan, stirring constantly. Bring to a simmer, then lower heat and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, about 5 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the sauce has thickened, juice lemon into the pan. Add dill, stir to combine, and remove from heat. Cover to keep warm.
Peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Add sauce to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Meanwhile, toast bread if desired, then cut in half.
Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl with the lettuce and gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad, shrimp, and bread between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Linguine with Crispy Prosciutto, Squash, Fennel & Parmesan

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice.

Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt, squash, and pasta, then stir for a few seconds. Cook until squash is tender and pasta is desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ¼-cup cooking water before draining and set aside.)
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add prosciutto and cook until crispy, about 1 minute per side. Remove to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Return skillet to medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fennel and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and starting to brown, 5-6 minutes.
While the fennel is cooking, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the parsley.

When the fennel is done, add cooked squash, pasta, reserved pasta water, parsley, Parmesan, and cream to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until water has evaporated and Parmesan has melted, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Meanwhile, crumble or chop prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and top with crispy prosciutto. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Mushroom Bacon Soup with Pear & Mixed Greens Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and slice the mushrooms.
Peel and small dice the onion. Peel and mince the garlic.
Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the mushrooms, onion, and garlic. Season with thyme, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 5-6 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Chop the bacon into smaller pieces. Add to the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-4 minutes.
Sprinkle arrowroot over the mushrooms and stir to coat.
Pour in the broth and cream. Stir well and bring the soup to a simmer. Cook until thickened, 1-2 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the greens.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash, core, and thinly slice the pear.
Purée the soup with an immersion (hand) blender or regular blender if desired. Otherwise, leave as is.
Arrange a bed of greens on a plate, top with pear slices, and drizzle with olive oil. Pour soup into a bowl and sprinkle with bacon. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Mushroom Chicken Over Roasted Spaghetti Squash

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place the rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off and discard ends of the squash; halve squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds from each half. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange the squash halves cut-side-down on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add flour to a plate. Dredge the chicken cutlets in flour, shake off excess, and add to the skillet. Pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, slice the mushrooms. Peel and mince garlic.
Return the skillet (with leftover oil from cooking) to medium heat. Add mushrooms, garlic, Italian seasoning, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Add flour to the skillet and stir to coat mushrooms. Pour in broth, milk, and Dijon. Return chicken to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Remove skillet from the heat. Juice lemon into the skillet and add half of the parsley (reserving the rest for garnish); stir to combine.

Remove squash from the oven; allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand.)
To serve, divide spaghetti squash between bowls. Top with chicken and mushroom sauce. Garnish with remaining parsley and enjoy!

name: Creamy Paprika Chicken (Paprikash) with Pasta & Dressed Greens

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine the spice mix.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and medium dice. Season chicken with half the spice mix. (Set aside remaining spice mix for the sauce.)
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and stir-fry until cooked through and golden brown, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince onion and garlic.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Sprinkle remaining spice mix over onion and garlic, stir to coat, and continue to cook until fragrant, 1 minute more.
Add tomatoes and sugar to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer.
Return chicken to the skillet, stir to combine, and simmer until heated through, about 2 minutes.
Add yogurt to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Once the pasta is done, drain in a colander.
Wash spring mix (skip this step if it came pre-washed) and add to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: To serve, divide pasta, paprika chicken, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Parmesan Turkey Skillet with Spinach, Tomato & Basil

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic and shallot.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, shallot, turkey, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until almost cooked through, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve grape tomatoes.

When the turkey is almost cooked through, add tomatoes and spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until turkey is cooked through and tomatoes are softened, 4-5 minutes more.
