Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in a small bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the Parmesan and stir to combine.

Add half of the Parmesan-basil mixture to the skillet, along with the cream (reserving the rest for serving). Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until thickened slightly, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide skillet between plates or bowls, then top with reserved Parmesan and basil. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Portobello Mushroom Soup with Lemony Arugula & Garlic Bread

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off the root end and the dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ½-inch half-moons.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the leek and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 3 minutes.
Halve mushrooms then cut crosswise into thin strips. Add to the pan with the leeks.
Add flour to the pan; cook, stirring constantly, until combined, about 1 minute.
Gradually stir milk into the pan, then add the broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes, or until mushrooms are tender.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) whole milk
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing. Add arugula and toss to combine; set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a small bowl. Add butter and mash with the back of a spoon until soft.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the butter along with spices; mash with the back of a spoon to combine.

Slice roll in half and place on a baking sheet pan, cut-side up. Spread with garlic butter and sprinkle with parsley. Place in the oven and cook until golden around the edges, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the oven and cut in half.
Meanwhile, using an immersion (hand) or regular blender, purée the soup until almost smooth, leaving some flecks for texture.
Divide soup between bowls; serve with lemony arugula and garlic bread on the side. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Prawn & Cod Stew with Fresh Herbed Tomatoes

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and chop the potatoes into quarters.
Add flour and spices to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Gradually add broth, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add potatoes and bring the soup to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut the cod into 1-inch pieces. Add cod to the pan, cover, and simmer 5 more minutes.
Wash and small dice tomatoes; place in a small bowl.
Add shrimp to the saucepan, cover, and cook until cod is opaque and shrimp is pink, 5-6 minutes.

Meanwhile, wash and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves; add to the bowl with the tomatoes. Wash and juice lemon into the bowl, add oil and stir to combine. Set aside.
Add milk to the saucepan, stir to combine, and cook until heated through, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with tomato-parsley mixture. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Pumpkin & Arugula Pasta with Chicken & Rosemary

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Finely grate ½ cup of Parmesan and transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season the cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the chicken cutlets in the skillet; cook until they are golden brown on the outside and cooked through in the center, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm. Cook in batches if necessary.

When the water in the saucepan comes to a boil, uncover the pan and season the water with salt, then add the pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook the pasta, uncovered, for 11 to 12 minutes (or according to package directions). Drain the pasta in a colander.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Once the chicken has been transferred, reduce the heat to medium and add more oil to the skillet.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the rosemary sprigs to the skillet and cook until they start to turn brown, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate, leaving the oil in the skillet.
Once the rosemary has been transferred, add the pumpkin purée, garlic, and crushed red pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring, until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Add the cream, broth, and Parmesan to the skillet. Cook, stirring until the mixture is well combined, 1 to 2 minutes, then remove from the heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add the pasta and arugula to the skillet; stir until the pasta is thoroughly coated with the sauce.
One by one, holding a sprig of rosemary at its top, run your fingers down it to remove the leaves. Discard the sprigs and chop the fried leaves; transfer to a small bowl.
Place the chicken on a cutting board and cut on the diagonal into strips.
To serve, divide the pasta between dishes, top with the chicken slices, and garnish with the fried rosemary leaves. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Pumpkin-Parmesan Chicken with Spinach & Crispy Sage

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash, dry, and pick sage leaves off the stems; discard stems.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sage leaves in single layer and cook until crispy, about 30 seconds. Using tongs or a slotted spoon, transfer crispy sage to a paper towel-lined plate and season with salt. (Reserve skillet with oil for later use.)

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Return skillet to medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add chicken and pan-fry, without turning, until golden underneath, 5-6 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with sage oil for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic.
Finely grate Parmesan.
Return skillet with sage oil to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and tomato paste; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add Parmesan, pumpkin, broth, cream, and salt to the skillet, then stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée
4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Wash, dry, and add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Return chicken to the skillet and nestle into the sauce; cover with a lid. Cook, turning chicken occasionally, until cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chicken and sauce between plates or bowls. Top with crispy sage and enjoy!

name: Creamy Pumpkin, Pork & Apple Skillet with Cranberry Mixed Green Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and cook until golden, about 2 minutes per side (they will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer to a clean plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, quarter, and core apples; slice into ¼-inch thick wedges. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the apple.

Return the skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add apple, onion, garlic, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the apple and onion are cooking, place pumpkin, broth, and cream in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée
4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: When the apple and onion are soft, add pumpkin mixture to the skillet and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly, 2-3 minutes more.
Return pork to the skillet and use a spoon to coat in sauce; reduce heat to medium-low and cover with a lid. Simmer until pork is cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with cranberries, and toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Divide pork, apples, and sauce between plates or bowls. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Creamy Pumpkin Soup with Pork Sausage, Leek, Carrot & Kale

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and medium dice carrots. Place in a medium bowl.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Thinly slice crosswise, then add to the bowl with the carrot.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, sausage, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.

Add broth, milk, and pumpkin to the pan; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are tender and soup is slightly thickened, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.

When the soup has thickened, add kale to the pan in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until kale is tender, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!

name: Creamy Red Lentil Soup with Parsnip, Carrot, Lime & Cilantro

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and medium dice parsnips and carrots. Place both in a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the ginger and garlic. (Set remaining cilantro aside for serving.)
When the veggies are soft, add ginger, garlic, and cilantro to the pan. Cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.

Add lentils and broth to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies and lentils are tender, 10-12 minutes.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a hand blender, purée the soup until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pan.)
Juice lime into the pan, add cream, and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Sausage, Spinach & Cauliflower Soup

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of the sausages. Peel off casings and discard.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and cook, breaking up with a spoon, until sausage is browned, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until onion has softened, 2-3 minutes.
Wash the cauliflower, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stems. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower.
Add cauliflower and broth to the pot; stir, cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes more.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Wash spinach (unless it came pre-washed) and add to the pot.
Add cream, salt, pepper, and most of the Parmesan (reserve a small amount for garnish). Heat to a simmer, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide the soup between bowls and garnish with the remaining Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Scallop Orzo Pasta with Zucchini, Bell Pepper & Jalapeño

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ¼-cup pasta water before draining.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and small dice zucchini. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat the scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
When the veggies are done, add scallops and cream to the skillet, then gently stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until scallops are opaque, about 5 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Add cooked orzo to the skillet and stir to combine. Add reserved pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency. Continue to cook until orzo is warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide the creamy scallop and pasta sauté between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Sesame-Ginger Spaghetti Squash with Shrimp & Edamame

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash, dry, and trim spaghetti squash, then halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl along with tahini, water, oil, vinegar, soy sauce, and maple syrup. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: When the squash has about 5 minutes left, preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are just opaque, 2-3 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Set skillet aside for later use.)
Meanwhile, place edamame in a clean colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Remove squash from the oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands (use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand).
Return skillet to medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add sesame-ginger sauce, spaghetti squash, and edamame. Cook, tossing occasionally, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide spaghetti squash, shrimp, and edamame between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Shrimp Salad with Cucumber, Tomato, Dill, Pine Nuts & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Zest and juice half the lemon into a medium saucepan (zest and juice remaining lemon into a medium bowl and set aside).
Add water, vinegar, and salt to the pan with the lemon zest and juice. Cover the pan and bring the liquid to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid in the saucepan is boiling, uncover, add shrimp, and stir for a few seconds. Remove from heat, and let sit until cooked through, about 3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer shrimp to another medium bowl and place in the refrigerator to cool, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon zest and juice.
Add cream, salt, and pepper to the bowl and whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then thinly slice into half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Remove shrimp from the refrigerator and add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies; stir to combine the shrimp salad and set aside.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide lettuce between plates or bowls and drizzle with oil. Top with shrimp salad, pine nuts, and feta. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Creamy Shrimp, Spinach & Bacon over Parmesan Cauliflower "Grits"

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 3-4 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate (leaving the drippings in the skillet). Set skillet aside for later use.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan and set aside.

Using a clean cutting board, cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate cauliflower and place in a medium saucepan.

Add hot water (from the tap) to the pan with the cauliflower, filling it about halfway; cover and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once the water is boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until the cauliflower is tender, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic.
Return the skillet (with bacon drippings) to medium-low heat. Once the skillet is hot, add garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add cream, shrimp, and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the shrimp is just opaque, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: When the cauliflower is done, drain in a strainer and return to the pan. Add Parmesan, butter, salt, and pepper. Using a potato masher, gently mash the cauliflower into a "grits" consistency; cover and set aside.

When the shrimp is done, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Juice lemon into the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower "grits" and creamy shrimp between bowls; top with bacon and enjoy!

name: Creamy Shrimp & Veggie Soup with Parmesan Crisps

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper and set aside.
If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Set aside to drain.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash, dry, peel, and small dice carrot. Peel and small dice onion; transfer both to a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and small dice celery; add to the bowl with the veggies.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and thyme to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate cheese. To make the crisps, measure out 1 tbsp of grated cheese and place in a pile on the baking sheet. Repeat with remaining cheese, keeping the piles a few inches apart.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until cheese is lightly browned and crisp, 5-7 minutes. (Watch carefully because they can burn quickly.) Once done, remove from the oven and set aside to cool.

While the crisps are cooking, add broth, salt, and pepper to the pan with the veggies. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to a simmer; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, about 5 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, roughly chop the shrimp; add to the soup and continue to simmer until cooked through, about 3 minutes.
Cut cream cheese into small pieces and add to the pan; continue to cook, stirring constantly, until the cheese is melted and combined, about 3 minutes.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with cheese crisps on the side. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Soba Noodle Bowl with Rainbow Veggies

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with water and bring to a boil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger; transfer to a medium bowl.
Add peanut butter, honey, water, tamari, vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and sesame oil to the bowl with the ginger. Whisk until smooth, set aside.
Once water is boiling, add salt and noodles and stir for a few seconds. Cook according to package directions, 3 to 4 minutes. When cooked, drain and rinse well under cold water.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ⅛-inch pieces at an angle.
Cut the bell pepper lengthwise into quarters; remove and discard the seeds and white membrane. Julienne the pepper.
Trim and discard the ends of the cucumber; halve the cucumber lengthwise and then slice into ⅛-inch thick planks. Then, cut the planks ¼-inch wide julienne sticks.
Trim the stem ends of the carrot and peel; julienne or coarsely grate the carrot.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise.
Roughly chop the cashews.
Add noodles, cashews, and veggies to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine.
Divide noodles between plates, serve cold. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Spinach-Mushroom Orzo Pasta Skillet with Basil

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Add orzo, broth, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, roughly chop spinach and place in the reserved bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Finely grate Parmesan.
When the broth is mostly absorbed, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add half of the basil (reserve remaining basil for serving), Parmesan, and cream to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until thickened, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide orzo between plates or bowls. Top with reserved basil and enjoy!

name: Creamy Squash, Kale & Apple Soup with Crispy Parmesan Chickpeas

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice the flesh. Place in a medium bowl.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl with the squash.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add butternut squash, leek, and spices to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and pat dry with paper towels. Drizzle with oil, then season with spices; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring chickpeas halfway through, until crispy and golden, 15-18 minutes.
While the chickpeas are roasting, quarter, core, and small dice apple.

When the veggies are softened, add apple and broth to the pan; stir to combine the soup and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until apple is tender, about 5 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Set aside.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. When the apple is done, add kale to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add cream to the pan, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: When the chickpeas are done, remove from the oven. Add Parmesan to the baking sheet and stir until cheese starts to melt and combine with chickpeas.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with the crispy chickpeas. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Gnocchi with White Beans, Pepper, Peas & Basil

instructions.text: Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Wash and dry bell pepper, then trim, seed, and small dice. Place in a small bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Mince sun-dried tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Meanwhile, place water and cornstarch in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the slurry.

When the veggies are soft, add cornstarch slurry, almond milk, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) almond milk, unsweetened

instructions.text: While the sauce simmers, wash and dry basil. Pick leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add beans, gnocchi, peas, and half of the basil to the pan (reserve remaining basil for garnish). Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 4-5 minutes more.
To serve, divide creamy gnocchi between bowls. Top with remaining basil and enjoy!

name: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Pasta with Zucchini, Mushrooms & Peas

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve ½-cup cooking water before draining and set aside.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons; thinly slice mushrooms. Place both in a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and thinly slice shallot; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.
Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes.

When the veggies are done, add sun-dried tomatoes, cream, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: While the sauce simmers, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add cooked pasta, Parmesan, basil, and peas to the skillet; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until cheese is melted and peas are tender, 1-2 minutes more.
Add reserved pasta water to the skillet, a few tablespoons at a time, while stirring, to reach a saucy consistency (you may not need all of the reserved water). Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Creamy Sundried Tomato & Spinach Linguine Pasta

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 6 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) linguine pasta

instructions.text: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add onion, garlic, tomatoes, and crushed red pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until onion is softened, 3-4 minutes.
Wash and dry spinach.
Add tomato sauce, basil, salt, and pepper to pan. Stir to combine and simmer for 3-4 minutes.
Finely grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
Add yogurt to pan, reduce heat to medium-low, and stir to combine.
Add spinach and fold in until wilted. Remove pan from heat until pasta is ready.
Drain pasta in a colander, reserving about ½ cup of the pasta water.
Add pasta and ½ of the water to sauce; toss to coat. If sauce is too thick, add more pasta water to thin it out.
Place pasta in a bowl or on a plate and garnish with grated Parmesan.

name: Creamy Sweet Potato-Corn Chowder with Bacon, Bell Pepper & Spinach

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and medium dice sweet potato. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the sweet potato.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the pan is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until bacon has released its fat and is starting to brown, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
When the bacon is done, use a slotted spoon to transfer ½ to a plate; set aside. (Leave remaining bacon in the pan.)
Add veggies and corn to the pan with the remaining bacon, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems.

When the veggies are soft, add thyme, broth, water, and spices to the pan. Stir to combine the chowder, then bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are tender and chowder has thickened, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: When the sweet potatoes are done, reduce heat to medium-low. Add cream to the pan and, using a potato masher, gently crush some of the sweet potatoes to further thicken the chowder.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide the chowder between bowls and sprinkle with reserved bacon. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Thyme Chicken with Sweet Potato-Beet Mash & Dijon Kale Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash, dry, peel, and trim beet. Medium dice, transfer to a medium saucepan, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the remaining fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and medium dice sweet potato; place in a small bowl and set aside.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until beets are starting to soften, about 10 minutes. Add sweet potatoes and cook until veggies are soft, 10-12 minutes more.
While the beets are cooking, juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cutlets to the skillet and pan-fry until cooked through and golden brown, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic and shallot.
Return the skillet (with cooking juices), to medium heat; add garlic, shallot, and thyme. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shallot has softened, 2-3 minutes.
While the shallot is cooking, cut cream cheese into small pieces.

Add cream cheese and water to the skillet; stir until melted and combined, 1-2 minutes. (if needed, add additional water, 1 tablespoon at a time, to reach a saucy consistency). Return chicken to the skillet, along with any accumulated juices; stir to combine the chicken and sauce. Remove from heat.

When the beet and sweet potato are ready, drain in a colander and return to the saucepan; add salt and pepper, then use a hand (or regular blender) to purée until smooth. (Add water, a couple of tablespoons at a time, to reach desired consistency.)
To serve, divide sweet potato-beet mash, chicken, sauce, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Tomato Basil Chicken & Zucchini Noodles

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce (skip the spinach if it came pre-washed).
Use a spiralizer, julienne (or regular) peeler to make zucchini noodles; set aside.
Grate Parmesan into a small bowl.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince the garlic.
When the skillet is hot, add oil, and swirl to coat. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes on each side; remove chicken and set aside on a plate.

After setting the chicken aside, keep the pan on the heat and reduce to medium. Add the garlic, cream, broth, Italian seasoning, and Parmesan; cook, stirring occasionally until the sauce starts to thicken, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Drain and thinly slice the sun-dried tomatoes.

Add the spinach, basil, and sun-dried tomatoes to the skillet and let it simmer until the spinach starts to wilt, 2-3 minutes; stir in any accumulated juices from the plate with the cooked chicken. Remove from heat.
Add the zucchini noodles to the sauce and gently toss until well coated.
Slice the chicken crosswise into strips.
To serve, divide the zucchini noodles between bowls. Top with chicken and cream sauce; enjoy!

name: Creamy Tossed Shrimp Lasagna Skillet with Zucchini Ribbons & Basil

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Break lasagna noodles into thirds. Once the water in the pan is boiling, uncover, add salt and broken noodles, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Once done, drain in a colander and set aside.

While the noodles are cooking, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Trim zucchini; run a peeler along the zucchini to make long, noodle-like strips. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; medium dice tomato. Add both to the bowl with the zucchini.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, chop shrimp into small pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, shrimp, and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are opaque and veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Coarsely grate mozzarella.

When the veggies are done, add lasagna noodles, half of the basil, and cream to the skillet; toss to combine and continue to cook until heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Top lasagna skillet with mozzarella.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until the mozzarella is melted and golden, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide lasagna skillet between plates or bowls and top with reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Tuna Pasta Salad with Peas, Carrots, Celery, Tomato & Feta

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Rinse peas under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl.
Drain tuna, add to the bowl, and flake with a fork.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Add cooled pasta to the bowl, along with feta, and stir to combine the pasta salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Tuna Pasta with Tomatoes, Zucchini, Basil & Parmesan

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ½-cup of cooking water before draining; set aside.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons; place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the zucchini.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes and place in the reserved bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add half of the basil to the bowl with the tomatoes. (Set remaining basil aside for garnish.)
Add tomato paste to the skillet with the veggies; cook, stirring often, for 1 minute.

Drain tuna and flake with a fork; add to the skillet along with cream, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the sauce. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens slightly, 3-4 minutes more.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water
4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: While the sauce is cooking, finely grate Parmesan.
Add drained pasta to the skillet along with tomatoes and basil; stir to combine. Add reserved pasta water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls; top with Parmesan and reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken with Mushrooms, Spinach, & Cherry Tomatoes

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towel and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic and cook, stirring regularly, until onion begins to soften, 2-3 minutes.

Add chicken to the skillet; cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side. Once golden, transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
Meanwhile, slice the mushrooms.
Add mushrooms to the skillet, and cook until golden brown, 2-3 minutes.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add tomatoes and spices to the skillet and stir to combine. Continue to cook until veggies begin to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the cream and return the chicken to the skillet, along with any accumulated juices from the plate. Cover and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Add cheese to the skillet and stir to combine.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates, spooning skillet sauce on top. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Tuscan Scallop, Spinach & Tomato Sauté with Roasted Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Halve potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until potatoes are golden and fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
When the potatoes have about 15 minutes left, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and tomatoes; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in the reserved bowl, setting aside a small handful for serving.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the Parmesan.
When the onion and tomato are done, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add Parmesan, basil, cream, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the cheese is melted and sauce is combined, 1-2 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: While the sauce is cooking, pat the scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Add scallops to the skillet with the sauce and gently stir to coat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until opaque, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide creamy scallop sauté and potatoes between plates or bowls. Top with reserved Parmesan and enjoy!

name: Creamy Tuscan Shrimp with Bacon, Tomatoes, Spinach & Zucchini Noodles

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove to a paper towel-lined plate, leaving the drippings in the skillet.
Meanwhile, trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Halve the tomatoes.
Return skillet (with bacon drippings) to medium heat; add tomatoes and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Peel and mince garlic.
Add garlic and shrimp to the skillet; cook until shrimp are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add zucchini noodles, Parmesan (reserving a small handful for garnish), and cream to the skillet; stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is melted and combined, 1-2 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half the to skillet (reserving the rest for garnish) and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide shrimp, veggies, and sauce between bowls. Top with bacon and remaining Parmesan and basil. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Tuscan Soup with Potatoes, Pork & Kale

ingredients.name: cannellini (white kidney) beans
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can cannellini (white kidney) beans

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of the sausages. Peel off the casing and discard.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and break apart with a spoon. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and crumbly, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice onion.
Add garlic and onion to the pot and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can cannellini (white kidney) beans

instructions.text: Add beans, broth, and spices to the pot. Cover and bring to a simmer.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash the potato. Cut into quarters, then thinly slice into ⅛-inch pieces. Add to the pot.
Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the pot.
Let the soup simmer, covered, until potatoes are fork tender, 10-15 minutes. Add cream and stir until well combined.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!

name: Creamy Vegan Cashew "Parma Rosa" Penne with Fresh Basil & Side Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place cashews in a small bowl. Using a measuring cup, carefully remove 1 cup of boiling water from the pot and pour over the cashews; let sit for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, sugar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber, then thinly slice crosswise. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Drain cashews and place in a blender.
Add tomato sauce, broth, nutritional yeast, flour, and spices to the blender and purée until smooth.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Drain pasta, return to the saucepan, and set over medium heat. Add the sauce from the blender and stir to combine; cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
Divide pasta between plates and top with basil. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Creamy Vegan Cashew, Potato & White Bean Soup with Mixed Vegetables

ingredients.name: cannellini (white kidney) beans
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can cannellini (white kidney) beans

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Place a medium saucepan over high heat. Add broth, cover, and bring to a boil.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place cashews in a small bowl. Carefully pour boiling broth over the cashews and set aside to soak for 15 minutes. Reserve saucepan for later use.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice onion. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Peel and small dice carrot. Trim and small dice celery. Add both to the bowl.
Medium dice potatoes. Add to the bowl along with corn and peas.
Return saucepan to medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add veggies to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard stems.
Add broth, half the thyme (reserving the rest for garnish), and spices to the pan.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Drain and rinse beans; add to the pan.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can cannellini (white kidney) beans

instructions.text: Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are fork-tender, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, transfer the cashew-broth mixture to a blender and purée until smooth.
Add cashew cream to the pan and stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until soup begins to thicken, 5-7 minutes.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Top with reserved thyme and enjoy!

name: Creamy Vegan Cashew Pumpkin "Alfredo" Linguine with Baby Spinach

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 6 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, place cashews in a small bowl. Using a measuring cup, carefully remove 1 cup of boiling water from the pot and pour over the cashews; let sit for 15 minutes.
Peel and slice garlic; transfer to a blender.
Once cashews are done soaking, drain and add to the blender.
Add pumpkin, broth, nutritional yeast, flour, and spices to the blender and purée until smooth.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée
6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the spinach. (Skip this step if it came pre-washed.)
Drain pasta and set aside to drain further.
Return saucepan to medium heat. Add the sauce from the blender and bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add pasta, stir to combine, and cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 3-4 minutes.
Divide pasta between bowls and enjoy!

name: Creamy Vegan Mushroom Stroganoff with Thyme & Baby Spinach

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Wash and slice mushrooms. Peel and mince garlic.
Add mushrooms, garlic, and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until mushrooms are softened, 4-5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut milk and cornstarch.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Add coconut milk mixture, broth, soy sauce, and vinegar to the skillet. Stir and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened, 5-6 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry thyme. Slide leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Add leaves to the skillet and stir to combine.
Wash and dry the spinach (skip if it came pre-washed). Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Drain pasta and add to skillet with the sauce. Toss to combine.
To serve, divide the pasta and sauce between plates. Enjoy!

name: Creamy White Bean, Mushroom & Tomato Skillet with Sourdough Toast

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
When the onion is softened, add mushrooms to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are tender, 5-7 minutes.
While the mushrooms are cooking, drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
When the mushrooms are tender, add tomato paste to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes more.

Add beans, tomatoes, broth, and cream to the skillet. Stir to combine bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)

Arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until lightly toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and cut in half. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Divide skillet between plates or bowls. Serve with toast on the side and enjoy!

name: Creamy Zucchini, Leek & Dill Soup with Cheesy Flatbread

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl.

Trim off the root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green part. Cut the leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces and add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the zucchini and leek.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 6 minutes.
When the veggies are soft, add broth and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook until veggies are very tender, 5-6 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate mozzarella.
Place flatbreads on a baking sheet pan, then sprinkle with mozzarella and Italian seasoning. Place in the oven and broil until cheese is melted, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into wedges.
When the soup is done, use a hand blender to purée the soup until smooth. Alternatively, use a potato masher to crush the veggies (the soup will be chunkier).
Add dill and yogurt to the soup, then stir to combine.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with cheesy flatbread on the side. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Baked Chicken Sandwich with Broccoli-Carrot Slaw

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Whisk together mayo and spices in a medium bowl.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Slice crosswise into ¾-inch strips and add to the bowl with the mayo; toss to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add bread crumbs and parsley flakes to the bowl with the chicken and toss well to coat. Arrange chicken on a baking sheet pan and drizzle with oil. Place in the oven and bake, turning once, until golden brown and cooked through, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place mayo, vinegar, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl.
Add broccoli slaw to the bowl and toss to combine. Set aside.
Slice tomato into ½-inch thick rounds.
Toast buns if desired.
To serve, place the bottom half of a roll on each plate. Layer with slaw, chicken strips, and tomato; close with the top half of the roll and enjoy!

name: Crispy Baked Tofu with Hot Sauce, Veggie Sticks & Herby Ranch Dressing

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a blender.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Roughly chop chives. Add to the blender along with yogurt, mayo, salt, and pepper. Blend on high until herby ranch dressing is smooth, then set aside.
Place bread crumbs and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
Cut the tofu into ½-inch thick planks and place in a medium bowl. Wipe the baking sheet dry with paper towels and set aside for later use.
Add mayo to the bowl with the tofu and gently toss to coat. Add seasoned bread crumbs, then gently toss once more to coat, pressing with your fingers to adhere.
Transfer tofu to the reserved baking sheet. Place tofu in the oven and bake, turning halfway through, until the breading is golden brown and crispy, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long pieces; place on a plate.
Peel, trim, and quarter carrot lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long pieces. Add to the plate with the cucumber.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper into thin strips; add to the plate.
Divide tofu and veggie sticks between plates. Drizzle tofu with hot sauce and serve with dressing for dipping. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Black Bean Taquitos with Romaine Salad & Creamy Lime Dressing

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and roughly chop bell pepper. Roughly chop grape tomatoes. Place both in a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the bell peppers and tomatoes.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse beans in a colander.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beans and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender and warmed through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.
When the beans are done, transfer to another medium bowl and crush with a potato masher to create a semi-smooth mixture. (Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and set aside for later use.)
Coarsely grate cheese. Add to the bowl with the crushed beans, along with half of the green onions and yogurt. Stir to combine the filling and set aside. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Return the skillet to medium-high heat. Working in batches, add tortillas and cook, flipping once, until softened, 2-3 minutes. Remove to a flat surface.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Divide the bean mixture between softened tortillas. Tightly roll tortillas to close, then arrange taquitos, seam-side down, on the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, using tongs to turn taquitos halfway through, until golden and crispy on the edges, 5-6 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, juice lime into a small bowl. Add yogurt and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing. Transfer half to the bowl with the lettuce and toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining dressing for serving.)
To serve, divide taquitos and salad between plates. Drizzle taquitos with reserved dressing and sprinkle with reserved green onions. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Chicken Burrito (Chimichanga) with Spicy Peach & Mango Salsa

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a small bowl. Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Medium dice tomato. Add to the bowl.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice flesh. Add to the bowl.
Quarter peach lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pit; medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salsa, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.

Place tortillas on a flat surface. Divide chicken filling, salsa, and lettuce down the center of each. Fold in sides of tortillas and roll tightly to close the burritos. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)

Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat; add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Lay burritos, seam-side down, in the skillet and cook, rotating every 2-3 minutes, until golden brown and crispy on all sides. Remove from heat.
To serve, cut burritos in half and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Chicken with Cauliflower Rice Pilaf and Fresh Greens

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 2 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat a cast iron or oven-proof skillet (if available) over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, pat the chicken dry with paper towel and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until skin is golden and crispy, about 4 minutes; flip and repeat on other side.
Place skillet in the oven and continue cooking for 15 minutes, or until cooked through. If your skillet is not oven proof, transfer to a baking dish with a wire rack.
Remove the leaves from the cauliflower. Using a food processor or box grater, grate to rice-like texture. Transfer to a large bowl and set aside.
Place a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add butter, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, turmeric, cayenne pepper, and salt.
Once the butter is fully melted, add the cauliflower and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add broth to the cauliflower and cook for another 5-7 minutes.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Stir into the cauliflower.
Cut lemon into wedges. Toss the mixed greens with oil and a squeeze of lemon.
To serve, arrange chicken, cauliflower-rice, and greens on plates. Serve with lemon wedges, if desired, enjoy!

name: Crispy Chicken Fingers with Peanut Dipping Sauce & Tossed Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Place mayo, soy sauce, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then slice into ¾-inch strips. Add to the bowl with the mayo mixture and toss to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add bread crumbs to the bowl with the chicken and gently toss once more to coat. Arrange on a baking sheet pan in a single layer and drizzle with oil.
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Juice lime into a small bowl; add peanut butter, soy sauce, maple syrup, water, turmeric, and curry powder. Whisk to combine the peanut sauce and set aside.
Place mayo, soy sauce, oil, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, trim and halve radishes, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
When the chicken is almost done, add mixed greens to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken fingers, peanut sauce, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Chicken Thighs & Maple-Mustard Roast Red Cabbage with Parsley

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry cabbage; halve lengthwise, cut out the core, and slice crosswise into 1-inch thick wedges. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Place oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the glaze.
Spread half of the glaze over the top side of the cabbage wedges. Carefully flip wedges and repeat with remaining glaze. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until cabbage is golden brown and tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in the reserved bowl. (Set aside remaining parsley for serving.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the parsley along with mayo, Dijon, and thyme, then stir to combine.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then season with salt and pepper on both sides. Transfer to a baking dish.
Spread Dijon mayo over the top side of the chicken, then sprinkle with bread crumbs, pressing gently to adhere. Drizzle with oil.
Add baking dish to the oven and roast until chicken is golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide cabbage and chicken between plates; top with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Chili Chicken Rice Bowl with Pineapple-Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, zest and juice lime into a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime, along with vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and salt. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and small dice shallot. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the chicken into ¼-inch thick slices and place in another medium bowl. Add cornstarch and pepper, then toss to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, flipping once, until cooked through and crispy on both sides, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, roughly chop peanuts.
When the chicken is done, add chili-garlic sauce to the skillet and stir to coat, 15-30 seconds. Remove from heat, add fish sauce, and stir once more to combine.
To serve, divide rice between bowls, then top with the chicken and salad. Sprinkle with peanuts and enjoy!

name: Crispy Cod with Lemon Parsley Sauce & Tomato-Arugula Panzanella Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Cut or tear bread into 2-inch pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until croutons are golden and toasted, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Zest lemon into a small bowl. Add flour and spices, then stir to combine the coating. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Sprinkle with the coating on both sides. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cod and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in the reserved bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the sauce. Set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Large dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with cooled croutons, arugula, and capers, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and cod between plates or bowls. Spoon sauce over the cod and enjoy!

name: Crispy Corn Fritters with Mixed Greens, Fried Egg & Sweet Chili Sauce

instructions.text: Combine water, vinegar, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook until slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes.
In a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.
