Add cornstarch slurry to the saucepan in a steady stream while stirring quickly. Cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Chop chives into small pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan; add to the bowl with the chives.
Place corn in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Place on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
Add corn, flour, and egg to the bowl; stir to combine.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Using a ¼-cup measure, form the corn mixture into ½-inch thick patties. Add to the skillet and cook, flipping once, until patties are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels. Set the skillet (with oil) aside for later use.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk together oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Peel carrots and trim ends; grate and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add mixed greens to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Return the skillet to medium heat. Gently crack the eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 3-4 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
To serve, divide salad, fritters, and eggs between plates. Drizzle with sweet chili sauce and enjoy!

name: Crispy Eggplant-Tomato Stacks with Fresh Mozzarella & Pine Nut Greens

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Place bread crumbs and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
Trim and slice eggplant crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Transfer eggplant to the baking sheet, spreading the slices out in a single layer.

Spread half of the mayo over the top side of the eggplant rounds, then sprinkle with half of the bread crumbs (pressing gently to adhere). Carefully flip eggplant and repeat with remaining mayo and bread crumbs.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until eggplant is tender and golden on both sides, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, thinly slice mozzarella. Place on a plate.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Thinly slice tomatoes and add to the plate with the mozzarella. Set aside.
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with mayo, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
When the eggplant is done, top with mozzarella and tomato. Return to the oven and continue to bake until the cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl along with mixed greens and pine nuts, then toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
To serve, divide eggplant stacks and salad between plates. Top eggplant with reserved basil and enjoy!

name: Crispy Fish Sandwich with Garlic-Tartar Sauce & Side Salad

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic; mince capers. Transfer both to a small bowl along with mayo, vinegar, Dijon, and pepper. Whisk to combine the tartar sauce; set aside.
Combine oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in a salad bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rounds. Set half of the onions aside on a plate. Add the other half to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Wash and dry the tomatoes, then halve and slice them. Place half of the tomatoes on the plate; transfer the other half to the salad bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts; transfer to the salad bowl. Set aside while you prepare the fish.
Whisk egg in a medium bowl.
Place bread crumbs in a second medium bowl.
Pat the fish dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Sprinkle flour over both sides of each fillet. Press gently to adhere.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
To bread the fish, dip each fillet into the egg, and then the bread crumbs. Press gently to adhere.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fish to the skillet and cook until golden brown and cooked through, about 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a clean plate lined with paper towel.
Meanwhile, toast the rolls.
Wash and dry the lettuce; separate the leaves. Set aside 2 large leaves per sandwich. Chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces, add to the salad bowl and toss to combine.
Place the bottom half of a roll on each plate. Layer with tartar sauce, lettuce, tomato, onion, and a crispy fish fillet; close with top half of the roll. Serve salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Crispy Ginger Pork Stir-Fry with Broccoli, Pepper, Mango & Cashews

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into thin strips. Place in a medium bowl, along with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, crispy, and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the broccoli.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.

Return the skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add veggies, mango, ginger, and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place soy sauce, water, chili-garlic sauce, and honey in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine the sauce.
When the veggies are starting to soften, add sauce and cashews to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly, 1-2 minutes more.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the skillet, along with the crispy pork, and stir once more to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Halloumi with Roasted Tomatoes, Dressed Arugula & Pine Nuts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the garlic.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl. Add oil, sugar, and spices, then stir to coat. Transfer tomatoes to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until tomatoes are soft and juicy, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add pine nuts and cook, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for later use.)

Pat halloumi dry with paper towels; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the halloumi in half horizontally, then cut each half lengthwise into 1-inch thick strips. Season both sides with pepper.

Return skillet to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the halloumi and cook, turning halfway through, until golden brown on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing. Add arugula and toss to coat. Set aside.

When the tomatoes are done, remove from the oven. Using a potato masher or fork, lightly crush the tomatoes so that they are jammy but not totally smooth (there should still be a few large pieces of tomato).
To serve, divide arugula between plates or bowls. Top with halloumi, jammy tomatoes, and pine nuts. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Pan-Fried Tofu with Lemony Spinach, Dill & Artichoke Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, roughly chop spinach. Place in a medium bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the spinach.
Drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Zest lemon into a small bowl. Add cornstarch, sugar, and spices, then stir to combine the the spice mixture. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, cut the tofu planks in half crosswise and place on a plate. Spread half of the mayo over top side of the tofu, then sprinkle with half of the spice mixture (pressing gently to adhere). Carefully flip tofu and repeat with remaining mayo and spice mixture.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden and crispy, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
When the rice is done, add to the bowl with the spinach and artichoke. Stir until spinach is slightly wilted and rice is combined, about 2 minutes.
Juice reserved lemon over the rice, then stir once more to combine.
To serve, divide spinach-artichoke rice and crispy tofu between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Pork Chops with Orange, Spinach & Pistachio Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Cut off a piece from each stem end of the orange to reveal the flesh; slice off the skin and pith, then cut the orange lengthwise into 8 wedges. Cut the wedges crosswise into small pieces and transfer to a small bowl.
Crack the egg into a medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork.
Place the flour and bread crumbs on two separate plates.
Place the pork chops on a cutting board and, holding a knife parallel to the board, cut the chops in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

One piece at a time, thoroughly coat the seasoned pork chops in the flour (shaking off any excess), then in the beaten egg (letting the excess drip off), then in the bread crumbs (pressing to adhere). Transfer to a plate.
Once the skillet is hot, add the pistachios and toast, stirring constantly for 1 to 2 minutes. Once done, transfer to a small bowl.
Once the pistachios have been transferred, add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the breaded pork chops in the skillet; cook until they are golden brown and cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
While the pork chops cook, in a small bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
To serve, arrange a bed of spinach on one side of a plate, top with the orange segments and pistachios, and drizzle with the dressing. Place the pork chops on the other side. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Pork Schnitzel with Ranch-Dressed Apple & Broccoli Slaw

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Mince chives and place in a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the chives.
Add yogurt, mayo, and spices to the bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter and core apples; cut into matchsticks or coarsely grate. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the broccoli slaw, and stir to combine. Set aside.
Crack egg into another medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork.
Place bread crumbs on a plate.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chops in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, dip the seasoned cutlets into the beaten egg (letting the excess drip off), then into the bread crumbs, pressing to adhere. Transfer to another plate.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the breaded cutlets and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pork schnitzel and slaw between plates. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Roasted Chicken Drumsticks with Cucumber-Bell Pepper Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Place flour, baking powder, and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Drizzle with oil and turn to coat.
Add spice mixture to the bowl with the chicken, toss, then press to adhere coating. Transfer chicken to the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning halfway through, until coating is crispy and chicken is cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Seared Halloumi Cheese over Lemony Zucchini-Spinach Sauté

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat halloumi dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the halloumi in half horizontally, then cut each half crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Place in a medium bowl, along with cornstarch, paprika, and pepper, then gently turn to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the halloumi and cook, turning halfway through, until golden brown on both sides, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve bowl and skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in the reserved bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Return the skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add zucchini, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until zucchini is just tender, 3-4 minutes.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Juice lemon into the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide zucchini-spinach sauté between plates or bowls. Top with crispy halloumi and enjoy!

name: Crispy Shrimp Burrito (Chimichanga) with Tomatoes, Cilantro & Yogurt

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper into thin strips; place in a medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince garlic; peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, jalapeño, garlic, and onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheddar; cut cream cheese into small pieces. Place cheeses in the reserved bowl and set aside.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Add shrimp, half of the cilantro (reserve remaining cilantro for garnish), and spices to the skillet; cook until shrimp are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side.
Reduce heat to low and add the cheeses. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until cheeses melt and combine, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide shrimp filling down the center of each one. Fold in sides of tortillas and roll tightly to complete.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Lay burritos, seam-side down, and cook, rotating every 2-3 minutes, until golden brown and crispy on all sides. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, medium dice tomatoes.
To serve, cut burritos in half and divide between plates. Top with tomatoes, reserved cilantro, and yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Smoked Salmon Sandwich with Lemon Tartar Sauce & Side Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a small bowl (reserve lemon for later use).
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon zest.
Mince capers; add to the bowl along with mayo, vinegar, Dijon, and pepper. Whisk to combine the tartar sauce and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add smoked salmon slices to the skillet in a single layer; cook, flipping once, until crispy, about 4 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside.
Meanwhile, juice reserved lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot; add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl.
Small dice half the tomato and add to the bowl. Thinly slice remaining tomato and place on a plate for serving.
Halve avocado and remove pit; scoop out the flesh. Medium dice half the avocado and add to the bowl. Thinly slice remaining avocado and add to the plate with the sliced tomato; set aside.
Separate the lettuce leaves. Set aside 2 leaves per sandwich and chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add chopped lettuce to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns or rolls (if desired).

Place the bottom half of a roll on each plate. Layer with tartar sauce, lettuce, tomato, crispy smoked salmon, and avocado; close with the top half of each roll. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Crispy "Taco-Spiced" Chicken Drumsticks with Jalapeño Broccoli Slaw

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Place flour, baking powder, and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Drizzle with oil and toss to coat.
Add seasoned flour to the bowl with the chicken, toss to coat, then press to adhere coating. Transfer chicken to the baking sheet, spreading it out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning halfway through, until coating is crispy and chicken is cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.

Wash, dry, and quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Thinly slice lengthwise and add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Wash, dry, trim, and halve radishes, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, along with broccoli slaw, and toss to combine.
To serve, divide chicken and slaw between plates. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Tempeh Bowl with Roasted Beets, Maple-Lemon Kale & Couscous

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and trim beets; halve lengthwise, then slice into ¼-inch thick wedges. Transfer to one half of a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Slice tempeh crosswise into ½-inch thick strips. Add to the other half of the baking sheet, then drizzle with soy sauce and oil. Season with pepper, then toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring each halfway through, until beets are tender and tempeh is crisp, about 20 minutes. Remove baking sheet from oven; season tempeh with additional soy sauce and toss to coat.
Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the couscous is cooking, juice lemon into a small bowl, then add mayo, oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Add half of the dressing to the bowl with the kale and, using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes. (Reserve remaining dressing for serving.)
To serve, divide couscous between bowls; top with kale, beets, and crispy tempeh. Drizzle with reserved dressing and enjoy!

name: Crispy Tilapia with Teriyaki Mixed Peppers, Green Onions & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and thinly slice bell peppers; transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim green onions and cut into 3-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the peppers and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the tilapia dry with paper towels and place on a plate; sprinkle with salt and pepper on both sides.
Sprinkle cornstarch over both sides of each fillet and press gently to adhere.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tilapia and cook, flipping once, until crispy and easily flakes with a fork, about 6 minutes. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and ginger; transfer to a small bowl.
Add broth, soy sauce, additional cornstarch, vinegar, honey, and crushed red pepper to the bowl with the garlic and ginger; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peppers and green onions to the skillet; stir-fry until veggies are fork-tender, about 5 minutes.
Add sauce to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens, about 2 minutes.
To serve, divide rice, tilapia, veggies, and sauce between plates. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Tofu Flatbread Pizza with Balsamic Tomatoes & Spinach

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.

Arrange flatbreads on another baking sheet. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until flatbreads are slightly crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place tomato sauce and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the sauce and set aside.
Wash, dry, and halve grape tomatoes. Place on a plate, drizzle with vinegar, and season with salt. Set aside.
Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Roughly chop and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Crumble the tofu with your fingers into the skillet, then season with spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is golden brown and warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.

Evenly spread tomato sauce over each flatbread, then top with tomatoes, spinach, tofu, and cheese. Return prepared flatbreads to the oven and bake until pizzas are warmed through and cheese is melted, 5-7 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, slice pizzas into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Tofu Sandwiches with Garlic Aioli & Arugula-Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.

Cut tofu into ½-inch thick planks along the short side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Zest lemon into a small bowl (reserve lemon for the dressing). Add mayo and spices, then stir to combine the aioli.

Place tofu on the baking sheet. Spread 1 tablespoon aioli over top side of the tofu, sprinkle with half of the bread crumbs, and drizzle with half of the oil. Carefully flip tofu and repeat with 1 tablespoon aioli, remaining bread crumbs, and remaining oil. (Reserve remaining aioli for sandwiches.)
Place tofu in the oven and bake, turning once, until the breading is crispy and golden brown, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice the lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice cucumber crosswise into rounds; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add broccoli slaw and arugula to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired.
Spread the remaining aioli over both halves of each bun. Layer each with a small portion of salad (reserving the rest for serving) and crispy tofu.
To serve, divide sandwiches and reserved salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Tofu Sandwiches with Quick Pickles, Chili Sauce & Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.

Cut tofu into ½-inch thick planks along the short side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
Trim and thinly slice cucumber and radishes; add both to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Place mayo and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the spiced mayo.

Place tofu planks on the baking sheet. Spread half the spiced mayo over the top side of the tofu, sprinkle with half the bread crumbs (pressing them gently into the surface to adhere), and drizzle with half the oil. Carefully flip tofu and repeat with remaining spiced mayo, bread crumbs, and oil.
Place tofu in the oven and bake, turning once, until the breading is crispy and golden brown, 15-18 minutes. Remove from the oven.

Meanwhile, place oil, chili-garlic sauce, vinegar, and sugar in a small saucepan; whisk to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Once simmering, remove from heat and cover with a lid to keep warm. (If the sauce separates, whisk together once more, right before serving.)
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Toast buns if desired.
Spread mayo on both halves of each bun. Layer each with a small portion of pickled vegetables (reserving the rest for the salad), top with tofu, and drizzle with sauce.
To serve, divide sandwiches and mixed greens between plates. Drizzle greens with oil, then top with reserved pickled vegetables and a small portion of pickling liquid. Enjoy!

name: Crispy Tofu with Warm Broccoli Slaw, Cucumber & Bell Pepper Salad

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons; place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into strips. Add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts and add to the bowl along with the broccoli slaw. Set aside.
Place bread crumbs and cornstarch in a small bowl; stir to combine.
Cut the tofu into ½-inch thick planks along the short side. Working in batches, roll tofu in the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere; transfer to a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add breaded tofu and pan-fry, turning occasionally, until browned and crispy, 5-7 minutes. Return crispy tofu to the plate.

Meanwhile, place vinegar, soy sauce, oil, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce in a small saucepan; stir to combine and bring the dressing to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add half of the dressing to the bowl with the salad and toss to combine. (Reserve remaining dressing for serving.)
To serve, divide salad and crispy tofu between bowls. Drizzle with remaining dressing and enjoy!

name: Crispy Turkey Burrito (Chimichanga) with Bell Pepper & Mushrooms

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Roughly chop mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, turkey, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese.

When the turkey is done, reduce heat to low and add cheese to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted and combined, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide turkey filling down the center of each one. Fold in sides of tortillas and roll tightly to close the burritos.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Lay burritos, seam-side down, in the skillet; cook, rotating every 2-3 minutes, until golden brown and crispy on all sides. Remove from heat.
To serve, cut burritos in half and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Crunchy Romaine Salad with Chickpeas, Corn, Tomatoes & Avocado

instructions.text: Remove husks and silks from corn. Hold vertically in the middle of a large bowl and slice kernels off the cob. Wash, halve, and add tomatoes to bowl. Halve and pit avocado; scoop out and medium dice. Add ½ to the bowl with the other ingredients and the other ½ to a small bowl (for the dressing).
Wash lettuce and chop into 1 inch strips. Add to bowl.
Drain and rinse chickpeas; place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl and toss salad.
Peel and mince garlic. Add garlic, lemon juice, oil, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper to bowl with avocado. Mash with a fork until smooth.
To serve, place salad on a plate, drizzle with dressing, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Enjoy!

name: Cuban-Spiced Steak with Garlicky Avocado, Tomato & Onion Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the citrus into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the citrus juice along with oil and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion. Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat; set aside to marinate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak to the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
While the steak is cooking, cut tomatoes into wedges and add to the bowl with the onions.
Halve and pit the avocado. Scoop halves out with a spoon and cut into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and gently stir to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak between plates; use a slotted spoon to portion salad, then drizzle steak with leftover dressing. Enjoy!

name: Cuban Style Cheesy Chicken-Rice Skillet with Peas & Bell Peppers

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add chicken to the skillet and cook, flipping once, until starting to brown, about 4 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Remove skillet from the heat and transfer chicken to a plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and onion.
Wash, dry, seed, and small dice bell pepper.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water. Set aside to drain.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat; add the veggies, rice, broth, tomato paste, and spices. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low. Return chicken to the skillet, cover, and cook until rice is tender and chicken is cooked through, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, grate cheese.
Place peas in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals.
Remove skillet from the heat. Sprinkle cheese and peas over the top, and let stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken and rice between plates and enjoy!

name: Cumin-Lime Arugula Salad with Bacon, Blueberries, Croutons & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Zest and juice lime into a medium bowl. Add oil, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Using a clean cutting board, cut bread into 1-inch cubes.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add bread cubes and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until croutons are golden and toasted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, roughly chop pecans and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add crispy bacon, croutons, blueberries, arugula, and feta to the bowl, then toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Cumin-Lime Wings with Potato, Green Bean, Tomato, Olive & Feta Salad

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into a medium bowl. Add oil and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and add to the bowl with the marinade. Toss to coat, transfer to the baking sheet, and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, halve new potatoes; place in a medium saucepan, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until almost fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and set aside.

Trim and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces. When the potatoes are just tender, add beans to the pan. Continue to cook until potatoes and beans are fork-tender, 2-3 minutes more. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with cooled potatoes, green beans, and feta, then stir to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Cumin Steak with Yellow Rice, Tomato-Cucumber Salad & Garlic Sauce

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water, turmeric, and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; transfer to a small bowl.
Medium dice tomato and add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Peel and small dice shallot; add to the bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to combine the salad and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and let rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place mayo, vinegar, and spices in another small bowl. Whisk to combine the garlic sauce.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Divide rice, salad, and steak between plates. Serve with garlic sauce on the side and enjoy!

name: Curried Apple Egg Salad Wraps with Walnuts & Raisins

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the lemon into a large bowl. Add mayo, Dijon, and spices; whisk dressing until well combined.
Core and medium dice apple. Medium dice celery. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop walnuts. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel and medium dice the eggs. Add eggs and raisins to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the thickest part of the stems. Lay leaves flat and fill with curried egg salad. Roll like a burrito and secure with a toothpick if needed.
To serve, divide curried egg wraps between plates and enjoy!

name: Curried Cauliflower Quinoa Bowl with Arugula, Pistachios & Mint

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, place oil and spices in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the spice oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the spice oil and stir to coat. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until cauliflower is fork-tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the cauliflower is roasting, pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half of the mint in a small bowl. (Reserve remaining mint for serving.)
Add yogurt, tahini, water, vinegar, additional garlic powder, and salt to the bowl with the mint. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces.
Roughly chop pistachios.
To serve, divide quinoa, cauliflower, arugula, and cucumber between bowls. Drizzle with sauce, then top with pistachios and reserved mint. Enjoy!

name: Curried Chicken, Chickpea & Cauliflower Bake with Cilantro Raita

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Place vinegar, honey, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and pat dry with paper towels.
Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the baking sheet with the chickpeas.

Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, then season with curry powder and salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until chickpeas are crisp, cauliflower is fork-tender, and chicken is cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and grate cucumber. Use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated cucumber. Place in another small bowl.
Juice half of the lime into the bowl with the cucumber. Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with yogurt, additional honey, crushed red pepper, and salt; stir to combine the raita.
Divide chicken bake between plates or bowls; top with pickled onion. Serve with raita on the side and enjoy!

name: Curried Chicken Salad Rice Bowl with Apple-Carrot Slaw & Cilantro

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
While the water is heating, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the slaw dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, quarter, core, and medium dice apples. Add to the bowl with the slaw dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the slaw. Set aside.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in another medium bowl. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the cilantro along with yogurt, mayo, and spices. Whisk to combine the curry yogurt dressing.
When the chicken is cool, add to the bowl with the curry yogurt dressing, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice, chicken salad, and slaw between bowls. Top with reserved cilantro and enjoy!

name: Curried Chicken-Zucchini Noodle Bowl with Mango, Mint Raita & Cashews

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine the spice mix.

Trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with half of the spice mix; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve remaining spice mix for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and bake, tossing halfway through, until zucchini is tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with remaining spice mix (reserve bowl for later use).
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove chicken to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic; place in the reserved bowl.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with yogurt and salt; stir to combine the raita and set aside.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice.
Roughly chop cashews.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide the zucchini noodles, chicken, and mango between bowls; top with mint raita and cashews. Enjoy!

name: Curried Chickpea Salad Flatbread Wrap with Lettuce, Tomato & Dill

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Transfer half of the chickpeas to the bowl with the lemon juice, along with mayonnaise and spices. Using a fork or potato masher, mash until smooth.
Add remaining chickpeas to the bowl and stir to combine.
Small dice celery and add to the bowl.
Trim off and discard ends of the green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces and transfer to the bowl.
Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the chickpea salad.
Warm flatbreads in a skillet, oven, or toaster (optional).
Meanwhile, slice tomato into rounds.
Divide lettuce and tomato slices between flatbreads and season with salt and pepper. Top with curried chickpea salad.
To make wraps easier to eat, place flatbreads on individual squares of parchment paper. Use the paper to tightly roll and secure each wrap. Otherwise eat as is and get a little messy! Enjoy!

name: Curried Chickpea Salad with Mixed Greens, Apple, Pumpkin Seeds & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Juice half the lemon into a medium bowl. (Set remaining lemon aside for later.)
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Transfer half the chickpeas to the bowl with the lemon juice; add mayo and spices. Using a fork or potato masher, mash until smooth.
Add remaining chickpeas to the bowl and stir to combine.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl.
Chop chives into small pieces and add to the bowl.
Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the chickpea salad. Set aside.
Juice remaining lemon into another medium bowl. Add oil, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter and core apple, then thinly slice each quarter; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add mixed greens, feta, and pumpkin seeds to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide green salad between plates or bowls, top with curried chickpea salad, and enjoy!

name: Curried Coconut Pumpkin Soup with Chicken & Crusty Bread

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Heat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and mince onion and garlic.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add pumpkin, broth, curry powder, turmeric, and salt. Stir until well combined and cook for 2-3 minutes.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add coconut milk and stir to combine. Simmer until rest of the meal is ready.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Toast bread.
Shred chicken with your hands or cut into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, pour soup in a bowl, garnish with chicken and parsley, and have crusty bread on the side. Enjoy!

name: Curried Coconut-Red Lentil Soup with Veggies, Cilantro & Yogurt

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice onion; transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots; add to the bowl with the onion.
Trim and small dice zucchini; add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, curry powder, and salt to the pan; cook, stirring often, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Add broth, coconut milk, tomatoes, and lentils to the pan; stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Once the soup is boiling, reduce heat to medium-low; simmer, stirring occasionally, until lentils and veggies are tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the soup is done, add cilantro and stir to combine.
To serve, divide soup between bowls, top with yogurt, and enjoy!

name: Curried Cottage Cheese Fritters with Mint Raita & Mango-Pepper Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between two medium bowls. (Set one bowl aside for the salad.)
Add cottage cheese, eggs, flour, bread crumbs, and spices to the remaining bowl with the cilantro. Stir to combine the batter.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; flatten slightly with the back of a spoon. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a small bowl. Pour half of the juice into the medium bowl for the salad. (Set the small bowl aside for the raita.)
Add oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the cilantro and lemon juice. Stir to combine the salad dressing.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; roughly chop the flesh. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then small dice. Add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the small bowl with the lemon juice along with yogurt and spices. Stir to combine the raita.
Divide fritters and salad between plates. Serve with raita and enjoy!

name: Curried Couscous, Kidney Bean & Maple Broccoli-Acorn Squash Bowl

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place maple syrup, oil, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; add to the bowl with the sauce.
Halve acorn squash lengthwise, trim off the ends, then scoop out the seeds. Cut crosswise into ¼-inch-thick slices and add to the bowl; toss vegetables to coat.

Transfer broccoli-squash mixture to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake, tossing halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the veggies are roasting, peel and small dice onion. Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and bell pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add beans, broth, and spices to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid is boiling, remove from heat; add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut lime into wedges and set aside.
To serve, divide curried couscous, roasted veggies, and lime wedges between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Curried Egg Salad Naan Wrap with Roasted Asparagus & Chives

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place asparagus in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until fork-tender, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, place mayo, vinegar, Dijon, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Small dice celery and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl.
Peel and roughly chop the eggs. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the egg salad.
Warm naan in a skillet, oven, or toaster (optional).
Chop chives into small pieces.
Layer each naan with asparagus, egg salad, and chives; roll to close.
To make wraps easier to eat, place each naan on a square of parchment paper. Use the paper to tightly roll and secure each wrap. Otherwise eat as is and get a little messy! Enjoy!

name: Curried Eggless Salad Sandwich with Spring Salad

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.display: ½ (12 oz) pkg extra firm tofu

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Peel and mince (or press) the garlic into a medium salad bowl.
Add the mustard, maple syrup, olive oil, balsamic, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic. Set aside.
Halve the grape tomatoes and set aside.
Shave the leaves off parsley stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces and set both aside.
Halve and pit avocado, scoop flesh out into a medium bowl and mash with a fork  Add Dijon, curry powder, turmeric, cayenne, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Drain tofu. Transfer to paper towels and gently pat dry. Using your hands, crumble tofu into the bowl with the avocado mixture.
amounts: ½ (12 oz) pkg extra firm tofu

instructions.text: Add parsley and green onion to bowl with the tofu and avocado, stir to combine.
Toast bread if desired.
Assemble the sandwiches by arranging several leaves of the spring mix on half the bread slices and topping with equal portions of the tofu salad and a second slice of bread.
Mix remaining spring mix with the dressing and tomatoes.
To serve, arrange a sandwich on each plate with the salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Curried Lentil Dal with a Cucumber Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Rinse lentils under cold water and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and spices; stir and bring to a boil. Lentils should be covered by about 1 inch of liquid; add water if needed.
amounts: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion. Add ¾ of the onion to the saucepan with the lentils. Put the other ¼ in a blender.
Peel, and small dice the carrots. Small dice the tomatoes. Add both to the saucepan with the lentils.
When lentil mixture comes to a boil, stir, cover with a lid and turn to low heat. Simmer for about 20 minutes or until lentils are tender.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Trim and discard the ends of the cucumber; halve the cucumber lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise on an angle. Transfer to a small bowl.
Warm the whole chili in the preheated skillet, 1 minute per side. Remove the stem and add chili to blender. Turn the skillet to medium low heat.
Juice the lemon and add the juice to the blender. Blend with onion, chili, mustard, sugar, salt, and yogurt. Transfer to the small bowl with the cucumber. Gently mix until evenly coated.
Place naan bread in skillet, toasting both sides, about 1 minute per side.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Put aside in a small bowl.
Once lentils are tender, give them a quick pulse with an immersion blender. Stir in half of the cilantro.
To serve, ladle the lentils into a bowl and garnish with the remaining cilantro. Serve with the toasted naan and cucumber salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Curried Pork & Apples over Baked Zucchini Noodles with Cilantro

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles; transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until zucchini noodles are tender, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, quarter, core, and small dice apple. Place in a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the apple.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add apple, garlic, pork, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until apple is tender and meat is browned, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the pork is done, add half of the cilantro to the skillet and stir to combine. Cover and remove from heat. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
To serve, divide zucchini noodles and curried pork between plates or bowls. Top with reserved cilantro and enjoy!

name: Curried Quinoa Salad with Chickpeas, Apples & Feta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa and broth; bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas; set aside to drain further.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes. Once done, remove the quinoa from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Quarter the apple lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; medium dice the apple into ½-inch cubes and transfer to a large salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the celery; medium dice the celery into ½-inch pieces and add to the salad bowl.
Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Transfer the feta to a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Juice the lemon into a small bowl.
To the lemon juice, add olive oil, honey, curry powder, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork.
Add the chickpeas and quinoa to the salad bowl, then pour the dressing overtop and toss to combine.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls and top with the feta. Enjoy!

name: Curried Salmon with Eggplant Puree & Lemony Arugula

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to the broil setting and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Halve the eggplant lengthwise and place the halves cut-side-up in a baking dish.

Place the eggplant in the oven and broil until browned on top, 4 to 5 minutes. Then, flip the halves over and continue to broil until the flesh is tender, another 8 to 10 minutes. Once done, remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
Juice the lemon; divide evenly between a small bowl and a medium salad bowl.
To the lemon juice in the salad bowl, add olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the arugula to the salad bowl and toss to thoroughly coat with the dressing; set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place on a plate; rub with curry powder, salt, and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Carefully place the salmon, skin-side-down, in the skillet; cook until the flesh is opaque and flaky, 3 to 4 minutes per side (depending on thickness). Once done, transfer the salmon to a plate.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the small bowl with the lemon juice.
Scoop the eggplant flesh out of the skin and transfer to a small saucepan; discard the skin.
To the eggplant, add the lemon juice and garlic mixture, olive oil, salt, and pepper; purée the mixture with a hand blender or mash with a potato masher until smooth.
To serve, divide the eggplant purée between plates, place the salmon on top, and add the arugula salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Curried Shrimp Stir-Fry with Noodles, Zucchini, Bell Pepper & Cilantro

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water in the pan is boiling, remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse under cold water; set aside.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Juice lime into a small bowl. Add water, soy sauce, sugar, and spices; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and slice carrot crosswise into thin rounds; add to the bowl with ginger and garlic.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Trim and medium dice zucchini; add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook until the shrimp are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and salt. Stir-fry until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Add drained noodles and sauce to the skillet with the veggies. Continue to cook, tossing frequently, until the liquid is absorbed and noodles are warmed through, 1-2 minutes more.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add cilantro to the skillet, along with cooked shrimp, and toss to combine; remove from heat.
To serve, divide noodles, shrimp, and veggies between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Curried Vegetable Frittata with Goat Cheese & Avocado-Tomato Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, halve tomatoes; add half to the bowl with the other veggies. Place remaining tomatoes in a small bowl and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place eggs, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.

When the veggies are tender, reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Crumble goat cheese over the frittata. Place in the oven and broil until top is set and cheese is slightly melted, 3-4 minutes; remove from oven.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the remaining tomatoes.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Curry-Lime Butternut Squash & Cauliflower Soup with Crispy Chickpeas

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the onion.
Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, curry powder, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to brown, about 15 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and pat dry with paper towels.
Add whole (unpeeled) garlic cloves to the baking sheet with the chickpeas. Drizzle with oil, then season with curry powder and salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring chickpeas halfway through, until crispy and golden, 15-18 minutes.

When the veggies in the saucepan are starting to brown, add broth and coconut milk; bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are very tender, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Meanwhile, zest and juice half of the lime into the reserved bowl. (Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.)
Peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the lime zest and juice.

When the chickpeas and garlic are done, remove from oven. Carefully transfer roasted garlic to the cutting board. Using the back of a spoon, press on the cloves to remove the skins; add garlic to the bowl. Set aside the crispy chickpeas.

Once the veggies are tender, remove soup from heat. Add lime, ginger, and roasted garlic to the pan. Use a hand blender to purée the soup until smooth. Alternatively, use a potato masher to crush the veggies (the soup will be chunkier).
Divide the soup between bowls and top with crispy chickpeas. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: "Currywurst" Sausage Wrap with Red Cabbage, Bell Pepper & Apple Slaw

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the sausages are cooking, place ketchup, water, Worcestershire, vinegar, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl; add yogurt, mayo, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and small dice apple; add to the bowl.
Trim, halve, seed, and slice bell pepper into thin strips; add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw. Set aside.
When the sausages are done, transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into thin rounds.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Place tortillas on a flat surface and top each with a small portion of slaw; arrange sausage slices on top and drizzle with sauce. Roll tightly to close. (Reserve remaining slaw for serving.)
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates; serve with remaining slaw on the side. Enjoy!

name: "Deviled Egg" Pasta Salad with Cucumber, Bell Pepper, Celery & Parsley

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.

While the eggs are cooking, fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and rinse under cold water to cool completely; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and small dice celery; place in a medium bowl.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; add to the bowl with the celery.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl and set aside.

Once the eggs have cooled, peel and halve lengthwise. Using a spoon, separate the yolks from the whites and place the yolks in a small bowl. Roughly chop the egg whites and add to the bowl with the veggies.
Gently mash the yolks with a fork. Add mayo, Dijon, vinegar, and spices to the bowl; stir to combine the dressing.
Add pasta and dressing to the bowl with the veggies; stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Dijon Breaded Pork Chop with Roasted Carrots, Parsnips & Broccoli

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and medium dice carrots and parsnips. Transfer both to a baking sheet pan.

Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the baking sheet with the other veggies, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are golden and fork-tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place mayo, Dijon, and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine.

Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Spread half of the Dijon mayo over the top side of the chops and sprinkle with half of the bread crumbs (pressing gently to adhere). Carefully flip chops and repeat with remaining mayo and bread crumbs.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
To serve, divide veggies and pork chops between plates. Enjoy!

name: Dijon-Caper Potato Salad with Pork Chops & Green Beans

instructions.text: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Trim ends from the green beans; cut potatoes in half.
Add beans to the boiling water and cook until tender-crisp, 1-2 minutes. Using tongs, remove the beans and transfer to a colander, leaving water on the heat. Rinse under cold water and set aside.
Add potatoes to the boiling water and cook until fork-tender, about 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
