Add chops to the skillet and cook, flipping once, until browned on both sides and cooked through, 6-7 minutes. When done, transfer to a plate and cover with aluminum foil; set aside to rest.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic; rinse and roughly chop the capers. Place both in a medium bowl.
Add oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain potatoes and rinse under cold water to cool. Add potatoes and green beans to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine.
Thinly slice the pork chops crosswise into strips.
To serve, divide arugula between plates, top with potato-bean salad and sliced pork. Enjoy!

name: Dijon Kale Salad with Crispy Chickpeas, Apple, Avocado & Almonds

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and pat dry with paper towels. Drizzle with oil and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring chickpeas halfway through, until crispy and golden, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add mayo, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to coat.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Quarter, core, and slice apple into thin wedges. Add to the bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add half to the bowl, along with almonds, and toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with crispy chickpeas, avocado, and remaining Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Dijon Pork Chops with Roasted Brussels Sprouts & Grapes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash brussels sprouts and grapes. Trim ends and halve the brussels sprouts. Pick grapes off the stems. Transfer to a sheet pan.
Drizzle with oil and season with thyme, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Place in the oven and roast until browned and tender, 20 minutes.
In a medium bowl, whisk together Dijon, vinegar, maple syrup, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Add pork chops to marinade and toss to coat.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add pork chops and cook until cooked through, 3-5 minutes per side, depending on thickness. Spoon any remaining marinade over top while cooking.
Remove sheet from oven, drizzle brussels sprouts and grapes with vinegar, and toss to coat.
To serve, place pork chops, brussels sprouts, and grapes on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Easy Korean Stew (Yukgaejang) with Bok Choy & Radishes

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Halve chili pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and place in a medium bowl. (Be careful, with chilies, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl along with oil, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and salt. Whisk to combine the pepper paste.
Thinly slice steak into strips and place in another medium bowl. Add half of the pepper paste and toss to coat. Set aside to marinate.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Using a clean cutting board, trim off and discard root ends of the bok choy; separate into leaves and add to the bowl with the remaining pepper paste.
Trim and cut green onions into 1-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the bok choy.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, trim and quarter the radishes; add to the bowl with the other veggies and toss to coat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add steak to the pot and cook, stirring frequently, until starting to brown, about 2 minutes.
Add broth and veggies to the pot, stirring to combine. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook until steak is cooked through and veggies are tender, 3 minutes more.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, whisk egg and salt in a small bowl.
When the soup is done, slowly pour the egg into the pot, while gently stirring, to separate into strands. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!

name: Edamame Pasta Salad with Peas, Bell Pepper, Tomato, Arugula & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Place edamame and peas in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Add oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and halve bell pepper crosswise; slice into thin strips and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Trim and halve snap peas crosswise; add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add drained edamame and peas to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; add to the bowl.
Add arugula and feta to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Egg Drop Soup with Pork, Spinach & Portobello Mushrooms

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Heat a large pot over medium heat. Once hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add pork to the pot. Cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until crumbly and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic and ginger. Add to the pot with the pork and cook, stirring often, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add broth to the pot and bring to a simmer.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Remove top and seeds from the pepper and slice into thin rounds. (Be careful, with chili peppers, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Remove mushroom stems and scrape out the gills using a spoon; halve and thinly slice.
Once the broth is simmering, add chili pepper, mushrooms, soy sauce, and turmeric. Cook until mushrooms begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
Crack the eggs into a small bowl and beat lightly with a whisk or fork.
Slowly pour the eggs into the soup, while stirring constantly, to separate the egg into ribbons.
Roughly chop spinach, add to the pot, and cook for 2 minutes more.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and drizzle with sesame oil. Enjoy!

name: Egg Salad & Spinach Sandwich with Grape Tomatoes

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, prepared dressing by mixing together garlic, mayo, Dijon, dill, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Wash celery and green onions. Small dice celery and add to bowl with dressing. Trim and discard green onion roots ends, chop, and add to bowl.
Wash and dry spinach.
Wash tomatoes.
Toast bread.
Peel, medium dice, and add eggs to bowl with other ingredients. Stir to combine.
Place bread in pairs on a flat surface. Arrange spinach leaves over one slice of bread in each pair, then top with egg salad and a second slice of bread.
Serve sandwiches with tomatoes on the side and enjoy!

name: Egg Scramble Tacos with Chard, Goat Cheese, Prosciutto & Tomato Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.

Arrange prosciutto in a single layer on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until prosciutto is crisp, 3-5 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine. Set aside to marinate.
Crack eggs into another medium bowl, season with salt, and whisk until smooth. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chard stems and crushed red pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until stems are tender, about 1 minute.

Add chard leaves to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. When the chard is just wilted, add vinegar and salt to the skillet, then stir to combine.

Pour egg mixture into the skillet with the chard and scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are no longer runny. Remove from heat, crumble goat cheese into the skillet, and stir to combine.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the tomato salad and stir to combine.
Crumble or chop prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates; fill with chard scramble and top with crispy prosciutto. Serve with tomato salad and enjoy!

name: Egg & Walnut Caesar Salad with Parmesan Crisps & Creamy Dressing

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 400°F.

Place the eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a full, rolling boil. Once boiling, remove the pan from the heat, cover, and let sit for 10 minutes. Drain and cover with cold water or ice to cool.
Coarsely grate ½ cup of Parmesan.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Measure out 1 tbsp of the grated Parmesan and place in a pile on the sheet. Repeat with remaining cheese.
Place in the oven and bake until lightly browned, 5-7 minutes. Once done, remove from the oven and let them sit for a couple of minutes.
Finely grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
Peel and mince the garlic.
In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together the grated Parmesan, minced garlic, lemon juice, mayo, olive oil, Dijon, coconut aminos, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Roughly chop the walnuts and transfer to a small bowl.
Wash and dry the lettuce. Halve lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1 inch strips.
Peel and quarter the eggs. Gently peel the Parmesan crisps off of the parchment paper. Slice remaining ¼ lemon into wedges.
To serve, arrange a bed of romaine on a plate, add eggs, walnuts, and Parmesan crisps. Drizzle with dressing and lemon juice and enjoy!

name: Eggplant Melts with Fresh Mozzarella & Pan-Fried Chickpeas

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 400°F and place the rack in the center position.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the eggplant lengthwise and place cut-side-up on a baking sheet. Rub with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the eggplant in the oven and roast until softened, 15 to 20 minutes.
Slice the tomato into rounds and place on a plate lined with paper towels.
Drain the mozzarella and pat dry with paper towels; slice into rounds.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas; transfer to paper towels or a clean towel and pat dry.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chickpeas to the skillet and shake to distribute. Cook the chickpeas, shaking occasionally, until they are golden brown and crispy, 5 to 7 minutes.
In a medium bowl, combine and mix together paprika, cumin, and salt.
Using a slotted spoon, transfer the chickpeas to a paper towel lined plate.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven. Top the eggplant halves with tomato and fresh mozzarella slices.
Return the eggplant to the oven and bake until the cheese has melted, another 3 to 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas to the bowl with the spices and toss to coat.
To serve, divide the eggplant melts and chickpeas between plates. Enjoy!

name: Eggplant Shakshuka (North African-Style Egg Dish) with Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the ends of the eggplant; large dice the eggplant into ¾-inch cubes. Transfer to a bowl.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces.
Once the pan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until slightly softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the onion cooks, trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the minced garlic, paprika, cumin, and cayenne pepper to the pan; cook, stirring, until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the eggplant to the pan and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6 to 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes to the pan and stir to combine; simmer for 5 to 6 minutes.
While the tomatoes simmer, using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves.
Stir about ¾ of the cilantro into the tomato mixture (save the rest for garnishing); stir to combine.
Break the eggs into the saucepan.
Season the eggs with salt and pepper.
Reduce the heat to low and cover the pan; cook until the egg whites are set and the yolks are still runny, 5 to 7 minutes.
Place the feta in a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Uncover the pan and garnish the shakshuka with feta and the remaining cilantro.
To serve, divide the shakshuka between plates. Enjoy!

name: Eggplant, Tomato & Chickpea Stew with Couscous & Feta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and discard the ends of the eggplant; medium dice the eggplant (cut into ½-inch cubes) and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch cubes).
Add olive oil to the pan and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the onion to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Peel and mince (or crush) the garlic.
Add broth to a small saucepan and bring to a boil.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add the garlic to the pan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.

Add the eggplant, diced tomatoes, and broth to the pan; season with cumin, salt, pepper, and curry powder. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low; cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggplant is tender, 8 to 10 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the water is boiling, remove the saucepan from the heat. Add salt and couscous and stir. Cover the saucepan and let it sit for 10 minutes.
While the eggplant cooks, drain and rinse the chickpeas in a colander.
Place the feta in a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and chop almost all of the leaves (save a few for garnishing).
Stir the chickpeas and chopped basil into the pan; cook for another 2 to 3 minutes.
Uncover the couscous and fluff with a fork.
To serve, spoon the couscous onto a plate, top with the stew, and garnish with the feta and remaining basil leaves. Enjoy!

name: Eggs Baked in Tomatoes  with Cheese, Cilantro, and Jalapeno Pepper

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat an oven safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice half of the jalapeno pepper. Slice the remaining jalapeno peppers and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and minced jalapeno. Stirring frequently, cook until vegetables are softened, 3-4 minutes.
Halve grape tomatoes and add to the skillet.
Drain and rinse the black beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Add tomato sauce, black beans, oregano, chili powder and salt to the skillet; stir to combine. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until reduced in volume, 6-8 minutes.
Grate mozzarella cheese.
Gently crack the eggs into the skillet. Top with cheese and sliced jalapeno peppers. Bake until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 8 to 10 minutes.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves.
To serve, divide between plates, and garnish with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Eggs in a Tomato, Sweet Potato & Kale Stew (Shakshuka) with Toast

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and coarsely grate sweet potato. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl with the sweet potato and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add sweet potato and onion to the skillet. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.

Once the veggies are tender, add half of the parsley, tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, and spices to the skillet. Stir to combine the stew and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, cook until slightly thickened, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
While the stew is simmering, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.
When the stew has thickened slightly, add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.

Using a stirring spoon, make a well in the stew for each egg; crack an egg into each well and season with salt and pepper. Cover and cook until the egg whites are firm but yolks are still soft, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Finely grate Parmesan.
To serve, divide eggs, stew, and toast between plates. Top with Parmesan and reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Enfrijoladas (Quesadillas with Black Bean Sauce), Avocado & Tomatoes

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and place in a small bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the jalapeño.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add jalapeño, onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 1-2 minutes.

Add beans with their liquid (do not drain) to the pan along with broth. Stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender and sauce is thickened slightly, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese.
To assemble the quesadillas, lay tortillas on a flat surface. Top with cheese and fold in half to close.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden on both sides, 3-4 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, small dice tomatoes. Place on another plate.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the plate with the tomato and set aside.
When the beans are tender, using a potato masher, mash until sauce is smooth and combined.
To serve, divide quesadillas between plates. Top with black bean sauce, tomato, and avocado. Enjoy!

name: "English Breakfast" Frittata with Bacon, Sausage, Tomato & Pinto Beans

instructions.text: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon. Slice sausage crosswise into 1-inch thick rounds.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and sausage; cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy and cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry tomatoes. Using a clean cutting board, thinly slice, then place on a plate and set aside.
Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl with the mushroom.
When the bacon and sausage are done, add mushroom, onion, and spices to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are soft, 4-5 minutes more. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Place eggs, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine. Set aside.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander.
When the veggies are done, add beans to the skillet and stir to combine.

Reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Arrange tomato slices on top of the frittata, then place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set and tomatoes are tender, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: English Muffin Sausage Burger with Fried Egg & Mixed Green Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Place pork and spices in a medium bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip and cook an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through. Remove to a clean plate and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, place ketchup and hot sauce in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spicy ketchup and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Juice lemon into a clean medium bowl. Add mayo, Dijon, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes. Add to the bowl and set aside.

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, split and toast muffins (if desired).
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the cucumber. Toss to combine the salad.

Spread spicy ketchup over one half of each muffin; top with burger patties and fried eggs. Close with the other half of each muffin. Divide burgers between plates and serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: "Everything Spice" Baked Salmon Rice Bowl with Avocado & Tomatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, transfer tomatoes to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until tomatoes are just beginning to burst, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, place seeds and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the "everything spice" mixture.

Pat the salmon dry with paper towels, season with salt, and place, skin-side down, on a plate. Spread the top-side with Dijon, then sprinkle evenly with the spice mixture, pressing gently to adhere. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
When the tomatoes are starting to burst, remove from the oven. Add salmon to the baking sheet, nestling the fillets into the tomatoes.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until the tomatoes are browned and salmon is cooked through, 7-8 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into the reserved bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside.
Halve and pit avocado. Halve lengthwise and slice thinly while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide rice between bowls. Top with salmon, roasted tomatoes, avocado, and capers, then drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: "Everything Spice" Crusted Salmon with Avocado, Cucumber & Caper Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place seeds and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the "everything spice" mixture.
Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on the baking sheet. Spread with Dijon, then sprinkle evenly with the spice mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Place fish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, capers, and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion crosswise into half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; cut crosswise while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon into the bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide the salmon and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: "Everything Spice" Fried Egg Bowl with Spinach, Smoked Salmon & Toast

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince shallot.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the shallot and cook, stirring often, until softened, about 2 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic.

Add garlic, seeds, salt, and pepper to the skillet with the shallot. Continue to cook, stirring often, until the shallot and garlic become golden, 2-3 minutes more. Transfer "everything spice" to a small bowl to keep the garlic from overcooking. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and slice cucumber into thin rounds; place on a plate.
Halve tomatoes and add to the plate with the cucumber.
Zest lemon into another small bowl. Slice lemon into wedges, add to the plate with the veggies, and set aside.

Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon zest along with goat cheese and crushed red pepper; mash with the back of a spoon to combine and set aside.
Return skillet to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, halve rolls and toast if desired; spread with lemon-dill goat cheese.
Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces.
Divide spinach between bowls. Top with cucumber, tomatoes, lemon wedges, eggs, and smoked salmon; sprinkle with "everything spice." Serve with goat cheese rolls on the side and enjoy!

name: "Everything Spice" Green Goddess Salad with Smoked Salmon & Eggs

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, place seeds and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the "everything spice" mixture. Set aside for serving.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a blender.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Roughly chop chives. Add to the blender along with yogurt, oil, capers, anchovy fillet, and spices. Blend on high until dressing is smooth; set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Trim and large dice cucumber. Place on a plate.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the plate with the cucumber.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and large dice the flesh. Add to the plate.
Peel and quarter eggs. Add to the plate.
Chop or tear smoked salmon into bite-sized pieces. Add to the plate.
Chop or tear lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces.
Divide lettuce between plates or bowls. Top with cucumber, tomatoes, avocado, eggs, smoked salmon, and additional capers. Sprinkle with everything spice and serve with dressing on the side. Enjoy!

name: Fajita-Style Pork Bowl with Bell Peppers, Onions, Kale & Lime Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine the spice mix; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, halve, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips; add to the baking sheet with the bell pepper.

Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board; thinly slice crosswise into bite-sized strips. Add to the baking sheet, sprinkle with ⅔ of the spice mix, then drizzle with oil; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve remaining spice mix for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until veggies start to soften, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander. Add beans to the bowl with the kale along with oil and salt; toss to combine.
When the veggies are soft, add kale and beans to the baking sheet; toss to combine, then return to the oven and continue to bake until kale is tender and pork is cooked through, 5-6 minutes more.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lime into the bowl with the remaining spice mix; add yogurt and water, then stir to combine the sauce.
To serve, divide pork, beans, and veggies between bowls; drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

name: Falafel-Inspired Burger with Tahini Mayo, Avocado & Cucumber Salad

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans; set aside to drain further.
Trim and thinly slice cucumber. Place in a medium bowl, along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Peel and mince garlic and shallot. Place half the garlic and shallot in the bowl with the cucumber and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Place remaining garlic and shallot in another medium bowl. Juice lemon into the same bowl.
Add beans and chili-garlic sauce to the bowl with the lemon juice. Crush the beans with a fork or potato masher until they are broken down.
Shave parsley and cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Drain and mince artichokes. Grate cheese. Add both to the bowl.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Add the egg, bread crumbs, baking powder, and spices to the bowl and stir to combine. Mash the chickpeas once more, until a cohesive mixture is formed.

Divide the mixture into 2 portions (about ⅔ cup each). Using your hands, form each portion into a ball, then flatten into a 1-inch thick patty. (The patties will be moist and delicate; they will firm up upon cooking.)
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Carefully transfer patties to the skillet and cook until dark brown on one side, 5-6 minutes. Gently flip the patties and cook until dark brown on the other side, 5 minutes more. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, place mayo, tahini, water, and salt in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the tahini mayo.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out. Slice tomato into rounds.
Toast buns if desired.
Place the bottom half of a bun on each plate. Layer with a falafel patty, tahini mayo, avocado, and tomato; close with the top half of the bun. Serve with cucumber salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Falafel-Inspired Salad with Crispy Chickpeas & Lemon Tahini Dressing

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry, then transfer to a large bowl.
Add oil, sesame seeds, and spices to the bowl with the chickpeas; stir to combine.

Transfer chickpeas to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 15 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; transfer to the reserved bowl.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Medium dice tomato; add both to the bowl with the carrot.
Trim off and discard tops and root ends of radishes; thinly slice and add to the bowl.
Cut romaine crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro and parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add tahini, water, Dijon, sugar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
To serve, divide salad between plates. Top with crispy chickpeas and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Fennel, Zucchini, Corn & Feta Frittata with Kale-Tomato Pine Nut Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add mayo, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in another medium bowl.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the fennel.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fennel, zucchini, corn, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender but not browned, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, crack eggs into the reserved bowl. Add half of the feta (reserving the rest for the salad) and spices, then whisk to combine. Set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

When the veggies are tender, pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, about 5 minutes.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until top of the frittata is just set, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with reserved feta and pine nuts, then toss to combine the salad.
Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Fettuccine Alfredo with Asparagus

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 9-10 minutes.
amounts: 6 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) fettuccine pasta

instructions.text: Wash asparagus and snap off woody ends. Cut diagonally into 2 inch pieces. Add to pasta during the last 2-3 minutes of cooking time.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Add butter to pan and swirl to coat. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Sprinkle flour into pan and whisk until combined with the butter.
Add broth and whisk until smooth. Then add milk and stir until sauce is thickened, 4-5 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Finely grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Add Parmesan, salt, and pepper to sauce. Stir until smooth, then reduce heat to low until pasta is ready.
Drain pasta and asparagus in a colander, reserving about ½ cup of the pasta water.
Add pasta, asparagus, and ½ of the reserved pasta water to sauce. Toss to combine. Add more pasta water to thin out the sauce if desired.
Place on a plate, garnish with freshly ground pepper, and enjoy!

name: Fettuccine Alfredo with Chicken & Peas

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 9-10 minutes.
amounts: 6 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) fettuccine pasta

instructions.text: Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with Italian seasoning.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add butter to skillet and swirl to coat. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and no longer pink inside, 3-5 minutes per side.
Peel and mince garlic.
Transfer chicken to a plate. Wash and dry pan; return to stove over medium heat.
Add butter to pan and swirl to coat. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Sprinkle flour into pan and whisk until combined with the butter.
Add broth and whisk until smooth. Then add milk and stir until sauce is thickened, 4-5 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Finely grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Add Parmesan, salt, and pepper to sauce. Stir until smooth, then reduce heat to low until pasta is ready.
Measure out peas.
Slice chicken diagonally into thin strips.
Drain pasta in a colander, reserving about ½ cup of the pasta water.
Add pasta, chicken, peas, and ½ of the reserved pasta water to sauce. Toss to combine. Add more pasta water to thin out the sauce is desired.
Place on a plate, garnish with freshly ground pepper, and enjoy!

name: Fettuccine with Tomatoes, Ricotta & Lemony Dressed Arugula

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ½-cup of pasta cooking water before draining.)
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and crushed red pepper; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant and golden, about 1 minute.

Add tomatoes and salt to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until simmering. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 12-15 minutes more.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in a small bowl along with ricotta and salt, then stir to combine. Set aside.
Wash, dry, zest, and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Add drained pasta and reserved pasta water to the skillet with the sauce. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta and arugula between plates or bowls. Top pasta with ricotta and crushed red pepper. Enjoy!

name: Fiesta Fish Taco Rice Bowl with Black Beans & Veggies

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Peel and mince garlic. Wash, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Remove husks and silks from corn. Hold vertically in the middle of a bowl and slice kernels off the cob.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
In a small bowl, mix together chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Rub fish with spice mixture.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add fish and cook until white and flaky, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to plate and set aside.
Return skillet to stove. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add bell pepper and corn and, stirring occasionally, cook until tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
Drain and rinse black beans. Add to skillet and stir until heated through, about 1 minute.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Halve and pit avocado; scoop out and medium dice.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place rice in a bowl and top with bean mixture and fish. Garnish with avocado, cilantro, and lime juice. Enjoy!

name: Filipino Beef Skillet (Giniling) with Potatoes, Peppers & Raisins

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and small dice potatoes.
Once the skillet is hot, add potatoes and ground beef; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice carrot; place in a small bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the carrot.
When the beef is done, add veggies to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 6-7 minutes more.
While the veggies are cooking, trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers.
When the veggies are starting to soften, add bell peppers to the skillet along with tomato sauce, raisins, soy sauce, and spices. Stir to combine, cover, and bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are tender and liquid is mostly absorbed, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide skillet between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: "Fish and Chips" Tacos with Chive Mayo & Crunchy Veggie-Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and small dice potato.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add potato and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and tender, 10-12 minutes. Transfer potatoes to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, zest lemon into a small bowl. (Cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.)

Chop chives into small pieces. Add half to the bowl with the lemon zest along with mayo, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the chive mayo and set aside. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
Pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch pieces. Place in a medium bowl, season with spices, and gently toss to coat.

When the potatoes are done, return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cod and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates. Spread with chive mayo, fill with fish and potatoes, then top with reserved chives. Serve with salad on the side and lemon wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!

name: Fish Tacos with Avocado-Peach Salsa

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard the pit; small dice the quarters into ¼-inch cubes. Transfer to a medium bowl (that will hold the salsa).
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and small dice the flesh into ¼-inch cubes. Add to the salsa bowl.
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the salsa bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salsa bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and finely dice the shallot. Add to the salsa bowl.
Add olive oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: While the skillet heats up, pat the fish dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with chili powder, salt, and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add the fish; cook until it is cooked through and flakes easily, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Juice the lime and add to the salsa bowl.
Season the salsa with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
Wrap the tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until heated through, 15 to 30 seconds.
Using a fork or your hands, flake the fish.
To serve, divide the fish between the tortillas and top with the avocado-peach salsa. Enjoy!

name: Fish Tacos with Guacamole & Napa Cabbage Slaw

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut out and discard the core from the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise and transfer to a large bowl.
Small dice the tomato and add to the cabbage.
Halve and pit the avocado; cube the flesh while still in the skin. Scoop out the flesh into a small bowl.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ of the cilantro to the cabbage and the other ½ to the avocado.
Juice the lime into a small bowl; add ½ to the cabbage and the other ½ to the avocado.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Place the fish on a plate, drizzle with olive oil, and season with chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Place the fish in the grill pan or skillet; cook until opaque and golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Season the avocado with salt and pepper; mash with a fork until smooth.
Season the cabbage mixture with salt and pepper; toss until well combined.
Place the tortillas on a plate and cover with a damp paper towel. Microwave for 30 to 60 seconds until they are warmed through. (This step is optional.)
Using your hands or a fork, flake the fish.
Divide the cabbage slaw among the tortillas (leaving any extra on the side), then add the fish, and spoon dollops of the guacamole on top. Enjoy!

name: Fish Tacos with Mango-Jalapeño Salsa & Lime Crema

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel the mangoes, then slice off the flesh from the pit, starting with the flatter sides; discard the pit and small dice the flesh (cut into ¼-inch cubes). Transfer to a medium bowl (that will hold the salsa).
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the salsa bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and add to the salsa bowl.
Add olive oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: While the skillet heats up, pat the sole fillets dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add the fish fillets and cook until opaque throughout, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate. Cook in batches if necessary.
While the fish cooks, using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salsa.
Juice the lime; add ½ of the juice to the salsa and the other ½ to a small bowl.
Season the salsa with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
Add yogurt to the bowl of lime juice and stir to combine.
Place the tortillas on a small plate and cover with a damp paper towel; microwave until heated through, 15 to 30 seconds.
Flake the fish with a fork.
To serve, divide the fish among the tortillas, top with the salsa, and drizzle with the crema. Enjoy!

name: Fish Tacos with Strawberry-Avocado Salsa

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the stem ends of the strawberries; small dice the strawberries. Transfer to a medium bowl (that will hold the salsa).
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and small dice the flesh. Add to the salsa bowl.
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the salsa bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salsa bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and finely dice the shallot. Add to the salsa bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan / skillet heats up, pat the fish dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Rub with olive oil and season with chili powder, salt, and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Once the grill pan / skillet is hot, add the fish; cook until it is cooked through and flakes easily, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Juice half of the lime and add to the salsa bowl; cut the remaining half into wedges for serving.
Season the salsa with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
Wrap the tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until heated through, 15 to 30 seconds.
Using a fork or your hands, flake the fish.
To serve, divide the fish between the tortillas and top with the strawberry-avocado salsa; serve with lime wedges on the side. Enjoy!

name: Fish Tikka Naan Wrap with Yogurt, Cilantro & Veggie-Mango Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a medium bowl.
Juice half of the lemon into the bowl with the ginger and garlic (set remaining lemon aside for later use). Add yogurt, spices, and sugar; whisk to combine the marinade.
Cut fish into 1-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the marinade, gently stir to coat, and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6 inches from the top. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Juice remaining lemon into another medium bowl; add oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; small dice and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice cucumber; halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add both to the bowl and set aside.

Transfer fish to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, turning the fish pieces halfway through, until golden and flesh flakes with a fork, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies, then stir to combine the salad.
Just before serving, arrange naan on another baking sheet. Place in the oven and broil, flipping once, until toasted 1-2 minutes; remove from oven.
Spread yogurt over each naan and top with a small portion of salad and the fish. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)

To make wraps easier to eat, place each naan on a square of parchment paper. Use the paper to tightly roll and secure each wrap. Otherwise, eat as is and get a little messy! Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Flank Steak with Cauliflower, Pickled Onions & Tahini-Yogurt Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Place vinegar, honey, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until the cauliflower is golden and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into another small bowl.
Add yogurt, tahini, water, pepper, and salt to the bowl with the lemon. Whisk to combine.

Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the yogurt, whisk once more to combine the sauce, and set aside. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and yogurt sauce between plates; top yogurt with cauliflower and pickled onions. Sprinkle with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Flank Steak with Italian-Style Spicy Fennel, Orange & Olive Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Mince anchovy fillets. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place steak on a plate, season with salt and pepper on both sides, then drizzle with half of the dressing. Turn to coat and set aside to marinate, 15 minutes. (Reserve remaining dressing for the next step.)
While the steak is marinating, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the remaining dressing.
Halve olives lengthwise and add to the bowl.
Cut off skin and white pith from orange; slice between the membranes to release segments. Add to the bowl and set aside.
When the steak is done marinating, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the olives and orange segments.
Pick parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems. Add leaves to the bowl and gently stir to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Flank Steak Street Tacos with Cilantro & Spicy Cabbage-Jalapeño Slaw

instructions.text: Place soy sauce, oil, and spices in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the marinade.

Pat steak dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Slice crosswise into thin strips, then cut each strip into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in another medium bowl. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Juice lime into the bowl with the cilantro. Add oil and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons and add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw; set aside
When the steak is done marinating, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add steak and cook, undisturbed, until browned, 2-3 minutes. Turn and continue to cook until desired doneness, 1-2 minutes more. Transfer to a plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and mince onion. Set aside for serving.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas and slaw between plates. Top tortillas with steak, hot sauce, onion, and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Flank Steak Tacos with Green Onion Chimichurri & Lime-Dressed Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place half in a small bowl and half in a medium bowl. (Set medium bowl aside for the salad.)

Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the small bowl with the green onion along with vinegar, water, oil, and spices. Stir to combine the chimichurri and set aside.
Juice lime into the medium bowl with the green onion. Add mayo, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad; set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board; slice crosswise into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and stir-fry until just cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates; fill with a small portion of salad, then top with steak and chimichurri. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: "Four Seasons" Pizza with Prosciutto, Olives, Mushrooms & Artichokes

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Place tomato sauce and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and cut mushrooms into ¼-inch thick slices. Transfer to a plate.
Slice olives and add to the plate with the mushrooms.
Drain and slice artichokes; add to the plate.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces and place on the plate.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Spread tomato sauce over each toasted flatbread and sprinkle with cheese.
Divide mushrooms, olives, artichokes, and prosciutto between flatbreads, piling each ingredient in their own quarter.
Return prepared flatbreads to the oven and bake until cheese is melted and mushrooms have softened, 5-7 minutes. Remove from the oven.
To serve, slice flatbread pizzas into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: "French Onion" Orzo Skillet with Spinach, Thyme & Toasted Sourdough

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and caramelized, 15-18 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Place leaves in another skillet.

Add orzo, broth, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper to the skillet with the thyme. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer over high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the orzo is cooking, finely grate mozzarella. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.
Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed.)
When the onions are caramelized, carefully transfer them to the skillet with the orzo. Stir to combine. (Reserve skillet for later use.)

Add spinach to the skillet with the orzo in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Return to medium-high heat and continue to cook until spinach is completely wilted, 2-3 minutes more.
Once the spinach is wilted, remove from heat, sprinkle with grated cheese, and cover with a lid. Set aside until cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, return skillet used for the onions to medium-high heat. Add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread slices and pan-fry until toasted on one side, about 1 minute.
Remove bread to a plate and add more butter to the skillet. Return bread to the skillet, toasted-side up, and continue to pan-fry until toasted on the other side, 1 minute more. Return to the plate.
Divide orzo between plates or bowls. Serve with toasted sourdough on the side and enjoy!

name: Fresh Corn, Peach, Avocado & Goat Cheese Salad with Garlic Breadsticks

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with oil and spices. Stir to combine the garlic oil.

Drizzle garlic oil over the flatbread, cut into 1½-inch wide strips, and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove husks and silks from the corn. Using a knife, carefully slice corn kernels off the cobs; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter peach lengthwise (around the pit); twist to separate and remove pit. Medium dice and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Peel and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl and gently stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and breadsticks between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Fresh Corn "Polenta" with Fried Eggs & Goat Cheese-Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Remove husks and silks from corn. Using your hands, snap each ear in half. Working over a large bowl, coarsely grate corn off of the cob, catching all of the kernels and corn juices in the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.

Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add corn and its juices to the saucepan, along with cream, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the corn is cooked and most of the liquid has evaporated, 3-4 minutes. Reserve bowl for later use.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Add to the saucepan with the corn and stir to combine the polenta. Cover and remove from heat.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes. Add to the bowl along with the arugula and toss to combine the salad.
Crumble goat cheese.
To serve, divide polenta, eggs, and salad between plates. Top the salad with goat cheese and enjoy!

name: Fresh Creamed Corn Fettuccine with Lettuce, Cucumber & Tomato Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Reserve ½-cup cooking water before draining; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Remove husks and silks from the corn. Using a knife, carefully slice corn kernels off the cobs and place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; peel and small dice half the onion (reserving the rest for later use). Add both to the bowl with the corn.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add corn, garlic, onion, broth, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until corn starts to soften and break down, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Thinly slice remaining onion. Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise; slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl; set aside.
Cut cream cheese into small pieces. Finely grate Parmesan.
When the corn is ready, add cream cheese and Parmesan to the skillet. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring often, until cheese melts and the sauce thickens slightly, 2-3 minutes.
Transfer pasta to the skillet and toss to combine; add reserved pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency. Remove from heat.
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the veggies and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Fresh Mozzarella & Cucumber Sandwich with Green Goddess Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Juice lemon into a blender.
Peel garlic and add to the blender.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.

Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender, along with yogurt, mayo, oil, capers, salt, and pepper. Blend on high until dressing is smooth, then transfer half to a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining dressing for later use.)
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Trim and cut cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Place on a plate.
Slice mozzarella into rounds. Add to the plate with the cucumber.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Toast bread if desired.

To assemble the sandwiches, spread each bread slice with the reserved dressing. Layer half of the slices with cucumber and mozzarella. Season with salt, close with remaining bread slices, and cut in half.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Fried Cabbage Skillet with Sausages

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and transfer to a small bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the sausages to the skillet; cook, turning occasionally, until they are browned on all sides and cooked through, 10 to 15 minutes total. Once done, transfer to a plate.
While the sausages cook, trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the onion.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into shreds and transfer to a large bowl.
Once the sausages have been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet followed by the onion and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until the onion is softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and ¼ cup of water to the skillet; mix together.
Add the cabbage to the skillet and season with crushed red pepper, salt, and pepper. Increase the heat to medium-high and cook, stirring frequently, until the cabbage is softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle and transfer to a small bowl.
Slice the sausages into ¼-inch-thick rounds.
Add the sausage slices and about ¾ of the green onions to the skillet; mix with the cabbage until well combined.
To serve, divide the cabbage and sausage mixture between bowls and sprinkle with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Fried Cauliflower Rice with Bacon, Spinach, Mushrooms & Eggs

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate; set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)

Using a clean cutting board, cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower and place in a medium bowl; set aside.
Thinly slice mushrooms.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl with the cauliflower and set the other half aside for garnish.
When the mushrooms are soft, add cauliflower, green onion, and oil to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is soft and beginning to brown, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small bowl along with soy sauce and maple syrup; whisk to combine the sauce.

When the cauliflower is done, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add sauce, stir to combine, and continue to cook until heated through, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
Preheat another skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add additional oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and eggs between plates. Garnish rice with crispy bacon, reserved green onion, and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Fried Egg Rice Bowl with Pickled Carrot & Ginger-Green Onion Sauce

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into thin pieces; place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger; add to the bowl with the green onion along with oil, vinegar, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce. Stir to combine the sauce and set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place additional vinegar, water, sugar, and salt in another small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice cucumber crosswise into rounds.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh.
To serve, divide the rice, eggs, pickled carrots, cucumber, and avocado between bowls. Top with ginger-green onion sauce and enjoy!

name: Fried Egg Sandwich with Cheddar, Avocado & Tomato-Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-moons. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad; set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the eggs are cooking, thinly slice cheddar.
Place bread on a baking sheet pan; place in the oven and broil until bread is toasted on one side, 1-2 minutes.

Remove baking sheet from the oven, flip bread, and arrange cheese over half of the slices. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to broil until bread is toasted and cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
Layer each cheesy toast slice with two fried eggs and avocado. Spread mayo over remaining toast slices and place on top to close sandwiches.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Gado-gado Salad Bowl with Spicy  Peanut Dressing

instructions.text: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add salt, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Place eggs in a medium saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel sweet potato; slice lengthwise and crosswise into ¼-inch half rounds. Once the water is boiling in the large pot, add the potatoes and cook until tender, 5-7 minutes.
