Meanwhile, peel and trim carrot; coarsely grate. Transfer to a large plate.
Quarter the cabbage lengthwise (into wedges) and cut out the core; chop crosswise into bite-sized pieces (about 1-inch-wide). Transfer to the plate with the carrots.
Seed and slice pepper into thin strips. Transfer to the plate.
Trim and slice cucumber into thin rounds. Add to the plate.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Trim the green beans. Add to the potatoes during the last 2-3 minutes of cooking time and cook until bright green and tender-crisp. Drain veggies in a colander and rinse under cold water.
Juice the lime into a medium bowl. Add peanut butter, water, soy sauce, maple syrup, and chili-garlic sauce; whisk until smooth. Set aside.
Peel and cut eggs in half.
To serve, divide the cabbage between bowls, top with sweet potatoes, green beans, eggs, peppers, carrots, and cucumbers. Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with peanuts and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Garlic-Avocado Toast with Marinated Mozzarella, Basil & Side Salad

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Mince the sun-dried tomatoes and place in a small bowl. Add oil and spices; stir to combine the marinade.
Cut mozzarella into ½-inch cubes and add to the bowl with the marinade; gently toss to coat the cheese and set aside.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and mince bell pepper; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Mince artichokes and add to the bowl.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Chop or tear lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
Peel and mince additional garlic; place in another small bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the garlic oil.
Slice buns in half and place, cut-side up, on a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with garlic oil.
Place buns in the oven and toast until golden, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Set aside.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon. Arrange avocado slices on top of the garlic toast.
To serve, divide garlic-avocado toast and salad between plates; spoon marinated mozzarella over the toasts and garnish with basil. Enjoy!

name: Garlic-Dijon Ribeye with Warm Zucchini, Tomato, Mint & Feta Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim zucchini, quarter lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 2-inch long pieces; transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to coat; spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until zucchini is fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Cut steak into portions, place on a plate, and drizzle with marinade on both sides; turn to coat and set aside.
While the steaks are marinating, zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince additional garlic; peel and mince shallot. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Slice tomato lengthwise into wedges; add to the bowl, stir to coat, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, add steaks and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate.
While the steaks are cooking, pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the zucchini is done, add to the bowl with the dressing and tomatoes. Add mint and toss to combine the warm salad.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates; sprinkle feta over salad and enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Garlic Dill Yogurt with Arugula & Fried Eggs

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Coarsely chop walnuts. Toast walnuts until fragrant (2-4 minutes). Stir in red pepper flakes and butter until melted. Set walnuts aside in a bowl and return skillet to the heat.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Gently crack the eggs into the skillet. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, separate the eggs. Cook in batches if necessary.
Trim off the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the medium bowl with the garlic.
Add plain yogurt, olive oil, salt and pepper to the medium bowl and stir until smooth and well combined.
In a medium bowl, toss arugula with remaining olive oil and salt.
Toast flatbread if desired.
To serve, divide yogurt, flat bread, arugula, and eggs between plates. Top with walnuts and enjoy!

name: Garlic & Lemon Seared Steak Bites with Zucchini Noodles

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry lemon; zest and juice into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon.
Add broth, soy sauce, and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels, then cut into 1-inch cubes.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add steak and cook, stirring occasionally, until desired doneness, 3-4 minutes for medium. Transfer to a plate and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash zucchini, trim ends, and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Use a paper towel or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the zucchini noodles.
Add sauce to the skillet and whisk. Cook, stirring frequently, until the mixture is reduced by about half, 3-4 minutes.

Stir in butter and, once melted, add zucchini noodles. Cook, stirring constantly, until just tender, 2-3 minutes. Use tongs to remove from skillet and portion onto plates, leaving the excess sauce in the pan.
Return steak to the skillet and toss to coat in the sauce.
To serve, transfer steak to plates with the noodles and top with any remaining sauce. Enjoy!

name: Garlic Paprika Chicken Drumsticks with Avocado, Tomato & Greens Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F. Line a baking dish with foil.
Peel and mince or press the garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Add lime juice, olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper to the minced garlic and mix well.
Add the chicken drumsticks to the garlic-paprika mixture and toss until well coated. Place the drumsticks in the baking dish.
Place the drumsticks in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through cooking time, until they are cooked through and browned, 25-30 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together lime juice, olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Wash and dry the mixed greens.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and halve the tomatoes.
Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh and medium dice.
To serve, arrange the greens on plates, top with tomatoes and avocado, and drizzle with the dressing. Add chicken drumsticks to the side. Enjoy!

name: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wings with Spicy Roasted Carrot

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
In a medium bowl, mix together oregano, thyme, cumin, and salt. Add chicken wings and toss to coat.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken wings and brown on both sides, 2-3 minutes per side. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, occasionally flipping, until cooked through, 10-12 minutes.
Wash and dry carrots; trim ends and thinly slice, using a mandoline or knife, into rounds.
Brush a sheet pan with oil to prevent sticking. Transfer carrots to sheet. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Spread out in a single layer and place in the oven. Bake until crispy, 10-12 minutes. Watch carefully because they can burn quickly.

Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems, discard the stems and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic. Grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan. In a medium bowl, mix together parsley, garlic, Parmesan, and salt.
Add chicken wings to bowl and toss to coat.
To serve, place chicken wings and carrots on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Garlic-Parmesan Pork Chops with Spinach, Mushrooms & Zucchini Noodles

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Place in a small bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer chops to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, thinly slice mushrooms.
Peel and mince garlic.
Return skillet to medium heat and add more oil. Add mushrooms and garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms begin to soften, 4-5 minutes.
While the mushrooms are cooking, cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Finely grate Parmesan.

Add cream cheese, Parmesan, broth, and spices to the skillet; stir until cheese is melted and combined. Bring to a simmer and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add spinach and zucchini noodles to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for them to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Return pork chops to the skillet and turn to coat in sauce.
To serve, divide saucy veggies and pork chops between plates. Enjoy!

name: Garlic-Parmesan Ribeye with Roasted Brussels Sprouts & Carrots

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a small bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Mash together with the back of a spoon and stir to combine the garlic oil.
Cut steak into portions and spread garlic oil on both sides; set aside on a plate to marinate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry Brussels sprouts. Using a clean cutting board, trim ends and halve the sprouts; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Wash, dry, peel, trim, and cut carrot crosswise into ½-inch rounds; add to the baking sheet with the Brussels sprouts.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, add steaks and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side.
While the steaks cook, finely grate Parmesan.
When the steaks are done, transfer to a clean plate and top with the Parmesan. Loosely cover with aluminum foil and let rest, about 5 minutes.
To serve, divide roasted veggies and steaks between plates. Enjoy!

name: Garlic Parmesan Spaghetti Squash with Spinach

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place the rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim off and discard the ends of the squash; halve the squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds from each half.
Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange the squash halves cut-side-down on the baking sheet.
Place squash halves in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, about 25 minutes.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the garlic to the skillet, stir until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Add the spinach to the skillet and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring frequently, until the spinach has wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Grate Parmesan cheese; reserve a small amount for garnish.
Stir the cream and Parmesan into the spinach. Cook until the Parmesan has melted and incorporated into the cream; remove from heat.

Once tender, remove the squash halves from the oven; allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand). Transfer to the skillet with the sauce and toss to combine.
Divide between plates, garnish with reserved Parmesan, and enjoy!

name: Garlic-Rosemary Chicken Drumsticks with Sautéed Brussels Sprouts

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat the oven to 450°F and position the rack in the center. Place a baking dish (one that is big enough to hold the chicken) inside the oven to warm up.
Trim off and discard the stem ends of the Brussels sprouts, then remove the outer layer of leaves; halve the sprouts lengthwise (or quarter if they are large).
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat dry the chicken with paper towels and place on a plate, then generously season with salt and pepper.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the drumsticks in the skillet; cook, turning every 1 minute or so, until the they are browned on all sides (but not cooked through). Once done, remove the baking dish from the oven and transfer the chicken to it.
While the chicken cooks, one by one, holding a sprig of rosemary at its top, run you fingers down it to remove the leaves. Discard the sprigs and chop the leaves.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Juice the lemon into a small bowl.

Once the chicken has been transferred, return the skillet to the stove and reduce the heat to medium. Add the rosemary, garlic, ½ of the lemon juice, and ½ of the broth to the skillet. Deglaze the skillet by scraping up browned bits from the bottom.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Pour the skillet sauce over top of the chicken. Place the chicken in the oven and bake until it is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Add more coconut oil to the skillet.
Add the Brussels sprouts to the skillet and cook until they are lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes.
Once the sprouts are browned, add the remaining broth and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sprouts are tender and the liquid has evaporated, 3 to 4 minutes.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, place the chicken and Brussels sprouts on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Garlic-Rosemary Drumsticks & Cheesy Smashed Cauliflower with Chives

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Slide rosemary leaves off the sprigs; discard sprigs and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the herb paste.
Place chicken on the baking sheet; using your hands, coat drumsticks with herb paste and arrange in a single layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until golden brown and cooked through, 30-35 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water is heating, cut cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard leaves and thick stem. Separate into 2-inch wide florets.
Once the water comes to a boil, uncover and add cauliflower; stir for a few seconds. Cover and return to a boil; cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
While the cauliflower is cooking, grate the cheese. Chop chives into small pieces.
Drain cauliflower, then carefully transfer the florets to another baking sheet; drizzle with oil and season with spices.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Using a fork or potato masher, gently crush each cauliflower floret, flattening them to about a ½-inch thickness. Gather any loose cauliflower pieces into small piles of about the same size.
Sprinkle cauliflower with cheese and chives.
Add baking sheet to the oven and bake until cheese is golden and bubbly, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide drumsticks and cheesy cauliflower between plates. Enjoy!

name: Garlic-Rosemary Lamb Chops with Roasted Asparagus & Mushrooms

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Slide rosemary leaves off the sprigs; discard sprigs and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the garlic, along with oil, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Pat lamb chops dry with paper towels, place on a plate, and coat both sides with half the garlic-rosemary oil; set aside.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus. Transfer spears to a baking sheet pan.
Remove stems and slice mushrooms into ¼-inch pieces; add to the baking sheet with the asparagus.
Drizzle remaining garlic-rosemary oil over the veggies, toss to coat, and place in the oven. Bake, tossing once, until fork-tender, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add chops and cook, flipping once, until desired doneness, 4-5 minutes for medium-rare. Transfer to a clean plate and cover loosely with foil.
To serve, divide veggies and lamb chops between plates. Enjoy!

name: Garlic & Sage Chicken Thighs with Maple Roasted Acorn Squash

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and position rack in the centre.
Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, mix together the minced garlic, olive oil, sage, salt, and pepper.
Wash and thinly slice lemon.
Add chicken and lemon slices to bowl; toss to coat. Set aside.
Heat a saucepan over medium heat. Add butter, maple syrup, chill powder, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 2-3 minutes while you prepare the squash.
Wash and halve squash lengthwise. Scoop out the seeds and cut crosswise into ¼ inch thick slices.
Lightly coat a baking sheet with olive oil.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add squash slices to baking sheet and pour butter-maple mixture over top. Toss to coat and arrange slices in a single layer.
Place chicken and lemon slices on top of squash. Place in the oven and roast until squash is tender and chicken is cooked though, 12-15 minutes.
Serve chicken thighs with squash on the side. Enjoy!

name: Garlicky Bean, Swiss Chard, Bell Pepper & Almond Sauté with Eggs

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into thin strips.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peppers and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and starting to brown, about 10 minutes.

While the peppers are cooking, fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add vinegar, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once the water in the pan is boiling, reduce heat to medium-low.

Meanwhile, wash and dry chard; fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in a medium bowl and stems in a small bowl.
Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the bowl with the stems and set aside.
Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
When the peppers are tender, add chard stems, garlic, smoked paprika, and salt to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until garlic is fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add beans to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, about 30 seconds.
Add chard leaves to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add vinegar and stir to combine. Remove from heat and set aside.
Gently crack eggs into two additional small bowls (two eggs per bowl).

Adjust the heat of the saucepan as necessary so that the water is simmering. Gently tip bowls into the pan, sliding the eggs carefully into the water. Cook until whites are set but yolks are still soft, 2½-3 minutes. Using the slotted spoon, transfer eggs to a plate, then season with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, roughly chop almonds.
To serve, divide veggies between plates or bowls; top with almonds and poached eggs. Enjoy!

name: Garlicky Chicken, Tomato & Asparagus Skillet with Rice-Pasta Pilaf

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water. Set aside to drain.

Trim off the root ends and the dark green tops of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Add leaves to the bowl with the leek.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the saucepan heats up, use your hands to break the pasta into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the leek and thyme.

Once the saucepan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add leek, thyme, and pasta. Cook, stirring constantly, until the pasta turns golden, 1-2 minutes. Stir in the rice, broth, and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid in the saucepan comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook until rice and pasta are tender and the liquid is mostly absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry, without turning, until golden underneath, 5-6 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic; halve tomatoes. Place both in the reserved bowl.

Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus; cut into 1-inch pieces. Once the chicken is done, add asparagus, garlic, and tomatoes to the reserved skillet; stir to combine, then nestle chicken, cooked-side up, into the veggies.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, 10-12 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken, veggies, and rice-pasta pilaf between plates. Drizzle skillet sauce over the chicken and enjoy!

name: Garlicky Chickpea Toasts with Cucumber-Pepper Salsa & Dressed Tomatoes

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon; divide between a medium and small bowl. Set aside the small bowl for later use.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the medium bowl with the lemon juice.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl, along with oil and spices. Using a fork or potato masher, roughly mash the chickpeas until semi-smooth. Set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Add to the reserved small bowl with the lemon juice.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the salsa. Set aside.
Place honey, vinegar, and spices in another small bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing, stir to coat, and set aside.
Arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Spread toasted bread with smashed chickpeas, then top with salsa.
To serve, divide toasts and tomato salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Garlicky Shrimp Scampi with Bell Pepper & Spaghetti

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 6 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) spaghetti pasta

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place in a medium bowl, cover with cold water, and set aside to thaw. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry bell peppers and parsley.
Seed and cut bell peppers into small strips. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Drain shrimp in a colander and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Spread out on a clean towel and pat dry.
Add butter to skillet and let it melt. Add shrimp and cook, stirring frequently, until opaque and pink, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce heat to medium and add more butter to skillet. Then add garlic, bell peppers, and crushed red pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until peppers are tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
Add broth to skillet and cook until it reduces, 1-2 minutes.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Finely grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
Drain pasta in a colander.
Add pasta, shrimp, parsley, and Parmesan to skillet. Pour in remaining broth and drizzle with lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper and toss until well combined.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Serve pasta on a plate or in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Garlicky Smashed White Beans on Toast with Apple-Butter Lettuce Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Chop chives into small pieces. Place half in a medium bowl (set remaining chives aside for serving).
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the chives.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl along with tahini, oil, and spices. Using a fork or potato masher, roughly mash the beans until semi-smooth. Set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apple. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, 2-3 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Divide toast between plates, spread with smashed beans, and sprinkle with reserved chives. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Garlicky Spaghetti Parmesan Carbonara

ingredients.name: heavy whipping cream
ingredients.display: ¾ fl oz heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with water, season water with salt, cover and bring to a boil. Add pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook, uncovered, until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
While pasta is cooking, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Chop the bacon into 1-inch pieces; add to the skillet and cook until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Once done, transfer to a plate lined with paper towels. Reserve 1 tbsp of bacon fat.
Meanwhile, crack the eggs into a medium bowl; add 1 ½ tbsp cream and whisk to combine.
Finely grate Parmesan and transfer to the bowl with egg mixture. Season with salt and pepper; whisk to combine.
When pasta is done, drain in a colander, reserving ½ cup of cooking liquid.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the reserved bacon fat to empty pasta pot. Return pot to heat, reduce heat to low. Add garlic, stirring until fragrant, about 1-2 minutes.
Return pasta and bacon to pot. Remove pot from heat, add the egg mixture to pasta, stirring frequently. Stir just until the egg mixture begins to thicken, 3-4 minutes.
If the sauce seems dry, add some of the reserved pasta water 1 tbsp at a time, until rich and creamy.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Reserve a small amount for garnish and add the rest to the pot with the pasta.
To serve, divide pasta between bowls and garnish with remaining parsley. Enjoy!

name: Gazpacho (Chilled Veggie Soup) with Lemon-Parsley Shrimp Salad Toasts

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Medium dice bread and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and large dice cucumber; add to the bowl with the bread.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper. Large dice tomatoes; add both to the bowl.
Peel and roughly chop garlic; add to the bowl along with broth, oil, vinegar, and spices; stir to combine the soup mixture.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Working in batches, transfer the soup mixture to a blender; blend on high until semi-smooth. Once blended, transfer gazpacho to a container with a lid and refrigerate until ready to serve. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.

Transfer shrimp to a baking sheet pan lined with aluminum foil; drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until shrimp are opaque and cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the shrimp are cooking, mince capers. Place in the reserved bowl along with mayo and crushed red pepper.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the capers and stir to combine.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl (reserving a small handful for serving).

Carefully remove cooked shrimp from the baking sheet by lifting the corners of the foil and transferring the foil sheet to a flat surface. Arrange additional bread slices on the baking sheet, place in the oven, and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, roughly chop the cooked shrimp; add to the bowl with the lemon-mayo mixture and stir to combine. Divide shrimp salad between toast slices and spread out in an even layer.
Divide gazpacho between bowls; drizzle with additional oil and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Serve with shrimp salad toasts on the side and enjoy!

name: "General Tso's" Tempeh with Green Onion, Bok Choy, Sesame Seeds & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place ⅔ in a small bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the green onions along with broth, cornstarch, soy sauce, maple syrup, and ketchup. Stir to combine the stir-fry sauce and set aside.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, slice tempeh crosswise into ½-inch thick strips. Season with salt.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tempeh in a single layer and cook, flipping once, until browned and warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, trim and cut bok choy crosswise into bite-sized pieces.
Return the skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bok choy and salt, then stir-fry until softened, 3-4 minutes.

Add stir-fry sauce to the skillet. Bring to a boil and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat, add tempeh, and stir to combine; cover to keep warm.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Top with reserved green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Ginger Chicken Meatball Stir-Fry with Noodles, Snap Peas & Cashews

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the water in the pan is boiling, remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse under cold water; set aside.
Meanwhile, place soy sauce, fish sauce, water, honey, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger; place in a medium bowl along with chicken, additional soy sauce, and pepper. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
Using a tablespoon measure, form the chicken mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and slice carrot crosswise into thin rounds; halve snap peas crosswise. Place both in another small bowl.
Trim and slice green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and stir-fry until fork-tender, 3-4 minutes.
While the veggies are cooking, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, add noodles, sauce, and cilantro to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until the noodles are coated and warmed through, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop cashews.
To serve, divide noodles, veggies, and meatballs between bowls; top with cashews and enjoy!

name: Ginger-Lime Chicken Skewers with Grape, Grapefruit & Avocado Salad

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Zest lime into a medium bowl (set lime aside for later use).
Peel and mince shallot; place half in the bowl with the lime zest (set remaining shallot aside).
Peel and grate or mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the lime zest along with mayo, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the marinade.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces; transfer to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
Meanwhile, juice lime into another medium bowl. Add remaining shallot, oil, fish sauce, sugar, and Dijon; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, thread chicken onto skewers and place on a plate; alternatively, you can cook the chicken pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.
Once the grill pan is hot, add the skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, halve grapes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut off skin and white pith from the grapefruit. Slice between the membranes to release segments; cut into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the bowl along with the mixed greens and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and skewers between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Ginger-Lime Salmon Cake Lettuce Wraps with Spicy Mayo

ingredients.name: traditional style wild pink salmon
ingredients.display: 1 (7.5 oz) can wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice the lime into a medium bowl.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger; peel and mince garlic. Transfer both to the bowl with the lime.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves and add to the bowl.
Trim off and discard ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Add half to the bowl; reserve the rest for garnish.
Drain salmon. Add to the bowl along with the egg, mayonnaise, bread crumbs, and salt; mash with a fork to combine.
amounts: 1 (7.5 oz) can wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.text: Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Using a ¼ cup measure, portion and form the salmon mixture into ½-inch thick patties.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place patties in the skillet and cook until browned on the outside and warmed through, about 3 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; slice lengthwise and crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Trim off and discard ends of the carrot. Using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the carrot into thin noodle-like sticks.
In a small bowl mix together chili-garlic sauce and mayonnaise.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Divide carrots, salmon cakes, and avocado between leaves; top with spicy mayo and reserved green onion. Enjoy!

name: Ginger Marinated Tofu Noodle Bowl with Spinach, Carrot & Peanuts

instructions.text: Cut the tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and lay side by side on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce (skip the spinach if it came pre-washed).
Juice half the lime into a medium bowl. Grate the ginger and add to the bowl with the juice. Add maple syrup, fish sauce, soy sauce and oil; whisk to combine.
Cut the tofu into 1-inch squares. Place tofu in the bowl with the marinade and gently toss until well coated; set aside.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Peel the carrots; run the peeler along the carrot to make long, noodle-like strips.
Remove saucepan from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse.

Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Use a slotted spoon to add the tofu to the skillet leaving the marinade in the bowl for later use. Cook until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side.
While the tofu cooks, seed and cut the bell pepper into thin sticks.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.

Once the tofu is cooked, transfer to a plate, returning the skillet to the heat. Add the remaining marinade, bell pepper, carrot, green onions, cilantro, and spinach to the hot skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes. Add the noodles to the pan and toss to combine.
Cut the remaining lime into wedges for serving.
To serve, divide noodles between bowls and top with tofu. Garnish with cilantro, peanuts, and a squeeze of lime; enjoy!

name: Ginger Pork & Green Bean Stir-Fry over Cauliflower Rice with Sesame

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise. Add half to the baking sheet with the cauliflower and place half in a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger. Sprinkle half over the cauliflower and add half to the bowl with the green onion.
Drizzle oil over the cauliflower and season with salt. Stir to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring cauliflower halfway through, until rice is tender and golden, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and halve green beans crosswise.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green beans and cook, stirring frequently, until starting to brown and soften, 4-6 minutes.
Add pork and salt to the skillet. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until the pork is browned and crumbly and green beans are tender, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, add soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, sesame seeds, and maple syrup to the bowl with the green onion and ginger. Stir to combine the stir-fry sauce.
When the green beans and pork are done, reduce heat to low. Add stir-fry sauce and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Ginger Pork, Mushroom & Avocado Lettuce Wraps with Pickled Green Onion

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Roughly chop mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and salt; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in another small bowl along with sesame seeds, soy sauce, and additional vinegar. Stir to combine the sauce.
When the pork is done, add the mushrooms to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms start to brown, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
When the mushrooms are done, add sauce to the skillet and stir to combine. Continue to cook until heated through, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Fill each wrap with the pork mixture, then top with pickled green onions and avocado. Enjoy!

name: Ginger-Soy Chicken with Mozzarella, Bacon, Bell Peppers & Mushrooms

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a small bowl along with soy sauce, vinegar, and honey. Whisk to combine the sauce.

Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets; arrange in a baking dish. Pour half of the sauce over the chicken and turn to coat (reserve remaining sauce for later use).
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until chicken is almost cooked through, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
While the bacon cooks, using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and thinly slice bell peppers; place in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms and add to the bowl with the bell peppers.
Peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat; add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, thinly slice cheese.
When the chicken is almost cooked through, remove from oven. Change oven setting to broil on high.
Layer chicken with bacon and cheese. Return baking dish to the oven and broil until cheese is melted and chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes; remove from oven.
When the veggies are done, add remaining sauce to the skillet, stir to combine, and continue to cook until heated through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide veggies and chicken between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Ginger-Soy Salmon Sandwich with Spicy Mayo & Tomato Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the green onion. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl, along with soy sauce and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end (or corner) firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.
Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and cut into portions. Add to the bowl, turn to coat, and set aside to marinate, 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, place mayo and hot sauce in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spicy mayo and set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
When the salmon is done marinating, transfer to the baking sheet. Sprinkle with bread crumbs on the top side, pressing gently to adhere.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until salmon is opaque and cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the salmon is almost done, add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired.
Spread spicy mayo over the bottom half of each bun, then top with salmon and reserved cilantro. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Gingered Pumpkin Bisque with Shrimp

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel the carrot, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Medium dice the carrot (cut into ½-inch cubes). Transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the celery; medium dice the celery (cut into ½-inch cubes). Add to the bowl with the carrots.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the saucepan heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Add to the bowl with the carrots and celery.
Once the saucepan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion, celery, and carrots to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger.
Add the ginger, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper to the saucepan; stir and cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the pumpkin purée and broth to the saucepan; stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée
16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the soup cooks, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Then, lay them out on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. If using fresh shrimp, skip the first step.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shrimp to the skillet; cook until they are opaque, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a bowl and set aside to cool.
Stir the heavy cream into the soup and season with salt and pepper.
Using an immersion (hand) blender, purée the soup until smooth.
Toast the buns if desired.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and top with the shrimp. Serve with buns on the side. Enjoy!

name: Glazed Chicken Stir-Fry with Sesame Broccoli-Bell Pepper Slaw & Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, oil, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper. Halve crosswise, then slice into thin strips and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash, dry, peel, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl along with the broccoli slaw. Toss to combine and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with cold water (from the tap) and cornstarch. Whisk to combine.
Add ketchup, soy sauce, honey, and chili-garlic sauce to the bowl with the cornstarch mixture. Whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken, salt, and pepper to the skillet; stir-fry until chicken is just cooked through, about 5 minutes.

When the chicken is done, add the stir-fry sauce, and stir to combine. Reduce heat to low and let simmer, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, dressed slaw, and chicken between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Gnocchi with Broccoli & Cheddar Cheese Sauce

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry broccoli. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add broccoli and gnocchi. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate the cheese and set aside.
When the gnocchi and broccoli are done, drain and return to the saucepan. Cover and set aside.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add flour and whisk until smooth. Cook, whisking frequently, for 1 minute.
Slowly pour milk into the pan, whisking constantly. Continue whisking until the sauce has thickened, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: 10 fl oz (1 ¼ cups) whole milk

instructions.text: Add cheese and spices to the pan; whisk until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth.
Pour sauce into the pan with the gnocchi and broccoli; stir to combine.
To serve, divide gnocchi and broccoli between bowls and enjoy!

name: Gnocchi with Creamy Parmesan Tomato Sauce & Vegetables

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water from the tap, cover, and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. Peel and small dice carrots. Small dice zucchini.
Add carrots to the pot and cook until fork-tender, 3-5 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic.
Add zucchini and gnocchi to the pot with the carrots; boil for 2 minutes more, then drain in a colander and set aside.
Return pot to the stove over medium heat. Add butter and swirl to coat.
Add garlic and flour; whisk until smooth. Gradually add broth; bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat and simmer, whisking occasionally, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Stir in the tomato sauce, cream, salt, and pepper.
Add gnocchi and vegetables back to the pot. Cook, stirring often, until heated through, 1-2 minutes.
Finely grate Parmesan.
Divide gnocchi between bowls and top with Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Gnocchi with Roasted Grape Tomatoes, Basil, Parmesan & Balsamic

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry grape tomatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel garlic and add to the baking sheet with the tomatoes. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and crushed red pepper; stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until tomatoes are burst and browned in spots, 20-25 minutes.
When the tomatoes have about 10 minutes left, fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the water in the pan is boiling, add gnocchi and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
Meanwhile, using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Place half in a small bowl. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)
Wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to bowl with the Parmesan. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
When the tomatoes are done, remove from the oven. Add drained gnocchi, Parmesan, basil, and vinegar to the baking sheet. Gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide gnocchi and tomatoes between plates or bowls. Top with reserved Parmesan and basil, then drizzle with oil. Enjoy!

name: Goat Cheese Orzo with Roasted Asparagus, Crispy Prosciutto & Pine Nuts

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.

Place broth and orzo in a medium saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut into 1-inch pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces. Sprinkle over the asparagus.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until asparagus is tender and prosciutto is crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, crumble goat cheese into a small bowl.
Chop chives into small pieces. Add to the bowl with the goat cheese.

When the orzo is done, juice lemon into the pan, then add roasted asparagus, prosciutto, goat cheese, and chives. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until goat cheese is melted and orzo is combined, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide orzo between plates or bowls, then sprinkle with pine nuts and crushed red pepper. Enjoy!

name: Goat Cheese-Spinach Linguini with Roasted Acorn Squash & Red Onion

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, and halve acorn squash lengthwise; trim ends, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips. Add to the baking sheet with the squash.
Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the baking sheet along with oil, maple syrup, and spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until squash is starting to soften, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
While the pasta is cooking, crumble goat cheese into a small bowl. Set aside.
Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Place spinach in a colander and set aside.

When the squash is starting to soften, remove from the oven. Add pumpkin seeds to the baking sheet, stir to combine, and spread back out in an even layer. Return to the oven and continue to roast until squash is fork-tender and golden, 5-10 minutes more. Remove from oven.

When the pasta is done, reserve a ¼-cup of pasta water, then drain over the spinach in the colander. Return pasta, spinach, and reserved pasta water to the pan. Add goat cheese and stir until the pasta is creamy and combined.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls, then top with roasted squash, onion, and pumpkin seeds. Enjoy!

name: Golden Chickpea-Coconut Curry with Bell Pepper, Jalapeño, Basil & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl.

Thinly slice jalapeño pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse chickpeas. Pat dry with paper towels, then add to the bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, chickpeas, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are golden and tender, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.

When the veggies are done, add basil and coconut milk to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the curry is slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: To serve, divide rice and curry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Golden Coconut Curry Soup with Turkey Meatballs, Spinach & Mushrooms

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince ginger. Place in a medium bowl along with turkey, bread crumbs, egg, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs. Arrange on the baking sheet.
Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning halfway, until golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and roughly chop bell pepper. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 4-5 minutes.
Add broth and coconut milk to the pan, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Add baked meatballs to the pan and stir to combine the soup. Continue to cook until heated through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and enjoy!

name: Grape Tomato, Basil & Ricotta Flatbread Pizza with Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, mix together garlic, oil, salt, and pepper.
Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes.
Measure out 1 cup of ricotta.
Place flatbreads on a flat surface. Spoon oil and garlic mixture over top, add tomatoes, and finish off with spoonfuls of ricotta.
Place in the oven, directly on the rack, and bake until cheese melts, 8-10 minutes. Then broil for 1-2 minutes.
Wash and dry arugula and basil. Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and thinly slice the leaves into ribbons.
In a small bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Remove pizzas from oven and garnish with basil; slice into wedges.
To serve, place pizza on a plate and have salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Grape Tomato, Spinach & Avocado Salad with Quinoa

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic. Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, cilantro, oil, lime juice, honey, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Wash and dry spinach; transfer to a large bowl.
Wash, halve, and add tomatoes to bowl. Halve and pit avocado; scoop out, medium dice, and add to bowl.
Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork. Add to bowl and toss salad.
To serve, place salad on a plate and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Greek Beef Skillet with Bell Pepper, Zucchini, Tomato, Yogurt & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beef, salt, and pepper; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl (reserve remaining parsley for serving).
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, parsley, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Halve grape tomatoes. Place in the reserved bowl.
Halve olives lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
When the veggies are done, add beef, tomatoes, and olives to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide beef and veggies between plates or bowls. Top with feta, yogurt, and reserved parsley. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Greek Chicken Pasta Salad with Tomato, Bell Pepper, Parsley & Feta

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Place chicken in another medium bowl along with ⅓ of the dressing; turn to coat. (Reserve bowl with remaining dressing for the salad.)
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add the chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the remaining dressing.
Trim and large dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes crosswise and add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Add to the bowl, along with the feta, and stir to combine the pasta salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls and top with sliced chicken. Enjoy!

name: Greek Chicken Smash Tacos with Dill Yogurt & Cucumber-Tomato Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
Peel and mince shallot. Place in another medium bowl along with chicken and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined.

Arrange tortillas on a flat surface, then divide the chicken mixture between them (about 2 tablespoons per tortilla). Using a knife (or your hands), spread the chicken mixture over the surface of each tortilla in an even layer.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add tacos, meat-side down. Cook, pressing down once with the bottom of a spatula halfway through cooking, until the chicken is cooked through, about 3 minutes.
Flip tacos, chicken-side up, and continue to cook until tortillas are golden underneath, 1 minute more. Transfer to a plate and carefully fold in half to form tacos.
Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the dill. Add yogurt, sugar, and salt, then stir to combine the dill yogurt.
Divide tacos between plates. Fill each with a small portion of salad and drizzle with dill yogurt. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Greek Chicken Wings with Kale, Prosciutto, Artichoke & Olive Salad

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.

Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and spices, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet, spread out in an even layer, and drizzle with oil.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the skillet is hot, add prosciutto in a single layer and cook until crispy, about 1 minute per side. Remove to a plate and set aside.
Zest and juice lemon. Divide between a small and a clean medium bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between both bowls with the lemon, then set the small bowl aside for later use.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the medium bowl along with oil, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts and olives. Add both to the bowl.
Crumble or chop prosciutto into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, along with feta, and toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: When the wings are done, remove from the oven. Drizzle with the reserved lemon and dill, then toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Greek Frittata with Spinach, Grape Tomatoes & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry spinach. Wash and halve tomatoes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack about 4 inches from the top.
Add garlic and tomatoes to skillet. Stir to combine and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add spinach and stir to combine.

Spread out ingredients evenly in the skillet. Pour in egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 6-8 minutes.
Sprinkle feta over top. Place skillet in the oven under the broiler until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, cut frittata into wedges and place on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Greek Garlic Chicken & Potatoes with Sautéed Lemon Spinach

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Slice potatoes into ¼-inch thick rounds; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the baking sheet with the potatoes along with oil and spices; toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place potatoes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake for 6-8 minutes while you prepare the chicken.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken to the skillet; cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).

Remove baking sheet from the oven and place seared chicken on top of the potatoes. Juice half of the lemon over the chicken and potatoes. Return to the oven and continue to bake until potatoes are tender and chicken is cooked through, 12-15 minutes.
When there are 5 minutes left on the potatoes and chicken, return skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Juice remaining lemon into the skillet and season with salt and pepper; stir to combine.
To serve, divide potatoes, chicken, and spinach between plates. Enjoy!

name: Greek Mushroom Burger with Olive Mayo & Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove stems from the mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills. Place on the baking sheet, rub both sides with oil, season with salt and pepper, and arrange gill-side down.
Place mushrooms in the oven and broil until tops are soft, about 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, mince olives and place in a small bowl.
Zest lemon into the bowl with the olives (reserve lemon for later use); add mayo and spices. Stir to combine the olive mayo and set aside.

When the tops of the mushrooms are soft, remove from the oven and flip. Fill mushrooms with half the feta (setting remaining feta aside for the dressing), return to the oven, and continue to broil until tender and cheese is golden, 4 minutes more. Remove from oven.
While the mushrooms are cooking, juice reserved lemon into a medium bowl.
Mince sun-dried tomatoes and add to the bowl with the lemon juice. Add reserved feta, yogurt, oil, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Medium dice half the tomato and add to the bowl. Thinly slice the remaining tomato and set aside for serving.

Separate the lettuce leaves. Set aside 1 leaf per burger and chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add chopped lettuce to the bowl, along with pine nuts, and toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired.
Spread olive mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with feta-stuffed mushrooms, tomato, and reserved lettuce. Close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide mushroom burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Greek Pita Pizza with Chickpea Spread, Bell Peppers, Tomatoes & Olives

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise and add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, basil, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas; place in the reserved bowl.
