Peel the mango and cut the flesh away from the pit, starting from the flat sides. Small dice the flesh and transfer to a medium bowl.
Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh and small dice. Add to the bowl with the mango.
Halve the jalapeño and remove the seeds; mince the pepper and add to the bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Juice the lime into a small bowl.
Place the fish on a plate; season with salt and pepper, then drizzle with olive oil and ½ of the lime juice (save the rest for the salsa).
Place the fish on the grill pan or skillet; cook until it is opaque in the center, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the mango and avocado mixture.
Add the remaining lime juice to the salsa and season with salt and pepper; mix well.
To serve, place the rice and fish on a plate and spoon the mango-avocado salsa on top. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Halibut with Mango-Avocado Salsa

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel the mango, then slice off the flesh from the pit, starting with the flatter sides; discard the pit and small dice the flesh (cut into ¼-inch cubes). Transfer to a medium salad bowl.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and small dice the flesh. Add to the salad bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Add to the salad bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan / skillet heats up, pat the fish dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Rub with olive oil and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Once the grill pan / skillet is hot, add the halibut. Cook until the fish is opaque in the center and flaky, 4 to 6 minutes per side (depending on thickness), lowering the heat if needed to keep it from burning on the outside.
While the fish cooks, juice the lime and add to the salad bowl.
Add olive oil, salt, and pepper to the salsa; toss to combine.
To serve, divide the salsa between plates and top with the halibut fillets. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Honey Mustard Chicken Thighs with Corn & Peach-Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon, then divide between two medium bowls. Set one bowl aside for the salad.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the remaining bowl with the lemon, along with honey, Dijon, and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels, add to the bowl with the marinade, and turn to coat. Set aside.
Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, remove and discard outer husks and silk from corn.
Once the water is boiling, uncover the pot and reduce heat to medium; use tongs to lower the corn into the water and cook until just tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the corn is cooking, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add chicken (leaving any excess marinade in the bowl) and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, add oil, honey, salt, and pepper to the remaining bowl with the lemon, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop leaves. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad, chicken, and corn between plates. Drizzle corn with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Lemon Chicken with Strawberry, Cucumber & Mint Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
In a medium salad bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper.
Trim off and discard the stem ends of the strawberries; quarter the strawberries lengthwise and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces at an angle. Add to the salad bowl.
Pick the mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Juice the lemon into a medium bowl (that is big enough to hold the chicken breasts). Then, add the minced garlic, olive oil, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place the chicken cutlets in the medium bowl and turn to thoroughly coat in the marinade.

Once the grill pan / skillet is hot, add the chicken cutlets and pour any remaining marinade overtop. Cook until the chicken is cooked through, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate. Cook in batches if necessary.
Toss the salad until well coated with the dressing.
To serve, divide the chicken cutlets between plates and top with the salad. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Lemon Shrimp Skewers with Peach & Tomato Caprese Salad

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place in a medium bowl.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the shrimp. Add oil, salt, and pepper; toss to combine and set aside to marinate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic; place in another medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel and thinly slice the shallot; add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine.
Cut regular tomatoes in half and slice into thick half-moons; halve the grape tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, quarter the peaches (around the pit) and twist to separate, then remove and discard the pits.
Place the peaches on the grill pan and grill until charred, 2 minutes per side. Remove to the bowl with the tomatoes and toss gently to combine the salad.
While the peaches are cooking, thread the shrimp onto skewers. If you don't have skewers you can cook the shrimp directly on the pan. Discard the marinade.
Add the shrimp to the pan and grill until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Tear mozzarella into large chunks with your hands.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
To serve, divide shrimp and Caprese salad between plates. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with basil. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Lime Shrimp with Black Bean, Corn, Pepper, Tomato & Feta Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lime into a medium bowl and set aside for later use. Juice lime into another medium bowl, then add oil, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw, then add to the bowl and set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Add shrimp to the bowl with the lime zest, season with salt and pepper, then stir to coat.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thread shrimp onto the skewers and place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the shrimp directly on the grill pan.)
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add skewers to the pan and cook, turning occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the beans and corn.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide shrimp skewers and salad between plates. Top salad with feta and enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Grilled NY Steak & Warm Carrot-Spinach Salad with Ginger Dressing

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels. Place on a plate, then season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest. (Reserve pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long pieces. Place on another plate, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Return grill pan to medium heat. Add carrots and grill, turning occasionally, until lightly charred and tender, 6-8 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the ginger. Add oil, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add grilled carrots and spinach to the bowl with the dressing. Gently toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled NY Strip with Roasted Beets, Sweet Potatoes, Pears & Parsley

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potato. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel and trim beet; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the baking sheet with the sweet potato.
Quarter, core, and slice pears lengthwise into ½-inch wedges. Add to the baking sheet.

Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies and pears with oil, then season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies and pears are fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the roasted veggies and pears have about 12 minutes left, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak, roasted sweet potatoes, beets, and pears between plates. Sprinkle with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Grilled Oregano Chicken Thighs with Spicy Marinated Tomatoes & Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, sugar, and salt. Whisk to combine the marinade and set aside.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then mince. Add to the bowl with the marinade. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with spices on both sides.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; add chicken and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
To serve, divide rice, chicken, and marinated tomatoes between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Peach, Strawberry & Arugula Salad with Pistachios & Goat Cheese

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Wash, halve, and pit peaches.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Place peaches cut side down on grill/skillet and cook until lightly browned and tender, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Wash and dry arugula. Transfer to a large bowl.
Wash cucumber and strawberries. Medium dice and add cucumber to bowl. Trim stem ends, slice, and add strawberries to bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Slice and add peaches to bowl. Toss salad.
Shell pistachios. Crumble goat cheese.
To serve, arrange salad on a plate, sprinkle goat cheese and pistachios over top, and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Peach-Zucchini Flatbread with Cream Cheese & Balsamic Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise. Season the cut-sides with salt and pepper.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add zucchini to the pan and grill, flipping once, until charred and just tender, about 10 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Reserve pan for later use.)

Meanwhile, arrange pitas on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until pitas are slightly crispy, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
While the pitas are baking, finely grate Parmesan and set aside.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Season the cut-sides with salt and pepper.

When the zucchini is done, return the pan to medium-high heat and coat with more oil. Add the peaches and grill, flipping once, until charred and warmed through, about 3 minutes. Remove to the plate with the zucchini.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Divide between one small bowl and one medium bowl. (Set medium bowl aside for the salad.)
Add cream cheese, salt, and pepper to the small bowl with the basil. Using the back of a spoon, mash and combine the cream cheese, then spread evenly over each toasted pita.

Cut grilled zucchini crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Slice grilled peaches lengthwise into ½-inch thick wedges. Divide zucchini and peaches between pitas, arranging in an even layer, then top with Parmesan.
Return baking sheet to the oven and bake until flatbreads are warmed through and cheese is melted, about 3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper to the medium bowl with the basil. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Divide flatbreads between plates and top each with a small handful of greens. Serve with remaining greens on the side and enjoy!

name: Grilled Peanut-Lime Chicken with Broccoli, Peppers & Onion

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince the garlic. Place in a large bowl.
Juice one lime into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, and Worcestershire; whisk to combine. Pour half of the marinade into a small bowl and set aside.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Add the chicken to the large bowl with the marinade. Toss to coat and set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Seed and slice the bell pepper into strips.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Coat the grill pan with oil.
Add the broccoli and bell pepper to the grill pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are crisp-tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove and set aside on a plate; cover with foil.
Meanwhile, peel and slice the onion into thick rings.
Add the onion to the grill pan. Cook, flipping once, until the onion starts to soften and grill marks appear, 4-5 minutes. Remove and add to the plate with the veggies. Cover with the foil.
Coat the grill pan with additional oil.
Add the chicken to the grill pan; cook, flipping once, until cooked through and golden, 4-5 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Slice the remaining lime into wedges.
Divide the chicken and veggies between plates; garnish with cilantro and lime wedges and serve with the reserved marinade for dipping. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Peri-Peri Chicken Thighs with Rice & Pickled Cucumbers

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, place vinegar, honey, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.

Halve chili peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Place in a blender. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Peel garlic. Add to the blender along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Blend on high until peri-peri sauce is smooth. Transfer to another medium bowl.
Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and add to the bowl with the sauce; turn to coat.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add chicken and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, chicken, and pickled cucumbers between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Pork Burger with Basil Yogurt, Plum & Arugula-Tomato Salad

instructions.text: Place pork, bread crumbs, Worcestershire sauce, and spices in a medium bowl, then mix with your hands until well combined. Form the pork mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place in a small bowl along with yogurt, mayo, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the basil yogurt. Set aside.
Halve plum lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pit. Cut each half into thin slices. Place on another plate and set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Medium dice tomato. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Set aside a small handful of arugula for each burger, then add remaining arugula to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired.
Spread basil yogurt over the bottom half of each bun; top with reserved arugula, burger patties, and plums. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Grilled Pork Chop with Arugula, Grapefruit, Avocado, Feta & Dill Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add pork chops and grill until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Cut off skin and white pith from the grapefruits. Slice between membranes to release segments; roughly chop. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Add arugula to the bowl, along with feta, and toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Thinly slice pork chops.
To serve, divide salad and chops between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Pork Chop with German-Style Potato Salad & Pickled Veggies

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter potatoes; place in a medium saucepan, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until fork-tender, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, sugar, dill, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, trim, and halve carrot lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the parsley along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; add pork chops and grill until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and let rest, 5 minutes.
When the potatoes are done, drain and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
Quarter, core, and small dice apple; add to the bowl and stir to combine the potato salad.
To serve, divide pork chops, potato salad, and pickled veggies between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Pork Chop & Honeyed Zucchini with Snap Pea-Radish Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a small bowl (set lemon aside for later). Add oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine the lemon oil.
Trim and slice zucchini lengthwise into ¼-inch thick planks; transfer to a plate and drizzle both sides with the lemon oil.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, add zucchini planks and grill, flipping once, until charred and fork-tender, about 3 minutes per side; return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on another plate; season with spices on both sides.
Once the zucchini is done, coat the pan with oil; add pork chops and grill until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Add to the plate with the zucchini.
While the chops are cooking, juice reserved lemon into a medium bowl; add mayo and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Cut snap peas crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork chops, zucchini, and salad between plates. Drizzle honey over the zucchini and enjoy!

name: Grilled Pork Chop over Strawberry-Kiwi Spinach Salad with Pistachios

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add pork chops and grill until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, sesame seeds, Worcestershire, sugar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Trim and thinly slice strawberries. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and quarter kiwis lengthwise, then slice crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the bowl, along with the spinach, and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice pork chops.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with sliced pork and enjoy!

name: Grilled Pork Chop with Raw Brussels Sprout, Orange & Avocado Salad

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add pork chops and grill until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice half of one orange into a medium bowl. Add fish sauce and oil, then stir to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining oranges for the next step.)
Peel and halve remaining oranges, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim Brussels sprouts, then using a mandoline slicer (optional), shave or very thinly slice the sprouts. Add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl, along with pumpkin seeds, and stir to combine the salad.
Thinly slice pork chops.
To serve, divide pork chops and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Pork Chops with Peach-Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, combine and mix together olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; rub with the spice mixture on both sides.

Place the pork chops in the grill pan / skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate.
Juice the lime and transfer to a large salad bowl.
To the lime juice, add olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard the pit; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; halve the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-rounds at an angle. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds. Add to the salad bowl and toss the salad to combine.
To serve, divide the pork chops and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Pork Sausages with Balsamic Zucchini, Bell Peppers & Onion

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place the sausages on a plate and rub with a little olive oil.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Once the grill pan / skillet is hot, add the sausages and reduce the heat to medium. Cook, turning occasionally, until the sausages are cooked through, 12 to 15 minutes. Once done, transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
While the sausages cook, pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a large bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl.
To the basil and garlic, add olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Trim off and discard the ends of the zucchini; halve the zucchini crosswise, then cut each half lengthwise into 4 to 6 wedges. Add to the bowl with the marinade.
Quarter the bell peppers lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Cut each quarter into thirds lengthwise and add to the bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; cut lengthwise into ½-inch-thick wedges and add to the bowl.
Gently toss the vegetables until evenly coated with the marinade.
Once the sausages have been transferred, add the vegetables to the grill pan / skillet. Cook, tossing occasionally, until they are tender and charred, 5 to 8 minutes. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Cut the sausages at an angle into 1-inch pieces.
To serve, divide the grilled sausages and vegetables between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Pork Tacos with Fresh Peach-Lime Salsa

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Combine spices in a small bowl.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and season with spice mixture on both sides.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add pork and cook, flipping occasionally, until cooked through, about 8 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince leaves. Add to the bowl.

Halve and pit peaches. Add peach halves to the grill pan, cut-side down, and cook until the flesh is soft and charred, about 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a cutting board, medium dice, and add to the bowl with the cilantro.
Juice lime into the bowl, season with salt, and stir to combine the salsa.
Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional).
Meanwhile, thinly slice the pork chops crosswise into strips.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates and fill with pork and salsa. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Portobello Peanut Satay with Bok Choy, Edamame & Coconut Rice

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add coconut milk, water, and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, juice lime into a small bowl.

Peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with peanut butter, water, sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, turmeric, and curry powder. Whisk to combine the satay sauce.
Remove stems from portobello mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills; medium dice. Place in a medium bowl, add half of the satay sauce, and stir to coat. (Reserve remaining sauce for serving.)
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thread mushrooms onto skewers and place on a plate. (Alternatively, you can cook the mushroom pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.)
Once the pan is hot, add mushrooms and grill, flipping once, until tender and charred 3-4 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Place oil, chili-garlic sauce, fish sauce, and soy sauce in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the spicy marinade.
Trim and cut bok choy in half lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the spicy marinade and gently toss to coat.

When the mushrooms are done, add bok choy to the grill, and cook, flipping once, until tender and charred 3-4 minutes. Once done, add to the plate with the mushrooms. (Reserve any leftover marinade in the bowl for serving.)
To serve, divide coconut rice, bok choy, edamame, and mushroom skewers between plates. Drizzle reserved satay sauce over mushrooms and reserved spicy marinade over bok choy. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Ribeye with Anchovy Butter & Roasted Asparagus-Zucchini Medley

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Mince anchovy and place in a small bowl.
Zest lemon into the bowl with the anchovy. Add butter, parsley flakes, and garlic powder; set aside to soften. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 2-inch pieces. Add to the baking sheet with the zucchini.
Juice reserved lemon over the veggies. Season with spices, toss to combine, and spread out in an even layer.
Cut additional butter into small pieces and sprinkle over the veggies.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until fork-tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the pan is hot, coat with additional butter. Add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a cutting board, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, gently mash the softened butter, lemon zest, anchovy, and spices with the back of a spoon to combine.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide roasted veggies and steak between plates; top steak with anchovy butter. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Ribeye with Mint, Orange, Snap Pea & Radish Sauté

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Zest and juice orange into the bowl with the mint. Add water, Dijon, and salt, then stir to combine the sauce. Set aside.
Trim and quarter radishes lengthwise.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add radishes, garlic, snap peas, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring often, until just fork-tender, 2-3 minutes.
Add sauce to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring often, until veggies are tender and coated in sauce, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggie sauté between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Ribeye Steak with Mushrooms & Dijon-Roasted Napa Cabbage

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 475°F.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the Dijon sauce and set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry cabbage, then trim off and discard the root end. Cut cabbage in half lengthwise to make 2 wedges; transfer to a baking sheet pan, cut-side down.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, turning each cabbage wedge onto the other cut-side halfway through, until starting to soften, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the steak into portions, pat dry with paper towels, and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and, using a clean cutting board, thinly slice mushrooms.
When the cabbage is soft, remove baking sheet from the oven and turn wedges once more, so the cut-sides face up; drizzle with Dijon sauce.
Set oven to broil on high and return baking sheet to the oven. Broil until cabbage is golden brown and lightly charred around the edges, about 3 minutes.
When the steak is done, return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring often, until soft and golden, about 4 minutes.
To serve, divide steak and roasted cabbage between plates. Top steak with mushrooms and enjoy!

name: Grilled Ribeye Steak Salad with Pear, Blue Cheese & Cranberries

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
When the grill pan is hot, coat with oil.
Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Meanwhile, combine oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large salad bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, quarter, core, and thinly slice the pear; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash the spring mix (skip if it came pre-washed), and add to the bowl with the dressing and pears. Toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide the salad between plates; top with steak, blue cheese, and cranberries. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

name: Grilled Romaine, Steak & Berry Salad with Goat Cheese

instructions.text: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
Wash and quarter lettuce lengthwise. Rub cut sides with a little olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Place steak on grill/skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Place lettuce quarters, cut side down, on grill/skillet. Cook until charred and leaves begin to wilt, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

Peel and mince garlic. In a small saucepan, combine vinegar and garlic; bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to low. Stirring occasionally, simmer until liquid is reduced and thickened, 5-10 minutes.
Wash, trim stem ends, and slice strawberries. Wash blueberries.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, place lettuce cut side up on a plate and top with berries and steak slices. Crumble goat cheese on top and drizzle with balsamic reduction. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Romaine Steak Salad with Celery & Dill-Blue Cheese Dressing

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half of the dill in a small bowl. (Reserve remaining dill for serving.)
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the dill along with yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and spices. Whisk until smooth.
Add blue cheese to the bowl and whisk to combine the dressing; set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, trim and quarter romaine head lengthwise into wedges. Rub cut sides with oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Place romaine quarters, cut-side down, on the pan. Cook, turning halfway through, until charred and leaves begin to wilt, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to another plate.
Meanwhile, trim and medium dice celery.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide romaine between plates, arranging it grilled-side up. Top with steak, dressing, celery, and reserved dill. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Romaine & Steak Salad with Creamy Feta Dressing

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and quarter lettuce lengthwise. Rub cut sides with a little olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Place steak on grill/skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Place romaine halves, cut side down, on grill/skillet. Cook until charred and leaves begin to wilt, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Wash and halve tomatoes. Wash and chop chives.
Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, yogurt, olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon, honey, dill, salt, and pepper. Add feta and mix.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Cut remaining lemon into wedges.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, place romaine hearts cut side up on a plate and top with tomatoes and steak slices. Drizzle with dressing and garnish with chives and lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Salmon with Curried Yogurt Sauce & Pickled Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
In a medium bowl, combine vinegar, sugar, and salt; whisk to combine.
Thinly slice the cucumber and add to the bowl.
Peel and thinly slice the shallot; add to the bowl with the cucumber and toss to coat.
Juice lemon into a small bowl. Add yogurt and spices; whisk to combine.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon fillets dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
When the grill pan or skillet is hot, drizzle with oil and add fillets. Grill until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the cucumber salad; toss to combine.
To serve, divide rice, salmon, and cucumber salad between plates. Serve with curried yogurt sauce and enjoy!

name: Grilled Salmon with Eggplant, Tomato, Yogurt Sauce, Basil & Pine Nuts

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan is heating, trim and slice eggplant lengthwise into ½-inch thick planks; transfer to a plate, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with salt.
Once the pan is hot, add eggplant and grill, flipping once, until tender, 3-4 minutes per side. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl.
Add yogurt, water, and spices to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Pat salmon dry with paper towels, place on another plate, and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the eggplant is done, coat the pan with oil; add salmon and grill until flakey and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
While the salmon is cooking, thinly slice tomatoes.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
To serve, divide salmon, eggplant, and tomato slices between plates. Top veggies with yogurt sauce and pine nuts, then sprinkle basil over top. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Salmon Kabobs with Peach & Tomato Panzanella Salad

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 6-8 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin. If you don’t have a tail end, start at one corner of the fillet and work your way in until the knife is between the skin and flesh.
Cut the salmon crosswise into 1-inch strips and transfer to a medium bowl; season with oil, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Drizzle oil over both sides of the bread. Once the grill is hot, add bread and grill until charred marks appear, 2-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside to cool. (Leave the grill on for the salmon.)
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice the shallot; add to another medium bowl.
Add vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the shallot; stir together.
Thread one strip of salmon onto each skewer and place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the salmon directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.

Coat the grill or skillet with oil; place kabobs on the grill, rotating every 1½-2 minutes, until salmon is opaque and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil. Work in batches if necessary.
Meanwhile, tear the bread into bite-sized pieces. Halve the tomatoes and add both to the bowl with the shallots.
Halve peaches, twist to open, and remove pits. Slice each half into wedges and add to the bowl with the tomatoes and bread.

Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves into a chiffonade by stacking them and rolling tightly into a cigar, then slicing crosswise into thin ribbons. Add to the salad bowl and toss to combine.
To serve, divide salmon kabobs and panzanella salad between dishes. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Salmon Salad with Goat Cheese, Walnuts & Strawberry Dressing

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and thinly slice the strawberries; place in a small saucepan, reserving a small handful for garnish.

Add vinegar, honey, and Dijon to the saucepan; bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until berries have softened and mixture thickens, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the grill pan or skillet is hot, coat with oil. Add salmon and cook until opaque, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, zest the lemon.
Add lemon zest, salt, pepper, and water to the saucepan with the strawberries and remove from the heat.
Using a hand or regular blender, purée the dressing until smooth, adding additional water, 1 tbsp at a time, to reach drizzling consistency.
Cut lemon into wedges and set aside.
Roughly chop walnuts.
Crumble goat cheese.
To serve, divide the spinach between plates. Top with grilled salmon, walnuts, goat cheese, and reserved strawberries. Place lemon wedges on the side and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Sausage with Pickled Veggie-Olive Relish & Caprese Salad

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic. Divide between a small and a medium bowl, then set the medium bowl aside for later use.
Add vinegar, sugar, and spices to the small bowl with the garlic. Whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with pickling liquid.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Add to the bowl.

Thinly slice chili pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the bowl. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl, along with capers, and stir to combine the relish. Set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; add sausages and grill, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into the reserved medium bowl with the garlic. Add mayo, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop or tear the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Cut or tear mozzarella into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide salad and sausage between plates. Top sausage with relish and enjoy!

name: Grilled Sausage Tacos with Spicy Charred Pepper & Pineapple Salsa

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the bell pepper into quarters lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds. Place in a medium bowl.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard ends of the green onions; add to the bowl. Drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to coat.
Working in batches if necessary, place veggies on the grill. Cook until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side. Return grilled veggies to the bowl and set aside.
Place sausages on the grill and reduce heat to medium. Cook, turning occasionally, until sausages are cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Once done, transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Meanwhile, small dice grilled bell pepper, jalapeño, and half of the green onions (set aside the other half for garnish). Return chopped veggies to the bowl.
Cut off skin from pineapple, core, and small dice. Add to the bowl with the veggies.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice half the lime into the bowl and stir to combine the salsa. Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside.
Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional), 15-30 seconds.
Meanwhile, slice sausages into ½-inch thick rounds, at an angle.
To serve, fill tortillas with sausage, salsa, and whole grilled green onion. Divide tacos and lime wedges between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Scallop Salad with Mango, Bell Pepper & Cilantro Vinaigrette

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a blender.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems. Add leaves to the blender with the lime juice.
Peel and roughly chop garlic. Add to the blender along with oil, honey, salt, and pepper. Blend on high until smooth; set dressing aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and cut bell pepper into thin matchsticks. Add to the bowl with the mango.
Chop or tear lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Meanwhile, pat scallops dry with paper towels and thread onto the skewers so that they lie flat; place on a plate. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper on both sides. (Alternatively, you can cook the scallops directly on the grill pan without using skewers.)
Once the grill pan is hot, add skewers and cook, flipping once, until scallops are lightly charred and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
To serve, divide salad between plates; top with cashews and grilled scallops. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: Grilled Scallop Tacos with Wilted Cabbage, Guacamole & Pineapple Salsa

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve and pit avocado. Scoop out into a small bowl and mash with a fork.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the avocado.
Juice half of the lime into the bowl with the avocado; add salt, stir to combine the guacamole, and set aside. (Reserve remaining lime for the salsa.)
Cut off skin from pineapple, core, and small dice. Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; place both in a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the pineapple and bell pepper.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl.
Juice remaining lime into the bowl; add salt, stir to combine the pineapple salsa, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, quarter the cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; slice crosswise into thin strips.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add cabbage and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes. Transfer cabbage to a plate and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve pan for the next step).
While the cabbage is cooking, pat scallops dry with paper towels and place on another plate; rub with oil and season with spices on both sides.
Return pan to medium-high heat. Add scallops in a single layer; cook until they develop a nice sear and are opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Once done, add to the plate with the cabbage.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, spread tortillas with guacamole and top with scallops (cutting them in half if necessary); garnish with wilted cabbage and pineapple salsa. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Scallops with Corn, Lime and Avocado Salad

instructions.text: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Lightly oil grates or pan. Remove husks and silks from corn. Grill corn, turning occasionally until corn begins to char (8-10 min). Set aside to cool.
While the corn cooks, peel and finely chop the shallot. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Juice the lime into the medium bowl; add olive oil, cumin, salt, and pepper and stir to combine.

Pat scallops dry with paper towel.   (If using an outdoor grill, thread scallops, side by side onto skewers so that scallops lie flat.) Drizzle scallops with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Grill scallops until grill marks appear, about 2-3 minutes; flip and cook other side, about 2 minutes. Cook in batches if necessary.
Working one ear at a time, hold the corn vertically inside a large bowl and slice the kernels away from the cob; discard the cob. Add the kernels to the salad dressing.
Halve the avocado and remove pit. Thinly slice the flesh while still in the skin and then scoop out the slices using a spoon.
To serve, toss lettuce with corn mixture and avocado, arrange on a plate and top with grilled scallops. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Shrimp, Onion & Tomato Pizza with Lemon-Parsley Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Transfer shrimp to a plate; drizzle with oil and season with spices on both sides, then set aside.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and cut onion lengthwise into 1-inch wide wedges.
Once the grill pan is hot, add shrimp and onion; cook, turning occasionally, until the shrimp are cooked through and onion is tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the garlic.
Juice lemon into the bowl, then add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Halve tomatoes.
Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan; top with grilled shrimp and onion, tomatoes, and feta. Sprinkle with oregano and crushed red pepper.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until the cheese starts to melt, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into wedges.
Meanwhile, add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pizza and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Shrimp & Pineapple Salad with Honey-Lime Dressing

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 6-8 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the garlic. Add mayo, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Place spices in another medium bowl and stir to combine.
Cut skin off pineapple, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces; transfer to the bowl with the spice mix.

Add shrimp to the bowl with the pineapple, toss to coat, then thread shrimp and pineapple onto the skewers. Alternatively, you can cook the shrimp and pineapple directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add skewers to the grill and cook, turning occasionally, until charred and the shrimp are cooked through, about 6 minutes.
Trim and slice the cucumber into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with mixed greens; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates and top with skewers. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Shrimp Tacos with Mango-Avocado Salsa

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Then, lay them out on a paper towel or clean cloth and pat dry. Transfer to a medium bowl. If using fresh shrimp, place them directly into a medium bowl.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the shrimp and transfer the rest to a medium bowl (for the salsa).
Drizzle the shrimp with olive oil and season with chili powder; toss to combine. Set aside while you prepare the salsa.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel the mango and discard the peels; slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Small dice the mango and add to the cilantro.
Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh from the skin. Small dice the avocado and add to the bowl.
Halve the jalapeño lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl.
Juice the lime and pour over the salsa. Toss the salsa until well combined.
Once the grill pan / skillet is hot, add the shrimp; cook until they are opaque, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate and set aside to cool.
Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel or cloth and microwave until they are heated through, 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Once the shrimp have cooled slightly, peel and discard the tails.
To serve, place 3 to 4 shrimp into each tortilla and spoon the mango-avocado salsa over top. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Shrimp, Zucchini & Onion Skewers with Cheesy Garlic Flatbread

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Place oil and spices in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the spice oil.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the spice oil.
Peel, halve, and large dice onion. Add to the bowl.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Add shrimp to the bowl with the veggies and toss to coat. Thread shrimp and veggies onto the skewers, alternating ingredients; place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the shrimp and veggies directly on the grill pan.)
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add skewers to the pan and cook, turning occasionally, until veggies are lightly charred and shrimp are cooked through, about 6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Finely grate Parmesan.

Place flatbread on a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, and Parmesan. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until cheese melts, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven and slice into wedges.
To serve, divide skewers and cheesy flatbread between plates. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Sirloin Steak with Pineapple, Carrot, Cilantro & Broccoli Slaw

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a medium bowl. Add oil, vinegar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut off skin from pineapple; core and small dice. Add to the bowl.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with the broccoli slaw; toss to combine the coleslaw and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; add steak to the pan and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and let rest, about 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and coleslaw between plates or bowls; enjoy!

name: Grilled Spicy Asian Pork Skewers with Pineapple Salsa & Cabbage Slaw

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and slice lengthwise into thick planks. Place planks on a plate, then drizzle with oil and season with salt on both sides.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor skillet, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add the pineapple planks and grill, turning occasionally, until tender and charred in spots, about 8 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, place mayo, chili-garlic sauce, and salt in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat the pork dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl with the marinade and stir to coat.
Thread pork onto skewers and place on another plate. Alternatively, you can cook the pork pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.
Return the pan to medium-high heat; add the pork skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until the pork is charred and cooked through, about 8 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the shallot, then add fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Small dice pineapple, return to the plate, and drizzle with half of the dressing. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside. (Reserve remaining dressing for the next step.)
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the reserved dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop cashews. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw.
Divide skewers and slaw between plates. Serve with pineapple salsa on the side and enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak & Carrots with Garlic Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash, peel, and large dice potatoes. Transfer to a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and return to saucepan.
Wash carrots. Halve crosswise then halve or quarter lengthwise. Transfer to a medium bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with parsley flakes, salt, and pepper.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic. Wash and chop chives.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Place steak on grill/skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Once steak has been transferred, place carrots on grill/skillet. Cook until tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes per side.
Add broth, oil, garlic, chives, salt, and pepper to potatoes. Mash until smooth.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, arrange steak, carrots, and mashed potatoes on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak & Greek Salad Lettuce Wraps with Garlicky Yogurt Sauce

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels, then slice against the grain into ¼-inch thick strips. Transfer steak to a small bowl, pour half of the dressing over the steak, and turn to coat. Set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons. Transfer to the bowl with the remaining dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; add to the bowl.
Medium dice tomato and add to the bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes. Roughly chop olives. Add both to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a small bowl along with yogurt, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the yogurt sauce.
Once the grill pan is hot, add the steak strips and cook to desired doneness, about 1 minute per side for medium-rare. Transfer to a plate.
Separate lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Fill with Greek salad, steak, and feta. Serve with yogurt sauce on the side and enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Grilled Steak with Green Bean & Grape Tomato Salad

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Peel and finely dice the shallot. Grate zest from the lemon. In a large bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together the shallot, lemon zest and juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
amounts: zest and juice of ½ lemon

instructions.text: Wash the green beans, trim ends, and halve.

Add the green beans to the boiling water and cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes. Drain in a colander and rinse with cold water to prevent further cooking. Set aside to drain and cool.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the steak with salt and pepper on both sides.
Coat the grill or skillet with oil. Add the steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Wash the tomatoes and parsley. Halve the tomatoes and add to the dressing. Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems, mince the leaves, and add to the bowl.
Add the green beans to the bowl and toss to coat.
To serve, place the steak and salad on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak with Mango Salsa & Spinach-Tomato Salad

instructions.text: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together olive oil, lime juice, honey, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Season steak with salt and pepper.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Wash mango and jalapeño. Peel the mango, slice flesh away from the pit, small dice, and transfer to a medium bowl. Seed, mince, and add jalapeño to bowl. Peel, small dice, and add onion to bowl.
Add lime juice, honey, and salt to salsa; mix to combine.
Wash and dry spinach. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Wash and halve tomatoes. Add to bowl with spinach.
Place steak on a plate and top with mango salsa. Add salad on the side and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak & Mushroom Salad with Parmesan & Creamy Garlic Dressing

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 2-4 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats up, place mushrooms in a medium bowl. Add Worcestershire and spices, then toss to coat. Thread mushrooms onto the skewers and place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the mushrooms directly on the grill pan.)

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add mushroom skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until charred and tender, about 10 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve grill pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a clean medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with mayo, oil, Dijon, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels. Place on another plate, then season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Return grill pan to medium-high heat and coat with more oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
While the steak is cooking, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad, steak, and mushrooms between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak & Onion Salad with Spicy Jalapeño-Pineapple Salsa

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut skin off pineapple; quarter, core, and slice into ½-inch thick planks. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onion into half-moons; add to the bowl with the pineapple. Drizzle with oil and toss to coat.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add pineapple and onions. Grill, turning once, until charred and tender, about 4 minutes; remove to a plate. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in the reserved bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the garlic. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl, then add oil, vinegar, honey, and salt; whisk to combine the dressing.
Transfer the grilled pineapple to a cutting board and roughly chop. Add to the bowl with the dressing, stir to combine the salsa, and set aside.
Return grill pan to medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on another plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
