Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, onion, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice potato; medium dice tomato. Add both to the bowl with the cauliflower.
Add spices to the pan and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add cauliflower, potato, tomato, and broth to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to a simmer and cover; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 15-18 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the curry cooks, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in the reserved bowl (reserving the rest for the curry).
Trim and grate cucumber into the bowl with the cilantro; add yogurt, water, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the raita and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Arrange naan on a baking sheet pan and place in the oven; broil, flipping once, until golden brown and toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven, spread with oil, and cut into quarters.
When the curry is done, stir in reserved cilantro and remove from the heat.
Divide curry between bowls; serve with raita and naan on the side. Enjoy!

name: Indian Spiced Chicken Tacos with Tomato Raita & Cilantro-Carrot Salad

instructions.text: Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a small bowl.
Small dice tomato. Add to the bowl with the shallot along with yogurt, water, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the raita. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, fill with chicken, then top with raita. Serve with carrot salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Indian-Spiced Grilled Cheese with Carrot Chutney & Apricot-Mint Salad

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Place in a small saucepan.

Add water, vinegar, sugar, and spices to the pan with the carrot. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until carrots are soft and most of the liquid has evaporated, about 10 minutes. Remove chutney from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve apricots lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into thin slices and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the dressing and set aside. (Reserve remaining mint for the sandwiches.)
Slice mozzarella into thin rounds.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: When the carrot chutney is done, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place the bread slices on a flat surface. Layer mozzarella, chutney, and reserved mint over half of the slices, then cover sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes.

Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more oil to the skillet. Return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes more. Once done, transfer to a cutting board and slice in half.
Meanwhile, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing and apricots, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!

name: Indian Spiced Lentil Soup with Sweet Potato, Spinach & Pita

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and small dice the onion. Peel and mince the garlic.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, rinse the lentils in a colander or strainer.
Add ginger and spices to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the lentils, broth, water, salt and pepper to the pan; bring the mixture to a boil.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, peel and small dice the sweet potato; add to the pan.
Trim and discard the leaves and thick stem of the cauliflower and cut into small, bite-sized pieces; add to the pan.
Stir to combine the soup, then cover and reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until lentils and vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.
Cut pita into wedges.
Uncover the soup and stir in the spinach. Cook until spinach is wilted and soup is heated through, about 2 more minutes.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and serve with pita on the side. Enjoy!

name: Indian Spiced Potato Pockets with Mint Raita & Cilantro Chutney

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Medium dice potatoes. Transfer to a medium saucepan, add salt, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger. Transfer half of the ginger to a blender; place the other half in a small bowl.

Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeño with a spoon. Finely dice; add half to the blender and half to the small bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Juice lemon into the blender.

Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Add cilantro to the blender, along with coconut, water, salt, chili powder, and sugar. Blend on high until smooth and creamy. Transfer cilantro chutney to a small bowl and set aside. Rinse blender.

Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Transfer mint leaves to the blender along with yogurt, water, sugar, and spices. Blend on high until smooth and creamy. Transfer mint raita to a small bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince the onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add reserved ginger, jalapeño, and onion to the skillet; cook, stirring constantly, until softened, 3-5 minutes.
Add cooked potatoes, water, Dijon, and spices to the skillet; mash with a fork or potato masher, leaving some small pieces whole.
Add peas, and cook, stirring often, until peas are tender and potatoes are soft and fragrant, 2-3 minutes.
Toast pita if desired, then slice in half and carefully open using your fingers. Fill each pita with an equal portion of the potato filling.
To serve, divide spiced potato pockets between plates. Enjoy with cilantro chutney and mint raita on the side!

name: Indian Spiced Tofu & Spinach Stuffed Bell Peppers with Avocado Raita

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to another baking sheet, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then arrange cut-side up.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 8-12 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and place in a small bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl with the jalapeño.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Using your fingers, crumble tofu into the skillet, then add jalapeño, onion, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is soft and tofu is golden, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger. Add to the skillet and stir to combine.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the skillet. (Place remaining cilantro in the reserved bowl and set aside for the raita.)

When the tofu and onion are done, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add yogurt, stir to combine the filling, and remove from heat.

Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh, then add to the bowl with the cilantro along with additional yogurt, cumin, and salt. Mash with a fork or potato masher until the raita is smooth and combined.
Divide peppers between plates and stuff with tofu-spinach filling. Serve with avocado raita and enjoy!

name: Indian-Style Fried Rice with Turkey, Carrots, Green Onions & Cashews

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the carrots.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl and set aside. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop cashews.

When the turkey is done, add veggies to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat, add peas, and stir to combine; cover and set aside until the rice is done.
When the rice is done, add to the skillet. Return skillet to medium-high heat and continue to stir-fry until warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide fried rice between plates or bowls; top with cashews, chili-garlic sauce, and reserved green onions. Enjoy!

name: Indian Tofu Coconut Curry with Mushrooms, Zucchini, Cilantro & Rice

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, trim and medium dice zucchini. Place in a medium bowl.
Quarter mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, medium dice tofu.
When the veggies are softened, add tomato paste and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add tofu, coconut milk, and water to the skillet; stir to combine the curry and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened slightly, 5 minutes more.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. When the curry is thickened, add cilantro to the skillet and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and curry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Italian Chicken-Gnocchi Skillet with Broccoli, Snap Peas & Lemon

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Once the water in the pan is boiling, add gnocchi and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
While the gnocchi are cooking, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, chicken, and spices. Cook, stirring frequently, until chicken is golden and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add broccoli and snap peas to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Zest and juice lemon into the skillet, then add cooked gnocchi and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi is warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide gnocchi, veggies, and chicken between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Italian Chicken with Roasted Sweet Potatoes & Tomato-Mozzarella Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and cut sweet potato lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips; place in a medium bowl. Add oil and salt, toss to coat, then spread out on a baking sheet pan. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place sweet potato in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing once, until golden and fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Medium dice mozzarella and add to the bowl.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with spices.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
To serve, divide chicken, sweet potatoes, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Italian Chicken Wings with Lemon-Garlic Sauce & Tomato Caesar Salad

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).

Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and spices, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet, spread out in an even layer, and drizzle with oil.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic. Divide between a clean medium bowl and a small bowl.
Zest lemon into the medium bowl with the garlic. Juice lemon into the small bowl with the garlic, then add mayo, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the lemon-garlic dipping sauce and set aside.
Mince anchovy fillets. Add to the medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, honey, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomato lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
When the wings are almost done, using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide wings and salad between plates. Serve with dipping sauce on the side and enjoy!

name: Italian Garden Salad with Crispy Mozzarella & Chunky Tomato Dressing

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Chop or tear the lettuce into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a salad bowl.
Trim cucumber, quarter lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces. Add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and thinly slice shallot into rings; add to the bowl.
Drain and halve artichokes. Halve olives lengthwise. Add both to the bowl and toss to combine the salad; set aside.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Whisk egg in a small bowl. Place flour and bread crumbs on two separate plates.
Slice mozzarella into ½-inch thick rounds and pat dry with paper towels; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Dredge mozzarella slices in flour, shake off excess, then dip into the bowl with the egg. Let the excess drip off, then dredge in the bread crumbs, pressing  gently to adhere.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Carefully place breaded mozzarella in the skillet and cook, flipping once, until golden brown, 2-4 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, small dice tomato and place in a small bowl. Use a potato masher or fork to crush the tomatoes and release their juices.
Add oil, vinegar, and spices to the bowl with the tomatoes and whisk to combine the vinaigrette.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with crispy mozzarella and drizzle with vinaigrette. Enjoy!

name: Italian Inspired Turkey-Ricotta Pita Pizza with Zucchini & Spinach

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and small dice zucchini.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add zucchini, turkey, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until turkey is browned and crumbly and zucchini is tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, arrange pitas on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the pitas are baking, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add tomato sauce and half of the basil to the skillet with the turkey and zucchini, then stir to combine. (Reserve remaining basil for later use.)
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.

Spread pitas with about ⅔ of the ricotta; top with turkey mixture, then dot with remaining ricotta. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to bake until pizzas are warmed through, about 5 minutes.
When the pizzas are done, remove from the oven. Sprinkle with reserved basil and cut into wedges.
To serve, divide pizzas between plates and enjoy!

name: Italian Pasta Salad with Roasted Chicken, Fennel, Peppers & Artichokes

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper. Add to the baking sheet with the fennel.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, large dice, and add to the baking sheet. Drizzle chicken and veggies with oil, then season with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender, about 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Set aside.
While the pasta is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts and sun-dried tomatoes. Add both to the bowl.
When the chicken and veggies are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl, along with cooled pasta, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Italian Pork Meatballs with Garlic-Parmesan Zucchini Noodles

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of butter.
Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl. (Reserve a small handful of parsley for serving.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add half to the bowl with the parsley along with pork and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine. (Reserve remaining garlic for later use.)
Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the pork mixture into meatballs and place in the baking dish.
Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim zucchini; use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add reserved garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add zucchini noodles and spices to the skillet. Cook, tossing occasionally, until zucchini noodles are just tender, 3-4 minutes.
While the zucchini is cooking, finely grate Parmesan.
When the zucchini noodles are just tender, add Parmesan to the skillet. Continue to cook, tossing frequently, until cheese melts, 1 minute more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide zucchini noodles and meatballs between plates or bowls. Sprinkle with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Italian Sausage, Artichoke & Spinach Soup with Parmesan Crisps

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper and set aside.
Quarter artichokes, place in a small bowl, and set aside.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of each sausage; peel off casings and discard.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until brown and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.

Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. To make the crisps, measure out 1 tbsp of grated Parmesan and place in a pile on the baking sheet. Repeat with remaining Parmesan, keeping the piles a few inches apart.

Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until Parmesan is lightly browned and crisp, 5-7 minutes. (Watch carefully because they can burn quickly.) Once done, remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
When the sausage is done, add artichokes, broth, tomatoes, and spices to the pan. Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the soup is boiling, reduce heat, and simmer for 5 minutes.
While the soup is simmering, wash and dry the spinach (skip this step if the spinach came pre-washed), then roughly chop.
Add spinach to the soup in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from the heat.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with Parmesan crisps on the side. Enjoy!

name: Italian Sausage-Cabbage Stew with Tomato, Carrot, Parmesan & Toast

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, ground sausage, salt, and pepper. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and halve carrot lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the cabbage.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl.
When the sausage is done, add veggies, broth, and tomatoes to the pan. Stir to combine the stew and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the pan and stir to combine (set remaining parsley aside for serving).
Once the stew is simmering, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are soft, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the stew is cooking, preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then sprinkle with Italian seasoning. Place in the oven and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and cut toasts in half.
Finely grate Parmesan.
Divide stew between bowls; sprinkle with Parmesan and reserved parsley. Serve with toast on the side and enjoy!

name: Italian Sausage Skillet with Zucchini Noodles, Broccoli & Artichokes

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles; place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan, place in a small bowl, and set aside for serving.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of each sausage. Peel off casings and discard.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add sausage and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet, with cooking juices, for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.

Once the sausage is done, return the skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add broccoli and stir-fry until charred and just tender, about 5 minutes.
While the broccoli is cooking, peel and mince garlic.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes; thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes.
When the broccoli is tender, add garlic, artichokes, sun-dried tomatoes, salt, and pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add zucchini noodles and water to the skillet; continue to cook, tossing occasionally, until veggies are tender and liquid has evaporated, 1-2 minutes more.
Return cooked sausage to the skillet, juice lemon over top, and toss to combine; remove from heat.
To serve, divide sausage skillet between plates, top with Parmesan, and enjoy!

name: Italian Sausage Soup with Rotini Pasta, Bell Pepper, Tomato & Spinach

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of each sausage; peel off casings and discard.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, sausage, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until sausage is brown and crumbly, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry bell pepper; using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and small dice.
When the sausage is done, add bell pepper to the pan and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes more.
Add broth, tomatoes, water, pasta, and vinegar to the pan; stir to combine. Cover and bring to a boil; once boiling, reduce heat to medium, and simmer until pasta is cooked through, about 8 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the soup is simmering, wash and dry the spinach (skip this step if the spinach came pre-washed), then roughly chop.
Finely grate Parmesan.
Add spinach to the soup in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and top with Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Italian Stuffed Zucchini Boats with Ground Beef, Tomatoes & Mozzarella

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and halve zucchini lengthwise. Scrape out and discard the soft flesh from the middle of each half.
Place zucchini halves in a baking dish cut side up. Rub with a little olive oil and season with a little salt and pepper. Place in the oven and bake while you prepare the filling, 15-20 minutes.
amounts: about ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Wash and small dice mushrooms. Wash and small dice tomato. Peel and mince onion and garlic.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add onion, garlic, and mushrooms. Stirring frequently, cook until vegetables are softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add beef and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
Add diced tomato, tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Cook until most of the liquid has evaporated, 2-3 minutes.
Coarsely grate ½ cup of mozzarella.
Remove dish from oven. Fill zucchini halves with beef mixture and sprinkle with cheese. Place back in the oven and bake until cheese melts, 4-5 minutes.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, place zucchini boats on a plate and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Italian-Style Chopped Salad with White Beans, Artichokes & Parmesan

instructions.text: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl along with mayo, vinegar, oil, sugar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts and olives. Add both to the bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl.
Drain pickled onions. Add to the bowl, along with beans, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Italian-Style Macaroni Soup with Beef, Carrot, Celery & Bell Pepper

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat. Add the beef and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer beef to a plate and set aside. (Reserve saucepan with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Return the saucepan (with drippings) to medium-high heat.
While the pan is heating, peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Once the pan is hot, add the veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.

Return beef to the pan along with broth, tomatoes, pasta, and Worcestershire. Stir to combine the soup, cover, and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until pasta is cooked through, about 8 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Once the pasta is done, add half of the parsley to the soup and stir to combine. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
To serve, divide soup between bowls and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Italian-Style Turkey Burger with Mozzarella & Tomato Caesar Salad

instructions.text: Place turkey, egg, bread crumbs, and spices in a medium bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, thinly slice cheese.
When the patties are done on one side, flip, then top with cheese. Continue to cook until burgers are cooked through, 5-7 minutes more. Transfer to a clean plate.
While the burgers are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a clean medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; mince anchovy fillet. Add both to the bowl with the lemon juice, along with mayo, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Remove 1 whole lettuce leaf, cut in half, and set aside for the burgers. Chop (or tear) remaining lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Toast buns if desired.
Spread mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with burger patties and reserved lettuce. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Italian Tofu with Creamy Bell Pepper Rice & Orange-Olive Arugula Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 10 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and salt to the pan; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 10 fl oz (1 ¼ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the broth is heating up, trim, seed, and mince bell pepper.

Once the broth comes to a boil, add bell pepper and stir to combine; cover the saucepan and reduce heat to low. Cook bell pepper-rice until liquid is mostly absorbed, 18-20 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil and spices in a medium bowl; stir to combine the spice paste.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Medium dice tofu, add to the bowl with the spice paste, and gently stir to coat. Transfer tofu to a baking sheet and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until tofu is golden brown, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the tofu is cooking, peel and mince garlic. Place in the reserved bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and thinly slice shallot into rings. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut off skin and white pith from the orange; slice between the membranes to release segments. Add to the bowl.
Halve olives lengthwise. Add to the bowl along with the arugula and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan. When the bell pepper-rice is done, add Parmesan to the pan and stir until creamy and combined.
To serve, divide tofu, creamy bell pepper-rice, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Italian Tuna Melt with Tomato, Parmesan & Arugula

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, whisk together garlic, oil, vinegar, Dijon, dill, salt, and pepper.
Drain tuna, add to bowl, and flake with a fork.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash, dry, and small dice celery. Add to bowl and mix well. Set aside.
Wash and dry arugula. Wash and slice tomato into rounds.
Grate ¼ cup Parmesan.
Place bread slices on a sheet pan. Top 2 of the slices with a few arugula leaves, tomato slices, and tuna mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Place in the oven and broil until cheese melts and browns, 3-4 minutes.
In a medium bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add arugula to bowl and toss to coat.
To serve, place tuna melts on a plate and have salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Italian Tuna Salad Lettuce Wraps with Cannellini Beans & Olives

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl with the lemon and stir to combine.
Trim celery and thinly slice crosswise at an angle; add to the bowl.
Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl.
Halve olives lengthwise and add to the bowl.
Cut cheese into small cubes; add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add most of the parsley to the bowl (reserve a small amount for garnish).
Drain and flake tuna. Add to the bowl along with beans, mayo, and pepper. Stir to combine the salad.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Top with tuna salad and garnish with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Italian Turkey Meatball Sandwich with Mozzarella & Homemade Marinara

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a medium bowl, reserving the rest for garnish.
Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Transfer both to the bowl with the parsley.
Add turkey, egg, bread crumbs, and spices to the bowl with the parsley and mix with your hands until well combined.

Coat baking dish with a thin layer of oil. Using a tablespoon measure, form the meat mixture into rounded meatballs and place in the dish. Place the dish in the oven and bake until cooked through, 15-18 minutes.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, peel additional garlic and place in a blender.
Drain tomatoes and add to the blender along with sugar and spices. Blend on high until almost smooth.
Combine tomato purée and oil in a medium saucepan over medium-low heat; cook, stirring often, until sauce is thick and garlic is cooked through, 5-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate mozzarella; finely grate Parmesan. Transfer both to a small bowl and toss to combine; set aside.
When the meatballs are done, carefully transfer them to the pan with the tomato sauce; stir to combine.
Set oven temperature to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Split the rolls in half and place on a baking sheet pan, cut-side facing up. Place in the oven and cook until lightly toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from the oven.

Set the tops of the rolls aside, leaving the bottoms on the baking sheet pan. Sprinkle bottom of rolls with half of the cheese. Divide meatballs and sauce between the rolls and top with remaining cheese. Place in the oven and broil to melt the cheese, about 1 minute.
To serve, sprinkle reserved parsley and crushed red pepper over each sandwich. Close sandwiches and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Italian Wedding Soup with Turkey Meatballs & Kale

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the ends of the celery; small dice the celery (cut into ¼-inch cubes) and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel the carrot, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Small dice the carrot (cut into ¼-inch cubes) and add to the bowl with the celery.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the saucepan heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and add to the bowl with the celery and carrot.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the other vegetables.
Once the saucepan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the carrot, celery, onion, and garlic to the saucepan; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are softened, 5 to 6 minutes.
Finely grate about ¾ cup of Parmesan and transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

In a medium bowl, combine the ground turkey, ¾ of the grated Parmesan (save the rest for garnishing), salt, and pepper; mix together until well combined. Form the mixture into meatballs, each about 1 inch in diameter.
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the meatballs to the skillet; cook, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides (they don't need to be cooked through), 5 to 7 minutes. Once done, transfer to a bowl.
Once the vegetables are softened, add broth, Italian seasoning, and crushed red pepper to the saucepan and bring the mixture to a boil.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Cut out and discard the center stems from the kale leaves; slice the leaves crosswise into 1-inch strips and transfer to a large bowl.
Once boiling, add the kale and meatballs to the saucepan; season with additional salt and pepper. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook until the meatballs are cooked through, 6 to 8 minutes.
Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Stir the parsley into the soup.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and garnish with the remaining Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Jalapeño-Cheddar Grilled Cheese with Creamy Zucchini-Leek Soup

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off the root end and the dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ½-inch half-moons.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the saucepan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the leek and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve zucchinis lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half rounds. Add to the saucepan with the leeks.
Add flour to the saucepan; cook, stirring constantly, until combined, about 1 minute.
Gradually stir milk into the saucepan, then add the broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes, or until zucchini is tender.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) whole milk
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, quarter the jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeños with a spoon. Slice lengthwise into thin strips. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Coarsely grate cheddar.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the jalapeño strips and cook, stirring often, until soft and golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Top half of the bread slices with half of the cheddar. Add jalapeño strips and cover with remaining cheese. Close sandwiches and gently press to secure ingredients.
Return skillet to the stove over medium-low heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook, flipping once, until bread is golden brown and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a cutting board; slice sandwiches in half.
Using an immersion (hand) blender (or regular blender), purée the soup until smooth.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Serve with sandwiches and enjoy!

name: Jalapeño-Green Goddess Greens with Turkey Meatballs, Avocado & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic. Divide between a blender and a medium bowl. (Set bowl aside for later use.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Roughly chop chives. Add to the blender.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the blender along with mayo, oil, honey, salt, and pepper. Blend on high, adding water 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set dressing aside.

Add turkey, bread crumbs, and spices to the reserved bowl with the garlic; using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, along with mixed greens and feta, then toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide salad and meatballs between plates or bowls. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: Jalapeño-Peach Chicken Thighs with Creamy Avocado & Artichoke Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry, without turning, until golden underneath, 5-6 minutes. When the chicken is golden, flip, and remove skillet from the heat (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each quarter into wedges and place in a medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Small dice and add to the bowl with the peaches. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)

When the chicken has been removed from the heat, zest and juice lemon into the skillet; top chicken with peaches and jalapeño, then drizzle with honey (reserve bowl for the next step). Place skillet in the oven and bake until the chicken is cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the chicken is cooking, peel and mince garlic; transfer to the reserved bowl. Add mayo, vinegar, honey, Dijon, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear romaine into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad, chicken, and peaches between plates. Enjoy!

name: Japanese Ginger Beef Skillet with Mushrooms, Peas, Green Onions & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small bowl along with broth, soy sauce, cornstarch, fish sauce, and sugar. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Thinly slice mushrooms.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot.
When the mushrooms are done, add carrot, beef, additional salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
While the beef is cooking, place peas in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain further.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.

When the beef is done, add the sauce, peas, and half of the green onions to the skillet (reserve remaining green onions for serving). Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and beef skillet between plates or bowls; top with reserved green onions. Enjoy!

name: Japanese-Style Breaded Tofu (Katsu) with Sesame Veggie Slaw & Rice

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, place mayo and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the curried mayo.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, cut the tofu planks in half crosswise and return to the baking sheet.

Spread half of the curried mayo over the top side of the tofu, sprinkle with half of the bread crumbs (pressing gently to adhere), and drizzle with half of the oil. Carefully flip tofu and repeat with remaining mayo, bread crumbs, and oil. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place tofu in the oven and bake, turning halfway through, until the breading is crispy and golden brown, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place ketchup, soy sauce, maple syrup, chili-garlic sauce, and garlic powder in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the "tonkatsu" sauce and set aside.
Place additional mayo, vinegar, soy sauce, oil, and chili-garlic sauce in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, trim, and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash, dry, trim, and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl, along with the broccoli slaw, and toss to combine.
To serve, divide rice, tofu, and slaw between plates or bowls; drizzle sauce over tofu and enjoy!

name: Japanese-Style Broccoli Slaw Pancake (Okonomiyaki) with Crispy Sausage

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Add eggs and broth to the bowl with the ginger and garlic; whisk to combine and set aside.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Place flour, baking powder, and salt in another medium bowl; whisk to combine. Gradually add the egg mixture to the bowl with the flour, whisking to create a smooth batter.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, add broccoli slaw to the bowl with the batter and stir until thoroughly combined.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add half the pancake batter (1¼-cups per pancake) to the skillet and smooth out into a large, ½-inch thick pancake. Cook, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and cover with foil.
While the pancake is cooking, preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of each sausage. Peel off casings and discard.
Add sausage meat to the pan and cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until crispy and cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside.
Once the first pancake is done cooking, add more oil to the skillet and repeat with remaining batter.
Meanwhile, chop chives into small pieces and set aside.
Juice the lime into a small bowl. Add mayo and chili-garlic sauce; whisk to combine the spicy mayo.
To serve, place a pancake on each plate. Top with crispy sausage, drizzle with spicy mayo, and sprinkle with chives. Enjoy!

name: Japanese-Style Broccoli Slaw Pancake (Okonomiyaki) with Tuna & Avocado

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain tuna and transfer to a medium bowl; flake with a fork.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the tuna.
Add eggs and broth to the bowl with the tuna; whisk to combine.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Place flour, baking powder, and salt in another medium bowl; whisk to combine. Gradually add the egg mixture to the bowl with the flour, whisking to create a smooth batter.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, add broccoli slaw to the bowl with the batter and stir until thoroughly combined.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add half the pancake batter (1½-cups per pancake) to the skillet and smooth out into a large, ½-inch thick pancake. Cook, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, juice lime into a small bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime, along with mayo and chili-garlic sauce; whisk to combine the spicy mayo and set aside.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; transfer to a plate.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the plate with the green onions.
Once the first pancake is done cooking, add more oil to the skillet and repeat with remaining batter.
To serve, place a pancake on each plate. Top with green onions and avocado; drizzle with spicy mayo and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Japanese-Style Tofu Curry with Butternut Squash, Mushrooms & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, quarter mushrooms and place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl. (Reserve a small handful of green onions for serving.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While skillet heats up, medium dice tofu. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, ginger, green onion, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally until tender, 6-8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the tofu.

Once the mushrooms are tender, add tofu, squash, broth, soy sauce, honey, and vinegar to the skillet; stir to combine the curry and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and continue to cook, until squash is tender, about 15 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, place water and cornstarch in the reserved bowl. Whisk until slurry is smooth.
When the squash is tender, add slurry to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce is thickened, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and curry between plates or bowls. Top with reserved green onions and enjoy!

name: Jerk Chicken Drumsticks with Sweet & Savory Piña Colada Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger, garlic, and shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with soy sauce, oil, and spices; stir to combine the rub.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and add to the bowl with the rub; turn to coat.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add chicken and grill, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Remove to a plate and cover with foil.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400°F.
Juice lime into another medium bowl.
Trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Cut off skin from pineapple, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Seed and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Spread coconut on a baking sheet pan, place in the oven, and toast until golden, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Sprinkle salad with toasted coconut and enjoy!

name: Jerk-Style Pork, Mango & Bell Pepper Kebabs with Wilted Swiss Chard

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger, shallot, and garlic. Place all three in a medium bowl, along with oil and spices, then whisk to combine the sauce.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; large dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the sauce.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.

Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl and stir to combine. Thread mango, bell pepper, and pork onto the skewers, alternating ingredients; place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook directly on the grill pan.)
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add the skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until the pork is charred and cooked through, about 8 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves and stems into bite-sized pieces, keeping them separate. Place leaves in a clean medium bowl and stems in a small bowl. Set the medium bowl aside for later use.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince additional garlic. Add to the bowl with the chard stems.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chard stems, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring often, until stems are softened, 1-2 minutes.
Add chard leaves to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for them to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until chard is tender, 1-2 minutes more.
Add vinegar to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide skewers and chard between plates. Enjoy!

name: Kalamata-Balsamic Tilapia over Orzo with Tomato, Bell Pepper & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and orzo, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain in a colander.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the tilapia dry with paper towels. Season both sides with salt and pepper.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the tilapia and cook, flipping once, until fish is crispy and easily flakes with a fork, about 6 minutes. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
While the fish is cooking, trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Place in a small bowl.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.

Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, olives, tomatoes, and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the veggies are soft, add half of the basil and vinegar to the skillet. Stir to combine and remove from heat. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
To serve, divide orzo and tilapia between plates or bowls. Top with veggies, feta, and reserved basil. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Kale Caesar Burger with Crisp Apple & Parmesan Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; mince anchovy fillets. Divide both evenly between two medium bowls; set one bowl aside.
Add beef, salt, and pepper to the first bowl with garlic and anchovy. Use your hands to thoroughly combine. Form into 2 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
Zest and juice lemon into the second bowl with garlic and anchovy. Add mayo and whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter and core apple, then thinly slice each quarter; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces, add to the bowl with the dressing, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Place burger patties on the grill and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and grill an additional 3-4 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Toast buns on the grill pan (if desired).
Place a burger on the bottom half of each bun; top with half the Parmesan and a small portion of salad. Close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide burgers and remaining salad between plates. Top salad with remaining Parmesan and enjoy!

name: Kale Caesar Salad with Seared Strip Steak & Parmesan Crisps

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper and set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan. Place half in a medium bowl and set aside for the salad. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for the next step.)

To make crisps from the remaining cheese, measure out 1 tbsp of grated Parmesan and place in a pile on the baking sheet. Repeat with remaining Parmesan, keeping the piles a few inches apart. Season with pepper.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until Parmesan is lightly browned and crisp, 8-10 minutes. (Watch carefully because they can burn quickly.) Once done, remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Mince anchovy fillet. Add both to the bowl with the reserved Parmesan.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon into the bowl. Add mayo, oil, vinegar, pepper, and salt; whisk to combine the dressing.

Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, break Parmesan crisps into bite-sized pieces.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with Parmesan crisps and steak. Enjoy!

name: Kale Cobb Salad with Prosciutto, Sweet Potato, Apple & Blue Cheese

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potato. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potato is golden and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing and, using your hands, massage kale until wilted, 1-2 minutes. Set aside.
Peel and quarter eggs, then season with salt and pepper. Place on a plate.
Chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces. Add to the plate with the eggs.
Quarter, core, and medium dice apple. Add to the plate.
To serve, divide kale between plates or bowls. Top with prosciutto, eggs, sweet potato, apple, and blue cheese. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

name: Kale-Potato Cakes with Lemon Aioli & Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and chop the potatoes into 1-inch cubes; peel and smash the garlic (press firmly with the flat side of a knife or bottom of a pot).
Place the potatoes and garlic in a medium saucepan, season with salt, and cover with water. Cover with a lid and place on the stove at high heat; bring the water to a boil.
Fold leaves of kale in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.
When the potato water comes to a boil, uncover, turn down to medium, and cook until potatoes are almost done, 8 minutes. Add kale to the pot and cook 2 minutes more.
Meanwhile, grate the zest from the lemon and transfer to a small bowl, then juice the lemon into a medium salad bowl.
Grate cheese and set aside.
Add oil, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the salad bowl with the lemon juice; whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve the grape tomatoes and add them to the bowl with the dressing. Chop green onions into ¼-inch pieces, set aside.
Once potatoes and kale are done, drain and return to the pot. Cook, shaking the pan occasionally, over medium-low heat until dry, about 2 minutes; remove from heat.
Using a potato masher or fork, mash potato and kale until almost smooth, with a few small chunks remaining. Add bread crumbs, cheese, egg, green onions, Dijon, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, add mayonaise, garlic powder, and paprika to the small bowl with the lemon zest and mix to make the aioli.

Once the skillet is hot add oil. Using a ⅓ measuring cup for each cake, drop potato mixture into the pan, pressing to make ½-inch thick rounds. Cook 3 minutes on each side, until crisp and golden; set aside. Cook in batches if necessary.
Toss arugula with salad dressing and tomatoes.
To serve, divide potato cakes and salad between plates. Serve with aioli and enjoy!

name: Kale Salad with Bacon, Pineapple, Coconut & Orange Yogurt Dressing

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, zest and juice orange into a medium bowl. Add yogurt, oil, vinegar, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Wipe skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium heat. Add coconut and almonds; cook, stirring frequently, until golden and toasted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with bacon, coconut, and almonds. Enjoy!

name: Kale Salad with Chicken, Apple, Dates, Pumpkin Seeds & Crispy Parmesan

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper and set aside.
Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, mayo, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; finely chop leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes. Set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan. Place in a pile on the baking sheet and spread out into a 6-inch circle.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until Parmesan is lightly browned and crisp, 5-7 minutes. (Watch carefully as the Parmesan can burn quickly.) Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry apple; using a clean cutting board, quarter, core, and thinly slice. Add to the bowl with the kale.
Roughly chop dates and add to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
Break the crispy Parmesan into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls and top with sliced chicken, pumpkin seeds, and crispy Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Kale Salad with Nutty Middle Eastern Spiced "Dukkah" Eggs & Flatbread

instructions.text: Mince walnuts.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add walnuts, garlic, sesame seeds, and spices to the pan. Cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant and toasted, 1-2 minutes. Transfer the "dukkah" spice mix to a small bowl to keep the garlic from overcooking. (Reserve pan for next step.)

Wipe the saucepan clean with paper towels. Place eggs in the pan, cover with water (from the tap), and bring to a boil; reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince additional garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic, then add oil, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing; using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons; halve tomatoes. Add both to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Peel eggs, roll in the dukkah to coat, and halve lengthwise. (Reserve remaining dukkah for the flatbread.)
Toast flatbread if desired; drizzle with oil, sprinkle with remaining dukkah, and cut into wedges.
To serve, divide salad, eggs, and flatbread between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Kale Salad with Peppers, Prosciutto, Pine Nuts & Anchovy Dressing

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
