Divide skewers and eggplant between plates; top eggplant with tahini sauce, pine nuts, and reserved mint. Serve with lemon wedges on the side. Enjoy!

name: Lemon-Garlic Zucchini Salad with Walnuts & Ricotta Cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim the zucchini ends. Using a spiralizer, julienne peeler (or regular peeler) peel into noodle-like sticks; transfer to colander and sprinkle with salt. Set the colander in a bowl to catch the excess moisture.
Grate all the zest from the lemon, then juice the lemon; transfer both to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince or press the garlic; transfer to the bowl, whisking together with oil, lemon juice, and pepper.
Place a skillet over medium heat. Coarsely chop walnuts. Toast walnuts until fragrant (2-4 minutes) stirring regularly.
Pick the basil leaves off the stems and slice into ribbons.

Shake the zucchini noodles in the colander over the sink to remove excess water; transfer the noodles to the centre of a clean towel and wring over the sink to remove as much moisture as possible (you should squeeze out at least ½ a cup).
Add zucchini to the bowl with the dressing and toss until coated with dressing.
To serve, arrange zucchini noodles on a plate and top with walnuts and teaspoon sized scoops of ricotta cheese. Sprinkle with basil ribbons and enjoy!

name: Lemon-Herb Chicken over Warm Vegetable Primavera Rice Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and small dice zucchini. Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus and cut into 1-inch pieces. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest lemon into a small bowl, then set lemon aside for later use.

Add peas to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until peas are warm and veggies are tender-crisp, 2 minutes more. Return veggies to the bowl and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Chop chives into small pieces. Add both to the bowl with the lemon zest.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl along with salt, and stir to combine the herb mix. Set aside.
Return skillet to medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken, half of the herb mix (reserving the rest for the rice salad), salt, and pepper. Sauté, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, transfer cooked rice and remaining herb mix to the bowl with the veggies. Juice lemon into the bowl, drizzle with oil, and stir to combine the rice salad.
To serve, divide warm rice salad and chicken between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Lemon-Herb Pork Chop with Feta & Greek Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic; add oil and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place in a small baking dish. Pour marinade over the chops, turn to coat, and set aside. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
While the chops are marinating, peel and mince additional garlic; place in the reserved bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; medium dice tomato. Add both to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Thinly slice olives and add to the bowl; stir to combine the salad and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add chops and marinade; pan-fry until golden brown on one side, 3-4 minutes.

Flip chops and sprinkle the top side with half of the feta (reserve remaining feta for the salad). Continue to pan-fry until cheese has softened and chops are cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide chops and salad between plates; top salad with reserved feta and enjoy!

name: Lemon Oregano Chicken, Feta Mashed Potatoes & Cucumber-Tomato Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and mince garlic and shallot. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and halve cucumber lengthwise; slice crosswise into half-moons. Halve tomatoes. Add both to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add salt, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, peel and chop potatoes into ½-inch cubes. Add to the saucepan and cook until very tender, about 10 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan.
Drizzle chicken with oil and season with spices on both sides; arrange in a single layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven and broil the chicken for 5 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice lemon.

Remove baking sheet from the oven. Using tongs, flip the chicken and place a lemon slice on top of each thigh. Return to the oven and continue to broil until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
When the potatoes are tender, drain in a colander and return to the pan. Add feta, milk, oil, and spices; blend or mash until smooth.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide chicken, salad, and mashed potatoes between plates. Enjoy!

name: Lemon-Oregano Salmon with Greek Spinach-Rice (Spanakorizo) &  Tzatziki

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel, trim, and quarter the cucumber lengthwise; thinly slice crosswise. Transfer to a colander and sprinkle with salt. Place the colander in a bowl to catch the excess moisture and set aside.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Roughly chop the spinach. Add spinach to the saucepan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.

Using a strainer, rinse rice under cold, running water, then drain and add to the saucepan with the spinach. Add half the dill (reserving the rest for the tzatziki), broth, salt, and pepper; stir to combine, then scrape down the edges of the pan to submerge the rice. Bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until tender and liquid is mostly absorbed, 15-18 minutes (the rice should resemble a saucy risotto). Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, place the salmon, skin-side down, on a baking sheet pan. Rub with oil and season with spices on both sides.
Trim, halve, and slice lemon into thin half-moons. Arrange lemon slices over the salmon, place in the oven, and bake until flakey and cooked through, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic. Add to the bowl with the reserved dill, along with yogurt, pepper, and salt; stir to combine.
Use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the sliced cucumber. Add cucumber to the yogurt mixture and stir to combine the tzatziki; set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan. When the spinach-rice is done, add half of the Parmesan to the pan and stir to combine. Set remaining Parmesan aside for garnish.
To serve, divide spinach-rice, salmon, and tzatziki between plates. Sprinkle remaining Parmesan over the spinach-rice and enjoy!

name: Lemon-Parsley Panko Crusted Cod with Creamy Spinach & Mushroom Sauté

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince shallot.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Zest and juice lemon into the skillet; add half the shallot (reserving the rest for later) and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Add parsley, bread crumbs, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until bread crumbs begin to brown, 3-4 minutes. Remove skillet from the heat.

Pat the cod dry with paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Coat the top side of each fillet with mayo, then press the bread crumb mixture on top to form a crust. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until the fish is cooked through and flaky, about 15 minutes.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, thinly slice mushrooms.

Once the skillet is hot, add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add remaining shallot, mushrooms, salt, and pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring often, until veggies start to soften, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add cream cheese and cream to the skillet; stir until combined and warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide baked cod and veggie sauté between bowls or plates. Enjoy!

name: Lemon Pepper Pork Chop with Parmesan-Roasted Carrots & Dressed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 2-inch long sticks. Place in a medium bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the carrots, along with mayo and spices, then stir to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until carrots are fork-tender and cheese is golden and crispy, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest lemon into a small bowl. Add flour and spices, then stir to combine the coating. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; sprinkle with the coating on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest.
Meanwhile, juice reserved lemon into the reserved medium bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Just before serving, add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
To serve, divide carrots, chops, and dressed greens between plates. Enjoy!

name: Lemon Pepper Steak with Mashed Potatoes & Green Beans

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash, peel, and large dice potatoes; add to saucepan. Once boiling, cook until potatoes are tender, 10-12 minutes.

Peel and mince garlic. Grate 1 tsp of lemon zest. In a medium bowl, prepare marinade by mixing together ¼ of the garlic (save the rest for the green beans), lemon zest, lemon juice, oil, oregano, pepper, and salt.
Place steak in bowl and coat with marinade.
Wash green beans and trim ends.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
amounts: about ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.text: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat and add coconut oil. Add remaining garlic and crushed red pepper. Cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
amounts: about ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.text: Add green beans to the sauté pan and, stirring occasionally, cook until tender crisp, 5-7 minutes.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Drain potatoes and return back to saucepan. Add parsley, chicken broth, oil, salt, and pepper. Mash until smooth.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Remove beans from heat. Season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
To serve, arrange steak, mashed potatoes and green beans on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Lemon-Ricotta Flatbread with Crisp Asparagus and Prosciutto

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, and zest lemon into a small bowl (reserve lemon for later use).
Add ricotta, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon zest. Stir to combine and set aside.

Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until flatbreads are slightly crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice reserved lemon into the bowl with the shallot. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears crosswise into thin coins. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop (or tear) prosciutto into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
Spread the lemon ricotta over each flatbread, then top with asparagus-prosciutto salad.
To serve, cut flatbreads into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Lemon-Roasted Salmon with Dill-Yogurt Sauce & Greek Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice half of the lemon into a small baking dish. Add oil, vinegar, sugar, and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade. (Reserve remaining lemon for later use.)
Pat the salmon dry with paper towels. Add to the baking dish with the marinade and turn to coat.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until salmon is opaque and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between a small and a medium bowl, then set the medium bowl aside for the salad.
Juice reserved lemon into the small bowl with the dill. Add yogurt, mayo, and spices, then whisk to combine the sauce. Set aside.
Add oil, vinegar, and spices to the medium bowl with the dill, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl, along with feta, and stir to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide salad and salmon between plates or bowls. Top salmon with sauce and enjoy!

name: Lemon-Rosemary Steak & Dressed Greens with Broiled Parmesan Tomatoes

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Slide rosemary leaves off the sprigs; discard sprigs and mince the leaves. Divide between two medium bowls.
Peel and mince garlic; add to one of the bowls with the rosemary.

Zest lemon into the bowl with the rosemary and garlic; add oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the marinade, add the steak, and turn to coat; set aside. (Reserve lemon for the next step.)
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: While the steak is marinating, juice lemon into the second bowl with the rosemary; add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest.
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes and transfer to a baking sheet pan, cut-side up; season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven and broil until softened, about 8 minutes.
While the tomatoes are broiling, finely grate Parmesan and place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic; add to the bowl with the Parmesan, along with Italian seasoning, and stir to combine.
When the tomatoes are soft, remove from the oven and top with the Parmesan mixture. Return to the oven and continue to broil until the cheese is melted and golden, 2-3 minutes more.
While the tomatoes are broiling, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces, add to the bowl with the dressing, and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad and broiled tomatoes between plates; top salad with steak and enjoy!

name: Lemon-Soy Steak with Asparagus, Mushrooms, Ginger & Sesame Seeds

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon juice, along with soy sauce, oil, and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Add steak to the bowl with the marinade, turn to coat, and set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Slice mushrooms into ¼-inch thick pieces and add to the baking sheet with the asparagus.
Peel and mince ginger and additional garlic; sprinkle over the veggies.
Drizzle veggies with oil and soy sauce; sprinkle with sesame seeds, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, tossing once, until veggies are fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the steak and marinade; pan-fry until steak reaches desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and let rest 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide veggies and steak between plates. Enjoy!

name: Lemon-Spinach Orzo Pasta with Pan-Fried Chicken, Leeks, Dill & Feta

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into thin pieces.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leek and garlic; cook, stirring frequently, until beginning to soften, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest the lemon. Juice lemon into a small bowl.

When the leek and garlic have softened, add lemon zest, broth, orzo, and salt to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed and orzo is desired firmness, 10-15 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice, along with the feta, and set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
When the orzo is done, add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add lemon juice, dill, and feta to the pan. Stir to combine and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until warmed through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Using a clean cutting board, slice chicken into thin strips.
To serve, divide orzo and chicken between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Lemon-Tahini Chicken Thighs with Tomato, Cucumber & Feta Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a small bowl. Add salt and pepper, then stir to combine the lemon seasoning. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, transfer to the baking sheet, and sprinkle with lemon seasoning on both sides. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until chicken is golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice half of the lemon into the small reserved bowl. Juice the remaining lemon into a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide parsley between the two bowls, then set the medium bowl aside for later use.
Add tahini, water, vinegar, and spices to the small bowl. Whisk to combine the lemon-tahini sauce and set aside.
Add oil, additional vinegar, salt, and pepper to the medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl, along with the feta, and gently stir to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Drizzle chicken with lemon-tahini sauce and enjoy!

name: Lemon-Thyme Roasted Chicken & Leeks over Mashed Butternut Squash

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard stems and place leaves in a medium bowl.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the thyme; add honey and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, add to the bowl with the marinade, and turn to coat; set aside.

Trim off the root ends and dark green tops of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit.
Slice leeks crosswise into 4-inch pieces. Transfer to a baking dish and arrange side-by-side, cut-side down.
Cut butter into small pieces.
Arrange chicken on top of the leeks, pouring any leftover marinade on top. Sprinkle butter over leeks and chicken, then season with additional salt and pepper.
Place baking dish in the oven and roast, turning chicken halfway through, until leeks are tender and chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice. Place squash in a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until squash is fork-tender, 12-14 minutes.
When the squash is done, drain in a colander and return to the saucepan; add cream, salt, and pepper. Using a potato masher, mash until smooth.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide mashed butternut squash, roasted leeks, and chicken between plates. Enjoy!

name: Lemony Chicken, Egg & Rice Soup (Avgolemono) with Greek Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a medium saucepan.

Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Add chicken to the pan with the carrot and celery, placing the fillets over the veggies in a single layer; sprinkle with spices.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add broth, rice, and oil to the pan. Place the pan over high heat, cover, and bring to a boil; once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and rice is almost tender, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, halve, and thinly slice bell pepper. Peel, trim, and thinly slice cucumber crosswise into rounds. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and olives; add both to the bowl along with the feta.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the dill to the bowl and toss to combine the salad; set aside. (Reserve remaining dill for the soup.)
Juice lemon into another medium bowl. Add the egg and whisk to combine the thickening liquid; set aside.

When the chicken is done, remove fillets to a plate using tongs (cover the soup and continue to simmer over low heat). Shred the chicken using two forks; use one fork to hold the chicken and the other fork to pull and shred the meat. Set aside.
Using a ladle, carefully add 1-2 cups of hot broth (from the saucepan) to the bowl with the thickening liquid, whisking constantly.

Slowly pour the warm thickening liquid back into the saucepan, stirring to combine. Add shredded chicken and reserved dill; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Lemony Chicken Piccata with Blanched Asparagus

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and transfer to a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the breasts in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season the cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, add flour to a small plate. Dredge the chicken cutlets in flour, shake off excess, and place on a large plate.
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and butter and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add the chicken cutlets to the skillet; cook until golden brown and cooked through, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the chicken to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm. Cook in batches if necessary.
While the chicken cooks, fill a medium saucepan about three-quarters of the way with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the cutting board and knife.
Snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; transfer to a bowl.
Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.
Cut the lemon in half; juice one half into a small bowl and thinly slice the other half into rounds.

Once the chicken has been transferred, reduce the heat to medium and add lemon juice, broth, capers, lemon slices, and parsley to the skillet; scrape up any browned bits from the bottom. Cook the sauce until it is reduced by about half, then stir in the butter.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, season with salt then add the asparagus. Cook until the asparagus is bright green and tender-crisp, 1 to 3 minutes. Once cooked, drain in a colander and run under cold water to stop the cooking process. Set aside to drain further.
To serve, divide the asparagus between plates and season with salt and pepper. Place the chicken on the side, spoon the sauce overtop, and garnish with the lemon slices.

name: Lemony Chicken Piccata with Parmesan Wilted Spinach

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season the cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a stainless steel or cast iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, flipping once, until cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Wash and juice half the lemon into a small bowl; cut the other half of the lemon into wedges and set aside.
When the chicken is cooked, remove from skillet and set aside on a plate, loosely covered with aluminum foil.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until the onion is softened, 3-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.

Add lemon juice, vinegar, and butter to skillet along with any accumulated drippings from the chicken plate. Cook, stirring frequently, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet, about 1 minute.
Add capers, parsley, and chicken to the skillet and cook, 2 minutes more. Remove skillet from heat and set aside.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Wash spinach (unless it came pre-washed).
Add butter to the second skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Season with salt and pepper. Finely grate Parmesan into the skillet and stir to combine.
To serve, divide chicken, rice, and wilted spinach between plates, garnish with lemon wedges, and enjoy!

name: Lemony Chicken Thighs with Charred Scallion Dressing & Grilled Veggies

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a small bowl. Add salt and pepper, then stir to combine the lemon seasoning. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and transfer to the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with lemon seasoning on both sides. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until chicken is golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and slice zucchini lengthwise into ¼-inch thick planks. Place on a plate.
Halve and pit avocado. Add to the plate with the zucchini.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, trim green onions and add to the plate. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Once the pan is hot, add the green onions. Grill until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side; return to the plate.
Place zucchini on the pan. Grill until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, roughly chop ⅓ of the green onions. Place in the reserved bowl. (Set remainder aside for serving.)

Juice half of the reserved lemon into the bowl with the onions (set remaining lemon aside for the veggies). Add yogurt and spices, then stir to combine. Add water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set dressing aside.
When the zucchini is done, place avocado, cut-side down, on the pan. Grill until charred on the cut-side and warmed through, 1-2 minutes per side; return to the plate.
When the avocado is done, squeeze the reserved lemon over the veggies, then drizzle with additional oil.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates; drizzle dressing over chicken. Enjoy!

name: Lemony Gnocchi with Crispy Prosciutto, Snap Peas, Radishes & Parmesan

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Once the water in the pan is boiling, add gnocchi and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside. (Reserve a ¼-cup gnocchi water before draining.)

While the gnocchi are cooking, trim off root end and dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into thin pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Trim and quarter radishes. Add to the bowl with the leeks.
Cut snap peas crosswise into ½-inch pieces. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add prosciutto and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 2-3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer prosciutto to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for the next step.)
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.

When the veggies are done, zest and juice lemon into the skillet, then add drained gnocchi and stir to combine. Add reserved gnocchi water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency. Continue to cook until gnocchi is warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide gnocchi and veggies between plates or bowls. Top with Parmesan and crispy prosciutto. Enjoy!

name: Lemony Mushroom & Orzo Soup with Tuna-Tomato Sourdough Toast

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the mushrooms, onion, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms are tender, about 10 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, drain tuna, place in the reserved bowl, and flake with a fork. Add mayo and spices, then stir to combine the tuna salad. Set aside.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Slice tomato crosswise into thin rounds and set aside.

When the mushrooms are tender, zest and juice lemon into the pan, then add broth and orzo. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and cook until the pasta is tender, 7-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Divide tuna salad between toasted bread and top with tomato slices. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with tuna-tomato toast on the side. Enjoy!

name: Lemony Pasta Primavera with Chicken, Asparagus & Peas

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears into 2-inch pieces at an angle and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the asparagus.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season generously with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: When the water in the saucepan comes to a boil, uncover the pan and season the water with salt, then add the pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook the pasta, uncovered, for 11 to 12 minutes (or according to package directions). Drain the pasta in a colander, reserving ½ cup of the cooking water.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the chicken cutlets in the skillet; cook until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 4-6 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.

Once the chicken has been transferred, add more butter to the skillet followed by the asparagus, garlic, and peas; season with salt and pepper. Cook, tossing frequently, until the asparagus is bright green and just tender, 4 to 6 minutes.
Finely grate ½ cup of Parmesan and transfer to a small bowl. Add the yogurt and stir to combine.
Grate the zest from the lemon and transfer to the bowl with the Parmesan, then juice the lemon into the same bowl; stir to combine.

To the asparagus and peas, add the cooked pasta, butter, Parmesan mixture, and half of the reserved pasta water. Cook, tossing constantly, until the mixture is well combined, 2 to 3 minutes. (If the sauce is dry, gradually add the remaining pasta cooking water to achieve your desired consistency.)
Slice the chicken crosswise into strips.
To serve, divide the pasta between plates and top with the chicken slices. Enjoy!

name: Lemony "Shrimp Boil" Soup with Pork Sausage, Fennel, Corn & Kale

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter new potatoes. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, slice sausages crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes.

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim off root end and dark green stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the potato.

When the sausage is done, add potato, fennel, broth, tomato sauce, corn, and spices to the pan. Stir to combine and bring the soup to a boil. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are fork-tender, 10-12 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the soup is cooking, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Place in the reserved bowl.
When the potatoes are tender, add kale to the pan in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add shrimp to the soup and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through and kale is tender, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, cut lemon into wedges.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Squeeze lemon over top and enjoy!

name: Lemony Tuna, White Bean & Sweet Pepper Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Grate the zest from the lemon and transfer to a small bowl, then juice the lemon into the same bowl. Peel and mince (or press) the garlic; add to bowl with the lemon.
Add oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice and whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and rinse the beans; set aside to drain further.
Drain the tuna and transfer to a large salad bowl; flake with a fork. Place the spinach in the bowl with the tuna.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Cut the bell pepper into quarters lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membranes. Medium dice the pepper and add to the bowl with the spinach.
Remove the root ends from the green onions and cut them crosswise, into ¼ inch pieces at an angle; add them to the salad bowl.
Halve the tomatoes and add them to the salad bowl as well.
Add beans to the salad bowl along with the dressing; toss to coat.
Halve avocado and remove pit; scoop out the flesh and cut into slices; set aside.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls and top with avocado slices. Enjoy!

name: Lemony White Bean-Arugula Salad with Prosciutto & Homemade Croutons

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut bread into ¾-inch cubes.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add bread cubes to the skillet and season with spices. Toast the bread, tossing occasionally, until croutons are golden brown, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Juice lemon into a large bowl. Add oil, Dijon, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and rinse beans, then add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
Add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Use a vegetable peeler to shave the Parmesan.
To serve, divide salad between plates. Top with croutons and Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Lemony White Bean Spinach Salad Topped with Feta & Pistachios

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and thinly slice the carrots at an angle.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add the carrots and cook until fork-tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water and set aside.
Meanwhile, zest half the lemon into a medium bowl, then juice the whole lemon into the same bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl.
Add oil and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and mince the shallot; add to the bowl, stirring to combine.
Halve and pit the avocado; cut the flesh into cubes while still in the skin and scoop out into the bowl.
Drain and rinse the beans in the colander with the carrots, then add both to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Roughly chop the pistachios.
To serve, divide spinach between plates, layer with vegetable-bean salad and top with feta cheese and pistachios. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Lentil-Arugula Salad with Beets, Oranges, Pine Nuts & Goat Cheese

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel, trim, and cut beets into ½-inch cubes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and roast, stirring halfway through, until fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the lentils are cooking, zest half of the oranges into a medium bowl (reserve oranges for later use).
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl with the orange zest along with vinegar, oil, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Cut off skin and white pith from reserved oranges; slice between the membranes to release segments. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Crumble goat cheese into a small bowl.
When the lentils are done, drain in a colander, rinse with cold water, and add to the bowl with the orange segments.
Add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with roasted beets, pine nuts, and goat cheese. Enjoy!

name: Lentil Bolognese with Fettuccine Pasta & Basil

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water; cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim the ends and peel the carrot; discard the trimmings and small dice the carrot. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim and discard the ends of the celery; small dice the celery and add to the bowl.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl with the other vegetables.
Add olive oil to the pan and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the carrots, celery, and onion to the pan and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, season with salt and add the pasta; stir for the few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 9 to 10 minutes. Once done, drain the pasta.
amounts: 5 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) fettuccine pasta

instructions.text: Add the garlic to the pan and stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, and lentils; season with salt and pepper. Cover and cook until the lentils have softened, 15 to 18 minutes.
While the sauce cooks, pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and stack the leaves and thinly slice crosswise. Stir about half into the sauce (save the rest for garnishing).
Finely grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Divide the fettuccine noodles between two bowls (or one bowl and one lunch container), top with the lentil bolognese sauce, and garnish with the Parmesan and remaining basil. Enjoy!

name: Lentil & Goat Cheese Tartines with Warm Tomato-Dressed Spinach Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic; halve grape tomatoes. Transfer both to a small baking dish, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tomatoes have softened and released their juices, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice shallot into thin half-moons. Peel and mince additional garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with vinegar and spices; stir to combine.
Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the shallot and garlic.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Slice sun-dried tomatoes into thin strips and add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl and set aside.
When the roasted tomatoes are done, add cream to the baking dish, and stir to combine the warm tomato dressing. Set aside.
amounts: 1 fl oz (⅛ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: When the lentils are done, drain in a colander. Add to the bowl with the goat cheese mixture and stir until creamy and combined.
Toast bread in the oven or toaster (if desired). Divide lentil mixture between bread slices, spreading it out in an even layer.
To serve, divide lentil tartines and spinach between plates. Spoon the warm tomato dressing over the spinach and enjoy!

name: Lentil Green Curry with Squash, Spinach & Cottage Cheese "Flatbread"

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice the flesh. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add the white and pale green parts to the bowl with the squash. (Reserve dark green parts for later use.)
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the squash.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add squash, onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring frequently, until onion starts to brown and squash is just tender, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, roughly chop spinach. Place in the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the spinach and set aside.
Rinse lentils in a colander or strainer.

When the squash is just tender, add lentils and broth to the pan; stir to combine the curry and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook until the lentils are just tender, about 20 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic. Place in another medium bowl along with egg, cottage cheese, flour, milk, baking powder, and salt. Whisk to combine the batter.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, add reserved green onions to the bowl with the batter and whisk once more to combine.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Using a ½-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; spread into an oval shape with the back of a spoon. Cook until "flatbreads" are golden brown, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.

When the lentils are tender, add spinach and cilantro to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the greens to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat, add yogurt, and stir to combine.
Divide curry and flatbread between bowls. Serve with additional yogurt and enjoy!

name: Lentil & Mushroom Sloppy Joes with Avocado-Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince onion and garlic; transfer both to a medium bowl.
Roughly chop mushrooms. Trim, seed, and roughly chop pepper. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add vegetables, sugar, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and salt in the bowl used for the veggies. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.

Add tomato sauce to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into the bowl with the dressing. Add spinach and toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired.
When the lentils are tender, drain, and add to the skillet with the vegetables; stir to combine the sloppy joe mix.
To serve, place the bottom half of a bun on each plate. Top with sloppy joe mix and close with top half of the bun. Divide salad between plates and enjoy!

name: Lentil, Peach & Greens Salad with Goat Cheese & Walnuts

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Rinse the lentils, then transfer to a small saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap) by about 2 inches; bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a small bowl (that will be used to prepare the dressing).

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the lentils until they are just tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain in a colander, rinse under cold water, and set aside to cool and drain further.
To the garlic, add olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together and set aside.
Transfer the greens to a large salad bowl.
Quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard the pit; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges. Add to the salad bowl.
Roughly chop the walnuts and add to the salad bowl.
Crumble the goat cheese with your hands and place in a small bowl.
Once drained, add the lentils to the salad bowl; toss to combine.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls, top with the goat cheese, and drizzle with the dressing. Enjoy!

name: Lentil, Sweet Potato & Kale Salad with Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Rinse the lentils, then transfer to a small saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap) by about 2 inches; season with salt and pepper. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the lemon into a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the lemon juice.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the lentils until they are just tender, 15 to 18 minutes. Drain in a colander, then set aside to cool and drain further.
To the lemon juice and garlic, add olive oil, Dijon, maple syrup, cumin, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds.
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the shallot to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the shallot cooks, peel and medium dice the sweet potatoes into ½-inch cubes.
Add the sweet potatoes to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender, 6 to 8 minutes.
While the potatoes cook, cut out and discard the kale stems; chop the leaves into 1-inch pieces.
Add the kale to the skillet; cook, tossing with the potatoes, until it is softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Transfer the feta to a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Transfer the potatoes and kale to a large salad bowl.
Add the lentils to the salad bowl. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
To serve, divide the salad between dishes and top with the feta. Enjoy!

name: Lentil Taco Lettuce Wraps with Sautéed Veggies & Lime Crema

instructions.text: Rinse lentils under cold water and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer, cover with a lid, and cook until the lentils are just tender, 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Seed bell pepper, slice into thin strips. Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat. Add onions, bell peppers, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 8 minutes.
Quarter tomatoes and set aside.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise and then lengthwise to form cubes while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Set aside.
Finely chop walnuts and place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the walnuts.
Add oil, water, and spices to the bowl.
Add the cooked lentils to the bowl and stir until well combined.
To make the crema, juice the lime into a small bowl; add mayo and whisk to combine.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Top with lentil taco "meat", veggies, cilantro, and crema. Enjoy!

name: Lentil, Tomato & Mixed Greens Salad with Avocado & Garlic Bread

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Rinse lentils under cold water and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until tender 15-20 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, mix together ¾ of the garlic (save the rest for the salad), oil, and Italian seasoning.
Place buns or rolls cut side up in a small baking dish. Spoon olive oil and garlic mixture on the bread.
Place in the oven and bake until bread is crusty, 10-12 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Wash and dry greens. Wash, dry, and cut tomato into wedges. Halve and pit avocado; scoop out and medium dice. Wash, trim root ends, and chop green onions. Transfer everything to a large bowl.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Drain lentils and add to bowl. Toss salad.
To serve, place salad on a plate, drizzle with dressing, and have with garlic bread on the side. Enjoy!

name: Lentil-Walnut "Bolognese" Fettuccine with Artichoke Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Peel, trim, and small dice carrot; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a medium bowl.
Medium dice tomato; add to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Add tomato sauce, water, lentils, and walnuts to the pan; stir to combine the bolognese. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until lentils are soft, about 18 minutes.

While the bolognese is cooking, fill another medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta in a colander.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in the reserved bowl. Add mayo, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the lentils are soft, use a potato masher to mash the bolognese until semi-smooth, about 1 minute.
Add drained pasta and half of the parsley to the pan with the bolognese, then toss to combine; remove from heat. (Reserve remaining parsley for garnish.)
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta and salad between plates; top pasta with remaining parsley and enjoy!

name: Lentils with Cauliflower, Carrots, Caper-Anchovy Salsa Verde & Feta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel, trim, and medium dice carrots. Add to the baking sheet with the cauliflower.

Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the baking sheet along with whole (unpeeled) garlic cloves. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until the veggies are golden and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the lentils are cooking, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Mince anchovy fillet and capers. Add both to the bowl with the parsley along with additional oil, vinegar, and pepper; set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: When the lentils are done, drain and return to the pan. Cover and set aside.

When the veggies are done, carefully transfer roasted garlic to the cutting board. Using the back of a spoon, press on the cloves to remove the skins. Mash with a fork, add to the bowl with the parsley mixture, and stir to combine the salsa verde.
Add half of the salsa verde to the pan with the lentils. Stir to combine. (Reserve remaining salsa verde for serving.)
To serve, divide lentils between plates or bowls; top with the veggies, feta, and reserved salsa verde. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Lettuce Wrap Burgers with Fresh Greens & Paprika Aioli

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a small bowl.
Juice half of the lemon into the bowl with the zest. Add mayo and spices; whisk to combine the aioli and set aside.
Juice remaining lemon into a medium salad bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Form the ground beef into 2 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and season with salt and pepper.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan or skillet is hot, coat with oil.
Place the burger patties in the grill pan and cook, undisturbed, for 3 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, seed and slice the bell pepper into thin strips; add to the salad bowl.
Halve the tomatoes and add to the salad bowl.
Separate the lettuce leaves. Set aside two large leaves per burger; chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing. Toss to combine the salad.
Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Top with a burger patty and a spoonful of aioli. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Linguini with Caramelized Onion, Mushrooms, Kale, Parsley & Parmesan

instructions.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and starting to brown, 6-8 minutes.

Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ½-cup of pasta cooking water before draining.)
While the pasta is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Thinly slice mushrooms.
When the onions are browned, add more oil, mushrooms, and salt to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are soft and onions are caramelized, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half of the parsley to the bowl with the kale. (Set remaining parsley aside for serving.)
Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the bowl.

When the onions are caramelized, add kale, parsley, and garlic to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the kale is tender, 1-2 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.

When the kale is tender, add drained pasta, reserved pasta water, half of the Parmesan, vinegar, and crushed red pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook, tossing frequently, until heated through, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls; top with reserved Parmesan and parsley. Enjoy!

name: Linguini with Tofu, Fresh Tomato Sauce, Zucchini, Basil & Parmesan

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.

Meanwhile, cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the tofu into ¾-inch cubes.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu to the skillet and sprinkle with spices; cook, turning often, until golden on all sides, about 6 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic.
When the tofu is done, remove to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat and add more oil, swirling to coat the bottom. Add garlic and crushed red pepper; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 15 seconds.
Add tomatoes, zucchini, broth, Italian seasoning, and salt to the skillet. Stir to combine and bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer until zucchini is soft and sauce has thickened, 6-7 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Cut lemon into wedges; set both aside.
Finely grate Parmesan.
When the pasta is done, drain in a colander and return to the pan. Add zucchini-tomato sauce and tofu to the pan; gently toss to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates; top with Parmesan, basil, and a squeeze of lemon. Enjoy!

name: Loaded Potato Soup with Cauliflower, Cheddar & Bacon

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the bacon to the pot and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice the potatoes. Trim ends and small dice celery. Add both to a large bowl.
Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Chop the cauliflower into small pieces and add to the bowl with the potatoes.
Once the bacon is cooked, transfer to a plate lined with paper towels; pat to remove excess oil. Crumble or chop into small pieces and set aside.

Return pot (with bacon fat) to the stove over medium-high heat. Add the potatoes, celery, cauliflower, and broth; stir and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes, until potatoes are fork-tender.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Coarsely grate the cheddar.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add butter to the saucepan and swirl to coat the bottom. Add flour and whisk until smooth.
Add milk to the saucepan and whisk until roux is thickened, 2-3 minutes. Stir in the cheese until melted (reserving a small amount for garnish).
Once the potatoes are done, remove pot from heat. Use a potato masher to break up the potato chunks.
Slowly pour the cheese mixture into the pot and stir until combined. Add the spices and stir to combine.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls. Top with remaining cheese, bacon, and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Macaroni Salad with Tuna, Crunchy Veggies & Olives over Dressed Greens

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the creamy dressing.
Drain tuna and add to the bowl with the creamy dressing; flake with a fork.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Mince olives and add to the bowl.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; add to the bowl. Stir to combine the macaroni salad and set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the vinaigrette.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: To serve, divide mixed greens between plates and drizzle with vinaigrette. Top with macaroni salad and enjoy!

name: Macaroni-Stuffed Zucchini Boats with Grape & Strawberry Fruit Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, and halve zucchini lengthwise. Scrape out the soft flesh from the middle of each half, place in a small bowl, and set aside for later use.

Arrange zucchini halves, cut-side up, on a baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until softened, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the zucchini is baking, trim and quarter strawberries lengthwise. Place in a medium bowl.
Halve grapes. Add to the bowl with the strawberries, stir to combine the fruit salad, and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese. Set aside.
Roughly chop reserved zucchini flesh.
When the pasta is done, return the pan to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chopped zucchini and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 2 minutes.
Add flour to the pan and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until zucchini is well coated, about 30 seconds.
Slowly pour milk into the pan, whisking constantly. Continue to cook, whisking constantly, until sauce has thickened, 1-2 minutes more.
Add cheese and spices to the pan. Continue whisking until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth, about 1 minute. Add cooked pasta, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide zucchini boats between plates, then fill with macaroni and cheese. Serve with fruit salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Mango, Avocado & Arugula Salad with Cilantro-Lime Dressing

instructions.text: In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together lime juice, olive oil, maple syrup, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to dressing and mix. Set aside.
Wash and dry arugula.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out and medium dice the flesh. Wash and peel mango; slice flesh away from pit and medium dice. Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
To serve, arrange a bed of arugula on a plate and top with onion, avocado, and mango. Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with pine nuts. Enjoy!

name: Mango, Avocado & Bacon Salad with Lemony Chive Dressing

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, finely dice chives. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Place frozen edamame in a medium bowl, cover with hot water (from the tap), and let sit 5 minutes. Drain in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Juice the lemon into the bowl with the chives.
Add mayonnaise and spices to the bowl and whisk to combine the dressing.
Chop or tear the lettuce into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a salad bowl.
Once the bacon is cooked transfer to a plate lined with paper towels and pat to remove excess oil. Crumble or chop into small pieces and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into the salad bowl.
Peel mango and slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Slice the mango and add to the bowl.
Add edamame to the bowl and toss to combine.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls. Drizzle dressing over salad and enjoy!

name: Mango-Avocado Pesto Pasta Salad with Snap Peas, Edamame & Pine Nuts

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice and place half in a blender. Place the other half in a medium bowl and set aside.
Halve and pit avocado; cut crosswise while still in the skin, scoop out with a spoon, and add to the blender with the mango.
Peel and mince garlic; pick basil leaves off the stems. Add both to the blender.
