Juice lime into the blender; add water, oil, salt, and crushed red pepper. Blend on high until mango pesto is very smooth, adding water 1 tablespoon at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency; set aside.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl with the mango.
Halve snap peas and add to the bowl.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise; add to the bowl.
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; drain and add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and add to the bowl along with the mango pesto and pine nuts; stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Mango-Avocado Quinoa Bowl with Black Beans

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa and water; bring to a boil over high heat.
Drain and rinse the black beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes. Once done, remove the quinoa from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Juice the lime and transfer to a medium salad bowl.
To the lime juice, add olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Peel the mango, then slice off the flesh from the pit, starting with the flatter sides; discard the pit and small dice the flesh into ¼-inch cubes. Add to the salad bowl.
Remove the pit from the avocado with a knife or spoon; scoop out and small dice the flesh into ¼-inch cubes. Add to the salad bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the salad bowl.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add the black beans and cook until heated through, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork.
To serve, arrange the quinoa, black beans, and mango-avocado mixture in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Mango-Cabbage Salad with Spicy Seared Tofu, Avocado, Peanut & Cilantro

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with soy sauce, maple syrup, and chili-garlic sauce, then whisk to combine. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the tofu planks in half, then cut each half into 2 triangles. Place in a medium bowl, then sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper. Gently turn to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden and crispy, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat. (Wipe the bowl clean with paper towels and reserve for next step.)
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl. (Set aside a small handful of cilantro for serving.)
Add half of the sauce to the bowl with the cilantro, along with oil and vinegar, then whisk to combine the dressing. (Set remaining sauce aside for later use.)
Halve cabbage lengthwise, cut out the core, and slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad; set aside.
Add remaining sauce to the skillet with the tofu and gently toss to coat.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, then top with tofu and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Mango Chicken Curry with Bell Pepper & Basmati Rice

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Large dice the pepper into ¾-inch cubes. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Peel the mango, then slice off the flesh from the pit, starting with the flatter sides; discard the pit and large dice the flesh into ¾-inch cubes. Transfer to a small bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger. Transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the ginger.
To the ginger and garlic, add curry powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels, then cut into 1-inch cubes.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the pan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken to the pan and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is browned but not cooked through, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add the bell pepper and onion to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Add the spice mixture to the pan; stir until fragrant and well combined, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the coconut milk and mango to the pan; bring to a boil.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Once boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer. Add the chicken and about ¾ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing) to the pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through, 4 to 6 minutes.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls, top with the curry, and garnish with the remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Manhattan Fish Chowder with Halibut & Crusty Bread

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel the carrot, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Halve the carrot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into ⅛-inch-thick half-rounds and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the celery; slice it crosswise into ⅛-inch-thick pieces and add to the bowl.
Preheat a saucepan over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and add to the bowl with the carrots and celery.
Once the saucepan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the carrots, celery, and onion to the saucepan; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are softened, 5 to 6 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the saucepan.
Peel and medium dice the potato.
Grate all the zest from the lemon into a small bowl, then juice the lemon into the same bowl.

Add the diced potatoes, diced tomatoes, broth, lemon zest and juice to the saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender, 10 to 12 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: One by one, holding a sprig of thyme at its top, run your fingers down it to remove the leaves. Discard the sprigs and chop the leaves; add to the saucepan.
Cut the fish into 1-inch pieces.
Add the fish to the soup and season with additional salt and pepper. Cook until the fish is opaque and cooked through, another 4 to 5 minutes.
Slice the buns in half and toast if desired.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and serve with the bun on the side. Enjoy!

name: Maple-Bacon Chicken Wings with Cucumber, Bell Pepper & Parsley Salad

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with baking powder, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the chicken wings are baking, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until almost crispy, 3-4 minutes.

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Place in a clean medium bowl along with ketchup, water, maple syrup, soy sauce, vinegar, and cornstarch. Whisk to combine a smooth slurry.

When the bacon is almost crispy, pour slurry into the skillet, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook, stirring frequently, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes. Return sauce to the bowl and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in another medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
When the wings are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Maple Bacon Turkey Meatballs with Butternut Squash & Spiced Walnuts

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F and position rack in the center. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Wash the butternut squash. Trim off and discard the ends of the squash; halve the squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds from each half. Peel and cut into ½-inch cubes, about 4 cups.
Wash and dry thyme. Slide leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
In a small saucepan, melt the coconut oil over medium heat. Add maple syrup, cinnamon, thyme and salt. Stir to combine then remove from the heat and add to a medium bowl.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to bowl with the coconut oil and spices.
Add butternut squash pieces to bowl. Toss to coat and spread out in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Add to a medium bowl.
Add ground turkey to the bowl with the garlic and ginger.
Mince bacon and add to ground turkey.
Season turkey and bacon with cumin, salt and pepper and stir to combine.
Form meat mixture into 2-inch size meatballs and place on top of squash.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, until meatballs are golden brown and cooked through and squash is soft.
To serve, divide squash, spiced walnuts and meatballs between plates. Enjoy!

name: Maple Balsamic Steak with Pear, Arugula & Goat Cheese Salad

instructions.text: In a medium bowl, whisk together vinegar, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Transfer ½ to a small bowl.
Place steak in medium bowl and turn to coat.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash, core, and cut pear into thin wedges. Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add pear and onion slices; cook until lightly browned and tender, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a large bowl.
Add steak to grill/skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Wash and dry arugula. Add to bowl with pear and onion and toss.
Crumble goat cheese.
To serve, place steak and salad on a plate, sprinkle with goat cheese, and drizzle with remaining sauce. Enjoy!

name: Maple Dijon Bacon-Wrapped Salmon with Roasted Asparagus

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (for easier cleanup).
Wash and dry asparagus. Snap (or cut) off woody ends and arrange on one half of the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; set aside.
Place maple syrup and Dijon in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on the cutting board. Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin). Discard the skin.
Cut salmon into portions. Spread half of the sauce over the salmon, then wrap with bacon. Spread remaining sauce over the bacon, then arrange, seam-side down, on the prepared baking sheet.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until salmon is cooked through and asparagus is tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and transfer asparagus to a plate; cover with aluminum foil.
Change the oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. Return salmon to the oven and broil until bacon is crispy, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide salmon and asparagus between plates. Enjoy!

name: Maple-Dijon Chicken Drumsticks with Lemony Dill, Kale & Cabbage Slaw

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Place oil, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a baking dish; whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, add to the baking dish with the marinade, and turn to coat.
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning halfway through, until chicken is cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise. Add to the bowl. Using your hands, massage the greens with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw.
To serve, divide chicken and slaw between plates. Enjoy!

name: Maple Dijon Chicken with Mushroom & Quinoa Risotto

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa, broth, and water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Place chicken thighs in a baking dish.

Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, mix together ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the mushrooms), maple syrup, Dijon, vinegar, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Pour over top chicken and turn to coat.
Place in the oven and roast until chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Scoop sauce over chicken halfway though.
Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add mushrooms and season with rosemary, salt, and pepper. Stirring occasionally, cook until tender, 3-5 minutes.
amounts: about 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
Add broth to mushrooms and cook until liquid thickens, 2-3 minutes. Add spinach and stir until wilted. Then stir in quinoa and Parmesan.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, place risotto on a plate and top with chicken. Enjoy!

name: Maple-Dijon Pork Chops with Acorn Squash & Brussels Sprouts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).
Wash and dry acorn squash; halve lengthwise, trim off the ends, then scoop out seeds. Cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick slices and place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and trim Brussels sprouts; halve lengthwise and add to the bowl with the squash.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons; add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl.
Drizzle oil over veggies and season with spices; toss to coat.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Transfer veggies to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake, tossing halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
While the chops are cooking, place maple syrup, Dijon, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine the maple-Dijon sauce.
When the chops are done, remove to a clean plate, pour maple-Dijon sauce over top, and turn to coat both sides.
To serve, divide pork chops, sauce, and veggies between plates. Enjoy!

name: Maple Glazed Chicken Thighs, Apples & Red Onion with Quinoa

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa, broth, and water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered for 5 minutes.
amounts: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Season chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Wash, core, and cut apples into wedges. Peel and cut onion into wedges.
Transfer chicken to a plate and return skillet to stove. Add more oil, apples, onion, and thyme. Stirring occasionally, cook until apples are just tender and golden, 5-6 minutes.
amounts: about ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.text: In a small bowl, mix together broth, maple syrup, and vinegar.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return chicken to skillet and pour in sauce. Stir and cook until sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes.
Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place quinoa on a plate and top with chicken, apples, and onion. Enjoy!

name: Maple Glazed Salmon with Sugar Snap Pea, Carrot & Quinoa Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Place salmon fillets in a baking dish and season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven and broil for 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, maple syrup, Dijon, and pepper.
Take salmon out of the oven and spoon sauce over top. Return to oven and cook until salmon is opaque, another 5-6 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash peas and carrot. Halve the peas and add to bowl with dressing. Peel, coarsely grate, and add the carrot to bowl.
Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork. Add to bowl and toss salad.
To serve, place quinoa salad on a plate and add salmon on top. Enjoy!

name: Maple Glazed Tofu with Garlic Sautéed Bok Choy & Basmati Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain and large dice tofu; place on paper towels and pat dry.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add tofu and, stirring frequently, cook until lightly browned, 5-6 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, whisk together ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the bok choy), soy sauce, maple syrup, and rice vinegar.
Add sauce to tofu. Stirring frequently, cook until sauce thickens and coats tofu, 2-3 minutes.
Wash bok choy, trim ends, and separate into leaves.
Transfer tofu and sauce to a plate and return skillet to stove. Add more oil, remaining garlic, and pepper; cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add bok choy and soy sauce. Tossing occasionally, cook until greens are just wilted and stalks are tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, arrange rice, tofu, and bok choy in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Maple-Teriyaki Salmon Sushi Bowls with Cucumber & Edamame

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Place maple syrup, soy sauce, oil, vinegar, and garlic powder in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the marinade.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin. If you don’t have a tail end, start at one corner of the fillet and work your way in until the knife is between the skin and flesh.
Cut salmon into bite-size pieces. Add to the bowl with the marinade and gently toss to coat. Set aside for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry cucumber. Trim and cut into thin sticks.
Place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain further.
When the salmon is done marinating, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add salmon and all of the marinade. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and salmon is opaque and flaky, 3-5 minutes.
Place vinegar, maple syrup, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine. When the rice is done, pour the mixture over it and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice between bowls and top with cucumber, edamame, and salmon. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Margherita Pita Pizza with Spinach & Tomato Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, mix together garlic and oil.
Wash and dry tomatoes and basil. Slice one tomato into rounds and the other into wedges. Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
Grate 1 cup of mozzarella.
Place pitas on a flat surface. Spoon olive oil and garlic mixture over top, add tomato slices (save the wedges for the salad), and sprinkle with mozzarella.
Place in the oven, directly on the rack, and bake until cheese melts and crust is crispy, 8-10 minutes. Then add basil leaves and broil until cheese begins to brown, 1-2 minutes.
In a medium bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry baby spinach. Add spinach and remaining tomato to bowl with dressing and toss.
To serve, place pizza wedges on a plate and have with salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Margherita Portobello Mushroom Pizzas with Bacon

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the mushroom caps, then remove and discard the stems. Peel and mince the garlic.
Place the mushrooms on the baking sheet. Rub with olive oil and season with the minced garlic, salt, and pepper.
Place the mushrooms in the oven and bake for 5 minutes while you prepare the toppings.
Wash the tomato and basil. Slice the tomato horizontally into rounds. Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves crosswise into ribbons.
Grate the fresh mozzarella.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) ball fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Chop or cut the bacon into smaller pieces.

Remove mushrooms from the oven and drain any excess liquid. Sprinkle a little of the mozzarella into each cap, then top with bacon, tomato rounds, and ½ of the basil. Finish off with the remaining mozzarella.
Place in the oven and cook until the mushrooms are tender and the cheese is melted, 15-20 minutes.
Wash the cucumber and grape tomatoes. Quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then chop crosswise. Halve the tomatoes.
To serve, place the mushroom pizzas on a plate and sprinkle with the remaining basil. Serve with grape tomatoes and cucumber on the side and enjoy!

name: Marinated Steak with Crunchy Apple, Walnut & Blue Cheese Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic; add soy sauce, vinegar, Worcestershire, Dijon, and pepper. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Place the steak in the marinade, turn to coat, and set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Peel and mince additional garlic; transfer to another medium bowl along with yogurt, blue cheese, water, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Chop or tear romaine into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add steak to the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, quarter, core, and cut apple into matchsticks, add to the bowl with the romaine, and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad and steak between plates. Enjoy!

name: Masala Steak with Cardamom Root Veggies, Goat Cheese & Pistachios

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place in a small bowl.
Add goat cheese to the bowl with the basil; set aside to soften.

Peel, trim, and slice carrots and parsnips crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Transfer both to a baking sheet pan, season with cardamom and salt, then stir to combine. Spread out in an even layer and drizzle with honey.

Cut butter into small pieces and sprinkle over the veggies. Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't need to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with spices on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the pan is hot, coat with butter. Add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
While the steak is cooking, use the back of a spoon to mash and combine the basil-goat cheese. Set aside.
Roughly chop pistachios.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates. Top veggies with basil-goat cheese and pistachios. Enjoy!

name: Mashed Indian Curry Vegetable Stew with Buttered Rolls (Pav Bhaji)

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 20 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice potatoes and carrot. Seed and small dice bell pepper. Transfer veggies to a large pot.

Add broth, sugar, and salt to the pot; stir to combine, then scrape down the edges of the pot so that veggies are submerged. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; reduce heat to medium and simmer until potatoes and carrots are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion (reserving a small handful for garnish) and cook, stirring occasionally, until it begins to soften, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the skillet with the onion. Continue to cook, stirring often, until soft and fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Small dice tomatoes.
Add tomatoes, additional broth, peas, tomato paste, and spices to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens and peas are heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the potatoes and carrots in the pot are tender, remove from heat. Use a potato masher to gently crush the veggies, forming a textured mash. Transfer the tomato sauce to the pot and mash once more to combine.
Return veggie mash to the stove over medium-high heat. Continue to cook, stirring often, until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut lime into wedges and set aside.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add cilantro to the vegetable mash (reserving a small handful for garnish) and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Toast rolls if desired, and spread with butter.
Divide veggie mash between plates and top with more butter. Serve with onion, cilantro, lime wedges, and buttered rolls. Enjoy!

name: Meatball Spinach Salad with Tomato, Avocado & Dill-Yogurt Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of oil.
Place beef and spices in a medium bowl; mix with your hands until well combined.
Using a scant ¼-cup measure, form the meat mixture into rounded meatballs and place in the prepared dish.
Place dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until meatballs are cooked through, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Zest lemon into a small bowl. Add yogurt and spices; whisk to combine the yogurt sauce and set aside.
Juice the lemon into a clean medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add spinach to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide salad, avocado, and meatballs between plates. Top meatballs with yogurt sauce and enjoy!

name: Meatballs & Tomato Sauce with Zucchini Spaghetti

instructions.text: Peel and mince onion. Peel and mince garlic. Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
In a medium bowl, combine beef, egg, almond meal, ½ of the onion, ½ of the garlic, cumin, basil, salt, pepper, and a ¼ of the minced parsley. Mix together.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Form beef mixture into small balls and place on a plate.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil and add meatballs. Turning occasionally, cook until browned but not cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate once done.
Once meatballs have been transferred, add more oil to skillet. Add remaining onion and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add remaining garlic and red pepper to skillet and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.

Add tomatoes, remaining parsley, oregano, basil, salt, and pepper. Mash tomatoes with a potato masher. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, add meatballs, and simmer until meatballs are cooked through, 5-10 minutes.
Wash zucchini, trim ends, and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles.
To serve, place zucchini noodles in a bowl, top with meatballs and sauce, and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Baked Tilapia with Green Beans, Tomatoes & Black Olives

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince shallot; place in a medium bowl along with the oil, vinegar, Dijon, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim ends of green beans and arrange them in a single layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet pan. Add tomatoes and drizzle with half the dressing. Reserve the remaining dressing for later.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast 10 minutes, until tomatoes and beans begin to soften.
Pat the tilapia dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with pepper on both sides.
Roughly chop the olives.
Remove the vegetables from the oven and toss. Lay the fish on top of the vegetables and return to the oven; bake for 10 minutes, or until tilapia is cooked through.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Change oven setting to broil and cook another 4 minutes, until the fish is slightly golden.
To serve, divide the fish and veggies between plates and top with olives, parsley, feta, and remaining dressing. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Mediterranean Chicken & Bread Salad (Fattoush) with Feta Dressing

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Arrange racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.

Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Arrange chicken cutlets on a baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil and season both sides with spices.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place chicken on the bottom rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping once, until cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.

Meanwhile, holding a knife parallel to a clean cutting board, cut each pita in half horizontally to separate the two sides; cut or tear the bread into bite-sized pieces, place on a second baking sheet pan, and spread out in an even layer.
Drizzle oil over the pita and sprinkle with Italian seasoning and salt. Gently toss to combine, then spread back out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place pita chips on the top rack of the oven and bake, tossing halfway through, until chips are crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Add yogurt, water, vinegar, sugar, Dijon, and spices to the bowl with the garlic; whisk until smooth. Add feta and stir to combine the dressing; set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and thinly slice cucumber. Trim and thinly slice radishes. Transfer both to a large bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; shave parsley leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl along with the pita chips and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Spoon dressing on top and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Chicken Quinoa Bowl with Feta & Tzatziki

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and water; bring to a boil.
While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the lemon into a small bowl; pour ½ of the juice into the quinoa (save the rest for the tzatziki sauce).
Once the quinoa is boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cover; cook for 15 minutes. Once cooked, remove the saucepan from the heat and let the quinoa stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Halve the tomatoes and transfer to a large bowl.
Small dice a ⅓ of the cucumber and add to the remaining lemon juice; halve the other ⅔ of the cucumber lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise on an angle. Add to the tomatoes.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chops the leaves. Add to the tomatoes and cucumber.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon juice and cucumber.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Place the chicken on a cutting board and holding a knife parallel to the board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper, then rub with olive oil.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the chicken in the grill pan or skillet; cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a clean cutting board.
Add yogurt, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice, cucumber, and garlic; mix together and set aside.
Measure out the olives and add to the vegetables.
Measure out the feta and add to the bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork; add to the bowl.
Cut the chicken crosswise into bite-sized strips and add to the bowl. Toss the ingredients until well combined.
To serve, place the quinoa mixture into a bowl and spoon the tzatziki sauce over top. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad with Lemon Vinaigrette

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
Peel, medium dice, and add onion to bowl.
Wash and dry tomatoes, cucumber, and bell pepper. Medium dice tomatoes and cucumber and add to bowl with chickpeas. Seed, medium dice, and add pepper to bowl.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to bowl.
Halve olives and add to bowl.
To serve, place salad in a bowl or on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Sandwich with Sprouts, Tomato & Side Salad

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with mayo, Dijon, and spices. Whisk until smooth.
Drain and rinse chickpeas; add to the bowl with the mayo dressing. Using a fork or potato masher, roughly mash chickpeas until semi-smooth.
Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes and olives. Add both to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the chickpea salad, and set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, and spices in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and roughly chop artichokes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Slice tomato into thin rounds.
Toast bread if desired.
Divide the chickpea salad between half of the slices and spread out in an even layer. Layer with tomato and sprouts, then close sandwiches with remaining slices of bread.
Slice sandwiches in half and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Lamb Chops with Tomatoes, Bell Pepper, Olives & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the lamb chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season both sides with spices.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add lamb chops and pan-fry until browned, flipping once, 4-6 minutes (the chops will not be cooked all the way through).
While the lamb is cooking, peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into thin wedges.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper into thin strips.
When the lamb is browned, remove skillet from heat and add the onion and bell pepper, nestling them around the chops.
Place skillet in the oven and roast until the veggies are fork-tender and chops are cooked through, 6-8 minutes more. Remove skillet from the oven.
Meanwhile, halve and slice tomatoes into 1-inch thick wedges; place in a small bowl.
Halve olives and add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
When the chops are done, transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Add tomatoes, olives, and parsley to the skillet and toss to combine. Return skillet to the oven and roast until tomatoes are warmed through, about 4 minutes. Remove from the oven.
To serve, divide the veggies and lamb chops between plates. Top veggies with feta and enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Mediterranean Pita Pizza with Roasted Garlic White Sauce

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim zucchini. Halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion. Add to the baking sheet.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Peel garlic, place in the center of a small square of aluminum foil, and drizzle with oil. Fold foil around the garlic to close the packet. Place garlic packet on the baking sheet with the veggies.
Place veggies in the oven and bake until zucchini is tender, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve tomatoes; transfer to a medium bowl, add oil and spices, then toss to combine. Set aside to marinate.
Coarsely grate mozzarella. Cut cream cheese into small pieces. Set cheeses aside, keeping them separate.
When the vegetables are done, remove from the oven and carefully transfer to the bowl with the tomatoes; stir to combine and set aside. (Leave garlic packet on the baking sheet).
Place pitas on the baking sheet with the garlic packet. Return to oven and toast for 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a small saucepan over medium heat. Once the pan is hot, add oil, flour, and spices. Whisk constantly for 30 seconds.
Reduce heat to low; whisk in broth and cream cheese until smooth, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Carefully remove garlic from the packet and roughly chop; add to the pan with the white sauce and stir to combine.
Top toasted pitas with white sauce, mozzarella, and veggies. Return pitas to the oven and bake until the cheese melts, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide pitas between plates and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Salad with Crispy Chickpeas, Pita Chips, Olives & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Drain and rinse chickpeas, then transfer to baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and stir to coat; spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until chickpeas are golden and crispy, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.

Meanwhile, place pitas on a flat surface. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the pitas in half horizontally to separate the two sides; cut or tear the bread into 2-inch pieces and transfer to another baking sheet.
Drizzle pita with oil and season with salt; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Add baking sheet to the oven and bake until pita chips are crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
While the pita chips are baking, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add vinegar, oil, Dijon, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Halve olives and add to the bowl.
Add crispy chickpeas, pita chips, spinach, and feta to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Spiced Chickpea Patties with Pita & Minty Tahini Sauce

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel and mince shallot. Peel and mince garlic. Add chickpeas, shallot, and garlic to a medium bowl; mash the beans with a fork or potato masher until beans are broken down.
Peel the carrot, then trim off the ends. Coarsely grate the carrots and add to the bowl.
Add egg, bread crumbs, and spices to the bowl and stir ingredients to combine. Mash the beans with a fork or potato masher once more, until a cohesive mixture is formed.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Divide chickpea mixture into 8 portions. Using your hands, form each portion into a ball, then flatten into a 2-inch diameter patty.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place the chickpea patties in the skillet and cook until crispy and golden in color, about 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate to cool slightly.
Juice the lemon into the blender.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and coarsely chop the leaves; add to the blender.
Peel the garlic. Add garlic, tahini, and salt to the blender, and blend on high for 1-2 minutes to make a smooth sauce. Thin the sauce with 1-2 tbsp of cold water if necessary.
Toast the pita bread if desired, then slice into quarters.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; slice the cucumber crosswise into thin rounds.
Halve the grape tomatoes crosswise.
To serve, divide pita bread, chickpea patties, cucumbers and tomatoes between dishes and serve with a side of minty tahini sauce. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Sweet Potatoes with Chickpeas & Garlic-Yogurt Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and cut sweet potatoes lengthwise into 4-6 wedges each, depending on size, then transfer to the sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Spread wedges out in an even layer, then place in the oven and bake for 10 minutes, until potatoes begin to soften slightly.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Juice half of the lemon into a medium bowl.
Place drained chickpeas in the bowl with the lemon juice; add oil and spices. Toss to coat.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Remove sweet potatoes from the oven and flip using tongs. Sprinkle chickpeas (and any leftover seasoning) over the sweet potatoes in an even layer and return to the oven. Bake until chickpeas become crispy and potatoes can be pierced easily with a fork, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, grate the zest from remaining half lemon into a small bowl, then juice into the same bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon zest and juice.
Add yogurt and spices to the bowl and whisk to combine the sauce. Add 1-2 tablespoons cold water, if needed, to reach drizzling consistency.
Halve the grape tomatoes crosswise.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide potatoes and chickpeas between plates. Top with tomatoes, parsley, and garlic-yogurt sauce. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Tuna Salad with Chickpeas

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Halve the grape tomatoes and transfer to a large salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces on an angle and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the celery; halve the celery lengthwise, then slice crosswise at an angle into ¼-inch-thick pieces and add to the salad bowl.
Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and add to the salad bowl.
Halve the olives lengthwise and add to the salad bowl.
Add the capers to the salad bowl.
Open the tuna cans and drain the liquid; add to the salad bowl.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna, packed in water

instructions.text: Transfer the chickpeas to a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry; add to the salad bowl.
Juice the lemon into a small bowl.
Add olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice; whisk together until well combined.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
To serve, spoon the salad into a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Tuna Stuffed Bell Peppers with Baby Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil.
Wash, halve lengthwise, and seed the bell peppers.
Place the peppers cut-side down on the baking sheet. Place in the oven and broil until the peppers start to soften and brown, 3-4 minutes.
Drain the tuna and transfer to a medium bowl.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and halve the tomatoes; add to the tuna bowl.
Wash and dry the parsley. Shave the leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince the shallot; add to the bowl.
Halves the olives and add to the bowl.
Add the capers, feta, lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon, and pepper to tuna mixture. Mix until well combined.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Remove the peppers from the oven and carefully flip them over. Fill the peppers with the tuna mixture. Return to the oven and broil for another 3-4 minutes.
Wash and dry the spinach.
Cut the remaining piece of lemon into wedges.
Place the stuffed peppers on a plate. Arrange a bed of greens on the side; drizzle with olive oil and squeeze lemon juice over top. Enjoy!

name: Melty Caprese Steak with Butter Lettuce, Bell Pepper & Basil Salad

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Add oil, vinegar, and spices to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the dressing. Pour half into a baking dish, then set the bowl aside.
Cut steak into portions, pat dry with paper towels, and add to the baking dish; turn to coat and set aside to marinate.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add bell pepper, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, 3-4 minutes. Remove to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
When the peppers are done, return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, thinly slice tomato and mozzarella crosswise into rounds.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: When the steak is done, remove skillet from heat; top with tomatoes and mozzarella. Cover with a lid and let sit until cheese starts to melt, 2-3 minutes.
While the cheese melts, pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl with the dressing. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Chop or tear lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl, along with the cooked peppers, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and steaks between plates. Top steaks with reserved basil and enjoy!

name: Melty Mozzarella, Zucchini, Leek & Green Pea Frittata with Basil

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add zucchini, leek, and peas; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate cheese and set aside.
Place eggs, cream, and salt in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl with the eggs. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)

When the veggies are done, reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 3-5 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Sprinkle with reserved basil and enjoy!

name: Mexican Beef Meatball Soup (Albóndigas) with Tomato & Green Beans

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the garlic, setting aside a small handful for serving.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add beef, rice, egg, and spices to the bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Using a tablespoon measure, form mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate. Set aside.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Trim and cut green beans into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.

Add broth, tomatoes, and meatballs to the pan; gently stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until meatballs are cooked through, 10-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Mexican Chicken Soup with Avocado & Tortilla Crisps

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F and place the rack in the center position.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the lime into a small bowl.
Stack the tortillas; cut in half, then cut crosswise into ½-inch-wide strips and transfer to a baking sheet.
Drizzle the tortilla strips with olive oil and season with salt; toss to coat then spread out in a single layer.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the tortilla strips in the oven and bake until golden brown and crispy, 6 to 8 minutes. Once done, remove from the oven and transfer to a paper towel lined plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, halve the breasts horizontally to form thin fillets. Season the chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken to the skillet; cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate to cool.
While the chicken cooks, preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces).
Once the saucepan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, cumin, salt, and pepper to the onion; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the broth, tomatoes, and lime juice to the saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 8 to 10 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using two forks, shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces and add to the soup immediately.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a small bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Stir the cilantro into the soup.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls, then top with the avocado and tortilla crisps. Enjoy!

name: Mexican Pork Stew with Cheesy Tortilla Chips

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Slice the pork chops crosswise into thin strips.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
On a clean cutting board, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; mince the stems and the leaves, keeping them separate. Set the leaves aside in one small bowl and the stems in another.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add pork strips to the saucepan and cook, tossing occasionally, until the pork is browned and cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Meanwhile, seed and medium dice the bell pepper. Peel and mince garlic.
Return the saucepan to medium heat; add more oil, cilantro stems, peppers, and garlic. Cook, stirring often, until peppers soften, 3-4 minutes.
Combine spices in a small bowl.
Add half of the spice mix, pork, tomatoes, corn, and broth to the saucepan and stir to combine. Bring to a boil on high, then reduce heat to medium and simmer until slightly thickened, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, cut each tortilla into 8 triangles and place on a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and remaining seasoning mix. Toss to coat, then spread out in a single layer. Place in the oven and bake until golden and crispy, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Zest and juice half of the lime into a small bowl. Cut the remaining lime into wedges.
Add yogurt and salt to the bowl with the lime zest and stir to combine.
Coarsely grate cheese. Remove tortillas from the oven and sprinkle with cheese. Return to the oven and bake until the cheese melts, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide pork stew between bowls and top with tortilla chips, cilantro leaves, and a dollop of lime yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Mexican Shrimp Naan Wrap with Yogurt & Spicy Bell Pepper-Corn Salad

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil and spices, then whisk to combine.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Add to the bowl with the spice paste, stir to coat, and set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Juice lime into another medium bowl. Add oil and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Arrange naan bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until lightly toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add shrimp and cook until they are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Spread yogurt over each naan and top with a small portion of salad and the shrimp. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)

To make wraps easier to eat, place each naan on a square of parchment paper. Use the paper to tightly roll and secure each wrap. Otherwise, eat as is and get a little messy! Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Mexican Spiced Salmon with Walnut Guacamole & Bell Pepper-Corn Sauté

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; place in a small bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper and set aside.
Pat fish dry with paper towels and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle both sides with oil, arrange skin-side down, then season top side with spices.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until salmon is just opaque, about 5 minutes. Flip salmon and continue to broil until the skin is crispy, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, cilantro, corn, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the veggies are cooking, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in the reserved bowl.
Juice half of the lime into the bowl with the shallot and garlic. (Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.)
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop the flesh into the bowl. Add spices and mash with a fork or potato masher until guacamole is smooth.
Roughly chop walnuts, add to the bowl with the guacamole, and stir to combine.
Divide salmon and veggies between plates; top salmon with guacamole and serve with lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!

name: Mexican Street Corn Salad with Black Beans, Radish, Feta & Lime Crema

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Add corn to the baking sheet; drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to combine. Place in the oven and broil, stirring halfway through, until veggies are lightly charred, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Zest lime into a small bowl. Add yogurt, water, and spices to the bowl and whisk to combine the crema. Set aside.
Juice the lime into a large salad bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Seed and slice bell pepper into thin strips. Trim and thinly slice radishes. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop or tear romaine leaves into bite-sized pieces; transfer to the bowl, along with the beans, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, top with the corn mixture, and drizzle with lime crema. Sprinkle with feta and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Mexican Stuffed Peppers with Roasted Sweet Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; place half in a medium bowl. (Set remaining garlic aside for later use.)
Juice lime into the bowl with the garlic, then add oil and spices; stir to combine the spice oil.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Quarter sweet potato lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl with the spice oil and toss to combine. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet on lower rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to another baking sheet, cut-side up, and drizzle with oil.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in the reserved bowl along with the remaining garlic. (Set the rest of the cilantro aside for serving.)
Add ground beef, tomato sauce, and spices to the bowl with the cilantro and garlic; stir to combine the filling.
Divide filling between pepper halves. Place baking sheet on upper rack of the oven; bake until the peppers are tender and beef is almost cooked through, about 15 minutes.
While the peppers are cooking, coarsely grate cheddar.
When the peppers are tender, remove from the oven and sprinkle with cheese. Return to the oven and continue to bake until the beef is cooked through and cheese is melted, 5 minutes more.
To serve, divide stuffed peppers and sweet potato between plates. Sprinkle with reserved cilantro and enjoy!

name: Mexican-Style Chicken, Corn, Jalapeño & Cilantro Soup with Feta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Trim and small dice celery; trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add both to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats up, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Small dice and add to the bowl with the veggies. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Add flour and spices to the pan; continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add chicken, broth, and tomato sauce to the pan. Stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, 10-12 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, trim, halve, and thinly slice radishes crosswise; place in the reserved bowl. Drizzle with vinegar, sprinkle with salt, and stir to combine; set aside to marinate.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the chicken is done, remove thighs to a plate using tongs (continue to simmer soup over low heat). Shred the chicken using two forks; use one fork to hold the chicken and the other fork to pull and shred the meat.
Return shredded chicken to the pan, along with cilantro, corn, and additional vinegar; stir to combine the soup and continue to simmer until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more.
To serve, divide soup between bowls; top with pickled radish and feta. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Mexican-Style Frittata with Bell Pepper, Cheddar & Avocado

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat the oven to the broil setting and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Slice the quarters crosswise into small strips and transfer to a medium bowl.
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; halve the onion lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise. Add to the bowl with the peppers.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Transfer to a small bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add the peppers, onion, and about ¾ of the green onions (save the rest for garnishing) to the skillet; season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables have softened, 4 to 6 minutes.
Coarsely grate about ½ cup of cheddar.
In a medium bowl, combine and whisk together the cheddar, eggs, water, salt, and pepper.

Pour the egg mixture into the skillet. While tilting the skillet with one hand, lift up the edges of the frittata with a spatula and let the eggs run underneath during the first few minutes of cooking. Cook until most of the frittata is set, but the top is still runny, 4 to 5 minutes.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; thinly slice the flesh crosswise (without piercing the skin) and scoop out.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and broil until the top is set and lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes.
To serve, separate the frittata into wedges and divide between plates; top with avocado slices and remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Mexican-Style Sweet Potato & Black Bean Hash with Fried Eggs

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and small dice the potatoes (cut into ¼-inch cubes); transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces).
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the onion cooks, trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle and transfer to a small bowl.
Juice the lime into a small bowl.
Add more coconut oil and the sweet potatoes to the skillet; season with salt, chili powder, cumin, and black pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until they are browned and tender, 10 to 15 minutes.
While the potatoes cook, drain and rinse the beans, then set aside to drain further.
In nonstick skillet, melt coconut oil over medium heat.
Gently crack the eggs into the skillet. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 2 to 3 minutes. Once done, separate the eggs.

Add the black beans, spinach, ½ of the green onions (save the rest for garnishing), and lime juice to the potatoes; cook, stirring constantly, until the spinach is wilted and the beans are heated through, 1 to 2 minutes.
To serve, spoon the hash onto a plate, top with the fried eggs, and sprinkle with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Mexican Tofu Taco Bowl with Tomato-Corn Salsa, Cheddar & Lime Crema

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, place soy sauce, oil, and spices in a medium bowl; stir to combine the marinade.
Using your fingers, crumble tofu into the bowl with the marinade. Stir to combine, transfer to a baking sheet pan, and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for the salsa.)
Place tofu in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until golden brown and slightly crispy, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince shallot. Place in the reserved bowl.
Zest and juice half of the lime into the bowl with the shallot. (Reserve remaining lime for later use.)

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Small dice tomato and add to the bowl.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Juice reserved lime into a small bowl. Add yogurt and spices, stir to combine the lime crema, and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
To serve, divide rice, tofu, lettuce, cheese, and salsa between plates or bowls. Drizzle with lime crema and enjoy!

name: Mexican Tomato Soup (Sopa de Fideo) with Pasta, Avocado & Feta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and large dice onion. Large dice tomatoes; place both in a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and roughly chop garlic.

Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, tomatoes, garlic, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Trim and cut green beans into 1-inch pieces. Place both in the reserved bowl and set aside.
Transfer the tomato-onion mixture to a blender and blend on high until smooth; set aside.
Use your hands to break the pasta into 1-inch pieces.
Return pan to the stove over medium-high heat; add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the pasta and cook, stirring constantly, until it turns golden, 1-2 minutes.

Add tomato-onion pureé, broth, tomato sauce, carrots, green beans, and spices to the pan. Stir to combine, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and cover the pan. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until pasta and vegetables are tender, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add peas to the soup during the last 2 minutes of cooking; continue to simmer until heated through, 1-2 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocado; scoop out flesh with a spoon and medium dice.
Cut lime into wedges.
Divide soup between bowls; top with avocado and feta. Serve with lime wedges on the side and enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Mild Turkey Chili with Butternut Squash, Bell Pepper & Mushrooms
