ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim ends and peel squash. Halve lengthwise, scrape out seeds, and small dice the flesh; transfer to a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and small dice onion. Trim and small dice celery.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and celery; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper.
Add garlic and bell pepper to the pan; stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add diced squash, broth, tomatoes, and spices to the pan. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the chili comes to a boil, thinly slice mushrooms; add to the pan.
Once the chili is boiling, reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the squash is almost tender, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, about 7 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
When the squash is almost tender, stir cooked turkey and any accumulated juices into the pan; continue to cook until squash is tender and the chili is heated through, about 5 minutes.
To serve, divide chili between bowls and enjoy!

name: Minestrone Soup with Kidney Beans, Green Beans, Carrots & Pasta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a small bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse kidney beans; set aside to drain further.
When the veggies are soft, add broth and tomatoes; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the soup is boiling, add the kidney beans and pasta; stir to combine. Reduce heat to medium, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally until the pasta is partially cooked, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green beans into 1-inch pieces.
Add green beans to the soup and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta and veggies are tender, 3-5 minutes more.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!

name: Minestrone Soup with Kidney Beans, Orzo Pasta, Spinach & Parmesan

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Trim and small dice celery. Place both in a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans.

When the veggies are soft, add beans, broth, tomatoes, and orzo to the pan. Stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the soup is boiling, reduce heat and simmer until the orzo is tender, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the soup is cooking, roughly chop spinach. Place in the reserved bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the spinach and set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan.
When the orzo is tender, add spinach and parsley to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the greens to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls, then drizzle with vinegar and top with Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Mini Beef Meatloaves with Garlicky Mashed Parsnips & Mixed Green Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).
Place ketchup, water, Worcestershire, and sugar in a small bowl, then whisk to combine the sauce. Set aside.
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with beef, egg, bread crumbs, additional ketchup, and spices; mix with your hands until the meatloaf mixture is well combined.
Form the meatloaf mixture into 6 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 3-inches long. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until meatloaves are cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Peel and medium dice parsnips; peel garlic. Place both in a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 12-15 minutes.
While the parsnips are cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
When the parsnips are done, drain in a colander and return to the pan. Add milk, salt, and pepper, then using a potato masher, mash until smooth.
To serve, divide mashed parsnips, meatloaves, and salad between plates. Top meatloaves with sauce and enjoy!

name: Mini Glazed Meatloaves with Mashed Potatoes & Roasted Carrots

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Peel and mince onion; place in a medium bowl.
Add ground beef, egg, milk, bread crumbs, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the onions. Mix with your hands until well combined.
Place ketchup, Dijon, and brown sugar in a small bowl; whisk to combine.
Divide meatloaf mixture between 6 muffin cups and top with ketchup glaze. Place in the oven and bake until cooked through, 20-25 minutes.

Meanwhile, wash, peel, and medium dice potato. Transfer to a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes.

Wash, trim, and peel carrots. Slice lengthwise into quarters. Place on a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven and bake until golden and fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
When the potatoes are done, drain, and return to the pan.
Add milk, butter, salt, and pepper to the potatoes. Mash until smooth.
To serve, divide the meatloaves, roasted carrots, and mashed potatoes between plates. Enjoy!

name: Mini Tofu Shawarma with Cucumber-Tomato Salad & Mint Yogurt

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil and spices in a medium bowl; stir to combine the spice paste.
Medium dice tofu, add to the bowl with the spice paste, and gently toss to coat. Transfer tofu to a baking sheet and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until tofu is golden brown, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice tomato. Peel, trim, and small dice cucumber. Add both to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the mint, along with yogurt, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the yogurt sauce.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, fill tortillas with tofu, cucumber-tomato salad, and mint yogurt. Divide between plates and enjoy!

name: Minted Asparagus Pea Soup with Seared Shrimp & Parmesan Crisps

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Drain shrimp in a colander and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Spread out on a clean towel and pat dry. Skip this step if you are using fresh shrimp.
amounts: ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash the asparagus and snap (or cut) off the woody ends. Cut into 1-inch pieces and transfer to a baking sheet; drizzle with olive oil and bake in the oven for 10-12 minutes.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: To make crisps, line a baking sheet with parchment paper and grate Parmesan cheese. Measure out 1 tbsp of the grated Parmesan and place in a pile on the sheet. Repeat with remaining cheese, keeping the piles a few inches apart.
Place in the oven and bake until lightly browned, 5-7 minutes. Watch carefully because they can burn quickly. Once done, remove from the oven and let them sit for a couple of minutes.
Trim, peel, and mince the shallot and garlic.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
When the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat. Add the shrimp; cook until opaque, about 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Return pot to heat, add oil, swirling to coat the bottom; add shallot and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until shallots are translucent, 2-3 minutes.
Wash mint. Pick leaves off the stems; discard the stems and finely mince the leaves. Add to pot.
Add peas, broth, salt, and pepper to the pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then turn down to medium-high. Cook until peas have softened, 4-5 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add the roasted asparagus and cream to the soup, reserving some asparagus for garnish. Using an immersion (hand) blender, purée the soup until smooth. Allow soup to heat through but not boil, 2-3 minutes more.
To serve, ladle soup into bowls and drizzle with more cream. Top with reserved asparagus, Parmesan crisps, and shrimp. Enjoy!

name: Mixed Green Salad with Pork Sausage, Apple, Almonds & Italian Dressing

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Once the skillet is hot, add almonds and cook, stirring often, until lightly toasted and fragrant, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apple. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl.
When the sausages are almost done, add mixed greens and toasted almonds to the bowl, then toss to combine the salad.
Slice sausages crosswise into thin rounds.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, then top with sausage. Enjoy!

name: Mixed Green Salad with Sausage, Sweet Potato, Feta & Italian Dressing

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Peel and cut sweet potato into ½-inch cubes; transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to combine; spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potatoes are golden brown and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, slice the sausages crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and crispy, 5-6 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the sausage to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside.
While the sausage is cooking, place oil, vinegar, sugar, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, halve tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add mixed greens to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with roasted sweet potato, crispy sausage, and feta. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Mongolian Beef Meatball Lettuce Wraps with Sesame & Roasted Broccoli

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat one half of a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to the unoiled half of the baking sheet, drizzle with oil and soy sauce, then season with pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer. Set aside.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Divide between a medium bowl and a small saucepan.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Divide both between the bowl and saucepan with the green onion. (Set pan aside for later use.)
Add beef, bread crumbs, egg, and spices to the bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
Using a tablespoon measure, form the beef mixture into rounded meatballs. Arrange on the oiled half of the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake, tossing broccoli and turning meatballs halfway, until meatballs are cooked through and broccoli is fork-tender and lightly charred, 15-18 minutes.

When the meatballs are almost done, add cold water, soy sauce, cornstarch, sugar, oil, and vinegar to the pan with the green onions. Set over medium heat and cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
When the meatballs and broccoli are done, remove from oven. Drizzle sauce over meatballs and toss to coat.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with meatballs and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve with broccoli on the side and enjoy!

name: Moroccan Chicken, Eggplant & Tomato Skewers with Lemony Yogurt Dip

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 6-8 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl, along with oil and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade.
Trim and large dice eggplant. Add to the bowl with the marinade.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and large dice. Add to the bowl, along with tomatoes, and stir to coat. Set aside.
Using a clean cutting board, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the parsley. Add yogurt, oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the lemony yogurt. Set aside.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats up, thread chicken, eggplant, and grape tomatoes onto skewers, then place on a plate. (Alternatively, you can cook the chicken and veggies directly on the pan without using skewers.)
Once the pan is hot, add skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until chicken and veggies are cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Divide skewers between plates and serve with lemony yogurt for dipping. Enjoy!

name: Moroccan Chickpea, Apricot, Bell Pepper & Zucchini Curry with Couscous

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and slice carrot crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and thinly slice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies start to soften, about 5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Place in the reserved bowl.
Roughly chop apricots and add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander.
Once the veggies start to soften, add zucchini, apricots, chickpeas, tomatoes, broth, tomato paste, and sugar to the skillet. Stir to combine the curry and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies and chickpeas are tender, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the curry is done, remove from heat, add half of the parsley, and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
To serve, divide couscous and curry between plates or bowls. Top with reserved parsley and pine nuts. Enjoy!

name: Moroccan Cod with Cauliflower, Sweet Potato, Chickpeas & Spicy Yogurt

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potato. Place in a medium bowl.
Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the sweet potato.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl along with oil and spices, then stir to combine. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a baking dish.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the baking dish with the lemon, along with oil, and whisk to combine.
Cut cod into portions and place in the baking dish. Turn to coat with the lemon oil, then season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Add baking dish to the oven and roast until cod is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place yogurt and chili-garlic sauce in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spicy yogurt and set aside.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies and chickpeas are done, remove from the oven. Add cilantro to the baking sheet and stir to combine.
To serve, divide roasted veggies, chickpeas, and cod between plates or bowls. Top cod with spicy yogurt and enjoy!

name: Moroccan Fish, Carrot, Zucchini & Bell Pepper Skillet with Couscous

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes. Uncover couscous and fluff with a fork.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat the fish dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Sprinkle flour over both sides of each fillet and press gently to adhere.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fish to the skillet and cook until opaque and cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and cover with foil.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Seed and slice bell pepper into thin strips. Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion. Peel and thinly slice garlic.
Return skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the bell pepper, onion, and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice carrot. Trim and thinly slice zucchini. Add both to the skillet along with the spices. Cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Stir in the tomatoes, broth, tomato paste, and sugar. Increase temperature to high and bring to a boil; then reduce heat to medium and let simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the skillet (reserve the rest for garnish).

Place fish fillets in the skillet over the vegetables, spooning a thin layer of sauce over the top to cover. Cover with a lid and let simmer until veggies are soft and fish is warmed through, about 5 minutes.
Cut the lemon into wedges.
To serve, divide couscous and vegetable-fish sauté between plates or bowls. Garnish with cilantro and lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Moroccan Grilled Meatballs with Yogurt Sauce & Beet Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and large dice beets; place in a small saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Divide between a small and medium bowl. Set the medium bowl aside for the meatballs.
Juice lemon into the small bowl with the garlic. Add yogurt, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the yogurt sauce. Set aside.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until beets are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat, drain, and run under cold water to cool; set aside to drain further.
While the beets are cooking, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the medium bowl with the garlic. (Set remaining parsley aside for later use.)

Peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl along with beef, bread crumbs, egg, sugar, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the beef mixture into rounded meatballs. Place on a plate.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add meatballs and grill, turning occasionally with a fork or tongs, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, zest and juice orange into a clean medium bowl. Add reserved parsley, oil, cumin, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, along with cooled beets, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide yogurt sauce and salad between plates; top yogurt with meatballs. Enjoy!

name: Moroccan Halloumi, Apricot & Shallot Sauté with Almond-Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl, along with spices, then stir to combine the spice mix.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add half of the spice mix (reserving remainder for the halloumi), oil, and maple syrup, then whisk to combine the marinade.
Peel and quarter shallot lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the marinade.
Halve apricots lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into ¼-inch thick slices, add to the bowl, and toss to combine. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat halloumi dry with paper towels; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the halloumi in half horizontally, then cut each half lengthwise into 1-inch thick strips. Season both sides with the reserved spice mix.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the halloumi and cook, turning halfway through, until golden brown on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve skillet for later use and bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, maple syrup, and spices in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop almonds. Add to the bowl, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.

Return the skillet to medium-high heat. Add apricots and shallots; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and caramelized, 2-3 minutes. Return halloumi to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide salad and halloumi sauté between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Moroccan-Inspired Eggplant & Chickpea Salad with Feta & Parsley

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the lemon and transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the lemon juice.

To the lemon juice and garlic, add olive oil, Dijon, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper; whisk together. Transfer half of the dressing to a large salad bowl and set aside; leave the remaining dressing in the small bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Trim off and discard the ends of the eggplant; slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick rounds.

Once the grill pan or skillet is hot, add the eggplant slices. Brush or rub the tops of the slices with half of the remaining dressing, then flip them over and brush or rub the other sides with the rest of the dressing. Cook until the slices are tender and browned on both sides, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the slices to a plate. Cook in batches if necessary.
While the eggplant slices cook, trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and mince the shallot. Add to the salad bowl.
Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Add the feta to the salad bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Add the chickpeas to the salad bowl.
Cut the eggplant slices into bite-sized pieces and add to the salad bowl. Toss the salad until thoroughly coated with the dressing.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Moroccan Lentil-Kale Salad with Apricots, Dates, Pistachios & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan; add water and salt. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove lid, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain, rinse under cold water to cool, and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice orange into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and shallot. Add both to the bowl with the orange juice along with oil, vinegar, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pistachios, dates, and apricots. Add all three to the bowl.
When the lentils are done, add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with feta and enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Moroccan Style Chicken with Zucchini & Couscous

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash zucchini and tomatoes. Halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half rounds. Medium dice tomatoes. Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add chicken and cook until lightly browned but not cooked through, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Return pan to stove and add more oil. Add onion, garlic, and zucchini. Stirring frequently, cook until vegetables begin to soften, 2-3 minutes.

Return chicken to pan. Add tomatoes, honey, cinnamon, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and cook until chicken is cooked through and zucchini is tender, 8-10 minutes.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ to pan (save the rest for garnishing) while the ingredients cook.
Uncover couscous and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place couscous on a plate, top with chicken and sauce, and garnish with remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Moroccan-Style Turkey Meatball Stew with Carrot Couscous & Herbs

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; place in a small saucepan.
Add broth to the pan with the carrot, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once boiling, remove pan from the heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half of the herbs in a medium bowl and set remainder aside for serving.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the herbs along with turkey and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning often, until just browned on all sides, 4-5 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Once done, transfer to a clean plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onion; trim and small dice celery.
Return the skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and celery; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, about 3 minutes.
While the veggies are cooking, medium dice tomatoes; add to the skillet along with the tomato sauce, water, and spices. Stir to combine and bring the stew to a boil over high heat.

Once the stew is boiling, reduce heat to medium, then return meatballs (and any accumulated juices) to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until meatballs are cooked through, 5-6 minutes more.
When the meatballs are done, juice lemon into the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide couscous and meatball stew between plates or bowls; sprinkle with reserved herbs and enjoy!

name: Mozzarella, Basil & Prosciutto Grilled Cheese with Lemon Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Thinly slice the mozzarella.
Pick basil leaves off the stems.
Preheat a grill pan or nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Place the bread slices on a flat surface. Evenly top half of the slices with the prosciutto, basil leaves, and sliced mozzarella. Cover the sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
Coat the grill pan or skillet with butter.
Place the sandwiches in the pan and cook until the bottom is golden brown, 2-4 minutes.

Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more butter to the pan; return the sandwiches to the pan, browned-side-up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a cutting board.
While the sandwiches toast, juice the lemon into a large bowl. Whisk in the vinegar, oil, salt, and honey.
Use a vegetable peeler to shave the Parmesan into strips.
Add the arugula and shaved Parmesan to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine.
Cut the sandwiches in half on the diagonal.
To serve, divide the salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!

name: Mozzarella & Bruschetta Grilled Chicken with Balsamic Glaze

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Place a small saucepan on medium-high heat; add balsamic vinegar and brown sugar; stir until sugar is dissolved. Cook until reduced by half, or until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, 10-15 minutes. Once done, remove from heat.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken breasts in half horizontally, forming thin fillets.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Mix the spices together in a small bowl. Rub chicken fillets with the spice mixture on both sides.
Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
When hot, coat grill pan with oil.
Place the chicken fillets in the grill pan; cook until they are golden brown and cooked through, 5-6 minutes per side. Once done, remove from heat.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil for easy clean-up (optional).
Small dice the tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince the shallots and garlic and add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes. Add the oil, salt, and pepper and stir to combine. Set aside.
Slice the fresh mozzarella.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Place cooked chicken on the baking sheet pan. Top with sliced mozzarella. Place in the oven and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the cheese begins to melt.
To serve, divide the chicken between plates, top with tomato mixture, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze. Enjoy!

name: Mozzarella Grilled Cheese with Tomato-Basil Soup

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the onion.
Once the saucepan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion and garlic to the saucepan; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the onion is softened, 4 to 6 minutes.

Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves into a chiffonade by stacking them and rolling tightly into a cigar, then slicing crosswise into thin ribbons. Transfer the basil to a small bowl.
Coarsely grate 1 cup of mozzarella.
Add the diced tomatoes, broth, and basil to the saucepan; season with additional salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 8 to 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add butter to a nonstick skillet and heat over medium-low heat.
Place the bread slices on a clean, dry work surface. Divide the cheese between 2 of the bread slices, then top with the remaining bread slices.
Once melted, spread the butter around the skillet, then season the bottom of the skillet with salt.

Place the sandwiches in the skillet and cook until golden brown and crispy on the first side, 3 to 4 minutes. Then, add more butter and carefully flip the sandwiches; cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese has melted, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a cutting board.
Using a hand blender, purée the soup until smooth. Alternatively, use a potato masher to mash the tomatoes (the soup will be chunkier).
Cut the grilled cheese sandwiches in half diagonally.
To serve, divide the soup between small bowls and serve with the grilled cheese on the side. Enjoy!

name: Mozzarella, Prosciutto, Corn & Arugula Flatbread Pizza

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Place corn in a medium bowl and cover with hot water from the tap.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a small bowl. Add oil and stir to combine.
Using a strainer or colander, drain the corn and transfer to a clean towel; pat dry.
Grate cheese.
Place the flatbreads on a baking sheet and spread with the garlic oil.
Layer cheese, corn, and prosciutto onto the flatbreads.
Place pizza in the oven and bake, until the cheese is golden and melted, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the basil and arugula. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.) Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When pizza is done top with arugula, basil, and crushed red pepper.
To serve, cut pizza into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Mozzarella & Prosciutto Stuffed Pita with Italian Dressed Greens

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Medium dice tomato. Add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Slice mozzarella into rounds. Place on a plate.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Chop or tear prosciutto into bite sized pieces. Add to the plate with the mozzarella.
Cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets. Spread mayo on the inside of the pitas, then fill with mozzarella, prosciutto, and a small portion of salad. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)
Divide pitas between plates and serve with remaining salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Mu Shu-Style Pork with Broccoli Slaw & Mushrooms over Jasmine Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms; transfer to a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board; thinly slice crosswise into bite-sized strips and season with salt and pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork strips and stir-fry until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with soy sauce, cornstarch, peanut butter, chili-garlic sauce, oil, vinegar, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
When the pork is done, use a slotted spoon to transfer the strips to a plate and set aside.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add broccoli slaw and sauce to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are tender-crisp and sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes.
Return pork to the skillet, along with any accumulated juices; stir to combine and cook until heated through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and pork stir-fry between plates. Enjoy!

name: Mushroom, Cheddar & Jalapeño Quesadilla with Poppy Seed Fruit Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a medium bowl; add yogurt, poppy seeds, and sugar. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Remove stems from mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills; halve and slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add mushrooms, garlic, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 4-5 minutes; remove from heat.

Meanwhile, halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Coarsely grate cheese.

To assemble the quesadillas, lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide mushrooms, jalapeño, green onion, and cheese between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla; fold in half to close. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, quarter, core, and medium dice apple; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, peel, and medium dice kiwis; add to the bowl, along with the blueberries, and stir to combine the fruit salad.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with fruit salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Mushroom-Egg Scramble Tacos with Avocado, Feta & Pickled Onions

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, thinly slice mushrooms.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and tender, 8-10 minutes.

Meanwhile, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and place in another small bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Juice lime into the bowl with the jalapeño.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince half of the leaves. Add to the bowl. (Reserve remaining whole leaves for serving.)
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Add to the bowl, along with salt, and mash with a fork until semi-smooth. Set aside.
Crack eggs into a medium bowl, then season with salt. Whisk until smooth.
When the mushrooms are done, add vinegar to the skillet, and stir to combine.

Pour egg mixture into the skillet with the mushrooms and scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are no longer runny. Remove from heat, add feta, and stir to combine.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with mashed avocado, mushroom scramble, and pickled onion. Top with reserved cilantro and enjoy!

name: Mushroom & Olive Stuffed Pizza Burgers with Lemon-Artichoke Salad

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl with the dressing, toss to coat, and set aside.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Mince olives and mushrooms; place both in another medium bowl.
Add beef and spices to the bowl with the olives; mix with your hands until well to combined. Form into two, 1-inch thick patties, and place on a plate. Set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, cut tomato into thick slices and season both sides with salt and basil.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add tomatoes and grill until lightly charred, about 1 minute per side. Transfer to a plate.
Meanwhile, slice cheese.

Place burger patties on the pan and grill, undisturbed, for 5 minutes. Flip patties and top with cheese and grilled tomatoes; continue to grill until cooked through, 5 minutes more. Transfer to the plate used for the tomatoes.
Meanwhile, chop or tear romaine leaves into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl with the artichokes and toss to combine the salad.
If desired, place buns, cut-side down, on the grill pan to toast, 1-2 minutes.
Assemble pizza burgers and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy.

name: Mushroom, Onion & Mozzarella Frittata with Lemony Arugula

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Thinly slice the mushrooms.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes. Reserve bowl for later.
Increase heat to medium-high and add mushrooms; season with salt and thyme. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are softened and liquid has evaporated, about 7 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly grate the cheese.
Combine eggs, half the cheese, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine.
Preheat oven to broil on high.

Spread the mushrooms evenly in the skillet. Reduce heat to medium-low and pour in the egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Sprinkle remaining cheese over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice the lemon into a medium salad bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing. Add arugula and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and place on plates; top with arugula and enjoy!

name: Mushroom Sandwich with Avocado-Mayo Spread, Arugula, Tomato & Carrot

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Place oil, soy sauce, vinegar, maple syrup, paprika, and pepper in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Remove mushroom stems and carefully scrape out the gills. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with marinade, and turn to coat. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place mushrooms in the oven and roast until tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into the reserved bowl.
Add nutritional yeast, mayo, and spices to the bowl with the avocado; mash with a potato masher or fork until smooth. Set avocado mayo aside.
Slice tomato. Peel, trim, and coarsely grate the carrot. Transfer both to a plate and set aside.
Toast bread if desired.
Slice mushrooms into strips.
Place bread slices on a flat surface and spread evenly with avocado mayo. Top half the slices with mushrooms, tomato, carrot, and arugula. Cover sandwiches with remaining bread slices.
To serve, divide sandwiches between plates and enjoy!

name: Mushroom Scramble Toasts with Goat Cheese, Crispy Prosciutto & Greens

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Arrange prosciutto in a single layer on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and cook until prosciutto is crisp, 3-5 minutes. Remove from oven and transfer crispy prosciutto to a plate; set aside to cool. (Reserve baking sheet for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Thinly slice mushrooms.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until deep brown and tender, 12-14 minutes.
While the mushrooms are cooking, change the oven to broil on high.
Arrange bread on the reserved baking sheet. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.
Crack eggs into a medium bowl, then season with salt and pepper. Whisk until smooth.
When the mushrooms are done, add vinegar and salt to the skillet, then stir to combine.

Pour egg mixture into the skillet with the mushrooms and scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are no longer runny. Remove from heat, crumble goat cheese into the skillet, and stir to combine.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Chop chives into small pieces. Place half in the bowl with the dressing (reserving the rest for serving).
Chop (or tear) lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and toast between plates. Top toast with cheesy mushroom scramble, reserved chives, and crispy prosciutto. Enjoy!

name: Mushroom Stuffed Pork Chops with Carrot & Thyme Couscous

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Wash, dry, and small dice mushrooms.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add onion, garlic, and mushrooms. Stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Wash and dry thyme. Slide leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
Add ½ of the thyme, salt, and pepper to skillet. Stir and remove from heat. Transfer remaining thyme to a plate.
Heat a small saucepan over medium-high heat.
Wash, peel, and small dice carrots.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add carrots and cook until tender, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to plate with thyme.
In the same small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Cut a pocket in each pork chop. Season with salt and pepper, then fill with the mushroom and onion mixture. Transfer any remaining mixture to a plate.
Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add pork and cook until cooked through, 3-5 minutes per side.
Uncover couscous and fluff with a fork. Add carrots and remaining thyme; mix well.
To serve, place pork chops on a plate and couscous on the side. Enjoy!

name: Mustard Pork Schnitzel with Roasted Parmesan Green Beans

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash green beans and trim ends. Transfer to a sheet pan.
Peel and mince garlic. Sprinkle green beans with garlic, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Spread out evenly and place in the oven. Roast until tender-crisp, 10-15 minutes.
In a medium bowl, mix together bread crumbs, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the pork chops in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Rub with Dijon mustard on both sides, then place in the breadcrumb mixture and coat on both sides.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add pork chops and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Grate ⅛ cup Parmesan.
Remove green beans from oven, sprinkle with Parmesan, and toss.
To serve, place pork chops and green beans on a plate. Add a dollop of Dijon on the side for dipping if desired. Enjoy!

name: Naked Wonton Soup with Bok Choy & Green Onions

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 28 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Pour broth, oil, and sauces into a large pot and heat over medium-high.
amounts: 28 fl oz (3 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic. Peel and mince or grate ginger. Add half of each to the pot and transfer the rest to a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer half to the medium bowl and set the other half aside in a small bowl.
Trim and finely chop green onions. Add half to the medium bowl and half to the small bowl.
Add pork, egg, sauces, and pepper to the medium bowl and mix with your hands until well combined.
Using a tablespoon measure, form the pork mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Once the broth begins to boil, turn down to a simmer. Carefully add the meatballs (a few at a time, to avoid splashing) to the pot. Simmer until pork is cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim bok choy and slice in half lengthwise. Add to the soup along with the remaining cilantro and green onion.
Return soup to a simmer and cook until bok choy is tender, 4-5 minutes more.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!

name: Napa Cabbage, Pork & Bell Pepper Stir Fry

instructions.text: In a small bowl, combine and whisk together water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and cornstarch.
Thinly slice the pork chops crosswise into strips; transfer to a medium bowl.
Pour ½ of the sauce over the pork; toss to coat and set aside.
Wash and dry the cutting board, knife, and fresh produce.
Halve the cabbage lengthwise and cut out the core; chop crosswise into bite-sized pieces (about 1-inch-wide). Transfer to a large bowl.
Cut the bell pepper into 4 wedges lengthwise, then remove and discard the seeds. Thinly slice into strips lengthwise and add to the bowl of cabbage.
Trim and discard the ends of the green onions; chop the onions into ¼-inch pieces. Separate the white parts from the greens and transfer to two small bowls.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince or grate the ginger; add to the white parts of the green onions.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the onions and ginger.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the pork strips in the skillet; cook until browned, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Once the pork has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet.
Add the ginger, garlic, and white parts of green onions; cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the bell pepper and cabbage to the skillet. Cook, stirring regularly, until the vegetables are tender-crisp and lightly browned, 3 to 4 minutes.

Add the pork (along with any juices), remaining sauce, and ½ of the remaining green onions (save the rest for garnishing) to the skillet; stir to combine and cook until the sauce is slightly thickened, 1 to 2 minutes.
Divide the stir fry between bowls and sprinkle with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: New Potato, Asparagus & Egg Salad with Lemon-Mustard Vinaigrette

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 450°F and position rack in the center.
Place the eggs in a small saucepan and fill with enough water to cover the eggs by about 1 inch. Cover the saucepan and bring to a full rolling boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the potatoes lengthwise into 4 wedges and transfer to a baking sheet.
Snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears into 1-inch pieces and add to the potatoes.
Drizzle the potatoes and asparagus with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
Place the sheet in the oven and roast until the vegetables are tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Once done, remove from the oven.

Once the water in the saucepan in boiling, remove the pan from the heat, cover, and let it sit for 8 minutes. Drain and place the saucepan under cold running water for 1 to 2 minutes to allow the eggs to cool. Alternatively, add ice to the saucepan.
Juice the lemon into a large bowl, then add olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together. Set aside.
Peel, halve lengthwise, then thinly slice the shallot; add to the bowl.
Measure out the almonds and add to the bowl.
Measure out the capers and add to the bowl.
Transfer the roasted vegetables to the bowl and toss to coat.
Peel and quarter the eggs lengthwise.
To serve, divide the salad between plates and place the egg wedges overtop. Enjoy!

name: New York Steak with Green Bean & New Potato Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water and add salt; cover and bring to a boil.
Quarter the potatoes and transfer to a medium bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the steak with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the steak in the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2 to 5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Trim the ends of the beans. Once the water is boiling, add the beans; cook until they are bright green and tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water.
Once the steak has been transferred, add the potatoes to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender when pierced with a fork, 8 to 10 minutes.
Juice ¼ of a lemon into a large bowl and cut the other ¼ into wedges for serving. Add olive oil and Dijon to the lemon juice and whisk together.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, halve lengthwise, and thinly slice the shallot; add to the bowl.
Add the green beans and potatoes to the bowl; toss until the salad is combined.
Divide the steak and salad between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container). Garnish with lemon wedges for squeezing over top. Enjoy!

name: New York Strip Steak with Bell Pepper & Creamed Spinach

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.
While the water is heating, finely grate Parmesan; cut cream cheese into small pieces. Place both in a medium bowl and set aside.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Wash the spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, add salt and spinach, and stir until wilted, about 30 seconds. Drain in a colander and rinse with cold water to cool. (Reserve pot for next step.)
Return pot to medium heat. Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, salt, and pepper to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is soft, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can. Add spinach to the bowl with the Parmesan and cream cheese.
Once the onion is soft, add Parmesan, cream cheese, spinach, and milk to the pot. Cook, stirring frequently, until cheeses melt and combine, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak to the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry bell pepper; trim, seed, and slice into thin strips.
Return skillet to medium heat; add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
While the pepper is cooking, reheat the spinach, if necessary. (Return the pot to low heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes.)
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Divide steak between plates and top with peppers; serve with spinach on the side. Enjoy!

name: New York Strip Steak with Mushroom Sauce & Cauliflower Puree

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.

Wash cauliflower and cut off the leaves. Separate into small florets and cut the thick stem into smaller pieces; transfer to a bowl. Add to boiling water and cook until very tender, 10-15 minutes. Drain in a colander, return to saucepan, and cover.
Wash and slice mushrooms.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Generously season steak with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Coat skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.

Once steak has been transferred, reduce heat to medium and add butter and mushrooms to skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 3-4 minutes. Add vinegar and season with salt and pepper; cook until reduced, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add water, butter, salt, pepper, and about ½ of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing) to cauliflower. Blend using an immersion hand blender or a potato masher.
To serve, place cauliflower purée on a plate and top with steak and mushroom sauce. Sprinkle with remaining parsley and enjoy!

name: New York Strip Steak with Roasted Asparagus & New Potato Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 425°F and position rack in the center. Place a baking sheet in the oven to warm up.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the potatoes into ¼-inch-thick slices. Remove the baking sheet from the oven and add the potatoes.
Snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears into 2-inch pieces. Add to the potatoes.
Drizzle the potatoes and asparagus with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
Place the sheet in the oven and roast until the vegetables are tender, 12 to 15 minutes. Once done, remove from the oven.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Place the steak on a plate and season with salt and pepper.
Juice the lemon into a large bowl, then add olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together. Set aside.
Coat the grill pan or skillet with coconut oil.
Place the steak in the grill pan or skillet; cook until desired doneness, 2 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Chop the chives into ¼-inch pieces; transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Transfer the roasted vegetables to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
To serve, divide the steak and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: New York Striploin over Cauliflower Risotto with Mushrooms

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot; cook, stirring often, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Slice mushrooms. Add to the pan with the shallot; cook, stirring often, until soft and browned around the edges, 3-4 minutes.
Cut cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate cauliflower.
Peel and mince garlic.
Add cauliflower, garlic, broth, salt, and pepper to the pan. Continue to cook, stirring often, until cauliflower has softened, 5-6 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Add Parmesan and cream to the pan with the cauliflower. Reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring often, until slightly thickened, 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Mince chives. Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide cauliflower risotto and steak between bowls or plates and garnish with chives. Enjoy!

name: NY Steak with Roasted Fennel, Grape, Walnut, Parmesan & Arugula Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Add grapes to the baking sheet with the fennel; drizzle with oil and season with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated); roast, stirring halfway through, until fennel and grapes are lightly browned and tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with additional oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl.
Transfer cooled fennel and grapes to the bowl, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: NY Strip Steak with Shallot-Red Wine Vinegar Sauce & Swiss Chard

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and cut into portions. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steaks and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate, cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)

Meanwhile, wash and dry chard; fold leaves in half lengthwise and, using a clean cutting board, slice off the stems. Cut leaves into bite-sized pieces and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in a medium bowl, reserving stems for the next step.

Preheat another skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chard stems, salt, and pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add chard leaves to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon into the skillet with the chard and stir to combine. Cover and remove from heat.
Peel and slice shallot crosswise into thin rounds.

Return reserved skillet (with steak drippings) to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, 4-5 minutes.
When the shallots are soft, add water, vinegar, and sugar to the skillet. Bring to a simmer and cook until sauce is reduced by half, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide steaks and lemony chard between plates. Spoon shallot sauce over steaks and enjoy!

name: Olive-Caper Chicken with Mixed Green Salad & Garlic Toast

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing, toss to combine, and set aside.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with spices on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, sprinkle cornstarch over both sides of each fillet and press gently to adhere.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken to the skillet and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise; slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl; set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and mince garlic.

Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet pan and drizzle with oil; sprinkle with garlic and salt. Place in the oven and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and cut toasts in half on the diagonal.
Meanwhile, mince olives and capers; divide between chicken fillets and spread out in an even layer.
Add spring mix to the bowl with the veggies and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and chicken between plates. Serve with toasts on the side and enjoy!

name: Olive Chicken with Roasted Onions, Bell Peppers & Artichokes over Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and medium dice onion. Peel and thinly slice garlic. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Drain artichokes and add to the bowl.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon into the bowl. Add oil and spices, then toss to combine.
Transfer veggies to a baking sheet pan and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Mince olives and place in the reserved bowl; add oil and stir to combine the olive mixture.
Season both sides of the chicken with salt and pepper; nestle chicken in the veggies on the baking sheet. Spoon olive mixture over the chicken.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender, about 20 minutes.
To serve, divide rice, roasted veggies, and chicken between plates. Enjoy!

name: One-Pan Cheesy Cauliflower & Broccoli Chicken

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken, onion, paprika, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through, 5-7 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the cauliflower into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower and transfer to a large bowl.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to bowl with the cauliflower.
Add the cauliflower, broccoli, and broth to the skillet and cover. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender, 5-7 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Coarsely grate the cheddar.
Once the vegetables are tender, remove skillet from the heat. Add cheese, yogurt, salt, and pepper; stir until smooth and creamy.
To serve, divide the chicken and vegetables between bowls. Enjoy!

name: One-Pan Cheesy Chicken & Broccoli Quinoa Skillet

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Peel and small dice the onion; transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized cubes.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add olive oil to the pan and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add the onion and chicken to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is softened and the chicken is browned, 3 to 4 minutes. The chicken just needs to be browned and doesn't have to be cooked all the way through.
Add the garlic and stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add in the quinoa and broth; stir to combine. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash the cutting board (if used to cut the chicken) and return to the counter.
While the quinoa cooks, wash the broccoli. Cut the broccoli head into bite-sized florets and medium dice the stems.
Coarsely grate ½ cup of cheddar.

Once the quinoa has cooked for 10 minutes, quickly add the broccoli over the top and season with salt and pepper. Cook, covered, until the quinoa is cooked and the broccoli is tender, an additional 5 to 7 minutes.
Stir the mixture, then sprinkle the cheddar over top; cook until the cheese is fully melted, 1 to 3 minutes.
Divide the dish between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container). Enjoy!

name: One-Pan Sausage & Veggie Bake with Asparagus, Mushrooms, and Zucchini

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Place sausages on a baking sheet pan and place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated); bake for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic; place in a medium bowl along with the oil and spices. Stir to combine.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and slice zucchini into ¼-inch rounds; place in the bowl with the garlic oil.
Cut the mushroom in half and then crosswise into thin strips; add to the bowl.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends from the asparagus and cut into 2-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the other veggies and toss to combine.

Remove baking sheet pan from the oven, flip sausages, and push them to one side. Add veggies to the pan and return to the oven; continue to bake, until veggies are tender and sausages are cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Slice sausages into 1-inch pieces.
To serve, divide sausage pieces and vegetables between plates. Enjoy!

name: One Pot Creamy Goat Cheese Penne with Asparagus, Peas, Carrots & Dill

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until starting to soften, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and halve carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch long pieces. Add to the bowl with the carrot, along with the peas.
When the pasta is starting to soften, add veggies to the pan and stir for a few seconds. Continue to cook until pasta and veggies are fork-tender, 4-5 minutes more. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
