Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl with the dill.

When the pasta and veggies are done, drain in a colander and return to the pan. Add dill, goat cheese, oil, and spices then set over medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until cheese is melted and sauce coats the pasta, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: One-Pot Creamy Taco Pasta with Turkey & Cheddar

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Seed and small dice the bell pepper.
Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.

Once the pot is hot, add the oil, bell pepper, onion, garlic, and ground turkey. Break apart the turkey with a spoon until crumbly. Stirring occasionally, cook until turkey is cooked through and vegetables are tender, 5-7 minutes.

Add the pasta, tomatoes, water, and spices to the pot. Stir and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally until pasta is cooked and most of the water is absorbed, 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate the cheddar.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Once the pasta is done, remove from heat. If more than ¼ cup of liquid is remaining in the pot, carefully strain off excess liquid using a colander.
Add cheese, yogurt, and half of the cilantro to the pot with the pasta and stir until cheese is melted and creamy.
To serve, divide pasta between bowls. Garnish with remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: One-Pot Creamy Zucchini & Mushroom Pasta

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Add dried spaghetti to a large pot, off the heat, breaking noodles in half.
Remove the stems of the portobello mushrooms. Using a spoon, carefully scrape out the gills, making sure not to damage the rim of the mushrooms. Dice mushrooms into ½-inch cubes and add to the pot.
Trim and discard the ends of the zucchini; small dice the zucchini into ½-inch cubes and add to the pot.
Peel and mince or press the garlic; add to pot.
Remove the stem ends of the green onions. Slice in ¼-inch pieces and add to pot.
Slide the thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems, add to the pot. Add butter and season everything with salt and pepper.
Add enough water to the pot just to cover noodles. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium; water should remain at a low boil for the entire cooking process.

Ensure pasta is mostly submerged in cooking liquid while cooking. Stirring frequently, simmer, uncovered, until pasta is cooked through, vegetables have softened and liquid has reduced. About 8-10 minutes.
Finely grate Parmesan.
When pasta is done cooking drain any excess liquid from the pot using a colander.
Return pasta and veggies to the pot. Stir in heavy cream and Parmesan. Serve immediately. Enjoy!

name: One-Pot Turmeric Chicken & Basmati Rice with Tomato Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
In a medium bowl (that will hold the chicken), combine and mix together olive oil, turmeric, salt, and pepper.
Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place in the marinade; gently toss until well coated.
Once the pan is hot, carefully add the chicken thighs; cook until they are browned (but not cooked through), 2 to 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
While the chicken cooks, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and transfer to a small bowl.

Once the chicken has been transferred, reduce the heat to medium. Add olive oil and the ½ of the onion to the pan (save the rest for the salad); cook, stirring frequently, until the onion is softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, turmeric, salt, and pepper to the pan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the rice to the pan and stir until coated with the spices and oil. Then, pour the broth into the pan, stir to combine with the rice, and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer, return the chicken to the pan, and cover with a lid. Cook until the broth is absorbed and the chicken is cooked through, 12 to 15 minutes.
Wash and dry the tomatoes, then cut them into thin wedges and transfer to a medium salad bowl.
Add the remaining onions to the salad. Drizzle the salad with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Once the chicken and rice are cooked, transfer the chicken to a plate and fluff the rice with a fork.
To serve, divide the rice between plates and top with the chicken; serve with tomato salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Open-Face Cheesy Tuna Melts with Creamy Lime-Poppy Seed Fruit Salad

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Split muffins and arrange on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Keep oven on for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and small dice celery. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the celery.
Drain tuna and flake with a fork. Add to the bowl along with mayo, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the tuna salad and set aside.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Thinly slice cheese.
Arrange muffin halves cut-side up, then top with tuna salad and cheese. Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lime into a clean medium bowl; add yogurt, poppy seeds, and sugar. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter, core, and medium dice apple; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice and add to the bowl along with the blueberries. Stir to combine the fruit salad.
To serve, divide tuna melts and fruit salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Open Face Herby Egg Salad English Muffins with Lemony Roast Asparagus

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F and arrange rack in the upper third of the oven. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil and set aside.
Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus. Transfer to the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, turning asparagus halfway through, until tender-crisp, 5-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining dill for serving.)
Chop chives into small pieces. Add half to the bowl with the dill. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl along with mayo, capers, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the dressing.
Peel and roughly chop the eggs. Add to the bowl with the dressing and gently stir to combine the egg salad. Set aside.
When the asparagus is done, change oven to broil on high. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the English muffins.)

Carefully remove cooked asparagus from the baking sheet by lifting the corners of the foil and transferring the whole sheet to a flat surface. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the English muffins.)
Split muffins and arrange on the baking sheet. Place in the oven and broil until toasted, about 1 minute per side; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster for the muffins.)
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a small bowl. Add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the sauce.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: To serve, divide muffins and asparagus between plates. Top muffins with egg salad and reserved herbs. Drizzle asparagus with lemony sauce and enjoy!

name: Open-Face Steak Sandwiches with Onions, Lemon Aioli & Roasted Carrots

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and cut carrots lengthwise into quarters; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Zest lemon into a small bowl and set aside. Juice lemon over the carrots, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing once, until carrots are fork-tender, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and golden, about 8 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: While the onions are cooking, add mayo and garlic powder to the bowl with the lemon zest; stir to combine the lemon aioli and set aside.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on another plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the onions are done, return the skillet to medium-high heat and add more oil; swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak to the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Add to the plate with the cooked onions, re-cover with foil, and let rest 5 minutes.
Toast buns if desired.
Slice tomato into rounds.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Divide buns between plates, spread each with lemon aioli, then top with tomato, steak, and onions. Serve with roasted carrots on the side and enjoy!

name: Open-Faced Curried Tofu Salad Sandwiches with Lettuce & Cucumber

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place mayo, nutritional yeast, Dijon, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl; stir to combine the creamy dressing.
Crumble tofu with your fingers into the bowl with the dressing; using a fork, mash to combine the tofu mixture.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl with the tofu mixture.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl. Stir to combine the tofu salad and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with oil and salt. Stir to combine the garlic oil.
Arrange bread on the baking sheet and drizzle with garlic oil. Place in the oven and broil until golden brown and toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds.
Separate lettuce into leaves.
To serve, divide toast between plates; top with lettuce, tofu salad, and cucumber slices. Season cucumber with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Open-Faced Muffuletta Sandwiches with Tapenade & Tomato Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave leaves off the stems of the parsley; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Finely chop the olives and sun-dried tomatoes; add to the bowl with the parsley.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the olives along with oil and spices. Stir to combine the tapenade.
Add vinegar, oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim off the ends of the cucumber; slice crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the salad bowl with the dressing.
Halve the tomatoes and add to the salad bowl; stir to combine.
Trim and thinly slice the bell pepper into rounds.
Thinly slice cheese.
In a small bowl combine mayonnaise and vinegar; stir to combine.
Spread mayo over the bread and layer with cheese, prosciutto, bell pepper, and tapenade.
To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!

name: Open-Faced Pesto Tofu Salad Sandwich with Tomato & Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Place mayo, nutritional yeast, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the creamy dressing.
Finely chop pine nuts and add to the bowl with the creamy dressing.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Crumble tofu with your fingers into the bowl; using a fork, mash to combine the tofu salad. Set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Slice tomatoes into rounds.
Arrange bread on a baking sheet. Place in the oven and broil until bread is golden brown and toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the vinaigrette.
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the vinaigrette and toss to coat.
To serve, divide toast between plates; top with dressed greens, tofu salad, and tomato slices. Season tomatoes with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Open-Faced Portobello Melts with Tomato-Onion Jam & Sweet Potato Fries

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and slice potato into ¼-inch thick strips. Place in a medium bowl and add oil and salt; toss to coat and spread out on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping once, until golden and fork-tender, about 25 minutes.

Trim and slice mushrooms into ½-inch thick pieces; place in the bowl used for the potatoes, add oil and salt, then toss to coat. Spread out on another baking sheet pan, add to the oven, and roast until soft, 10-12 minutes. Remove mushrooms to a plate to cool.
Meanwhile, heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and thinly slice the onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onions to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, medium dice tomatoes. Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.

Add tomatoes, half the basil, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes break down and the sauce thickens, 4-5 minutes. Reserve remaining basil for garnish.
Wipe the baking sheet pan used for the mushrooms dry, then cut the buns in half and place them on the pan. Toast in the oven until golden brown, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, thinly slice mozzarella.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Spread each bun half with mayo, then top with the tomato jam, mushrooms, and mozzarella. Return to the oven and bake until the cheese melts, about 5 minutes.
To serve, divide the melts and sweet potatoes between plates. Sprinkle melts with reserved basil and enjoy!

name: Open-Faced Tuna Nicoise Sandwich (Pan Bagnat) on Crispy Garlic Bread

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 425°F.
Place peas in colander and run under cold water to thaw. Transfer to a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry; set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, mayo, capers, and Dijon in a small bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain tuna and add to the bowl with the dressing. Add peas, stir to combine, and set aside.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash, dry, and slice tomato into rounds; place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes. Halve olives and add both to the bowl.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Peel and thinly slice shallot into rings. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the sandwich topping; set aside.
Peel and mince garlic.

Cut rolls in half and place, cut-side up, on a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then sprinkle with minced garlic and Italian seasoning. Place in the oven and toast, until golden and slightly crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and slice eggs into rounds.
Spoon tuna mixture over the toasted rolls; layer with sandwich topping and sliced eggs.
To serve, divide sandwiches between plates and enjoy!

name: Open-faced Vietnamese Fried Egg Banh Mi with Mango & Romaine Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place vinegar, water, sugar, and salt in a small saucepan; stir to combine. Bring the pickling liquid to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and cut carrot into thin matchsticks. Trim and thinly slice radishes.
Once the pickling liquid has come to a boil, add carrots and radishes; stir to combine, remove from heat, and set aside to cool.
Peel and mince garlic. Place half the garlic in a small bowl (reserving the rest for the next step); add mayo and stir to combine the garlic aioli. Set aside.
Juice lime into a medium bowl; add remaining garlic, oil, sugar, fish sauce, and pepper. Whisk to combine the salad dressing.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Roughly chop and add to the bowl with the dressing; set aside.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Transfer to a plate.

Thinly slice the jalapeño pepper into rounds; add to the plate with the cucumber. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the mango; place the other half on the plate with the veggies. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the eggs are cooking, chop or tear romaine into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the mango and cilantro. Toss to combine the salad.
Split rolls in half and toast, cut-side down, in another skillet over medium-high heat or in a toaster (optional).

Divide toasted rolls between plates; spread each half with a layer of garlic aioli, then top with cucumber, pickled carrots and radish, eggs, jalapeños, and cilantro. Drizzle with fish sauce and season with pepper. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Orange-Dijon Salmon Salad with Penne, Arugula, Snap Peas & Parsley

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer half to a small bowl and half to a medium bowl; set the medium bowl aside.
Zest orange into the small bowl with the parsley (set orange aside for later use), then add Dijon, oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the herb paste.
Pat salmon dry with paper towels and place on the baking sheet; spread herb paste evenly over top.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until the salmon is opaque and flakes easily with a fork, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly.

Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
While the pasta is cooking, peel and mince garlic; add to the medium bowl with the remaining parsley.
Juice reserved orange into the bowl, then add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot into half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Thinly slice snap peas crosswise and add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain in a colander and rinse under cold water to cool. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the arugula; toss to combine the salad.
When the salmon is cool enough to handle, break into large chunks with your fingers.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with salmon. Enjoy!

name: Orange-Dressed Pasta Salad with Snap Peas, Almonds, Mint, Dates & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice one orange into a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining orange for later use.)
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the orange along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices. Stir to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Mince dates. Add to the bowl with the dressing, stir once more to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, roughly chop almonds.
Once the skillet is hot, add almonds and toast, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel and separate remaining orange into segments; cut segments crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Cut snap peas into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Add to the bowl, along with feta, and stir to combine the pasta salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Orange-Glazed Chicken Thighs with Roasted Parmesan Cauliflower

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, and separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets. Transfer to a sheet pan.
Peel and mince garlic. Add ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the sauce), lemon juice, oil, salt, and pepper to cauliflower; toss to coat.
Place the cauliflower in the oven and roast until it is tender and browned on the bottom, 15-20 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until browned, 2-3 minutes per side.
Wash and halve orange. Juice ½ into a small bowl and slice the other ½ into wedges. Add honey, vinegar, and remaining garlic to bowl and mix.
Pour sauce over top chicken and add orange wedges. Cook until sauce thickens, 4-5 minutes. Flip chicken a few times to evenly coat in sauce.
Grate ⅛ cup Parmesan.
Remove cauliflower from oven, sprinkle with Parmesan, and toss to coat.
To serve, place chicken, orange slices, and cauliflower on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Orange Glazed Pork Chops with Almond Green Beans

instructions.text: Halve orange. Grate zest from 1 half into a medium bowl, then juice the half into the same bowl. Cut other half into wedges.
Peel and mince garlic. Add ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the beans), honey, salt, and pepper to bowl and mix.
Preheat broiler and place rack about 6 inches from the top.
Wash rosemary and add to bowl with marinade.
Add pork chops to marinade and turn to coat.
Place orange wedges in marinade.
Lightly coat a baking dish with olive oil. Place pork chops and orange wedges in dish, leaving rosemary in the marinade. Spoon ½ of the marinade over top the pork.

Place dish in the oven and broil until pork is golden on top, 7-9 minutes. Then flip pork and orange wedges, spoon remaining marinade over top pork, and add rosemary sprigs to the dish. Return to oven and broil until pork is cooked through, 7-9 minutes more.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash green beans and trim ends.
Add salt and green beans to boiling water. Cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Add remaining garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, almonds, salt, and pepper to green beans; toss.
Serve pork, orange wedges, and green beans on a plate and enjoy!

name: Orange Glazed Salmon with Cranberry Brussels Sprouts & Sweet Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Grate zest from the orange. (Reserve orange for later use.)
Measure out and roughly chop the cranberries.
In a medium bowl, combine vinegar, honey, olive oil, salt, pepper, cranberries, and half of the orange zest.
Remove the outer layer of leaves from the Brussels sprouts, then trim off and discard the stem ends. Halve the sprouts lengthwise and add to vinegar mixture; toss until well coated.
Transfer Brussels sprouts to one half of a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)

Peel and cut the sweet potatoes into ½-inch cubes; place in the reserved bowl. Toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Transfer to the other half of the baking sheet with the Brussels sprouts and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, halve the orange. Juice half of the orange and slice the other half into rings.
Combine orange juice with remaining zest, honey, salt, and pepper.

Line a second sheet pan with aluminum foil. Place the salmon fillets, skin-side down, in the middle of the sheet pan. Drizzle the orange juice mixture over the salmon and top with slices of orange. Place in the oven and bake until salmon is cooked through, 12-14 minutes.
To serve, divide salmon and roasted veggies between plates, spoon warm orange sauce over top. Enjoy!

name: Orange-Glazed Salmon with Sautéed Bok Choy

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the orange crosswise. Juice one half into a small bowl. Slice the other half into half-rounds and transfer to a separate small bowl.
Trim the bok choy ends and cut in half lengthwise.
Preheat a (stainless steel or cast iron) skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Carefully place the salmon, skin-side-down, in the skillet; cook until the flesh is opaque and flaky, 3 to 4 minutes per side (depending on thickness). Once done, transfer the salmon to a plate.
While the salmon cooks, trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a small bowl.

Once the salmon has been transferred, add the orange juice to the skillet and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom. Then, add ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the bok choy), soy sauce, and honey; stir to combine.
Add the orange slices and the salmon to the skillet. Move the salmon around to evenly coat in the sauce. Cook until the sauce is slightly reduced, then remove from the heat, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add coconut oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add the remaining garlic and the bok choy. Cook, tossing frequently, until the bok choy is wilted and tender, 3 to 5 minutes.
To the bok choy, add soy sauce and sesame oil. Toss to coat, then remove from the heat.
To serve, divide the salmon, bok choy, and orange slices between plates, then spoon the skillet sauce overtop. Enjoy!

name: Orange-Spiced Chicken with Snap Peas, Carrots, Couscous & Peanuts

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir; cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken to the skillet; cook, turning once, until golden brown on each side, 6-7 minutes (chicken will not be cooked through all the way).
Meanwhile, zest and juice orange into a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the orange juice.
Add water, sugar, soy sauce, ketchup, vinegar, and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Peel, trim, and thinly slice carrots. Add carrots and snap peas to the skillet with the chicken.

Add sauce to the skillet and bring to a boil over high heat (reserve bowl for later use). Reduce heat and simmer, turning thighs occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender, about 10 minutes.
While the chicken cooks, roughly chop peanuts.
Trim green onions and cut into ¼-inch pieces.

In the reserved bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth. Add to the skillet in a steady stream, while stirring constantly; continue to simmer, until sauce thickens, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chicken-vegetable sauté and couscous between plates or bowls. Top with peanuts and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Oregano Chicken Drumsticks with Greek-Style Cabbage Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat. Transfer chicken to the baking sheet and spread it out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning halfway, until chicken is golden and cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in a clean medium bowl, along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice tomato. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and halve bell pepper crosswise, then slice into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Drain and roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
To serve, divide drumsticks and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Oregano Chicken with Red Pepper Pesto Pasta

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash, dry, seed, and slice bell pepper into thin strips.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peppers and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with spices on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the peppers are done, transfer to a blender and set aside to cool.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat. Add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place chicken in the skillet and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.

Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems. Transfer half the basil to the blender with the peppers. Using a clean cutting board, roll up remaining basil leaves and thinly slice into ribbons; set aside for garnish.
Peel garlic and add to the blender.
Add pinenuts, sun-dried tomatoes, oil, salt, and crushed red pepper to the blender. Blend on high, adding water 1 tbsp at a time, if necessary, to form a semi-smooth pesto.
Drain pasta and return to the pot. Add pesto, stir to combine, and place over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, 1-2 minutes.
Meanwhile, slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and top with chicken. Garnish with reserved basil and enjoy!

name: Orzo Pasta Skillet with Cottage Cheese, Zucchini, Snap Peas & Basil

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.

Add orzo, broth, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Trim and halve snap peas. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice zucchini. Add to the bowl with the snap peas.
Zest lemon into the bowl. Cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Place cottage cheese in a strainer and set strainer in a bowl to catch the excess liquid. Set aside to drain.
When the broth is mostly absorbed, add snap peas, zucchini, lemon zest, and basil to the skillet, then stir to combine. Return to a simmer and cook until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes.
When the veggies are done, add cottage cheese to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until thickened, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Divide orzo between plates or bowls, top with reserved basil, and drizzle with oil. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Oven-Baked BBQ Chicken with Lime & Cilantro Slaw

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F and position a rack in the center. Line a sheet pan with aluminum foil (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Add ketchup, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce to the bowl with the garlic and whisk together; add the chicken drumsticks and toss to coat.
Spread the ​chicken out in a single layer on the prepared sheet pan, setting aside any marinade remaining in the bowl. Place in the oven and roast for 15 minutes.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Zest and juice the lime into a medium bowl; add oil, honey, cilantro, green onion, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into shreds. Add cabbage to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Remove the chicken from the oven, flip each drumstick, then spoon on the remaining marinade. Return chicken to the oven and bake until cooked through, about 15 minutes more.
To serve, divide slaw and chicken between plates. Enjoy!

name: Oven Roasted Chicken with Carrots, Cauliflower Rice & Green Harissa

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F and position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stems. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower and transfer to a baking dish.
In a medium bowl whisk together oil and spices to make a smooth paste. Add half of the spice paste to the baking dish with the cauliflower and stir to combine.
Pat dry the chicken breasts with paper towels and place in the bowl with the remaining spice paste; turn to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and place the chicken on top.
Grate all of the zest from the lemon; add to a small bowl and set aside. Cut the lemon into wedges and add to the pan with the chicken.

Place the chicken on the upper rack of the oven and the cauliflower rice on the rack below. Bake until the cauliflower rice has softened and the chicken is golden brown and cooked through, about 20 minutes.

While the chicken and cauliflower cook, quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeño with a spoon. Finely mince and add to the bowl with the lemon zest. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and finely mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic.
To make the harissa, add cilantro, garlic, olive oil, and spices to the bowl with the jalapeno and zest; stir to combine.
Peel the carrots; then using the peeler, run it along the carrot to make long, noodle-like strips; add carrot strips to a medium bowl with 1 tbsp of the harissa; toss to coat.
When the chicken is done, slice into strips.
To serve, divide chicken, crisp carrots, and cauliflower rice between plates. Drizzle remaining harissa over the chicken and serve with warm lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Pan con Tomate (Spanish Tomato Bread) with Ham & Spinach Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash, dry, and mince tomato; place in a small bowl. Season with salt and pepper, stir to combine, and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic.

Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet pan and drizzle oil over both sides; sprinkle tops with garlic. Place in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until toasted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven (keep oven on).
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, and Dijon in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash spinach (skip if it came pre-washed) and add to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
Spread tomato mixture over toasts and return to the oven. Bake until tomato topping is heated through, 1-2 minutes; remove from oven.
Halve olives. Cut or tear prosciutto into bite sized pieces.
To serve, divide toasts and salad between plates. Top salad with olives, prosciutto, and almonds. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Chicken Breast with Lemony Mushroom & Herb Rice

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and mince the shallot.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shallot and garlic to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the shallot and garlic cook, thinly slice the mushrooms lengthwise from cap to stem.
Add the mushrooms to the pan and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring frequently, until the mushrooms are tender and the liquid has evaporated, 5 to 7 minutes.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towels and place on a plate; generously season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Carefully place the chicken breasts in the skillet; cook until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through (check doneness with a thermometer or cut into the chicken with a knife), 6 to 8 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the chicken to plate and tent with foil to keep warm.

Once the mushrooms are tender, add the rice and broth to the pan; stir and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-18 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the chicken and rice cook, zest and juice the lemon; transfer to a small bowl.
Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon zest and juice.
Once the rice is cooked, add the lemon zest, juice, parsley, and olive oil; stir to combine.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: To serve, divide the rice and chicken between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Chicken Breast with Mushroom, Asparagus & Thyme Orzo

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch long pieces. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Add leaves to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, thyme, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.

Add broth, orzo, and Worcestershire to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed and orzo is desired firmness, 10-15 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season both sides with spices.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
To serve, divide chicken and orzo between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Chicken Breasts with Corn, Tomato & Feta Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove the husks and silks from the corn. Working one ear at a time, hold the corn vertically inside a large bowl and slice the kernels away from the cob; discard the cob. Set the bowl aside.
Halve the grape tomatoes crosswise and transfer to a medium salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Add to the salad bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season the cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the chicken cutlets in the skillet; cook until they are golden brown on the outside and cooked through in the center, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm. Cook in batches if necessary.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add the corn kernels to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until tender and lightly browned, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, add to the salad bowl.
Add the feta to the salad bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Juice the lime and add to the salad bowl.
Drizzle the salad with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
To serve, divide the chicken cutlets and salad between plates; season the salad with additional salt and pepper if desired. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Chicken with Cheesy Leek, Spinach & Zucchini Sauté

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Using a clean cutting board, trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Thinly slice crosswise and place in a medium bowl.
Roughly chop spinach. Add to the bowl with the leek.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.

Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
When the veggies are softened, add Parmesan and cream to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide cheesy veggie sauté between plates or bowls. Top with chicken and enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Chicken with Sautéed Sugar Snap Peas & Sweet Potato Mash

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.

Wash, peel, and medium dice the sweet potatoes; add to the saucepan. Once the water is boiling, cook until the potatoes are very tender when pierced with a fork, 10-15 minutes. Drain and return to saucepan.
Wash the snap peas and lemon. Cut the lemon into wedges. Peel and mince the garlic.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Melt butter in the skillet. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Add more butter to the skillet, followed by the sugar snap peas. Cook, stirring occasionally, until bright green and tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and remove from heat.
Add the remaining butter to the potatoes and season with salt and pepper. Mash with a potato masher (or a fork) until smooth.
Slice the chicken crosswise on an angle.
To serve, place the mashed potatoes, sautéed peas, and chicken on a plate. Garnish with the lemon wedges and enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Chicken Thighs with Thai-Inspired Kale, Carrot & Peanut Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the chicken thighs in the skillet; sear on both sides until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and continue to cook until they are cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes total. Once done, transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Cut out and discard the kale stems; halve the leaves lengthwise, then chop crosswise into ¼-inch-thick strips. Transfer to a large salad bowl.
Peel the carrot, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Using a box grater, coarsely grate the carrot. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Add to the salad bowl.
Juice the lime and transfer to a small bowl.
To the lime juice, add peanut butter, water, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, and crushed red pepper; whisk together.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
To serve, divide the chicken thighs and salad between plates; sprinkle the salad with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Cod with Asparagus & Carrot Purée

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel the carrots, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Cut the carrots crosswise into 1-inch chunks and transfer to a small saucepan.
Cover the carrots with hot water (from the tap) by about 1 inch; bring to a boil over high heat.
Snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears into 2-inch pieces at an angle and transfer to a bowl.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce the heat slightly and simmer until the carrots are tender when pierced with a knife, 15 to 20 minutes. Once the carrots are cooked, reserve ½ cup of cooking water and drain the carrots in a colander. Return the carrots to the saucepan.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Carefully place the cod in the skillet; cook until it is opaque throughout and flakes easily, 2 to 4 minutes per side (depending on thickness). Once done, transfer to a plate.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.

Once the cod has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet, then add the asparagus and season with salt and pepper. Cook the asparagus, stirring occasionally, until bright green and tender-crisp, 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, remove the skillet from the heat.

To the carrots, add ½ of the reserved cooked water, garlic, butter, salt, and pepper; mash with a potato masher or purée with a hand blender until smooth. Add more cooking water to thin out the mash if needed.
To serve, divide the carrot purée between plates, then top with the asparagus and cod. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Cod, Citrus Fruit, Avocado & Arugula Salad with Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and spread it out on a baking sheet pan to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Cut orange in half; zest and juice one half into a medium bowl. (Set remaining orange aside for later use.)
Juice lime into the bowl with the orange zest and juice. Add oil, honey, salt, and crushed red pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel and thinly slice shallot into rings; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut off skin and white pith from the remaining orange and the grapefruit; slice into thin rounds. Add both to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fish and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, trim, halve, and slice cucumber crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing and citrus fruit.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Once the cod is done, use your fingers to flake the fish into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl.
Add arugula to the bowl and gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide cooled rice between bowls and top with cod and citrus salad. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Falafel Patties with Tzatziki & Tomato-Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas; place on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Transfer to a large bowl and, using a potato masher or fork, mash into a paste.

Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ of the parsley to the bowl with the chickpeas and transfer the other ½ to a medium salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add ½ of the garlic to the bowl with the chickpeas and transfer the other ½ to a small bowl.
Juice the lemon; add ½ of the juice to the bowl with the chickpeas and add the other ½ to the small bowl with the garlic.
Add olive oil to a nonstick skillet and heat over medium-high heat.
To the bowl of chickpeas, add olive oil, flour, coriander, cumin, salt, and pepper; stir until well combined. Form the mixture into 6 patties and place on a plate.
Once the skillet is hot, add the patties and cook until golden brown and crispy, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Halve the grape tomatoes and add to the salad bowl with the parsley.

Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; coarsely grate ¼ of the cucumber and add to the bowl with the garlic and lemon juice, then quarter the remaining ¾ of the cucumber lengthwise and cut crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces. Add to the salad bowl.
Add yogurt to the bowl with the garlic, lemon juice, and cucumber; season with salt and pepper and mix together.
To the salad bowl, add olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper; toss to combine.
To serve, place the patties on a plate, add the salad on the side, and serve with tzatziki sauce. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Moroccan Salmon with Apricot, Plum & Cucumber Couscous Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a plate. Season with spices on the top-side.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add salmon, skin-side down, and cook until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
While the salmon is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add tahini, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into ¼-inch thick slices. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop apricots. Add to the bowl and set aside.
When the couscous is done, transfer to a baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool slightly, 5 minutes.
Add cooled couscous to the bowl with the salad and gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide couscous salad and salmon between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Pork Chop with Green Onion Butter & Cheesy Roasted Asparagus

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, spread out in an even layer, and season with spices.
Peel and mince garlic. Cut butter into small pieces. Sprinkle both over the asparagus.
Place baking sheet in oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until asparagus is fork-tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Set aside.
When the asparagus is done, remove from the oven and sprinkle with Parmesan. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from oven.

Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions and spices; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pork chops and asparagus between plates. Drizzle green onion butter over the chops and enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Pork Chop with Warm Paprika Potato, Spinach & Chive Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Quarter potatoes; place in a medium saucepan, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until fork-tender, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, Dijon, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Chop chives into small pieces. Add half to the bowl with the dressing and set aside. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
When the potatoes are done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Set aside to drain further.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
Add spinach to the bowl with the dressing, along with drained potatoes, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide pork chops and potato salad between plates. Top potato salad with reserved chives and enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Apple & Kale Sauté

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter the apple lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; cut each quarter lengthwise into 4 thin wedges and transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the pork chops in the skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate.
While the pork chops cook, trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds and leave on cutting board.
Once the pork has been transferred, add the shallot to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the apple slices to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until they are lightly browned and just tender, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the apples cook, cut out and discard the stems from each kale leaf; chop leaves crosswise into 1-inch strips.
Add the kale and ¼ cup of water to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until it is wilted, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat.
Drizzle the kale with apple cider vinegar and season with salt and pepper.
To serve, divide the pork chops and sauté between plates. Add a dollop of mustard on the side for the pork if desired. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Basil Peach Salsa & Green Beans

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Place the pork chops on a plate, rub both sides with chili powder, and season with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Wash the green beans, then trim off and discard the ends.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add the green beans and cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water. Set aside to drain further.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the pork chops and cook until browned and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and let them rest for 2-3 minutes.
Peel and mince or press the garlic.

Once the chops have been removed, reduce the heat to medium and add more coconut oil to the skillet. Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add the green beans and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, for 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Wash the peach, halve, core, and small dice; transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince the shallot; add to the bowl.
Wash and dry the basil. Pick the leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Drizzle lime juice over the salsa and season with salt and pepper. Mix well.
To serve, place pork chops on plates, spoon peach salsa over top, and add green beans to the side. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Eggplant & Tomato Sauté

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the ends of the eggplant; medium dice the eggplant (cut into ½-inch cubes) and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the pork chops in the skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the chops to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the garlic to the pan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the eggplant to the pan and season with salt and pepper; increase the heat to medium-high. Cook, stirring frequently, until just tender, 5 to 7 minutes.

While the eggplant cooks, pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves into a chiffonade by stacking them and rolling tightly into a cigar, then slicing crosswise into thin ribbons.
Add the balsamic vinegar to the eggplant and stir for about a minute.

Add the diced tomatoes and most of the basil (save a little for garnishing) to the pan; season the mixture with additional salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened, 4 to 5 minutes.
To serve, divide the pork chops and eggplant sauté between plates and garnish with the remaining basil. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Maple-Roasted Acorn Squash

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F and place the rack in the center position. Place a baking sheet in the oven to warm up.

Wash and halve the squash lengthwise; trim off the ends, then scoop out the seeds and cut the halves crosswise into ¼-inch-thick slices. Remove the baking sheet from the oven and transfer the squash to it.
Drizzle the squash with olive oil and maple syrup and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then arrange in a single layer.
Place the squash in the oven and bake until it is tender, 18 to 20 minutes.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat dry the pork chops with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the pork chops in the skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 4 to 6 minutes.
To serve, arrange the squash slices and pork chop on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Mushroom Gravy & Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and quarter the potatoes; transfer to a small saucepan.
Cover the potatoes with hot water (from the tap); bring to a boil over high heat.
Thinly slice the mushrooms and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms and onion.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce the heat to medium and cook until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife, 15 to 20 minutes. Once done, reserve about ½ cup of liquid and drain the rest. Cover the saucepan to keep warm.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the pork chops in the skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate, reserving the juices in the skillet.

Once the pork cutlets have been transferred, add butter to the skillet followed by the mushrooms, onions, and garlic; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables have softened, 5 to 7 minutes.

While the mushroom mixture cooks, using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.
Sprinkle the flour over the mushroom mixture and stir until it has been absorbed.
Add the broth and about ¾ of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing) to the skillet. Cook the mixture until the gravy is thickened, another 3 to 4 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add ½ of the reserved liquid, butter, salt, and pepper to the potatoes; mash with a potato masher until smooth. Add more liquid to thin out the mash if needed.
To serve, spoon the mashed potatoes onto a plate, place a pork chop on the side, top with the mushroom gravy, and sprinkle with the remaining parsley. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Napa Cabbage Sauté & Roasted Carrots

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F and place the rack in the center position.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel the carrots, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Cut the carrots crosswise into ¼-inch-thick rounds at a 45° angle and transfer to a baking sheet.
Drizzle the carrots with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat then spread out in a single layer.
Place the carrots in the oven and roast until they are tender when pierced with a fork, 15 to 18 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into shreds and transfer to a bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the pork chops in the skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate, reserving the juices in the skillet.
While the pork cooks, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; halve the onion lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise.
Once the pork has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet, followed by the onion. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the cabbage to the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the cabbage is lightly browned and wilted, 4 to 5 minutes.
Add the vinegar to the cabbage and cook, stirring occasionally, for another 30 seconds to 1 minute.
To serve, place the cabbage on plate, top with a pork chop, and arrange the carrots on the side. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Pear, Arugula & Walnut Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan / skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the grill pan / skillet is hot, coat the bottom with coconut oil.

Place the pork chops in the grill pan / skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate.
Transfer the arugula to a large bowl.
Quarter the pear lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; cut each section lengthwise into 4 thin wedges and transfer to the bowl with the arugula.
Roughly chop the walnuts and leave on cutting board.
In a small bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Drizzle the dressing over the arugula and pears; toss to coat.
To serve, divide the salad between plates and sprinkle with the walnuts; place the pork chops next to the salad. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Roasted Broccoli & Sweet Potato Mash

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F and position rack in the centre. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.

Wash, peel, and medium dice the sweet potatoes; add to the water in the saucepan. Once the water is boiling, cook the potatoes until tender when pierced with a fork, 8-10 minutes. Drain in a colander and return back to saucepan.
Wash the broccoli and cut into bite-sized florets; transfer to the baking sheet.
Peel and mince the garlic. Wash the lemon and grate the zest from it.
Drizzle the broccoli with olive oil and lemon juice and season with the zest, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and red pepper (optional). Toss to coat, then spread out in a single layer.
Place broccoli in the oven and roast until tender and browned, 10-15 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the pork chops with salt and pepper on both sides.
Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the pork chops and cook until browned and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and let them rest for 2-3 minutes.
Grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
Remove broccoli from oven, sprinkle with Parmesan, and toss.
Add butter to the sweet potatoes and season with salt and pepper. Mash with a potato masher (or a fork) until smooth.
Serve pork chops with sweet potato mash and broccoli on the side. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Sautéed Apples & Garlic Mashed Potatoes

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and quarter the potatoes lengthwise (into wedges); transfer to a small saucepan. Cover with hot water (from the tap) by about 1 inch and bring to a boil over high heat.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the pork chops in the skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce the heat to medium and cook until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife, 8 to 12 minutes. Once done, reserve about ½ cup of liquid and drain the rest. Cover the saucepan to keep warm.
While the pork chops cook, quarter the apples lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; cut each quarter lengthwise into 4 thin wedges.
Once the pork chops have been transferred, add the apples to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until they are lightly browned and softened, 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add ½ of the reserved liquid, butter, garlic, salt, and pepper to the potatoes; mash with a potato masher until smooth. Add more liquid to thin out the mash if needed.
To serve, divide the mashed potatoes, sautéed apples, and pork chops between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Sautéed Carrots & Cauliflower Mash

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); bring to a boil.
Trim off and discard the stem end and leaves of the cauliflower; cut the head into large florets and thinly slice the stem portion. Transfer to a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the pork chops in the skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the chops to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add the cauliflower. Bring to a boil again, then cook until the cauliflower is tender, 6 to 8 minutes. Once done, drain the cauliflower in a colander, then return back to the saucepan and cover to keep warm.
While the pork chops cook, peel the carrots, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Cut the carrots into ¼-inch-thick rounds at a 45° angle.

Once the pork chops have been transferred, add the carrots to the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the carrots are tender, 6 to 8 minutes. Once done, remove the skillet from the heat.
Add butter, salt, and pepper to the cauliflower; mash with a potato masher (or blend with a hand blender for a smoother consistency).
