instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the bowl with the kale along with corn.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add kale, corn, and garlic to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for kale to wilt before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring often, until the kale is tender and corn is warmed through, 1-2 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash, dry, and juice lemon into the skillet. Season with salt, then stir to combine. Return veggies to the bowl, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan.

When the polenta is done, add Parmesan, oil, and pepper to the pan; stir to combine. If the polenta is too firm, add hot water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until you reach a desired consistency. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: To serve, divide polenta between plates or bowls; top with kale-corn sauté and eggs. Enjoy!

name: Parsley Pork Chops with Lemon & Herb Roasted New Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Wash and dry potatoes, lemon, and parsley. Halve or quarter (depending on their size) the potatoes. Thinly slice the lemon into rounds. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic.
Transfer potatoes, lemon slices, and ½ of the parsley and garlic (save the rest for garnishing) to a sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Place in the oven and roast, tossing once halfway through, until golden and tender, 15-20 minutes.
Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Season pork with salt and pepper.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add pork and cook until browned, 2-3 minutes per side.
Add water to pan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook until pork is cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
Add remaining parsley and garlic to pan juices.
To serve, arrange pork chops and potatoes on a plate and drizzle with pan juices. Enjoy!

name: Parsnip-Apple Soup with Grilled Prosciutto & Blue Cheese Sandwich

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice parsnip and carrot; place both in a medium bowl.
Quarter, core, and small dice apple; trim and small dice celery. Add both to the bowl with the parsnip and carrot.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender, 5-6 minutes.
When the veggies are done, add broth and bring the soup to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are very soft, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, place the bread slices on a flat surface. Layer blue cheese and prosciutto over half of the slices, then cover the sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes.

Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more butter to the skillet; return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes more. Once done, transfer to a cutting board and slice in half.
When the soup is done, use a hand blender to purée the soup until smooth. Alternatively, use a potato masher to crush the veggies (the soup will be chunkier).
Divide soup between bowls and serve with sandwiches on the side. Enjoy!

name: Parsnip Latkes with Yogurt, Smoked Salmon & Avocado-Radish Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice half of the lemon into a small bowl. Juice remaining lemon into a medium bowl and set aside.
Add yogurt, salt, and pepper to the small bowl with the lemon, then stir to combine the sauce. Set aside.
Add oil, salt, and pepper to the medium bowl with the lemon juice. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Place egg, baking powder, salt, and pepper in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate parsnips. Add to the bowl with the egg mixture.
Peel, halve, and coarsely grate onion. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl, along with flour, and stir to combine the latke mixture. (Reserve remaining dill for serving.)

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; press down to form ½-inch thick fritters. Cook, flipping once, until latkes are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop (or tear) lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and thinly slice. Season with salt and pepper.
Chop or tear smoked salmon into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide latkes and salad between plates. Top latkes with yogurt sauce, salmon, and reserved dill. Top salad with avocado and enjoy!

name: Pasta e Ceci (Pasta with Chickpeas)

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Small dice the celery and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl with the celery.
Add olive oil to the pan and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the celery and onion to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables have softened, 4 to 5 minutes.
Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Slide the rosemary leaves off the sprigs; discard the sprigs and mince the leaves. Add to the garlic.
Add the garlic, rosemary, and crushed red pepper to the pan; stir and cook until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and their liquid to the pan, followed by the tomatoes and broth; stir to combine.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Season the sauce with salt and pepper, then break apart some of the tomatoes and chickpeas with a potato masher or fork. Bring the sauce to a simmer.
Add the pasta directly to the sauté pan and mix with the sauce. Cook the pasta in the sauce according to package directions, about 8 to 12 minutes.
To serve, scoop the pasta into a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Pasta Frittata with Warm Puttanesca Sauce & Basil-Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse pasta in a colander and set aside.
Wash and dry tomatoes; cut in half crosswise. Peel and thinly slice garlic. Peel and thinly slice shallot into rings.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Halve the olives lengthwise.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes, garlic, shallots, olives, capers, and spices. Cook, stirring often, until tomatoes begin to soften and make a chunky sauce, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a serving bowl and cover with foil. Reserve skillet for the frittata.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry remaining fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan; add to the bowl with the parsley along with the eggs, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine.
Return skillet (it doesn't have to be wiped clean) to medium heat.
Transfer pasta to the bowl with the eggs and stir to combine.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Pour the egg-pasta mixture into the skillet and smooth out in an even layer. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place skillet in the oven and cook until top is set and golden brown, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the oven and slice into wedges.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and thinly slice the leaves into ribbons. Add basil and arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Divide frittata and salad between plates and serve with warm puttanesca sauce. Enjoy!

name: Pasta Salad with Blue Cheese, Walnuts, Grapes, Celery & Arugula

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.

Meanwhile, transfer walnuts to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until lightly toasted, 5-7 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
While the walnuts are toasting, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve grapes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim celery and green onions; slice crosswise into thin pieces and add both to the bowl.
Mince half of the walnuts and add to the bowl. Roughly chop remaining walnuts and set aside for serving.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; add to the bowl.
Add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls; top with blue cheese and remaining walnuts. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

name: Pasta Salad with Mango, Avocado, Edamame & Sesame-Soy Dressing

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Combine soy sauce, oil, vinegar, and sugar in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel mango and slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Small dice and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice lengthwise and crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the bowl.
Using a box grater, coarsely grate the carrots; add to the bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise and cut out the core; thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl.
Trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces and add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts and add to the bowl along with the edamame.
Once pasta is done, drain and rinse under cool water. Add pasta to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Pasta Salad with Peaches, White Beans, Radish, Arugula & Goat Cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into very thin strips; add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Add beans to the bowl.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice and add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool.
Add pasta and arugula to the bowl; toss to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Crumble goat cheese over top and enjoy!

name: Pasta Skillet with Cabbage, Carrot, Bacon, Walnuts, Sage & Parmesan

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ¼-cup cooking water before draining and set aside.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve cabbage lengthwise, cut out the core, and slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot. Add to the bowl with the cabbage and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
While the bacon is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot and garlic.

Return the skillet (with drippings) to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cabbage, carrot, shallot, and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Pick sage leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the cabbage is done, add pasta, reserved pasta water, Parmesan, sage, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until water has evaporated and Parmesan has melted, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, roughly chop walnuts.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls; top with crispy bacon and walnuts. Enjoy!

name: Peach-Blueberry Pita Pizza with Ricotta, Basil & Pine Nuts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into ¼-inch thick wedges. Place in a medium bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl with the peaches. (Reserve remaining basil for later use.)
Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl along with blueberries, pine nuts, oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine.
Arrange pitas on a baking sheet pan. Spread each with ricotta, then top with the peach mixture.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until peaches are tender and pizzas are warmed through, 12-15 minutes.
When the pizzas are done, remove from the oven. Sprinkle with reserved basil, then drizzle with vinegar and honey. Cut into wedges.
To serve, divide pizzas between plates. Enjoy!

name: Peanut-Coconut Chicken Curry with Zucchini, Tomato & Cauliflower Rice

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in a small bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Once the chicken is done, add curry powder and coriander to the pan. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add chopped veggies, coconut milk, peanut butter, sugar, fish sauce, and chili-garlic sauce to the pan; stir to combine the curry and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook until chicken and veggies are cooked through, and curry has thickened, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: While the curry is cooking, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add riced cauliflower, water, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is soft, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the cauliflower rice is done, remove from heat, add cilantro, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and curry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Peanut Tofu Rice Bowl with Carrots & Broccoli

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water to the saucepan; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger; transfer to a small bowl.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and large dice the tofu (cut into ¾-inch cubes); place the cubes on paper towels or a clean towel and pat dry.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom, then add the ginger and cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the tofu to the skillet and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 8 to 10 minutes. Once done, remove skillet from the heat.
Cut the broccoli head into small, bite-sized florets and thinly slice the thicker stem portions; transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel the carrots, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Using a box grater, coarsely grate the carrots. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Once the tofu has been transferred, add the broccoli to the skillet and cook until slightly softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a small bowl (that will be used to make the dressing).
Juice the lime and add to the garlic.
Add peanut butter, soy sauce, water, honey, and crushed red pepper to the garlic, and lime juice; whisk together until well combined.
To serve, arrange rice, tofu, broccoli, and carrots in a bowl, then drizzle with the peanut sauce, and sprinkle with the sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Pear & Hot Honey-Goat Cheese Pita Pizza with Almond Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Quarter, core, and thinly slice pears. Transfer to a small baking dish.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Add leaves to the baking dish with the pear.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips. Add to the baking dish, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; stir to combine.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until pears and onions are soft and starting to brown, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
Place goat cheese, honey, and crushed red pepper in a small bowl. Mash with the back of a spoon to combine and set aside.
Arrange pitas on a baking sheet pan. Add to the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until pitas are slightly crispy, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
When the pears and onion are done, remove from oven. Spread goat cheese over each pita, top with pears and onions, then cut into wedges.
Add mixed greens and almonds to the bowl with the dressing, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pizzas and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Penne with Broccoli, Leeks & Anchovy-Parmesan Cream Sauce

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ½-cup of pasta cooking water before draining.)

Trim off the root ends and the dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leeks, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and finely chop broccoli. Add to the skillet with the leeks and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 4 minutes.
While the veggies are cooking, peel and mince garlic. Mince anchovy fillets.
Add garlic and anchovy to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant and lightly caramelized, 5 minutes more.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Add Parmesan (reserving a small handful for garnish) and cream to the skillet. Cook, stirring until the mixture is well combined, 1-2 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Add drained pasta to the skillet and stir to combine; add reserved pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency.
To serve, divide pasta between bowls and top with reserved Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Penne Pasta with Basil-Cottage Cheese Sauce, Spinach & Tomatoes

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Once the water is boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ¼-cup pasta water before draining and reserve saucepan for later use.)
While the pasta is cooking, halve grape tomatoes. Place in a medium bowl.
Roughly chop spinach. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes and set aside.
Juice lemon into a blender.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the blender (reserving a small handful for serving).
Peel garlic and add to the blender.
When the pasta is done, add reserved pasta cooking water, cottage cheese, pine nuts, oil, and spices to the blender. Blend until sauce is smooth and creamy.

Return saucepan to medium heat. Add drained pasta, tomatoes, spinach, and sauce to the pan, then stir to combine. Cook, stirring frequently, until pasta is heated through and spinach is wilted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Top with reserved Parmesan and enjoy!

name: Penne Pasta with Tuna & Tomato Sauce

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: about 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add garlic and pepper; cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until sauce begins to thicken, 5-6 minutes.
Grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
Drain tuna and stir into the sauce. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Add pasta and toss to coat.
To serve, place pasta in a bowl and sprinkle with Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Penne with Pork Sausage, Caramelized Onion, Fennel & Swiss Chard

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ½-cup of pasta cooking water before draining.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Cut fennel in half lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the fennel.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fennel, onion, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and starting to brown, 6-8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in the reserved medium bowl and stems in a small bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the chard leaves and set aside. (Set remaining parsley aside for serving.)
Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the bowl with the chard stems.
Once the fennel and onion are soft, add the sausage. Cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Add chard stems, garlic, and crushed red pepper to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add drained pasta, reserved pasta water, and vinegar to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, 1-2 minutes more.

Add chard leaves and parsley to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the greens to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chard is tender, 30-60 seconds. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and top with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Pepper Shrimp with Mushroom & Herb Couscous

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: In a medium bowl combine olive oil, crushed red pepper, black pepper, paprika, and salt. Add shrimp and toss until well coated; set aside.
In a small saucepan, bring the broth to a boil.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Add the couscous to the saucepan, stir, remove from heat, and cover. Let sit for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince the shallot. Small dice the bell pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shallot and bell pepper to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Slice the mushrooms.
Add the mushrooms and shrimp to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until the shrimp are translucent, 4-5 minutes.
Shave the leaves off the parsley; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Set aside (saving a small amount for garnish). Repeat for the thyme.
Remove skillet from heat; stir in the cooked couscous, parsley, and thyme.
To serve, divide between bowls and garnish with fresh herbs. Enjoy!

name: Peppery Steak Stir-Fry with Creamy Garlic-Coconut Cauliflower Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower and transfer to a medium saucepan.

Peel and mince garlic. Add to the saucepan along with coconut milk and salt; stir to combine. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is soft and creamy, 10-12 minutes. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Meanwhile, seed and slice peppers into strips; transfer to a medium bowl.
Cut celery crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle; add to the bowl with the peppers and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and thinly slice against the grain. Cut slices into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add steak and stir-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Add peppers and celery; continue to cook, stirring often, until veggies begin to soften, 2-3 minutes more.
Meanwhile, place broth, soy sauce, vinegar, cornstarch, and pepper in the bowl used for the veggies; whisk to combine the sauce.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Pour sauce into the skillet. Reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring often, until the sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Perfect Shrimp Pad Thai

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Then drain in a colander and rinse.
If using frozen shrimp, place in a medium bowl, cover with cold water, and set aside to thaw. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic. Peel and mince or grate ginger.

Wash carrots, green onions, and cilantro. Peel and julienne (cut into thin sticks) or coarsely grate carrots. Trim and discard root ends of green onions and chop diagonally. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
In a medium bowl, whisk together lime juice, fish sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain shrimp in a colander and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Spread out on a clean towel and pat dry.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add ginger, garlic, white parts of onions, and shrimp. Stir fry until shrimp are pink, 2-3 minutes.
Add carrots and stir fry for 1-2 minutes.
Push ingredients to the sides of the skillet and crack an egg into the middle. Let it sit for a few seconds and then scramble.

Add noodles and pour in sauce. Stir fry until noodles get sticky and are well coated. Then add remaining green onions and almost all the cilantro (save a little for garnishing). Remove from heat and toss with the noodles until well combined.
Cut remaining ½ lime into wedges. Roughly chop peanuts.
To serve, toss pad thai onto a plate and garnish with peanuts, cilantro, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Persian Herb Frittata with Flatbread, Tomatoes & Lemon-Garlic Yogurt

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off the root ends and the dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Cut into ¼ inch thick pieces.
Peel and small dice onion.
Peel and mince garlic. Place ⅓ of the garlic in a small bowl and reserve for later.
Preheat an overproof skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leek, onion, and remaining garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and lightly golden, 7-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Crack eggs into a medium bowl. Add baking powder and spices; whisk thoroughly to combine.
Shave the leaves off the stems of the cilantro, dill, and parsley; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to the bowl with the eggs.
When the leeks are done, transfer them to the bowl with the eggs and stir quickly to combine.

Return skillet to the stove over medium heat. Add more oil and swirl to coat. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and smooth out in an even layer. Cook, undisturbed, until the bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add yogurt and spices; whisk to combine.
Place skillet in the oven and cook until top is set and golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Remove from the oven and slice into wedges.
Toast flatbread and cut into wedges. Cut tomatoes into wedges.
To serve, divide frittata, flatbread, and tomatoes between plates. Drizzle olive oil over tomatoes and season with salt and pepper; enjoy with a side of garlicky yogurt!
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

name: Peruvian-Style Steak, Sweet Potato & Tomato Bake with Cilantro Yogurt

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and cut each sweet potato lengthwise into 6-8 wedges, depending on size, then transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the baking sheet with the sweet potato.
Cut tomatoes into wedges and add to the baking sheet.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the baking sheet.
Drizzle veggies with oil and soy sauce, then season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies start to soften, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl, along with yogurt, and stir to combine. Set aside.
Pat steak dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch thick slices. Place in another small bowl, drizzle with additional soy sauce and oil, then season with pepper. Toss to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: When the veggies are starting to soften, remove from oven. Add steak (and any marinade in the bowl) to the baking sheet, stir to combine, and return to the oven. Continue to bake until veggies are fork-tender and steak is cooked through, 8-10 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates; top with cilantro yogurt. Enjoy!

name: "Philly Cheesesteak" Lettuce Wraps with Bell Peppers & Onions

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with Worcestershire, oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat steak dry with paper towels, then slice against the grain into very thin strips. Add to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Place in another medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the bell peppers. Set aside.

Once the skillet is hot, add steak strips and marinade. Cook to desired doneness, about 1 minute per side for medium-rare. Transfer steak to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; stir-fry until veggies are fork-tender, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Add veggies to the baking sheet, spreading them over the steak, then top with cheese. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until cheese melts, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Separate lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Fill with cheesy steak and veggies. Enjoy!

name: Philly Cheesesteaks with Quick-Pickled Pepper Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil. Turn on overhead exhaust fan or open a window (this may get a little smoky).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Seed and slice bell peppers into thin strips, transfer to the baking sheet, and drizzle with oil. Place in the oven and broil, until peppers are soft and lightly charred around the edges, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese and set aside.
Combine vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Transfer the cooked peppers to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine; set aside.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on the baking sheet used for the peppers. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place steak in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until desired doneness, 8-10 minutes for medium. Remove from oven and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, whisk together flour, spices, and half of the milk in a small saucepan. Heat over medium, whisking frequently, until thick, 1-2 minutes. Pour in remaining milk and whisk to combine.
Once the milk is steaming, remove from heat, and add the cheese. Continue whisking until the cheese has melted, creating a thick sauce, 2-3 minutes; set aside.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the peppers and stir to combine.
Split and toast the buns, if desired.
Thinly slice steak against the grain. Fill buns with steak and drizzle with cheese sauce.
To serve, divide cheesesteaks and mixed greens between plates. Top greens with roasted peppers and dressing. Enjoy!

name: Pineapple, Beef & Ginger Stir-Fry with Cauliflower Rice

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off the ends from the pineapple and cut off the skin, then cut lengthwise into 2 sections and cut out the cores; cut each section into bite-sized chunks and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger; transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the stem end and leaves of the cauliflower; cut the head into larger pieces and, using a box grater, coarsely grate the pieces into rice-like texture.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle and transfer to a small bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add the grated cauliflower to the skillet and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until it has softened, 4 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer to a bowl and tent with foil to keep warm.
While the cauliflower cooks, pat dry the steak with paper towels, then thinly slice crosswise (against the grain) into bite-sized strips.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the cauliflower has been transferred, increase the heat to medium-high.
Add more coconut oil and the steak slices to the skillet; cook, tossing occasionally, until the pieces are nicely browned, 3 to 4 minutes total. Once done, transfer to a bowl.
While the steak cooks, in a small bowl, whisk together cornstarch with 2 tsp of water, then add soy sauce, rice vinegar, and honey and whisk again.
Once the steak has been transferred, add more coconut oil and the ginger to the skillet; cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the pineapple to the skillet; cook until heated through, 30 seconds to 1 minute.

Return the steak to the skillet, add ½ of the green onions (save the rest for garnishing), and pour the sauce over top. Stir-fry until the steak slices and pineapple chunks are coated in the sauce and the sauce has thickened, 1 to 2 minutes.
To serve, place the cauliflower rice into a bowl, top with the stir-fry, and garnish with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Pineapple Pork Fried Rice with Carrot, Edamame, Celery & Cilantro

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and slice green onion and celery crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add both to the bowl with the pineapple.
Peel, trim, and slice carrot crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds; add to the bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on the cutting board; thinly slice crosswise into bite-sized strips, then season with salt and pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add pork and stir-fry until browned and cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
When the pork is done, return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pineapple, veggies, and edamame; stir-fry until veggies are fork-tender, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the veggies are done, add cooked rice, pork (with any accumulated juices), and soy sauce to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring constantly, until combined and heated through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat, add cilantro, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide fried rice between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Pineapple Pork Skewers with Bell Pepper-Tomato Salad & Rice

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and large dice the flesh. Place in a medium bowl.
Pat the pork dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl with the pineapple along with oil and spices; stir to coat.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats up, thread pineapple and pork onto skewers, alternating ingredients; place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the pork and pineapple pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.
Once the pan is hot, add the skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until pineapple is golden brown and pork is cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Juice half of the lime into the bowl with the cilantro. (Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.)
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl along with oil, honey, and spices. Stir to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice tomato. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
Divide rice, salad, and skewers between plates. Serve with lime wedges on the side. Enjoy!

name: Pineapple-Salmon Teriyaki Stir-Fry with Broccoli & Green Onion

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut skin off pineapple, core, and medium dice (cut into ¾-inch cubes). Add a ½ cup diced pineapple to a blender; set remaining pineapple aside in a small bowl.
Peel the garlic and ginger; add to the blender along with soy sauce, honey, vinegar, and pepper. Blend on high until smooth. Set teriyaki sauce aside.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin. If you don’t have a tail end, start at one corner of the fillet and work your way in until the knife is between the skin and flesh.
Cut salmon into bite-sized pieces.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add salmon to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until almost cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Return skillet to the stove over medium heat. Add more oil to melt. Add broccoli and cook, stirring often, until slightly softened, 1-2 minutes.
In a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.

Add diced pineapple and teriyaki sauce to the skillet. Increase heat to high and add the cornstarch slurry in a steady stream while stirring quickly. Cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes.
Add salmon back to the skillet; gently stir to combine and heat through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
To serve, divide rice and salmon stir-fry between bowls. Garnish with green onion and enjoy!

name: Pinto Bean-Bell Pepper Bowl with Fried Egg, Avocado & Cilantro

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the baking sheet with the peppers. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are browned and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beans, garlic, cumin, and salt; cook, mashing with the back of a spoon, until beans are broken up slightly and warmed through, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Set half aside for serving.

When the beans are done, add water, hot sauce, and remaining cilantro to the skillet, then stir to combine. Transfer to a medium bowl and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)

Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat; add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat, then season with salt and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: While the eggs are cooking, cut lime into wedges.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin pieces.
Divide beans and roasted veggies between bowls; top each bowl with an egg, avocado, and the reserved cilantro. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Pinto Bean, Goat Cheese & Corn Quesadilla with Creamy Tex-Mex Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add beans, onion, garlic, corn, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until corn is golden, 6-8 minutes; remove from heat.
Meanwhile, juice lime into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic; add to the bowl with the lime juice along with yogurt, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl and set aside. (Reserve remaining cilantro for the next step.)

To assemble the quesadillas, lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide bean and corn filling between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla. Crumble goat cheese over filling and sprinkle with remaining cilantro; fold in half to close. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, cut or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies. Toss to combine the salad.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates; serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Pinto Bean "Hummus" Toasts with Alfalfa Sprouts & Lemon-Dijon Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Juice half of the lemon into a blender (reserve remaining lemon for later use).
Drain and rinse beans; add to the blender.

Peel garlic. Add to the blender along with tahini, water, oil, and spices. Blend the mixture on high for several minutes until smooth, scraping down the sides of the blender as needed. Add additional water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach a smooth consistency. Set the hummus aside.
Juice remaining lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Spread toasted bread with hummus, then top with sprouts.
To serve, divide toasts and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pistachio Crusted Chicken with Lemon-Dill Carrots & Snap Peas

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Finely chop pistachios and place in a medium bowl. Add spices and stir to combine the coating.
Crack egg into another medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Working one by one, dip chicken cutlets into the egg, shake off excess, then dredge in the pistachio coating, pressing to adhere. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until the chicken is golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into thin rounds.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the carrots and snap peas; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 4 minutes.
Zest lemon into the skillet and add spices; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender, 2 minutes more.
Meanwhile, cut lemon into wedges for serving.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates. Squeeze lemon over the chicken and enjoy!

name: Pistachio-Crusted Halibut with Zucchini Fritters & Lemony Yogurt Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Transfer to a colander and sprinkle with salt. Place the colander in a bowl to catch the excess moisture and set aside.
Meanwhile, zest and juice half of the lemon into a small bowl. Cut remaining lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Add yogurt to the bowl with the lemon, along with spices, and stir to combine the sauce. Add water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set aside.
Mince pistachios. Place in another small bowl along with bread crumbs, oil, and salt; stir to combine the coating.

Pat halibut dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on the baking sheet; season the top side with salt and pepper. Spread the fish with mayo, then sprinkle evenly with the coating, pressing gently to adhere.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until halibut is cooked through, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated zucchini, then transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the zucchini along with egg, flour, baking powder, pepper, and salt. Stir to combine the batter.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; press down to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Divide fish and fritters between plates; drizzle yogurt sauce over fritters. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Pistachio-Crusted Salmon with Orange, Radish, Onion & Mint Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Mince pistachios. Place in a small bowl along with bread crumbs, oil, and salt; stir to combine the coating.

Pat salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on the baking sheet; season the top side with salt and pepper. Spread the fish with mayo, then sprinkle evenly with the coating, pressing gently to adhere.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until salmon is cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice half of the lemon into a medium bowl. Cut the remaining lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Add additional oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl.
Cut off skin and white pith from oranges; slice between the membranes to release segments. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and gently stir to combine the salad.
Divide salmon and salad between plates; serve with lemon wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!

name: Pistachio-Kale Pesto Pasta with Potato, Green Beans & Parmesan

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into 3-inch pieces; transfer to a large bowl.
Peel and dice potato into ¾-inch cubes.
Trim and discard the ends of green beans, then cut in half.

Once the water in the pot comes to a boil, uncover, add salt and kale, and stir. Cook until bright green and wilted, 30-60 seconds. Transfer kale to a colander using a slotted spoon. Reserve bowl for later.
Once the water in the pot returns to a boil, add potatoes and pasta; stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel garlic; transfer to a blender along with cooked kale, water, pistachios, oil, and salt.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; add to the blender. Juice lemon into the blender.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add half to the blender; set the rest aside for garnish. Blend on high, adding 1 tbsp of water at a time, if needed, until smooth; transfer pesto to the reserved bowl.
Add green beans to the pot with the pasta during the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Roughly chop additional pistachios.
Drain the pasta and vegetables, then transfer to the bowl with the pesto; stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between bowls or plates. Garnish with reserved Parmesan, pistachios, and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Pita "Nachos" with Fresh Veggies, Hummus, Garlic Yogurt, Feta & Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Place pita breads on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the board, cut each pita in half horizontally to separate the two sides; cut or tear the bread into 2-inch pieces and place on a baking sheet pan.
Zest lemon into a small bowl (set lemon aside for later use). Add oil and spices to the bowl; stir to combine the herb oil.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Spoon herb oil over the pita, toss with your hands to coat, then spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until the pita chips are crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from the oven. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in the reserved bowl along with yogurt, water, vinegar, and spices; whisk to combine the garlic yogurt and set aside.
Peel additional garlic and place in a blender.
Juice half of the lemon into the blender with the garlic (reserve the other half of the lemon for the salad dressing).
Drain and rinse chickpeas; add to the blender along with water, tahini, and spices. Blend on high until hummus is smooth; set aside.
Trim and small dice cucumber; small dice tomato. Place both in a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the cucumber and tomato; stir to combine the veggie topping and set aside.
Juice remaining lemon into another medium bowl. Add oil, honey, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing. Add mixed greens and toss to combine the salad.
To assemble the "nachos," spoon hummus, garlic yogurt, and veggie topping over the pita chips. Sprinkle with feta.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide "nachos" and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: "Pizza Salad" with Sausage, Mushrooms, Mozzarella & Tomato Dressing

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place water, oil, vinegar, tomato paste, maple syrup, Dijon, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Place on a plate.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts. Add to the plate with the mushrooms.
Cut mozzarella into bite-sized pieces. Add to the plate.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the plate and set aside.
Transfer cooked sausages to the cutting board and slice crosswise into thin rounds.
To serve, divide mixed greens between plates or bowls. Top with mushrooms, artichokes, mozzarella, basil, and sausage. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: Poached Chicken Salad with Cranberries, Pistachios & Garlic Croutons

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place chicken, salt, and pepper in a medium saucepan and cover with water by 1-inch; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate to cool.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl. Add oil and spices, then whisk to combine.
Cut bread into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl; toss to coat. Transfer to a baking sheet pan. Reserve bowl for later use.
Place croutons in the oven and cook, tossing halfway through, until golden and crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Trim and medium dice celery; place in the reserved bowl.
Zest lemon into the bowl with the celery.
Roughly chop pistachios; add to the bowl along with yogurt, cranberries, and spices. Stir to combine and set aside.
Juice the lemon into another medium bowl. Add oil and whisk to combine the dressing.
Add mixed greens and croutons to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine.
Using two forks, shred chicken and add to the bowl with the yogurt mixture. Mix well to combine.
To serve, place salad greens on a plate and top with chicken salad. Enjoy!

name: Poached Halibut with Roasted Bok Choy & Acorn Squash in Coconut Broth

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve acorn squash lengthwise, trim off the ends, then scoop out the seeds. Cut into ½-inch thick wedges and place on a baking sheet pan.

Trim the bok choy ends and cut in half lengthwise; add to the baking sheet with the squash. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat, then spread the veggies out in a single layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping veggies halfway through, until fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, pat the halibut dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a plate; season the top-side with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot into half-moons.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, shallot, and chili-garlic sauce; cook, stirring frequently, until starting to soften, 1-2 minutes.
Add broth, coconut milk, sugar, and fish sauce to the skillet. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to a simmer.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Place halibut fillets, skin-side down, in the broth. Spoon some of the broth over the tops of the fillets, then cover the skillet; poach the fish until opaque and cooked through, about 5 minutes, depending on the thickness of each fillet. Remove from heat.
While the fish is cooking, cut lime into wedges.
Divide roasted veggies, halibut, and coconut broth between bowls. Serve with lime wedges and enjoy!

name: Poached Tofu with Scallion-Ginger Sauce, Noodles, Carrots & Bok Choy

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the short side to make 2 smaller "blocks." Place in a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until tofu is warmed through, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the water in the pot is boiling, remove from heat. Carefully pour water into a medium, heat-proof bowl, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes (or prepare according to package instructions). Drain in a colander and set aside. (Reserve pot for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic along with soy sauce, oil, sugar, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the sauce and set aside.
Trim and separate bok choy into leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel and trim carrots; run the peeler along each carrot to make long, noodle-like strips. Add to the bowl with the bok choy.
Return pot to medium-high heat. Once hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add bok choy, carrot, and soy sauce. Stir-fry until veggies are fork-tender, 3-4 minutes.
Add drained noodles to the pot and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 1 minute more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide noodles and veggies between bowls. Top with poached tofu and drizzle with sauce. Enjoy!

name: Polenta with Goat Cheese, Lemony Asparagus, Leeks, Peas & Pine Nuts

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta in a thin steady stream, while whisking, until the polenta is incorporated; add salt. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and the texture is creamy, 15-25 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add pine nuts and cook, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Trim off the root end and the dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Thinly slice crosswise.
Return skillet to medium-low heat, add butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leeks and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until just beginning to brown, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 2-inch long pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Cut snap peas crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the asparagus.
When the leeks are done, increase heat to medium-high, then add veggies and salt to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until bright green and tender, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Zest and juice lemon into the skillet.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the skillet, along with cooled pine nuts, and stir to combine.

When the polenta is done, crumble goat cheese into the pan. Add butter and pepper, then stir to combine. If the polenta is too firm, add hot water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until you reach a desired consistency. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cheesy polenta between plates or bowls. Top with veggies and enjoy!

name: Polenta with Goat Cheese, Prosciutto, Swiss Chard & Sun-Dried Tomatoes

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta in a thin steady stream, while whisking, until the polenta is incorporated; add salt. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and the texture is creamy, 15-25 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry chard; fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves into bite-sized pieces and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in a medium bowl and stems in a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the bowl with the stems and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add prosciutto and cook until crispy, about 1 minute per side. Remove to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)

Return skillet to medium heat, add butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chard stems, garlic, salt, and pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Add to the skillet and stir to combine.

Add chard leaves to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through and tender, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place in the reserved small bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl with the basil and stir to combine.
When the polenta is done, add butter, pepper, and half of both the basil and goat cheese to the pan, then stir to combine (reserve remaining basil and goat cheese for serving).
To serve, divide polenta and Swiss chard sauté between bowls. Crumble prosciutto over top, then sprinkle with reserved basil and goat cheese. Enjoy!

name: Popcorn-Style Shrimp with Cocktail Sauce & Chopped Veggie Salad

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with foil and coat with a thin layer of oil.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Combine mayo and spices in a medium bowl.
Place breadcrumbs in a second medium bowl.

Toss shrimp in the mayo mixture to coat. Working in batches, transfer shrimp to the breadcrumb mixture and turn to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Transfer shrimp to the prepared baking sheet in a single layer.
Place shrimp in the oven and bake 10 minutes, then flip and cook until golden and crisp, 5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Juice lemon into a small bowl. Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl.
Add ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, sugar, and spices to the bowl with the garlic and lemon; stir to combine the cocktail sauce and set aside.
Place mayo, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim cucumber, halve lengthwise, and thinly slice crosswise on an angle. Add to the bowl.
Seed and slice the bell pepper into thin strips; add to the bowl, along with the mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad.
Divide shrimp and salad between plates. Serve with cocktail sauce on the side and enjoy!

name: Pork-Apple Burger with Spiced Mayo & Creamy Cranberry Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter and core apple. Thinly slice half the apple and add to the bowl with the dressing; toss to coat and set aside.
Coarsely grate the other half of the apple and transfer to another medium bowl.
Add pork, bread crumbs, Dijon, and spices to the bowl with the grated apple; use your hands to thoroughly combine. Form into 2 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Place burger patties on the grill and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and grill an additional 3-4 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, place mayo and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the spiced mayo.
If desired, place buns, cut-side down, on the grill to toast, 1-2 minutes.
While toasting the buns, add mixed greens and cranberries to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
Place burgers on bottom of buns, spread with spiced mayo, and close with tops.
To serve, divide burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pork & Asparagus Stir Fry with Basmati Rice

instructions.text: Rinse the rice in a colander and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine and whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, sesame oil, and cornstarch.
Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until the liquid is absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Remove from the heat and let the rice stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Thinly slice the pork chops crosswise into strips; transfer to a medium bowl.
Pour about ½ of the sauce over the pork strips (save the rest for later). Toss the pork until coated with the sauce.
Add water to the remaining sauce in the small bowl and mix.
Wash and dry the cutting board and the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears on an angle into 2-inch pieces. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger; transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the ginger.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the pork strips to the skillet and cook until browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Once the pork has been transferred, add more oil to the skillet.
Add the garlic and ginger; cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the asparagus and cook, stirring occasionally, until bright green and tender-crisp, 3 to 4 minutes.
Return the pork to the skillet and pour in the remaining sauce; stir to combine. Cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce is thickened, 1 to 2 minutes.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls and top with the stir fry. Enjoy!

name: Pork-Bell Pepper Quesadilla with Cilantro Crema & Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
