instructions.text: Juice lime and divide between a small and medium bowl. (Set medium bowl aside for the salad.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the small bowl with the lime juice along with yogurt and spices, then whisk to combine the crema. Set aside.
Trim and halve green onions crosswise. Place in another medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the green onions.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, pork, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender and pork is just cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese.

To assemble the quesadillas, lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide pork and veggies between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla. Top with cheese and fold in half to close. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, add Dijon, honey, and salt to the medium bowl with the lime juice, then whisk to combine the dressing. Add mixed greens and toss to coat.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad and lime crema on the side. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chop with Basil-Goat Cheese Butter, Green Beans & Cherry Tomatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a small bowl (reserve lemon for later use).
Add goat cheese and butter to the bowl with the lemon zest; set aside to soften.
Trim green beans; transfer to a baking sheet pan along with the tomatoes.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion crosswise into half-moons; add to the baking sheet with the other veggies.
Juice lemon over the veggies and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Cut additional butter into small pieces and sprinkle over the veggies; place baking sheet in the oven and roast, tossing once, until veggies are fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.

While the chops are cooking, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and mince; add to the bowl with the softened butter and goat cheese. Use the back of a spoon to mash and combine the basil-goat cheese butter.
To serve, divide pork chops and roasted veggies between plates; top chops with basil-goat cheese butter. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chop with Blackberry Sauce, Sweet Potato, Asparagus & Pistachios

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potato. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until sweet potato starts to soften, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears in half crosswise. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Once the sweet potato is softened, remove baking sheet from the oven. Add asparagus, toss to combine, and spread back out into an even layer. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are fork-tender, 7-8 minutes more. Remove from oven.

While the veggies are roasting, return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat. Zest and juice lemon into the skillet, then add blackberries, water, honey, pepper, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until blackberries, soften, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop pistachios. Set aside.

Once the blackberries are soft, use a potato masher (or fork) to crush the blackberries and combine the sauce. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Thinly slice pork chops.
To serve, divide veggies and pork between plates. Top pork with sauce and sprinkle veggies with pistachios. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chop, Dijon Roasted Cabbage & Arugula-Pear Salad with Blue Cheese

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Place Dijon, oil, water, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the Dijon sauce.

Halve cabbage lengthwise and cut out the core; slice crosswise into 1-inch thick wedges. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, then drizzle both sides of the cabbage with Dijon sauce. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, gently flipping cabbage halfway through, until tender and golden around the edges, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels. Place on a plate and season both sides with salt and pepper.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
While the chops are cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, and salt in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice pear; add to the bowl.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl.
Just before serving, add arugula and blue cheese to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide roasted cabbage, chops, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chop with Honey-Dijon Apples, Parsley Potatoes & Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Halve potatoes, place in a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and return to the saucepan; cover to keep warm.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
While the chops are cooking, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Quarter and core apple, then slice into ¼-inch thick wedges; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.

When the chops are done, return the skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-low heat. Add onion, garlic, and apple; cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion and apple are soft, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place vinegar, mayo, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise and add to the bowl with the dressing; set aside.
When the onion and apple are soft, add broth, Dijon, and honey to the skillet; bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Return the saucepan with potatoes to low heat; add butter, parsley, and salt. Cook, stirring frequently, until butter and parsley coat the potatoes, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add mixed greens to bowl with dressing and tomatoes; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork chops, apple sauté, potatoes, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chop with Jalapeño Basil Salsa & Strawberry-Tomato Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Juice lime into a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and shallot; add to the bowl with the lime juice along with oil, honey, and salt.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems, discard stems, and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salsa; set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer chops to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and quarter strawberries lengthwise; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes; add to the bowl along with the arugula and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork chops and salad between plates; spoon salsa over the chops and enjoy!

name: Pork Chop & Pinto Bean Salad (Cowboy Caviar) with Cilantro Dressing

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Juice lime into a medium bowl. Add oil, honey, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with spices on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Small dice tomato and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl, along with the beans, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chops and bean salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chop with Spiced Dates, Prosciutto, Green Beans & Sweet Potato

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.

Wash and dry sweet potato, then peel and large dice; place on a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer on one half of the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until sweet potatoes start to soften, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; mince dates. Place both in a small bowl along with oil and spices; stir to combine the date topping and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add chops and cook until golden, about 2 minutes per side. Once golden, transfer to a clean plate (the pork will not be cooked all the way through). Reserve skillet with juices for later use.
Divide date topping between chops and layer each with two slices of prosciutto.

Remove sweet potatoes from the oven and toss; add layered pork chops to the other half of the baking sheet. Return baking sheet to the oven and roast until sweet potatoes are tender and chops are cooked through, 8-10 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim green beans.
Peel and mince additional garlic.

Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom; add beans and salt. Stir-fry until lightly charred and fork-tender, 3-4 minutes. Add garlic and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds; remove from heat.
To serve, divide layered pork chops, sweet potatoes, and green beans between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chop with Warm Fennel, Radish & Asparagus Salad over Lemon Yogurt

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a small bowl. Add yogurt, Dijon, and spices, then whisk to combine the yogurt sauce. Set aside.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice into thin strips. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Trim and halve radishes lengthwise. Add to the baking sheet with the fennel, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer. Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until starting to soften, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic. Place in another small bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the garlic oil.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Using your hands, rub with the garlic oil on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.

When the veggies have started to soften, remove baking sheet from oven. Add asparagus, toss to combine, and spread back out in an even layer. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are fork-tender, 10-12 minutes more. Remove from oven. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl.
Place peas in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl with the basil.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven. Transfer to the bowl with the basil and peas, along with almonds, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide yogurt sauce between plates or bowls, then top with veggies and pork chops. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chop with Warm Peach, Bell Pepper, Jalapeño & Cilantro Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime along with oil, sugar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and thinly slice shallot; add to the bowl with the dressing.

Thinly slice jalapeño into rounds and add to the bowl; stir to combine and set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer chops to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
While the chops are cooking, trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place in a small bowl.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice and add to the bowl with the bell pepper.

Return the skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper and peaches; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and lightly charred in spots, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop almonds.
When the bell pepper and peaches are done, transfer to the bowl with the dressing; stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chops and peach salad between plates. Sprinkle with almonds and enjoy!

name: Pork Chops with Blackberry Sauce & Lemon Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash blackberries.
Season pork generously with salt and pepper.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Place pork on grill/skillet and cook until cooked through, 4-6 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Heat a small saucepan over medium heat.

Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add blackberries, vinegar, honey, and salt. Reduce heat to medium-low and, stirring occasionally, cook until sauce thickens and some of the berries collapse, 10-12 minutes.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Grate 1 tsp of lemon zest. In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together lemon zest and juice, olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper.
amounts: zest and juice of ½ lemon
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry arugula. Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
Shave or grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
To serve, place pork chops on a plate and spoon blackberry sauce over top. Add salad on the side and garnish with Parmesan and pine nuts. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chops with Brussels Sprouts, Apple & Almond Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Place pork chops in a small baking dish. Season with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, whisk together maple syrup, Dijon, and vinegar.

Spoon about ½ of the sauce over the pork chops. Place in the oven and bake for 10 minutes. Then flip pork, spoon remaining sauce over top, and continue to bake until pork is cooked through, another 10-15 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. Wash brussels sprouts, trim root ends, and chop into shred-like pieces.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.

Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add brussels sprouts and, stirring occasionally, cook until softened, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool.
In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Wash, core, and cut apple into thin medium pieces. Add to bowl with dressing.
Roughly chop almonds and add to bowl.
Add brussels sprouts to bowl and toss salad.
To serve, place pork chops and salad on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chops with Brussels Sprouts, Blueberry & Parmesan Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Remove the outer layer of leaves from the Brussels sprouts, then trim off and discard the stem ends; halve the sprouts lengthwise, then thinly slice each half crosswise. Transfer to a large salad bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the pork chops in the skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds.
Once the pork chops have been transferred, add the shallot to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the Brussels sprouts to the skillet and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring frequently, until bright green and just tender, 2 to 3 minutes. Once done, return back to the salad bowl.
Shave or coarsely grate about ¼ cup of Parmesan. Transfer to a small bowl.
Add the blueberries to the salad bowl.
Juice the lemon and add to the salad bowl; toss to combine.
To serve, divide the pork chops and salad between plates; top the salad with the Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chops & Cabbage with Mustard Cream Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork chops and sear to develop a nice brown crust on one side, about 4 minutes. Flip and cook until other side is browned, about 3 more minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice the onion.
Once you have removed the pork chops, reduce heat to medium, and add the onion. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Wash and dry cabbage. Trim off and discard root end; halve lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise.
Add cabbage to the skillet along with butter, salt, and pepper. Cook until tender, 2-3 minutes. Transfer the vegetables to a plate and cover with foil.
Wash and juice lemon into the skillet. Add cream and mustard; stir until well combined.

Add pork chops back to the pan; simmer over medium-low heat, spooning sauce over chops occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly, 3-4 minutes. Ensure pork chops are cooked through before removing from heat.
To serve, divide cabbage between plates, top with pork chops, and drizzle with sauce. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chops with Cherry Balsamic Sauce, Couscous & Green Beans

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Place couscous in a medium bowl.

Pour broth in a small saucepan, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from heat, pour broth into the bowl with the couscous, and stir. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Peel and mince garlic.
Return saucepan to medium heat. Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add shallot and garlic to the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add cherries, vinegar, and salt to the saucepan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cherries have softened and balsamic is slightly reduced, 8-10 minutes. Cover and remove from heat.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place chops in the skillet and cook, flipping once, until browned and cooked through, 6-7 minutes. Remove to a clean plate and cover with foil.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim green beans.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green beans and season with salt and pepper. Cook, tossing frequently, until bright green and tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Slice pork chops against the grain.
To serve, divide couscous, green beans, and pork chops between plates. Top chops with cherry sauce and enjoy!

name: Pork Chops with Pears & Blue Cheese

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter the pears lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; cut each quarter lengthwise into 4 thin wedges.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; halve lengthwise, then cut the halves into 4 wedges.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Halve the pork chops horizontally to form thin fillets; pat dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the pork fillets in the skillet; cook until golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Once the pork has been transferred, reduce the heat to medium. Add the pears and onions to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until they are softened and lightly browned, 4 to 6 minutes.
Add broth to the skillet and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return the pork fillets to the skillet and arrange among the pears and onions.
Top the mixture with blue cheese and continue to cook until the pork is cooked through and the cheese begins to melt.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide the pork and pear mixture between plates and spoon the pan sauce overtop. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chops with Raspberry-Coconut Salsa, Snap Peas & Garlic Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water. Set aside to drain.
Peel and mince garlic; trim and cut green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, green onion, rice, and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Add broth to the saucepan and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer chops to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
While the chops are cooking, roughly chop raspberries and place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl with the raspberries.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with coconut, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper; gently stir to combine the salsa and set aside.

Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium heat. Add snap peas, water, salt, and pepper; stir to combine, cover, bring to a simmer, and cook until just fork-tender, about 3 minutes. Uncover and continue to cook until liquid has evaporated, 1 minute more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, chops, snap peas, and raspberry-coconut salsa between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chops with Sage Butter, Roasted Asparagus & Lemon-Yogurt Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut butter into small pieces and place in a small bowl; set aside.
Quarter potatoes, transfer to a baking sheet pan, and spread out in a single layer. Dot half of the butter over the potatoes, then season with salt and pepper. (Set remaining butter aside.)
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, tossing halfway though, until potatoes are fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest lemon into a medium bowl; add yogurt, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the lemon-yogurt sauce and set aside.
Cut the lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus. Transfer to another baking sheet; dot with remaining butter and season with salt and pepper.
Add asparagus to the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until fork-tender, 10-12 minutes.
While the veggies are roasting, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil; set aside.
Meanwhile, pick sage leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Return skillet to medium-high heat and add more butter; stir constantly until the butter is melted and golden brown, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the sage.
When the potatoes are done, add to the bowl with the lemon-yogurt sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide potatoes, asparagus, and pork chops between plates. Top chops with sage butter and a squeeze of lemon. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chops with Sautéed Apples & Brussels Sprouts

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and small dice the shallot (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the pork chops in the skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate.
While the pork chops cook, trim off and discard the stems ends of the Brussels sprouts, then remove the outer layer of leaves; quarter the sprouts lengthwise.
Once the pork has been transferred, add the shallot to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.

Add the Brussels sprouts to the skillet; cook until they have a nice sear on one side, 4 to 6 minutes. Then, give them a stir and continue cooking until they are browned all over and tender on the inside, another 4 to 6 minutes.
While the Brussels sprouts cook, quarter the apple lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; large dice the apple (cut into ¾-inch cubes).
In the last few minutes of cooking time, add the apples to the Brussels sprouts; cook, stirring occasionally, until the apples are softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Drizzle the sprouts and apples with apple cider vinegar and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
To serve, divide the pork chops and the sautéed Brussels sprouts and apples between plates. Add a dollop of Dijon to the side for dipping the pork if desired. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chops with Sautéed Bell Peppers & Creamy Polenta

instructions.text: Add hot water (from the tap) to a small saucepan; cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter the bell peppers lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Cut the quarters lengthwise into ¼-inch-thick strips and transfer to a medium bowl.

Once the water is boiling, slowly add the polenta in a thin steady stream while whisking constantly until all the polenta is incorporated into the liquid. Turn the heat down to low and continue whisking until the polenta has thickened. Cover the polenta and cook for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes or so.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the pork chops in the skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate.
Once the pork chops have been transferred, add more coconut oil and the onion to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until the onion is softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the bell peppers to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Add olive oil to the polenta and season with salt and pepper; stir to combine.
To serve, divide the polenta, bell peppers, and pork chops between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pork Chops & Sweet Potato Mash with Citrus Baby Greens Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and medium dice sweet potatoes (without peeling). Place in a medium saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Cook until tender, 10-15 minutes.
Heat broiler and position rack about 6 inches from the top.
Place pork chops in a baking dish. Rub with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place in the oven and broil until pork is cooked through, 7-9 minutes per side.
Wash and dry greens. Transfer to a medium bowl.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Slice off top and bottom from orange, then cut off the skin and white pith from the sides so you can see the orange flesh. Cut in between the membranes to release the segments and add to bowl with greens.
Add cranberries to bowl with greens and orange.
In a small bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic.
Drain potatoes and return to saucepan. Add broth, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper; mash until smooth.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Serve pork with mash and salad on the side. Drizzle dressing over salad and enjoy!

name: Pork Coconut Curry with Peaches, Spinach, Cilantro & Cauliflower Rice

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl.
Add oil and salt to the bowl with the cauliflower rice, then stir to combine. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring cauliflower halfway through, until rice is tender and golden, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice and place in the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the peaches. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch cubes. Season with salt and pepper.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and stir-fry until golden and almost cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the peaches and cilantro.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peaches, cilantro, ginger, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Return pork to the skillet, along with coconut milk, and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pork is cooked through and curry thickens slightly, 2-3 minutes more.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and curry between plates or bowls. Top with reserved cilantro and enjoy!

name: Pork, Green Bean & Bell Pepper Stir Fry with Cashews

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash the green beans and trim ends; transfer to a bowl. Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add the beans and cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Wash, seed, and slice the bell pepper lengthwise into strips; transfer to a medium bowl. Peel and mince the garlic; add to bowl. Peel and mince or grate the ginger; add to bowl.
Wash the green onions, trim ends, and thinly slice on a angle; transfer to a small bowl.
In a small bowl, prepare the sauce by whisking together soy sauce, vinegar, and honey. Set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Thinly slice the pork chops crosswise into bite-sized strips; transfer to a small bowl. Add soy sauce and toss to coat.
Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the pork and stir-fry until browned, 1-2 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Add more oil to the skillet, then add the pepper, garlic, ginger, and green beans. Stir fry until the pepper is tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
Return pork to the skillet and pour in the sauce. Stir-fry until well combined, 1-2 minutes.
Roughly chop the cashews.
Place stir fry in a bowl and garnish with sliced green onions and chopped cashews. Enjoy!

name: Pork Lo Mein with Bell Pepper & Sugar Snap Peas

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 6 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) linguine pasta

instructions.text: In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, cornstarch, honey, and crushed red pepper. Set aside.
Thinly slice pork crosswise into strips; transfer to a small bowl.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and mince or grate ginger.
Wash peas and bell pepper. Seed and slice the pepper into strips.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add pork and stir fry until no longer pink, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Once pork has been transferred, coat skillet with more oil. Add garlic, ginger, peas, and pepper; stir fry until peas are bright green and pepper is tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
Drain pasta in a colander.
Add pork, pasta, and sauce to skillet. Toss until noodles are well coated and sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, place lo mein on a plate and enjoy!

name: Pork & Mango Stir Fry with Bell Pepper & Sugar Snap Peas

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel the mango, then slice off the flesh from the pit, starting with the flatter sides; discard the pit and large dice the flesh (cut into ¾-inch cubes). Transfer the mango to a small bowl.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Large dice the pepper (cut into ¾-inch cubes) and transfer to a medium bowl.
Halve the sugar snap peas at an angle and add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle and transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger. Transfer the ginger to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add the garlic to the bowl with the ginger.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat dry the pork chops with paper towels and place on a cutting board; thinly slice crosswise into bite-sized strips.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the pork strips to the skillet and season with salt and pepper; cook, tossing occasionally, until the pork is browned and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes total. Once done, transfer to a bowl.
Once the pork has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet followed by the ginger, garlic, and crushed red pepper; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the bell pepper and snap peas to the skillet; cook, tossing occasionally, until the vegetables are lightly browned and tender-crisp, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the vegetables cook, in a small bowl, combine and whisk together cornstarch, broth, and soy sauce.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return the pork to the skillet, then add the mango, ¾ of the green onions (save the rest for garnishing), and sauce. Cook, stirring constantly, until the stir fry is heated through and the sauce is thickened, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from the heat.
To serve, add the stir fry to a dinner bowl and garnish with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Pork, Olive & Feta-Stuffed Peppers with Creamy Cucumber-Tomato Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; arrange cut-side down. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, pork, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop olives and sun-dried tomatoes.
When the pork is done, add olives, sun-dried tomatoes, and half of the feta to the skillet. Stir to combine the filling and remove from heat. (Reserve remaining feta for the next step.)
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Turn pepper halves cut-side up, stuff with the filling, then top with reserved feta. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to broil peppers until the cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from oven.
While the peppers are broiling, place yogurt, vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide stuffed peppers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pork Parmesan with Garlicky Asparagus & Mushroom Sauté

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Finely grate cheese and place half in a small bowl. Add bread crumbs and spices to bowl, then stir to combine the coating. (Set remaining cheese aside for later use.)
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels. Place on a plate and spread both sides with mayo. Sprinkle the coating over both sides and press gently to adhere.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork chops and pan-fry until golden and almost cooked through, about 2 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Pour tomato sauce over pork chops and sprinkle with reserved cheese.
Place skillet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until pork is cooked through and cheese is melted, 6-7 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms; place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears crosswise into 1-inch pieces.
When the mushrooms are soft, add asparagus, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are fork-tender, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide veggies, pork, and sauce between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pork "Piccata" Fritters with Lemon Yogurt Sauce & Tomato-Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between a medium and a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Divide between the bowls. (Set the small bowl aside for later use.)
Zest lemon into the medium bowl (reserve lemon for later use). Add pork, egg, almond flour, capers, salt, and pepper to the bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
Using a ¼-cup measure, form the pork mixture into ½-inch thick fritters and place on a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fritters and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, juice the reserved lemon into the small bowl with the parsley and garlic. Add yogurt, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the yogurt sauce.
Transfer ⅓ of the yogurt sauce to a clean medium bowl, add oil, and whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining yogurt sauce for serving.)
Halve tomato lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
Divide fritters and salad between plates. Serve with remaining yogurt sauce on the side for dipping and enjoy!

name: Pork, Portobello Mushroom & Zucchini Noodle Soup with Sesame Seeds

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove stems and scrape out the gills of the mushrooms; small dice, place in a medium bowl, and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork, salt, and pepper; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl with the mushrooms.
When the pork is done, add mushrooms, ginger, and garlic to the pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are soft and fragrant, 3-4 minutes.
Add broth and soy sauce to the pan; stir to combine, cover, and bring the soup to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until flavors blend, about 5 minutes.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles.
When the soup is done, add zucchini noodles to the pan, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Pork Sausage "Cassoulet" with White Beans, Fennel & Thyme Bread Crumbs

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the fennel.
Peel, halve, and mince onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Add half to the bowl with the veggies. Mince remaining thyme leaves, place in a small bowl, and set aside for later use.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggie-thyme mixture and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans.
When the veggies are done, add beans, tomato sauce, and water to the skillet. Stir to combine, then nestle sausages into the stew.
Place skillet in the oven and bake, turning sausages and stirring beans halfway through, until sausages are golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add bread crumbs to the bowl with the minced thyme and stir to combine.
To serve, divide cassoulet between plates or bowls and top with bread crumbs. Enjoy!

name: Pork Sausage with Honey-Roasted Root Veggies, Arugula, Dill & Almonds

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potato. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel and trim beet and turnip; halve each lengthwise, then slice into ¼-inch thick wedges. Add both to the baking sheet with the sweet potato.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick wedges. Add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until just fork-tender, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add almonds and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl and set aside. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)

Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat, cover to keep warm, and set aside.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the garlic. (Reserve a small handful of dill for serving.)
Juice lemon into the bowl. Add yogurt, milk, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.

When the veggies are just tender, remove baking sheet from the oven, then drizzle with honey. Toss to combine and spread back out in an even layer. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Remove baking sheet from the oven. Carefully transfer warm veggies to the bowl with the almonds. Add arugula, then gently toss until slightly wilted and salad is combined, about 1 minute.
To serve, divide salad and sausages between plates or bowls. Drizzle with dressing, sprinkle with reserved dill, and enjoy!

name: Pork Sausage Ragù with Zucchini, Spinach & Basil over Spaghetti Squash

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim squash, halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper; arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
While the squash roasts, preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the sausage and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Trim and medium dice zucchini; small dice tomato. Add both to the bowl with the garlic.
Once the pork is browned, add veggies and spices to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 2-3 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Add tomato sauce to the pan; stir to combine the sauce and continue to cook until slightly thickened, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, roughly chop spinach; pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place both in the reserved bowl.

When the sauce is done, add spinach and basil to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine, remove from heat, and cover to keep warm.
Finely grate Parmesan.

Remove squash from the oven; allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand.)
To serve, divide squash and ragù between plates or bowls; top with Parmesan and enjoy!

name: Pork Sausage, Roasted Potato, Bell Pepper & Mushroom Frittata

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Small dice new potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until potatoes are golden and fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Place in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the peppers and set aside.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
While the sausage is cooking, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the veggies.
When the sausage is done, add veggies, garlic, and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place eggs, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine. Set aside.
When the potatoes are done, change oven to broil on high. Transfer potatoes to the skillet with the sausage and veggies, then stir to combine.

Return skillet to medium-low heat and add the egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 3-5 minutes.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pork Sausage with Spicy Corn, Pepper & Edamame Sauté (Succotash)

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the bowl.
Place edamame and corn in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Add both to the bowl and set aside.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and softened, 4-5 minutes.

Add veggies, garlic, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are warmed through and fork-tender, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, halve grape tomatoes. Place in the reserved bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the tomato.
When the veggies are fork-tender, add tomatoes, basil, and vinegar to the skillet, then stir to combine the succotash. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide sausages and succotash between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Pork Sausages with Sautéed Apples & Potato Mash

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel the potatoes, then halve lengthwise and crosswise; transfer the quarters to a small saucepan. Cover with hot water (from the tap) by about 1 inch and bring to a boil over high heat.
Place the sausages on a plate and rub with a little olive oil.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add the sausages. Cook, turning occasionally, until the sausages are browned and cooked through, 10 to 15 minutes. Once done, transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Quarter the apples lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; cut each quarter lengthwise into 4 thin wedges.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce the heat to medium and cook until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife, 8 to 12 minutes. Once done, reserve about ½ cup of liquid and drain the rest. Cover the saucepan to keep warm.
Once the sausages have been transferred, add the apples to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until they are lightly browned and softened, 4 to 6 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat.
Add ½ of the reserved liquid, butter, salt, and pepper to the potatoes; mash with a potato masher until smooth. Add more liquid to thin out the mash if needed.
To serve, divide the mashed potatoes, sautéed apples, and sausages between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pork Schnitzel with German Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
In a salad bowl, combine and mix together yogurt, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; halve the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-rounds at an angle. Add to the salad bowl.
Using a knife, shave the dill leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Toss the salad.
Crack the egg into a medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork.
Place the flour and bread crumbs on two separate plates.

Place the pork chops on a cutting board and, holding a knife parallel to the board, cut the chops in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Pat dry with paper towels. Season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

One piece at a time, thoroughly coat the seasoned pork chops in the flour (shaking off any excess), then in the beaten egg (letting the excess drip off), then in the bread crumbs (pressing to adhere). Transfer to a plate.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the breaded pork chops in the skillet; cook until they are golden brown and cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
To serve, divide the schnitzel and cucumber salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pork Skewers with Jalapeño Blueberry Sauce & Feta-Pecan Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and place in a small saucepan. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Add blueberries to the pan with the jalapeño along with maple syrup, vinegar, ketchup, Worcestershire, and salt. Stir to combine.

Set pan over high heat and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until saucy and thickened, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, pat the pork dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch cubes. Place in a medium bowl along with oil and spices; stir to coat.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor skillet, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thread pork onto skewers and place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the pork pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.
Once the pan is hot, add the skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until pork is cooked through, about 8 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot. Place in a clean medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the dressing.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl with dressing.
Roughly chop pecans. Add to the bowl along with mixed greens and feta. Gently toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide skewers and salad between plates. Top skewers with sauce and enjoy!

name: Pork-Stuffed Pita with Creamy Apple Chutney & Parmesan Zucchini Spears

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger, garlic, and shallot; transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, quarter, core, and small dice apple; add to the bowl with the ginger, garlic, and shallot.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add ginger, garlic, shallot, and apple. Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and soft, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Trim zucchini and quarter lengthwise, then halve crosswise; arrange on a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and sprinkle with Parmesan.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until zucchini is fork-tender, 12-15 minutes; remove from oven.

When the apple is soft, add broth, vinegar, sugar, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine the chutney and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: When the chutney is done, transfer to the reserved bowl and set aside. Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board; thinly slice crosswise into bite-sized strips, then season with salt and pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add pork and stir-fry until browned and cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, add yogurt to the chutney and stir to combine.
Using a clean cutting board, cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets; stuff each pocket with creamy chutney and pork.
To serve, divide pitas and zucchini between plates. Enjoy!

name: Pork Tacos with Pico de Gallo & Guacamole

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter the tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the bowl.

Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the bowl with the tomatoes and pepper and transfer the rest to a small bowl (for the guacamole).
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the medium bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; add half to the medium bowl and the other half to the small bowl.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist to open, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and large dice the flesh. Add to the small bowl.
Juice the lime and divide between the two bowls.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice the pork chops crosswise into thin strips and transfer to a medium bowl.
Season the pork with chili powder, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the pork strips in the skillet; cook until browned and cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Season the salsa with salt and mix to combine.
Season the guacamole with salt and pepper; mash with a fork until smooth.
Wrap the tortillas in a damp towel and microwave until heated through, 30 to 60 seconds.
To serve, spread the guacamole in the middle of the tortillas, add the pork strips, and top with the pico de gallo. Enjoy!

name: Pork Tacos with Roasted Veggies, Fresh Salsa & Lime Crema

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place spices in a medium bowl; stir to combine the spice mix.
Peel and halve onion. Mince half and place in a small bowl; set aside. Thinly slice remaining onion and transfer to the baking sheet.

Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into strips; add bell pepper and corn to the baking sheet with the sliced onion. Sprinkle veggies with half of the spice mix and drizzle with oil; toss to combine. (Reserve remaining spice mix for the pork.)
Spread veggies out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until softened, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest lime into another small bowl; add yogurt, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the lime crema and set aside. (Reserve lime for next step.)
Juice half of the reserved lime into the bowl with minced onion; cut the remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.

Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Halve tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with onion and lime juice along with oil, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
Grate cheddar.
Pat pork chops dry with paper towels, then thinly slice into bite-sized strips. Place in the bowl with remaining spice mix, and toss to coat.

Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add the pork and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with pork, veggies, and cheese. Serve with fresh salsa, lime crema, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Pork Thai Green Curry with Zucchini Noodles, Cashews, Basil & Cilantro

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim zucchini, then run a vegetable peeler along the length of the zucchini to make ribbons. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger, shallot, and garlic. Place all three in a small bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then small dice. Add to the bowl with the ginger, shallot, and garlic. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, zest lime into the small bowl. (Reserve lime for later use).
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger-jalapeño mixture, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, and spices. Cook, stirring frequently until fragrant, about 2 minutes.

Add broth and coconut milk to the pot, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low, and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 3-4 minutes more.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems, then pick basil leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Add herbs to the pot (reserving a small handful of each for serving), then stir to combine.
Using a hand blender, purée the curry until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return curry to the pot.)
Slice pork chops crosswise into thin strips. Add to the pot with the curry, and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pork is cooked through, 5-6 minutes more.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, roughly chop cashews. Set aside.
When the pork is done, add the zucchini noodles to the pot. Gently toss the noodles to coat with the curry, and continue to cook, until zucchini noodles are soft, 1-2 minutes more.
Juice reserved lime into the pot, then add fish sauce and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pork green curry and zucchini noodles between bowls. Top with reserved herbs and cashews. Enjoy!

name: Portobello Burger Stack with Grilled Onions, Chimichurri & Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter potatoes and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until potatoes are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and slice onion crosswise into ¼-inch thick rings. Place on a plate.
Remove stems from the mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills; add to the plate with the onions. Drizzle veggies with oil, and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, place mushrooms and onions on the pan. Grill until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes per side. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, shave parsley and cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half of the herbs in a small bowl and set aside; place the other half in a medium bowl.
Add beef, salt, and pepper to the medium bowl with the herbs; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the beef mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on another plate.

When the veggies are done, place burger patties on the grill pan and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and grill an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
While the burgers are cooking, peel and mince garlic; add to the small bowl with the herbs, along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Stir to combine the chimichurri and set aside.
Slice tomato into rounds.
To serve, divide potatoes and grilled mushrooms between plates. Layer each mushroom with a burger patty, tomato, and onions; spoon chimichurri over top and enjoy!

name: Portobello Mushroom, Asparagus & Ricotta Flatbread with Balsamic Glaze

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Remove mushroom stems, then slice caps into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the garlic.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl.
Add oil and spices to the bowl; toss to coat. Transfer veggies to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet on upper rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, arrange flatbreads on another baking sheet. Place on the lower rack and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.

While flatbreads are toasting, place vinegar in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place half of the basil in a small bowl. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Add ricotta, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the basil; stir to combine.
To assemble the flatbreads, spread ricotta over each flatbread and top with roasted veggies. Return to oven and bake until warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, slice flatbreads and divide between plates. Drizzle with balsamic glaze, top with reserved basil, and enjoy!

name: Portobello Mushroom Egg Bakes with Asparagus & Parmesan Quinoa

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 400°F and place the rack in the middle position.
In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa and broth; bring to a boil.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the mushrooms; remove the stems and carefully scrape out the gills, making sure not to damage the rim of the mushrooms.
Place the mushrooms on the baking sheet; rub with olive oil.
Once the quinoa is boiling, reduce heat to a simmer and cover; cook for 15 minutes. Once cooked, remove from the heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Break an egg into each mushroom cap and season with salt and pepper.
Place the mushrooms in the oven and bake for 8 minutes.

Wash and dry the asparagus. Snap (or cut) off and discard the woody ends; cut the spears on an angle into 1-inch pieces. Transfer to a large bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Finely grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
After the 8 minutes are up, remove the sheet pan from the oven temporarily. Arrange the asparagus on the sheet around the mushrooms.
Return the sheet to the oven and continue to bake until the eggs are cooked and the asparagus is tender, 7 to 10 more minutes.
Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork. Add the asparagus and Parmesan; stir until well combined.
Divide the mushrooms and quinoa between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container). Enjoy!

name: Portobello Mushroom "Parmesan" with Zucchini, Olive & Pine Nut Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Wash, dry, and remove stems from portobello mushrooms, then carefully scrape out the gills. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, rub with oil, and season with salt and pepper on both sides; arrange cap-side up.
Place mushrooms in the oven and broil until starting to soften, about 6 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a small saucepan along with tomato sauce, crushed red pepper, and salt. Stir to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer over high heat. Once simmering, remove from heat and set aside.
While the sauce is heating, finely grate Parmesan. Place in a medium bowl along with bread crumbs and spices, then stir to combine the Parmesan topping.
Using tongs, carefully flip the mushrooms, cap-side down. Spread evenly with warm tomato sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan topping. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to broil until the mushrooms are soft and cheese topping is golden brown, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl.
Wash, dry, and trim zucchini, then run a vegetable peeler along the length of the zucchini to make ribbons. Add to the bowl, along with the pine nuts, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide the mushrooms and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Portobello Mushroom "Pizzas" with Sausage & Basil

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 400°F and position rack in the center of the oven. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Remove the mushroom stems and carefully scrape out the gills; discard stems and gills.

Place mushrooms, cap-side up, onto the baking sheet pan and season with oil, salt, and pepper; turn mushrooms over and bake for 10 minutes. When the mushrooms are done, remove from the oven and set aside to cool slightly.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice the sausage into ½-inch-thick rounds.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage slices to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sausage slices are browned, about 5 minutes; remove from heat.
Grate the cheese and transfer to a small bowl.
Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves into a chiffonade by stacking them and rolling tightly into a cigar, then slicing crosswise into thin ribbons.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Add oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine. Add mixed greens to the bowl; toss to coat.
Combine tomato paste and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine.

When the mushrooms are cool enough to handle, carefully lift each cap with a spatula and tip the juices out into the sink; return mushrooms, cap-side down, to the baking sheet pan. Blot the inside of each cap with a paper towel before filling.

Fill each mushroom cap with 1½ tbsp tomato paste mixture. Divide cheese and sausage between mushrooms, then return to the oven and bake until cheese is melted and mushrooms are heated through, about 5 minutes.
To serve, divide mushroom pizzas and salad between plates; sprinkle basil over the mushrooms and enjoy.

name: Portobello Mushroom Tuna Melts with Baby Greens

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
