ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat broiler and position rack about 6 inches from the top.
Wash and dry mushrooms; remove stems. Place mushroom caps on a baking sheet pan and brush with a little olive oil. Place in the oven and broil until almost tender, 6-8 minutes.
Small dice mushroom stems and transfer to a medium bowl.

Wash and dry celery and parsley. Small dice and add the celery to bowl with mushrooms. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems, mince the leaves, and add to bowl. Peel, mince, and add garlic to bowl.
Drain tuna and add to bowl.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Drizzle tuna with lemon juice and olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
Wash and slice tomato into rounds.
Grate ½ cup of mozzarella.
Remove the mushrooms from the oven. Divide tuna mixture evenly among the mushrooms and stuff inside. Top with tomato slices and sprinkle mozzarella over top.
Return to oven and broil until cheese melts and begins to turn golden brown, 2-3 minutes.
Wash and dry mixed greens.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Arrange a bed of mixed greens on a plate and place mushroom caps on top. Enjoy!

name: Portobello Stacks with Ground Pork, Pepper, Tomato & Fresh Mozzarella

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and spices; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, remove stems from the mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills. Place on the baking sheet, rub with oil, and season with salt and pepper on both sides; arrange gill-side down.
Place mushrooms in the oven and broil until starting to soften, about 4 minutes.
While the mushrooms are broiling, trim and discard top and bottom portions of the bell pepper, then cut crosswise into 4 rings; remove seeds.
Remove baking sheet from the oven, flip mushrooms, and add pepper rings. Return to oven and broil until mushrooms and peppers are fork-tender, 4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, slice tomato crosswise into rounds.
Thinly slice mozzarella.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: When the broiled veggies are ready, remove from oven. Place a bell pepper ring on top of each mushroom; fill with ground pork, then layer with tomato and mozzarella.
Place mushroom stacks in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden, about 2 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide mushroom stacks between plates and sprinkle with crushed red pepper; enjoy!

name: Portobello-Tomato Melts with Simple  Greens

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
In a medium bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
amounts: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Remove the stems of the mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills using a spoon.
Toss mushrooms in the dressing, making sure both sides are well coated; leave the mushrooms in the dressing to marinate and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Slice the tomato.
Grate the cheese.
Remove mushrooms from the dressing, shaking off excess; transfer mushrooms, stem side down, to a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil. (Reserve remaining dressing for the salad.)
Place mushrooms under the broiler and cook until tender, 2-3 minutes per side.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl, add oil and mix to combine.
Drizzle bread with oil and garlic mixture.

Remove mushrooms from oven and pour off any excess moisture. Place mushrooms back on the sheet pan, stem side up, and fill with tomato slices and cheese. Add bread to the baking sheet next to the mushrooms; return to the broiler until cheese is melted and bread is toasted, 1-2 minutes.
Add spring mix, sliced almonds, and half the basil to the bowl with the remaining dressing, toss to combine.
To serve, divide salad and toast between plates; top toast with broiled mushroom and garnish with remaining basil. Enjoy!

name: Portuguese Sausage, Potato & Leafy Greens Soup (Caldo Verde)

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, cut the sausages into ½-inch thick pieces.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and pan-fry, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
When the sausage is done, remove to a plate using a slotted spoon and set aside.

Using a clean cutting board, trim off the root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; place in a medium bowl.
Small dice tomato and add to the bowl with the leek.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl.
Return the pan (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat and add more oil. Add leek, tomato, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, about 5 minutes.
While the veggies cook, peel, quarter, and slice potatoes into ½-inch thick pieces.
Add potatoes and broth to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces; add to the soup. Once the soup comes to a boil, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until potatoes and kale are tender, 8-10 minutes.
While the soup cooks, roughly chop spinach and set aside.
When the potatoes and kale are tender, add cooked sausage and spinach to the soup and continue to simmer until spinach is wilted and sausage is heated through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!

name: Potato, Bacon & Kale Frittata

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat the oven to the broil setting and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Cut the bacon crosswise into ¼-inch-thick strips.

Once the skillet is hot, add the bacon strips. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the bacon is crispy, 4 to 6 minutes. Once done, transfer to a plate lined with paper towels, leaving the drippings in the skillet.
While the bacon cooks, trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds.
Once the bacon has been transferred, add the shallot to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
While the shallot cooks, medium dice the potato (cut into ½-inch cubes).
Add the potatoes to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6 to 8 minutes.
While the potatoes cook, cut out and discard the kale stems; chop the leaves crosswise into 1-inch strips.
Add the kale to the skillet; cook, stirring, until it is wilted but still green, 4 to 5 minutes.
While the kale cooks, in a medium bowl, combine and whisk together the eggs, water, salt, and pepper.

Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and top with the bacon. While tilting the skillet with one hand, lift up the edges of the frittata with a spatula and let the egg mixture run underneath during the first few minutes of cooking. Cook until most of the frittata is set, but the top is still runny, 4 to 5 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and broil until the top is set and lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes.
To serve, separate the frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Potato Gnocchi with Mushroom Ragu & Sautéed Spinach

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce (skip the spinach if it came pre-washed).
Small dice the mushrooms.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat; add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the mushrooms and let cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Season with salt and pepper.
Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and small dice the shallot.
Add shallots, oregano, basil, and half the garlic to the saucepan with the mushrooms and cook for 5 more minutes.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add the tomato sauce to the saucepan with the mushroom mixture and let simmer on low for 5 more minutes.
Once the water comes to a boil, add the potato gnocchi to the pot and cook, uncovered, for 2 minutes, or until the gnocchi begin to float on the surface. Drain the gnocchi.
Preheat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the oil, remaining garlic, spinach, and sliced almonds. Cook for 2-3 minutes until the spinach begins to wilt.
Finely grate the Parmesan.
To serve, divide the gnocchi into bowls and top with tomato sauce, grated Parmesan, and parsley. Arrange the sautéed spinach and almonds on the side. Enjoy!

name: Potato Latkes with Smoked Salmon, Yogurt, Dill & Celery-Apple Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Place eggs, bread crumbs, cornstarch, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the egg mixture.
Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add dill to the bowl with the egg mixture (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Peel potatoes; using a box grater, coarsely grate, and place in a colander. Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the potato as you can.
Add grated potato to the bowl with the egg mixture and use your hands to thoroughly combine the latke mixture.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, using a ⅓-cup measure, form the latke mixture into ½-inch thick patties; place on a plate.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add patties and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove latkes to a clean, paper towel-lined plate to drain.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and salt in another medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apple; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl.
Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces.
Just before serving, add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide latkes between plates and season with pepper; top with salmon, yogurt, and reserved dill. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Potato-Leek Soup with Broccoli, Spinach, Parmesan & Garlic Bread

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with butter and salt. Mash with the back of a spoon to combine the garlic butter; set aside.
Peel and small dice potatoes; separate broccoli into small florets and small dice the stems. Place both in a medium bowl and set aside.

Trim off the root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, add half of the garlic butter (reserving the rest for the garlic bread) and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the leek and cook, stirring often, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add broccoli, potato, and flour to the pan; stir to combine. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Gradually stir broth, milk, and spices into the pan. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) whole milk

instructions.text: Meanwhile, roughly chop spinach and place in the reserved bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan and add to the bowl with the spinach; set aside.
Slice lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Once the veggies are tender, use a potato masher to crush the potatoes and broccoli, creating a semi-smooth soup.

Add spinach and Parmesan to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to stir until cheese is melted and combined, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Slice rolls in half and place on a baking sheet pan, cut-side up; spread with remaining garlic butter. Place in the oven and broil until lightly toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Divide soup between bowls and sprinkle with crushed red pepper. Serve with garlic bread and lemon wedges for squeezing over top. Enjoy!

name: Potato & Red Pepper Hash with Fried Eggs & Parmesan

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and large dice the potatoes into ¾-inch cubes; transfer to a bowl.
Preheat a (stainless steel or cast-iron) skillet over medium heat.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Large dice the pepper into ¾-inch cubes and transfer to a separate medium bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the potatoes to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender, 8 to 10 minutes.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the bell pepper.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bell pepper and onion.
Add the bell pepper, onion, and garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables are tender and browned, 4 to 6 minutes.
Add coconut oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
Gently crack the eggs into the skillet. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, separate the eggs. Cook in batches if necessary.
Season the hash with salt and pepper; stir to combine and remove from the heat.
Finely grate ½ cup of Parmesan.
To serve, divide the hash between plates, top with the fried eggs, and sprinkle with the Parmesan. Season with additional salt and pepper if desired. Enjoy!

name: Potato, Walnut & Sun-Dried Tomato "Chorizo" Tacos with Avocado Cream

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Small dice potato into ¼-inch cubes.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add potatoes and salt; cook, stirring often, until golden and crisp, about 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely chop the walnuts and transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic. Mince the sun-dried tomatoes; add both to the bowl with the walnuts.
Add water, sugar, and spices to the bowl with the walnuts and stir to combine.
When the potatoes are done, add the walnut mixture to the skillet; cook, stirring often, until the liquid has evaporated, about 4 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Juice the lime into a blender.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out into the blender.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and add leaves to the blender.
Peel garlic; add to the blender along with almond milk and salt. Blend on high until smooth; set avocado cream aside.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) almond milk, unsweetened

instructions.text: Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Small dice the tomato.
Wrap the tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until heated through, 15-30 seconds.
To serve, divide the tortillas between plates and fill with potato-walnut mixture. Top with green onion, tomato, and avocado cream. Enjoy!

name: Potato, Zucchini & Kidney Bean Bake with Avocado Pico de Gallo

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter potatoes and transfer to a baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until potatoes start to soften, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; place in a medium bowl.
Trim and large dice zucchini; add to the bowl with the beans. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to combine.
When the potatoes have softened, remove from oven; add beans and zucchini to the baking sheet. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are fork-tender, 10-12 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lime into the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the lime juice.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Small dice tomato and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the pico de gallo.
To serve, divide roasted veggies and beans between plates or bowls; top with yogurt and pico de gallo. Enjoy!

name: Prosciutto, Asparagus, Pea & Goat Cheese Frittata with Mixed Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Add eggs, pepper, and salt to the bowl with the parsley. Whisk to combine.
Crumble the goat cheese. Add half to the bowl with the egg. (Set remaining cheese aside for the salad.)
Chop (or tear) prosciutto into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.

Trim off the root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Place in another medium bowl.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, snap (or cut) off the woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the leek.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leek, asparagus, peas, pepper, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are bright green and starting to soften, about 3 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

When the veggies are soft, reduce heat to medium and pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, about 5 minutes.
While the frittata is cooking, place additional oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until top of the frittata is just set, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Separate lettuce into leaves. Chop (or tear) leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, along with the reserved goat cheese, and toss to combine the salad.
Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Prosciutto, Mozzarella, Tomato, Pepper & Basil Sandwich with Arugula

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Divide between a medium and small bowl. (Set the medium bowl aside for the salad.)
Zest lemon into the small bowl with the basil, then add mayo and spices. Stir to combine the basil aioli and set aside. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Slice tomato crosswise into thin rounds. Place on a plate and season with salt and pepper.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the plate with the tomato.
Slice mozzarella into thin rounds. Add to the plate and set aside.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Juice reserved lemon into the medium bowl with the basil. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Toast bread if desired.
To assemble the sandwiches, spread each bread slice with basil aioli. Layer half of the slices with tomato, bell pepper, mozzarella, and prosciutto; close with remaining slices and cut in half.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: "Prosciutto & Mushroom Pizza" Smothered Chicken with Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of oil.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with tomato sauce and Italian seasoning. Stir to combine and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.

Place chicken on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Place cutlets in the baking dish and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Pour tomato sauce over the chicken, layer with prosciutto slices, and sprinkle with cheese.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until chicken is cooked through and cheese is golden, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, using a clean cutting board, thinly slice mushrooms.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add half of the mushrooms (reserving the rest for the salad) and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and golden, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: While the mushrooms are cooking, juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, mayo, vinegar, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the dressing along with the reserved mushrooms.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot; add to the bowl.
Right before serving, add mixed greens to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide smothered chicken and salad between plates. Top chicken with sautéed mushrooms and sprinkle with crushed red pepper. Enjoy!

name: Prosciutto-Orzo Bake with Zucchini, Pepper, Corn, Feta & Hot Honey

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the skillet is hot, add prosciutto in a single layer and cook until crispy, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and medium dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, corn, and spices; cook, until veggies are slightly caramelized and liquid has evaporated, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

When the veggies are caramelized, juice lemon into the skillet. Add orzo, broth, milk, half of the feta (reserve remaining feta for serving), salt, and pepper, then stir to combine. Place skillet in the oven and bake until liquid is absorbed and orzo is tender, 12-15 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl.
Crumble or chop prosciutto into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the basil and set aside.
Place honey and crushed red pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the hot honey.
When the orzo is done, remove from the oven. Add basil, prosciutto, and half of the hot honey to the skillet, then stir to combine. (Reserve remaining hot honey for serving.)
To serve, divide orzo bake between plates or bowls, then top with reserved feta and hot honey. Enjoy!

name: Prosciutto, Pear & Blue Cheese Sandwich with Spinach-Mushroom Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Thinly slice mushrooms and add to the bowl with the dressing; set aside.
Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet pan, place in the oven, and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice shallot.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice pear.

Spread mayo and Dijon over half of the toasted bread slices. Layer a small handful of spinach, shallot, pear, prosciutto, and blue cheese over top (reserving remaining spinach for the salad). Close with remaining toast slices.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Add remaining spinach to the bowl with the dressing and mushrooms; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Prosciutto, Strawberry & Goat Cheese Toasts with Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Crumble goat cheese into a small bowl and set aside to soften.
Meanwhile wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove toast from the oven and set aside. (Keep the broiler on.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Add vinegar, oil, honey, and spices to the bowl with the basil; whisk to combine the marinade.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Trim and thinly slice strawberries. Add to the bowl with the marinade, toss to combine, and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the goat cheese and mash with a fork to combine.
Spread goat cheese mixture evenly over the toast. Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until the cheese browns slightly, 1-2 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Using a slotted spoon, remove strawberries from the marinade and arrange on top of the toast. (Reserve leftover marinade for the salad.)
Chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces and place on top of toast.
Add arugula to the bowl with the reserved marinade and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide toasts and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Asparagus with Herbed Cheese & Mashed Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until asparagus is just tender, 5-7 minutes, depending on the thickness of the spears. Remove baking sheet from oven and set aside to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a box grater, coarsely grate cream cheese into a small bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the cream cheese.
Chop chives into small pieces. Add to the bowl along with salt and pepper, then stir to combine.
Lay prosciutto on a flat surface and spread each slice evenly with the cream cheese mixture.

When the asparagus is cool enough to handle, divide into 6 equal piles. Wrap each pile with a slice of the prepared prosciutto, gently pressing the cream cheese-side around the asparagus to secure. Arrange, seam-side down, on the baking sheet.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until prosciutto is golden and asparagus is fork-tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
When the potatoes are done, drain in a colander and return to the pan. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then using a potato masher, mash until smooth.
To serve, divide mashed potatoes and prosciutto-wrapped asparagus between plates. Enjoy!

name: Prosciutto Wrapped Basil-Salmon Kabobs with Cauliflower Rice

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 6-8 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring often, until it begins to soften, 3-4 minutes.

Meanwhile, wash and dry the cauliflower. Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower.
Add cauliflower and salt to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring often, until cauliflower is lightly golden and cooked through, 5-7 minutes.

Meanwhile, wash and dry the basil. Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and mince. Place half of the basil in a medium bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the marinade. (Reserve remaining basil for the cauliflower rice.)

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin. If you don’t have a tail end, start at one corner of the fillet and work your way in until the knife is between the skin and flesh.
Cut the salmon crosswise into 1-inch strips and transfer to the bowl with the marinade. Turn to coat.

Thread one strip of salmon onto each skewer; wrap a piece of prosciutto around each salmon skewer and place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the salmon directly on the grill pan without using skewers.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Place kabobs on the grill and cook, rotating every 1½-2 minutes, until salmon is opaque and cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
Once the cauliflower rice is done, remove from heat and stir in the reserved basil.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and kabobs between plates. Serve mayonnaise on the side for dipping and enjoy!

name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Chicken with Spicy Spaghetti Squash "Aglio e Olio"

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim spaghetti squash, then halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.

Meanwhile, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season both sides with salt and pepper, then wrap each cutlet with two slices of prosciutto. Set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: When the squash has about 10 minutes left in the oven, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cutlets and pan-fry until prosciutto is crisp and chicken is cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Remove squash from the oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
While the squash is cooling, using a clean cutting board, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in a small bowl and set aside.
Cut half of the lemon into wedges and set aside for serving. (Reserve remaining lemon for later use.)
Peel and thinly slice garlic.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and crushed red pepper; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Juice reserved lemon into the skillet, stir to combine the lemon-garlic sauce, and remove from heat.

Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands (use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand). Add to the skillet with the lemon-garlic sauce, along with the parsley, and gently toss. Remove from heat.
Slice chicken into strips.
Divide chicken and squash between plates. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing over the chicken and enjoy!

name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Chicken with Warm Lentil, Pepper & Zucchini Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan; add water and salt. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove lid, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain and set aside.

Meanwhile, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season both sides with spices, then wrap each cutlet with two slices of prosciutto.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cutlets and pan-fry until prosciutto is crisp and chicken is cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
While the chicken is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice zucchini. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.

Return skillet to medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, parsley, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies have softened, 4-5 minutes.
Add drained lentils and vinegar to the skillet with the veggies, then stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Slice chicken into thin strips.
To serve, divide warm lentil salad between plates or bowls and top with chicken. Enjoy!

name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Cod with Caper Aioli & Roasted Broccoli Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; mince capers. Place both in a small bowl.
Zest lemon into the bowl with the garlic and capers (reserve lemon for the next step). Add mayo, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the aioli and set aside.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Transfer broccoli to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to combine; spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet on lower rack of the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until broccoli is fork-tender and lightly charred, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.

While the broccoli is roasting, pat cod dry with paper towels, cut into portions (if necessary), and transfer to another baking sheet. Season with pepper, then wrap 2 slices of prosciutto around each portion; drizzle with oil.
Place baking sheet on upper rack of the oven and roast until the fish is cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the parsley to the bowl with the dressing (reserving the rest for garnish).
When the broccoli is done, add it to the bowl, along with the almonds, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide cod and broccoli salad between plates; top fish with aioli and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Cod with Tomato, Corn, Peach & Goat Cheese Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into portions (if necessary). Season with salt and pepper, then wrap 2 slices of prosciutto around each portion.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cod and cook until golden on one side, 3-4 minutes; flip and continue to pan-fry until the fish is cooked through and the prosciutto is crisp, 3-4 minutes more. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, place corn in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes and peaches.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and tear the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl, then gently stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide prosciutto-wrapped cod and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Peaches over Arugula, Couscous & Goat Cheese Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince shallot and garlic; place both in a medium bowl.
Zest and juice orange into the bowl with the shallot and garlic. Add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium heat.
While the grill pan heats up, halve peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Wrap one slice of prosciutto around each peach half.

Once the grill pan is hot, place peaches on the grill, cut-side down. Cook, turning halfway through, until peaches are warmed through and prosciutto is golden and crispy, about 5 minutes. Remove to a plate and set aside.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add cooked couscous, arugula, and blackberries to the bowl. Gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and peaches between plates or bowls. Crumble goat cheese over top and enjoy!

name: Pub-Style Steak Sandwich with Roasted New Potatoes & Dijon Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, and halve potatoes; transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to combine, then spread out in a single layer.
Place potatoes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until fork-tender, about 20 minutes.
While the potatoes are baking, peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Add oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
While the steak is cooking, peel and mince additional garlic.
Place bread on an another baking sheet, sprinkle with garlic, and drizzle with oil. Transfer to the oven and bake until toasted, about 3 minutes.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Divide toast between plates and top with steak. Serve with roasted potatoes and salad on the side. Enjoy sandwiches pub-style, with a knife and fork!

name: Pumpkin & Beef Chili with Green Onions & Cool Yogurt

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add ground beef. Breaking apart with a spoon, cook until browned, 2-3 minutes.
Add onion and garlic to saucepan. Reduce heat to medium. Stirring frequently, cook until onion softens, 3-4 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans.
In a small bowl, mix together chili powder, cumin, cinnamon, salt, and pepper.
Add spice mixture, beans, tomatoes, and pumpkin purée to saucepan. Stir to combine and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Wash green onions, trim and discard root ends, and chop. Stir ½ into the chili and save the rest for garnishing.
Serve chili in a bowl, garnish with remaining green onions and spoonfuls of yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Pumpkin-Black Bean Soup with Sweet Potatoes & Tender Kale

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Peel and small dice onion.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeño with a spoon. Finely dice. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add the oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add ginger, garlic, onion, and jalapeño to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and dice sweet potato into ½-inch pieces.
Drain and rinse beans.
Add sweet potato, beans, broth, tomatoes with their juices, pumpkin, coconut milk, and spices to the pot. Stir to combine.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Bring to a boil over high heat, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer until vegetables are tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to pot during the last 5 minutes of cook time.
Juice lime into the pot and stir to combine.
Divide the soup between bowls and top with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Pumpkin & Kale Lasagna Skillet with Melted Mozzarella

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.

Break lasagna noodles into thirds. Once the water in the pan is boiling, uncover, add salt and broken noodles, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Once done, drain in a colander and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until starting to soften, 1-2 minutes.
Add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring frequently, until the onion and kale are tender, 2-3 minutes more.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate mozzarella.
When the veggies are done, add pumpkin and cream to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until sauce is smooth, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée
4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Add noodles to the skillet and toss to combine. Continue to cook, tossing occasionally, until heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Sprinkle cheese over the lasagna skillet.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until the mozzarella is melted and golden, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide lasagna skillet between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Pumpkin & Ricotta Pasta Bake with Kale, Parmesan & Chives

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 6 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice the onion
Heat a sauté pan over medium-low heat.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add garlic, onion, sage, and thyme. Cook until soft, 3-4 minutes.

Meanwhile, wash kale leaves, then fold in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add to the pan with the onions; cook, stirring often, until kale begins to wilt, 4-5 minutes.
Add broth, pumpkin, ricotta, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine. Simmer, stirring occasionally, while pasta is cooking.
amounts: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil and position rack 4 inches under the broiler.
Wash and chop chives into small pieces.
Grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Add ½ of the chives and Parmesan (save the rest for garnishing) to pan and stir to combine.
Drain pasta, add to pan with sauce, and stir to combine.
Place pan in the oven and broil until slightly browned, 3-4 minutes.
To serve, place pasta on a plate and garnish with remaining chives and Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Soup with Goat Cheese & Chickpea-Kale Sauté

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 20 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the saucepan heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces.
Once the saucepan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a small bowl.
Add ½ of the garlic, cinnamon, and crushed red pepper to the saucepan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the pumpkin purée and broth to the saucepan; stir to incorporate and season with salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée
20 fl oz (2 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut out and discard the kale stems; chop the leaves into 1-inch pieces.
Once the pan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the remaining garlic and crushed red pepper to the pan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the kale to the skillet and toss with the garlic and olive oil; cook until it is tender, 4 to 6 minutes.
Crumble the goat cheese and place in a small bowl.
Add the chickpeas to the kale and season the mixture with salt and pepper; mix together and continue to cook until the chickpeas are heated through, 1 to 2 minutes.
Juice the lemon and drizzle over the kale and chickpeas.
Using an immersion (hand) blender, purée the soup until smooth.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and top with the goat cheese; serve with the sautéed chickpeas and kale on the side. Enjoy!

name: Pumpkin & Turkey Chili with Kale & Cannellini Beans

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the saucepan heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Add to the bowl with the pepper.
Once the saucepan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the ground turkey to the saucepan; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a bowl, leaving some of the juices in the saucepan.
Once the turkey has been transferred, add the pepper and onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin, and oregano to the saucepan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Return the turkey to the saucepan, then add in the beans, diced tomatoes, and pumpkin purée; season with salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Cut out and discard the kale stems; chop leaves crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Stir the kale into the chili while it is cooking.
To serve, divide the chili between bowls and top with spoonfuls of Greek yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Puréed White Bean Soup with Arugula, Sun-Dried Tomato & Parmesan Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Trim off root ends and dark green tops of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Thinly slice crosswise.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leek and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and just starting to brown in spots, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice garlic.
Drain and rinse beans.

When the leek is done, using a stirring spoon, remove half of the cooked leek to a small bowl and set aside for serving. Add garlic, thyme, and pepper to the pan with the remaining leek, then continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add beans and broth to the pan, then stir to combine. Bring the soup to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until slightly thickened, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, juice half of the lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining lemon for later use.)
Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl and set aside.

When the soup is done, remove from heat. Juice reserved lemon into the pan, then use a hand blender to purée the soup until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pan.)
Add arugula and pine nuts to the bowl with the dressing. Gently toss to combine the salad.
Divide soup between bowls, top with reserved leek, and drizzle with oil. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Puttanesca Pasta Salad with Tuna, Anchovies & Artichokes

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic and shallot; place both in a large bowl.
Finely mince anchovy fillets; add to the bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve olives lengthwise and add to the bowl.
Roughly chop capers and add to the bowl.
Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes; add to the bowl.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine.
Drain pasta in a colander and rinse under cold water; add to the bowl.
Drain tuna, flake with a fork, and add to the bowl. Gently toss the salad to combine.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: To serve, divide pasta salad between bowls or plates. Garnish with pine nuts and enjoy!

name: Quick & Cheesy French Onion Soup

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Peel and very thinly slice onions, using a mandoline slicer if desired.
When the pot is warm, melt butter until foamy. Add onions to the pot and season with salt to help them release their moisture. Cook until tender, stirring occasionally, 4-5 minutes.
Add broth, water, soy sauce, Worcestershire, pepper, and thyme; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer, 10-15 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While soup is simmering, slice bread (if required) and grate cheese; set aside.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
Divide soup into oven-safe bowls or ramekins, place bowls on a baking sheet pan. Top with bread slices and cheese.
Place under broiler until cheese is golden brown, about 1 minute. Watch it carefully as it can burn easily.
When the soup is brown and bubbly, carefully remove from oven using oven mitts and place bowls on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Quick Chicken Cacciatore with Basmati Rice

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Rinse the rice in a colander and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil.
While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water is boiling, reduce heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until liquid is absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Remove from heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside.
Halve, seed, and cut the bell pepper lengthwise into strips. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl.
Slice the mushrooms and add to the bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the bowl.
Pat dry the chicken; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom. Place the chicken in the skillet and cook until browned (but not cooked through), 1 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add the vegetables to the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 4 to 6 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, olives, and half of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing) to the skillet; stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and sink into the sauce. Bring to a simmer and cook until chicken is cooked through, 4 to 6 minutes.
Divide the rice between two plates (or one plate and a lunch container) and top each with the chicken cacciatore. Garnish with the remaining parsley and enjoy!

name: Quick Pickled Spicy Shrimp & Avocado Salad with Buttered Toast Points

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry thyme. Add thyme sprigs, water, vinegar, salt, and coriander to a medium saucepan; cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.)
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, uncover, add shrimp, and stir for a few seconds. Remove from heat, and let the shrimp pickle in the cooking liquid while you prepare the rest of the salad, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Grate the zest from the lemon and transfer to a medium bowl, then juice the lemon into the same bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to the bowl.
Add additional vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl and whisk to combine the dressing.
Thinly slice the jalapeño into rounds (be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Peel and thinly slice the shallot into rings. Add shallots and jalapeños to the bowl with the dressing.
Seed and slice bell pepper into thin strips. Peel and medium dice the cucumber. Peel and thinly slice the carrot into rounds. Add vegetables to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Drain the shrimp and discard the liquid. Remove tails, then add shrimp to the bowl with the vegetables and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Toast and butter the bread, then slice on the diagonal to make toast points.
To serve, divide shrimp salad between bowls. Enjoy with a side of buttered toast points for dipping.

name: Quinoa Black Bean Chili with Parmesan-Date Kale Salad & Dijon Dressing

instructions.text: Drain and rinse beans; set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 2 minutes.

Add beans, corn, tomatoes, quinoa, water, chili powder, and salt to the pan. Stir to combine the chili and bring to a boil over high heat; reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until the liquid is absorbed and quinoa is tender, about 20 minutes.
While the chili is cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry kale; fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice dates and add to the bowl along with the pumpkin seeds.
Grate or shave Parmesan with a vegetable peeler and add to the bowl with the kale; toss to combine the salad.
Divide chili between bowls and top with a dollop of yogurt; serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Quinoa Bowl with Kale Chips, Marinated Chickpeas & Tahini Dressing

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into large bite-sized pieces and place in a medium bowl.

Add nutritional yeast, oil, vinegar, and salt to the bowl with the kale; using your hands, toss the leaves well to coat. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing once, until the kale is crispy, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Zest and juice half of the lemon into the reserved bowl. (Reserve remaining lemon for the dressing.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil, maple syrup, Dijon, and spices; stir to combine the marinade. Add chickpeas, stir to combine, and set aside to marinate.
Peel and mince additional garlic; place in a small bowl.
Juice the reserved lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add tahini, water, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces.
Trim and thinly slice radishes.
To serve, divide quinoa, kale chips, chickpeas, cucumber, and radish between bowls. Drizzle with lemon-tahini dressing and enjoy!

name: Quinoa Bowl with Lemony White Beans, Swiss Chard, Feta, Olives & Mint

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa, water, and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.

Fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in a medium bowl and stems in a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the bowl with the chard stems.
When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chard stems, garlic, and crushed red pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until garlic is fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add beans and salt to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, about 30 seconds.
Add chard leaves to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
Zest and juice lemon into the skillet.
Halve olives lengthwise. Add to the skillet along with the feta.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the skillet and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining mint for serving.)
To serve, divide quinoa and bean-chard sauté between bowls. Drizzle with oil and top with reserved mint. Enjoy!
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

name: Quinoa Bowl with Marinated Beans, Squash, Pears, Walnuts & Parmesan

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa, water, and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until squash is golden and fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a small bowl.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the shallot.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the dressing.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl with the dressing, stir to combine, and set aside to marinate.
Roughly chop walnuts. Place on a plate.
Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the plate with the walnuts.
Quarter, core, and medium dice pear. Add to the plate.
To serve, divide quinoa between bowls. Top with marinated beans, roasted squash, pear, walnuts, and Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Quinoa Bowl with Roasted Carrots, Garlic-Lime Chickpeas & Cumin Yogurt

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F and place the rack in the center position. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel carrots, cut in half lengthwise, and add to the baking sheet.
Drizzle oil and honey over carrots and sprinkle with spices. Place carrots in the oven and cook, until tender, 15-20 minutes.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to a medium bowl (reserving some for garnish).
Peel and mince garlic. Zest the lime and add both to the bowl with the parsley. Add salt, pepper, and oil; stir to combine.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the lime zest mixture​, along with the corn, and toss to coat. Add to the baking sheet for the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Juice the lime into a small bowl. Add yogurt, cumin, and salt; whisk to combine.
To serve, divide quinoa between bowls, add roasted carrots, chickpeas, and corn. Drizzle with cumin yogurt and top with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Quinoa Bowl with Roasted Sausage, Apple, Beets & Orange-Yogurt Sauce

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.

In a small saucepan, combine broth and quinoa; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until liquid is fully absorbed, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter, core, and medium dice apples. Transfer to one half of a baking sheet pan.

Peel, trim, and small dice beets; add to the other half of the baking sheet. Drizzle apples and beets with oil, then season with spices. Stir each to combine (keeping them separate), then spread out in an even layer.
Add sausages to the baking sheet, nestling them into the apples.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring apples and beets and flipping sausages halfway through, until beets are tender and sausages are cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice orange into a small bowl. Add yogurt and spices, then whisk to combine the orange-yogurt sauce. Set aside.
Transfer cooked sausages to the cutting board and slice crosswise into thin rounds.
To serve, divide quinoa between bowls; top with roasted apples, beets, and sausage slices, then drizzle with orange-yogurt sauce. Enjoy!

name: Quinoa Bowl with Salmon Skewers, Spinach, Radish & Chili-Garlic Sauce

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, place vinegar, oil, chili-garlic sauce, honey, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end (or corner) firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.

Cut the salmon into 1-inch cubes and thread onto the skewers; place on a plate, drizzle with half of the sauce, and turn to coat. If you don't have skewers, you can cook the salmon directly on the grill pan. (Reserve remaining sauce for later use.)
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, add skewers and grill, turning every 1½-2 minutes, until salmon is opaque and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Using a clean cutting board, trim and thinly slice radishes; place on another clean plate.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds; add to the plate with the radish and set aside.
Add mayo to the bowl with the reserved sauce and whisk to combine.
To serve, divide quinoa between bowls; top with spinach, radish, cucumber, and salmon skewers. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

name: Quinoa Burrito Bowls with Fresh Strawberry Salsa

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, 5 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice onion.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 3 minutes.
Remove stems and roughly chop strawberries; place in a medium bowl.
Add drained beans, frozen corn, broth, and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, about 5 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeño with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl with the strawberries. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the strawberries.
Juice half the lime into the bowl with the strawberries; cut the other half into wedges.
Peel and mince the shallot; add to the bowl. Stir to combine the salsa.
To serve, divide quinoa between bowls, top with bean mixture, salsa, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Quinoa-Butternut Squash Stew with Peanuts, Raisins, Spinach & Cilantro

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out seeds, and small dice. Place in a small bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the squash and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 2 minutes.

Add squash, bell pepper, tomatoes, water, quinoa, and spices to the pan. Stir to combine the stew and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until squash and quinoa are tender, about 20 minutes. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Meanwhile, roughly chop spinach and place in the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the quinoa is tender, add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.

Add peanut butter, additional water, raisins, and half of the cilantro to the stew. Stir to combine and continue to cook until warmed through, about 3 minutes. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Meanwhile, roughly chop peanuts. Slice lime into wedges.
Divide stew between bowls; top with reserved cilantro and peanuts. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing over and enjoy!

name: Quinoa Minestrone with Kale & Crispy Italian-Spiced Chickpeas

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry; transfer to a medium bowl. Add oil and spices to the bowl and toss to combine.

Transfer chickpeas to a baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until crispy, about 20 minutes. Reserve bowl for later use.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off the root ends and the dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ½-inch half-moons; transfer to the medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and slice carrots into ¼-inch rounds. Trim celery and slice crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Transfer both to the bowl with the leeks.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leeks, carrots, celery, and spices to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables begin to soften slightly, 2-3 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic.

Add garlic, broth, tomatoes, and quinoa to the pot and stir to combine; increase the heat to high and bring the liquid to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce the heat to medium-low, cover the pot with a lid, and cook for 7 minutes.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add kale to the pot and cook until kale is soft and quinoa is cooked through, about 7 more minutes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Finely grate Parmesan.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls. Top each bowl with a pile of crispy chickpeas; garnish with parsley, Parmesan, and crushed red pepper. Enjoy!

name: Quinoa Panzanella-Inspired Salad with Salmon, Spinach & Capers

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic. Transfer to a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine dressing.
Peel and small dice onion; add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place salmon, skin-side down, in the skillet. Cook, flipping once, until the flesh is opaque and flaky, 3-5 minutes per side; remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, transfer the cooked quinoa to a baking sheet pan, spread out in an even layer, and cool for 5 minutes.
Remove skin from salmon and use a fork to break the fillet into bite-sized chunks.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the veggies, along with capers and cooled quinoa. Stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide spinach, quinoa salad, and flaked salmon between plates. Enjoy!

name: Quinoa Primavera with Lemony Salmon & Asparagus

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa and broth; bring to a boil.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cover; cook for 15 minutes. Once cooked, remove from the heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Cut the lemon in half; juice one half into a small bowl and cut the other half into four wedges for serving.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
