Place the salmon on a plate, drizzle with half of the lemon juice and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the salmon skin-side-down in the skillet; cook until the flesh is opaque, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Peel and mince the shallot; transfer to a small bowl.
Snap (or cut) off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears on an angle into 2-inch pieces.
Once the salmon has been transferred, add more butter to the skillet, then add the shallot. Cook, stirring frequently, until the shallot is softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the asparagus and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, 5 to 7 minutes.
While the asparagus cooks, shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Once cooked, remove the asparagus from the heat; stir in most of the parsley (save a little for garnishing) and drizzle with the remaining lemon juice.
Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork; add to the asparagus and stir to combine.

Divide the quinoa and asparagus mixture between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container), top with the salmon, and garnish with the remaining parsley. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing over top. Enjoy!

name: Quinoa "Risotto" with Garden Veggies, Basil & Parmesan

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim ends and medium dice eggplant. Transfer to a medium bowl, add salt, and toss to coat; set aside.
Medium dice tomatoes and place in a large bowl.
Seed and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Trim ends and medium dice zucchini; add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince onion and garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic. Stirring frequently, cook until onion begins to soften, 2-3 minutes.

Using a clean towel or paper towel, squeeze the eggplant to release excess moisture. Add eggplant to the skillet along with the chopped veggies, corn, tomato sauce, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies begin to soften, 12-14 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add quinoa and half of the Parmesan; stir to combine.
To serve, divide the risotto between bowls and garnish with remaining Parmesan and basil. Enjoy!

name: Quinoa-Spinach Salad with Shrimp, Strawberries, Basil, Feta & Almonds

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot into half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter strawberries lengthwise; add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Add feta to the bowl and set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Transfer the cooked quinoa to a baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp and season with salt and pepper; cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Add cooled quinoa to the bowl with the dressing and salad fixings; gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide spinach between plates; top with quinoa salad, shrimp, almonds, and reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Quinoa Tabbouleh Salad with Chickpeas & Feta Cheese

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa and broth; bring to a boil.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the quinoa comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the quinoa is boiling, reduce heat to a simmer and cover; cook for 15 minutes. Once cooked, remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Halve the tomatoes lengthwise and transfer to a large bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; medium dice the cucumber and add to the bowl.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Pick the mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas; add to the bowl.
Measure out the feta and add to the bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Peel and mince the garlic.
In a small bowl, combine and whisk together the minced garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork; add to the bowl with the rest of the ingredients.
Add the dressing and toss the salad until well combined.
Divide the salad between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container). Enjoy!

name: Quinoa Tabbouleh Salad with Grape Tomatoes & Cucumber

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, lemon juice, oil, salt, pepper, and cumin.

Wash and dry tomatoes, cucumber, parsley, and mint. Halve and add tomatoes to bowl with dressing. Medium dice and add cucumber to bowl. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems, mince the leaves, and add to bowl. Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems, mince the leaves, and add to bowl.
Uncover quinoa, fluff with a fork, and drain any excess liquid. Add quinoa to bowl and toss salad.
To serve, place salad in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Rainbow Mango Salad with Edamame & Thai Sesame Dressing

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Place frozen edamame in a medium bowl, cover with hot water (from the tap), and let sit 5 minutes. Drain in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice the shallot into half rings; place in a medium salad bowl.
Trim, peel, and coarsely grate the carrots; add to the bowl with the shallots.
Halve the sugar snap peas at an angle and add to the salad bowl.
Halve the tomatoes and add to the salad bowl.
Peel the mango and slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice and place in the salad bowl along with the edamame.
Juice lime over the veggies in the salad bowl.
Coarsely chop the cashews.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and coarsely chop the leaves.
Combine vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, sesame seeds, and crushed red pepper in a small bowl; whisk to combine.
To serve, divide salad between plates, top with cashews and chopped mint. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: Raspberry-Basil Quinoa Spinach Salad with Orange, Pecans & Goat Cheese

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel orange, separate into segments, and roughly chop the flesh. Place in a medium bowl along with the spinach.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the orange and spinach.
Pick basil leaves off the stems. Roll half of the basil leaves up crosswise, thinly slice into ribbons, and add to the bowl. Place remaining (whole) basil leaves in a blender.

Add half of the raspberries to the bowl and set aside. Add remaining raspberries to the blender with the basil along with oil, vinegar, water, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Blend on high until smooth, then set dressing aside.
Transfer the cooked quinoa to a baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop pecans.
Once the quinoa is cool, add to the bowl, along with the pecans, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Crumble goat cheese over top and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: "Ratatouille" Bruschetta with Eggplant, Zucchini, Bell Pepper & Tomato

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and thinly slice garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with tomato sauce, oil, and spices. Stir to combine the sauce.
Trim and medium dice eggplant and zucchini. Add both to the bowl with the sauce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl and stir to combine the ratatouille veggies. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)

Transfer ratatouille veggies to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spice oil.
Arrange bread on another baking sheet and drizzle with spice oil on both sides.
When the veggies are done, place bread in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until toasted, 5-6 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
To serve, divide toast between plates, then top with ratatouille, Parmesan, and reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Red Cabbage, Quinoa & Edamame Salad with Asian Peanut-Herb Dressing

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa, water, and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15-18 minutes. Transfer cooked quinoa to a baking sheet pan and spread out in a thin layer to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Zest and juice lime into a large salad bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger; transfer both to the salad bowl.
Trim and mince green onions; add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts and add half to the bowl (reserve the rest for garnish).
Add soy sauce, oils, and crushed red pepper to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Halve the cabbage lengthwise and cut out the core; thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl with the dressing. Using tongs, toss cabbage with the dressing to thoroughly coat.
Add spinach, edamame, and quinoa to the bowl; toss once more to combine the salad.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with avocado and reserved peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Red Lentil Coconut Curry with Peppers & Avocado

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Peel and mince the garlic and shallot. Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the garlic, shallot, and ginger to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, 2-3 minutes.

Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeño with a spoon. Finely dice (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Small dice the bell pepper. Add the jalapeño, bell pepper, curry powder, and salt to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, 2-3 minutes.

Add the diced tomatoes, coconut milk, and broth to the pot. Stir and bring to a boil over high heat, then add the red lentils. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender, 22-25 minutes.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide the lentil curry between bowls; top with sliced avocado and minced cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Red Lentil Soup with Bacon, Cabbage, Carrots, Celery & Garlic Toast

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Trim and small dice celery; transfer both to a medium bowl.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the veggies.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the pan is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring often, until bacon has released its fat and is starting to brown, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, place lentils in a colander, rinse, and set aside to drain.
Add veggies and spices to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, about 5 minutes.
While the veggies cook, using a clean cutting board, trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise.

Add cabbage, lentils, and broth to the pan; stir to combine, cover, and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to medium-low and continue to simmer, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender, about 15 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and mince additional garlic.
Slice buns in half and place, cut-side up, on a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with garlic and spices.
Place buns in the oven and toast until golden, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with toasted buns on the side. Enjoy!

name: Red Lentil Soup with Sweet Potato, Pear, Coconut Milk & Lime

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Rinse the lentils in a colander or strainer; set aside to drain.
Peel and small dice onion; transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot; add to the bowl with the onion.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, carrot, celery, and spices to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice sweet potato.
Zest lime and then cut into wedges (set wedges aside for serving).
Add lentils, sweet potato, lime zest, broth, and coconut milk to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Peel, quarter, core, and small dice pear; add to the soup. Once the soup comes to a boil, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until veggies and lentils are tender, about 15 minutes.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with lime wedges on the side. Enjoy!

name: Red Lentil Tacos with Veggie-Herb Salad, Quick Pickled Onions & Feta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Peel and slice half the onion into thin half-rings. Small dice remaining onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Place sliced onion in a small bowl along with vinegar and salt. Toss to combine and set aside.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat. Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add diced onion and garlic to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until onion begins to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Rinse lentils under cold water and add to the pan along with the broth. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Juice lemon into a large bowl. Add olive oil and salt; stir to combine.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop arugula and add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumber and tomatoes; add to the bowl.
Halve olives and add to bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Once lentils are done, drain off excess liquid and return to pan. Add paprika and salt; stir to combine.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates and fill with lentils. Top with salad, pickled onions, and feta. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Rib Eye Steak with Buttery Sautéed Mixed Vegetables

instructions.text: Wash green beans, carrot, and bell pepper.
Trim green bean ends and transfer to a large bowl. Seed and slice pepper into strips lengthwise; add to bowl. Trim ends, peel, and thinly slice carrot on the diagonal; add to bowl.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Season steak with salt and pepper on both sides.
Coat grill or skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Heat a separate skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Melt butter in skillet and add garlic; cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add vegetables and cook, stirring often, until tender-crisp, 5-6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Serve steak with sautéed vegetables on the side. Enjoy!

name: Ribeye with Lemony Arugula, Sun-Dried Tomato & Shaved Parmesan Salad

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile wash, dry, zest, and juice half of the lemon into a medium bowl. Cut remaining lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Add to the bowl.
Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl and gently toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Divide steak and salad between plates or bowls. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing over the steak. Enjoy!

name: Ribeye with Maple Balsamic Shallots & Cucumber-Tomato Salad

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with capers, and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
Peel, halve, and slice shallots crosswise into thin half-moons.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallots, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add vinegar and maple syrup to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring often, until liquid is reduced and shallots are soft, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates. Top steak with shallots and enjoy!

name: Ribeye with Spicy "Cowboy" Butter, Butternut Squash & Brussels Sprouts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim and halve Brussels sprouts lengthwise. Add to the baking sheet with the squash.
Zest lemon into a small bowl (set aside for later use). Juice lemon over the veggies, then season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Cut butter into small pieces and sprinkle over the veggies.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until the veggies are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the pan is hot, coat with butter. Add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
While the steak is cooking, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the lemon zest.
Cut additional butter into small pieces and add to the bowl along with Dijon and spices. Mash with the back of a spoon to combine the "cowboy" butter.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates. Top steak with cowboy butter and enjoy!

name: Ribeye with Spicy Cucumber-Avocado Salad & Orange Soy Dressing

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice orange into a medium bowl. Add oil, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons and add to the bowl.  (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Trim and slice radishes into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad between plates and top with steak. Enjoy!

name: Ribeye Steak with Apricot-Onion Sauté, Roast Potatoes & Asparagus

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, and halve new potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until potatoes start to soften, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 3-inch long pieces. Place in a medium bowl, along with oil, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)

When the potatoes have started to soften, remove baking sheet from the oven, add asparagus, and toss to combine. Return baking sheet to oven and continue to roast until veggies are golden and fork-tender, 10 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into thin strips. Place in a small bowl.
Thinly slice apricots. Add to the bowl with the onion.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, apricots, garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak, potatoes, and asparagus between plates; top steak with apricot-onion sauté. Enjoy!

name: Ribeye Steak with Asparagus, Almond & Goat Cheese Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears into 2-inch pieces at an angle. Transfer to a medium bowl and set aside.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add the almonds. Cook, stirring frequently to avoid burning, until fragrant and lightly toasted, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a small bowl.
Once the almonds have been transferred, increase the heat to medium-high. Add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, uncover and season with salt. Add the asparagus and cook until bright green, 2 to 4 minutes (depending on the thickness of the spears). Drain in a colander and run under cold water to stop the cooking process. Set aside to drain further.
Grate all of the zest from the lemon, then juice it. Add the zest and juice to the bowl that held the asparagus.
To the lemon zest and juice, add olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the asparagus to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Crumble goat cheese into a small bowl.
To serve, divide the steak and asparagus between plates, then top the asparagus with the crumbled goat cheese and toasted almonds.

name: Ribeye Steak, Grape Tomato & Mushroom Kebabs

instructions.text: Peel and mince the garlic. Wash and dry the parsley. Shave the leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
In a large bowl, whisk together the minced garlic, ½ of the minced parsley (save the rest for garnishing), olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Cut the steak into cubes; transfer to the bowl with the marinade and toss to coat.

Wash the tomatoes and mushrooms. Halve the mushrooms. Add the tomatoes and mushrooms to the marinade. Peel the onion and cut into chunks; add to the marinade. Toss beef and vegetables until well coated.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Thread the steak and vegetables onto 6 skewers. Alternatively, you can cook the steak and vegetable pieces directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.
Add the kebabs (as many as will fit) to the grill or skillet. Cook until steak is browned and vegetables are tender, 3-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining kebabs.
To serve, place kebabs on a plate and sprinkle with the remaining minced parsley. Enjoy!

name: Ribeye Steak with Orange, Ginger & Kale Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil and position a rack under the broiler; position a second rack in the bottom portion of the oven and place a baking sheet on it to preheat.
While the oven heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Wash and dry the fresh produce (skip the broccoli slaw if it came pre-washed).
Peel and mince or grate the ginger; place in a medium salad bowl and add peanut butter, chili garlic sauce, honey, and salt.
Juice orange into the salad bowl and whisk to combine the dressing.

Carefully remove the baking sheet from the oven and use tongs to transfer steak onto it. Place under broiler on top rack and cook 6-7 minutes for medium rare, flipping once halfway through. Transfer steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the salad bowl; add broccoli slaw.
Drizzle any pan juices over the salad and toss with salad dressing to combine.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls along with steak strips. Enjoy!

name: Ribeye Steak with Roasted Mushroom & Sun-Dried Tomato Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Quarter mushrooms and transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the baking sheet with the mushrooms. Drizzle with oil and vinegar, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring once, until mushrooms are browned and tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add additional oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice shallot crosswise into thin half-moons. Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Place both in a small bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the shallot and sun-dried tomato.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl and stir to combine.
Once the mushrooms are tender, remove from oven and top with the Parmesan mixture. Return to the oven and continue to roast until Parmesan has melted, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, thinly slice steak.
Once the Parmesan has melted, remove mushrooms from oven. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with steak. Enjoy!

name: Ribeye Steak with Roasted Radishes, Carrots & Artichoke Chimichurri

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and trim carrots; slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim off and discard tops and root ends of radishes; halve and add to the pan with the carrots. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are tender, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board and let rest 5 minutes.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, halve chili pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the pepper with a spoon. Mince and place in a small bowl. (Be careful, with chili peppers, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Drain and mince artichokes. Add to the bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices; stir to combine the chimichurri.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates. Spoon chimichurri over the steak and enjoy!

name: Ribeye Steak with Sweet Potato Wedges & Arugula-Walnut Salad

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place the rack in the center position. Place a baking sheet in the oven to warm up.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Cut the sweet potatoes into ½-inch-thick wedges (about 8 to 10 wedges per potato). Remove the baking sheet from the oven and transfer the potatoes to it.
Drizzle the potatoes with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then spread out in a single layer.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the potatoes in the oven and bake for 10 minutes, then flip them over and continue to bake until they are tender, another 5 to 10 minutes.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat dry the steak with paper towels and place on a plate. Season the steak generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
Once the steak is done, in a salad bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and Dijon.
Roughly chop the walnuts and add to the salad bowl.
Add the arugula to the salad bowl and toss to coat.
To serve, arrange the steak, sweet potato wedges, and the arugula-walnut salad on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Rice Noodle Salad with Shrimp, Cabbage, Carrots & Crispy Shallots

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes (or prepare according to package instructions). Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, if using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, then season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until just cooked through and starting to color, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips.

Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and starting to crisp, 3-4 minutes. Transfer shallots to a paper towel-lined plate.
While the shallots are cooking, peel and mince ginger. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the ginger. Add mayo, soy sauce, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Halve cabbage lengthwise, cut out the core, and slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and halve carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add drained noodles and shrimp to the bowl, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide noodle salad between plates or bowls; top with crispy shallots and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Rich Cauliflower Mac & Cheese with Sausage

instructions.text: Wash cauliflower and cut off the leaves. Separate into small florets and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a medium saucepan.
Add hot water (from the tap) to the pan, so that the cauliflower is just covered. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cook until fork-tender, 4-5 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, roughly chop the sausage.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add the sausage. Cook, stirring often, until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Once done, transfer to a plate and reduce heat to low.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, wash, dry, and chop chives into small pieces; set aside.
Coarsely grate cheddar. Finely grate Parmesan.
Peel and mince garlic.
Melt more butter in skillet. Add garlic and stir until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Stir in cream, Dijon, paprika, and pepper.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: When the cream is warmed, add cheddar and Parmesan. Cook, stirring well, until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Add cauliflower to the cheese sauce and stir until well coated. Sprinkle with sausage and chives. Enjoy!

name: Ricotta Flatbread with Mushrooms, Leeks & Garlic-Parsley Gremolata

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the baking sheet with the leeks. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are golden and tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest lemon into a small bowl. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon zest.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl, along with salt, and stir to combine the gremolata. Set aside.
Place ricotta, salt, and pepper in another small bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
Carefully remove cooked veggies from the baking sheet by lifting the corners of the foil and transferring the whole sheet to a flat surface. (Reserve baking sheet for later use.)
Change oven to broil on high.
Arrange flatbreads on the reserved baking sheet. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lemon over veggies and stir to combine.
When the flatbreads are done, spread the ricotta over each flatbread, then top with roasted veggies and gremolata.
To serve, cut flatbreads into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Ricotta Flatbread with Roast Strawberries, Prosciutto & Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place oven racks in the upper and middle positions.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and quarter strawberries lengthwise. Transfer to a small baking dish and spread out in an even layer.

Place baking dish on the upper rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until strawberries are soft, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, zest lemon into a small bowl. Add ricotta, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine; set aside. (Reserve lemon for later use.)

When the strawberries have about 10 minutes left, arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place on the lower rack and bake, flipping halfway through, until flatbreads are slightly crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice reserved lemon into the bowl with the shallot. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat. Set aside.
Chop (or tear) prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
Spread the lemon ricotta over each flatbread, then top with roasted strawberries and prosciutto. Cut flatbreads into wedges.
To serve, divide flatbreads and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Ricotta & Spinach Pasta with Toasted Pine Nuts

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the onion.
Finely grate ½ cup of Parmesan. Transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.

When the water in the saucepan comes to a boil, uncover the pan and season the water with salt, then add the pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook the pasta, uncovered, for 11 to 12 minutes (or according to package directions). Once cooked, drain the pasta in a colander, reserving ½ cup of the cooking water.
Add the pine nuts to the pan; cook, stirring constantly, until they are golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl.
Once the pine nuts have been transferred, add olive oil to the pan and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the onion and garlic to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until the onion is softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Add the spinach to the pan and season the mixture with salt and pepper; cook, tossing frequently, until the spinach is wilted, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the ricotta to the pan and stir until it is thoroughly mixed with the spinach.
amounts: ¼ (15 oz) pkg (½ cup) ricotta cheese

instructions.text: Add the pasta, about ½ of the Parmesan, and reserved cooking water to the pan; cook, stirring constantly, until the pasta is well combined, 1 to 2 minutes.
To serve, divide the pasta between bowls, garnish with the remaining Parmesan, and sprinkle with the toasted pine nuts. Enjoy!

name: Ricotta & Spinach Stuffed Zucchini "Cannelloni" with Tomato Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Coarsely grate mozzarella. Finely grate Parmesan.

When the water in the pot comes to a boil, remove lid, add the spinach and stir for a few seconds. Cook the spinach, uncovered, until wilted, 30-60 seconds. Once done, drain the spinach in a colander and rinse under cold water.
Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can, then transfer to a cutting board. Roughly chop spinach and transfer a medium bowl.
Add basil, ricotta, egg, salt, pepper, Parmesan, and half of the mozzarella to the bowl with the spinach. Stir until well combined.
Peel and mince or press garlic.
Pour tomato sauce into a baking dish. Add garlic, tomato paste, and Italian seasoning; stir until combined.
Trim ends from zucchini; use a knife or vegetable peeler to slice zucchini lengthwise into very thin slices.

Place a heaping tablespoon of the ricotta mixture at one end of each zucchini slice. Roll up the slices and place in the baking dish with the tomato sauce, leaving at least a ½-inch space between rolls.
Sprinkle remaining mozzarella over top of the cannelloni.
Place in the oven and bake until cooked through, 15-18 minutes.
To serve, divide cannelloni and sauce between plates and enjoy!

name: Roast Butternut Squash with Fresh Mozzarella & Couscous-Arugula Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Trim butternut squash ends, halve crosswise, then cut each piece in half lengthwise; scoop out the seeds. Rub the inside of each squash piece with oil and season with salt and pepper; arrange pieces, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
While the squash is roasting, place couscous in a medium bowl.

Pour broth into a skillet, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from heat, pour into the bowl with the couscous, and stir (reserve skillet for later use). Tightly cover the bowl with foil and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion crosswise; trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the veggies are cooking, thinly slice mozzarella.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: When the squash is done, remove from the oven and turn the pieces over, cut-side facing up. Change the oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Divide mozzarella between squash pieces and return to the oven; broil until mozzarella is golden and melted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add cooked veggies, basil, arugula, pine nuts, and vinegar to the bowl with the couscous. Stir to combine the couscous salad.
To serve, divide butternut squash and couscous salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Roast Chicken Thighs with Oregano Aioli & Beet-Cucumber Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and medium dice beets; place in a small saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with mayo and spices. Stir to combine the aioli.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until beets are fork-tender, 12-14 minutes.

While the beets are cooking, pat chicken dry with paper towels and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Remove half of the aioli and divide between the chicken, spreading evenly over each thigh; season with salt and pepper. (Reserve remaining aioli for serving.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until chicken is cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; add to the bowl and set aside.
When the beets are done, drain and run under cold water to cool; set aside to drain further.
Just before serving, add beets and feta to the bowl with the dressing; stir to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates; top chicken with reserved aioli. Enjoy!

name: Roast Chicken Thighs with Tomato-Zucchini Couscous & Goat Cheese

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
In a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous and salt, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and large dice onion; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the baking sheet with the onion, along with the tomatoes.
Peel and mince garlic; sprinkle over the veggies, then drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides. Add chicken to the baking sheet and nestle into the veggies.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, roughly chop olives; pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add both to the pan with the couscous.
Juice lemon into the pan and stir to combine. Cover to keep warm.
Just before serving, transfer roasted veggies to the saucepan with the couscous and stir to combine.
To serve, divide veggie couscous and chicken thighs between plates; crumble goat cheese over couscous. Enjoy!

name: Roast Potatoes with Bell Pepper, Chicken, Swiss Chard & Paprika Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve new potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper; add to the baking sheet with the potatoes.
Peel, halve, and large dice onion; add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until potatoes are golden and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, water, and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the sauce and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in another small bowl, reserving stems for the next step. (Set leaves aside for later use.)
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chard stems, chicken, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
When the chicken is done, add chard leaves to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Remove skillet from the heat, add half of the cilantro, and stir to combine. Cover with a lid to keep warm. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
To serve, divide roasted veggies and chicken sauté between plates or bowls. Drizzle with sauce and top with reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Roast Salmon with Quinoa, Carrots, Beets & Cilantro-Tahini Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and cut beets into ½-inch cubes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and roast, stirring halfway through, until starting to soften, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Trim and cut green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; transfer both to a small saucepan.
Add water, quinoa, and salt to the saucepan, stir to combine, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
While the quinoa is cooking, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer half to a blender (place remaining cilantro in a medium bowl and set aside).

Peel additional garlic; add to the blender along with water, tahini, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Blend on high until smooth, adding additional water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place on a plate; coat both sides with oil and season the top side with salt and pepper.

Remove baking sheet from the oven, stir the beets, and push to one side. Place salmon on the other side of the baking sheet and return to the oven. Bake until salmon is cooked through and beets are tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and coarsely grate the carrots. Add to the bowl with the remaining cilantro.
When the quinoa is done, add to the bowl and stir to combine.
To serve, divide the quinoa mixture between plates; top with roasted beets, salmon, and cilantro-tahini sauce. Enjoy!

name: Roast Spaghetti Squash with Turkey-Bell Pepper Sauté & Peanut Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim spaghetti squash, halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lime into a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with peanut butter, water, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, and spices. Whisk to combine the peanut sauce and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, turkey, salt, and pepper; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Add half of the peanut sauce to the skillet and stir to combine. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm. (Reserve remaining peanut sauce for serving.)

Remove squash from the oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand.)
To serve, divide squash and turkey sauté between plates or bowls. Drizzle with reserved peanut sauce and enjoy!

name: Roast Sweet Potato, White Bean, Cucumber, Feta & Olive Salad with Mint

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potato. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potato is browned and fork-tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve olives lengthwise and add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Halve lettuce lengthwise, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
When the sweet potato is cool, add to the bowl, along with feta, then gently stir to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Asparagus with Fried Eggs & Homemade Romesco Sauce

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash, dry, and snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus and transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Wash, dry, trim, seed, and thinly slice bell pepper; add to the baking sheet with the asparagus. Drizzle veggies with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to coat.
Place veggies in the oven and roast until slightly charred and fork-tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes.
While the eggs are cooking, peel and mince garlic; transfer to a blender.
Add roasted peppers, sun-dried tomatoes, almonds, oil, vinegar, and paprika to the blender. Blend until smooth.
To serve, divide asparagus, eggs, and Romesco sauce between plates. Top with feta and enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Roasted Asparagus & Poached Eggs with Lemon Feta Vinaigrette

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together the minced garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Measure out feta into a small bowl and set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash asparagus and snap (or cut) off woody ends. Place in a single layer on the baking sheet; drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place in the oven and roast until tender, 10-12 minutes.
Fill a sauté pan three-quarters of the way with water and bring to a boil.
Crack 2 of the eggs into small bowls.

Once water in pan is boiling, reduce heat to medium-low. When the water is simmering, gently tip bowl, sliding egg carefully into the water. Repeat with other egg. Cook until whites are set but yolks are soft, 2 ½ to 3 minutes. Transfer eggs to paper towels. Repeat with the remaining 2 eggs.
To serve, arrange roasted asparagus on a plate and top with poached eggs. Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with feta. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Balsamic-Rosemary Chicken, Zucchini & Grapes with Couscous

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Slide rosemary leaves off the sprigs; discard sprigs and mince the leaves. Place leaves in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the rosemary along with vinegar, oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Add chicken to the marinade, turn to coat, and set aside.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Transfer to a large baking dish along with the grapes.
Using tongs, add chicken to the baking dish, nestling it into the zucchini and grapes. Drizzle any marinade in the bowl over the dish.

Place baking dish in the oven and roast, stirring zucchini and grapes and flipping chicken halfway through, until grapes are bursting and chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, divide chicken, zucchini, grapes, and couscous between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Beet, Apple & Spinach Salad with Honey-Dijon Vinaigrette

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash, trim ends, peel, and medium dice beets. Transfer to a sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to coat.
Place in the oven and roast until beets are tender, about 20 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Wash and dry spinach. Wash, core and slice apple into thin wedges. Transfer both to a large bowl.
Shell pistachios. Crumble goat cheese into a small bowl.
Remove beets from oven and add to bowl with spinach and apple. Toss salad.
To serve, place salad on a plate, sprinkle with pistachios and goat cheese, and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Broccoli Pasta with Lemon, Mint, Pistachios & Parmesan

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until the broccoli is starting to soften, 6-7 minutes.

While the broccoli is roasting, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop pistachios.
Once the broccoli has started to soften, remove from the oven. Sprinkle with pistachios, stir to combine, and spread out in an even layer.
Return baking sheet to the oven. Continue to roast until broccoli is tender and lightly charred and pistachios are toasted, 10-12 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan and place in a small bowl.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the Parmesan.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl along with the spices. (Reserve remaining mint for serving.)
When the pasta is done, reserve a ⅓-cup of cooking water, then drain. Return pasta and reserved cooking water to the pot.

Add roasted broccoli, pistachios, and Parmesan mixture to the pot. Set the pot over medium-high heat and cook, stirring often, until liquid has evaporated and Parmesan is melted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and sprinkle with reserved mint. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Broccoli Salad with Beans, Peppers, Pickled Onions & Pine Nuts

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets. Add to the baking sheet with the bell pepper, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are starting to char, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add pine nuts and cook, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Transfer to another small bowl and set aside to cool.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add cooled veggies, pickled onions, pine nuts, and feta to the bowl. Gently stir to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Brussels Sprout, Kale & Apple Salad with Honey-Dijon Dressing

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim ends and halve Brussels sprouts. Place in a large bowl.
Add oil and salt to the bowl and toss to coat. Transfer Brussels sprouts to a baking sheet pan in a single layer and place in the oven. Roast, tossing once, until fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into the bowl used for the Brussels sprouts.
Peel and mince garlic, then add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Add mayo, oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper to the bowl and whisk to combine the dressing.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl. Using your hands, massage the dressing into the kale.
Core and small dice apple, then add to the bowl.
Trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces and add to the bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan.
When the Brussels sprouts are done, remove from oven and sprinkle with Parmesan. Set aside to cool slightly and allow cheese to melt, about 5 minutes.
Add cranberries, pumpkin seeds, and Brussels sprouts to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between bowls and enjoy!

name: Roasted Carrot, Lentil & Feta Salad with Butter Lettuce

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F and position rack in the centre.
Rinse lentils under cold water and transfer to a small saucepan. Cover with broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and, stirring occasionally, cook until just tender, 15-20 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash carrots, trim ends, and peel. Halve lengthwise and thinly slice on the diagonal into ¼ inch thick half rounds; transfer to a baking sheet.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings; add to sheet.
Drizzle carrots and onion with olive oil and season with cumin, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
Place carrots in the oven and roast, tossing halfway through cooking, until tender, 10-15 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a salad bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together the minced garlic, olive oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Wash and dry lettuce. Tear into smaller pieces and add to salad bowl.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to salad bowl.
Assemble salad by adding carrots and lentils to salad bowl and tossing.
Serve by placing salad on a plate and sprinkle with feta. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Roasted Carrot-Onion Couscous Bowl with Kale & Turmeric Dressing

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the baking sheet with the carrots, drizzle with oil, and season with salt. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are golden brown and tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the veggies are roasting, in a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, juice lemon into a small bowl. Add tahini, water, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl and sprinkle with salt.
Add half of the dressing to the bowl with the kale and, using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes. (Reserve remaining dressing for serving.)
Roughly chop dates. Transfer to a plate.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the plate with the dates.
Crumble goat cheese onto the plate.
To serve, divide couscous between bowls; top with kale, roasted veggies, dates, pistachios, and goat cheese. Drizzle with reserved dressing and enjoy!

name: Roasted Carrot Salad with Lentils, Arugula, Pumpkin Seeds, Mint & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).

Using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, cover, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove lid, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces. Transfer to the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with spices. Toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast carrots, stirring halfway through, until golden brown and fork-tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the carrots are roasting, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot into half-moons; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl and stir to combine.
When the lentils are done, drain in a colander, rinse with cold water, and add to the bowl.
Just before serving, add roasted carrots, arugula, and pumpkin seeds to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with feta. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Roasted Cauliflower & Black Bean Burrito Bowl with Cilantro Lime Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Remove leaves and thick stems from cauliflower; cut into bite-sized florets and set aside.
In a small bowl, combine the spices.

Place the cauliflower on the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with half of the seasoning mixture; toss to coat. Spread out in a single layer. Place in the oven and roast for 20 minutes, flipping once halfway through.
Small dice the onion.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Drain and rinse the black beans in a colander.
Add the black beans, corn, and the rest of the seasoning mixture to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until the corn is softened, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Small dice the tomato.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. When the rice is finished, add half of the cilantro to the rice.
Juice half of the lime into the rice and stir to combine. Slice the rest of the lime into wedges for garnish.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls. Top with cauliflower, bean mixture, diced tomatoes, cilantro, avocado slices, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Cauliflower, Chickpea, Corn & Avocado Burrito with Cilantro

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine. Set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with half of the spice mix; stir to coat and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve remaining spice mix for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until cauliflower is golden and tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
While the onion is cooking, drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the onion is soft, add chickpeas, cilantro, corn, and reserved spice mix to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until corn and beans are warmed through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, small dice tomato.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Separate lettuce into leaves.

Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide roasted cauliflower and bean-corn filling down the center of each one. Top with tomatoes, avocado slices, and lettuce. Fold in sides of tortillas and roll tightly to close the burritos.
To serve, cut burritos in half and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Cauliflower Tacos with Broccoli-Mango Slaw & Cilantro Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Add oil and spices to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the spice oil.

Cut leaves from the cauliflower, separate into bite-sized florets, and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces; add to the bowl with the spice oil and toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until cauliflower is golden brown and tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Small dice and place in the reserved bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Small dice and add to the bowl with the mango. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the bowl. (Place remaining cilantro in a small bowl and set aside for the sauce.)
Juice half of the lime into the bowl with the mango. Add broccoli slaw, pumpkin seeds, and salt; toss to combine the slaw and set aside. (Reserve remaining lime for the next step.)
