Juice reserved lime into the bowl with the cilantro; add yogurt and salt. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with slaw, cauliflower, and sauce. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Chicken Thighs with Grapes, Mashed Potatoes & Dressed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook until golden, about 2 minutes per side (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Remove to a plate (reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use).
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Place in a small bowl.
Slide rosemary leaves off the sprigs; discard sprigs and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the shallot.

Place shallot, rosemary, and grapes in the reserved skillet and stir to combine. Add chicken, nestling it into the grapes. Place skillet in the oven and roast until chicken is cooked through and grapes are softened, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
When the potatoes are tender, drain in a colander and return to the pan; add milk, salt, and pepper. Using a potato masher, mash until smooth. Cover to keep warm and set aside.
When the chicken is done, add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
To serve, divide mashed potatoes and greens between plates. Top potatoes with roasted chicken and grapes. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Chickpea & Tomato Salad with Arugula & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings. Wash and halve tomatoes.
Place chickpeas, onion, and tomatoes on a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat.
Place in the oven and roast until chickpeas are golden and tomatoes begin to collapse, 10-15 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Wash and dry arugula. Transfer to a large bowl.
Add chickpeas, onion, tomatoes, and feta to bowl with arugula and toss.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, arrange salad on a plate and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Chickpeas, Brussels Sprouts & Carrots with Polenta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 500°F. Lightly coat a baking sheet with olive oil.

In a small saucepan, bring broth and water to a boil. Reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta in a thin steady stream, while whisking constantly, until the polenta is incorporated into the liquid. Cook, stirring occasionally, until grains are soft and the texture is creamy, 15-25 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and quarter Brussels sprouts. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Trim and peel carrots; halve lengthwise and cut into ¼-inch-thick pieces on an angle. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas; place on a clean towel (or paper towels) and pat dry. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Toss the vegetables and chickpeas and spread out evenly on the sheet. Place in the oven and roast until the vegetables are tender and chickpeas are golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes.
Slide the thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems and chop the leaves.
Peel and mince the garlic.
In a small bowl, combine and whisk together the thyme, garlic, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Remove the sheet from the oven. Pour the sauce over the vegetables and chickpeas; toss to coat.
Place the sheet back in the oven and continue to cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes more.
Add oil to the polenta and season with salt and pepper; stir to combine.
Divide the polenta between plates and top with the roasted vegetables and chickpeas. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Corn & Bean Tostadas with Broccoli Slaw

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
Remove the husks from the corn and brush with oil. Place on the top rack in the oven and cook for 6-8 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the corn begins to turn golden brown.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. Skip the broccoli slaw if it came pre-washed.
Small dice the tomato and set aside.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.
When the corn is done cooking, remove from oven and let cool for 5-6 minutes, until slightly warm to the touch.
Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Drizzle both sides of the tortillas with oil and sprinkle with salt; place in a single layer on baking sheet. Bake for 10-15 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the tortillas are crispy and lightly browned on both sides.
While tortillas bake, drain and rinse the beans in a colander; add to a medium bowl.
Juice one lime into the bowl with the beans.
Add oil, spices, and water to the bowl. Use a fork or potato masher to mash the mixture until smooth.
When the tortillas are done, remove from the oven and set aside.
Stand corn upright on a cutting board and use a sharp knife to carefully cut kernels off of the cob.
Cut the remaining lime into wedges.
To assemble, top the tortillas with bean mixture, tomatoes, broccoli slaw, roasted corn, and cilantro. Garnish with a lime wedge and enjoy!

name: Roasted Cremini Mushrooms with Creamy Parmesan Polenta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.

In a small saucepan, bring broth and water to a boil. Gradually add polenta in a thin steady steam, while whisking constantly until all the polenta is incorporated into the liquid. Lower heat to medium-low and, stirring frequently, cook until polenta thickens, 25-30 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, whisk together garlic, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Wash, dry, and quarter mushrooms. Transfer to a sheet pan, pour sauce over top, and toss to coat.
Place in the oven and, stirring halfway through, cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Grate ½ cup Parmesan.
Add butter, Parmesan, salt, and pepper to polenta. Stir to combine.
Remove mushrooms from oven, sprinkle with parsley, and toss to coat.
To serve, place polenta in a bowl and top with mushrooms. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Eggplant Flatbread with Mozzarella, Basil & Lemony Arugula

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and cut eggplant into ¾-inch cubes; transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; toss to coat, then spread out in a single layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until eggplant is soft and browned, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, arrange flatbreads on another baking sheet. Place in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
While the flatbreads are toasting, juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Place tomato sauce and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine and set aside.
Coarsely grate mozzarella.
When the eggplant is done, prepare the flatbreads. Spread tomato sauce over each flatbread; top with mozzarella and eggplant.
Return flatbreads to the oven and bake until warmed through and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Slice flatbreads, divide between plates, and sprinkle with basil. Serve with lemony arugula on the side and enjoy!

name: Roasted Eggplant Pasta Alla Norma

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and large dice eggplant. Transfer to a sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with oregano, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
Place in the oven and, stirring halfway though, bake until softened and browned, about 20 minutes.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 6 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) linguine pasta

instructions.text: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and mince onion and garlic.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 4-5 minutes.
amounts: about 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry basil. Pick leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add garlic and pepper to pan. Stir until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, vinegar, sugar, spices, and ½ of the basil (save the rest for garnishing). Cook for 4-6 minutes.
Shave or grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
Drain pasta and add to pan with tomatoes. Add eggplant and toss to combine.
To serve, place pasta in a shallow bowl or on a plate. Garnish with remaining basil and sprinkle with Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Eggplant Pitas with Tzatziki & Quick Pickled Onions

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Large dice the eggplant. Transfer to a parchment lined sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt, pepper, and oregano; toss to coat. Bake for 20 minutes.
Use a grater to coarsely grate the cucumber. Transfer to a medium bowl. Add the salt, stir, and let sit for 5 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings. Add to a small bowl along with the vinegar and salt. Toss to combine and set aside.
Halve and thinly slice the tomato.
Shave leaves off the parsley stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.

Gather the grated cucumber in the middle of a clean dish towel and gently squeeze out the water. Add the cucumber back to the medium bowl. Stir in the minced garlic, yogurt, salt, and dill. Juice the lemon and add to the mixture. Set aside.
To assemble, slice the pita bread into halves and open the pocket. Stuff with roasted eggplant, sliced tomato, onion, parsley, and cucumber sauce. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Fennel-Quinoa Salad with Arugula, Dates, Pistachios & Feta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.

Place fennel in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until slightly browned and tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Trim and halve radishes, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop dates and pistachios. Add both to the bowl.
Transfer the cooked quinoa to another baking sheet. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes.
Add cooled fennel and quinoa to the bowl, along with arugula and feta, then toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Garlic, Mushroom & Cauliflower Fettuccine with Walnuts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Quarter mushrooms and add to the baking sheet with the cauliflower. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to combine; spread out in an even layer.
Peel garlic, place in the center of a small square of aluminum foil, and drizzle with oil; fold foil around garlic to close the packet. Add to the baking sheet with the veggies.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing veggies halfway through, until golden brown and tender (and garlic is soft), 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.

While the veggies are roasting, fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and return pasta to the pan. (Reserve ½-cup pasta cooking water.)
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Small dice tomato; add to the bowl with the parsley.
Finely grate Parmesan; add to the bowl.
Once the garlic is ready, carefully open the packet; use a fork to mash the roasted garlic. Add to the bowl.

Juice lemon into the pan with the pasta; add roasted veggies, parsley, tomato, Parmesan, roasted garlic, and reserved pasta water. Return to low heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta is heated through and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop walnuts.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and top with chopped walnuts. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Garlic Rosemary Chicken & Pears with Butternut Squash Mash

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, mix together ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the mash), oil, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Place chicken in bowl and toss to coat.
Wash, core, and slice pears into wedges.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water and bring to a boil.
Transfer chicken and pears to a baking dish. Place in the oven and roast for 15 minutes. Then broil until lightly browned, an additional 3-4 minutes.
Wash and peel squash. Halve, scrape out and discard the seeds, and medium dice the flesh.
Add squash to saucepan once water is boiling. Cook until very tender, 10-12 minutes.
Drain and return back to saucepan. Add broth, oil, salt, pepper, and remaining garlic. Mash until smooth.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, arrange squash mash on a plate and place chicken thighs and pears on top. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Halibut with Asparagus, Tomatoes & Lemon-Caper Dill Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut butter into small pieces and place in a small bowl; set aside.

Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus; halve tomatoes. Transfer both to a baking sheet pan, spreading them out in an even layer. Season with salt and pepper, then sprinkle ⅓ of the butter over veggies.
Place baking sheet on lower rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until crisp-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, pat halibut dry with paper towels, cut into portions (if necessary), and transfer to another baking sheet. Season with spices, then sprinkle ½ of the remaining butter over fish.
Place baking sheet on upper rack of the oven and roast until fish is cooked through, about 12 minutes. Remove from the oven.
While the fish is roasting, preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add remaining butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Zest and juice lemon into the pan with the garlic; add cream, capers, salt, and pepper. Bring sauce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Meanwhile, using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Add half of the dill (reserving the rest for garnish) to the sauce and stir to combine.
To serve, divide fish and veggies between plates; spoon sauce over fish and sprinkle with reserved dill. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Indian-Spiced Drumsticks with Carrot Raita & Garlic Broccoli

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Place spices in a large bowl and stir to combine.
Add chicken to the bowl with the spice mix and toss to thoroughly coat; transfer to the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 30-35 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; transfer to a small bowl. Add yogurt, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the raita and set aside.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim green onions and slice crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, green onions, and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add broccoli and water to the skillet; cook, stirring often, until the broccoli is bright green and fork-tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide spiced drumsticks, broccoli, and carrot raita between plates. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Moroccan-Spiced Drumsticks with Kale, Parsley & Feta Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl, along with oil and spices, and whisk to combine the marinade.
Add chicken to the bowl with the marinade and turn to coat. Transfer drumsticks to the baking sheet, spreading them out in a single layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, turning once, until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 30-35 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a clean medium bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Finely chop leaves and add to the bowl with the dressing; using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes; add to the bowl, along with feta, and toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Paprika Chicken Thighs with Carrots & Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash potatoes and carrots. Large dice the potatoes. Halve carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thirds. Transfer to a sheet pan.
Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Place in the oven and roast while you prepare the chicken, 5-10 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season chicken with paprika, salt, and pepper.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until browned, 1-2 minutes per side.
Remove sheet from oven and place chicken in the middle. Return to oven and roast until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender, 10-15 minutes.
Wash and dry thyme. Slide leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
Remove sheet from oven and sprinkle with thyme; toss to coat.
To serve, place chicken and vegetables on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Red Cabbage-Chard Salad with Chickpeas, Pumpkin Seeds & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Halve cabbage lengthwise, cut out the core, and slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips; transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until cabbage is just tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and soft, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves and stems into bite-sized pieces; place both in a medium bowl and set aside.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Set aside to drain further.
When the onion is golden, add vinegar, honey, garlic powder, and pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, for 30 seconds. Remove from heat and set onion dressing aside.

When the cabbage is just tender, remove from the oven. Add chard to the baking sheet, stir to combine, then spread back out in an even layer. Return to the oven and continue to roast until cabbage and chard are very tender, 6-8 minutes more. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl along with chickpeas, onion dressing, cranberries, and pumpkin seeds.
When the cabbage and chard are done, remove from oven. Add to the bowl with the chickpeas and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with feta and enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Roasted Red Pepper & Goat Cheese Flatbread with Lemony Arugula

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Place oven racks in the upper and middle positions.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the baking sheet with the peppers, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet on the upper rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until peppers are browned and fork-tender, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, arrange flatbreads on another baking sheet. Place on the lower rack and bake, flipping halfway through, until flatbreads are slightly crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the flatbreads are baking, juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
When the flatbreads are almost done, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat. Set aside.
Spread goat cheese over each flatbread, then top with roasted peppers and a small handful of arugula. (Reserve remaining arugula for serving.)
To serve, divide flatbreads and remaining arugula between plates. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Root Vegetable Salad with Goat Cheese & Walnuts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 475°F and position rack in the centre. Place a baking sheet pan in the oven to warm up.
Peel, cut into thin wedges, and transfer onion to a large bowl.
Wash and dry beets, carrots, celery, potato, and thyme.

Peel and cut beets into thin wedges; add to bowl with onion. Peel and cut carrots diagonally into ¼ inch thick rounds; add to bowl. Cut celery crosswise into ¼ inch thick pieces; add to bowl. Cut potato into thin wedges; add to bowl. Slide leaves off most of the thyme stems (saving a couple stems for garnishing); add to bowl.
Drizzle vegetables with olive oil and season with salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
Remove sheet from oven and, using a paper towel, rub with a little olive oil. Place vegetables on sheet and spread out. Place in the oven and roast until vegetables are tender, 15-20 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Roughly chop walnuts.
Add walnuts to skillet and, stirring constantly, cook until toasted, 2-3 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Serve salad on a plate or in a bowl, sprinkle with walnuts, crumble goat cheese over top, drizzle with dressing, and garnish with remaining thyme. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Salmon & Asparagus with Balsamic-Butter Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F and position rack in the centre. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and mince the garlic.

Wash the asparagus and snap (or cut) off the woody ends. Transfer to the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with the minced garlic and salt and pepper; toss to coat. Spread out in a single layer, leaving room for the salmon in the middle.
Place the salmon fillets, skin-side down, in the middle of the baking sheet. Rub with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place in the oven and bake until the salmon is opaque and the asparagus is tender, 10-15 minutes.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Let it brown slightly, then remove from heat. Stir in the balsamic vinegar and coconut aminos. Cover to keep warm.
To serve, arrange asparagus on a plate and place the salmon on top. Spoon the balsamic-butter sauce over top. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Salmon & Asparagus with Lemon-Dill Yogurt Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F and position rack in the center.
Wash asparagus and snap off woody ends. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel and mince garlic. Sprinkle ⅔ of it over the asparagus (save the rest for the sauce).
Drizzle asparagus with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Turn to coat.
Place salmon in the middle of the sheet, moving asparagus to the sides. Rub salmon with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place in the oven and roast until salmon is opaque and asparagus is tender, 10-12 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare sauce by mixing together remaining garlic, lemon juice, yogurt, dill, salt, and pepper.
Cut remaining ½ lemon into wedges.
To serve, place asparagus and salmon on a plate, drizzle with yogurt sauce, and garnish with lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Salmon with Carrots, Onions, Lemon-Tahini Yogurt & Mint

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and trim carrots. Cut lengthwise into quarters or halves (depending on size), then transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the baking sheet with the carrots.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until veggies are starting to soften and brown, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest and juice half of the lemon into a small bowl. Cut remaining lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Add yogurt, tahini, and salt to the bowl with the lemon juice. Whisk to combine the lemon-tahini yogurt and set aside.
When the veggies are soft, remove from the oven and stir. Add salmon to the baking sheet, nestling fillets into the veggies. Drizzle salmon with additional oil and season with salt.
Return baking sheet to the oven and roast until the salmon is cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
When the salmon is done, remove from the oven. Add half of the mint to the veggies and stir to combine (reserve remaining mint for serving).

Spoon yogurt over the bottom of each plate. Top with veggies and salmon, drizzle the veggies with honey, then sprinkle with crushed red pepper and reserved mint. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Roasted Salmon with Garlic Buttered Leeks

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F and position rack in the centre.
Pat salmon dry with a paper towel and place, skin-side down, on a baking sheet. Rub with olive oil, drizzle with lemon juice, and season with salt and freshly ground pepper. Set aside.
Wash leeks and trim ends. Slice on the diagonal into ¼ inch thick pieces.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Place salmon in the oven and roast until it's opaque, 10-15 minutes (depending on thickness).

Melt butter in skillet. Add garlic and stir until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add leeks and season with thyme, salt, and freshly ground pepper; stir to coat in the butter. Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until leeks are tender, about 10 minutes.
Serve salmon with buttered leeks on the side. Drizzle with juice from remaining ¼ lemon and enjoy!

name: Roasted Salmon & Tomatoes with Minted Pea Puree

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut each of the tomatoes into 8 wedges; transfer to a medium bowl.
Drizzle the tomatoes with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a baking sheet (that is also big enough to hold the tomatoes).
Rub the salmon with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Transfer the tomatoes to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer around the salmon.

Place the sheet in the oven; cook until the salmon is cooked through, 10 to 12 minutes, and the tomatoes are tender, 12 to 15 minutes. Remove the salmon from the oven once it is done and continue to cook the tomatoes.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and mince (or press) the garlic.
Once the saucepan is heated, add butter and the garlic. Cook until the butter has melted and the garlic is fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the peas to the saucepan and mix with the butter; cook until the peas are warmed through but still bright green, 4 to 6 minutes. Once done, remove the saucepan from the heat.
While the peas cook, pick the mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add the minced mint to the peas and season with salt and pepper. Mash the peas with an immersion blender, potato masher, or fork until smooth.
To serve, place the minted pea purée, salmon, and tomatoes on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Sole with Honey Lemon Broccoli & Almond-Raisin Couscous Pilaf

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and grate carrot; place in a small saucepan.
Add broth to the pan with the carrot, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once boiling, remove broth from the heat, add couscous and garlic powder, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.

Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet on lower rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until broccoli is lightly charred and fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the broccoli is roasting, place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine.
Pat the fish dry with paper towels and place on another baking sheet; season with spice mix on both sides and drizzle with oil. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet on upper rack of the oven and roast fish until flakey and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into the reserved bowl; add honey and oil. Whisk to combine the honey-lemon sauce.
When the broccoli is done, drizzle the honey-lemon sauce over top and toss to coat.
Fluff couscous with a fork, then add almonds and raisins; gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide fish, couscous, and broccoli between plates. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Sweet Potato & Black Bean Salad with Arugula & Bell Pepper

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, peel, and medium dice potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Place in the oven and roast until tender, 15-20 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans. Place on paper towels and pat dry.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, lime juice, olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Wash and dry arugula.
Wash, seed, and medium dice bell pepper.
To serve, arrange a bed of arugula on a plate, top with potatoes, beans, and bell pepper. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: Roasted Tomato, Feta, Shallot & Pine Nut Pasta with Lemon-Dijon Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Peel, halve, and slice shallots crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Place in a small baking dish.

Zest lemon into the dish with the shallots, then add tomatoes, feta, and pine nuts. Drizzle with oil and season with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tomatoes are bursting and shallots are soft, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice reserved lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.

Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain in a colander, return to the pan, and cover to keep warm.
When the tomatoes and shallots are done, remove from oven. Add to the pan with the cooked pasta and stir to combine.
Add mixed greens and alfalfa sprouts to the bowl with the dressing, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta and salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Tomato, Onion & Mozzarella Flatbread with Arugula-Caper Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Place oven racks in the upper and middle positions.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces; halve tomatoes. Transfer both to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet on the upper rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies soften, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, arrange flatbreads on another baking sheet. Place on the lower rack and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
While the flatbreads are baking, juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; mince capers. Add both to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Coarsely grate mozzarella.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the veggies are done, sprinkle mozzarella over the flatbreads; top with the roasted veggies and half of the basil. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Return flatbreads to the oven and bake until warmed through and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and bell pepper; toss to combine the salad.
Slice flatbreads, divide between plates, and sprinkle with reserved basil. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Roasted Tomato Pasta with Asparagus, Parmesan, Basil & Pine Nuts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place tomatoes in a baking dish and arrange in a single layer. Cut butter into small pieces and dot over the tomatoes. Drizzle with vinegar and season with salt and pepper.
Place baking dish in the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until tomatoes begin to burst, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, about 6 minutes.
While the pasta is cooking, snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus. Cut into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan and set aside.

Add asparagus to the pan with the pasta and continue to cook until pasta reaches desired firmness and asparagus is tender, about 3 minutes. Drain pasta and asparagus in a colander, reserving ½-cup of pasta cooking water. (Reserve saucepan for later use.)
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Return the saucepan to low heat. Add roasted tomatoes, drained pasta, and asparagus; cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes coat the pasta, 3-4 minutes.
Add Parmesan to the pan and stir until melted.
Add reserved pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency.
To serve, divide pasta between bowls, top with pine nuts, and enjoy!

name: Roasted Veggie, Dried Fruit & Pistachio Quinoa Bowl with Curry Yogurt

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus and cut into 2-inch pieces. Place on a baking sheet pan.
Trim and cut the zucchini crosswise into thin rounds; add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until veggies are fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lime into a small bowl. Add yogurt and spices; whisk to combine the sauce.
Coarsely chop pistachios and place in another small bowl along with the raisins.
Medium dice apricots and add to the bowl with the pistachios; stir to combine.
To serve, divide quinoa between bowls and top with roasted veggies; sprinkle with fruit and nut mix. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

name: Roasted Zucchini, Mushroom & Pinto Bean Tacos with Creamy Feta Sauce

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the baking sheet with the zucchini.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies and beans are tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, small dice tomato and set aside for serving.
Juice lime into a small bowl. Add feta, mayo, chili powder, and salt, then stir to combine the sauce. Set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: When the veggies are almost done, warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates, then fill with roasted veggies and beans. Top tacos with tomatoes and sauce. Enjoy!

name: Roasted Zucchini Tuna Melts

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F and position rack in the centre.

Wash and dry the zucchini. Halve lengthwise and, using a spoon, scrape out the centre and reserve for later. Place the halves cut-side up on the baking sheet. Rub with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place in the oven and bake until just tender when pierced with a fork, 10-15 minutes.
Small dice the reserved zucchini flesh; transfer to a large bowl.
Wash the celery, trim ends, and small dice; add to the bowl with the zucchini. Peel and mince the garlic; add to the bowl.
Add tuna, lemon juice, olive oil, dill, salt, and pepper to the bowl with vegetables and mix together.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Finely grate ½ cup of Parmesan.
Once the zucchini is done, take it out of the oven. Turn on the broiler and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Fill the zucchini halves with the tuna mixture and sprinkle with the grated Parmesan. Return to the oven and broil until the cheese has browned, 2-3 minutes.
Cut the remaining ¼ lemon into wedges for serving.
To serve, place the zucchini tuna melts on a plate and garnish with lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Romaine Salad with Crispy Smoked Salmon, Egg & Lemon-Caper Dressing

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon zest.
Mince capers; add to the bowl along with cream, mayo, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
amounts: 1 fl oz (⅛ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add smoked salmon slices to the skillet in a single layer; cook, flipping once, until crispy, about 4 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl.
Medium dice tomato and add to the bowl.
Halve avocado and remove pit; scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Peel and slice eggs crosswise into thin rounds. Chop or tear crispy smoked salmon into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with eggs and crispy smoked salmon. Enjoy!

name: Roman Egg Drop Soup (Stracciatella) with Olive, Tomato & Avocado Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Mince olives and sun-dried tomatoes; transfer both to a small bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the tapenade and set aside.
Pour broth into a medium saucepan, add spices, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; transfer to a medium bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan; add to the bowl with the basil (setting a small handful aside for garnish).
Juice lemon into the bowl.
Add eggs to the bowl and whisk until well blended; set aside.
Roughly chop spinach.
Add spinach to the simmering broth in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Slowly pour the egg mixture into the soup, while gently stirring, to separate into ribbons. Simmer until the egg is cooked through, 2-3 minutes; cover and remove from heat.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin and scoop out with a spoon. Thinly slice tomatoes.
Arrange avocado and tomato slices on plates and spoon tapenade over top.
Divide soup between bowls and top with reserved Parmesan. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Rosemary Chicken Thighs with Roasted Winter Vegetables

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Position rack in the center.
Wash carrots, turnip, and potato.

Slice carrots diagonally into ¼ inch thick pieces and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Peel turnip, halve lengthwise, slice crosswise into ¼ inch thick half rounds, and add to pan. Halve potato lengthwise, slice crosswise into ¼ inch thick half rounds, and add to pan. Peel onion, cut into thin wedges, and add to pan.
Place pan in the oven and begin roasting vegetables while you prepare the sauce and chicken, about 10 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. Wash rosemary and slide leaves off most of the stems (leave a couple stems for garnishing).
In small bowl, prepare sauce by combining garlic, rosemary leaves, olive oil, Dijon, thyme, salt, and pepper.

Remove pan from oven. Place chicken thighs over top vegetables. Drizzle sauce over top and toss chicken and vegetables until well coated. Then return to oven and roast until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Remove pan from oven. Change oven setting to broil and position rack about 6 inches from the top. Return pan to oven and broil until chicken and vegetables are lightly golden, 2-3 minutes.
Place vegetables and chicken thighs on a plate. Garnish with remaining rosemary stems and enjoy!

name: Rosemary-Parmesan Crusted Chicken with Olive, Pine Nut & Arugula Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional). Coat with a thin layer of oil.
Finely grate Parmesan and place in a medium bowl.
Add bread crumbs and spices to the bowl with the Parmesan; stir to combine the coating.
Crack egg into another medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork.

Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Sprinkle flour over both sides to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Dip chicken cutlets, one at a time, into the egg; shake off excess, then dredge in the bread crumb coating, pressing to adhere. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until the chicken is golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Using a clean cutting board, slice half of the lemon into wedges and set aside for serving. Juice remaining lemon into a clean medium bowl.
Add oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, halve, and thinly slice cucumber crosswise into half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, peel, halve, and thinly slice carrot crosswise into half-moons; add to the bowl.
Halve olives; add to the bowl along with the arugula and pine nuts. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Squeeze lemon over the chicken and enjoy!

name: Rosemary Pork Chops with Balsamic-Strawberry Sauce & Green Beans

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
While the water comes to a boil, wash the fresh produce.
Trim and discard the ends of the green beans; transfer the beans to a medium bowl and set beside the stove.
Slide the rosemary leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the rosemary.
Add olive oil to the rosemary and garlic; mix together.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add the green beans. Cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, drain in a colander and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process. Set aside to drain further.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Place the pork chops on a plate and season with salt and pepper, then rub with the rosemary and garlic mixture.
Place the pork chops in the hot skillet and pour in the remaining oil mixture; cook until cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes per side (depending on their thickness). Once done, transfer to a plate.
While the pork cooks, trim and discard the stem ends of the strawberries; slice the strawberries and transfer to a medium bowl.

Once the pork chops have been transferred, add the strawberries, balsamic vinegar, and honey to the skillet. Cook, scraping up any browned bit from the bottom of the skillet, until the strawberries have softened and the sauce is slightly thickened, 5 to 6 minutes.
Transfer the green beans to a bowl and season with salt and pepper; toss to mix.
To serve, place the green beans and pork chops on a plate and spoon the balsamic-strawberry sauce over top. Enjoy!

name: Rosemary Salmon, Butternut Squash & Creamy Portobello Mushroom Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Slide rosemary leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the rosemary along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the marinade.

Trim and peel squash. Halve lengthwise, scrape out seeds, and cut into 1-inch cubes; transfer to a baking sheet pan. Spoon half of the marinade over the squash (reserving the rest for the salmon), toss to coat, and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until squash is golden and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot and additional garlic.
Using a box grater, coarsely grate the mushroom. (Alternatively, you can mince the mushroom.)
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then set aside to drain.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot, garlic, mushroom, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.

Add rice and broth to the pan, stir to combine, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the broth comes to a boil, cover the pan and reduce heat to low. Cook mushroom-rice until liquid is mostly absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, coat another baking sheet with a thin layer of oil. Pat salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on the baking sheet; drizzle with remaining marinade. Add salmon to the oven and roast until flakey and cooked through, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: While the salmon is roasting, cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Finely grate Parmesan. When the mushroom-rice is done, add Parmesan to the pan and stir until creamy and combined.
Divide squash, creamy mushroom-rice, and salmon between plates; serve with lemon wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!

name: Rosemary-Thyme Mushroom Flatbread with Soft-Boiled Eggs & Bacon

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 4 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry mushrooms; roughly chop into small pieces and place in a medium bowl. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side.
While the bacon is cooking, peel and small dice onion.
Once the bacon is cooked, transfer to a plate lined with paper towels; pat to remove excess oil.
Return skillet (with bacon fat) to the stove over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic.
Add mushrooms, garlic, vinegar, and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms have softened, 5-7 minutes.
While the mushrooms are cooking, toast flatbreads (if desired).
Peel and halve eggs.
Chop or crumble bacon into small pieces.
To serve, place a flatbread on each plate. Use a slotted spoon to divide mushrooms between flatbreads, then top with bacon and eggs. Enjoy!

name: Rotini Caesar Salad with Homemade Garlic Croutons

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut bread into ¾-inch cubes.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add bread cubes to the skillet and sprinkle with spices. Toast the bread, tossing occasionally, until croutons are golden brown, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Grate Parmesan into a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to bowl with the Parmesan.
Mince anchovy fillets and add to the bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl and add mayonnaise, oil, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Chop or tear romaine leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes crosswise and add to the bowl.
Once the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cool water. Add pasta and croutons to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide the pasta salad between bowls and enjoy!

name: Rotini Pasta with Broccoli Sauce, Parmesan, Raisins & Bread Crumbs

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until golden and crispy, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.

Once the water is boiling, add broccoli to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until very tender, 6-7 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to transfer broccoli to a medium bowl and set aside. (Reserve boiling water in pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onion.

Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat; add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and starting to brown, 6-8 minutes.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: While the onion is cooking, peel and mince garlic.

When the onion is starting to brown, add cooked broccoli, garlic, water, anchovy fillet, crushed red pepper, and salt to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until broccoli is soft enough to break apart with a spoon, about 10 minutes.

Meanwhile, return pan with hot water to high heat and bring back to a boil. Once boiling, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ¼-cup pasta water before draining.)
While the pasta is cooking, finely grate Parmesan. Set aside.
When the broccoli is very soft, remove 1-cup, then using a potato masher, mash remaining broccoli until a semi-smooth sauce forms.

Wash, dry, and juice lemon into the skillet. Add drained pasta, reserved pasta water, Parmesan, reserved broccoli, and raisins; continue to cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Drizzle with oil, top with crispy bread crumbs, and enjoy!

name: Rotini Pasta with Cauliflower, Chard, Anchovy, Raisins & Pine Nuts

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ½-cup of pasta cooking water before draining.)
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add pine nuts and cook, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Wash and dry cauliflower; separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Return skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower and salt; cook stirring occasionally, until tender and deeply browned, 7-10 minutes.

Meanwhile, wash and dry chard; fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in a medium bowl and stems in another small bowl. (Set bowl with leaves aside.)
Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the bowl with the chard stems.
Mince anchovy fillets. Add to the bowl, along with raisins and crushed red pepper, then stir to combine. Set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan.
When the cauliflower is browned, add anchovy mixture to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until garlic is fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add drained pasta, reserved pasta water, vinegar, and toasted pine nuts to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, 1-2 minutes more.
Add chard leaves to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add Parmesan and salt to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the chard is tender, 30-60 seconds more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Drizzle with oil and enjoy!

name: Rotini Pasta with Oven-Roasted Shrimp, Cherry Tomatoes, Parsley & Feta

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Transfer shrimp to a large baking dish, spreading them out in an even layer; season with spices.
Peel and thinly slice garlic. Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot. Add both to the baking dish with the shrimp.
Wash and dry tomatoes; cut in half crosswise and add to the baking dish.
Add oil and capers to the baking dish, toss to combine, then spread everything out in an even layer.
Sprinkle feta over the top of the shrimp and tomato mixture.
Place baking dish in the oven and roast until tomatoes are soft and shrimp are cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.
When the pasta is done, drain in a colander. Return pasta to the saucepan, cover, and set aside to keep warm.
When the shrimp and tomato mixture is done, carefully transfer to the pan with the pasta; add parsley and gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Rotini Pasta with Pork Sausage, Mushrooms, Zucchini, Tomato & Basil

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ¼-cup pasta water before draining.)
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add onion, garlic, sausage, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and medium dice zucchini. Place in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
When the sausage is done, add zucchini and mushrooms to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
When the veggies are done, add tomato sauce to the skillet, then stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Add drained pasta, reserved pasta water, and basil to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Russian Potato Salad with Ham, Eggs, Carrots & Peas over Mixed Greens

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
While the eggs are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
Peel, trim, and medium dice potatoes. Transfer to a medium saucepan, fill about halfway with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and medium dice carrot. Add carrot to the pan with the potatoes and stir to combine. Cook until veggies are crisp-tender, 5-7 minutes.
While the eggs and veggies are cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the vinaigrette and set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place yogurt, mayo, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the creamy dressing.
Place peas in a colander. When the potatoes and carrots are done, pour into the colander over the peas. Run under cold water to cool and set aside to drain.
Drain and mince capers; add to the bowl with the creamy dressing.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl.
Chop or tear prosciutto into small pieces and add to the bowl.
Peel and medium dice eggs; add to the bowl along with the potatoes, carrots, and peas. Stir to combine the potato salad.
To serve, divide spring mix between plates and drizzle with vinaigrette. Top with potato salad and enjoy!

name: Sage Chicken Meatballs with Creamy Pumpkin-Spinach Orzo

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic. Place half in a medium bowl and set aside for the meatballs. (Reserve remaining garlic for the next step.)
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add reserved garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.

Add broth, pumpkin, orzo, salt, and nutmeg to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed and orzo is desired firmness, 10-15 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick sage leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves (reserving a small handful of whole leaves for garnish). Add minced sage to the bowl with the garlic.
Add chicken, bread crumbs, and spices to the bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the chicken mixture into meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
When the orzo is done, add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add milk, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide orzo between plates or bowls; top with meatballs and reserved sage. Enjoy!

name: Sage-Dijon Roasted Chicken with Lemon Broccoli & Pecans

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Melt butter in the microwave or in a small saucepan. Add mustard, salt, and sage; whisk together.

Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towel and place in a baking dish. Brush the chicken thighs evenly with the butter mixture. Place in the oven on the bottom rack and bake for 20 minutes or until cooked through.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the broccoli head into small, bite-sized florets and thinly slice the thicker stem portions.

Place the broccoli on the baking sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss on the pan to coat. Spread out in a single layer and place in the oven. Roast for 10 to 12 minutes.

Thinly slice one quarter of the lemon, stack the slices and then finely dice. Transfer chopped lemon, including peel (but not seeds), to a blender. Juice the other quarter of the lemon. Add lemon juice, honey, oil, and salt; blend until smooth.
Roughly chop the pecans. Remove broccoli from oven and toss in lemon dressing and pecans.
To serve, divide the chicken thighs and broccoli mixture between the dishes. Enjoy!

name: "Salade Niçoise" with Tuna, Potato, Asparagus, Artichokes & Olives

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.

While the eggs are cooking, halve potatoes. Place in a medium saucepan, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium, and simmer until starting to soften, 8-10 minutes.

Meanwhile, snap (or cut) off the woody ends of asparagus; cut spears in half crosswise. Once the potatoes start to soften, add asparagus to the pan and continue to cook until veggies are tender, 2-3 minutes more. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool.
While the veggies are cooking, trim and halve radishes lengthwise. Transfer to a plate.
Drain artichokes. Add to the plate with the radish.
Halve olives lengthwise and add to the plate. Set aside.
Peel and mince shallot. Place in a small bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the shallot. Add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
When potatoes and asparagus are cool, return to the pan and drizzle with half of the dressing. Gently toss to coat and set aside. (Reserve remaining dressing for serving.)
Drain tuna, place in another small bowl, and flake with a fork.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Peel and halve eggs. Season with salt and pepper.
To serve, divide tuna, eggs, potatoes, asparagus, radishes, artichokes, and olives between plates or bowls. Top with capers, drizzle with remaining dressing, and enjoy!

name: Salisbury Steak with Cauliflower Mash & Tomato-Onion Gravy

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan with about 1-inch of hot water from the tap; cover and place over high heat.
Wash cauliflower and cut off the leaves; roughly chop into bite-sized pieces.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add cauliflower, reduce heat to medium, and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine ground beef, egg, almond meal, and spices in a medium bowl and mix with your hands until well combined.
Form ground beef mixture into 2 equal-sized, approximately 1-inch thick, patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the patties in the skillet and cook until they are well done, 4-5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the patties to a clean plate and cover with aluminum foil.

When the cauliflower is cooked, drain in a colander, transfer to a blender, and add butter, salt, and pepper; purée until smooth. Transfer to a medium bowl, cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. Reserve blender for later use.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the onion.
Return the skillet to medium heat. Add butter and onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, about 4 minutes.
Add tomato paste, Dijon, soy sauce, and broth to the skillet. Bring to a boil and remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Pour the onion gravy into the blender and process until smooth, about 1 minute.
To serve, divide cauliflower mash and Salisbury steak between plates. Top with gravy and enjoy!

name: Salisbury Steak & Mushroom Gravy with Asparagus

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Slice the mushrooms and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl of mushrooms.
Fill a medium saucepan (one that is big enough to fit the asparagus) about halfway with water; cover and bring to a boil.
Peel and mince the garlic.
In a medium bowl, combine and mix together the minced garlic, ground beef, onion powder, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper. Shape the beef mixture into two oval patties.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Cut (or snap off) and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; leaves the spears on the cutting board.
Add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the beef patties in the skillet and cook until they are browned and the meat is nearly cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.

Once the water is boiling, add the asparagus. Cook until the asparagus is tender and bright green, 3 to 4 minutes. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process; set aside to drain.
Once the patties have been transferred, add more butter to the skillet.
Add the onion and mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the onions and mushrooms are softened and lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over the mushrooms and onions and stir until fully incorporated. Then pour in the broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return the beef patties and any juices to the skillet. Simmer until the patties are cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Stir almost everything into the gravy (save some for garnishing).
Divide the asparagus between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container) and place the steak and gravy over top. Enjoy!

name: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy & Parsley Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash, peel, and large dice potatoes. Transfer to a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and return to saucepan.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
In a medium bowl, combine beef, bread crumbs, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper. Mix well and form into 2 patties.
Melt butter in pan. Add beef patties and cook until browned and almost cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Once patties have been transferred, add more butter and onion to pan. Stirring frequently, cook until onion begins to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Wash and slice mushrooms. Peel and mince garlic.
Add mushrooms, garlic, and thyme to pan. Stirring occasionally, cook until mushrooms are tender, 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together flour and broth until smooth. Add to pan and stir to combine.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return beef patties and any juices to pan. Cover and simmer until gravy thickens and steaks are cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add butter, broth, ½ of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing), salt, and pepper to potatoes. Mash until smooth.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, place mashed potatoes on a plate and top with steaks and gravy. Garnish with remaining parsley and enjoy!

name: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy, Roasted New Potatoes & Broccoli

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve potatoes and place on a baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until the potatoes start to soften, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; peel and thinly slice onion. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms, add to the bowl with the garlic and onion, and set aside.

Place beef, egg, bread crumbs, Dijon, Worcestershire, and spices in another medium bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the beef mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip and pan-fry until cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Once done, transfer to a clean plate (leaving the cooking juices in the skillet) and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.

Remove baking sheet from the oven; add broccoli, drizzle with additional oil, and season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine with the potatoes and return to the oven. Roast until the veggies are fork-tender, 10 minutes more.
Return the skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, onion, and mushrooms; cook, stirring often, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle flour into the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add broth and Worcestershire, stir to combine, and bring the gravy to a boil.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return patties to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the gravy has thickened and patties are warmed through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide potatoes, broccoli, and beef patties between plates. Top patties with mushroom gravy and enjoy!

name: Salmon, Avocado & Cucumber Lettuce Wraps with Garlic-Yogurt Sauce

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and discard the ends of the cucumber; halve the cucumber lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise on an angle. Transfer to a large bowl.
Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh and thinly slice crosswise. Add to the bowl.
Juice the lemon into a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Place the salmon on a plate; drizzle with ½ of the lemon juice (save the rest for the sauce), and season with salt and pepper.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the salmon in the skillet; cook until it is opaque and cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes per side (depending on the thickness). Once done, transfer to a plate.
Separate the lettuce into leaves and place on a plate.
Trim and discard the root ends of the green onions; chop the onions into ¼-inch pieces. Add about ½ of the onions to the bowl with the remaining lemon juice and the other ½ to the large bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the small bowl.
Add yogurt, olive oil, salt, and pepper to the small bowl and mix together.
Using your hands or a fork, flake the salmon and add to the large bowl. Toss the ingredients together.
To serve, make the lettuce wraps by spooning the salmon mixture into the lettuce leaves, then topping with the yogurt sauce. Enjoy!

name: Salmon & Avocado-Grapefruit Salsa with Lime Cilantro Rice Pilaf

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Heat small saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add ½ of the onion (save the rest for the salsa) and cook until softened, 4-5 minutes. Transfer remaining onion to a medium bowl.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Place salmon in a baking dish and rub with spice mixture.
Place in the oven and roast until salmon is opaque in the centre, 15-20 minutes.
Once onion has softened, add rice and water to saucepan; bring to a boil.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
