Halve and pit avocado; scoop out the flesh, small dice, and add to bowl with onion.

Slice off top and bottom from grapefruit, then cut off the skin and white pith from the sides so you can see the pink flesh. Cut in between the membranes to release the segments. Cut segments crosswise into medium pieces and transfer to bowl with onion.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add ½ of the cilantro (save the rest for the rice pilaf), lime juice, crushed red pepper, salt, and pepper to salsa bowl; gently toss to combine. Set aside.
Add remaining cilantro, lime juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper to rice; stir to mix.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Serve salmon with rice pilaf on the side and spoon salsa over top. Enjoy!

name: Salmon Burger with Dill, Caper Aioli & Spinach-Apple Salad

ingredients.name: traditional style wild pink salmon
ingredients.display: 1 (7.5 oz) can wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Drain salmon, place in a medium bowl, and flake with a fork; add egg, bread crumbs, mayo, and spices. Stir to combine the salmon mixture, form into 2 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
amounts: 1 (7.5 oz) can wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic; mince capers. Place both in a small bowl, add mayo, and stir to combine the aioli; set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add salmon patties and cook until browned and warmed through, about 5 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apple; add to the bowl along with spinach and cranberries. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
Toast buns if desired.
To assemble the burgers, spread the bottom half of each bun with aioli; layer with a salmon patty and the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Salmon Burgers with Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry green onions. Trim and discard root ends, chop, and transfer to a medium bowl.
Small dice salmon and add to bowl with onions.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium heat.
Add bread crumbs, lemon juice, Dijon, salt, and pepper to bowl with salmon and onions. Mix well and shape into 2 patties.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add salmon patties and grill until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Wash and dry greens and tomato. Slice tomato into rounds.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: In a small bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Toast buns or rolls on the grill or skillet. Spread the inside with mayo.
To serve, place a few greens and salmon patties on the bottom of the buns, top with tomato rounds, and close the burgers. Place remaining mixed greens on the side and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Salmon Caesar Salad with Homemade Parmesan Croutons

instructions.text: Trim off and discard the root end of the lettuce and remove any blemished leaves; halve the head lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Rinse and spin dry in a salad spinner or rinse in a colander, then transfer to a clean towel and pat dry. Transfer to a large salad bowl.

Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add ½ of the garlic to a medium bowl (that will hold the croutons) and the other ½ to a separate medium bowl (that will hold the dressing).
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Add olive oil, salt, and pepper to the garlic in the crouton bowl.
Cut the bun or roll into ¾-inch cubes; transfer to the bowl with the garlic-oil mixture and toss to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add the croutons and cook, tossing frequently, until golden brown, 5 to 7 minutes. Once done, transfer back to the bowl and set aside.
While the croutons cook, pat the salmon fillets dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper.
Once the croutons have been transferred, wipe the skillet with a paper towel to remove any remaining crumbs. Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the salmon fillets, skin-side-down, in the skillet; cook until the flesh is opaque and flaky, 3 to 5 minutes per side (depending on thickness). Once done, transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.

Finely grate about 1 cup of Parmesan and divide into thirds. Sprinkle ⅓ of the Parmesan over the croutons and toss to coat, add another ⅓ to the dressing bowl with the garlic, and transfer the remaining ⅓ to a small bowl (for garnishing).
Wash and dry the lemon. Juice ½ of the lemon into the dressing bowl; cut the other ½ into 4 wedges.
Mince the anchovy fillets and add to the dressing bowl.
To the dressing bowl, add mayonnaise, Dijon, Worcestershire, and pepper; whisk together (or blend with a hand blender for a smoother consistency).
Pour the dressing over the lettuce and toss with your hands (or salad spoons) until the lettuce is well coated.
To serve, divide the dressed lettuce between plates, top with the croutons, remaining Parmesan, and salmon, and garnish with the lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Salmon Cakes with Mango Cabbage Slaw

ingredients.name: traditional style wild pink salmon
ingredients.display: 2 (7.5 oz) cans wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Transfer ½ of the cilantro to a medium bowl (that will be used to mix the salmon mixture) and the other ½ to a salad bowl.
Drain and add the salmon to the medium bowl with the cilantro.
amounts: 2 (7.5 oz) cans wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.text: Add the egg, mayonnaise, Dijon, bread crumbs, salt, and pepper to the salmon and cilantro; mix together until well combined. Form the mixture into 4 patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into shreds and add to the salad bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Carefully place the salmon patties in the skillet; cook until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Peel the mango, then slice off the flesh from the pit, starting with the flatter sides; discard the pit and small dice the flesh (cut into ¼-inch cubes). Add the mango to the salad bowl.
Juice the lime and add to the salad bowl.
Season the salad with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
To serve, place 2 salmon patties on a plate and add the mange cabbage slaw on the side. Enjoy!

name: Salmon with Cauliflower Rice, Spinach, Tomatoes & Creamy Basil Sauce

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl.
Add oil and spices to the bowl with the cauliflower, then stir to combine. Transfer cauliflower rice to one half of a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on the other half of the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil, then season the top side with salt and pepper.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring cauliflower halfway through, until rice is tender and salmon is cooked through, 13-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add additional oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes start to burst, about 4 minutes.
While the tomatoes are cooking, finely grate Parmesan.

Add Parmesan, broth, cream, and garlic powder to the skillet; stir to combine the sauce and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 6-7 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the sauce is done, add basil and spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice, salmon, and sauce between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Salmon Coconut Curry with Spinach, Tomatoes, Cilantro & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl with the cilantro.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on the cutting board. Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin). Discard the skin.
Cut salmon into 1-inch pieces, season with salt and pepper, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, cilantro, curry powder, and turmeric; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Add coconut milk, broth, chili-garlic sauce, fish sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper to the skillet; stir to combine.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Juice lime into the skillet, add salmon, and stir to combine the curry. Bring to a simmer; once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until the salmon is cooked through and flakey, 7-8 minutes.
While the salmon is cooking, using a clean cutting board, roughly chop spinach; halve tomatoes. Place both in the reserved bowl.
Add spinach and tomatoes to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the veggies to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook until heated through, about 3 minutes.
To serve, divide rice and salmon curry between bowls. Top with reserved cilantro and enjoy!

name: Salmon Fettuccine Alfredo with Spinach, Lemon & Dill

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan (for the pasta) about halfway with water; cover and bring to a boil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
While the pan warms up, place the salmon on a plate and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Add butter to the pan and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the salmon, skin-side down, in the pan; cook until it is cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic.
Once the salmon has been transferred, reduce the heat to medium-low and add more butter to the pan.
Add the garlic and flour to the pan; whisk until the mixture is smooth, about 1 minute.
Add the broth and whisk until smooth, then add the milk and cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce is thickened, 4 to 5 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, season with salt and add the pasta; stir for the few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 5 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) fettuccine pasta

instructions.text: While the sauce cooks, pick the tender dill stems off the tough stems; discard the tough stems and finely chop the tender ones.
Finely grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Add the Parmesan to the sauce and season with salt and pepper; stir until smooth, then turn off the heat.
Grate the zest from the lemon and transfer to a small bowl, then juice the lemon into the same bowl.
Drain the pasta in a colander, reserving about ½ cup of the pasta water.
Using a fork or your hands, flake the salmon into bite-sized pieces.

Add the pasta, spinach, ¾ of the dill (save the rest for garnishing), salmon, lemon zest and juice, and ½ of the reserved pasta water to the sauce; toss to combine. Return sauté pan to the stove over medium-low heat; cook for 2-3 minutes or until spinach has wilted, adding more pasta water to thin out the sauce as needed.
To serve, divide pasta between dishes, sprinkle with the remaining dill, and season with freshly ground pepper. Enjoy!

name: Salmon Fish Fingers with Oven-Baked Fries & Zesty Yogurt Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F and position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Wash, peel, and slice potatoes into ¼-inch thick strips. Place in a medium bowl and add oil and salt; toss to coat.

Spread potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and place in the lower third of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated). Tossing once halfway through, roast until golden brown, 15-20 minutes. Reserve bowl for next step.
Wash, dry, and zest lemon into the reserved bowl.
Add bread crumbs, oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon zest; stir to combine.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin. If you don’t have a tail end, start at one corner of the fillet and work your way in until the knife is between the skin and flesh.
Slice the salmon crosswise into 1-inch wide fingers.
Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Roll the salmon in the bread crumb mixture, pressing to adhere; place on the prepared baking sheet.
Place salmon in the upper third of the oven and bake until golden, crispy, and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Watch carefully because the bread crumbs can burn quickly.
Meanwhile, juice half of the lemon into a small bowl. Cut the remaining lemon into wedges.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Add yogurt, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine the yogurt sauce.
Divide salmon and fries between plates; serve with lemon wedges and yogurt sauce on the side. Enjoy!

name: Salmon & Goat Cheese Salad Sandwich with Tapenade-Dressed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

ingredients.name: traditional style wild pink salmon
ingredients.display: 1 (7.5 oz) can wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Zest lemon into a medium bowl. (Set lemon aside for later use.)
Drain salmon and place in the bowl with the lemon zest; flake with a fork.
amounts: 1 (7.5 oz) can wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.text: Small dice tomato and add to the bowl along with spices.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl, stir to combine the salmon salad, and set aside.
Juice lemon into another medium bowl.
Roughly chop olives, sun-dried tomatoes, and capers; add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl along with the oil. Stir to combine the tapenade dressing.
Trim and halve the cucumber lengthwise; slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Toast bread if desired.
Place bread slices on a flat surface. Divide salmon salad between half of the slices; cover with remaining slices.
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Sprinkle salad with pine nuts and enjoy!

name: Salmon Nicoise Pasta Salad with Kalamata Olive-Caper Vinaigrette

instructions.text: Fill a large pot with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and discard the ends of the green beans, then cut into 2-inch pieces; transfer to a medium bowl.

Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, 8-10 minutes. Add green beans to the pot and cook 2-3 minutes more. Drain and rinse under cold water; set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, preheat a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat the salmon fillets dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place salmon, skin-side down, in the pan; cook until opaque and cooked through, 3-5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate to cool.
Combine oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a salad bowl; whisk to combine.
Peel and mince garlic. Roughly chop capers and olives. Transfer everything to the salad bowl; stir to combine the dressing.
Halve the grape tomatoes crosswise. Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings; add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves; add to the bowl (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Remove skin from the salmon, then using a fork or your hands, flake into bite-sized pieces.
Add salmon, pasta, and green beans to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between dishes and garnish with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Salmon with Spicy Roasted Fennel, Grapefruit, Pecan & Date Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the green onions along with soy sauce and spices. Stir to combine the marinade.
Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and add to the bowl with the marinade. Turn to coat and set aside.

Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice each half into ½-inch thick wedges. Transfer to one half of a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place fennel in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until starting to soften, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, honey, vinegar, Dijon, and spices in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Cut off skin and white pith from the grapefruits; halve and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Remove any visible seeds, add to the bowl with the dressing, and set aside.

When the fennel has started to soften, remove from the oven and arrange salmon on the other half of the baking sheet. Return to the oven and continue to roast until salmon is opaque and cooked through and fennel is tender, 10-12 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, roughly chop dates and pecans. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Just before serving, transfer roasted fennel to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salmon and salad between plates. Top salmon with reserved green onions and enjoy!

name: Salt & Pepper Chicken Wings with Cucumber, Tomato & Avocado Salad

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F.
In a large bowl, mix together salt and pepper.
Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Transfer the wings to a baking sheet and spread out in a single layer. Place in the oven and, turning halfway through cooking time, bake until crispy, 20-25 minutes.
Wash the green onions, trim ends, and thinly slice on an angle. Peel and mince the garlic.
In a small bowl, mix together the minced garlic, green onions, and sesame oil. Set aside.
Wash the tomatoes and cucumber. Halve the tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl. Medium dice the cucumber and add to the bowl.
Peel and medium dice the onion and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh with a spoon, medium dice, and add to the bowl.
Drizzle the salad with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat.
Once the chicken wings are cooked, add the sesame oil mixture over top and toss to coat.
Serve the wings on a plate with salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Saucy Cashew-Lime Chicken with Basil over Zucchini & Carrot Noodles

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Peel and trim carrots; using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel each carrot into noodle-like strips. Add to the baking sheet with the zucchini. Drizzle veggies noodles with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and roast, tossing halfway through, until zucchini and carrot noodles are tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, chicken, salt, and pepper. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, zest and juice lime into a small bowl. Add water, peanut butter, chili-garlic sauce, and soy sauce, then whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce.
When the chicken is done, add stir-fry sauce to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through and thickened slightly, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, roughly chop cashews.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add cashews and half of the basil to the skillet. Stir to combine and cover to keep warm. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
To serve, divide zucchini and carrot noodles between plates or bowls. Top with saucy chicken and reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Saucy "Chicken Parmesan" Patty Melt with Mozzarella & Italian Greens

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean-up easier (optional).

Peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl along with tomato sauce and spices, then stir to combine. Transfer 2 tablespoons of the tomato sauce to a medium bowl. (Set remaining sauce aside for later use.)

Add chicken, bread crumbs, salt, and crushed red pepper to the medium bowl with the tomato sauce, then mix with your hands until well combined. Form the chicken mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and transfer to one half of the baking sheet. (The patties will be loose but will firm up when cooked.)
Drizzle patties with oil, then place baking sheet in the oven. Broil, flipping patties halfway, until chicken is cooked through and golden, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, roughly chop capers. Place in a clean medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts and sun-dried tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Thinly slice cheese.

When the patties are done, top with remaining sauce and cheese. Add bread slices to the other half of the baking sheet. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to broil until bread is toasted, sauce is warm, and cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash and dry alfalfa sprouts. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Place a slice of toast on each plate and top with saucy patties. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Saucy Grilled Ham & Cheese "Croque Madame" with Pickled Veggies

instructions.text: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the marinade.
Wash, dry, peel, trim, and thinly slice carrot. Peel and thinly slice shallot; add both to the bowl with the marinade.
Wash, dry, trim, and thinly slice cucumber; add to the bowl, toss to combine, and set the veggies aside to marinate.
Thinly slice mozzarella.
Place the bread slices on a flat surface and spread with Dijon. Evenly top half the slices with the mozzarella and prosciutto. Cover the sandwiches with remaining bread slices.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes.

Remove sandwiches to a plate and add more butter to the skillet. Return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side up; cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a cutting board.

Wipe the skillet clean with a paper towel; return to medium heat, and add more butter. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until whites are set but yolks are still runny, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, preheat a small saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the saucepan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add flour, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Slowly whisk milk into the saucepan; bring to a boil and cook until sauce is thickened, about 2 minutes.
Divide sandwiches between plates; drizzle with sauce and top with a fried egg. Serve with pickled veggies on the side and enjoy!

name: Saucy Italian Veggie-Chickpea Skillet with Basil & Garlic Toast

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Peel and medium dice onion; transfer both to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, thinly slice mushrooms and place in the reserved bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Add mushrooms, zucchini, and chickpeas to the skillet with the other veggies and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and mince additional garlic and place in a small bowl. Add oil and spices; stir to combine and set aside.
Add tomato sauce and vinegar to the skillet. Stir to combine and cook until heated through, 3 minutes more.
Meanwhile, spread garlic oil on the bread and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from the oven and cut toasts in half.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Finely grate Parmesan.
Divide veggie-chickpea skillet between plates or bowls; sprinkle with basil and Parmesan. Serve with garlic toast on the side and enjoy!

name: Saucy Pork, Bean & Bell Pepper Stew with Parmesan Grilled Zucchini

instructions.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but not crispy, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry bell pepper. Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and small dice, then place in a small bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
When the bacon is done, add bell pepper and onion to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies begin to soften, 3-4 minutes.

Add beans with their liquid (do not drain) to the skillet along with tomato sauce, vinegar, Dijon, honey, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the stew and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender and sauce thickens, 10-12 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the beans are cooking, wash, dry, and trim zucchini, then slice lengthwise into ¼-inch thick planks. Transfer to a plate, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or another skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add zucchini and grill until charred and tender, 2-3 minutes per side. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Divide pork and bean stew between bowls. Serve grilled zucchini on the side and top with Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Saucy Veracruz Fish Tacos with Tomatoes, Olives, Capers & Jalapeño

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl. Stir to combine the pickling liquid.

Thinly slice jalapeño pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the bowl with pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and thinly slice garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop olives.

When the onions are soft, add olives, tomatoes, and capers to the skillet. Stir to combine and bring the sauce to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened, 5-6 minutes.
While the sauce thickens, pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
When the sauce is thickened, add fish to the skillet and gently stir to combine. Cover and continue to simmer until fish is cooked through, 5-6 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, cut lime into wedges. Transfer to a plate.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the plate with the lime.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide fish and sauce between plates. Serve with tortillas, avocado, pickled jalapeño, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Sausage, Apple & Goat Cheese Pita Pizza with Arugula-Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 10-15 minutes.

Meanwhile, arrange pitas on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
While the pitas bake, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apple.
When the sausages are done, transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into thin rounds.

Layer baked pitas with apple and sausage slices, then crumble goat cheese over top. Return baking sheet to the oven and bake until warmed through and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, halve, and slice cucumber into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Divide pita pizzas between plates and sprinkle with basil. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Sausage, Apple & Sweet Potato Stuffing Bowl with Sweet Curry Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and medium dice carrot and sweet potato. Transfer both to a baking sheet pan.

Trim and medium dice celery; peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add both to the baking sheet with the other veggies, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until fork-tender, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, quarter, core, and medium dice apple.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add apple, sausage, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes; remove from heat.

While the sausage and apple are cooking, place yogurt, water, honey, Dijon, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce. Add additional water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set aside.
Cut bread into 1-inch cubes.
When the veggies are done, remove from oven and set oven to broil on high.
Sprinkle bread cubes over the veggies, return baking sheet to the oven, and broil until golden and toasted, 2-3 minutes.
When the bread cubes are done, remove from the oven; add sausage mixture to the baking sheet and toss to combine the "stuffing."
To serve, divide stuffing between bowls, drizzle with sauce, and enjoy!

name: Sausage, Asparagus & Walnut Quinoa Pilaf with Cranberries

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut the sausages at an angle into 1-inch pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the sausage to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides and almost cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus; then cut into 2-inch pieces.
Peel and mince garlic.
In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together vinegar, oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Roughly chop walnuts.

When the sausage is almost cooked through, add asparagus, garlic, and walnuts; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until asparagus is crisp-tender, about 3 minutes. When done, remove from the heat, cover, and set aside.
Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork. Add quinoa and asparagus-sausage mixture to the bowl with the sauce and stir to combine.
To serve, divide the pilaf between plates and garnish with cranberries. Enjoy!

name: Sausage Banh Mi Salad with Jalapeños, Herbs & Garlic Crostini

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place sausages on a baking sheet pan and place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated); bake until sausages are cooked through, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a salad bowl.
Peel and thinly slice carrot into rounds; add to the bowl with the lettuce.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl.
Trim and thinly slice cucumber into rounds; add to the bowl.
Trim and thinly slice jalapeño into rounds; add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Pick mint leaves off the stems. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
When the sausages are done cooking, remove to a cutting board. Slice into ½-inch thick pieces, at an angle, and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic.

Slice roll in half and place on the baking sheet, cut-side up. Drizzle with oil, then sprinkle with minced garlic. Place in the oven and toast until golden, 4-5 minutes. Remove from the oven and cut in half.
Meanwhile, juice the lime into a small bowl. Add mayo, honey, chili-garlic sauce, and fish sauce; whisk to combine the dressing.
To serve, divide salad, sausage, and crostini between plates or bowls. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: Sausage-Basil Ragù over Potato Gnocchi with Parmesan

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring often, until it begins to soften, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: While the onion is cooking, fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.

Use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of each sausage. Peel off the casings and discard. Add sausage meat to the saucepan with the onions and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until starting to brown, about 4 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic.
Add garlic, tomato sauce, water, sugar, and spices to the saucepan and stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 4-5 minutes.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, add gnocchi and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan and set aside.
Wash and dry basil. Pick leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the ragú and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide gnocchi and ragú between plates or bowls. Garnish with Parmesan and enjoy!

name: Sausage, Brussels Sprout & Kale Frittata with Parmesan

instructions.text: Wash, dry, trim, and thinly slice Brussels sprouts; place in a medium bowl.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the Brussels sprouts.
Add veggies and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sprouts are tender and sausage is cooked through, about 4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
While the sprouts are cooking, wash and dry kale; fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.
Add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the kale is tender, about 3 minutes.
While the kale is cooking, place eggs, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.

Reduce heat to medium-low and pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Sprinkle Parmesan over the frittata. Place in the oven and broil until top is set and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes; remove from oven.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges, divide between plates, and enjoy!

name: Sausage, Brussels Sprout, Mushroom & Leek Bake with Honey-Dijon Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and halve Brussels sprouts lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Quarter mushrooms and add to the baking sheet with the Brussels sprouts.

Trim off the root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces and add to the baking sheet.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Add sausages to the baking sheet, nestling them into the veggies.

Place the baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring veggies and flipping sausages halfway through, until veggies are tender and sausages are nearly cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, Dijon, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: When the veggies and sausages are nearly done, change the oven to broil on high. Broil until sausages are browned and cooked through, about 3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide sausages and veggies between plates; drizzle with sauce. Enjoy!

name: Sausage, Cauliflower & Pepper Bowl with Cilantro-Jalapeño Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice potato; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the baking sheet with the potato.
Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; add to the baking sheet.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer. Add sausages to the baking sheet, nestling them into the veggies.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until veggies are tender and sausages are cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Place in a blender. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add cilantro to the blender with the jalapeño (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Juice lime into the blender.
Peel garlic and add to the blender.
Add mayo, water, salt, and pepper to the blender; purée on high until the sauce is smooth. Set aside.
When the sausages are done, transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into 1-inch thick pieces.
To serve, divide veggies and sausage between bowls; pour sauce over top and sprinkle with reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Sausage with Honey-Chili Glazed Brussels Sprouts & Carrots over Rice

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and cut carrots lengthwise into quarters, then crosswise into 2-inch long pieces; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim and halve Brussels sprouts; add to the baking sheet with the carrots. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to combine; spread out in an even layer.
Add sausages to the baking sheet, nestling them into the veggies.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, tossing once, until veggies are fork-tender and sausages are cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lime into a small bowl; add honey and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the honey-chili glaze.

When the sausages and veggies are done, transfer sausages to a cutting board; drizzle veggies with the glaze and toss to combine. Return to the oven and continue to roast until caramelized, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Cut sausages in half lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons.
To serve, divide rice, veggies, and sausage between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Sausage, Lentil, Fennel & Spinach Sauté with Lemony Yogurt

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain and set aside.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the lentils are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Cut fennel in half lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the fennel.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fennel, onion, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and starting to brown, 6-8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into the reserved bowl. Add yogurt and salt, then whisk to combine the lemony yogurt. Set aside.
When the fennel and onion are soft, add sausage to the skillet. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
While the sausage is cooking, peel and thinly slice garlic.
When the sausage is done, add cooked lentils, garlic, vinegar, and crushed red pepper to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until warmed through and fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the spinach is tender, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide lemony yogurt and lentil sauté between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Sausage, Mushroom & Ricotta Pita Bread "Calzones" with Dressed Greens

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of the sausage. Peel off the casing and discard. Add sausage meat to the skillet and break apart with a spoon until crumbly. Cook, stirring often, until browned and almost cooked through, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and roughly chop mushrooms. Add to the skillet and cook, stirring often, until mushrooms are soft and sausage is cooked through, 2-3 minutes more.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the skillet along with tomato sauce and spices; stir to combine and remove from heat.
Grate the cheese.
Cut pitas in half and carefully open them.
Spread a layer of ricotta cheese inside the bottom half of each pita. Layer with sausage mixture and grated cheese. Place filled pitas on the baking sheet, ricotta-side facing down.
Place calzones in the oven and bake until the outside is crisp and the inside is hot and bubbly, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the lettuce. Chop or tear into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide calzones and salad between plates and enjoy!

name: Sausage Salad with Chickpeas, Pickled Shallots & Curry-Ginger Dressing

instructions.text: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the ginger and garlic. Add tahini, water, curry powder, sugar, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to coat.
Trim, seed, and cut bell pepper into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Halve tomato lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Slice the sausages into bite-sized rounds.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, then top with sausage and pickled shallots. Enjoy!

name: Sausage, Shrimp & Cauliflower Rice Jambalaya Stew with Green Onions

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove sausages to a plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Combine spices in a medium bowl.
Peel and medium dice onion; add to the bowl with the spices.
Slice celery crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl.
Seed and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Return the pot (with leftover oil from cooking) to medium-high heat. Add chopped veggies and spices from the bowl; cook, stirring often, until veggies begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the pot along with the cauliflower, broth, tomatoes, and tomato paste. Bring mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Slice sausages into ½-inch thick rounds; add back to the pot, along with the shrimp. Cook, stirring often, until shrimp are opaque and cauliflower is tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Stir half of the onions into the pot (reserve the rest for garnish).
To serve, divide jambalaya between bowls and top with remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Sausage Skillet with Bell Pepper, Zucchini, Corn & Creamy Basil Sauce

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, slice the sausages crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add sausage and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy, 5-6 minutes. Transfer to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Divide between a small and a medium bowl, then set the small bowl aside for later use.
Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the medium bowl with the garlic.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, place corn in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince half of the leaves. Add to the small bowl with the garlic. (Reserve whole remaining basil leaves for later use.)
Juice lime into the bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the sauce. Set aside.

When the veggies are done, return sausage to the skillet along with the corn. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until corn is warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat, add reserved basil leaves, and stir once more to combine.
To serve, divide sausage skillet between plates or bowls. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

name: Sausage, Spinach & Artichoke Frittata with Parmesan

instructions.text: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry spinach (skip if it came pre-washed). Peel and mince garlic.

Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add garlic and spices, stir to combine, and remove from heat. Transfer spinach mixture to a medium bowl and set aside.
Place eggs, salt, and pepper in another medium bowl; whisk to combine and set aside.
Wipe skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of each sausage. Peel off the casings and discard.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage meat and cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add artichokes and spinach mixture (leaving any juices in the bowl) to the skillet with the sausage; stir to combine.

Reduce heat to medium-low and pour in the egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Sprinkle Parmesan over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until the top is set, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges, place on plates, and enjoy!

name: Sausage, Tomato & Spinach Pasta with Parmesan

instructions.text: Wash and dry the spinach. (Skip this step if the spinach came pre-washed.)
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; cut the onion into ¼-inch cubes and transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add the garlic to the bowl with the onion.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Slice the sausages into ¼-inch-thick rounds.

When the water in the saucepan comes to a boil, uncover the pan and season the water with salt, then add the pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook the pasta, uncovered, for 11 to 12 minutes (or according to package directions).
Once the sauté pan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the onion, garlic, sausage slices, and crushed red pepper to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is softened and the sausage slices are browned, 3 to 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes to the sauté pan and season with oregano, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook until the pasta is ready.
Finely grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan and transfer to a small bowl.
Once done, drain the pasta in a colander.
Add the pasta and spinach to the sauté pan; stir until the spinach is wilted and the ingredients are combined, 1 to 2 minutes.
To serve, spoon the pasta into a bowl and sprinkle with the Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Sautéed Chicken Thighs with Asparagus & Tomato Salad

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears into 2-inch pieces at an angle and transfer to a bowl.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, uncover and season with salt. Add the asparagus and cook until bright green, 2 to 4 minutes (depending on the thickness of the spears). Drain in a colander and run under cold water to stop the cooking process. Set aside to drain further.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the chicken thighs in the skillet; sear on both sides until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and continue to cook until they are cooked through, 2 to 4 minutes total. Once done, transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a salad bowl.
To the garlic, add olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Halve the grape tomatoes and add to the salad bowl.
Add the asparagus to the salad bowl and toss to coat.
To serve, divide the chicken thighs and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Sautéed Chicken Thighs with Brussels Sprouts & Peanut Sauce

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove the outer layer of leaves from the Brussels sprouts, then trim off and discard the stem ends; quarter the sprouts lengthwise and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the chicken thighs in the skillet; sear on both sides until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and continue to cook until they are cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes total. Once done, transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
While the chicken cooks, trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and mince the shallot.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add the shallot to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the Brussels sprouts to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned and tender, 4 to 6 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat.
While the sprouts cook, juice the lime and transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the lime juice.
To the lime juice and garlic, add peanut butter, water, soy sauce, honey, and crushed red pepper; whisk together.
To serve, divide the chicken thighs and Brussels sprouts between dishes; drizzle with the peanut sauce or serve the sauce on the side for dipping. Enjoy!

name: Sautéed Chicken Thighs with Mushroom Sauce & Roasted Green Beans

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash green beans and trim ends. Transfer to a sheet pan.
Drizzle green beans with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Spread out evenly and place in the oven. Tossing once halfway through, roast until tender-crisp, 10-15 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
In a medium bowl, mix together flour, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken to bowl and toss to coat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Shake off excess flour from chicken and add to skillet. Cook until browned, 2-3 minutes per side.
Wash, dry, and halve mushrooms.
Transfer chicken to a plate and return skillet to stove. Add more oil and mushrooms. Stirring occasionally, cook until tender, 4-5 minutes.
Return chicken to pan and add broth. Reduce heat to medium and cook until chicken is cooked through and liquid is reduced, 5-6 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, arrange chicken with mushroom sauce and green beans on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Sautéed Chicken Thighs with Roasted Parsnips & Grape Tomatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F.

Wash parsnips, tomatoes, and green onions. Peel the parsnips, halve crosswise, then halve or quarter lengthwise to form equal-size pieces. Trim root ends and cut green onions into 2 inch pieces. Transfer everything to a sheet pan.
Drizzle with oil and season with thyme, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
Place in the oven and roast, tossing once halfway through, until parsnips are tender, 15-20 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-heat.
Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Peel and mince garlic.
Transfer chicken to a plate; return skillet to stove and reduce heat to low. Add garlic and vinegar. Scrape up any browned bits from bottom of skillet. Return chicken to skillet and coat with sauce.
To serve, place chicken with roasted parsnips, tomatoes, and onions on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Sautéed Kale "Caesar" Penne with Almonds, Bread Crumbs & Parmesan

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ¼-cup cooking water before draining and set aside.)
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl.
Roughly chop almonds. Add to the bowl with the garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium-low heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash, dry, and zest lemon into the bowl with the garlic and almonds. (Reserve lemon for later use.)

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, almonds, lemon zest, bread crumbs, and spices. Cook, stirring often, until golden and toasted, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and return to the bowl. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Mince anchovy fillets. Peel and mince additional garlic.

Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add anchovies, garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring often, until garlic is fragrant and golden, about 2 minutes.
Add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 1-2 minutes more.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.

Juice reserved lemon into the skillet. Add pasta, reserved pasta water, and Parmesan. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly and Parmesan has melted, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and top with the bread crumb mixture. Enjoy!

name: Sautéed Shrimp over Japanese-Style Carrot, Cucumber & Mango Salad

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place mayo, vinegar, hot sauce, honey, and salt in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and trim carrots; using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the carrots into noodle-like strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim cucumber; using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the cucumber into noodle-like strips. Add to the bowl.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; cut lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl, along with bread crumbs, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until just opaque, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice lengthwise into thin pieces.
To serve, divide salad, shrimp, and avocado between plates or bowls. Top with sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Sautéed Vegetable & Black Bean Tacos Boats with Tangy Tomato Guacamole

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Seed and medium dice the bell pepper.
Peel and small dice the onion.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion, bell pepper, and garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
Grate mozzarella.
Add beans, corn, tomato sauce, and spices to the skillet, stirring to combine. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocado. Slice while still in the skin, then scoop out into a medium bowl; mash slightly with a fork.
Medium dice the tomatoes; place in the bowl with the avocado.
Juice lime into the bowl, add salt, and stir to combine.
Separate whole leaves from the head of romaine to use as taco shells.
To serve, arrange romaine leaves on plates and fill with seasoned beans and veggies. Top with guacamole and cheese. Enjoy!

name: Sautéed White Fish with Balsamic Quinoa, Spinach & Strawberry Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Season fish with dill, salt, and pepper. Dust both sides with flour.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add fish and cook until golden, 2-3 minutes per side.
amounts: about 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: In a large bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, basil, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry spinach. Thinly slice leaves crosswise into ribbons and add to bowl with dressing.
Wash strawberries, trim tops, and medium dice. Add to bowl.
Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork. Add to bowl and toss salad.
To serve, place fish and salad on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Savory Cornmeal Pancakes with Spicy Avocado Salsa

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Small dice tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Juice lime into the bowl.
Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice. Add to the bowl along with spices and gently stir to combine the salsa. Set aside.
Place corn in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Set aside to drain.
Place corn meal, flour, nutritional yeast, almond meal, baking powder, and salt in another medium bowl; whisk to combine.
Whisk milk and maple syrup in a small bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, create a well in the center of the flour mixture. Add the milk mixture and corn; whisk until just combined.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, use a ⅓-cup measure to pour the batter into the skillet. Cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, until golden and cooked through.
To serve, divide pancakes and salsa between plates. Enjoy!

name: Savory Tomato-Chive French Toast with Apple, Feta & Pumpkin Seed Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Place eggs, tomato sauce, cornstarch, and spices in a baking dish; whisk until smooth.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, place bread slices in the dish with the egg batter; turn the slices, making sure both sides are soaked through.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, transfer soaked bread to the skillet and cook until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter and core the apple, then thinly slice each quarter; transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Add spring mix, feta, and pumpkin seeds to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Chop chives into small pieces.
Divide French toast between plates; top with butter and chives. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Scallop Bisque with Carrots, Celery, Tomatoes, Parsley & Crispy Bacon

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a small bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; add to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the parsley to the bowl with the veggies (reserve remaining parsley for serving).
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat the scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the bacon to a clean, paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve pot with drippings for the next step.)

Return pot with drippings to medium-high heat. Add scallops in a single layer; cook until golden brown and opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Once done, add to the plate with the bacon. (Reserve pot with drippings for the next step.)
Return pot with drippings to medium heat. Add the veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
Add flour to the pot with the veggies and cook, stirring frequently, for 1 minute.
Slowly add broth to the pot, while stirring constantly, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, chop scallops into bite-sized pieces.
Add tomatoes, cream, and spices to the pot; stir to combine the soup and remove from heat. Purée with an immersion or regular blender (return soup to the pot).
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide soup between bowls; top with scallops, bacon, and reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Scallop Fettuccine Alfredo with Lemon, Parsley & Sautéed Asparagus

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, snap (or cut) off woody ends of asparagus.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add asparagus, salt, and pepper; cook, turning occasionally, until bright green and tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in a small bowl, setting aside a small handful for serving.
Return skillet to medium heat. Add Parmesan, cream, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until cheese melts and sauce is combined, 1-2 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: While the sauce is cooking, pat the scallops dry with paper towels and place on another plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Add scallops to the skillet with the sauce and gently stir to coat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until scallops are opaque, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Juice lemon into the skillet with the sauce. Add drained pasta and parsley. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook, tossing occasionally, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide scallop fettuccine and asparagus between plates. Top pasta with reserved Parmesan and enjoy!

name: Scallop Zucchini Noodle Salad with Spinach, Radish & Citrus Dressing

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Zest orange into a small bowl and set aside. Juice orange into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince or grate ginger; add to the bowl with the orange juice along with oil, vinegar, and salt. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Trim zucchini and, using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel into thin noodles.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once it is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add zucchini noodles and salt to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, about 2 minutes. Transfer noodles to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Trim and thinly slice radishes. Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add both to the bowl with the zucchini noodles and set aside.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; rub with oil and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add scallops in a single layer; cook until they develop a nice sear and are opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, add spinach to the bowl with the zucchini and toss to combine the salad.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with avocado, scallops, orange zest, and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Scallops with Cilantro-Lime Butter, Cheddar Potatoes & Veggies

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of butter.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Thinly slice potatoes crosswise and transfer to the baking dish; season with salt and pepper, then spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese into a small bowl, then add bread crumbs and Italian seasoning. Stir to combine the cheese topping and set aside.
Zest and juice lime into another small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl with the lime and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add scallops and sear until golden brown and cooked through, 1½-2 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and slice carrot crosswise into thin rounds.

When the potatoes are tender, remove from the oven, and sprinkle with the cheese topping. Return to the oven and continue to bake until the cheese is melted and golden, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.

When the scallops are done, wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat; add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add carrot, snap peas, salt, and pepper; sauté until the veggies are fork-tender, 4-5 minutes. Add to the plate with the scallops.

Return the skillet to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add lime, garlic, and cilantro; cook, stirring constantly, until butter is melted and fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cheesy potatoes, veggies, and scallops between plates; drizzle scallops with warm cilantro-lime butter and enjoy!

name: Scallops over Spicy Egg Fried Rice with Snap Peas, Carrots & Cilantro

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
