Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place in a medium bowl.
Halve snap peas. Add to the bowl with the carrots.
Peel and mince ginger. Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices, then stir-fry until softened, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, place eggs in a small bowl and whisk to combine.

When the veggies are done, add egg to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until set and no longer runny, about 1 minute. Transfer veggies and egg to the reserved medium bowl; loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Pat scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
While the rice is resting, wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add scallops in a single layer and cook until they develop a nice sear and are opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)

When the rice is done, transfer to the skillet along with veggie-egg mixture, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce. Return skillet to medium-high heat and stir-fry until warmed through, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Divide fried rice between plates or bowls; top with scallops and reserved cilantro. Serve with additional chili-garlic sauce on the side and enjoy!

name: Seared Chicken Breast with Green Beans & Sautéed Mushrooms

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and discard the ends of the green beans; transfer to a medium bowl.
Cut off the mushroom stem ends, then quarter the mushrooms lengthwise from cap to stem (you may need to cut them further if the mushrooms are large). Transfer everything to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds. Transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic and add to the bowl with the shallot.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is heated, add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until it is cooked through and golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the chicken to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Juice the lemon into a small bowl.

Once the chicken has been transferred, add more butter to the skillet, followed by the shallot, garlic, and mushrooms; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms have softened, 5 to 7 minutes.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, season with salt and add in the green beans. Cook the beans until they are bright green and tender-crisp, 3 to 4 minutes.
Once the beans are cooked, drain them in a colander and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process. Set aside to drain.
Add additional butter and the lemon juice to the skillet. Stir together, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet, until the butter has melted.
To serve, place the chicken and green beans on a plate and spoon the lemon butter and sautéed mushrooms over top. Enjoy!

name: Seared Chicken Thighs with Creamy Zucchini and Cauliflower Purée

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken to the skillet and pan-fry until cooked through and golden brown, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet with drippings.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Fill a medium saucepan with about 1-inch of hot water from the tap; cover and place over high heat.
Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Roughly chop into bite-sized pieces.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add cauliflower, reduce heat to medium, and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons.
Small dice tomato.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the zucchini, tomato, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, 3-4 minutes.
While the veggies are cooking, cut cream cheese into small pieces. Finely grate Parmesan.
Add cream cheese, Parmesan, and water to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the cheeses melt and combine, 2-3 minutes.
Return chicken to the skillet with the creamy zucchini and cook, turning to coat, until warmed through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
When the cauliflower is done, drain in a colander, and transfer to a blender. Add oil, salt, and pepper; purée until smooth.
To serve, divide cauliflower purée, chicken, veggies, and sauce between plates. Enjoy!

name: Seared Cod with Bacon-Balsamic Tomatoes, Asparagus & Sweet Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate, leaving the drippings in the skillet. (Set skillet aside for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus; peel and small dice sweet potato. Transfer both to a baking sheet pan.
Peel and mince garlic; sprinkle over the veggies. Squeeze lemon over top, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until crisp-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, return skillet (with bacon drippings) to medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat fish dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add fish and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, about 5 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
When the fish is done, remove all but 1 tablespoon of drippings from the skillet. Return to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add tomatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to burst, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

Add vinegar and half of the parsley (reserving the rest for garnish) to the skillet; continue to cook, crushing tomatoes with the back of a spoon to release their juices, until sauce is thickened, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide fish, sauce, and roasted veggies between plates. Top fish with bacon and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Seared Coriander Pork Chop with Roasted Plum, Fennel & Parmesan Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into thin slices and transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the baking sheet with the plums.
Peel and mince ginger. Add to the baking sheet, then drizzle plums and fennel with oil. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until plums and fennel are golden and tender, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, honey, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
When the plums and fennel are done, add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork chops and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Seared Halloumi with Minted Strawberry-Tomato Salad & Golden Couscous

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous and turmeric, then stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat halloumi dry with paper towels, then cut crosswise into ½-inch thick slices.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the halloumi and cook, turning halfway through, until golden brown on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and halve strawberries lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl and stir to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining mint for serving.)
To serve, divide couscous and salad between plates or bowls. Top salad with halloumi and sprinkle with reserved mint. Enjoy!

name: Seared Lamb Chops with French-Dressed Asparagus, Chopped Egg & Lemon

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus.

Once the water in the pan is boiling, add asparagus and salt; cook until tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer asparagus to the colander, and run under cold water to cool; transfer to a plate and set aside. (Reserve boiling water in pan for the next step.)
Carefully add eggs to the reserved pan, reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a small bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the shallot. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
Add capers, oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the bowl. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the lamb chops dry with paper towels and place on another plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until lamb is golden brown and cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and set aside to rest.
Meanwhile, cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Peel and roughly chop the eggs. Season with salt.
Divide lamb and asparagus between plates. Top asparagus with dressing, chopped egg, and reserved parsley. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Seared Lemon Chicken with Spinach Ricotta Linguine

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve ½ cup of pasta cooking water before draining.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add chicken to the skillet and cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic.
Wash and dry lemons. Zest and juice 1 lemon into a small bowl. Slice remaining half a lemon into rounds and set aside for garnish.
Reduce heat to low, then add garlic, lemon zest and juice, and water to the skillet with the chicken. Stir to combine.
Cover skillet and cook, turning chicken once and basting occasionally, until it's cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove chicken to a plate and cover loosely with foil.
Return skillet (with leftover cooking juices) to medium heat. Add ricotta and reserved pasta cooking water. Whisk until smooth.
Wash and dry the spinach (skip if it came pre-washed). While stirring, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add pasta to the skillet with spinach-ricotta sauce; toss to combine and cook until heated through, 1-2 minutes.
Slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide pasta and chicken between bowls and garnish with lemon rounds. Enjoy!

name: Seared Lemon Shrimp with Tomato Rice Pilaf & Peas

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 2 minutes.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water. Drain rice and transfer to the saucepan along with the spices. Cook, stirring constantly, about 1 minute.
Add broth and tomato sauce to the saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp and cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side.
While the shrimp cooks, wash, dry, and zest the lemon into a small bowl, then juice it into the same bowl.
Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Remove skillet from the heat and stir in lemon zest, juice, and parsley. Cover with a lid and set aside.
Place peas in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw; add to the rice, tossing gently to combine.
To serve, divide rice pilaf and lemon shrimp between plates. Enjoy!

name: Seared Maple-Dijon Pork Chop with Fennel, Apple & Walnut Salad

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, roughly chop walnuts.
Once the skillet is hot, add walnuts and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly browned, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Place maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper in another small bowl. Whisk to combine the maple-Dijon sauce and set aside.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apple. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with cooled walnuts, and gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork chops and salad between plates. Drizzle chops with maple-Dijon sauce. Enjoy!

name: Seared NY Strip with Spicy Celery, Cucumber & Cilantro "Tiger Salad"

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl along with soy sauce, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside for serving.
Place vinegar, oil, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, thinly slice jalapeño pepper crosswise into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level (optional). Add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and slice green onions on the diagonal into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and slice celery on the diagonal into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and add the leaves to the bowl. Stir to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates. Drizzle sauce over the steak and enjoy!

name: Seared Pork Chop with Cranberry-Pear Pan Sauce, Parsnips & Carrots

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and medium dice parsnips and carrots; transfer both to a baking sheet pan.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are golden and tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
Meanwhile, quarter, core, and small dice pear; place in a small bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the pear.
When the chops are done, add more oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom; add pear, onion, garlic, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until pear and onion start to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add broth, cranberries, and honey to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring often, until fruit is tender and sauce is thickened, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, divide chops and roasted veggies between plates; spoon pan sauce over chops. Enjoy!

name: Seared Pork Chop & Sautéed Plums with Lemony Arugula-Almond Salad

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add almonds and cook, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add half to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside. (Reserve remaining shallot for later use.)
Return skillet to medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and set aside to rest. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, halve plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into ½-inch thick slices.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add reserved shallot, plums, water, honey, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until plums are tender, 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, add arugula and toasted almonds to the bowl with the dressing. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork chops and salad between plates. Top pork chops with sautéed plums and enjoy!

name: Seared Pork Chop with Spicy Roasted Butternut Squash, Apple & Onion

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash, dry, trim, and peel squash; quarter lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and cut crosswise into thin slices. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, quarter, core, and thinly slice apple. Add to the bowl with the butternut squash.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Add oil, sugar, and spices to the bowl, then toss to combine. Transfer squash, apple, and onion to a baking sheet pan, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until squash and apples are tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the squash and apples have about 10 minutes left, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chops and veggies between plates. Enjoy!

name: Seared Pork Salad with Carrots, Blue Cheese, Pistachios & Balsamic

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork chops and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, peel, and trim carrots; run the peeler along each carrot to make long, noodle-like strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the bowl, along with the blue cheese, and toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Thinly slice pork chops.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with pork and enjoy!

name: Seared Ribeye with Ginger-Cilantro Cucumber Salad & Cauliflower Rice

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower and place in a medium bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl with the cauliflower and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and cut into portions; season both sides with salt and pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Remove to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a small bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the ginger and garlic; add oil, vinegar, and salt. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice cucumber; add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.

When the steak is done, return the skillet to medium-high heat; add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower, green onion, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is soft, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice, steak, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Seared Ribeye over Crunchy Cabbage, Cucumber & Water Chestnut Salad

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime, along with mayo, soy sauce, honey, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Drain and roughly chop water chestnuts. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad and steak between plates or bowls, then sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Seared Ribeye with Roasted Broccoli & Olive Tapenade

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until broccoli is golden brown and tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Mince olives, anchovy fillet, and capers. Add all three to the bowl with the parsley along with oil and vinegar; stir to combine the tapenade and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak between plates. Add tapenade to each plate, spreading it out in an even layer, then top with roasted broccoli. Enjoy!

name: Seared Ribeye with Roasted Peppers, Tomatoes, Pickled Onions & Basil

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Place vinegar, honey, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel garlic. Add to the baking sheet with the peppers along with the tomatoes. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and crushed red pepper; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are browned and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.
About 15 minutes before the veggies are done, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven. Add basil and pickled onion to the baking sheet, then stir to combine.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates. Enjoy!

name: Seared Rosemary Chicken Thighs with Creamy Mushrooms & Peas

instructions.text: Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms; transfer to a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken in a single layer and cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, and loosely cover with aluminum foil (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
While the chicken browns, peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Return the skillet to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion begins to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add mushrooms to the skillet and cook until golden brown and tender, 4-5 minutes.
While the mushrooms cook, place peas in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw.
Add peas, cream, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine.
Return chicken to the skillet, along with any accumulated juices. Cover and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
When the chicken is done, add Parmesan to the skillet and stir to combine.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates, spooning skillet sauce on top. Enjoy!

name: Seared Sage Pork Chop with Crunchy Apple, Celery & Pumpkin Seed Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot into half-moons; add to the bowl, toss to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, trim and slice celery crosswise into ½-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the dressing and shallot.
Quarter, core, and medium dice apple; add to the bowl.
Add mixed greens to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork chops and salad between plates; top salad with pumpkin seeds and enjoy!

name: Seared Salmon over Mediterranean Bean Salad with Feta & Yogurt Sauce

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Juice lemon into a small bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Add yogurt, water, salt, and pepper to the bowl; whisk to combine the yogurt sauce and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a plate; season with spices on the top-side.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add salmon, skin-side down, and cook, flipping once, until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side depending on thickness. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with foil.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice the shallot into rings; place in a medium bowl.
Trim cucumber, halve lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-moons. Add to the bowl with the shallot.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Add beans, feta, oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine the bean salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Divide bean salad and salmon between plates; drizzle yogurt sauce over the salmon just before serving. Enjoy!

name: Seared Sausage with Dutch-Style Potato Kale Mash & Dijon Yogurt Sauce

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and medium dice potatoes. Place in a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leek, garlic, and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.

Add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 1-2 minutes more. Return sautéed veggies to the bowl. (Reserve the skillet for the next step.)
Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
When the potatoes are done, drain in a colander and return to the saucepan. Add milk, butter, and spices; using a potato masher, mash until smooth.
Add sautéed veggies to the pan with the mashed potatoes and stir to combine. Cover to keep warm and set aside.
Place yogurt, Dijon, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the sauce.
To serve, divide sausages and potato-kale mash between plates. Drizzle with Dijon yogurt sauce and enjoy!

name: Seared Scallop Salad with Balsamic Roasted Grapes, Avocado & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Transfer grapes to a baking dish; drizzle with oil and vinegar, then season with salt. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until grapes begin to swell, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add scallops in a single layer and cook until they develop a nice sear and are opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
When the grapes are done, remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.

While the grapes are cooling, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the mixed greens and feta; toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with grapes and scallops. Enjoy!

name: Seared Scallops with Carrot-Parsnip Mash & Arugula Asparagus Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Trim, peel, and medium dice parsnips and carrots; place both in a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until veggies are soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus, then cut spears into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing, toss to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add scallops to the skillet in a single layer and cook until they develop a nice sear and are opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
When the veggies are done, drain in a colander and return to the saucepan. Add cream, salt, and pepper; using a potato masher, mash until semi-smooth.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Add arugula and almonds to the bowl with the dressing and asparagus; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide carrot-parsnip mash, scallops, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Seared Scallops with Lemon Parsley Sauce & Bacon-Roasted Acorn Squash

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve acorn squash lengthwise; trim ends, scrape out the seeds, and cut crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
Small dice bacon and butter. Sprinkle both over the squash, then season with salt and pepper.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until bacon is crisp and squash is tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in a small bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add scallops in a single layer; cook until golden brown and opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.

Wipe skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-low heat. Add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot, garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Juice lemon into the skillet and stir to combine the sauce. Remove from heat.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the skillet with the sauce and stir to combine.
To serve, divide squash, bacon, and scallops between plates; spoon lemon parsley sauce over scallops. Enjoy!

name: Seared Sirloin with Blackberry-Mint Sauce & Roasted Root Veggies

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and medium dice turnip and carrots; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Quarter potatoes and add to the baking sheet with the other veggies; drizzle with oil, sprinkle with spices, toss to coat, and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing once, until veggies are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
While the steak is cooking, pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Roughly chop blackberries.

When the steak is done, zest and juice lemon into the skillet; add mint, blackberries, water, sugar, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes; remove from heat.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and roasted veggies between plates; drizzle sauce over the steak and enjoy!

name: Seared Steak with Ginger-Orange Pan Sauce & Apricot Veggie Couscous

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Trim and small dice celery. Place both in a small bowl.
Small dice apricots. Add to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, apricot, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and cut into portions. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
When the veggies are tender, add broth to the pan and bring to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, zest and juice orange into the reserved bowl. Add Dijon and sugar, then stir to combine. Set aside.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic.

When the steak is done, return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add orange mixture to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until sauce is reduced slightly, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Small dice tomato. Add to the pan with the couscous and gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide couscous and steak between plates. Top steak with ginger-orange pan sauce and enjoy!

name: Seared Steak with Roasted Broccoli, Shallots & Tahini-Lemon Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel and quarter or halve shallots (depending on size). Add to the baking sheet with the broccoli.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until veggies are golden brown and tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and juice lemon into a small bowl.
Add tahini, water, and spices to the bowl with the lemon juice. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates; drizzle veggies with tahini-lemon sauce. Enjoy!

name: Seared Strip Steak with Crunchy Zucchini Noodles & Sizzling Chili Oil

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash, dry, and trim zucchini; use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl along with oil, crushed red pepper, and salt. Stir to combine the chili oil.
Return skillet to medium heat. Once hot, add chili oil and cook until sizzling and fragrant, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat and immediately drizzle over the zucchini noodles. Toss to coat.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and zucchini noodles between plates. Enjoy!

name: Seared Strip Steak Salad with Cucumber, Dates, Pistachios, Feta & Dill

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Place oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop dates and pistachios. Add both to the bowl, along with mixed greens and feta, then toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Thinly slice steak into strips.
To serve, divide salad and steak between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Seared Striploin with Blue Cheese Butter & Lemony Zucchini-Leek Sauté

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Place blue cheese, butter, and thyme in a small bowl; set aside to soften.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off the root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces and place in another small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the leek and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak to the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons.
When the steak is done, return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the leek, garlic, and spices; sauté until soft and golden, 3-4 minutes.
Add zucchini and water to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the liquid is evaporated and zucchini is fork-tender, 5 minutes more.
While the zucchini is cooking, gently mash the softened butter, blue cheese, and thyme with the back of a spoon to combine.
When the zucchini is done, juice lemon into the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggie sauté between plates; top steak with blue cheese butter and enjoy!

name: Seared Tempeh with Basil Parmesan "Tapenade" & Warm Peach-Plum Medley

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the basil.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pine nuts. Add to the bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the "tapenade." Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, slice tempeh crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces. Place in a medium bowl, along with spices, and gently stir to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tempeh in a single layer and cook, flipping once, until browned and warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into ½-inch thick wedges. Place in the reserved bowl.
Halve plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into ¼-inch thick slices. Add to the bowl with the peaches and set aside.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peaches, plums, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide warm fruit and tempeh between plates. Top tempeh with tapenade and enjoy!

name: Sesame Beef, Asparagus & Carrot Lettuce Wraps with Cilantro

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus and cut into 1-inch pieces.
In a small saucepan, bring a ½-inch of water to a boil over high heat. Add asparagus and cook, uncovered, until crisp-tender, 3-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince or grate ginger; transfer to a medium bowl.
Add soy sauce, oil, and vinegar to the bowl with the ginger; whisk to combine the dressing.
When the asparagus is done, drain and add to the bowl with the dressing; set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, cover loosely with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest for about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and trim carrots. Using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel carrots into thin noodle-like sticks; add to bowl with the asparagus.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Slice lime into wedges.
Thinly slice steak against the grain and add to the bowl with the vegetables. Toss to combine.

Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Fill with steak, vegetables, and cilantro; sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve with lime wedges on the side and enjoy!

name: Sesame Chicken & Broccoli with Basmati Rice

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
In a medium bowl, whisk together egg and cornstarch.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Add to egg mixture and toss to coat. Set aside.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash and cut broccoli into same-size florets. Cut remaining stalks into smaller pieces. Wash, trim root ends, and chop green onions.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together garlic, honey, soy sauce, oil, and seeds. Set aside.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a bowl.
Return skillet to stove and add more oil. Add broccoli and, stirring frequently, cook until tender and bright green, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: about ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.text: Return chicken to skillet, pour in sauce, and add onions. Stir and cook until sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Uncover rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place rice in a bowl and top with stir fry. Enjoy!

name: Sesame Chicken, Cabbage, Mushroom & Ginger Stir-Fry with Jasmine Rice

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

While the rice is cooking, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small bowl along with soy sauce, oil, sesame seeds, water, cornstarch, vinegar, sugar, chili-garlic sauce, and pepper. Stir to combine the stir-fry sauce and set aside.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; quarter lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the green onions.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to brown, about 2 minutes.
Add veggies to the skillet and stir-fry until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Add stir-fry sauce to the skillet and continue to cook until sauce thickens, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Top with reserved green onions and enjoy!

name: Sesame-Coconut Curry with Butternut Squash, Edamame, Peppers & Rice

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and large dice. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the squash.

Quarter chili pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl with the other veggies. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.

Add edamame, coconut milk, tahini, and sugar to the pan; stir to combine the curry and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until curry has thickened and squash is tender, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: To serve, divide rice and curry between plates or bowls; top with sesame seeds and reserved green onions. Enjoy!

name: Sesame Crusted Chicken with Snap Pea, Cucumber & Cilantro Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger; place in a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the ginger.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with oil and salt; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Place sesame seeds and cornstarch another medium bowl; stir to combine.

Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Spread mayo over both sides of the chicken, then dredge in the sesame coating, pressing gently to adhere. Transfer to a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add the chicken and cook until the coating is golden and chicken is cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut snap peas crosswise into thin pieces, add to the bowl, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Sesame Crusted Cod with Green Bean-Bell Pepper Sauté & Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim green beans, place in a medium bowl, and set aside.
Pat the cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Place egg and cornstarch in another medium bowl; beat with a whisk or fork until smooth.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, place sesame seeds on another plate. Dip cod in the egg mixture, then dredge in the sesame seeds, pressing gently to adhere; return to the plate.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cod and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips; add to the bowl with the green beans.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice between plates or bowls; top with cod and veggies. Enjoy!

name: Sesame Encrusted Salmon over Tahini-Parmesan Caesar Salad with Apple

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest the lemon into a large salad bowl. Juice half of the lemon into the same bowl. Cut remaining lemon into wedges and set aside.
Add water, tahini, Dijon, oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with lemon juice and zest; whisk until the dressing becomes smooth and glossy.
Peel and finely mince garlic. Finely mince anchovy fillet; transfer both to the salad bowl.
Finely grate half of the Parmesan and add to the salad bowl (set the rest aside for garnish). Stir to combine and set aside.
Pat the salmon fillets dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper.
Combine the egg and cornstarch into a medium bowl; beat with a whisk or fork until smooth and frothy.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet is heating, dip the skinless side of the salmon into the egg mixture and place back on the plate, skin-side down. Sprinkle sesame seeds over the surface of the fish, pressing down gently with your fingers to adhere.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add salmon to the skillet, sesame-seed side down, and cook until crust is firm and seeds are golden brown, about 3 minutes. Flip and cook until salmon is cooked through and skin is crispy, 5-7 minutes longer. Remove skillet from the heat.
Meanwhile, chop or tear the romaine into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash, core, and thinly slice the apple; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and salmon between bowls or plates. Grate reserved Parmesan over top and garnish with lemon wedges. Enjoy!

name: Sesame-Ginger Glazed Salmon with Avocado-Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
In a shallow bowl, whisk together the minced garlic and ginger, soy sauce, vinegar, and sesame oil.
Place the salmon flesh side down in the marinade and coat both sides; let it sit while you prepare the salad dressing.
In a medium bowl, prepare the salad dressing by whisking together the mayo, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, and salt.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Add the sesame seeds to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl.

Once sesame seeds have been removed, increase heat to medium-high. Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Place salmon in the skillet skin-side down, reserving marinade in the bowl. Cook until skin is crisp, 3-4 minutes, then flip over and pour the reserved marinade over top. Continue cooking salmon in the marinade until opaque, 3-4 more minutes.
Wash the fresh produce.

Halve the cucumber crosswise, then quarter lengthwise and slice crosswise on an angle; add to the bowl with dressing. Halve and pit the avocado; scoop out the flesh with a spoon and medium dice; add to the bowl. Trim onion ends and thinly chop on an angle; add to the bowl. Gently toss until well combined.
To serve, place salmon on a plate and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Sesame-Ginger Orzo Pasta Salad with Shrimp, Carrot & Bell Pepper

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and orzo, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, about 8 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger. Place in a medium bowl along with soy sauce, vinegar, oil, sesame seeds, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin pieces.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until just opaque, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, add cooled orzo to the bowl with the veggies and dressing. Stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide orzo pasta salad between plates or bowls. Top with shrimp and enjoy!

name: Sesame-Lime Noodles with Crispy Tempeh, Snap Peas & Broccoli Slaw

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl with the ginger and garlic. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Zest and juice half of the lime into the bowl. Add soy sauce, water, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar. Whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce and set aside. (Reserve remaining lime for later use.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Using your fingers, crumble tempeh into the skillet, then add salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the tempeh is browned, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice reserved lime into another small bowl. Add water, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar. Whisk to combine the tempeh seasoning and set aside.
Cut snap peas crosswise into bite-size pieces.
Once the tempeh is browned, reduce heat to medium-low, add the tempeh seasoning, and stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has evaporated, about 1 minute. Return to the bowl.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add snap peas, broccoli slaw, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 4-5 minutes.
Add drained noodles and stir-fry sauce to the skillet. Continue to cook, tossing frequently, until the liquid is absorbed and noodles are warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide noodles between plates or bowls, then top with tempeh and reserved green onions. Enjoy!

name: Sesame-Masala Tuna Fritters with Coriander Aioli & Roasted Veggies

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel, trim, and thinly slice carrots; add to the baking sheet with the broccoli. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain tuna, place in a medium bowl, and flake with a fork.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Zest lemon into the bowl with the tuna. Add egg, almond flour, sesame seeds, mayo, and spices; stir well to combine. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
Using a ¼-cup measure, form the tuna mixture into ½-inch thick fritters and place on a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fritters and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, juice the reserved lemon into a small bowl; add mayo and spices. Stir to combine the aioli.
To serve, divide veggies, tuna fritters, and aioli between plates. Enjoy!

name: Sesame-Panko Edamame Fritters with Spicy Mayo & Tahini Dressed Salad

instructions.text: Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; drain and place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and mince onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the edamame.
Add flour, eggs, salt, pepper to the bowl, then using a fork, stir until well combined. (The batter will be soft and sticky.)
Place bread crumbs and sesame seeds on a plate. Stir to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
Using a ¼-cup measure, drop edamame batter onto the plate with the bread crumbs. Gently roll each scoop of batter in the crumbs to coat.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Using a spatula, transfer batter to the skillet, spacing the scoops a few inches apart. Use the spatula to press down on the batter to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, place mayo and chili-garlic sauce in a clean small bowl. Whisk to combine the spicy mayo and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger; place in a clean medium bowl. Add tahini, vinegar, soy sauce, oil, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice cucumber and add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with edamame fritters and drizzle with spicy mayo. Enjoy!

name: Sesame Rice Balls (Onigiri) with Smoked Salmon, Avocado & Veggie Salad

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with mayo, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add sesame seeds; cook, stirring constantly, until seeds are toasted and golden brown, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork. Add toasted sesame seeds, vinegar, and sugar; stir to combine, then spread the rice out on a baking sheet pan to cool, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and crushed red pepper in a small bowl; whisk to combine the dipping sauce. Set aside.
Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces. Halve and pit avocado; slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.

Portion out the rice using a scant ¼-cup measure. Using lightly oiled hands, form each portion of rice into a ping pong-sized ball and return to the baking sheet. Layer salmon and avocado pieces over each rice ball.
Divide rice balls (onigiri) and salad between plates. Serve with dipping sauce on the side and enjoy!

name: Sesame Roasted Chickpea & Veggie Bowl with Quinoa

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half rounds. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Quarter mushrooms and add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger; add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine, transfer to a baking sheet pan, and spread out in an even layer.
Place veggies in the oven and roast until starting to brown, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, place chickpeas, oil, and soy sauce in the bowl used for the veggies; stir to coat.
Once the veggies are starting to brown, add seasoned chickpeas to the baking sheet; return to the oven and continue to bake until the veggies are fork-tender, 5 minutes more.
Place additional soy sauce, maple syrup, and chili-garlic sauce in the bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.
To serve, divide quinoa between bowls. Top with roasted chickpeas, veggies, and sesame seeds. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

name: Sesame Salmon-Bell Pepper Skewers with Grilled Bok Choy & Rice

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with oil, soy sauce, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the marinade.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end (or corner) firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.
Cut the salmon into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl, gently stir to coat, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, using a clean cutting board, trim and cut bok choy in half lengthwise. Place on a plate, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper.

Once the pan is hot, add bok choy, cut-side down, and grill, flipping once, until tender and charred, 4-5 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pan for later use.)

Meanwhile, thread salmon and bell pepper onto the skewers, alternating ingredients; place on another plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the salmon and bell pepper directly on the grill pan.)
Return pan to medium-high heat, add skewers and grill, turning every 1 ½-2 minutes, until salmon is opaque and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to the plate with the bok choy.
