To serve, divide rice, bok choy, and skewers between plates. Sprinkle skewers with sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Sesame Salmon with Broccoli, Pickled Carrot, Bok Choy & Ginger Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until broccoli is golden brown and tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, honey, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
Trim and slice bok choy crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot. Add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the pickled veggies, and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl along with soy sauce, vinegar, honey, and chili-garlic sauce, then whisk to combine the marinade.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end (or corner) firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.
Cut the salmon into 1-inch cubes. Place in another medium bowl, along with half of the marinade, and stir to coat. (Reserve remaining marinade for the sauce.)
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, add sesame seeds to the bowl with the salmon, and stir once more to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add salmon (leaving any excess marinade in the bowl) and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, add mayo to the bowl with the reserved marinade and whisk to combine the ginger sauce.
To serve, divide broccoli, pickled veggies, and salmon between bowls. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

name: Sesame Salmon over Warm Spinach, Curried Cauliflower & Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut leaves off the cauliflower, separate into small florets, and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Drizzle cauliflower with oil and season with curry powder; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until the cauliflower starts to soften, about 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl; add mayo, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise; thinly slice crosswise into half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place on a plate; coat both sides with oil and season with salt and pepper on the top side.

Remove baking sheet from the oven, stir the cauliflower, and push to one side. Place salmon on the other side of the baking sheet and return to the oven. Bake until salmon is cooked through and cauliflower is tender, 10-15 minutes. Remove from the oven.
While the salmon is cooking, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add sesame seeds and toast, stirring often, until golden, 2-3 minutes; remove from heat.
Once done, add the roasted cauliflower and spinach to the bowl with the dressing and cucumber. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with salmon and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Sesame Salmon Rice Bowl with Wilted Spinach & Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
Place water in a large skillet and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.

Once the water is simmering, add spinach and cook, stirring frequently, until just wilted, about 1 minute. Using tongs, transfer spinach to the colander, rinse with cold water, and set aside to drain (reserve skillet for later use).
Place vinegar, honey, soy sauce, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the marinade.

Wash, dry, trim, and slice cucumber crosswise into very thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the marinade; using your hands, gently massage cucumber with the marinade until wilted, about 1 minute. Set aside.
Return skillet to medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a plate. Season with salt on the top-side.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add salmon, skin-side down, and cook until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside.
Meanwhile, place tahini, sesame seeds, soy sauce, water, and honey in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sesame dressing.
Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can. Place in another small bowl, add half of the sesame dressing, and toss to coat. (Reserve remaining dressing for serving.)
Divide rice between bowls; top with salmon, spinach, and cucumbers. Serve with remaining dressing for drizzling over the salmon. Enjoy!

name: Sesame Shrimp Stir-Fry with Egg, Asparagus, Bok Choy, Edamame & Rice

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; place in a medium bowl.
Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus; cut into 1-inch pieces and add to the bowl with the green onion.
Trim bok choy and cut crosswise into 1-inch strips; add to the bowl and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger; set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place eggs, salt, and pepper in a small bowl; whisk to combine.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Pour eggs into the skillet; scramble using a combination of stirring and folding. Cook until eggs are no longer runny, 2-3 minutes. Remove eggs to a plate and set aside.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add shrimp, veggies, and edamame to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender and shrimp are cooked through, 5-7 minutes.
Return eggs to the skillet. Add soy sauce and sesame seeds; stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and shrimp stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Sesame Soba Noodle Bowl with Spicy Soy-Baked Tofu & Smashed Cucumbers

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash, dry, trim, and quarter cucumber lengthwise. Using the flat side of a chef's knife, press down on the skin-side of each quarter until it starts to split; cut or tear into bite-sized pieces.
Transfer cucumber pieces to a colander and sprinkle with salt. Place the colander in a bowl to catch the excess liquid and set aside.
Place soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, oil, and sugar in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the marinade.

Medium dice tofu, add to the bowl with the marinade, and gently stir to coat. Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels, then return tofu to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until tofu is golden, 13-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add salt, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water is heating, place tahini, water, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
Wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl with the sauce and set aside (reserve remaining for serving).
Transfer cucumber to a plate. (Reserve colander for the next step.)
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add noodles. Cook noodles according to package directions, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water.
Transfer drained noodles to the bowl with the sauce and stir to coat. Add additional water, a teaspoon at a time, if necessary, to coat the noodles in sauce.
To serve, divide noodles, tofu, and smashed cucumbers between bowls. Top with sesame seeds and reserved green onions. Enjoy!

name: Sesame Soba Noodle Soup with Mushrooms, Asparagus & Soft-Boiled Eggs

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 4 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince the garlic and ginger.
Place garlic, ginger, broth, tahini, tomato paste, soy sauce, oil, and crushed red pepper in a medium saucepan.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Whisk to combine, cover, and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, thinly slice mushrooms and transfer to a medium bowl.
Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus and cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Once the broth in the saucepan is simmering, add the noodles, mushrooms, and asparagus. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the noodles and vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Stir half of the onions into the soup (reserve the rest for garnish).
Peel and halve the eggs.
To serve, divide soup and eggs between bowls. Garnish with reserved green onions and crushed red pepper. Enjoy!

name: Sesame Tofu & Snap Pea Stir-Fry with Basmati Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Halve the sugar snap peas at an angle and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the snap peas.
Drain the tofu and pat dry with paper towels; cut into ¾-inch cubes.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Add the sesame seeds to the skillet; toast, stirring frequently, until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Once done, transfer to a small bowl.
Once the sesame seeds have been transferred, increase the heat to medium-high and add coconut oil to the skillet.
Add the tofu to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 4 to 6 minutes. Once done, transfer to a bowl.

Once the tofu has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet, followed by the snap peas and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until the peas are bright green and slightly softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, combine and whisk together cornstarch, water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, and sesame oil.

Return the tofu to the skillet, add about ¾ of the green onions (save the rest for garnishing), and pour in the sauce. Cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture is well coated with the sauce, 1 to 2 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls, top with the stir fry, and sprinkle with the remaining green onions and toasted sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Sesame Tuna Rice Bowl with Lettuce, Cucumber, Radish & Avocado

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place half in a small bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Drain tuna, add to the bowl with the green onion, and flake with a fork. Add mayo, oil, vinegar, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce; stir to combine and set aside.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Place additional mayo, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, and garlic powder in another small bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place on a plate.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the plate with the cucumber.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the plate.
Halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
Divide rice, tuna, and veggies between bowls; top with reserved green onions and sesame seeds. Serve with dressing on the side and enjoy!

name: Sesame Turkey Bowl with Braised Bok Choy, Carrots & Soba Noodles

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce to medium, and let simmer, covered, until you are ready to cook the noodles.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place soy sauce, oil, honey, and chili-garlic sauce in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
Trim off and discard root ends of the bok choy; separate into leaves and add to the bowl with the sauce. Set aside.
Peel and thinly slice carrot; transfer to a small bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ground turkey and cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and ginger.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
When the turkey is done, add garlic, ginger, and green onions to the skillet; stir to combine, and continue to cook until fragrant, 1 minute more.
Add carrots and broth to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add bok choy and sauce to the skillet. Cover and cook until veggies are fork-tender, 3-4 minutes; remove from heat.
Meanwhile, return water in the saucepan to a boil, add noodles, and cook according to package directions, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain in a colander.
To serve, divide noodles between bowls. Top with turkey, veggies, sauce, and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Asian Chicken Drumsticks with Broccoli & Spiced Walnuts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F, position a rack in the center position and another in the bottom position. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil (optional).
Peel and mince garlic and ginger; transfer to a large bowl.
Add soy sauce, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar to the bowl and whisk to combine the marinade. Add the chicken and toss to coat.
Spread chicken out in a single layer on a prepared sheet pan. Place on the bottom rack of the oven and roast until the chicken is cooked through, 30-35 minutes. Reserve marinade.
Wash broccoli and cut into small, bite-sized florets. Thinly slice the thicker stem. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Toss broccoli with soy sauce and oil. Spread out in a single layer on the other baking sheet and place in the oven for 5-8 minutes while you prepare the nuts.
Remove chicken from the oven. Use tongs to flip each drumstick. Spoon on remaining marinade, and return to the oven.
Roughly chop walnuts. In a small bowl, toss walnuts with water to moisten.
In another small bowl, stir together sugar, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper. Toss moistened walnuts in the spice mixture.
Remove the broccoli pan from the oven and sprinkle the walnuts on top. Return the pan to the oven for an additional 5-8 minutes or until broccoli is tender-crisp, and walnuts are toasted.
To serve, arrange chicken, broccoli, and walnuts on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Cheesy Tex-Mex Mini Meatloaves with Bell Peppers & Onions

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).
Place beef, egg, bread crumbs, and spices in a medium bowl; mix with your hands until the meatloaf mixture is well combined.
Form the beef mixture into 6 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 3-inches long. Transfer to one half of the baking sheet.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the other half of the baking sheet.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons; add to baking sheet with the peppers. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake, stirring veggies halfway through, until meatloaves are almost cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, thinly slice cheese.

When the meatloaves are almost cooked through, remove from the oven, and top with sliced cheese. Return to the oven and continue to bake until meatloaves are cooked through and the cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide meatloaves and veggies between plates. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Chicken with Maple-Thyme Squash & Brussels Sprouts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and peel the squash. Halve lengthwise, scrape out seeds, and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim and halve Brussels sprouts; add to the baking sheet with the squash.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard stems and sprinkle leaves over the veggies.
Peel and mince garlic; sprinkle over the veggies.
Drizzle veggies with oil and maple syrup; season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in a single layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Season both sides of the chicken with salt and pepper; nestle chicken in the veggies on the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven; bake until the chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender, about 20 minutes.
To serve, divide roasted veggies and chicken between plates. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Chicken Pitas with Bell Peppers, Tzatziki, Olives & Feta

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and coarsely grate cucumber, then transfer to a colander and sprinkle with salt. Place the colander in a bowl to catch excess moisture and set aside.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil and spices. Stir to combine the marinade.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into thin pieces; add to the bowl with the marinade.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips; add to the bowl.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut crosswise into thin strips; add to the bowl and stir to coat. Transfer veggies and chicken to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince additional garlic; place in a small bowl. Add yogurt and spices, then stir to combine.
Use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated cucumber. Add cucumber to the yogurt mixture and stir to combine the tzatziki; set aside.
Roughly chop olives.
Cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets; spread each pocket with tzatziki, then stuff with chicken, veggies, olives, and feta.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide pita pockets between plates and enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Chicken Tikka Masala with Roasted Cauliflower & Red Onion

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Peel and mince or press the garlic. Set half of the garlic aside.
In a medium bowl, combine ginger, tomato paste, cumin, paprika, cayenne, and salt, with half of the garlic, and yogurt. Add chicken and toss to coat.

Wash cauliflower and cut off the leaves. Separate into small florets and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces; transfer to a sheet pan. Peel and cut onion into ½-inch pieces; add to the sheet pan with the cauliflower.
Toss cauliflower and onion on the pan with oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange in a single layer and place in the oven. Roast until the cauliflower is fork-tender (about 18-20 minutes).
Transfer the chicken to a sheet pan, spreading the pieces out in a single layer. Place the pan in the oven and roast until cooked through (18-20 minutes).
Meanwhile, combine olive oil, paprika, cumin, salt, and remaining yogurt and garlic in a medium small bowl.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Once cooked, remove the cauliflower from the oven and toss with fresh parsley.
To serve, arrange the chicken and vegetables on plates, and top chicken with a dollop of yogurt sauce. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Gnocchi "alla Norma" with Roasted Eggplant and Tomatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and medium dice eggplant. Transfer to a baking sheet pan along with the tomatoes.
Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the baking sheet with the veggies along with gnocchi. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and gnocchi is golden, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the gnocchi and veggies are almost done, finely grate Parmesan.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Add Parmesan and parsley to the baking sheet. Stir to combine.
To serve, divide gnocchi and veggies between plates or bowls. Drizzle with oil and enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Gnocchi Bake with Bacon, Mushrooms, Arugula & Green Peas

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash, dry, and quarter mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into thin strips. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Small dice bacon and add to the bowl.
Add gnocchi, oil, and spices to the bowl. Stir to combine, transfer to a large baking sheet pan, and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until gnocchi is golden brown and bacon is crispy, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, place Dijon, vinegar, Worcestershire, and honey in a small bowl. Stir to combine the sauce.
Wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
When the gnocchi is done, remove from the oven. Add the sauce, arugula, and peas to the baking sheet; stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until arugula is wilted and peas are warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide gnocchi bake between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Lemon-Herb Chicken with Warm Beet, Onion, Olive & Feta Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and trim beets; halve lengthwise, then slice into ¼-inch thick wedges. Transfer to one half of a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer. Set aside.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add parsley to the bowl with the lemon, reserving a small handful for garnish.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl along with oil and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing. Transfer half to another medium bowl and set aside for the salad.
Add chicken to the bowl with the remaining dressing and turn to coat. Transfer chicken (and any dressing in the bowl) to the other half of the baking sheet, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring the beets halfway through, until beets are tender and chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, add vinegar and honey to the remaining bowl with the dressing. Whisk to combine.
Peel, trim, and slice onion crosswise into ¼-inch thick rings. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop olives and add to the bowl.
When the chicken and beets are done, remove baking sheet from the oven. Add warm beets to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and chicken between plates; top with feta and reserved parsley. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Sheet Pan Lemony Chicken & Potatoes

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 400°F and position the rack in the center. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the new potatoes and cut the cauliflower into florets. Toss in a bowl with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Arrange in a single layer on the baking sheet pan and bake for 15 minutes.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper on both sides, set aside.
amounts: ½ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Grate all of the zest from the lemon, then juice the lemon into a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic, add to bowl with the lemon juice and zest. Add olive oil, mustard, honey, and oregano and whisk together.
Quarter and thinly slice the red onion. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and add onions on top, dispersing evenly.
Lay the chicken on top of the vegetables and drizzle evenly with the lemon sauce.
Return the sheet pan to the oven and bake until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, about 20 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken and vegetables between plates and top with sauce from pans. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Lemony Greek Chicken & Vegetables with Feta

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ¼ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest the lemon into a small bowl and set aside.
Juice the lemon into a medium bowl. Peel and mince garlic and add to the same bowl. Add oil and spices and whisk to combine to make the marinade.
amounts: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Chop the bell pepper into 1-inch pieces. Peel and chop the onion into 1-inch pieces. Transfer both to the baking sheet along with the tomatoes.
Pour about half of the marinade over the vegetables and stir to coat. Place in the oven while you prepare the chicken, about 5 minutes.

Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Place the chicken in the bowl with the remaining marinade and gently toss until evenly coated.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Remove the vegetables from the oven and stir well. Push the vegetables to each side and lay the chicken flat in the center of the pan. Return to the oven and bake for 14 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Change setting to broil and cook for another 4 minutes.
While chicken is cooking, halve olives and set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and sprinkle the vegetables with olives, lemon zest, parsley, and feta.
amounts: ¼ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide the chicken and vegetables between plates and enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Pork Chops with Apricots, Red Cabbage & Blue Cheese

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with aluminum paper (optional).
Wash cabbage, quarter, and cut off core. Thinly slice crosswise into shreds and transfer to a medium bowl. Toss with oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Use tongs to transfer cabbage to a baking sheet pan, leaving the excess vinegar in the bowl. Spread cabbage out in an even layer on a baking sheet and place in the oven.
Slice the apricots in half lengthwise. Add to the bowl and toss in the remaining oil and vinegar; allow to soak in the vinegar mixture while the cabbage cooks.
Wash and dry thyme. Slide leaves off the stems; discard the stems.

Pat the pork chops dry, rub with olive oil, and season with salt, pepper, and thyme. Arrange on a baking sheet and place in the oven. Roast until pork chops are cooked through and cabbage is fork-tender (18-20 minutes).
During the last 5 minutes of cooking, sprinkle the apricots and the blue cheese over the cabbage.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: To serve, arrange a bed of cabbage, apricots, and blue cheese on a plate and top with a pork chop. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Roasted Chicken, Brussels Sprouts & Maple-Cinnamon Apples

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
While the oven heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan; rub with oil and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until chicken starts to brown, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and quarter the potatoes. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve the Brussels sprouts; add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl.
Add oil and spices to the bowl and toss to coat.
Remove baking sheet pan from the oven, flip chicken, and push to one side. Add Brussels sprouts and potatoes in an even layer. Return to oven and roast until veggies start to soften, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, quarter, core, and slice apple into wedges. Place in the medium bowl with maple syrup and cinnamon; toss to coat.
Add apples to the baking sheet pan, on top of the chicken, and cook until veggies are fork-tender and chicken is cooked through, about 8 minutes more.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates and enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Roasted Chicken & Veggie Pitas with Lemony Yogurt

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a small bowl, add yogurt, and whisk to combine. Set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; place a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, honey, and spices; whisk to combine.
Cut the chicken into small bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice the sweet potato into half rounds; add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and cut the onion into thick wedges; add to the bowl and toss to coat.

Transfer chicken and veggies to a baking sheet pan and arrange in a single layer. Place in the oven and bake, tossing once, until the chicken is cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice the cucumber; place in another medium bowl along with the salt and pepper.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the cucumber and toss to combine; reserve the other half for garnish.
Toast pitas if desired.
To serve, divide pitas between plates and spread with lemon yogurt. Top with chicken, veggies, cucumbers, and remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Roasted Halloumi, Eggplant & Tomato With Minty Yogurt

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and medium dice eggplant. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the baking sheet with the eggplant.

Pat halloumi dry with paper towels, then medium dice. Add to the baking sheet along with tomatoes. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and crushed red pepper; stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until veggies are tender and halloumi is golden, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a blender.

Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems. Roughly chop leaves, then add to the blender along with yogurt, capers, honey, salt, and crushed red pepper. Blend on high until minty yogurt is smooth; set aside.
To serve, divide halloumi and veggies between plates or bowls. Drizzle with minty yogurt and enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Salmon with Honey-Dijon Roasted Kale & Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F and place the rack in the center position.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Medium dice the potatoes and transfer to a sheet pan.
Drizzle the potatoes with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss thoroughly to coat, then arrange in a single layer.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the potatoes in the oven and roast for 10 minutes while you prepare the kale and salmon.
In a large bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper.
Cut out and discard the kale stems; chop leaves crosswise into 1-inch strips. Add the kale to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Pat dry the salmon with paper towels and place on a plate; rub with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Remove the sheet pan from the oven. Evenly spread the kale over the potatoes, then top with the salmon.
Return the pan to the oven; roast until the salmon is cooked through and the kale is crispy; 8 to 10 minutes.
To serve, divide the potatoes and kale between plates and top with the salmon. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Sausage with Cauliflower, Peppers, Feta & Sun-Dried Tomatoes

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Cut into bite-sized florets and transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the baking sheet with the cauliflower.
Drizzle oil over the veggies, season with spices, and toss to coat; spread the mixture out in an even layer.
Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes. Sprinkle tomatoes and feta over the veggies.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Place sausages on the baking sheet, nestling them between the veggies.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are tender and sausages are cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
When the veggies and sausages are done, remove from oven; transfer sausages to a cutting board and thinly slice crosswise. Add back to the baking sheet.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Sprinkle over the veggies and sausage; toss to combine.
To serve, divide roasted veggies and sausage between plates. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Sausage-Stuffed Portobellos with Cheese, Broccoli & Tomatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove stems from portobello mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills. Rub with oil, then season with salt and pepper; transfer to one half of the baking sheet, cap-side down, and set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan. Divide between a medium and a small bowl. (Set small bowl aside for later use.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the medium bowl with the Parmesan along with sausage, bread crumbs, vinegar, and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined.
Divide the sausage mixture between mushrooms (about 2 tablespoons each). Using your hands, spread the mixture over the inside of each mushroom in an even layer, gently pressing to adhere.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until mushrooms begin to soften, 8-10 minutes.

Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a clean medium bowl, along with the tomatoes. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then toss to coat.
When the mushrooms are starting to soften, remove baking sheet from the oven. Sprinkle remaining Parmesan over the mushrooms.
Add broccoli and tomatoes to the other half of the baking sheet, spreading them out in an even layer.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are fork-tender and sausage is cooked through, 12-15 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide stuffed mushrooms and veggies between plates. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Shrimp Fajita Rice Bowl with Avocado, Lime & Cilantro

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, juice half of the lime into a medium bowl. Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
Add oil, soy sauce, and spices to the bowl with the lime juice. Stir to combine the spice paste and set aside.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons. Add to the baking sheet with the peppers. Drizzle with half of the spice paste, stir to coat, and spread out in an even layer. (Set remaining spice paste aside for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until peppers are fork-tender, 15-18 minutes.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Add shrimp to the bowl with the reserved spice paste. Gently toss to coat.

When the veggies are tender, remove from the oven. Add shrimp to the baking sheet and toss to combine. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are browned and shrimp are cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
When the veggies and shrimp are done, remove from the oven. Add half of the cilantro to the baking sheet and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Divide rice between bowls. Top with shrimp, veggies, avocado, and reserved cilantro. Serve with lime wedges and enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Shrimp Fajitas with Tomato, Avocado, Cilantro & Lime

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
In a small bowl, mix together the spices; set aside.
Seed and slice bell peppers into thin strips; transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings; transfer both to the bowl with the peppers.

Add oil and approximately ⅔ of the spice mixture to the bowl with the veggies; toss to combine. Transfer veggies to a baking sheet pan, place in the oven and bake until slightly soft, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, transfer shrimp to the bowl used for the veggies. Add more oil and remaining spice mix; toss to coat and set aside.
Medium dice tomato and slice lime into wedges. Transfer both to a plate.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out; add to the plate.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Remove veggies from the oven and toss. Layer shrimp on top and return to the oven; bake until shrimp are opaque and cooked through, 7-8 more minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide shrimp and veggies between plates and garnish with cilantro. Serve with tortillas, tomato, avocado, yogurt, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Steak, Bell Pepper, Onion & Carrot Fajitas with Lime Crema

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine.
Pat steak dry with paper towels and place in the center of the baking sheet; drizzle with oil and sprinkle with half of the spice mixture on both sides (reserve remaining spices for the veggies).
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into strips; place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onion into ½-inch thick half-moons; add to the bowl with the peppers.
Peel, trim, and quarter carrot lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long pieces; add to the bowl.

Sprinkle remaining spice mixture over the veggies, drizzle with oil, and toss to combine. Add veggies to the baking sheet, spreading out in an even layer around the steak. (Reserve spice bowl for next step.)
Juice half of the lime over steak and veggies; juice the other half into the reserved bowl.
Place the baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring veggies and flipping steak halfway through, until veggies are tender and steak is cooked to desired doneness, 13-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add yogurt and spices to the bowl with the lime juice; whisk to combine the lime crema.
When the steak and veggies are done, transfer steak to the cutting board and thinly slice against the grain.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with steak and veggies, then drizzle with lime crema. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Sticky Sesame Chicken with Roasted Broccoli & Peppers

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towels, rub with olive oil, season generously with salt and pepper on both sides and place in the middle of a parchment paper lined baking sheet.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Peel and medium dice the onion. Cut the sugar snap peas crosswise (at an angle) into 1-inch pieces and add to a mixing bowl.
Cut the bell pepper into quarters lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membranes. Medium dice the pepper, add to the bowl with the onion.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into bite-sized pieces and add to bowl with other vegetables.
Drizzle the vegetables with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then arrange in a single layer on baking sheet around the chicken breasts. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes.
Heat a small saucepan over medium heat. Once the pan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Add to the saucepan; cook, stirring until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, sesame seeds and water to the saucepan. Bring sauce to a boil, then reduce heat to low, stirring frequently.
Combine cornstarch with water in a small bowl and pour into sauce. Let sauce thicken for 2-3 minutes then remove from heat and set aside.
Remove chicken from oven, drizzle sauce over top and return to oven for another 5 minutes or until sauce is sticky and chicken is cooked through.
To serve, slice chicken into strips. Divide between plates and sprinkle sesame seeds over top. Enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Sweet Potato Hash with Peppers, Fried Eggs & Paprika Aioli

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potato; transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the baking sheet with the sweet potato.

Halve chili pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons and add to the baking sheet. (Be careful with chili peppers; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the baking sheet with the other veggies, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are golden and fork-tender, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl along with mayo, vinegar, soy sauce, and spices; stir to combine the aioli and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper.
While the eggs are cooking, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven, sprinkle with half of the cilantro, and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
To serve, divide veggies and eggs between plates or bowls; top with aioli, remaining cilantro, and feta. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Sheet Pan Turkey Meatballs with Roasted Apples, Plums & Basil Yogurt

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat one half of a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into ½-inch thick slices. Place in a medium bowl.
Quarter, core, and slice apples into ¼-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl with the plums.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips. Add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine.
Transfer fruit and onions to the unoiled half of the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Set aside. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Divide between the reserved medium bowl and a small bowl. (Set small bowl aside for later use.)
Add turkey, bread crumbs, egg, and spices to the medium bowl with the basil. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs. Arrange on the oiled half of the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake, tossing fruit and turning meatballs halfway, until meatballs are cooked through and fruit is fork-tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add yogurt, mayo, water, and spices to the small bowl with the basil. Stir to combine.
To serve, divide yogurt and roasted fruit between plates; top yogurt with meatballs. Enjoy!

name: Short-Cut Spanakopita with Greek Tomato-Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and thinly slice ⅓ of the onion; transfer to a medium bowl. Add vinegar and set aside to marinate.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Mince remaining onion.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the minced onion and cook, stirring often, until softened, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a separate, medium bowl. Save skillet for later use.

When the water in the pot comes to a boil, remove lid, add the spinach and stir for a few seconds. Cook the spinach, uncovered, until wilted, 30-60 seconds. Once done, drain the spinach in a colander and rinse under cold water.
Shave parsley and dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl with the cooked onion.
Grate the cheddar and add to the bowl with the cooked onion.

Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can, then transfer to a cutting board. Roughly chop spinach and add to the bowl with the cooked onion. Add feta, oil, and spices to the bowl and mix with your hands to thoroughly combine.
To assemble the pies, lay the tortillas on a flat surface and divide the spinach mixture between them; press the mixture firmly onto one half of each tortilla; fold in half.
Wipe the skillet clean and return to medium heat. Add oil, swirl to coat, and lay the assembled pies in the pan. Cook until golden, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from the heat and slice into wedges.
Meanwhile, cut the tomato into wedges. Peel and trim the ends of the cucumber, then thinly slice into rounds. Add to the bowl with the sliced onion.
Add olives, oil, and spices to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide spinach pie and cucumber-tomato salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Shredded BBQ Tofu Bun with Creamy Cabbage, Radish, Celery & Chive Slaw

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Coarsely grate tofu and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until tofu is golden and just starting to dry out, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a medium bowl.
Chop chives into small pieces. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with yogurt, mayo, and spices. Stir to combine the dressing.
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve radishes lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the slaw, and set aside.
Place ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium saucepan; stir to combine the BBQ sauce.
Bring sauce to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
When the tofu is done, add to the pan with the BBQ sauce and stir to combine.
Toast the buns if desired.
Place bottom half of each bun on a plate; top with BBQ tofu and a small portion of the slaw. Close with the top half of each bun and serve with remaining slaw on the side. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp & Asparagus Fried Rice

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Rinse the rice in a colander and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil.
Place the shrimp in a medium bowl.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until the liquid is absorbed, 12 to 15 minutes. Remove from the heat and let the rice stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears into 1-inch pieces. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger; transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the ginger.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; chop the onions into ¼-inch pieces. Transfer to a small bowl.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shrimp to the skillet; cook until opaque, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Add more coconut oil to the skillet, followed by the garlic, ginger, and white parts of the green onions. Cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the asparagus and cook, stirring frequently, until bright green and just tender, 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp to the skillet and add most of the remaining green onions (save some for garnishing); stir to combine.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet; cook, stirring constantly, until any leftover moisture evaporates, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, sesame oil, and squeeze the lime over top; stir to combine.
Divide the stir fry between plates or bowls and sprinkle with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp, Avocado & Grapefruit Salad

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place in a medium bowl, cover with water, and set aside to thaw. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the lettuce and then tear into bite-sized pieces.

Wash and quarter grapefruit. Peel and slice 3 of the quarters into wedges (save 1 for the dressing). Halve and pit avocado; thinly slice flesh while still in skin and scoop out (save a quarter of the avocado for the dressing).
Wash and juice the lime and remaining grapefruit wedge into a small bowl; add saved avocado and mash thoroughly. Add honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine and set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Drain and rinse shrimp under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Place on paper towels and pat dry. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add shrimp and cook until opaque, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, arrange lettuce on a plate and top with avocado, grapefruit, and shrimp. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: Shrimp, Bell Pepper & Mushroom Stir Fry with Basmati Rice

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
If using frozen shrimp, place in a medium bowl, cover with cold water, and set aside to thaw. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash bell peppers and mushrooms. Seed and slice peppers into strips. Slice mushrooms. Transfer to a bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and mince or grate ginger.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain shrimp in a colander and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Spread out on a clean towel and pat dry.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add shrimp and cook, stirring frequently, until opaque and pink, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Once shrimp have been transferred, add more oil to skillet. Add garlic, ginger, bell peppers, and mushrooms. Stir fry until peppers are tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, honey, and cornstarch.
Return shrimp to skillet and pour in the sauce. Stir fry until sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
Serve by placing rice in a bowl or on a plate and adding stir fry over top. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp & Bell Pepper Quesadilla with Tomato-Butter Lettuce Salad

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Roughly chop shrimp and place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the shrimp.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, bell pepper, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until bell pepper is tender and shrimp are cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, juice lime into a clean medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with yogurt, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.

To assemble the quesadillas, lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide shrimp-bell pepper filling between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla. Top with cheese and fold in half to close. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)

Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat; add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until tortillas are golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Shrimp, Bell Pepper & Tomato Gumbo with Green Onion Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-low heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add flour and cook, stirring occasionally, until butter is fully melted and mixture is golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise; add half to the bowl with the garlic. (Set remaining green onions aside for the rice.)
Trim and small dice celery; trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add both to the bowl with the garlic and green onion.
When the flour mixture is golden brown, add veggies to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add broth and spices to the skillet; bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring frequently, until thickened, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add shrimp and tomatoes to the skillet; stir to combine the gumbo. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Just before serving, add remaining green onion to the rice, and gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide green onion rice and gumbo between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp, Blueberry & Feta Salad with Walnuts & Lemon Vinaigrette

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Grate all of the zest from the lemon, then juice the lemon; transfer both to a small bowl.
To the lemon zest and juice, add olive oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk together. Set aside.
Place the feta in a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Roughly chop the walnuts and transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Then, lay them out on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. If using fresh shrimp, skip the first step.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add the walnuts; cook, stirring constantly, until they are lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes. Once done, return back to the bowl.
Once the walnuts have been transferred, add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shrimp to the skillet; cook until they are opaque, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a bowl and set aside to cool.
To serve, divide the mixed greens between plates, top with the blueberries, shrimp, feta, and walnuts, and drizzle with the lemon vinaigrette. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp Burrito Bowl with Cilantro-Lime Rice & Pico de Gallo

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Quarter the grape tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl (that will be used for the salsa).
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the salsa bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces. Transfer one ½ to the salsa bowl and the other ½ to a separate medium bowl.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Small dice the pepper into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the medium bowl with the onion.
Juice the lime into a small bowl; add about ½ of the juice to the salsa bowl and save the rest for the rice.

Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add about ½ of the cilantro to the salsa bowl and add the rest to the bowl with the remaining lime juice.
Season the salsa with salt; stir to combine and set aside.
Add coconut oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Then, lay them out on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. If using fresh shrimp, skip the first step.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add the shrimp and cook until they are opaque, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a bowl and set aside to cool.

Once the shrimp has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet followed by the onion and bell pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables are browned and softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork. Add the remaining lime juice and cilantro to the rice and stir to combine.
To serve, arrange the rice, veggie mixture, shrimp, and salsa in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp & Cannellini Bean Stew with Crusty Bread

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place in a medium bowl and cover with cold water to thaw. Set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic. Wash and medium dice tomatoes.
Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Drain shrimp and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks; place on paper towels and pat dry.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add ½ of the garlic (save the rest for later), shrimp, and paprika. Cook until shrimp are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Return pan to stove and reduce heat to medium. Add more oil, remaining garlic, and pepper. Cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
amounts: about ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.text: Add tomatoes. Cook until liquid is reduced, 2-3 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans.
Add beans and broth to pan. Cook until stew thickens, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Toast bread.
Stir in shrimp and cook until heated through.
To serve, add stew to a bowl and have with crusty bread on the side. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp, Corn & Coconut Milk Chowder with Bell Pepper

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place in a medium bowl, cover with water, and set aside to thaw. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash potatoes and bell pepper. Peel and medium dice potatoes. Seed and medium dice pepper. Remove husks and silks from corn. Stand up in the middle of a medium bowl and slice kernels off the cob. Transfer everything to a medium bowl.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add garlic, potatoes, bell pepper, and corn to saucepan. Stir to combine.
Add coconut milk, broth, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Drain shrimp and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to saucepan while the chowder is cooking.
Toast bread if desired.
To serve, pour soup into a bowl and enjoy with bread on the side!

name: Shrimp Couscous with Tomatoes, Zucchini & Feta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: 1 lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil over high heat. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes then fluff with a fork.
amounts: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: 1 lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve tomatoes. Cut peppers into quarters, remove seeds and membranes and slice into strips. Medium dice the zucchini into ½-inch cubes. Transfer cut veggies into a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shrimp and garlic to the skillet; cook until shrimp are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Return skillet to the heat, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peppers, zucchini, tomato, and oregano to the skillet, stirring occasionally until vegetables soften, 3-4 minutes.
Shave dill leaves from stalk; discard stalk and mince leaves.
Once veggies are soft add broth, scraping up any browned bits, and cook until most of the liquid has evaporated, 4-5 minutes.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add dill to the skillet, along with the shrimp and any accumulated juices; allow to cook for 1 minute more.
To serve, divide couscous between plates and top with the shrimp, veggies, and crumbled feta. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: "Shrimp Dumpling" Rice Bowl with Pickled Veggies, Lettuce & Peanuts

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Place vinegar and sugar in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
Trim, peel, and coarsely grate carrots; trim and cut cucumber into matchsticks. Add both to the bowl with the pickling liquid, toss to combine, and set aside.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl with the green onion, along with soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, oil, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the dumpling sauce.
Roughly chop shrimp and place in another medium bowl. Spoon ⅓ of the dumpling sauce over the shrimp, stir to combine, and set aside. (Reserve remaining sauce for serving.)
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add shrimp and sauce. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, roughly chop peanuts.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
When the rice is done, add oil, vinegar, and sesame seeds; stir to combine.
Divide rice, shrimp, pickled veggies, and lettuce between bowls. Top with peanuts and serve with reserved dumpling sauce on the side. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp Fettuccine with "Tikka Masala" Sauce, Zucchini, Peppers & Peas

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Reserve a ½-cup cooking water before draining; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Peel, halve, and small dice onion; trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place both in a medium bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons; add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place sugar and spices in the reserved bowl; stir to combine the spice mix.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl with the spice mix, along with the shrimp, and toss to coat.
When the veggies are soft, add seasoned shrimp to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are just starting to turn opaque, 1-2 minutes.
Add tomato sauce, peas, and cream to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and continue to cook until shrimp are cooked through, 2-3 minutes more.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Transfer drained pasta to the skillet and toss to combine; add reserved pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp Gnocchi in Spicy Tomato Sauce (Fra Diavolo) with Arugula Salad

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water heats up, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in a small bowl.

Quarter chili pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the shallot and garlic. Set aside. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Once the water in the pan is boiling, add gnocchi and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot, garlic, chili pepper, shrimp, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are just cooked through, about 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the skillet, along with the drained gnocchi, and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add half to the bowl with the dressing, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)
