To serve, divide shrimp gnocchi and salad between plates or bowls. Sprinkle gnocchi with crushed red pepper and reserved Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp Louie Salad with Hard-Boiled Egg, Lettuce, Avocado & Tomato

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a small bowl; add oil, honey, chili-garlic sauce, Worcestershire, and spices. Whisk to combine the sauce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place shrimp in a medium bowl, drizzle with half of the sauce, and toss to coat. (Reserve remaining sauce for later use.)
Once the skillet is hot, add shrimp and any sauce left in the bowl; cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, roughly chop capers; add to the bowl with the remaining sauce along with mayo and ketchup. Whisk to combine the creamy dressing and set aside.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; place on a plate.
Halve tomatoes and add to the plate with the radish.
Peel and quarter eggs; add to the plate.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the plate.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
Divide lettuce between plates or bowls; top with radish, tomato, egg, avocado, and shrimp. Serve with creamy dressing on the side and enjoy!

name: Shrimp & Napa Cabbage Stir-Fry with Jasmine Rice

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger; transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic and transfer to the bowl with the ginger.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle and transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; half the cabbage lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1-inch pieces.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and stir-fry until lightly browned and almost cooked through, 2 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a bowl or plate.
Once the shrimp have been transferred, add more oil to the skillet, followed by the garlic, ginger, and crushed red pepper; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the cabbage to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until the cabbage is softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
While the cabbage cooks, in a small bowl, combine and whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, honey, and cornstarch.

Return the shrimp to the skillet along with any accumulated juices, add about ¾ of the green onions (save the rest for garnishing), and pour the sauce overtop; stir-fry until the ingredients are well combined, about 1 minute.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, spoon the rice onto a plate, top with the stir-fry, and garnish with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp Pad See Ew with Ginger & Sugar Snap Peas

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles; stir to seperate the noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain shrimp in a colander and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks; skip this step if you are using fresh shrimp. Spread out on a clean towel and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince the garlic.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onions and sugar snap peas. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the peas are tender crisp, 2-3 minutes. Transfer the veggies to a plate and return the skillet to the heat.

Add more coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the shrimp, garlic, and ginger to the skillet. Cook until the shrimp are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, remove from heat.
When the noodles are tender, scoop out ¼ cup of the cooking water, then drain in a colander. Rinse the noodles under cold running water.
Return the skillet to the heat and add noodles, veggies, soy sauce, fish sauce, maple syrup, and the reserved cooking water to the shrimp. Stir until well combined and heated through, 2-3 minutes.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Roughly chop the peanuts.
To serve, divide shrimp, noodles, and veggies between plates and sprinkle with basil and peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp Penne with Swiss Chard, Tomatoes, Mint, Pistachios & Parmesan

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ¼-cup pasta water before draining.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the mint.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add half to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)

Fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in a medium bowl and stems in another small bowl. Set leaves aside for later use.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the chard stems.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chard stems, tomatoes, salt, and pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: When the tomatoes have softened, add shrimp to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through, 2-3 minutes.
While the shrimp are cooking, roughly chop pistachios.

Add chard leaves to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for them to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add drained pasta, reserved pasta water, pistachios, and the Parmesan mixture. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta is combined and coated in sauce, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and sprinkle with reserved Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp Po'Boy with Spicy Mayo & Lemon-Dijon Garden Salad

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic. Transfer to a small bowl.
Juice half the lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add mayonnaise, chili-garlic sauce, and salt; whisk to combine and set the spicy mayo aside.
In a medium bowl, combine bread crumbs, flour, and spices. Add shrimp and toss to combine.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add shrimp to the skillet; cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a paper-towel lined plate.
Meanwhile, juice the other half of the lemon into a large bowl. Add oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Separate the lettuce leaves. Set aside 2 large leaves per sandwich; chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim carrot and peel into thin noodle-like sticks using a julienne (or regular) peeler. Add to the salad bowl.
Slice half of the tomato and set aside for the sandwiches. Small dice the other half and add to the salad bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired.
Place the bottom half of a bun on each plate. Layer with lettuce, shrimp, tomato, and spicy mayo; close with top half of the bun. Serve salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Shrimp and Sausage Boil with Corn, Baby Potatoes, and Fresh Thyme

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); and place over high heat.
Add seasoning to the pot, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the potatoes and add to the pot. Prick the sausages with a fork and add to the pot.
Once water is boiling reduce the heat to medium-high. Make sure the water continues to bubble, but not over boil.
Trim the ends off of the beans, halve them, and set them aside.
Remove the husks and silks from the corn. Cut the corn into 1 inch long rounds - use a large knife to cut right through the cob. Add the corn to the pot.
Drain shrimp in a colander and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Spread out on a clean towel and pat dry.
amounts: ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Shrimp and beans cook for a very short time, be sure the potatoes are almost tender and the sausage is cooked through before adding them (8-10 minutes). Add the beans to the pot, followed by the shrimp and cook for another 2-4 minutes.
Using a large colander strain out the water. Using tongs, remove the sausage and slice diagonally into ¼ inch rounds.
Return all ingredients to the pot and toss with butter, thyme, salt, and pepper (save some thyme for garnishing).
To serve, arrange on a plate, sprinkle with thyme, and enjoy!

name: Shrimp Sauté with Capers, Green Pea-Rice Pilaf & Creamy Broccoli Slaw

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, place peas in a clean colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Wash, dry, and zest lemon into a medium bowl (set lemon aside for later use). Add mayo, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Add broccoli slaw to the bowl with the dressing, stir to combine, and set aside.
Juice reserved lemon into a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, capers, and thyme; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add shrimp and lemon juice to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the shrimp are cooked through, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat.

While the shrimp are cooking, wash and dry the dill. Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the rice, along with the peas, and gently stir to combine the pilaf.
To serve, divide rice pilaf, broccoli slaw, and shrimp between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp Scampi with Bacon & Zucchini Noodles

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Cut butter into small pieces and place in a small bowl; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make zucchini noodles. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer; dot with ⅓ of the butter and season with salt. (Set remaining butter aside.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until zucchini is tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.)
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate, leaving the drippings in the skillet.
While the bacon is cooking, peel and thinly slice garlic.
Return the skillet to medium heat; add garlic and crushed red pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until garlic starts to brown, 2-3 minutes.

Add broth and shrimp to the skillet. Cover and simmer until shrimp are opaque and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the shrimp to a plate (leaving cooking juices in the skillet) and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to the bowl with the remaining butter and set aside.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat and simmer sauce until reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
While the sauce cooks, chop or crumble bacon into pieces.
Juice lemon into the sauce and remove from heat. Stir in the remaining butter, parsley, salt, and pepper. Add shrimp back to the skillet and toss to coat.
To serve, divide zucchini noodles, shrimp, and sauce between plates. Top with bacon and enjoy!

name: "Shrimp Scampi" Caesar Salad with Kale, Romaine & Toasted Bread Crumbs

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest half of the lemon into a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining lemon for later use.)

Cut butter into small pieces. Add to the bowl with the lemon zest along with bread crumbs, salt, and pepper; stir to combine. Transfer bread crumb mixture to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't need to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until bread crumbs are golden and toasted, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and thinly slice garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add additional butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until garlic is golden and fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the garlic is golden, juice half of the lemon into the skillet, then add parsley and shrimp. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the shrimp are opaque and cooked through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining lemon for the next step.)
While the shrimp are cooking, juice remaining lemon into the reserved bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Peel and mince additional garlic; mince anchovy fillets. Add both to the bowl along with mayo, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear kale and lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add both to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with shrimp scampi and bread crumbs. Enjoy!

name: "Shrimp Scampi" Pasta with Swiss Chard, Lemon & Parmesan Bread Crumbs

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, then stir for a few seconds. Cook until pasta is desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ¼-cup cooking water before draining and set aside.)
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in a small bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and toast, stirring frequently, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Add to the bowl with the Parmesan, along with spices, and stir to combine; set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)

Wash and dry chard; fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves and stems into bite-sized pieces, keeping them separate. Place leaves in a medium bowl (reserving stems for later use).

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chard stems, shrimp, and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until shrimp are just opaque, 2-3 minutes.
Add cooked pasta and reserved pasta water to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until water has evaporated, 1-2 minutes.
Add chard leaves to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chard is tender, about 1 minute.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon into the skillet. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and top with cheesy bread crumbs. Enjoy!

name: "Shrimp Scampi" Pita Pizza with Cucumber, Bell Pepper & Romaine Salad

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Shave parsley leaves off stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a medium bowl. (Set remaining parsley aside for the pizzas.)
Add mayo, vinegar, oregano, and salt to the bowl with the parsley. Stir to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince shallot and garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, shallot, garlic, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are opaque, 2-3 minutes.
When the shrimp are done, zest and juice lemon into the skillet. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
Coarsely grate cheese.

Arrange pitas on a baking sheet pan. Top with shrimp and sauce from the skillet, then sprinkle with cheese. Place in the oven and bake until the cheese is melted, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into wedges.
Meanwhile, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pizzas and salad between plates. Sprinkle pizzas with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Shrimp Scampi with Spaghetti Squash

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place the rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds. Rub each half with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Place halves, cut side down, on a baking sheet.
Place the squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender so a knife can easily pierce though the flesh, 18 to 20 minutes.

While the squash cooks, using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Transfer the parsley to a small bowl.
Grate all of the zest from the lemon, then juice the lemon. Add the zest and juice to the bowl with the parsley.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the garlic and crushed red pepper to the skillet; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the shrimp to the skillet; cook, tossing occasionally, until opaque and cooked through, 2 to 4 minutes total.
Add the lemon zest, lemon juice, and parsley to the shrimp; season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.

Remove the squash from the oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Using a fork, scrape the squash flesh to make spaghetti-like strings (use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand).
To serve, top the squash with the shrimp scampi. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp & Spinach Linguine with Roasted Red Pepper Sauce

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: When the water in the pot comes to a boil, uncover the pot and season the water with salt, then add the pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook the pasta, uncovered, for 11-12 minutes (or according to package directions). Once done, drain the pasta in a colander.
Peel and chop onion into 2-inch pieces; peel garlic. Spread out on a baking sheet.
Cut the bell peppers lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membrane and chop into 2-inch pieces. Chop tomatoes into quarters and place on the baking sheet along with the peppers.

Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt and pepper; place in the oven and roast for 13-14 minutes. During that last 3-4 minutes of cooking, change the setting to broil and cook until they begin to char slightly.
Meanwhile, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add shrimp to the pan, season with salt and pepper. Cook until golden brown and pink all the way through, about 2-3 minutes.
Finely grate Parmesan.
When vegetables are done cooking let cool for 3-4 minutes. Once cooled, peel the skin off the peppers and tomatoes and discard them.
Add vegetables to the blender and blend until mostly smooth. Add half the Parmesan and season with salt and crushed red pepper. Pulse to combine.
Return pasta to the pot, add shrimp, sauce and spinach and stir to until spinach is wilted slightly.
To serve, divide pasta between plates, top with remaining Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp "Summer Roll" Bowl with Rice Noodles, Veggies & Peanut Sauce

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.)
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Once the water is boiling, add shrimp to the pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer shrimp to a plate. (Reserve boiling water in pan for the next step.)

Add rice noodles to the pan with the boiling water, remove from heat, and soak for 10 minutes (or prepare according to package instructions). Drain in a clean colander, rinse under cold water, and set aside.
Meanwhile, cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place on a plate.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot. Add to the plate with the green onions.
Trim and cut cucumber into thin matchsticks. Add to the plate.
Trim, seed, and cut bell pepper into thin matchsticks. Add to the plate.
Trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the plate.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the plate and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small bowl along with peanut butter, honey, soy sauce, fish sauce, and vinegar. Whisk to combine the peanut sauce.
To serve, divide rice noodles, veggies, and shrimp between bowls. Drizzle with peanut sauce and enjoy!

name: Shrimp Tacos with Mango Salsa, Cabbage, Avocado & Spicy Yogurt

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into a medium bowl.
Peel mango and slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Medium dice and add to the bowl with the lime.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince onion; add to the bowl along with salt and pepper. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
Place yogurt, chili-garlic sauce, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add shrimp to the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, chop into small pieces and set aside.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; quarter cabbage lengthwise and remove the core. Slice crosswise into thin strips.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates, top with cabbage, avocado, shrimp, salsa, and spicy yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Shrimp Tostadas with Guacamole & Pico de Gallo

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water until there are no more ice chunks; set aside to drain. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Drizzle both sides of the tortillas with oil and sprinkle with salt; place on a baking sheet. Bake for 10-15 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the tortillas are crispy and lightly browned on both sides.
In a medium bowl, combine the spices and oil.
Toss shrimp in spice mixture and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; add to a medium bowl. Halve avocado and remove pit; scoop out the flesh into the bowl with garlic.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with avocado and the other half to another medium bowl for the pico de gallo.
Juice the the lime into the bowl with avocado; add salt and pepper and mash with a fork until smooth.
Peel and small dice the shallot; small dice the tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the cilantro for the pico de gallo.

Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeño with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the pico de gallo. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.) Season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot add shrimp; cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side.
To serve, divide the tortillas between plates, top with guacamole, shrimp, and pico de gallo.  Enjoy!

name: Shrimp & Zucchini Coconut Curry with Basmati Rice

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Then, lay them out on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. If using fresh shrimp, skip the first step.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces).
Once the pan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until slightly softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the onion cooks, trim off and discard the ends of the zucchini; quarter the zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces.
Add the zucchini to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
While the zucchini cooks, trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger. Add to the bowl with the garlic.
Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder, turmeric, salt, and pepper to the pan; cook, stirring, until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the coconut milk, and fish sauce to the pan; bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves.
Add the shrimp and ¾ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing) to the pan; cook until the shrimp are opaque and pink, 3 to 4 minutes, then remove from the heat.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls, top with the shrimp and zucchini curry, and garnish with the remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Simple Butter Chicken with Peas & Basmati Rice

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towel, cut into bite-sized (1-inch) pieces, and set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the water for the rice is boiling, reduce the heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until the liquid is absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Remove from the heat and let the rice stand, covered, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix spices in a small bowl.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and small dice onion.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onions and cook, stirring often, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Wash, peel, and mince or grate ginger. Peel and mince garlic.
Add ginger, garlic, and spices to the onions and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30 seconds.
Using a strainer or colander, drain the diced tomatoes, pressing with the back of a spoon to extract as much liquid as possible; discard liquid.
Add additional butter, chicken, diced tomatoes, and cream to the skillet. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium; cover and cook until chicken is cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the frozen peas under running water. Add peas to the butter chicken, stir, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and butter chicken between bowls; garnish with cilantro and enjoy!

name: Simple Sweet Chili Salmon with Sesame Broccoli & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, sugar, water, chili-garlic sauce, and salt in a skillet. Whisking occasionally, bring to a boil over high heat.
In a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.
Add cornstarch slurry to the skillet in a steady stream while whisking quickly. Cook, whisking continuously, until the sweet chili sauce thickens, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat.
Place salmon, skin-side down, on the baking sheet. Spoon the sweet chili sauce evenly over each filet.
Place salmon in the oven and bake until opaque and flaky, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry broccoli. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Rinse skillet and wipe dry with paper towels; place over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add broccoli and stir-fry until bright green and tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, salmon, and broccoli between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Sirloin with Creamy Dijon Sauce, Lemon-Garlic Kale, Couscous & Chives

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous and salt, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, place oil, Dijon, mayo, vinegar, water, sugar, salt, and pepper in a small bowl; whisk to combine the Dijon sauce and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
While the steak is cooking, chop chives into small pieces; add half to the bowl with the kale (reserving the rest for garnish).
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl.
When the steak is done, return skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add kale, chives, garlic, salt, and crushed red pepper; cook, stirring often, until kale is tender, 3-4 minutes.
Juice lemon into the skillet with the kale and stir to combine; remove from heat.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide couscous, steak, and kale between plates. Drizzle Dijon sauce over the steak and garnish with reserved chives. Enjoy!

name: Sirloin Steak with Basil Compound Butter, Roasted Potatoes & Snap Peas

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Cut butter into small pieces, place in a small bowl, and set aside to soften.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Slice potatoes crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Transfer to the baking sheet, season with spices, and spread out in a single layer; dot potatoes with ⅓ of the butter. (Reserve remaining butter for later.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until the potatoes are fork-tender and golden, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest lemon into the bowl with the remaining butter. Cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the butter.

Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl. Mash the butter, garlic, and basil together with the back of a spoon until smooth. Set the compound butter aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat. Add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add snap peas, salt, and pepper; stir-fry until the peas are fork-tender, about 4 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide roasted potatoes, steak, and snap peas between plates. Top steak with compound butter and squeeze lemon over the peas. Enjoy!

name: Skillet Broccoli Mac 'n' Cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 6-8 minutes. Drain.
Wash broccoli and cut into bite-sized florets. Add to saucepan with pasta during the last 2-3 minutes of cooking time.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Melt butter in pan. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add flour and whisk until smooth.
Add milk, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk until well combined. Cook until thickened, about 8 minutes.
Preheat oven to broil.
Grate 1 cup of cheddar and ⅛ cup Parmesan.
Add ¾ of the cheddar to pan and stir until sauce is smooth.
Add pasta and broccoli to sauce and stir to combine. Sprinkle with remaining cheddar and Parmesan.
Place under the broiler until cheese is melted and golden brown, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, place in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Skillet Dijon Chicken & Mushrooms with Asparagus

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a sauté pan about three-quarters of the way full with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash the asparagus and snap (or cut) off and discard the woody ends.
Once the water in the pan is boiling, add the asparagus and cover. Cook until bright green and tender, 3-4 minutes. Drain and thoroughly rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process. Set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Slice the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Wash and slice the mushrooms. Peel and finely dice the shallot.

Once the chicken has been removed, add more butter to the skillet. Add the mushrooms and shallot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms are tender and any liquid has evaporated, 5-6 minutes.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Add the garlic and thyme and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add the broth and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. Stir in the cream and Dijon and season with salt and pepper.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return the chicken to the skillet and bring to a boil. Simmer until the sauce is thickened, 4-5 minutes.
Arrange asparagus on a plate and top with the chicken and mushrooms. Enjoy!

name: Skillet Eggplant, Beef & Feta Moussaka with Lemon Arugula Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet warms up, peel and small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces; transfer to a small bowl.
Add the ground beef to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until crumbly and browned, 2 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer the beef to a bowl and leave the juices in the skillet.
While the beef cooks, peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Once the beef has been transferred, add the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
While the onion cooks, trim and discard the ends of the eggplant; medium dice the eggplant into ½-inch cubes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Add olive oil to the skillet, followed by the garlic, eggplant, and diced tomatoes; season with cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggplant is tender, 8 to 10 minutes.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: While the eggplant cooks, shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Juice the lemon into a small bowl.
Add olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the lemon juice; whisk together.
Return the ground beef to the skillet and stir in half of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing).

To serve, place the moussaka on a plate, sprinkle with the feta and remaining parsley, and season with additional salt and pepper to taste. Add the arugula on the side and drizzle with the dressing. Enjoy!

name: Skillet Moussaka with Béchamel Sauce

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet warms up, peel and small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces; transfer to a small bowl.
Add the ground beef to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until crumbly and browned, 2 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer the beef to a bowl and leave the juices in the skillet.
While the beef cooks, peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat the oven to broil and position the rack about 6 inches from the top.
Once the beef has been transferred, add olive oil and the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: While the onion cooks, trim and discard the ends of the eggplant; medium dice the eggplant into ½-inch cubes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Add the garlic, eggplant, and diced tomatoes to the skillet; season with cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggplant is tender, 8 to 10 minutes.
While the eggplant cooks, in a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
While the butter melts, grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
Sprinkle in the flour over the melted butter and whisk until the mixture is smooth, 15 to 30 seconds.
Slowly pour the milk into the saucepan, whisking constantly. Cook the sauce, whisking constantly, until thickened, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the Parmesan to the sauce and season with salt and pepper; stir and remove from the heat.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Return the ground beef to the skillet and stir in ¾ of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing).
Drizzle the béchamel sauce over the top of the beef and eggplant mixture.
Place the skillet in the oven and broil until the dish is browned on top, 1 to 3 minutes.
To serve, spoon the moussaka into a bowl and sprinkle with the remaining parsley. Enjoy!

name: Skillet Shepherd's Pie with Parsley

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash, peel, and large dice potatoes. Place in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and return to saucepan.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Wash, peel, and small dice carrots.

Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add onion, carrots, and ground beef. Break apart the beef with a spoon until crumbly. Stirring occasionally, cook until beef is browned and vegetables are tender, 5-7 minutes.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Transfer beef and vegetables to a colander and set aside.
Return skillet to stove. Add butter and flour; whisk until smooth. Add broth and Worcestershire. Bring to a simmer.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return beef and vegetables to skillet. Add peas, salt, and pepper. Mix well and cook until sauce thickens, 4-5 minutes.
Add butter, broth, salt, and pepper to potatoes. Mash until smooth.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, place beef and veggie mixture in a bowl or on a plate, top with mashed potatoes, and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!

name: Skillet Sweet Potato "Pizza" with Prosciutto, Olives & Green Peppers

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and coarsely grate the sweet potato.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add sweet potatoes, garlic, salt, and pepper to the skillet and fry, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, grate cheese.
Peel and thinly slice the shallot into rounds.
Using the back of a spoon, press the sweet potato mixture into an even layer. Place skillet in the oven and broil until starting to brown, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, seed and thinly slice the pepper into rounds. Thinly slice olives.
Remove skillet from oven and top with tomato sauce, oregano, cheese, veggies, and prosciutto.
Return skillet to the oven and broil until the cheese is melted and golden, about 5 minutes. (The sweet potato crust will remain soft, enjoy this pizza with a fork and knife.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Remove skillet from the oven and garnish with fresh basil and crushed red pepper. Divide between plates and enjoy!

name: "Sloppy Joe" Beef Bowl with Sweet Potatoes, Cabbage & Pickled Onion

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Place vinegar, honey, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potato. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, then drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potato is fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve cabbage lengthwise, cut out the core, and slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing, toss to coat, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, thinly slice jalapeño pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Once the skillet is hot, add beef and salt; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Add water, ketchup, Dijon, vinegar, and spices to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide sweet potatoes, cabbage, and beef between bowls. Top with jalapeños and pickled onions. Enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon & Arugula Salad with Goat Cheese and Orange Vinaigrette

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Cut off the skin and white pith from one orange; cut between the membranes to release the segments. Juice the remaining orange into a large bowl.
Add oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and salt to the bowl with the orange juice. Whisk to combine.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice lengthwise and crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the orange segments.
Trim off and discard tops and root ends of radishes and thinly slice. Add to the bowl.
Thinly slice cucumber into half rounds and add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese with your hands and add to the bowl.
Add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with smoked salmon. Enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon, Asparagus, Goat Cheese & Dill Frittata with Green Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Add eggs, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the dill; whisk to combine.
Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl; stir to combine and set aside.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus. Slice crosswise into ½-inch pieces and place in another medium bowl.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add asparagus, green onions, salt, and pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring often, until asparagus is crisp-tender, about 3 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Pour the egg mixture into the skillet with the veggies; gently stir to combine. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 5-6 minutes.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until the top is set, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the frittata is cooking, peel and mince garlic. Place in the reserved bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes. Trim and medium dice cucumber; add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Finely chop walnuts and add to the bowl along with the mixed greens; toss to combine the salad.
Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon-Avocado Flatbread with Fennel, Cucumber & Sesame Seeds

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the dill. Add yogurt, oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.
Meanwhile, chop or tear smoked salmon into bite-sized pieces.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and place in a small bowl. Mash with a fork or potato masher until smooth.
To serve, spread toasted flatbreads with mashed avocado, then top with salad and smoked salmon. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon, Bell Pepper, Cucumber, Basil & Goat Cheese Pasta Salad

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and shallot; add both to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Add yogurt, mayo, vinegar, and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl.
Add pasta to the bowl with the veggies and stir to combine the pasta salad.
Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide pasta salad and salmon between plates or bowls. Crumble goat cheese over top and enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon Bowl with Ginger Rice, Edamame, Mango & Avocado

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add ginger, water, and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Combine vinegar, sesame seeds, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to dissolve the sugar.
Trim cucumber and thinly slice crosswise into rounds. Add to the bowl with the vinegar mixture.
Trim off and discard tops and root ends of radishes; thinly slice and add to the bowl with the cucumber. Stir to combine the salad.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Medium dice and set aside.
Combine chili-garlic sauce and mayonnaise in a small bowl; whisk until smooth.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out, keeping avocado halves intact. Fill avocado halves with spicy mayo.
Divide rice, edamame, mango, and cucumber-radish salad between bowls; top with smoked salmon and an avocado half. Serve with soy sauce on the side and enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon, Cottage Cheese & Egg Flatbread with Tossed Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 475°F.
Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place cottage cheese in a strainer and press gently with the back of a spoon to remove excess liquid. Set aside to drain further.
When the flatbreads are done, spread the drained cottage cheese over top, creating a large well in the center of each. Crack an egg into each well.
Return baking sheet to the oven and bake until eggs are just set, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, chop or tear smoked salmon into bite-sized pieces. Place on a plate.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the plate with the salmon, along with capers, and set aside for serving.
About 5 minutes before the flatbreads are done, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, trim, and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing and radish, then toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: When the flatbreads are done, top with smoked salmon, minced shallot, and capers, then cut into wedges.
To serve, divide flatbreads and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon, Cream Cheese & Cucumber Roll-Ups with Side Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut cream cheese into small pieces and place in a small bowl.
Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the cream cheese.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl. Use the back of a spoon to soften and combine the cream cheese mixture.
Juice lemon into the bowl. Add yogurt, salt, and pepper; stir to combine and set aside.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into (thin) half-moons.
Lay tortillas on a flat surface. Using a spatula, spread cream cheese mixture evenly over each tortilla.
Top tortillas with half of the cucumbers (reserve remaining cucumbers for the salad) and the salmon; roll tightly to close and cut crosswise into pieces. Set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Add reserved cucumbers to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and thinly slice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl, along with the pine nuts, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide roll-ups and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon "Everything Bagel" Pasta Salad with Cream Cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add honey, poppy seeds, sesame seeds, garlic powder, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and halve radishes, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop capers. Add to the bowl.
Medium dice cream cheese. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear smoked salmon into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, along with the cooled pasta, and stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon Linguine with Spinach, Artichoke, Leek & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside.
Meanwhile, chop or tear smoked salmon into bite-sized pieces. Place in a small bowl and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leek, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts and sun-dried tomatoes.
When the leek is done, add artichokes and sun-dried tomatoes to the skillet, then stir to combine.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Juice lemon into the skillet. Add drained pasta and smoked salmon, then toss to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls; top with feta and enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Smoked Salmon-Quinoa Bowl with Pickled Veggies, Avocado & Tahini Sauce

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine broth and quinoa; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until liquid is fully absorbed, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place vinegar, honey, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
Trim and slice cucumber and radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add both to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Juice lemon into a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil, tahini, soy sauce, and pepper. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Right before serving, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
To serve, divide quinoa, pickled veggies, avocado, and smoked salmon between bowls. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon Salad with Edamame, Mango, Pear, Avocado & Pecans

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the bowl.
Quarter, core, and medium dice pear; add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pecans and add to the bowl.
Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
Add mixed greens and edamame to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon Salad Niçoise with Sweet Potatoes, Green Beans & Olives

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Peel and medium dice sweet potato. Transfer to a baking sheet pan along with tomatoes. Drizzle with oil and season with salt; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potato is fork-tender and tomatoes are burst and browned in spots, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim green beans.

Once the water in the pan is boiling, add green beans; cook until tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer green beans to the colander, and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside. (Reserve pan of boiling water for the next step.)
Add eggs to the pan of boiling water, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a small bowl.

Juice lemon into the bowl with the shallot. Add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Transfer half of the dressing to a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining dressing for serving.)
Add mixed greens to the medium bowl with the dressing. Gently toss to combine the salad and set aside.
Halve olives lengthwise. Transfer to a plate.
Chop or tear smoked salmon into bite-sized pieces. Add to the plate with the olives.
Peel and quarter eggs. Add to the plate and season with salt.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with sweet potato, tomatoes, green beans, eggs, smoked salmon, olives, and capers. Drizzle with reserved dressing and enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon Sandwich with Lettuce, Tomato, Avocado & Chopped Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place mayo, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Separate lettuce leaves; set aside one leaf per sandwich. Chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
Add broccoli slaw to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Thinly slice tomato and place on a plate.
Halve and pit avocado; cut crosswise while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon. Add to the plate with the tomato.
Toast bread if desired.
To assemble the sandwiches, spread each bread slice with additional mayo. Layer half of the slices with the reserved lettuce, tomato, avocado, and smoked salmon; close with remaining slices.
To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon Soba Noodle Bowl with Cucumber, Edamame & Avocado

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Transfer to a small bowl.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, oil, and honey to the bowl and whisk to combine.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add the noodles and edamame; cook according to package directions, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water. Return to the saucepan and toss with 1 tbsp of the dressing.
Meanwhile, thinly slice cucumber into match-like sticks.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide noodles and edamame between bowls and top with smoked salmon, cucumbers, and avocado. Drizzle with remaining dressing and enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon Sushi Stacks with Ginger Rice & Avocado-Cucumber Salad

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Peel and grate or mince ginger; transfer to a small saucepan.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to the saucepan with the ginger. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl along with mayo and whisk to combine.
Trim and thinly slice green onions; add to the bowl with the mayo.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Chop or tear salmon into small pieces and add to the bowl. Stir to combine the salmon mixture and set aside.
Place sesame seeds, oil, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, chili powder, and salt in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut the snap peas crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork. Add vinegar and sugar; stir to combine, then spread the rice out on a baking sheet pan to cool, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocado; scoop out flesh with a spoon and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the other veggies and gently stir to combine the salad.

Place a ⅓-cup of the salmon mixture in a small cup or bowl; top with a ½-cup of rice and press gently to secure. Once the stack is complete, flip the cup or bowl onto a plate; tap on the bottom to loosen the stack. If the rice is sticking, run a knife around the edge before flipping.
Repeat with remaining salmon mixture and rice, creating 2 stacks per plate.
To serve, divide salad between plates and enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon Wrap with Dill Cream Cheese, Capers & Artichoke Greens

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Cut cream cheese into small pieces. Place in a small bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the cream cheese. Place remaining dill in a medium bowl.
Zest lemon into the bowl with the cream cheese, then season with salt and pepper. Using the back of a spoon, mash and combine the dill cream cheese. Set aside. (Reserve lemon for the next step.)
Juice reserved lemon into the medium bowl with the dill.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl along with oil, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve radishes, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl, along with the mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Lay tortillas on a flat surface. Divide cream cheese between them and spread out in an even layer.
Divide smoked salmon, sprouts, and capers between the tortillas. Top with a small portion of the salad and roll tightly to close. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Smoky Bacon-Wrapped Chicken Thighs with Roasted Zucchini & Asparagus

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
In a small bowl, combine chili powder, paprika, onion powder, cinnamon, salt, and pepper.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towel; sprinkle chicken with half of the spice blend. Wrap each thigh in 1-2 strips of bacon, place in a baking dish, and sprinkle with the remaining spice blend.
Place chicken in the oven and bake until chicken is golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature of chicken reaches 165°F), 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the ends of the zucchini; medium dice the zucchini (cut into ½-inch cubes) and transfer to a medium bowl.
Snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; transfer to the medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle and transfer to the medium bowl.
Pick the mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Save some of the mint for garnish and add the rest to the medium bowl.
Juice the lemon and add the juice to the medium bowl.

Drizzle the vegetables with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet and place in the oven. Cook until vegetables are fork tender, 12-15 minutes.
Remove both pans from oven. Change oven setting to broil and position rack near the top. Return chicken pan to oven and broil until bacon crisps, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide the chicken and vegetables between plates and garnish with fresh mint. Enjoy!

name: Smoky Beef Chili with Black Beans, Pepper, Carrot, Cilantro & Yogurt

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and mince onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies and set aside.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beef and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
When the beef is done, add veggies and tomato paste to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Add beans and broth to the pan; stir to combine the chili, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the chili is done, add half of the cilantro and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
To serve, divide chili between bowls; top with reserved cilantro and a dollop of yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Smoky Caramelized Steak with Kale, Fennel, Apple & Dried Apricot Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Place sugar and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spice rub.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with the spice rub on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, sugar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing, then using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Quarter, core, and medium dice apple. Add to the bowl.
Peel and thinly slice shallot into rings. Add to the bowl.
