Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop apricots. Add to bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Thinly slice steak into strips.
To serve, divide salad and steak between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Smoky Chicken, Mushroom, Pepper & Tomato Sauté over Rice with Arugula

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Place in a medium bowl, season with spices, and toss to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook until golden, about 2 minutes per side (it will not be cooked all the way through). Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, remove stems from portobello mushrooms; halve lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the mushroom.

When the chicken is done, return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushroom, bell pepper, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Add tomatoes to the skillet and stir to combine the sauce. Nestle seared chicken into the sauce and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and sauce is thickened slightly, 6-8 minutes. Cover and remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Just before serving, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Divide rice, chicken, and sauce between plates or bowls. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Smoky Cod with Crispy Bread Crumbs, Potatoes, Broccoli & Lemon Aioli

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve new potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until potatoes start to soften, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Set aside.
Place mayo and spices in a small bowl, then stir to combine.
Pat the cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Spread the mayo mixture over top side of the fish, then sprinkle with bread crumbs, pressing gently to adhere. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

When the potatoes have started to soften, remove from oven. Add broccoli to the baking sheet, toss to combine, and spread back out in an even layer. Add breaded fish to the baking sheet, nestling it into the veggies.
Return baking sheet to the oven; continue to roast until the fish is cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, 10-12 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into the reserved bowl. Add mayo and spices, then stir to combine the lemon-pepper aioli.
Divide cod, potato, and broccoli between plates. Serve with lemon-pepper aioli on the side and enjoy!

name: Smoky Ground Beef Tacos with Lime-Dressed Broccoli Slaw & Sprouts

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the bell pepper.

Once the skillet is hot, add bell pepper, onion, garlic, beef, and spices to the skillet. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, juice lime into the reserved bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Add broccoli slaw to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine; set aside.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with ground beef and slaw, then top with sprouts. Enjoy!

name: Smoky Paprika Chicken Frittata with Pepper, Zucchini & Dressed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, chicken, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise ½-inch thick pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Once the chicken is done, add veggies to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes more. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Place eggs and salt in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine.

When the veggies are done, reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 3-5 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, and salt in a clean medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing. Add mixed greens to the bowl and toss to coat.
Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with dressed greens on the side and enjoy!

name: Smoky Pork Chop with Roasted Acorn Squash, Walnut Butter Sauce & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).
Wash, dry, and halve acorn squash lengthwise; trim ends, scrape out the seeds, and cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
Small dice butter and sprinkle over the squash. Season with salt and pepper.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until squash is tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork chops and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, roughly chop walnuts.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-low heat. Add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add walnuts and cook, stirring occasionally, until toasted, about 3 minutes.
While the walnuts are cooking, peel and mince garlic.
When the walnuts are done, add garlic, water, and soy sauce to the skillet. Stir to combine the sauce and remove from heat.
To serve, divide squash and pork chops between plates. Sprinkle squash with feta and drizzle with sauce. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Smoky Salmon-Coconut Rice Bowl with Cucumber, Mango & Yogurt Sauce

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, place vinegar, honey, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with oil, soy sauce, honey, and spices; whisk to combine the marinade.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end (or corner) firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.
Cut the salmon into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, juice lime into another small bowl. Add yogurt and chili-garlic sauce, then stir to combine the spicy yogurt sauce. Set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add salmon (with marinade) and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; cut into bite-sized pieces. Place in a third small bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the mango (reserving a small handful for serving) and stir to combine.
Just before serving, fluff rice with a fork. Add coconut and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice, salmon, pickled cucumber, and mango between bowls. Drizzle with yogurt sauce, top with reserved cilantro, and enjoy!

name: Smoky Sausage & Zucchini Noodle Skillet with Tomato-Cream Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add onion, garlic, sausage, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
While the sausage is cooking, wash, dry, and trim zucchini; run a vegetable peeler along the length of the zucchini to make ribbons.

When the sausage is done, add zucchini noodles, tomato sauce, and cream to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until zucchini noodles are soft and sauce has thickened, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
To serve, divide skillet between plates or bowls. Top with Parmesan and enjoy!

name: Smoky Tempeh Fajitas with Peppers, Onions & Avocado

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Place oil and spices in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the spice paste.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Slice tempeh crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl with the spice paste, gently stir to coat, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the tempeh.

Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl and gently stir once more to combine. Transfer tempeh and veggies to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until tempeh is browned and veggies are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, cut lime into wedges. Set aside for serving.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with tempeh, veggies, and avocado. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Smoky Tomato-Bell Pepper Skillet with Steak, Hard-Boiled Egg & Toast

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
While the steak is cooking, trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl along with grape tomatoes.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the veggies.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, cilantro, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes start to burst, 6-8 minutes.
Add tomato sauce to the skillet and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel and quarter eggs, then season with salt and pepper.
Toast bread if desired, then spread with butter.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Divide tomato-bell pepper skillet between plates or bowls, then top with steak and eggs. Serve with bread on the side and enjoy!

name: Smoky Tuna-Cucumber Sandwich with Fennel, Arugula & Pistachio Salad

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between two medium bowls (set one bowl aside for the salad).
Add yogurt, mayo, Dijon, and spices to the remaining bowl with the parsley. Stir to combine the creamy dressing.
Drain tuna, add to the bowl with the creamy dressing, and flake with a fork. Stir to combine the tuna salad and set aside.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Zest and juice lemon into the second bowl with the parsley. Add oil, Dijon, honey, and salt, then whisk to combine the salad dressing.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the salad dressing.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the bowl, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds.
Toast bread if desired. Divide tuna salad between half of the slices and spread out in an even layer. Layer with cucumber, close sandwiches with remaining slices of bread, and cut in half.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Smothered Cheesy Bean Burrito with Enchilada Sauce & Lime Crema

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Coarsely grate cheese. Place half in a small bowl and set aside for burrito topping. (Reserve remaining cheese for the next step.)
Drain and rinse beans in a colander. Transfer to a medium bowl along with the reserved cheese and spices; stir to combine the filling.

Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide filling down the center of each one. Roll tortillas tightly to close and transfer to the baking dish, seam-side down. (The burritos should not be touching.)
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until burritos are slightly crispy and heated through, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince shallot.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot to the pan and cook, stirring often, until it begins to soften, 1-2 minutes.
Add flour and spices to the pan with the shallot; continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds.

Slowly whisk tomato sauce and broth into the pan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 3 minutes. Remove enchilada sauce from heat, cover, and set aside.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Remove baking dish from the oven; pour enchilada sauce over the burritos and top with remaining cheese. Return to the oven and continue to bake until sauce is bubbly and cheese is melted, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven. (Reserve bowl for the lime crema.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into the reserved bowl; add yogurt and salt. Whisk to combine the lime crema and set aside.
Stack lettuce leaves, one on top of the other; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Transfer to a plate.
Small dice tomato. Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add both to the plate with the lettuce.
To serve, divide burritos and sauce between plates. Drizzle burritos with lime crema; top with lettuce, tomato, and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Smothered Pork Chops in Creamy Onion Gravy with Broccoli & Mushrooms

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 6 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a medium bowl, stir together flour and spices; remove 1 tablespoon seasoned flour and set aside for later use.
Pat pork chops dry with paper towels, add to the bowl with the flour, and toss to coat.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add chops to the skillet; cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side. Once golden, transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil (the pork will not be cooked all the way through).
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Return skillet to medium heat. Once hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onions, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft and slightly caramelized, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry broccoli. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; place in another medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the broccoli.
Add reserved flour to the skillet and stir to coat onions. Cook, stirring frequently, about 1 minute.
Add broth and cream to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce begins to thicken, 4-5 minutes.
amounts: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return pork chops to the skillet and turn to coat in sauce. Cover and simmer until chops are cooked through, 5 minutes more.
Meanwhile, heat another skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add veggies, salt, and pepper to the skillet; stir-fry until broccoli is bright green and tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
To serve, divide pork chops, sauce, and veggies between plates. Enjoy!

name: Soba Noodle Salad Bowl with Steak, Bok Choy, Broccoli Slaw & Ginger

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add salt, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add the noodles. Cook noodles according to package directions, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lime into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and oil. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
While the steak is cooking, trim and cut bok choy in half lengthwise.
Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat. Add bok choy, salt, and pepper; cook, flipping occasionally, until tender, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl along with the cooled noodles and broccoli slaw. Toss to combine the noodle salad. (Reserve remaining mint for serving.)
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide noodle salad between bowls; top with steak and bok choy. Sprinkle with reserved mint and enjoy!

name: Soba Noodle Soup with Tofu, Edamame, Mushroom, Green Onion & Ginger

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Thinly slice mushrooms and place in a small bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, ginger, and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are lightly browned, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut tofu into ½-inch cubes.
When the mushrooms are done, add broth to the pan and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the broth is boiling, add tofu, noodles, edamame, and soy sauce; stir to combine the soup. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and continue to cook until noodles are tender and tofu is warmed through, 5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into thin pieces; add to the soup and stir to combine.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!

name: Soba Noodles with Garlicky Green Sauce, Scallion Oil & Avocado

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add salt, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Once the water is boiling, add spinach and cook until bright green and just tender, about 15 seconds. Using tongs, transfer spinach to the colander, and set aside to drain (reserve boiling water in pan for the next step).
Add the noodles to the pan and cook according to package directions, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain in the colander. (Reserve pan for later use.)
While the noodles are cooking, transfer drained spinach to a blender. (Reserve colander for the noodles.)
Juice lime into the blender.

Add nutritional yeast, soy sauce, oil, and garlic powder to the blender. Blend on high until sauce is smooth, adding water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if needed to reach a drizzling consistency. Set green sauce aside.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise.
Wipe the pan used for the noodles clean with paper towels and return to medium heat.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions, crushed red pepper, and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until bright green and just tender, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat.
Transfer drained noodles to a medium bowl. Add green sauce, then stir to coat noodles; add additional water, a tablespoon at a time, if necessary, to coat the noodles in sauce.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin pieces. Season with salt.
To serve, divide noodles and avocado between plates or bowls; top noodles with scallion oil. Enjoy!

name: Soft Beef Tacos with Shredded Romaine, Cheddar & Spicy Salsa

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry lettuce, tomatoes, jalapeño, and green onions.
Add beef to the skillet and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until beef is browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
Add chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper to skillet and stir to combine with the beef. Remove skillet from heat.
Slice the lettuce crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Small dice the tomatoes. Seed and mince the jalapeño. Trim and discard root ends and chop green onions.
In a small bowl, prepare the salsa by mixing together tomatoes, jalapeño, onions, lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Grate ½ cup of cheddar.
To serve, fill tortillas with shredded lettuce, ground beef, and salsa. Sprinkle cheddar over top. Enjoy!

name: Sourdough Pizza Toasts with Prosciutto, Bell Pepper & Artichoke Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Place oil, vinegar, mayo, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper; halve lengthwise, then slice into thin strips. Add half to the bowl with the dressing. (Reserve remaining bell pepper for the pizza toasts.)
Drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place tomato sauce and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the pizza sauce and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Roughly chop olives.
Chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
Spread toasted bread with pizza sauce, then top with cheese, bell pepper, olives, and prosciutto.
Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until pizza toasts are warmed through and cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies, then toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: To serve, divide pizza toasts and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Sourdough Turkey Burger Melt with Mushrooms & Roasted Broccoli

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.

Wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until broccoli is tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)

Meanwhile, place turkey, bread crumbs, egg, Italian seasoning, and salt in a medium bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 2 equal-sized patties, place on another plate, and set aside.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, until golden underneath, about 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-6 minutes, until cooked through. Add burgers to the plate with the mushrooms.
Meanwhile, thinly slice cheese.
When the broccoli is done, change the oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Arrange bread slices on another baking sheet. Spread with mayo, then top with burger patties, mushrooms, and cheese slices. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide turkey burger melts and broccoli between plates. Enjoy!

name: Southern-Style Tomato Sandwich with Parmesan & Pine Nut Kale Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.

Place pine nuts on a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and toast, stirring every 2-3 minutes, until golden brown, 5-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a small baking dish; whisk to combine the marinade.
Slice tomatoes into ¼-inch thick rounds; add to the dish with the marinade, turn to coat, and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Finely chop leaves and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Turn oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
While the broiler heats up, finely grate Parmesan and add to the bowl with the kale.
Roughly chop toasted pine nuts. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad; set aside. (Reserve baking sheet for next step.)
Arrange bread on the baking sheet. Place in the oven and toast, flipping once, until golden brown, 1-2 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Spread each slice of toast with a thick layer of mayo. Top half of the slices with marinated tomatoes, then close with remaining toast slices.
To serve, divide tomato sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Southwest Chicken Salad with Creamy Yogurt Dressing

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cut tortillas into thin strips and place on a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat, then spread out in a single layer.
Place in the oven and bake until golden and crispy, 10-12 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together yogurt, salt, chili powder, garlic powder, pepper, cumin, and paprika.
Remove husks and silks from corn. Stand up vertically in the middle of a large bowl and slice kernels off the cob.

Wash and dry lettuce, bell pepper, tomato, and green onions. Chop lettuce crosswise into 1 inch strips and transfer to the bowl with corn. Seed, medium dice, and add bell pepper to bowl. Medium dice and add tomato to bowl. Trim and discard root ends, chop onions, and add to bowl. Halve and pit avocado; scoop out and medium dice the flesh and add to bowl.
Drain and rinse beans. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl.
Add tortillas strips to bowl and pour dressing over top. Toss salad until well combined.
Slice chicken into strips.
To serve, place salad on a plate and top with chicken slices. Enjoy!

name: Southwest Salmon Chowder with Potato, Corn, Bell Pepper & Avocado

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: traditional style wild pink salmon
ingredients.display: 1 (7.5 oz) can wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice potatoes; place in a small bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the potato and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add potato, bell pepper, and onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Sprinkle flour and spices over the veggies; continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add broth and milk to the pan, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium, and cook until potatoes are tender, 10-12 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, slice lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
Halve and pit avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
When the soup is done, drain and break salmon into chunks; add to the pan, along with the corn, and stir to combine. Cook until heated through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 1 (7.5 oz) can wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.text: Divide soup between bowls, top with avocado, and sprinkle with additional chili powder. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Southwest Turkey Burger with Aioli, Onion, Avocado & Mixed Green Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the cilantro. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Add turkey, bread crumbs, and spices to the bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 2 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, place mayo and additional spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the aioli and set aside.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and salt in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and halve bell pepper crosswise, then slice into thin strips; halve tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Peel and slice onion crosswise into thin rings.
Halve and pit avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Toast buns if desired.
Just before serving, add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and veggies; toss to combine the salad.
Place bottom half of each bun on a plate; spread with aioli, then layer with burger patties, onion, and avocado. Close with the top half of each bun and serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Southwest White Chicken Chili with Avocado & Crusty Bread

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Wash, seed, and mince jalapeño.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add onion, garlic, and jalapeño. Stirring frequently, cook until onion is softened, 3-4 minutes.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Drain and rinse beans.
Add chicken to saucepan and, stirring occasionally, cook until no longer pink, 2-3 minutes.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.

Add beans, broth, ½ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing), cumin, oregano, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Toast bread.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out and medium dice.
To serve, add chili to a bowl and garnish with avocado and remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Southwestern Black Bean Cakes with Guacamole & Corn

instructions.text: Drain and rinse beans.
Wash and dry jalapeño and cilantro. Seed and mince jalapeño. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Transfer beans to a medium bowl and mash with a fork. Add egg, jalapeño, ½ of the cilantro (save the rest for the guacamole), bread crumbs, cumin, salt, and pepper. Mix until well combined.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out the flesh into a medium bowl. Add remaining cilantro, lime juice, salt, and pepper. Mash with a fork until smooth.
Measure out corn.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add corn and cook until heated through, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.
Shape black bean mixture into 6-8 patties and place on a plate.
Once corn has been transferred, wipe skillet and coat with more oil. Add patties and cook until browned and crisp, 3-4 minutes per side.
Peel and mince garlic. Add garlic, lime juice, salt, and pepper to corn; mix to combine.
Serve black bean cakes with guacamole and corn. Enjoy!

name: Southwestern Stuffed Spaghetti Squash with Black Beans

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash squash, halve lengthwise, and scoop out the seeds. Rub each half with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Place halves, cut side down, on a baking sheet.
Place the squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender so a knife can easily pierce though the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
While the squash cooks, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Seed and small dice the bell pepper; transfer to a medium bowl.
Seed and mince the jalapeño pepper (leave the seeds in for more heat if desired); add to the bowl.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse the beans.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion and peppers; cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to soften, 3 to 4 minutes.

Add the beans, chili powder, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and squeeze lime juice over top; stir to combine and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Reduce heat to low and stir occasionally while you wait for the squash to cook.
Coarsely grate ½ cup of cheddar.

Remove the squash from the oven and change the oven setting to broil. Allow the squash to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Using a fork, scrape out the squash flesh to make spaghetti-like strings (use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand).
Add the strands of spaghetti squash along with half of the minced cilantro (save the rest for garnishing) to the skillet; toss to combine.
Fill the squash halves with the squash-vegetable mixture and sprinkle with the grated cheddar.
Place the squash back in the oven and broil until the cheese is melted, 1-3 minutes.
Divide the squash halves between plates and sprinkle with the remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Soy-Baked Salmon Rice Bowl with Mango Cabbage Slaw & Cilantro

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
While the water is heating, place soy sauce, oil, honey, and spices in a small baking dish. Whisk to combine the marinade.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, if using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end (or corner) firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.
Cut the salmon into 1-inch cubes. Add to the baking dish with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Juice lime into the bowl with the cilantro. Add mayo, soy sauce, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, stir combine the slaw, and set aside.
When the rice has about 10 minutes left, place salmon in the oven and bake, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide rice, salmon, and slaw between bowls. Top with reserved cilantro and enjoy!

name: Soy-Ginger Salmon with Sesame Napa Cabbage Slaw

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the lime into a small bowl.
Peel and mince the ginger; transfer to a medium bowl.
Add half of the lime juice (save the rest for the salad), soy sauce, and olive oil to the ginger; whisk together.
Place the salmon, skin-side-up, in the sauce. Set the bowl aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is warm, measure out the sesame seeds and add to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until they are golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Once done, transfer to a small bowl.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the salmon, skin-side down, in the skillet; cook for 3 to 4 minutes on one side, then flip and pour in the remaining sauce. Continue to cook until the flesh is opaque, another 2 to 3 minutes.
Combine the remaining lime juice, olive oil, sesame oil, soy sauce, and honey in a large bowl; whisk together.
Halve the cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; thinly slice crosswise and add to the large bowl.
Trim the ends and peel the carrots; discard the trimmings and coarsely grate the carrots. Add to the cabbage.
Toss the salad until well combined.
To serve, arrange the salad on a plate and place the salmon on top. Enjoy!

name: Spaghetti al Limone (Lemon Pasta) with Basil & Garlic-Roasted Veggies

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.

Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve ¼-cup cooking water before draining and set aside.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the garlic oil.

Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with half of the garlic oil (reserving the rest for the kale), toss to coat, and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast broccoli while you prepare the kale.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces, add to the bowl with reserved garlic oil, and toss to coat.

Remove baking sheet from the oven, add seasoned kale, and toss to combine with the broccoli. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are tender-crisp, 8-10 minutes more. Remove from oven.
While the veggies are roasting, zest and juice lemon into a small bowl. Add cream, oil, salt, and crushed red pepper; whisk to combine the lemon cream.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Finely grate Parmesan, add to the bowl with the lemon cream, and stir to combine. Set aside.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Set aside.

Return drained pasta to the pan and place over medium heat. Stir in the Parmesan-lemon cream and reserved pasta water; cook, stirring gently, until cheese has melted and sauce has thickened slightly, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Stir basil into the pasta.
To serve, divide pasta and veggies between plates or bowls. Top pasta with additional crushed red pepper and enjoy!

name: Spaghetti "Carbonara" with Tempeh, Parsley & Lemony Kale Salad

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ½-cup pasta water before draining.)
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice tempeh. Place in a small bowl, drizzle with soy sauce, then season with smoked paprika and salt. Stir to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tempeh and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 4-5 minutes. Transfer tempeh to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Divide between two medium bowls.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to one of the bowls with the Parmesan. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
Add egg, pepper, and salt to the bowl with the Parmesan and parsley. Whisk to combine the egg mixture and set aside.
Juice lemon into the remaining bowl with the Parmesan. Add oil, crushed red pepper, and salt. Whisk to combine the dressing.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing and, using your hands, massage kale until wilted, 1-2 minutes. Set aside.
When the pasta is done, return skillet to medium-high heat. Add drained pasta and cook, tossing frequently, until warmed through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.

Carefully transfer warmed pasta to the bowl with the egg mixture. Tossing continuously, combine pasta with the egg mixture until pasta is glossy and evenly coated, 1-2 minutes. (The heat of the pasta will cook the egg.)
Add tempeh to the bowl with the pasta and toss once more to combine. Add reserved pasta water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if necessary, to loosen the pasta.
To serve, divide pasta and kale salad between plates or bowls. Top pasta with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Spaghetti with Creamy Basil-Spinach Sauce, Tomatoes, Walnuts & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve ½-cup of pasta cooking water before draining.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Roughly chop walnuts, place in a small bowl, and set aside.
Halve tomatoes and set aside.
Place peas in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Transfer to a blender.
Peel garlic and add to the blender with the peas.
Pick basil leaves off the stems and add to the blender.
Add spinach, half of the feta (reserving remaining feta for garnish), cream cheese, oil, salt, and ½-cup reserved pasta water; purée sauce until smooth.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Return drained pasta to the pan. Add sauce and tomatoes; stir to combine.
Return pan to medium-low heat and cook, stirring often, until sauce coats the pasta and tomatoes are warmed through, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls; top with walnuts, remaining feta, and crushed red pepper. Enjoy!

name: Spaghetti Puttanesca

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic. Halve olives. Measure out capers.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic, olives, capers, oregano, and crushed red pepper. Stir and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add tomatoes and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer the sauce while the pasta cooks.
Wash basil. Pick leaves off the stems; discard the stems and thinly slice the leaves into ribbons.
Drain pasta in a colander.
Add pasta to sauce and drizzle with olive oil. Stir in the basil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: To serve, add pasta to a shallow bowl or plate and enjoy!

name: Spaghetti with Roasted Bacon, Brussels Sprouts, Mushrooms & Parmesan

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and halve Brussels sprouts lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Wash, dry, and quarter mushrooms. Add to the baking sheet with the Brussels sprouts.
Small dice bacon and add to the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and maple syrup, then season with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and bacon is cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
When the pasta is done, reserve a ⅓-cup of cooking water, then drain. Return pasta and reserved cooking water to the pot; set aside until the veggies are done.

Add roasted veggies, bacon, Parmesan, and Dijon to the pot, then set over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring often, until the liquid has evaporated and Parmesan has melted, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Spaghetti with Spinach, Peas, Asparagus, Poached Eggs & Parmesan

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and set aside.

Meanwhile, fill another medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add vinegar, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once the water in the pan is boiling, reduce heat to medium-low.
While the water is heating, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the green onions.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add garlic and peas to the bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.
Gently crack eggs into two additional small bowls (two eggs per bowl).

Adjust the heat of the saucepan as necessary so that the vinegar water is simmering. Gently tip bowls into the pan, sliding the eggs carefully into the water. Cook until whites are set but yolks are still soft, 2½-3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer eggs to a plate.
When the veggies are done, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Zest and juice lemon into the skillet, then add drained spaghetti. Continue to cook, tossing occasionally, until warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta and eggs between bowls. Top with Parmesan and enjoy!

name: Spaghetti Squash "Carbonara" with Bacon, Leeks, Parmesan & Fried Egg

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim spaghetti squash, then halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 3-4 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate; set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim off the root end and the dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Thinly slice crosswise.

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add leek and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender but not browned, 2-3 minutes. Transfer leek to a medium bowl. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the leek.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with pepper, and set aside.
Remove squash from the oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
While the squash is cooling, wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper.

Meanwhile, scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands (use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand). Add to the bowl with the leek and Parmesan, then toss to combine.
To serve, divide spaghetti squash between plates or bowls. Top with crispy bacon and fried eggs. Enjoy!

name: Spaghetti Squash with Creamy Asparagus, Artichoke & Spinach Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place the rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim squash, halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper; arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop spinach, place in a medium bowl, and set aside.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch pieces.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add asparagus and garlic. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut cream cheese into small pieces; drain and thinly slice artichokes.
Finely grate Parmesan.
When the asparagus is done, add cream cheese, artichokes, Parmesan, milk, and water to the pan. Stir until the cheese is melted and sauce is heated through, 1-2 minutes.
Add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove sauce from heat and cover to keep warm.

Remove squash from the oven; allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand.)
To serve, divide squash and sauce between plates. Sprinkle with crushed red pepper and enjoy!

name: Spaghetti Squash with Garlicky Sausage, Kale & Cheesy Bread Crumbs

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim spaghetti squash, then halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until golden and crispy, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat. Once hot, add sausage and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice garlic.
When the sausage is done, add garlic and crushed red pepper to the skillet. Cook, stirring often, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the bread crumbs and stir to combine. Set aside.
Remove squash from the oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces.

Return skillet with sausage to medium-high heat. Add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the kale is tender and the sausage is warmed through, about 1 minute.
Juice lemon into the skillet and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands (use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand). Season with salt.
To serve, divide spaghetti squash between plates or bowls. Top with sausage-kale sauté and cheesy bread crumbs. Enjoy!

name: Spaghetti Squash "Pad Thai" with Shrimp

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place the rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off and discard ends of the squash; halve the squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds from each half. Rub the inside of the squash with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange the squash halves cut-side-down on the baking sheet.
Place the squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Transfer to a small bowl.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the green onion and set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry; transfer to a medium bowl.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince shallot. Peel and mince garlic. Add shallot, garlic, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the shrimp and toss to coat.

When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp in a single layer and cook until lightly golden, 1½-2 minutes per side; transfer to a plate and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.

Once tender, remove the squash halves from the oven; allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand).
While the squash cools, juice the lime into a small bowl. Add fish sauce, soy sauce, maple syrup, vinegar, oil, and cayenne to bowl with lime juice; whisk to combine the sauce.
Return skillet to medium-high heat; add spaghetti squash, shrimp, and sauce to the skillet and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes.
To serve, divide the pad Thai between plates or bowls and garnish with green onions, cilantro, and peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Spaghetti Squash with Rich Tomato Meat Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and position rack in the centre. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash squash, halve lengthwise, and scoop out the seeds. Rub each half with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Place halves, cut side down, on a baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Wash, trim ends, and small dice celery. Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add oil to skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add beef and cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
Add celery, onion, and garlic to beef and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring often, until vegetables have softened, 4-5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, Italian seasoning, and red pepper; stir to combine. Reduce heat to medium and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until reduced in volume, 10-12 minutes.
Wash and dry basil. Pick leaves off the stems; discard the stems and thinly slice about ½ of the leaves crosswise into ribbons (save the rest for garnishing). Stir the ribbons into the sauce.

Remove the squash from oven; allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Using a fork, scrape the squash flesh to make spaghetti-like strings (use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand). Keep in the squash shell for serving or transfer to a separate bowl.
To serve, spoon the tomato meat sauce overtop spaghetti squash and garnish with remaining basil leaves and freshly ground pepper. Enjoy!

name: Spaghetti with Turkey Bolognese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and discard the ends of the celery; small dice the celery and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the celery.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Add olive oil to the pan and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the celery and onion to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, 2 to 4 minutes.
While the vegetables cook, pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add the garlic to the pan; cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Once the water is boiling, season with salt and add the pasta. Cook the pasta until desired firmness, 8 to 10 minutes. Once done, drain in a colander.
Add the ground turkey to the pan; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 2 to 4 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes and tomato sauce to the pan; season with salt, pepper, and crushed red pepper. Increase the heat to medium-high and let the sauce simmer until thickened, 4 to 6 minutes.
Stir the basil and spaghetti into the sauce.
To serve, place the pasta into a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Spanakopita-Inspired Flatbread with Creamy Feta, Spinach, Lemon & Dill

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Zest lemon into a small bowl. Add ⅔ of the feta, yogurt, oil, pepper, and salt. Mash with a fork until semi-smooth and combined, then set aside. (Reserve lemon and remaining feta for later use.)

Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until flatbreads are slightly crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
Meanwhile, juice reserved lemon into another small bowl.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with oil and salt, then stir to combine.

Once the skillet is hot, add lemon-oil mixture. Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring frequently, until wilted, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Spread the creamy feta over each flatbread, then top with sautéed greens and reserved feta.
To serve, cut flatbreads into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spanakopita-Inspired Kale, Leek & Feta Frittata with Greek Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the kale and set aside.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leek and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender but not browned, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, crack eggs into another medium bowl. Add salt and pepper, then whisk to combine. Add half of the feta, whisk once more to combine, and set aside. (Reserve remaining feta for later use.)
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
When the leeks are tender, add kale and dill to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the greens to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

When the kale is wilted, pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, about 5 minutes.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until top of the frittata is just set, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes and olives. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, along with reserved feta, and gently stir to combine the salad.
Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Spanish Potato & Onion Frittata with Spinach Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach and chives if they came pre-washed.)
Using a mandoline or knife, slice the potatoes into very thin slices and transfer to a colander. Sprinkle with salt and toss to coat; set aside in the sink or on a plate to drain.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium high heat.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings. Peel and mince (or press) the garlic.

Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, thyme, and oregano to the pan, stirring until soft and golden brown, 4-5 minutes; remove from skillet and set aside.
Meanwhile, shake excess water from the potato slices and quickly pat dry with a paper towel.

Add more oil and the potatoes to the pan; turn the heat down to low and cover with a lid. Cook potatoes, stirring occasionally, until tender, 5-7 minutes. Once cooked, spread onion in a layer on top of the potatoes.
While the potatoes are cooking, crack the eggs into a medium bowl, add water and season with salt and pepper. Whisk to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet gently so you don't disturb the potatoes. Cover with a lid and cook until the base and sides are set, about 5-6 minutes.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
While frittata is cooking on the stove, combine balsamic, oil, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a large bowl to make the dressing for the salad.
Peel the carrot, then trim off the ends. Using a box grater, coarsely grate. Medium dice tomato and add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Once frittata edges are set transfer the pan to the oven and broil until the center eggs are firm and the top becomes golden brown, 5-7 minutes.
Add spinach to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine.
Chop chives into small pieces.

When frittata is done cooking, remove from oven and place a cutting board on top of the skillet. Using oven mitts, flip the pan to turn the frittata out onto the cutting board so that potatoes are facing up.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Garnish with chives and serve with spinach salad. Enjoy!

name: Spanish Rice with Pinto Beans, Tomatoes, Avocado & Cilantro

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.

Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain. When the veggies are soft, add rice to the pan; cook, stirring constantly, until rice is slightly translucent, 1-2 minutes.
Add beans, tomatoes, and broth to the pan. Stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid in the saucepan comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Simmer until rice is tender and the liquid is mostly absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
When the rice is almost done, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and thinly slice. Set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the rice and stir to combine (reserve the rest for serving).
To serve, divide rice between plates or bowls; top with avocado and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Spanish-Style Baked Beans with Olives, Parsley Chimichurri & Flatbread

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve grape tomatoes. Place in a small bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes, bell pepper, garlic, and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes are starting to burst, 7-8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans.
Halve olives lengthwise.

When the veggies are done, add beans, olives, broth, and vinegar to the skillet, then stir to combine. Place skillet in the oven and bake until beans are tender and sauce has thickened slightly, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Add to the bowl with the parsley along with oil, vinegar, oregano, and salt. Stir to combine the chimichurri and set aside.

When the beans have about 5 minutes left, cut flatbread into wedges and arrange on a baking sheet pan. Add to the oven and bake until warmed through and slightly golden, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide beans and flatbread wedges between plates or bowls. Drizzle beans with chimichurri and enjoy!

name: Spice-Rubbed Pork Chop with Garlicky Bacon, Kale & Mushroom Sauté

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate, leaving the drippings in the skillet.
Meanwhile, preheat the broiler to high and position rack about 6 inches from the top.
Place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine the spice rub.
Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a broiler pan; season with spice rub on both sides. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Place pork chops in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until chops are no longer pink in the center and are browned at the edges, 12-14 minutes, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F. Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms; place in the reserved bowl and set aside.
Peel and thinly slice garlic.
Return skillet (with bacon drippings) to medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add mushrooms and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are soft and golden, 6-7 minutes.
While the mushrooms are cooking, wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.
When the mushrooms are done, add kale, water, salt, and pepper to the skillet; stir to combine and cover. Cook until the kale is wilted and tender, 1-2 minutes; remove from heat.
Meanwhile, chop or crumble bacon into pieces.
Add bacon to the skillet with the veggies and stir to combine.
To serve, divide pork chops and veggie sauté between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spiced Beet, Butternut & Chickpea Bowl with Rice Pilaf & Lemon Yogurt

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, peel, and cut beet into ½-inch cubes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim and peel butternut squash. Halve lengthwise, scrape out seeds, and cut flesh into ½-inch cubes; add to the baking sheet with the beet.
Drain and rinse chickpeas; add to the baking sheet.
Drizzle veggies and chickpeas with oil and sprinkle with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and spices; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice cooks, juice lemon into a small bowl. Add yogurt, maple syrup, and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the lemon yogurt.
Pick cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Add almonds and half the cilantro to the cooked rice; stir to combine the pilaf. (Reserve remaining cilantro for garnish.)
To serve, divide rice pilaf, veggies, and chickpeas between bowls. Drizzle with lemon yogurt, sprinkle with reserved cilantro, and enjoy!

name: Spiced Chicken Kale Salad with Pear, Pecans, Parmesan & Cranberries

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan; add ⅔ to the bowl with the lemon juice (reserving the rest for serving).
Add oil and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Finely chop leaves and add to the bowl with the dressing; using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes. Set aside.
Place additional spices in a small bowl and stir to combine.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Place on a plate and season with the spice mixture on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, quarter, core, and thinly slice pear; add to the bowl with the kale.
Roughly chop pecans and add to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls and top with sliced chicken, cranberries, and reserved Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Spiced Chicken Skewers with Roasted Vegetable Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Combine spices and oil in a medium bowl.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, cut into 1-inch pieces and place in the medium bowl with the spice mix; toss to combine.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Thread chicken onto skewers and place on a broiler pan. If you don't have skewers you can put the chicken directly on the pan. Set pan aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim zucchini and green onions; chop zucchini into 1-inch pieces and green onions into ¼-inch pieces. Place both in a large bowl.
