Snap (or cut) off the woody ends of the asparagus and cut into thirds; add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Remove seeds and membranes from pepper and slice into thin strips; add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the vegetables. Add oil, salt, and pepper; toss to combine.

Spread vegetables in an even layer on a parchment lined baking sheet. Put both the veggies and the chicken skewers in the oven and bake until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender, about 15 minutes. Toss veggies and turn chicken half-way through.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves.
When chicken and vegetables are done, remove from the oven and toss mint with the veggies.
To serve, divide chicken and vegetables between plates; crumble cheese over the veggies and enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Spiced Honey Chicken with Sauteed Snap Peas, Carrots, & Cabbage

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Peel and mince garlic; combine with chili garlic sauce, soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil in a small bowl; whisk to combine.

Place chicken in a baking dish, making sure to unroll the thigh pieces and lay them flat. Drizzle with half the marinade and place in the oven. Reserve the remaining, untouched marinade for later. Bake chicken until cooked through and golden, 20 minutes, flipping once halfway through.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: While chicken is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion to the skillet and stir-fry until tender, 2-3 minutes.
Peel and grate or julienne the carrot.
Add peas and carrots to the skillet with the onions and stir-fry, 2-3 minutes more.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise.
Add cabbage and remaining marinade to skillet and stir-fry until cabbage is just wilted, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide stir-fried vegetables between plates; top with chicken and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Spiced Pakistani-Style Chicken Curry with Bell Pepper, Spinach & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice cooks, juice the lime into a medium bowl. Add spices and stir to combine the marinade.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-size pieces. Add to the bowl with the marinade and stir to combine; set aside.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, and onion; cook, stirring often, until onion is soft, 3-4 minutes.
Add chicken to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until partially cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper.

Add bell pepper, tomato sauce, and water to the skillet. Stir to combine and bring to a boil over high. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low; simmer, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the chicken is done, remove from heat. Stir handfuls of spinach into the skillet, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add half the cilantro (reserving the rest for garnish) and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice and chicken curry between bowls. Top with reserved cilantro and enjoy!

name: Spiced Pork, Apple, Celery & Cranberry Stuffed Acorn Squash

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve acorn squash lengthwise, trim ends, then scoop out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper; arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Quarter and core apple, then medium dice; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl with the veggies and apple.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, apple, pork, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.

When the pork is done, add broth, cranberries, and sugar; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes more. Cover and remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, divide squash halves between plates and fill with the pork and veggie stuffing. Enjoy!

name: Spiced Red Lentil, Carrot & Tomato Soup with Guacamole-Radish Toast

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, trim, and small dice carrot; trim and small dice celery. Add both to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and set aside.

When the veggies have softened, add lentils, broth, tomatoes, and spices to the pan; stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender, 15-20 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado. Scoop out the flesh and place in the reserved bowl; mash with a fork.
Peel and mince additional garlic; add to the bowl with the avocado.
Juice half of the lemon into the bowl; add salt, stir to combine the guacamole, and set aside. (Reserve remaining lemon for the soup.)

Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler. Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet pan and place in the oven; broil until toasted, flipping halfway, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Trim and small dice radishes.
Once the lentils are tender, juice remaining lemon into the pan and stir to combine the soup. Remove from heat.
Divide guacamole between toast slices and top with radish; season with salt and pepper.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with guacamole-radish toast on the side. Enjoy!

name: Spiced Sesame-Parsley Turkey Meatballs with Spinach & Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic; divide between two medium bowls.
Juice lemon into one of the bowls with the garlic. Add oil, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.

Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the parsley to the bowl with the dressing, whisk to combine and set aside. (Reserve remaining parsley for the next step.)
Add remaining parsley, turkey, bread crumbs, egg, sesame seeds, oil, and spices to the second bowl with the garlic. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Add spinach to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide the meatballs and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spiced Sirloin with Quinoa, Sweet Pepper, Tomato, & Herb Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: In a small bowl, combine spices. Pat the steak dry with paper towel, season both sides with spice mixture, and set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Add both to a medium bowl.
Grate zest from half of the lemon; juice the entire lemon. Place zest and juice into the bowl with the garlic and shallot. Add olive oil, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve the grape tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Medium dice the bell pepper and add to the bowl with the dressing and tomatoes.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place seasoned steaks on the pan and cook until preferred degree of doneness, 3-4 minutes per side for medium. Remove steaks from the pan and allow to rest for 5 minutes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the vegetables.
Once the quinoa is finished, fluff with a fork and add to the bowl with the dressing and vegetables. Toss to combine.
To serve, slice steak into thin strips and divide between plates along with the salad. Enjoy!

name: Spiced Sweet Potato-Chickpea Bake with Spinach, Carrot & Feta Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Place oil, sesame seeds, spices, and sugar in a medium bowl; stir to combine the spice oil.
Peel, trim, and slice sweet potato crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Add to the bowl with the spice oil along with chickpeas; using your hands, gently toss to coat.
Transfer chickpeas and sweet potato to a baking sheet pan, then spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping sweet potato halfway through, until sweet potato is tender and chickpeas are crisp, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wipe reserved bowl clean with paper towels.
Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the dill.
Add feta, yogurt, mayo, water, salt, and pepper to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing. (Add additional water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if necessary, to reach a drizzling consistency.)
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Peel, trim, and julienne or coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop spinach, add to the bowl, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chickpeas, sweet potato, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spiced Turkey Bowl with Basil Slaw, Cucumber, Avocado & Sesame Sauce

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, turkey, and spices; cook, breaking the turkey apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger; place in a small bowl along with tahini, oil, vinegar, water, soy sauce, and maple syrup. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place in a medium bowl (reserving a small amount for garnish).
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl with the basil, along with broccoli slaw, and toss to combine.
Trim and thinly slice cucumber crosswise into rounds.
Halve and pit avocado. Slice thinly while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide slaw between bowls; top with turkey, cucumber, avocado, and reserved basil. Drizzle sauce over top and enjoy!

name: Spiced Veggie, Lentil & Chickpea Soup (Harira) with Cilantro Yogurt

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Rinse chickpeas and lentils in a colander or strainer; set aside to drain.
Peel and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot; add to the bowl with onion and garlic.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl with the other veggies.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, carrot, celery, spices, and sugar to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies soften, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Add chickpeas, lentils, broth, and tomatoes to the pan; stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the soup comes to a boil, reduce heat to a simmer and cover; cook, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into the reserved bowl; add water, flour, and egg. Whisk to combine the thickening liquid.

Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the thickening liquid and whisk to combine; set aside. (Reserve remaining cilantro for the next step.)
Place remaining cilantro in another small bowl. Add yogurt and water; stir to combine the cilantro yogurt and set aside.
When the lentils are tender, slowly pour the thickening liquid into the soup while gently stirring. Simmer until soup thickens, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with cilantro yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Spicy African Peanut Curry with Sweet Potato, Kale, Cilantro & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, add salt, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger; transfer to a medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl with the garlic; set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and small dice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and medium dice sweet potato.
Add garlic, ginger, jalapeño, curry powder, and salt to the pan. Cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. (Reserve bowl for later.)

Add broth, tomatoes, peanut butter, and sweet potato to the pan. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sweet potato begins to soften, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces, place in the reserved bowl, and set aside.
Coarsely chop peanuts. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set both aside.
Add kale to the simmering curry and stir to combine. Continue to simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, about 5 minutes.
While the curry finishes cooking, slice lime into wedges.
To serve, divide rice and curry between bowls; top with peanuts, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Asian Pork, Bok Choy & Snap Pea Stir-Fry over Jasmine Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice cooks, place broth, chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and cornstarch in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Trim and cut bok choy crosswise into 1-inch strips; place in a medium bowl.
Halve snap peas crosswise and add to the bowl with the bok choy; set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the veggies.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
When the pork is done, add veggies, ginger, garlic, salt, and pepper to the skillet; stir-fry until veggies soften, about 3 minutes.
Add sauce to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates; sprinkle with reserved green onion and enjoy!

name: Spicy Asian Pork Stir-Fry with Eggplant, Green Beans & Sesame Seeds

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork, salt, and pepper; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, trim and small dice eggplant. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and halve green beans crosswise. Add to the bowl with the eggplant.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place soy sauce, vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and additional oil in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce.

When the veggies are done, return pork to the skillet, along with sauce, and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pork and veggies are coated in sauce, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Top with sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Spicy Asian Turkey Meatballs with Veggie Fried Rice

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the minced garlic, ground turkey, egg, bread crumbs, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, onion powder, and salt.

Coat a glass baking dish with a thin layer of olive oil. Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place in the glass dish. Place the dish in the oven and bake for 18 minutes.
Peel and grate the ginger.

Place a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add ginger, soy sauce, vinegar, cornstarch, sugar, sesame oil, chili-garlic sauce, and water. Whisk until well combined. Continue to cook, whisking occasionally, until sauce becomes thick enough to coat a spoon, 3-4 minutes. Once done, remove from heat and set aside.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Trim the ends and peel the carrot; discard the trimmings and coarsely grate or julienne.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the broccoli, carrots and snap peas. Stir fry until soft, 4-5 minutes. Add the cooked rice to the skillet and toss to combine.
Push ingredients to the sides of the skillet and crack eggs into the middle. Let sit for a few seconds and then scramble. Add the soy sauce and stir to combine everything together.
When the meatballs are done baking, remove from the oven and toss with the sauce in a large bowl.
Divide the rice and veggies between bowls and top with the meatballs with sauce. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Bacon, Eggplant & Mushroom Pasta (Amatriciana) with Parsley

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and small dice eggplant; quarter mushrooms. Transfer both to a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate, leaving the drippings in the skillet.
While the bacon cooks, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot and garlic.

Return the skillet (with bacon drippings) to medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add eggplant, mushrooms, shallot, garlic, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until eggplant and mushrooms are soft and golden, 7-8 minutes.
When the pasta is done, drain in a colander and return to the pan; cover and set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Finely grate Parmesan.
When the veggies are done, add tomato sauce and spices to skillet. Stir to combine the veggie sauce and bring to a simmer; cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, about 2 minutes.
Add veggie sauce, bacon, and half of the parsley (reserving the rest for garnish) to the pan with the pasta; stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls; top with reserved parsley, additional crushed red pepper, and Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Baked Chicken Wings with Italian Mushroom & Celery Salad

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 475°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice half the lemon into a medium bowl (reserve remaining lemon for the salad). Add oil and spices; whisk to combine the marinade.
Add chicken wings to the bowl with the marinade and toss to coat; transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in a single layer.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice remaining lemon into another medium bowl. Add oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim celery and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Thinly slice mushrooms and add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Chop chives into small pieces and add to the bowl.
Use a vegetable peeler to shave Parmesan; add to the bowl and gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Beef Bell Peppers with Cheese, Mixed Greens & Cilantro Dressing

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then arrange cut-side down.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until peppers are tender and charred, 5-6 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, quarter chili pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice. (Be careful with chili peppers; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Once the skillet is hot, add the ground beef and chili pepper; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until the beef is browned and cooked through, 3-4 minutes.
While the beef is cooking, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a medium bowl and set aside (reserve remaining cilantro for the next step).
Add reserved cilantro and spices to the skillet with the beef; stir to combine and remove from the heat.
Coarsely grate mozzarella.
Divide beef mixture between pepper halves and top with cheese. Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, add oil, vinegar, and spices to the bowl with the cilantro; stir to combine the dressing.
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide stuffed peppers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Beef & Cheddar Bell Pepper "Nachos" with Tomatoes and Jalapeños

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.

Once the skillet is hot, add ground beef and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until the beef is browned and no longer pink, 3-4 minutes. Stir in the garlic, then remove skillet from the heat.
Cut the bell peppers lengthwise into quarters; remove and discard the seeds and white membrane. Slice each quarter crosswise into 3 or 4 pieces to make the "chips."
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place bell pepper pieces, skin-side down, in a single layer on the baking sheet.
Preheat oven to broil on high; position rack under the broiler.
Grate the cheese.
Thinly slice the jalapeño into rounds. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Top the bell pepper slices with an even layer of ground beef, cheese, and jalapeños.
Place the baking sheet in the oven; cook until cheese is melted and bubbly, 3-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Small dice the tomato. Cut the lime into wedges.
To serve, divide the nachos between plates. Garnish with cilantro, tomatoes, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Beef "Taco" Burger with Cilantro Aioli & Chili-Corn Tossed Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lime into a small bowl. (Reserve lime for later use.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime zest, along with mayo and garlic powder, then stir to combine the aioli. Set aside.
Juice reserved lime into a medium bowl. Add oil and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.

Peel and mince garlic. Place in another medium bowl along with beef, bread crumbs, and spices; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the beef mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, slice tomato crosswise into thin rounds. Place on another plate.

Thinly slice jalapeño pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the plate with the tomato. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Add 2 lettuce leaves to the plate, then chop or tear remaining lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add chopped lettuce to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired.
Spread aioli over the bottom half of each bun, then top with burger patties, jalapeño, tomato, and lettuce. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Spicy Bibimbap Style Cauliflower Stir-Fry with Beef, Veggies & Eggs

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 4 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add ground beef and cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove skillet from the heat and, using a slotted spoon, transfer beef to a plate and set aside.

Meanwhile, cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower and place in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms and add to the bowl with the cauliflower.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl.
Return the skillet (with leftover cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and stir to combine.

Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Once all the spinach has wilted, flatten the veggie mixture in an even layer and cook, without stirring, until a brown crust forms on the bottom, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic and ginger.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Place garlic, ginger, onions, tomato paste, vinegar, oil, maple syrup, soy sauce, sesame seeds, and crushed red pepper in the bowl used for the veggies. Whisk to combine the sauce.
Drizzle sauce over the veggies, stir to combine, cover, and cook until the veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Return beef to the skillet, stir to combine and continue to cook, until heated through, 1-2 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and halve the eggs.
To serve, divide stir-fry between bowls or plates and top with eggs. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Black Bean-Avocado Tacos with Lime Crema & Cilantro-Cabbage Slaw

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Juice half of the lime into a small bowl. Add yogurt and salt, then whisk to combine. Add water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set crema aside. (Reserve remaining lime for the next step.)
Juice reserved lime into a medium bowl. Add oil and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the dressing. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Quarter cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw. Set aside.
Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and cumin; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add beans, hot sauce, and salt to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Season with salt.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then top with beans, avocado, crema, and reserved cilantro. Serve with slaw on the side and enjoy!

name: Spicy Black Bean Cauliflower Rice Bowl with Corn, Avocado & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise. Add half to the bowl with the cauliflower. (Place remaining onions on a plate and set aside.)
Add oil and spices to the bowl, then stir to combine. Transfer cauliflower rice to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring cauliflower halfway through, until rice is tender and golden, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place half in the reserved bowl. (Add remaining cilantro to the plate with the onions.)
Juice half of the lime into the bowl with the cilantro. Cut remaining lime into wedges and add to the plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse beans in a colander.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beans, corn, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until beans and corn are warmed through and spices are fragrant, 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat, add feta, and stir to combine.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Slice crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the plate.
When the cauliflower is done, remove from the oven. Add lime and cilantro mixture, then stir to combine.
Divide cauliflower rice between bowls; top with spicy bean sauté, reserved cilantro, green onions, and avocado. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Spicy Blackberry Pulled Chicken Sandwich with Butter Lettuce Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Place broth, vinegar, Worcestershire, sugar, and spices in a medium saucepan. Stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the liquid is boiling, add chicken to the pan and reduce heat to medium-low. Cover and cook until chicken is cooked through, 12-15 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, place mayo, vinegar, oil, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Medium dice tomato. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot. Add to the bowl and set aside.
When the chicken is done, transfer to a plate, leaving the liquid in the pan.
Add blackberries and hot sauce to the pan, then mash with a potato masher to create a chunky sauce. Return to medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Toast buns if desired.
Using two forks, shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Return to the pan with the reduced sauce, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide buns between plates. Top the bottoms with pulled chicken, then close with the top half of the bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Spicy Bombay Chicken Skillet with Potato, Tomato, Zucchini & Cilantro

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve potatoes, place in a medium saucepan, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until potatoes are fork-tender, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion; add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons; add to the bowl.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Small dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels. Cut into bite-sized pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and chicken; cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is golden brown and almost cooked through, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the chicken is done, add half of the cilantro (reserving the rest for garnish), tomatoes, pine nuts, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes more.
When the potatoes are done, drain and add to the skillet; stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide the chicken skillet between plates or bowls and top with reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Spicy "Buffalo" Wings with Veggie Sticks & Blue Cheese Dressing

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 475°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels, place on the baking sheet, and drizzle with oil. Season with salt and pepper, toss to combine, and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place blue cheese in a small bowl; add mayo, water, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch pieces; place on a plate.
Peel, trim, and quarter carrot lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long pieces; add to the plate with the cucumber.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper into thin strips; add to the plate and set aside.

Place oil, chili-garlic sauce, and vinegar in a small saucepan; whisk to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Once simmering, remove from heat and cover with a lid to keep warm. (If the sauce separates, whisk together once more, right before serving.)
When the wings are done, drizzle with the warm sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings, veggies, and dressing between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Cajun Shrimp Skillet with Zucchini, Corn & Bell Peppers

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
In a medium bowl, combine and mix together the spices.
Small dice the celery. Peel and mince the shallot.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shallot and celery to the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, 2-3 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and half of the spice mixture to the saucepan. Cook, stirring continuously, for 1 minute.

Add the rice and broth to the saucepan and bring to a boil. Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Add the shrimp and oil to the medium bowl with the rest of the spice mixture. Stir to combine and set aside.
Halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half moons. Medium dice the bell pepper.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the zucchini, bell pepper, and frozen corn to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Add the shrimp to the skillet; cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, remove skillet from heat.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls and top with the shrimp and vegetables. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Cajun Shrimp Stew with Green Onions, Bell Pepper, Celery & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
While the water is heating, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Place in a small bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl. (Set remaining green onions aside for serving.)
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain tomatoes in a colander. Set aside to drain further.
When the veggies are tender, add flour to the pan. Cook, stirring frequently, until golden brown, 1-2 minutes.
Add tomatoes, broth, Worcestershire, and hot sauce to the pan, then stir to combine the stew. Cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 5-6 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: When the stew has thickened, add shrimp and cream to the pan, then stir to combine. Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide the shrimp stew between bowls. Place a scoop of rice in the center of each bowl and top with reserved green onions. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Carrot Flatbread with Arugula, Apricots, Almonds & Minted Yogurt

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel, trim, and slice carrots into ¼-inch thick rounds. Place in a medium bowl along with maple syrup, oil, and salt; toss to coat.

Transfer carrots to a baking sheet pan and spread out in a single layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until fork-tender, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

While the carrots are roasting, arrange flatbreads on another baking sheet. Add to the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl along with yogurt and salt; stir to combine and set aside.
Peel and mince the garlic. Transfer to the reserved bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the garlic; add oil, maple syrup, salt, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Thinly slice apricots and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop almonds and set aside.
Once the carrots have cooled to room temperature, transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide minted yogurt between flatbreads and spread out in an even layer. Top each flatbread with carrot-arugula salad and slice into wedges.
To serve, divide flatbreads between plates. Sprinkle with almonds and drizzle with vinegar. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Cauliflower "Steaks" with Zesty Cashew Cream & Dressed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).

Boil water in a kettle. (If you do not have a kettle, boil water in a small saucepan, starting with hot water from the tap.) In a small heat-safe bowl, pour boiling water over cashews and set aside to soak.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a small bowl along with soy sauce, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and spices, then stir to combine the sauce.

Slice cauliflower lengthwise into 1-inch thick "steaks." Transfer steaks (and any loose florets) to the baking sheet, then drizzle with sauce. Using your hands, rub the sauce over both sides of the cauliflower and spread out in an even layer.
Place cauliflower in oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping halfway through, until fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
Drain cashews and place in a blender.
Zest and juice lime into the blender. Add water, nutritional yeast, flour, oil, and spices to the blender; purée on high until the cashew cream is smooth, 1-2 minutes.
When the cauliflower is almost done, add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide cauliflower and salad between plates. Drizzle cauliflower with cashew cream and enjoy!

name: Spicy Chicken, Cream Cheese & Spinach Skillet with Green Beans

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim green beans and transfer to a baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil, season with salt, and toss to combine. Spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until green beans are golden brown and fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces; season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, about 5 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
While the chicken cooks, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic.

Halve jalapeño lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
When the chicken is done, add garlic and jalapeño to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Add cream cheese, cream, and spices to the skillet; bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low, and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until melted and combined, 2-3 minutes more.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide green beans and chicken skillet between plates or bowls; sprinkle with crushed red pepper and enjoy!

name: Spicy Chicken Fingers with Ranch-Dressed Greens & Rosemary Potatoes

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl along with oil and spices.

Halve potatoes, add to the bowl with the garlic oil, and toss to combine. Spread out in a single layer on a baking sheet pan and place in the oven. Roast until potatoes are fork-tender, tossing halfway through, 20-25 minutes.
Slice the chicken breasts into ¾-inch strips. Place in the bowl used for the potatoes and season with chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper; toss to combine.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add bread crumbs to the bowl with the chicken and toss well to coat. Place on another baking sheet pan and drizzle with oil. Add to the oven, and bake until cooked through, turning once, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan and place in a clean medium bowl.
Add mayo, vinegar, oil, and spices to the bowl with the Parmesan; whisk to combine the dressing.
Chop or tear romaine leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide rosemary potatoes, chicken strips, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Chicken Parmesan with Sautéed Garlicky Kale

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the bowl with the kale and set aside.
Wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons. Place half in a small bowl. (Set remaining basil aside for serving.)
Add tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, and crushed red pepper to the bowl with the basil. Stir to combine the sauce and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken cutlets and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
While the cutlets are cooking, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate cheeses into another medium bowl and stir to combine.
When the cutlets are done, transfer to a baking dish. Pour tomato sauce over chicken and top with cheeses. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Place baking dish in the oven and broil until the sauce is warmed through and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Season with crushed red pepper and salt. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until the kale is tender, 1-2 minutes more.
Remove skillet from the heat, add vinegar, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide the chicken, sauce, and kale between plates. Top chicken with reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Chicken-Quinoa Soup with Mixed Vegetables, Cilantro & Avocado

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine water and quinoa; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until liquid is fully absorbed, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Meanwhile, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces; season with salt and pepper. When the veggies have softened, add chicken to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until almost cooked through, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add broth to the pan. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer over high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender, 10-12 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, medium dice tomato. Place in the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

Add the cooked quinoa, tomato, and half of the cilantro to the pan; stir to combine the soup. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until quinoa and tomato are warmed though, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Cut lime into wedges.
Divide the soup between bowls, then top with avocado and reserved cilantro. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Spicy Chicken & Scrambled Egg Wrap with Mango-Spinach Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince shallot and garlic; place both in a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the shallot and garlic, then add oil and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice and add to the bowl with the dressing. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add bell pepper, chicken, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, crack eggs into a small bowl and whisk until smooth.

When the chicken is done, pour eggs into the skillet. Scramble the eggs using a combination of stirring and folding, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are no longer runny; remove from heat.
While the eggs are cooking, add spinach to the bowl with the dressing and mango; toss to combine the salad.
Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide chicken-egg scramble between them; roll tightly to close.
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Spicy Chicken Stir-Fry with Noodles, Mushrooms, Bell Pepper & Broccoli

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Drain in a colander and rinse.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into thin strips. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and stir-fry until cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
While the chicken is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add veggies, salt, and pepper; stir-fry until veggies are fork-tender, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the veggies are cooking, place soy sauce, water, fish sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and cornstarch in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce.
When the veggies are done, add sauce to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 2-3 minutes more.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into thin pieces.
Once the sauce has thickened, add drained noodles, chicken, and green onions to the skillet. Toss to combine and continue to cook until warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Chicken Thighs with Spinach, Tomato, Coconut & Turmeric Rice

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, flipping once, until starting to brown, about 4 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer chicken to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and shallot.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water. Set aside to drain.
Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat. Add garlic and shallot; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add rice, coconut milk, water, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Once the  mixture is boiling, reduce heat to medium-low. Return chicken to the skillet, cover, and simmer until rice is tender and chicken is cooked through, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve tomatoes.
Wash and dry spinach. (Skip this step if it came pre-washed.)
When the chicken and rice are done, remove skillet from the heat; transfer chicken to a clean plate and set aside.
Stir handfuls of spinach into the coconut rice, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Gently stir tomatoes into the coconut rice.
To serve, divide the coconut-vegetable rice and chicken between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Chicken-Vegetable Soup with Zucchini Noodles & Parmesan

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Trim and small dice celery. Place in a small bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Add to the bowl with the celery.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl with the celery and carrot.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add celery, carrot, onion, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Season with spices.
When the veggies have started to soften, add chicken to the pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is almost cooked through, 3-4 minutes.

Add zucchini noodles, broth, and hot sauce to the pan. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a simmer over high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Chickpea Stew (Chana Masala) with Rice & Cilantro-Lime Raita

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel and mince garlic and ginger; place in a small bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the garlic and ginger; set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and small dice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander. Set aside to drain further.
Add garlic, ginger, jalapeño, and spices to the pan with the onion. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Add chickpeas, broth, and diced tomatoes to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until chickpeas are soft and stew has thickened, about 15 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the stew cooks, juice half the lime into the reserved bowl. Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with yogurt, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the raita.
When the stew is done, add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Divide rice and chickpea stew between bowls; serve with lime wedges and raita on the side. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Chili Chicken with Peanut Sauce, Roasted Bok Choy & Sesame Seeds

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and mince ginger. Place in a medium bowl, along with soy sauce, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade. (If coconut oil is solid, melt in a small saucepan over low heat.)

Trim and cut bok choy lengthwise into quarters. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with half of the marinade, and turn to coat. Spread bok choy out in an even layer. (Reserve remaining marinade for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until bok choy is tender and starting to brown, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels, add to the bowl with the reserved marinade, and turn to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken (shaking off any excess marinade) and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.

While the chicken is cooking, zest and juice lime into a small bowl. Add peanut butter, chili-garlic sauce, and salt, then whisk to combine the sauce. If needed, add water, 1 teaspoon at a time, to reach a drizzling consistency.
To serve, divide bok choy and chicken between plates or bowls. Drizzle with peanut sauce, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and enjoy!

name: Spicy Chili-Garlic Caramelized Pork Bowl with Carrots, Cucumber & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; place in a small bowl and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, ginger, chili-garlic sauce, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add pork to the skillet and cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until the pork begins to brown, 3-4 minutes.
Add sugar and fish sauce to the skillet with the pork, stir to combine, and continue to cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, halve lengthwise, and cut cucumber crosswise into thin half-moons.

Stir the pork, then continue to cook, undisturbed, until the sugar begins to caramelize and the pork becomes dark brown, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat and stir in half of the green onions (reserving the rest for garnish).
While the pork finishes cooking, peel and trim the carrot; using the peeler, run it along the carrot to make long, noodle-like strips. Roughly chop into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide rice between bowls. Top with pork, cucumbers, carrots, and remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Chili-Garlic Chicken & Broccoli Rice Bowl

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F and position rack in the center.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid for the rice comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Add to a medium bowl and sprinkle with cornstarch and salt; toss to coat. Add chicken to one half a baking sheet, then place in the oven and bake for 10 minutes.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Wash broccoli. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.

Remove the chicken from the oven and toss; add broccoli to the other half of the baking sheet. Drizzle broccoli with sesame oil and season with salt and pepper. Return tray to the oven until chicken and broccoli are cooked, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, add honey, chili-garlic sauce, vinegar, and sesame oil to the bowl with the garlic; whisk until well combined.
Wash the green onions, trim off and discard the ends; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
When the chicken is done add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide rice, chicken, and broccoli between bowls. Top with green onions and sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Spicy Curried Pork Burger & Tossed Salad with Honey-Lime Dressing

instructions.text: Place pork, bread crumbs, Worcestershire sauce, and spices in a medium bowl, then mix with your hands until well combined. Form the pork mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
While the burgers are cooking, place ketchup and crushed red pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spicy ketchup and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a clean medium bowl. Add oil, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel and trim carrot; using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the carrot into noodle-like strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Toast the buns if desired.
Spread spicy ketchup over the bottom half of each bun; top with burger patties and a small handful of salad. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Spicy Edamame Salad with Creamy Ginger-Peanut Dressing & Avocado

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add edamame and cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water. Set aside to drain further.
Meanwhile, peel and mince or grate ginger; transfer to a medium bowl.
Add peanut butter, water, soy sauce, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce to the bowl with the ginger; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and slice cucumber into thin rounds; add to the bowl with the dressing.

Quarter chili pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Thinly slice and add to the bowl. (Be careful, with chili peppers, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the bowl.
Cut romaine crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips; add to the bowl.
Add edamame to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Roughly chop peanuts.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, top with peanuts, and enjoy!

name: Spicy Fried Cauliflower Rice with Flank Steak, Zucchini & Green Onion

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels, place on a cutting board, and slice crosswise into thin strips. Place in a small bowl, add soy sauce, and stir to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak strips and cook, undisturbed, until browned, about 3 minutes. Turn and continue to cook until desired doneness, 1-2 minutes more. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet and cooking juices for later use.)

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Using your hands, gently squeeze to remove excess water, then add to the bowl with the cauliflower.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl.

Return the skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower, zucchini, green onion, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is soft and starting to brown, 5-6 minutes.

Meanwhile, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then mince. Place in a clean small bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the jalapeño, along with soy sauce, and stir to combine.

When the cauliflower is done, return steak strips (with any accumulated juices) to the skillet. Add the jalapeño mixture and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until warmed through and fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide fried cauliflower rice between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Ginger-Beef Meatball Soup with Spinach, Carrot & Cilantro

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a medium bowl. Add beef, egg, bread crumbs, chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper; using your hands, mix well to combine.
Using a scant ¼-cup measure, form the beef mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning often, until just browned on all sides, 4-5 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Once done, transfer to a clean plate. (Reserve pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons; peel and mince additional garlic. Place both in a clean medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and slice carrot crosswise into thin rounds; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Return saucepan to medium heat. Add onion, garlic, and carrot; cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Add meatballs (and any accumulated juices), broth, soy sauce, and vinegar to the pan; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until meatballs are cooked through, about 5 minutes.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, roughly chop spinach; place in the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the spinach.
When the meatballs are done, add spinach and cilantro to the soup in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls; drizzle with additional oil and chili-garlic sauce. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Ginger-Lime Chicken Thighs with Sweet Potatoes & Asparagus

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus; add to the baking sheet with the potatoes.
Drizzle oil over veggies and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake until vegetables are fork-tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
