Add chicken to the skillet; cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side. Once golden, transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

Return skillet to medium heat. Juice lime into the skillet. Add ginger, half of the cilantro (reserving the rest for garnish), oil, chili-garlic sauce, honey, and coriander. Stir to combine the sauce.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Return chicken to the skillet, along with any accumulated juices. Cover and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken and vegetables between plates. Sprinkle with reserved cilantro and enjoy!

name: Spicy Ginger-Soy Rice Bowl with Tofu, Mushrooms & Brussels Sprouts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and mince ginger. Place in a medium bowl along with soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, oil, and maple syrup. Whisk to combine the marinade. Transfer half of the marinade to a small bowl and set aside for serving.
Medium dice tofu, add to the medium bowl with the marinade, and gently stir to coat. Set aside. (Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels and reserve for the next step.)
Trim and thinly slice Brussels sprouts crosswise. Transfer to the reserved baking sheet.
Thinly slice mushrooms and add to the baking sheet with the Brussels sprouts.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the baking sheet.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt. Toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer on one half of the baking sheet.
Transfer tofu to the other side of the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Drizzle with any leftover marinade in the bowl.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and tofu is golden, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop cashews.
When the veggies and tofu are done, remove from the oven. Sprinkle cashews over veggies and toss to combine.
To serve, divide rice, tofu, and veggies between plates or bowls; drizzle with remaining marinade. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Grilled Chicken with Tomato-Cilantro Salsa & Mexican Corn Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Place hot sauce, oil, honey, and spices in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the marinade.
Add chicken to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, remove husks and silks from corn. Using your hands, snap each ear in half.
Once the pan is hot, add corn cobs and grill, rotating occasionally, until slightly charred, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a plate and allow to cool slightly. (Reserve pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into another medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime.
Peel and mince shallots. Add to the bowl, along with the spices, and stir to combine the lime dressing. Transfer half of the dressing to a third medium bowl, then set both bowls aside.
Return the grill pan to medium-high heat. Once the pan is hot, add chicken and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Once done, add to the plate with the corn.
Meanwhile, quarter tomatoes. Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add both to one of the bowls with the dressing, stir to combine the salsa, and set aside.
Working over the bowl with the remaining lime dressing, coarsely grate corn off of the cob, catching all of the kernels and juices in the bowl.
Add feta, yogurt, and mayo to the bowl with the corn. Stir to combine the corn salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide chicken, corn salad, and tomato salsa between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Grilled Tilapia with Arugula, Crunchy Corn Salsa, Yogurt & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Zest and juice lime into a small bowl.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Add oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice tomato and add to the bowl.
Place corn in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw; drain and add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse water chestnuts in the colander; chop into small pieces and add to the bowl. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat tilapia dry with paper towels and place on a plate; drizzle with oil and season with spices on both sides.
Once the grill pan is hot, add tilapia to the pan; grill until golden brown and cooked through, 2-4 minutes per side.
To serve, divide arugula and tilapia between plates or bowls. Top with corn salsa, feta, and a dollop of yogurt. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Spicy Honey Butter Shrimp with Sautéed Kale & Creamy Cheddar Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 6 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and milk; bring the mixture to a simmer over medium-high heat.
amounts: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese, transfer to a small bowl, and set aside.
Once the liquid comes to a simmer, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook until liquid is partially absorbed and the rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter, honey, and chili-garlic sauce; whisk to combine.
Add shrimp to the skillet and cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer shrimp and butter sauce to a medium bowl; cover with foil.
When the rice is tender, with some liquid remaining, add the cheese and stir to combine. Remove from the heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring often, until soft, 4-5 minutes.
To serve, divide rice, kale, and shrimp between bowls. Drizzle with honey butter and enjoy!

name: Spicy Honey Soy Pork Stir-Fry with Noodles, Broccoli Slaw & Carrots

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes (or prepare according to package instructions). Drain in a colander and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons and place in a small bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the jalapeño.
Juice lime into the bowl. Add water, soy sauce, honey, cornstarch, pepper, and salt, then whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch cubes. Season with salt and pepper.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
While the pork is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and slice carrot crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds.
Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add carrot and broccoli slaw; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.

Add drained noodles, pork, and stir-fry sauce to the skillet, then toss to combine. Continue to cook, tossing occasionally, until noodles are warmed through and sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Italian Sausage & Mixed Pepper Skillet with Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the sausages into 1-inch pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and pan-fry, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, seed and slice bell peppers into thin strips. Transfer to a medium bowl.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Thinly slice and add to the bowl with the bell peppers. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince garlic. Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half moons; add both to the bowl with the peppers.
When the sausages are done, remove to a plate.
Return the skillet to medium heat, add additional oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and browned, about 10 minutes.
Stir sausages into the skillet and continue to cook until heated through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and sausage-pepper skillet between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Italian-Style Sausage Bake with Peppers, Eggplant & Pine Nuts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim and medium dice eggplant. Add to the baking sheet with the bell pepper.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into thin strips; add to the baking sheet.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Add sausages to the baking sheet, nestling them into the veggies.

Place the baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring veggies and flipping sausages halfway through, until veggies are tender and sausages are nearly cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add pine nuts. Cook, stirring constantly, until golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside.
When the veggies and sausages are nearly done, change the oven to broil on high. Broil until veggies and sausages are browned, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Remove baking sheet from the oven, add half of the parsley and vinegar, then toss to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
To serve, divide sausages and veggies between plates. Top with toasted pine nuts and reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Spicy "Jalapeño Popper" Burger with Grilled Bell Pepper Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and place in a medium bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Coarsely grate cheese into the bowl with the jalapeño. Add ground beef and spices; mix with your hands until well combined. Form into 2 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, quarter, trim, and seed bell pepper. Place in another medium bowl, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with salt; toss to combine.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Once the grill pan is hot, add bell pepper and cook, turning occasionally, until charred and fork-tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in the bowl used for the peppers. Whisk to combine the dressing.
When the peppers are done, transfer to a cutting board to cool.
Place burger patties on the grill pan and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and grill an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Once the peppers are cool enough to handle, roughly chop and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Separate the lettuce leaves. Set aside 1 leaf per burger and chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces; add chopped lettuce to the bowl with the peppers and toss to combine the salad.
Slice tomato into rounds.
If desired, place buns, cut-side down, on the grill pan to toast, 1-2 minutes.
Place bottom half of a bun on each plate, spread with ketchup, then top with burgers, lettuce, and tomato slices. Close with the top half of the bun and serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Mapo Tofu with Ground Pork, Mushrooms, Spinach & Green Onion

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice the mushrooms and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ground pork and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until the pork begins to brown, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and dice tofu into ½-inch cubes; add to the skillet with the pork.
Peel and mince or grate ginger; peel and mince garlic.
Add ginger and garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds.
Add mushrooms, soy sauce, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring often, until the mushrooms begin to soften, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.
Trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add most of the green onions to the skillet (reserve a small amount for garnish).
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add the cornstarch slurry to the skillet in a steady stream while stirring quickly. Cook, stirring often, until the sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and tofu-pork mixture between bowls or plates. Garnish with reserved green onions and enjoy!

name: Spicy Mexican-Style Ground Beef Frittata with Pico de Gallo

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and mince onion; place half in a small bowl. Set remaining onion aside for later use.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the onion.
Small dice tomatoes and add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Juice lime into the bowl, then add salt and pepper. Stir to combine the pico de gallo and set aside.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add reserved onion, garlic, ground beef, and spices to the skillet. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the skillet and continue to cook until the pepper starts to soften, 2-3 minutes more.
While the bell pepper is cooking, place eggs, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine.

When the bell pepper is tender, reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate mozzarella.
Sprinkle mozzarella over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until top of the frittata is set and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes; remove from oven.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates; top with pico de gallo. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Mexican-Style Pasta Salad with Shrimp, Corn, Pepper & Cilantro

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, jalapeño, garlic, corn, and spices; cook, stirring frequently, until veggies are soft, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Add shrimp to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring often, until opaque, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the shrimp are cooking, juice lime into the reserved bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the lime juice, along with yogurt and mayo, then stir to combine the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
When the shrimp are done, add to the bowl along with the veggies and cooled pasta. Stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide the pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Orange Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes.
Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Set both aside in a small bowl.
Use a grater to zest the orange and transfer to the bowl with the garlic and ginger. Juice the orange into a separate small bowl.
Heat the oil in a small saucepan over medium-low heat. Once the oil is hot, add the garlic, ginger, orange zest, and chili-garlic sauce. Sauté until ingredients soften, 2-3 minutes.

Add orange juice, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and soy sauce to the saucepan. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer, uncovered and stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and reduces by half, about 10 minutes.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice the steak against the grain into ½-inch strips.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add the beef to the skillet and cook, without stirring, for 1 minute. Then turn the beef pieces over and cook, stirring occasionally, 2-3 minutes for medium-rare. Transfer beef to a plate and set aside.
Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets. Return the skillet to medium heat and add the broccoli. Stir-fry until tender-crisp, about 7 minutes.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Add the beef back into the skillet with the broccoli. Add green onions and orange sauce to the skillet and stir well.
To serve, divide the rice into bowls and top with the beef and veggie mixture. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Orange Tofu & Broccoli with Basmati Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash orange and grate ½ tbsp of zest into a small bowl, then juice orange into the same bowl. Add water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, chili-garlic sauce, and cornstarch to bowl and whisk together.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Drain tofu and pat dry with paper towels. Medium dice.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add tofu and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 7-9 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Peel and mince garlic.
Wash broccoli. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stem into smaller pieces.
Once tofu has been transferred, coat skillet with more oil. Add garlic and broccoli. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp and bright green, 3-4 minutes.
Return tofu to skillet and pour in sauce. Stir to coat until sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
Serve broccoli and tofu over top rice and enjoy!

name: Spicy Peanut Pork Stir-Fry with Bok Choy, Mango & Broccoli Slaw

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Add soy sauce, oil, and crushed red pepper to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the marinade.
Slice pork chops crosswise into ½-inch thick strips, add to the bowl with the marinade, toss to coat, and set aside.
While the pork marinates, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger; place in a small bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the ginger; add peanut butter, fish sauce, water, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the peanut sauce and set aside.
Place oil, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, and chili-garlic sauce in another medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork strips and marinade; stir-fry until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice bok choy crosswise into shred-like strips; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; large dice and add to the bowl.
Add broccoli slaw to the bowl and toss to combine.
When the pork is done, add peanut sauce, stir to combine, and cook until sauce is warmed through and pork is coated, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pork stir-fry and slaw between plates. Sprinkle pork with additional crushed red pepper and enjoy!

name: Spicy Peanut Tofu Bowl with Kale & Savory Sesame Rice

instructions.text: Cut the tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place side by side on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Peel and mince the garlic. In a medium bowl, combine garlic, sesame oil, soy sauce, and maple syrup to make a marinade for the tofu.

Once the liquid with the rice comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut the tofu planks in half and then cut each half into 4 triangles. Place tofu in the bowl with the marinade and gently toss until well coated. Set aside.
Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a salad bowl.
Wash, trim, and peel the carrot; coarsely grate and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash, peel, and mince or grate the ginger.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the tofu and the marinade.  Cook until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, prepare the peanut sauce by whisking together ginger, peanut butter, chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce, maple syrup, and hot water in a small bowl.

Once the tofu is cooked, transfer to a plate, returning the skillet to the heat. Add kale and water to the skillet and cover with a lid. Allow to steam for 1 minute covered then uncover, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute more.
Uncover the rice, fluff with a fork, and add sesame oil. Fold the oil into the rice.
To serve, divide rice between bowls, top with tofu, grated carrot, and kale; drizzle with peanut sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Spicy "Peri-Peri" Chicken with Sweet Potato, Pepper & Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Peel and small dice sweet potato; transfer both to a baking sheet pan.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in a single layer.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil and spices; whisk to combine the marinade.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add cutlets to the bowl with the marinade and turn to coat. Transfer cutlets to the baking sheet, nestling them in the veggies.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, flipping chicken halfway through, until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in another medium bowl.
Add yogurt, water, mayo, vinegar, and salt to the bowl with the parsley. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Roughly chop walnuts. Add mixed greens, walnuts, and cranberries to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken, veggies, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Peruvian Roast Chicken with Sweet Potatoes & Cilantro-Feta Salsa

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and slice sweet potatoes into ½-inch thick rounds. Place in a medium bowl, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat.
Arrange sweet potatoes on the baking sheet in a single layer. Place on the lower rack of the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest and juice half the lime into the bowl used for the sweet potatoes. Set remaining lime aside.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl along with oil, sugar, and spices. Stir to combine the spice paste.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels and add to the bowl with the spice paste; turn to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook on one side until golden brown and caramelized, 4-5 minutes. Flip and cook for 1 minute more, then remove from heat (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
Transfer the skillet to the upper rack of the oven and roast until chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice remaining lime into a small bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the lime juice. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Add to the bowl along with feta, oil, sugar, cumin, and salt. Stir to combine the salsa.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide sweet potatoes and chicken between plates. Spoon salsa over chicken and enjoy!

name: Spicy Pork & Eggplant Stir Fry

instructions.text: In a small bowl, create a slurry by whisking together water with cornstarch. Then add chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, and sesame oil and whisk together. Set aside.
Wash and dry the eggplant and green onions. Medium dice the eggplant; transfer to a bowl. Trim ends and cut the onions on an angle into ½ pieces; transfer to another bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Transfer both to a small bowl.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Thinly slice the pork chops into bite-sized strips and season with salt.
Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the pork and stir-fry until browned, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Once pork has been removed, add more oil to the skillet. Add the eggplant and stir-fry until lightly browned and softened, 4-5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet. Stir fry with the eggplant for 1-2 minutes.
Return pork to the skillet and add the green onions and sauce. Toss until the ingredients are well combined and sauce is thickened, about 1 minute.
Cut the lime into wedges for serving.
Serve stir fry in a bowl, squeeze lime juice over top, and enjoy!

name: Spicy Pork Pad Thai with Sugar Peas, Lime & Cilantro

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Then using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice noodles under cold, running water.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
When the skillet is hot, add pork and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until browned and crumbly, 4-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice half the lime into a small bowl. Add sauces and sugar; whisk to combine.
Peel and mince garlic.
Slice peas and green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Add garlic and vegetables to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until they begin to soften, about 3 minutes.
Push pork and veggies to the edge of the skillet and crack the egg in the center. Scramble until the egg is lightly set, then mix in with the pork and veggies.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add cilantro to the skillet, reserving some for garnish.
Add noodles and sauce to the skillet. Stir until coated and warmed through, 1-3 minutes.
Cut remaining lime into wedges.
To serve, divide Pad Thai between bowls and garnish with remaining cilantro and lime wedges.

name: Spicy Pork Rice Bowl with Pineapple-Broccoli Slaw & Lime Yogurt

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, zest and juice lime. Divide between a small and medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between the bowls.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the medium bowl with the lime and cilantro. (Set medium bowl aside for later use.)
Add yogurt and spices to the small bowl, then stir to combine the lime yogurt. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, pork, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the medium bowl, along with the broccoli slaw and salt, then toss to combine.
To serve, divide rice, pork, and slaw between bowls. Top with lime yogurt and enjoy!

name: Spicy Pork Sausage Soup with Rotini Pasta, Kale, Fennel & Garlic

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Cut fennel in half lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fennel and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and starting to brown, 3-4 minutes.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add sausage to the pan. Cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice garlic.
When the sausage is done, add garlic and crushed red pepper to the pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add broth, water, and pasta to the pan. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta is almost tender, 4-5 minutes more.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces.

When the pasta is almost done, add kale to the pan in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the kale and pasta are tender, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Juice lemon into the pan and stir to combine the soup.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and drizzle with oil. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Pork Tacos with Apple Salsa & Bell Pepper-Mixed Green Salad

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Juice half of the lime into a small bowl. (Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.)

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then mince. Add to the bowl with the lime juice. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Quarter, core, and small dice apples. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with salt and pepper. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add garlic, pork, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and cut bell pepper into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
When the pork is done, add hot sauce to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with spicy pork and apple salsa. Serve with salad on the side and lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Pork Tacos with Kiwi, Cucumber & Avocado Salsa

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, peel, and small dice kiwis; place in a small bowl.
Halve, pit, and scoop out the avocado flesh with a spoon; small dice and add to the bowl with the kiwi.
Trim and small dice cucumber; add to the bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl, then season with salt and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add jalapeño, pork, and spices; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates and fill with spicy pork. Top with salsa and enjoy!

name: Spicy "Relleños-Style" Sausage & Cheese Stuffed Peppers

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Place bell peppers in an ovenproof skillet and drizzle with oil. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and broil, flipping halfway through, until tender and skins are slightly charred, 3-4 minutes.
While the peppers cook, large dice tomato and place in a blender.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems and discard stems. Transfer leaves to the blender with the tomato.
Remove peppers from the oven, transfer to a plate, and set aside to cool. Set oven temperature to 425°F.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Add to the blender. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Juice lime into the blender.
Peel and roughly chop garlic and shallot. Add to the blender, along with oil, cumin, and salt; blend on high for several minutes until smooth. Set aside.
Preheat the skillet, used for the peppers, over medium-high heat.

Meanwhile, use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of each sausage. Peel off casings and discard. Add sausage to the skillet and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until browned and slightly crispy, 6-7 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Once the peppers are cool enough to handle, cut a 3-inch lengthwise opening in each pepper on one side, starting just below the stem. Use a spoon to scoop out the seeds.
Stuff peppers with cheese and sausage.

Pour blended sauce into the skillet. Transfer stuffed peppers, seam-side up, to the skillet with the sauce. Place in the oven and bake until peppers are warmed through and cheese is melted, 10-12 minutes.
To serve, divide sauce and peppers between plates. Top with yogurt and enjoy!

name: Spicy Roasted Potato Bowl with Bacon, Celery & Blue Cheese Dressing

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter new potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel, trim, and slice carrot crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Add to the baking sheet with the potato.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the baking sheet. (Set remaining green onions aside for serving.)
Trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper; add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with hot sauce and oil, then season with salt. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway, until veggies are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate.
While the bacon is cooking, using a clean cutting board, trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Set aside for serving.
Place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and spices in a small bowl; whisk dressing until smooth.
Add blue cheese to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide roasted veggies between bowls. Top with celery, reserved green onions, dressing, hot sauce, and crispy bacon. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Salmon Cakes with Yogurt & Crunchy Veggie-Cilantro Salad

ingredients.name: traditional style wild pink salmon
ingredients.display: 2 (7.5 oz) cans wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.text: Drain salmon, place in a medium bowl, and flake with a fork.
amounts: 2 (7.5 oz) cans wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.text: Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl with the salmon.
Add eggs, flour, and spices to the bowl; stir until well combined.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, using a ¼-cup measure, form the salmon mixture into ½-inch thick patties; place on a plate.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fritters and cook until golden brown and crispy, 3-4 minutes per side; transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.
While the patties are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into another medium bowl.
Add oil and spices to the bowl with the lime; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper into thin strips; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim cucumber, cut crosswise into 3-inch portions, then cut each portion lengthwise into thin sticks. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into the bowl. Gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salmon cakes and salad between plates; top salmon cakes with yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Salmon Tacos with Carrot-Radish Slaw & Yogurt Guacamole

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and cut radishes into matchsticks. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice half of the lime into the bowl. Add salt and pepper, then stir to combine the slaw. Set aside. (Reserve remaining lime for later use.)
Place oil, sugar, and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spice oil.

Pat salmon dry with paper towels, transfer to the baking sheet, and rub the top side with spice oil. Place salmon in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, juice remaining lime into the reserved bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl with the lime juice. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Add to the bowl, along with yogurt, salt, and pepper, then mash with a fork or potato masher until smooth. Set yogurt guacamole aside.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Flake salmon with a fork.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates, then fill with guacamole, slaw, and salmon. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Sausage, Kale, Fennel & Sweet Potato Hash with Fried Egg

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potato. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the sweet potato.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Using a slotted spoon, remove sausage to a plate; set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for the next step.)
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add veggies, salt, and crushed red pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden-brown and tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces.

When the veggies are done, add vinegar and cooked sausage to the skillet; stir to combine. Add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
Preheat another skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt.
To serve, divide hash between plates or bowls. Top with fried eggs and enjoy!

name: Spicy Sausage, Mushroom & Bell Pepper Quinoa Bowl with Wilted Spinach

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Thinly slice mushrooms and transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, slice the sausages crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to brown, about 4 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the sausage to a plate (the sausage will not be cooked all the way through).
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic; peel and medium dice onion. Add both to the bowl with the mushrooms.

Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat; add veggies and Italian seasoning. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms have softened, about 6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)

While the mushrooms are cooking, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and place in the reserved bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the jalapeño.
Add jalapeño, bell pepper, browned sausage, salt, and pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the bell pepper starts to soften and sausage is cooked through, about 4 minutes.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
To serve, divide quinoa, sausage, and veggies between bowls. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Seared Lamb Chops with Cucumbers, Peaches, Almonds & Yogurt

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, roughly chop almonds.
Once the skillet is hot, add the almonds; cook, stirring constantly, until lightly browned, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Place spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spice rub.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the lamb chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with the spice rub on both sides. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and sear, flipping once, until cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice half of the lemon into the reserved bowl. Cut remaining lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Meanwhile, pick parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems. Mince half of the leaves and add to the bowl with the lemon. Roughly chop remaining leaves and set aside for serving.
Add yogurt and salt to the bowl, then whisk to combine the lemony yogurt. Set aside.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl with the almonds.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice the flesh and add to the bowl. Season the salad with salt, then stir to combine.
Divide chops and lemony yogurt between plates. Top yogurt with the salad and reserved parsley, then drizzle with honey. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Spicy Sesame Soba Noodles with Kale, Green Onion & Soft-Boiled Eggs

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 4 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water heats up, wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Stack leaves on top of one another, then cut crosswise into thin (shred-like) ribbons.

Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, add kale, and stir. Cook until bright green and wilted, about 15 seconds. Transfer kale to a colander using a slotted spoon. (Reserve pot of water for the next step.)
Return water to a boil. Once the water is boiling, add noodles and cook according to package directions, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim green onions; cut crosswise into thin pieces and set aside.
Place tahini, water, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and oil in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
When the noodles are done, drain in the colander over the kale. Rinse thoroughly under cold water and set aside to drain further.
Peel and quarter the eggs.
Add noodles, kale, and half of the green onions to the bowl with the sauce; toss to combine. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
To serve, divide the noodles and kale between plates or bowls. Top with remaining green onions, sesame seeds, and eggs. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Sesame Tofu Lettuce Wraps with Fresh Peppers & Sugar Snap Peas

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Cut the tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Add both to a medium bowl.

Add tahini, maple syrup, chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce, and rice vinegar to the bowl with the garlic and whisk to combine. Thin the sauce out with 1-3 tsp of water, if needed, to reach a honey-like consistency.
Cut the tofu planks into ½-inch cubes.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add tofu to the skillet and cook, undisturbed, for 4 minutes. Once a golden brown crust forms, toss the tofu every minute for an additional 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Once tofu is golden brown on all sides, turn heat down to low and add sauce to the skillet. Stir until tofu is well coated, then remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes, allowing the tofu to soak up the sauce.
Seed the bell pepper and slice into thin strips.
Cut the snap peas crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Cut the lime into wedges.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates.
To serve, spoon the tofu onto lettuce stacks, then top with snap peas, peppers, green onions, and sesame seeds. Garnish with lime wedges and enjoy!

name: Spicy Shrimp Curry with Tomatoes, Spinach & Cilantro over Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Small dice tomatoes; place in a small bowl and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes.
While the onion cooks, peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Add ginger, garlic, sugar, and spices to the pan with the onion. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add tomatoes, coconut milk, and broth to the pan; stir to combine the curry and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 8 minutes.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the curry cooks, cut lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

Once the curry has thickened, add shrimp and half of the cilantro (reserving the rest for garnish) to the pan; stir to combine. Return to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the shrimp are cooked through, 3-4 minutes.
Add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful; stir to combine.
Divide rice and shrimp curry between bowls; sprinkle with reserved cilantro and serve with lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Sichuan-Style "Dan Dan" Zucchini Noodles with Pork & Peanuts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim zucchini; use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and roast, tossing halfway through, until zucchini is tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onion, garlic, pork, salt, and pepper. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and additional garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the bowl with the ginger and garlic. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Add tahini, water, soy sauce, vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and additional oil to the bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
When the pork is done, add cooked zucchini noodles and sauce to the skillet; stir to combine. Cook, stirring frequently, until sauce is warmed through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Roughly chop peanuts.
To serve, divide pork zucchini noodles between plates or bowls; top with reserved cilantro and peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Spinach Stew with Baked Eggs, Feta, Avocado & Sourdough

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the garlic.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop spinach. Add to the bowl.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl (reserving a small handful of cilantro for serving).
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 5-6 minutes.

Add broth and vinegar to the skillet; stir to combine the stew and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until stew is slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a stirring spoon, make a well in the stew for each egg; crack an egg into each well, sprinkle with feta, and season with pepper. Place the skillet in the oven and bake until egg whites are firm but yolks are still soft, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Meanwhile, toast bread if desired, then cut in half.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice lengthwise into thin pieces.
To serve, divide stew, eggs, and sourdough between plates or bowls. Top with yogurt, avocado, and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Steak, Bok Choy, Bell Pepper & Cilantro Stir-Fry with Peanuts

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and mince shallot; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the shallot and garlic; add soy sauce, peanut butter, chili-garlic sauce, and brown sugar. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Trim bok choy and cut crosswise into 1-inch strips; place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and halve bell pepper crosswise, then slice into thin strips; add to the bowl with the bok choy.
Trim and thinly slice mushrooms; add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels, then slice crosswise into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak strips and stir-fry until just cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Using tongs, transfer the steak to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for the next step.)
Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies to the skillet and stir-fry until fork-tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Roughly chop peanuts.

When the veggies are done, add sauce, steak (and any accumulated juices), and cilantro to the skillet; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and steak is warmed through, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide stir-fry and sauce between plates or bowls; top with peanuts and enjoy!

name: Spicy Steak Pizzaiola (Italian Braised Beef) with Mushrooms & Peppers

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side (it will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer to a plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Place in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the bell peppers.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl (reserving a small handful for serving).
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, basil, and spices; cook, stirring often, until the veggies have softened, 5-6 minutes.

Add tomatoes, broth, and tomato paste to the skillet; stir to combine the sauce. Bring to a simmer, then nestle steak into the sauce and cook, turning once, until sauce has thickened and steak is desired doneness, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Transfer the steak to a cutting board and thinly slice against the grain.
To serve, divide veggies and sauce between plates or bowls. Top with sliced steak, Parmesan, and reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Sweet Potato & Black Bean Burrito

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice onion. Small dice bell pepper.
Heat a large pot over medium heat. Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and bell pepper to the pot; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Peel and small dice sweet potato.
Add sweet potato and broth to the pot and bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer, 10 minutes, until potatoes are fork-tender.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Grate cheddar. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Once potatoes are tender, drain vegetables; return them to the pot and place on low heat.
Add beans, cheddar, cilantro, yogurt, and spices to the pot. Stir to combine and remove from the heat.
Lay tortillas on a flat surface. Divide vegetable mixture evenly and place in the middle of each tortilla. Fold in sides of tortilla and roll tightly.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Lay burritos seam side down and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Remove burritos from heat, cut in half, and enjoy!

name: Spicy Taco Beef Lettuce Wraps with Fajita Peppers, Onions & Avocado

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Place in a medium bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the beef and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the onion.
When the beef is done, add onion, bell pepper, and spices to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, 3-4 minutes more.
While the veggies are cooking, cut lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
When the veggies are soft, add water to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Fill each wrap with beef, veggies, and avocado. Serve with lime wedges and enjoy!

name: Spicy Tex-Mex Pasta Salad with Beans, Corn, Peppers, Tomato & Cheddar

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the lime juice, along with oil and spices, then stir to combine the dressing.
Medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl.
Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl.
Coarsely grate cheese. Add to the bowl, along with cooled pasta, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Thai Basil Chicken with Baby Spinach & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
In a medium bowl, combine the broth, soy sauce, fish sauce, and brown sugar. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Roughly chop the chicken thighs into ½-inch pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Peel and mince the garlic and shallot. Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeño with a spoon. Finely dice and set aside. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Heat a large skillet over high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add chicken and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, then add the garlic, shallot, and jalapeño. Continue cooking on high heat for 2-3 more minutes, stirring often.
Chop the baby spinach into small pieces.
Pour the sauce into the skillet. Cook on high, stirring often, until the sauce thickens and glazes the meat, 8-12 minutes. Remove from heat.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Reserve a few leaves for garnish.
Add the baby spinach (one handful at a time) and basil to the skillet and stir until wilted.
To serve, divide the rice and chicken between bowls. Garnish with reserved basil and enjoy!

name: Spicy Thai Beef Stir-Fry with Egg, Carrot, Bell Pepper & Basil

instructions.text: Place soy sauce, oil, fish sauce, cornstarch, and crushed red pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels, place on a cutting board, and slice crosswise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in another medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.

Thinly slice chili pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the bowl and set aside. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak (leaving excess marinade in bowl) and cook, undisturbed, until browned, about 3 minutes. Turn and continue to cook until desired doneness, 1-2 minutes more. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)

Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in a small bowl along with soy sauce, water, sugar, and vinegar. Stir to combine the stir-fry sauce and set aside.
Return the skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.

Juice lime into the skillet, then add the stir-fry sauce and steak (along with any accumulated juices). Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until steak is warmed through and sauce is thickened slightly, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel and halve eggs. Season with salt and crushed red pepper.
To serve, divide stir-fry and eggs between plates or bowls. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Spicy Thai Coconut Chicken Soup (Tom Kha Gai)

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion, ginger, garlic, and chili-garlic sauce to the pot. Cook, stirring frequently, until onion begins to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add broth, coconut milk, sugar, fish sauce, and salt to the pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to a simmer.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Thinly slice mushrooms.
Slice chicken crosswise into thin strips.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Add mushrooms and chicken to the pot and continue to simmer until chicken is cooked through, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a fresh cutting board, trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems.
When the soup is done, juice lime into the pot and stir to combine.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Top with green onions and cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Thai Coconut Pumpkin Soup

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

ingredients.name: pure pumpkin purée
ingredients.display: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion. Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic and press or mince.
Once the pot is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion and garlic to the pot.
Wash and peel the carrot, then trim off the ends. Using a box grater, coarsely grate the carrot and add to pot.
Wash the cilantro and shave the cilantro leaves off the stems. Chop the stems into small pieces and add to the pot. Mince the leaves and set half aside for garnish, add the rest to the pot.
Season mixture with salt and pepper. Cook until all vegetables have softened, 3-4 minutes.
Reduce heat to low. Wash, peel and mince or grate the ginger. Add to the pot.
Add pumpkin, honey and cayenne pepper, stirring to combine.
amounts: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.text: Shake can of coconut milk vigorously before opening. Add half the can to the soup and reserve a few tablespoons for garnish.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Add broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer stirring occasionally, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, melt butter and oil over medium heat in a small saucepan.
Peel and thinly slice the shallot into rings. Add to pan breaking it up as you go.

Turn heat up to medium-high. Cook until shallots are starting to darken around the edges, about 2 minutes. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook until golden brown and crispy, 2-3 minutes more. Watch carefully as they can burn easily.
Transfer shallots to a paper towel-lined plate and discard oil. Season with salt.
Using an immersion (hand) blender, purée the soup until smooth.
Wash and cut the lime into wedges.
To serve, ladle soup into bowls. Top with a swirl of coconut milk, crispy shallots, cilantro leaves and a squeeze of lime. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Thai Cod Lettuce Cups with Cucumber, Herbs, Peanuts & Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, juice lime into a medium bowl. Add fish sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat cod dry with paper towels, then season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cod and cook, turning once, until lightly browned and just cooked through, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, roughly chop peanuts. Place in a small bowl and set aside for serving.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
