When the cod is done, transfer to the cutting board and, using a fork, break the fish into bite-size pieces. Add to the bowl and gently stir to combine the filling.
Separate lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Divide cod filling between lettuce cups and top with peanuts. Serve with rice on the side and enjoy!

name: Spicy Thai-Inspired Meatball Salad with Kale, Peppers & Fresh Herbs

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide herbs between two medium bowls.

Add beef and spices to one of the bowls with the herbs (set the other bowl aside for the dressing); use your hands to combine the beef mixture. Using a scant tablespoon, form the mixture into mini meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; add to the second bowl with the herbs.
Juice lime into the bowl, then add oil, fish sauce, sugar, soy sauce, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.

Halve chili pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Thinly slice and add to the bowl. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim, seed, and halve bell pepper crosswise, then slice into thin strips; add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl and gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with meatballs and enjoy!

name: Spicy Tofu & Pepper Stir-Fry with Cilantro Rice

instructions.text: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the tofu in half horizontally to form two thin planks. Place the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place a baking sheet with something heavy (like a skillet) on top to press out excess water. Set aside.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove the seeds and membrane from the peppers and cut into strips; place them in a medium bowl.
Once the water for the rice is boiling, reduce the heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until the liquid is absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Remove from the heat and let the rice stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel and slice the onion into thin half moons; add to the bowl with the peppers.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, large dice the tofu (cut into ¾-inch cubes).
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the tofu, and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 5 minutes.
Combine soy sauce, water, maple syrup, and chili-garlic in a small bowl, whisk to combine.
When tofu is brown, add the soy mixture to the skillet along with the pepper and onions. Stir occasionally, until the vegetables begin to brown, about 5 minutes.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Roughly chop the cashews.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork; add cilantro to rice, reserving some for garnish.
Divide the rice between plates and top with the tofu and pepper mixture. Garnish with cilantro and cashews and enjoy!

name: Spicy Tofu Rice Bowl with Broccoli, Mushrooms & Soy-Tahini Dressing

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F and arrange rack in the upper third of the oven.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, oil, and maple syrup in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Medium dice tofu, add to the bowl with the marinade, and gently stir to coat. Set aside to marinate. (Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels and reserve for later use.)
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to the reserved baking sheet.
Quarter mushrooms and add to the baking sheet with the broccoli. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt. Toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer on one half of the baking sheet.
Transfer tofu to the other half of the baking sheet, spreading out in a single layer. Drizzle with any marinade left in the bowl. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and tofu is golden, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Set aside.
Place tahini, vinegar, maple syrup, soy sauce, and water in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
When the veggies and tofu are nearly done, change the oven to broil on high. Broil until veggies and tofu are golden brown, 2-3 minutes.
Remove baking sheet from the oven, add half of the green onions, and toss to combine. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
To serve, divide the rice, tofu, and veggies between plates or bowls. Drizzle with sauce and top with the remaining green onion. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Tomato-Rice Coconut Cream Soup with Zucchini, Beans & Cilantro

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the saucepan heats up, peel and small dice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, ginger, onion, chili-garlic sauce, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion begins to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Add broth, tomatoes, and coconut milk to the pan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Meanwhile, trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half rounds.
Drain and rinse beans.
Purée the soup with an immersion (hand) blender or regular blender. Return puréed soup to the pan and stir in zucchini, beans, and rice.
Bring soup to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Tuna Salad Lettuce Wraps with Avocado, Green Onions & Jalapeño

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Drain tuna, add to the bowl with the green onions, and flake with a fork.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Add mayo, chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce, oil, and salt to the bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.

Thinly slice jalapeño pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Season with salt.
Separate the lettuce into leaves.
To serve, pile lettuce leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with avocado and tuna salad. Top with reserved green onions and jalapeño. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Tuna Sushi Stack with Sticky Rice & Avocado

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Trim and discard the ends of the cucumber; halve the cucumber lengthwise, then cut in ½-inch cubes. Add to a bowl.
Cut the bell pepper into quarters lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membranes. Small dice the pepper. Add to a bowl with the cucumber.
Season vegetables with soy sauce and sesame oil. Add sesame seeds and stir to combine.
Halve and pit the avocado; cube the flesh into ½-inch cubes while still in the skin. Scoop out the flesh and set aside.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork. Add vinegar and salt and stir to combine. Spread out rice on a baking sheet to cool, about 5-10 minutes.
Drain tuna, add to a new bowl, and flake with a fork. Add chili-garlic sauce and mayo and stir to combine.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Using a 1 cup measure, fill up to the ⅓ mark with veggies and avocado, then to the ½ way mark with tuna, and finally the rest of the way with rice.

Once the stack is complete, flip the measuring cup onto a large plate. Tap on the bottom of the cup to loosen the stack. If the rice is sticking, run a knife around the edge before flipping. Serve immediately, 2-stacks per person. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Turkey Meatballs with Lime Yogurt & Green Bean Veggie Sauté

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of oil.

Place turkey, bread crumbs, hot sauce, oil, and spices in a medium bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into mini rounded meatballs. Transfer to the baking dish.
Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until golden and cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Trim and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and roughly chop water chestnuts. Add to the bowl along with corn.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; sauté until tender and starting to brown, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, juice lime into the reserved bowl. Add yogurt, water, garlic powder, and salt, then stir to combine the sauce.
To serve, divide meatballs and veggies between plates or bowls. Drizzle meatballs with sauce and enjoy!

name: Spicy Turkey Meatballs with Mashed Sweet Potatoes & Apple-Carrot Slaw

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger; transfer both to a medium bowl.
Trim and mince green onions; transfer half to the bowl with the garlic (set remaining green onions aside for the slaw).
Add ground turkey, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper to the bowl. Mix with your hands until well combined.

Using a scant ¼-cup measure, form the turkey mixture into meatballs and place in the baking dish. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until meatballs are cooked through, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and medium dice the sweet potatoes. Transfer to a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
Once the liquid in the saucepan is simmering, reduce heat to medium, cover, and cook until the potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, peel, and grate carrot; transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and coarsely grate apple; add to the bowl.
Add reserved green onions to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw.
When the potatoes are done, remove from heat, and drain in a colander. Return to the pan and add butter, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; mash with a potato masher until smooth.
To serve, divide sweet potato mash, meatballs, and slaw between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Turkey Meatballs with Peanut-Broccoli Slaw & Rice

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
In a medium bowl, combine the ground turkey, bread crumbs, egg, and spices; mix with your hands until well combined.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

Coat the bottom of a baking dish with oil. Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place in the dish. Place in the oven and bake until golden and cooked through 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic; wash, peel, and mince or grate the ginger. Place in another small saucepan.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and honey to the saucepan with the ginger and garlic; whisk to combine the sauce for the meatballs.
Bring the sauce to boil over medium-high heat, stirring frequently; reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, 2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Peel and mince garlic; add to a medium bowl along with water, peanut butter, vinegar, and soy sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Add broccoli slaw to bowl with dressing and toss to combine.
Remove meatballs from oven, drizzle with sauce, and toss to coat.
To serve, divide rice and peanut slaw between plates. Top rice with meatballs and sauce. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Spicy Turkey Rice Bowl with Butternut Squash, Radish & Lemon Sauce

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan; add water, salt, and pepper.
Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out seeds, and small dice the flesh. Add to the saucepan with the rice (do not stir). Bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, maple syrup, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the marinade.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice and squash until liquid is fully absorbed and squash is tender, about 18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice and squash are cooking, trim off and discard tops and root ends of radishes; thinly slice and add to the bowl with the marinade. Toss to coat and set aside.
Juice lemon into another small bowl; add yogurt and spices. Whisk to combine the lemon sauce and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ground turkey and cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise.
Add water and spices to the skillet with the turkey; continue to cook, stirring often, until sauce is reduced by half, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and squash between bowls; top with turkey, marinated radishes, and green onion. Drizzle with lemon sauce and enjoy!

name: Spicy Vietnamese Pork Noodle Bowls with Carrot, Cucumber & Radish

instructions.text: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger; transfer to a small bowl.

Quarter chili pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the garlic and ginger. (Be careful, with chilies, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Juice lime into the bowl with the garlic and ginger. Add vinegar, fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar; whisk to combine the dressing.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse under cold water.
Meanwhile, pat pork chops dry with paper towels. Place in a medium bowl and pour ⅓ of the dressing over the chops; turn to coat.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork chops and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Discard marinade.
Meanwhile, trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half-moons. Transfer to a plate.
Peel and coarsely grate carrot; transfer to the plate with the cucumber.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the plate.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the plate.
Thinly slice pork chops against the grain.
To serve, divide noodles, pork, and veggies between bowls. Drizzle with remaining dressing and enjoy!

name: Spicy Vietnamese-Style Pork Meatballs with Broccoli Slaw & Peanuts

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a small bowl. Add soy sauce, fish sauce, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, and cornstarch; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a medium bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add pork, egg, bread crumbs, fish sauce, and spices to the bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
Using a tablespoon measure, form the pork mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Transfer to a clean plate.
Separate the lettuce into leaves and roughly chop or tear into bite-size pieces; add to the plate with the cucumber.
Roughly chop peanuts.
When the meatballs are done, add sauce to the skillet and turn to coat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens slightly and coats meatballs, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cucumbers, lettuce, and broccoli slaw between bowls. Top with saucy meatballs and sprinkle with peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Spicy Vietnamese-Style Rice Bowl with Tofu, Peas, Radish & Cashews

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Juice lime and divide between two small bowls.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to one of the bowls with lime juice along with fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, add soy sauce, additional fish sauce, water, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, and cornstarch to the other bowl with the lime juice.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Crumble tofu into large pieces with your fingers and add to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is golden brown, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, thinly slice snap peas crosswise. Place on a plate.
Trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the plate with the snap peas.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the plate.
When the tofu is golden brown, reduce heat to medium, add sauce to the skillet, and gently stir to coat. Cook until sauce thickens slightly and coats tofu, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and large dice the flesh. Add to the plate.
Roughly chop cashews and add to the plate.
To serve, divide rice between bowls; top with tofu, snap peas, radish, avocado, mint, and cashews. Drizzle with dressing as desired and enjoy!

name: Spicy Vietnamese-Style Steak Salad with Carrots, Radishes & Cashews

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a small bowl.
Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the lime juice along with fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and trim carrots; run the peeler along each carrot to make long, noodle-like strips. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Chop or tear lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl.
Pick cilantro and mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add both to the bowl.
Roughly chop cashews. Add to the bowl, gently toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Divide salad and steak between plates or bowls. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: Spicy Vietnamese Wings with Cabbage, Pineapple, Mint & Cashew Slaw

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F.

Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and salt, then toss to coat. Drizzle with oil and toss once more to coat. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and shallot. Place both in a clean medium bowl.
Juice half of the lime into the bowl with the ginger and shallot (reserve remaining lime for later use).
Add soy sauce, sugar, fish sauce, vinegar, and salt to the bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.

Thinly slice chili pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.) Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl.
Shave mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop cashews. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw. Set aside.

Juice reserved lime into a small saucepan. Add soy sauce, water, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, fish sauce, and cornstarch to the pan. Cook over medium heat, whisking frequently, until sauce is slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes. Transfer sauce to another medium bowl and set aside.
When the wings are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and slaw between plates. Enjoy!

name: "Spinach & Artichoke Dip" Melts with Crunchy Mixed Veggie Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add both to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Once the water in the pan is boiling, uncover; add salt and spinach. Stir until wilted, 30-60 seconds, then drain in a colander and rinse with cold water to cool.
Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can, then transfer to a cutting board. Roughly chop spinach and place in a small bowl.
Drain and roughly chop artichokes; add to the bowl with the spinach along with mayo and spices.
Small dice cream cheese and add to the bowl with the spinach mixture; stir to combine the "dip" and set aside.
Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet pan and drizzle with oil. Place in the oven and broil until toasted, about 1 minute; remove from oven.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
Divide "dip" between toast slices and top with Parmesan. Return to the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.
To serve, divide melts and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spinach, Artichoke & White Bean Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Cut off the top ½-inch of each pepper; remove seeds, stems, and white membranes. Small dice remaining top portion of the peppers and set aside. Place the whole peppers on a baking sheet pan and rub with oil.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add diced peppers, onion, garlic, and salt to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and roughly chop artichokes.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Finely grate Parmesan.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add artichokes, Parmesan, beans, and yogurt to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Fill peppers with equal portions of the bean mixture.
Grate mozzarella and sprinkle over the peppers. Place in the oven and bake until peppers are tender and cheese is melted, about 15 minutes.
To serve, divide peppers between plates and enjoy!

name: Spinach-Bean Salad a la "Puttanesca" with Tomatoes, Olives & Anchovies

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Transfer tomatoes to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with spices; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring tomatoes halfway through, until they start to burst, 13-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Mince anchovy fillets. Add to the bowl along with additional oil and salt. Stir to combine the dressing.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl along with the feta. Set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: When the tomatoes are done, remove from oven and let cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Transfer cooled tomatoes to the bowl along with the spinach. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide white bean-tomato salad between plates or bowls; top with pine nuts. Enjoy!

name: Spinach, Carrot & Rice Noodle Soup with Crispy Tofu

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and trim carrots, then slice crosswise into thin rounds. Place in a small bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tofu. Place in a medium bowl, sprinkle with salt and cornstarch, then gently toss to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and pan-fry, turning occasionally, until browned and crispy, 5-7 minutes. Return crispy tofu to the bowl.
Meanwhile, preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add additional oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add broth to the pan and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the broth is boiling, add carrots, noodles, and soy sauce; stir to combine the soup. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and continue to cook until noodles are tender, 8-10 minutes more.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into thin pieces; add to the soup and stir to combine.
Add spinach to the soup in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Top with crispy tofu and enjoy!

name: Spinach & Chicken Quesadilla with Tomato & Green Onion Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the chicken to the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is lightly browned and cooked through, 4 to 6 minutes.
Wash and dry the cutting board and knife.
Coarsely grate 1 cup of mozzarella.
Add the spinach to the chicken and toss until the spinach is wilted, 1 to 2 minutes. Then, remove the skillet from the heat.
Add olive oil to a nonstick skillet and heat over medium heat.
Place the tortillas on a flat work surface and cover half of each tortilla with cheese, chicken and spinach mixture, and more cheese on top. Fold each tortilla in half and press down to close.

Place both quesadillas in the nonstick skillet, straight edges next to each other. Cook until golden brown on both sides and the cheese is melted, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer each quesadilla to a cutting board and cut into 4 wedges.
Halve the grape tomatoes and transfer to a medium salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle and add to the salad bowl.
Drizzle the salad with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the yogurt in a small bowl.
To serve, place a quesadilla on a plate and serve with the salad and yogurt dip on the side. Enjoy!

name: "Spinach Dip" Flatbread with Artichokes, Sun-Dried Tomatoes & Basil

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the basil along with cottage cheese and spices. Set aside.
Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
Once the water in the pan is boiling, uncover, then add salt and spinach. Stir until wilted, 30-60 seconds, then drain in a colander and rinse with cold water to cool.

Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can, then transfer to a cutting board. Roughly chop spinach and add to the bowl with the cottage cheese mixture. Stir to combine the spinach dip and set aside.
Peel and mince shallot. Place on a plate.
Drain and thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes and artichoke hearts. Add both to the plate with the shallot.
Coarsely grate cheese.
Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Spread with spinach dip, then top with cheese, sun-dried tomatoes, artichoke hearts, and shallots.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until flatbreads are lightly crispy and cheese is melted, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, cut flatbreads into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Spinach-Egg Tacos with Mexican Pickled Veggies (Escabeche) & Avocado

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ½-inch wide strips. Place in a small bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Cut lengthwise into ½-inch wide strips and add to the bowl with the onion. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, trim, and slice carrot crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds; add to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and thinly slice garlic. Transfer to a small saucepan and set aside.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, jalapeño, carrot, and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring often, until veggies are crisp-tender, about 3 minutes. Return veggies to the bowl, reserving the skillet for later use.
While the veggies are cooking, add vinegar, water, sugar, and salt to the saucepan with the garlic; stir to combine. Bring the pickling liquid to a boil over high heat.
Pour the pickling liquid into the bowl over the cooked veggies. Stir to combine and set aside to cool.
Coarsely grate cheese and place in a medium bowl. Add eggs and spices, then whisk until combined.
Roughly chop the spinach leaves and add to the bowl with the egg; stir to combine.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Pour egg mixture into the skillet; scramble the eggs using a combination of stirring and folding, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until eggs are no longer runny, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the eggs are cooking, warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional), 15-30 seconds.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates and fill with spinach-scrambled eggs. Top with pickled veggies and avocado. Enjoy!

name: Spinach, Mushroom & Feta Frittata with Grape Tomatoes

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Slice the mushrooms; transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and small dice the onion; transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Preheat the oven to the broil setting.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the diced onion and cook, stirring frequently, until translucent, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add more olive oil and the mushrooms to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms are tender, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the mushrooms cook, in a large bowl, combine and whisk together the eggs, water, salt, and black pepper.
Add the spinach (a handful at a time) to the skillet and stir until wilted, 1 to 2 minutes.
Pour the egg mixture over top the vegetables and sprinkle with the feta cheese.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: While tilting the skillet with one hand, lift up the edges of the frittata with a spatula and let the eggs run underneath during the first few minutes of cooking. Cook until most of the frittata is set, but the top is still runny, 4 to 5 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and broil until the top is set and lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes.
Separate the frittata into wedges and divide between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container). Serve with the grape tomatoes on the side. Enjoy!

name: Spinach-Pea Soup with Bacon, Mint, Bread Crumbs & Pumpkin Seeds

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and pumpkin seeds; toast, stirring frequently, until bread crumbs are golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside. (Reserve pan for later use.)
Medium dice bacon.
Return pan to medium-high heat. Add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes.

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces.
When the bacon is done, add leek, salt, and pepper to the pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add broth, milk, and peas to the pan; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until peas are tender, 6-8 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.

When the peas are tender, add mint and spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the greens to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until spinach is very tender, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat, add vinegar, and stir to combine.
Using a hand blender, purée the soup until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pan.)
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and pumpkin seeds. Enjoy!

name: Spinach & Ricotta Stuffed Zucchini Boats with Blistered Tomato Toasts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean-up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise. Scrape out the soft flesh from the middle of each half, place in a medium bowl, and set aside for later use.
Arrange zucchini halves, cut-side up, on one half of the baking sheet; drizzle with oil and season with spices.

Add grape tomatoes to the other half of the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil, then season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer. Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until zucchini are starting to soften, 5-7 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, roughly chop reserved zucchini flesh and return to the bowl.
Roughly chop spinach. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and garlic to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
When the veggies are done, add ricotta, half of the Parmesan, salt, and pepper to the pan. Stir to combine the filling. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for the next step.)

When the zucchini boats have started to soften, divide filling between them, then top with reserved Parmesan. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to bake until zucchini is tender, cheese is bubbly, and tomatoes have started to burst, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the zucchini boats are done, change oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)

Arrange bread on another baking sheet. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes. Remove from oven and cut toast in half. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
To serve, divide zucchini boats and toast between plates. Top toast with blistered tomatoes and enjoy!

name: Spinach Salad with Chicken, Blueberry, Plum, Pistachio & Goat Cheese

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Zest lime into a medium bowl. Juice half of the lime into the bowl with the lime zest, then add oil and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade. (Reserve remaining lime for later use.)

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Add to the bowl with the marinade and turn to coat. Set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: While the chicken is marinating, juice remaining lime into another medium bowl. Add oil, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to coat.
Halve plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into ¼-inch thick slices and add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add chicken (leaving any excess marinade in the bowl) and grill, flipping once, until cooked through and golden, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a cutting board.
When the chicken is almost done, crumble goat cheese into the bowl with the dressing, then add spinach and blueberries. Toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with chicken. Enjoy!

name: Spinach Salad with Chicken, Olives, Feta, Walnuts & Pickled Onions

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, roughly chop walnuts.
Once the skillet is hot, add walnuts and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in another small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken cutlets and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.

Meanwhile, wash, dry, and, using a clean cutting board, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve olives lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Add to the bowl along with cooled walnuts, feta, and pickled onion. Gently toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with chicken. Enjoy!

name: Spinach Salad with Veggie Sausage, Lentils & Lemon-Dijon Dressing

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water and place in a small saucepan; add broth and bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook lentils until tender, about 15 minutes; drain and rinse with cold water (from the tap) to cool. Set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Place sausages on the pan and cook, turning occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions).
When the sausages are done, transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into thin rounds.
Add lentils, sausage, and spinach to the bowl with the dressing and veggies; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Spinach, Shrimp & Avocado Salad with Zesty Lemon Vinaigrette

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place in a medium bowl, cover with water, and set aside to defrost. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. Halve the tomatoes. Halve and pit the avocado; thinly slice the flesh crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Peel and mince the garlic.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain the shrimp in a colander and run under cold water to melt any remaining ice chunks. Place on a clean towel (or paper towels) and pat dry.
Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add the shrimp and cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side.
In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together lemon juice, olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper.
To serve, arrange a bed of spinach on a plate, top with the tomatoes, avocado and shrimp, and drizzle with the dressing. Enjoy!

name: Spinach & Tomato Frittata with Fresh Mozzarella

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry spinach and tomato. Slice the tomato into rounds. Peel and mince garlic.
Thinly slice mozzarella.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, water, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic and spinach. Cook until spinach begins to wilt, 1-2 minutes.
amounts: about 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Pour in egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 8-10 minutes.
Add tomato and mozzarella.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and place on a plate. Enjoy!

name: Steak with Arugula, Caramelized Onions & Balsamic Mushrooms

instructions.text: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add onions and, stirring frequently, cook until softened and starting to brown, about 10 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and slice mushrooms.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Place steak in the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Add mushrooms to pan with onion. Season with salt and pepper. Stirring occasionally, cook until tender, 5-6 minutes.
Wash and dry arugula.
Add vinegar to onion and mushrooms. Scrape up browned bits from the bottom of the pan and stir until liquid thickens, 2-3 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, arrange a bed of arugula on a plate, add onion and mushrooms, and top with steak slices. Enjoy!

name: Steak with Asparagus & Balsamic Tomatoes

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, add salt, and bring to a boil.
Wash asparagus and snap off woody ends. Add to boiling water and cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes. Drain in a colander.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and halve tomatoes. Peel and mince garlic.
Season steak with salt and pepper.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and cover with foil.
Once steak has been transferred, lower heat to medium. Add garlic and tomatoes to skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper to tomatoes. Stir and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
To serve, arrange asparagus on a plate and top with tomato mixture. Add steak on the side and enjoy!

name: Steak, Asparagus & Bell Pepper Stir Fry

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: In a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with arrowroot until smooth. Add coconut aminos, sesame oil, and red pepper; whisk together. Set aside.

Wash the fresh produce. Snap (or cut) off woody ends from the asparagus, then cut on an angle into 2 inch pieces; transfer to a large bowl. Seed and cut the bell pepper into 2 inch strips; add to the bowl with asparagus. Trim green onion ends and chop on an angle; transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Peel and mince the garlic. Transfer both to a small bowl.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice the steak into thin strips.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the steak strips and cook until browned, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.

Once steak has been transferred, add more oil to the skillet. Add the asparagus, bell pepper, ginger, and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until vegetables are crisp-tender and lightly browned, 2-3 minutes.
Return beef to the skillet and add green onions and sauce. Cook until sauce is slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, place stir fry in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Steak, Asparagus & Strawberry Salad with Balsamic-Poppy Seed Dressing

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)

Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus; cut into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until asparagus is tender-crisp, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and season with spices on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, sugar, poppy seeds, Dijon, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and slice strawberries crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim off and discard tops and root ends of radishes; thinly slice and add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl.
Add roasted asparagus and mixed greens to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad between plates. Top with steak and enjoy!

name: Steak with Balsamic Reduction & Garlic Zucchini Sauté

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic. Wash and dry zucchini and parsley. Trim zucchini ends; halve lengthwise and slice into half rounds. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic and crushed red pepper and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add zucchini, salt, and pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until tender and lightly browned, 5-6 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and stir in parsley.
Return skillet to stove and add more oil. Season steak with salt and pepper and place in skillet. Cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Discard any fat from skillet, return to stove, and reduce heat to medium-low. Add vinegar, salt, and pepper. Cook until reduced by about ½, 2-3 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain. Add any accumulated juices to skillet and stir to combine.
To serve, place steak and zucchini on a plate and drizzle with balsamic reduction. Enjoy!

name: Steak & Balsamic Strawberry Salad with Spinach & Goat Cheese

instructions.text: Wash, cut off stem ends, and medium dice strawberries. Wash and dry basil; pick leaves off the stems and mince.
In a medium bowl, mix together strawberries, basil, olive oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Roughly chop almonds.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Place steak on grill/skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Wash and dry spinach.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, arrange a bed of spinach on a plate and top with steak slices and strawberries. Sprinkle almonds and crumble goat cheese over top. Enjoy!

name: Steak, Bell Pepper & Apricot Skewers with Creamy Cucumber-Mint Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Place yogurt, oil, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the marinade.
Cut steak into 1-inch cubes, add to the bowl with the marinade along with the apricots and stir to coat; set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and, using a clean cutting board, mince the leaves. Place half in a small bowl (reserving the rest for garnish).
Add yogurt, oil, and salt to the bowl with the mint and whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, halve, and slice cucumber crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
Peel, halve, and cut onion into 1½-inch wide pieces. Trim, seed, and cut bell pepper into 1½-inch pieces. Add both to the bowl with the steak and apricots; stir to coat.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

While the grill pan heats up, thread steak, apricots, onion, and bell pepper onto skewers, alternating ingredients; place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the steak, apricots, and veggies directly on the grill pan.)
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; add the skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until the steak is cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
To serve, divide skewers and salad between plates; sprinkle with reserved mint and enjoy!

name: Steak with Black Pepper-Dijon Sauce, Roasted Asparagus & Carrots

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the asparagus. Snap or cut off woody ends, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Wash, dry, peel, and slice carrot into thin rounds. Add to the baking sheet with the asparagus.
Peel and mince garlic and shallot; sprinkle both over the veggies. Drizzle with oil, season with salt, and toss to combine.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast veggies, tossing once, until fork-tender, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with foil.

Return skillet to medium-high heat; add cream, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer. Cook until heated through and slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Meanwhile, thinly slice steak into strips.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates. Top steak with sauce and enjoy!

name: Steak with Blistered Tomatoes, Roasted Garlic, Lemony Yogurt & Parsley

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place tomatoes and whole (unpeeled) garlic cloves on a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then sprinkle with sugar and spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring tomatoes halfway through, until they start to burst, 13-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a clean plate and set aside to rest.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a small bowl; add yogurt and salt. Whisk to combine the lemony yogurt and set aside.
Once the tomatoes have begun to burst, change the oven to broil on high. Broil until tomatoes are lightly charred, about 3 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the tomatoes are done, carefully transfer roasted garlic to the cutting board. Using the back of a spoon, press on the cloves to remove the skins. Return garlic to the baking sheet.

Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and chop the leaves. Add half of the parsley to the baking sheet with the tomatoes and garlic; toss to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and lemony yogurt between plates. Top yogurt with roasted tomatoes, garlic, and reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Steak Bowl with Roasted Sweet Potato, Spinach, Fried Egg & Ketchup

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, peel, and medium dice sweet potato. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potato is fork-tender, 15-20 minutes.
When the sweet potatoes have about 10 minutes left, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and stir-fry until almost cooked through, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry spinach (skip if it came pre-washed).

When the steak is almost done, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Transfer steak and spinach to a plate; cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Wipe skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt.
To serve, divide potatoes, steak, spinach, and eggs between plates or bowls. Drizzle with ketchup and enjoy!

name: Steak Burrito Bowl with Cilantro-Lime Rice & Pico de Gallo

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Quarter the grape tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl (that will be used for the salsa).
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the salsa bowl.

Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; thinly slice one half of the onion and transfer to a medium bowl, then small dice (cut into ¼-inch pieces) the other half and add to the salsa bowl.
Juice the lime into a small bowl; add about ½ of the juice to the salsa bowl and save the rest for the rice.

Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add about ½ of the cilantro to the salsa bowl and add the rest to the bowl with the remaining lime juice.
Season the salsa with salt; stir to combine and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.

While the steak cooks, quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Cut the quarters lengthwise into ¼-inch-thick strips and add to the medium bowl with the onion.

Once the steak has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet followed by the onion and bell pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables are browned and softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork. Add the remaining lime juice and cilantro to the rice and stir to combine.
To serve, arrange the rice, veggie mixture, steak slices, and salsa in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Steak Coconut Curry with Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Cilantro & Lime

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Place spices in a medium bowl and stir to combine.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and thinly slice across the grain. Add to the bowl with the spices and toss to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and pan-fry until almost cooked through, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the ginger.
Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Add coconut milk and stir to combine the curry. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 4-5 minutes more.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Meanwhile, cut lime into wedges. Set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the curry has thickened, return steak to the skillet, along with half of the cilantro, and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until steak is warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Divide steak curry between plates or bowls and top with remaining cilantro. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Steak Fajita Cauliflower Rice Bowl with Avocado & Cilantro

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice half of the lime into a medium bowl. Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
Add oil, soy sauce, and spices to the bowl with the lime juice. Stir to combine the spice paste and set aside.

Pat steak dry with paper towels and place in the center of a baking sheet pan; drizzle with half of the spice paste, turning the steak to coat on both sides (reserve remaining spice paste for the veggies).
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the remaining spice paste.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl, then toss veggies in the spice paste to coat.
Add veggies to the baking sheet, arranging them in an even layer around the steak.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring veggies and flipping steak halfway through, until veggies are tender and steak is cooked to desired doneness, 13-15 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower and salt; cook, stirring often, until cauliflower is lightly golden and cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.

While the cauliflower rice is cooking, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the cauliflower rice and stir to combine. (Set remaining cilantro aside for serving.)
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Set aside.
Transfer steak to the cutting board and thinly slice against the grain.
Divide cauliflower rice, steak, veggies, and avocado between bowls; sprinkle with reserved cilantro. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Steak "Fried Cauliflower Rice" with Eggs, Carrots, Peas & Green Onions

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Place soy sauce, vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and maple syrup in a small bowl; whisk to combine the marinade.
Thinly slice steak against the grain into strips and transfer to the bowl with the marinade; toss to coat and set aside to marinate.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, in another small bowl, whisk together the eggs and salt.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Pour eggs into the skillet; scramble using a combination of stirring and folding. Cook until eggs are no longer runny, 1-2 minutes. Transfer eggs to a plate and set aside.

Return skillet to medium-high heat; add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak strips and marinade to the skillet; stir-fry until just cooked through, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to the plate with the scrambled eggs.
While the steak is cooking, place peas and corn in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.

Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower and place in a medium bowl. Set aside.
Peel and small dice carrot.

Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat; add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the carrot and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 2 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and ginger.
Add cauliflower, garlic, ginger, and salt to the skillet with the carrot; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower begins to soften, about 3 minutes.
While the cauliflower is cooking, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.

Add peas, corn, green onion, scrambled eggs, steak, and any accumulated juices to the skillet; stir to combine and continue to cook until fragrant and heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide fried cauliflower rice between bowls. Drizzle with additional oil and soy sauce, then sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Steak Kabobs with Mediterranean Spice Rub & Cauliflower Tabouli Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, place 4 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp-tender, 4-5 minutes. Transfer cauliflower to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer to cool.
Meanwhile, combine spices in a medium bowl; stir to combine.
Cut the steak into 1½-inch cubes; transfer to the bowl with the spices and toss to coat; set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Thread steak onto the skewers and place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the steak pieces directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.
Coat the grill or skillet with oil; place kabobs on the grill, rotating every 2½ minutes, until browned and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Meanwhile, grate the zest from the lemon and transfer to a medium bowl, then juice the lemon into the same bowl. Add the cauliflower and stir to combine.
Peel and mince garlic. Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Transfer both to the bowl with the cauliflower.
Peel and small dice the cucumber. Small dice the tomatoes; add both to the bowl with the cauliflower.

Shave parsley leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add herbs, oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the cauliflower and stir to combine the tabouli salad.
To serve, divide tabouli between plates or bowls. Place steak kabobs on top and enjoy!

name: Steak & Kale Caesar Salad with Creamy Parmesan Dressing

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the kale leaves and lemon.
One kale leaf at a time, cut along the sides of the tough center ribs, then pull out and discard the ribs. When all the leaves are trimmed, chop them into 1-inch pieces and transfer to a large bowl.
Cut the lemon in half; juice one half into a small bowl (that is big enough for making the dressing) and cut the other half into wedges for serving.
Finely grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add ½ of the grated Parmesan (save the rest for garnishing), the minced garlic, yogurt, Dijon, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice; whisk together until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the kale and toss to combine. If the kale is tough, massage it with your hands to soften it.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the bun or roll into ¾-inch cubes.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add the bread cubes to the skillet; sprinkle with salt and toss to coat in the oil, then arrange in a single layer. Toast the bread, tossing occasionally, until the bread cubes are golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the croutons to a bowl and return the skillet to the stove.
Wipe out the skillet with a paper towel and heat over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat dry the steak with paper towels and season it generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak for 4 to 6 minutes for medium-rare, or until desired doneness. (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
Slice the steak against the grain into thin strips.
To serve, arrange a bed of the kale on a plate and top with the croutons, remaining Parmesan, and steak slices. Garnish with lemon wedges for squeezing over the top.

name: Steak with Mashed Turnip, Potato & Carrot Medley

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash turnip, potatoes, and carrots. Peel, large dice, and add to saucepan. Once boiling, cook until vegetables are tender, 10-12 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry basil. Pick leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.

Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Season steak with salt and pepper on both sides. Place in the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Drain vegetables and return back to saucepan. Add broth, oil, ½ of the basil (save the rest for garnishing), salt, and pepper. Mash until smooth.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, place mash on a plate, add steak slices, and sprinkle with remaining basil. Enjoy!

name: Steak & Mushroom Stir Fry with Cauliflower Rice

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Peel and mince or grate ginger. In a medium bowl, prepare marinade by whisking together the minced ginger, water, coconut aminos, vinegar, arrowroot, and pepper.
Thinly slice steak and place in marinade; toss to coat and set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and remove leaves from cauliflower. Using a food processor or grater, grate to rice-like texture.
