Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Add oil to skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add cauliflower and cook, stirring frequently, until warmed through and slightly tender, 5-6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to a bowl and cover with foil to keep warm.
Wash mushrooms and green onions. Thinly slice mushrooms. Trim ends and thinly slice onions on the diagonal. Peel and mince garlic.

Once cauliflower rice has been transferred, add more oil to skillet. Remove steak slices from marinade, reserving the marinade in the bowl, and add to skillet. Cook until browned, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Add garlic, mushrooms, ½ of the green onions (save the rest for garnishing), and reserved marinade to skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until mushrooms are tender and sauce has thickened.
Wash and dry spinach.
Return steak and add spinach to skillet. Stir until spinach is wilted and ingredients are well combined.
Serve stir fry over cauliflower rice and garnish with remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: "Steak & Potatoes" Romaine Salad with Creamy Dijon Dressing

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Halve new potatoes lengthwise, then cut each half into ¼-inch thick wedges. Place in a medium bowl, add oil and spices, then stir to coat. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until potatoes are golden and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in the reserved bowl along with oil, mayo, Dijon, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
When the potatoes are almost done, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad and roasted potatoes between plates or bowls. Top salad with steak and enjoy!

name: Steak & Rice Noodle Stir-Fry with Zucchini, Bell Pepper & Green Onion

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Drain in a colander and rinse.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into thin strips. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and stir-fry until cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer steak to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; stir-fry until veggies are fork-tender, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the veggies are cooking, place soy sauce, water, fish sauce, and additional cornstarch in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine.
When the veggies are done, add sauce to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into thin pieces.
Once the sauce has thickened, add noodles, steak, and green onions to the skillet. Toss to coat and continue to cook until warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Steak, Roasted Carrots & Red Onion with Chimichurri Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Peel and cut onion into 8 wedges. Transfer to a sheet pan. Wash and peel carrots. Slice into thirds crosswise, then halve or quarter lengthwise. Add to sheet.
Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Arrange in a single layer and place in the oven. Roast, tossing once halfway through, until carrots are tender, 15-20 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Season steak with salt and pepper. Add to skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
In a small bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together parsley, garlic, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
To serve, place steak, carrots, and onion on a plate and drizzle with chimichurri sauce. Enjoy!

name: Steak with Roasted New Potatoes & Sugar Snap Peas

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F and place the rack in the centre position.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Quarter the potatoes and transfer to a baking sheet.
Drizzle the potatoes with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat then spread out in a single layer.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the potatoes in the oven and roast, tossing halfway through cooking time, until they are tender and browned, 20 to 25 minutes.
Halve the snap peas and transfer to a bowl. Add to the baking sheet with the potatoes halfway through cooking time.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
To serve, divide the steak and roasted vegetables between plates. Enjoy!

name: Steak with Roasted Parsnips, Cauliflower & Caper-Anchovy Salsa Verde

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel, trim, and medium dice parsnips. Add to the baking sheet with the cauliflower. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until the veggies are golden and fork-tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Mince anchovy fillet. Add to the bowl with the parsley.
Mince capers. Add to the bowl along with oil, vinegar, and pepper. Stir to combine the salsa verde and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates; top steak with salsa verde. Enjoy!

name: Steak Salad with Celery, Tomatoes, Blue Cheese & Garlic-Chive Crostini

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic. Trim and chop chives into small pieces.
Place half of the garlic and half of the chives in a small bowl (reserving the rest for the next step); add oil, salt, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the garlic-chive oil and set aside.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add remaining garlic and chives, oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak to the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and let rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high; position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Halve tomatoes. Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise; add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Add mixed greens and blue cheese to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Slice roll in half and place on a baking sheet pan, cut-side up; drizzle with the garlic-chive oil. Place in the oven and toast until golden, 1-2 minutes. Remove from the oven and cut each round in half.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad, steak, and crostini between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Steak Salad with Egg, Bell Pepper, Avocado & Blue Cheese Dressing

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain eggs and transfer to a small bowl; add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest.
While the steak cooks, peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic.
Chop chives into small pieces; add to the bowl along with blue cheese, mayo, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-size pieces, add to the bowl, and set aside.
Peel and roughly chop eggs.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Just before serving, halve and pit avocado; scoop the flesh out with a spoon and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the lettuce and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad, steak, and eggs between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Steak Salad with Roasted Asparagus, Brussels Sprouts & Dijon Dressing

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and quarter Brussels sprouts; transfer to a medium bowl.
Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus; cut into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the sprouts. Drizzle with oil, sprinkle with spices, and toss to combine.
Transfer veggies to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and roast until fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, cover loosely with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; transfer to the bowl used for the veggies.
Add oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the dressing.
When the veggies are done, transfer to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine. Set aside to cool, about 5 minutes.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl with the veggies and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide roasted vegetable salad between plates or bowls and top with steak. Enjoy!

name: Steak Salad with Walnuts, Goat Cheese & Blueberry-Basil Dressing

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest.
Meanwhile, pick basil off the stems and place in a blender.
Add half of the blueberries (reserve remaining blueberries for the salad), vinegar, water, oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper to the blender. Blend on high until smooth, then set dressing aside.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin pieces; place in a medium bowl.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Add mixed greens and remaining blueberries to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad and steak between plates or bowls. Crumble goat cheese over top and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Steak with Spicy West African Tomato Salsa, Peanuts & Cauliflower Rice

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl.
Add oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the cauliflower, then stir to combine. Transfer cauliflower rice to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring cauliflower halfway through, until the rice is golden and tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in the reserved bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the shallot, then add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Small dice tomato. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then mince. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salsa, and set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and cauliflower rice between plates. Top steak with salsa and peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Steak & Spinach Salad with Sauteed Mushrooms, Grape Tomatoes & Corn

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash, dry, and quarter mushrooms. Peel and mince garlic.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Season steak generously with salt and pepper. Place in skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.

Return skillet to stove and reduce heat to medium. Add more oil, garlic, and mushrooms. Season with salt and pepper. Stirring occasionally, cook until mushrooms are golden, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper.
Remove husks and silks from corn. Hold vertically in the middle of a medium bowl and slice kernels off the cob.
Wash and dry spinach and tomatoes. Halve the tomatoes. Add both to bowl with corn.
Add mushrooms and toss salad.
Slice steak against the grain.
To serve, arrange salad on a plate, top with steak slices, and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Steak Tacos with Strawberry Salsa & Goat Cheese

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the stem ends of the strawberries; small dice the strawberries and transfer to a medium salad bowl.
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the salad bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and add to the salad bowl.
Juice one half of the lime and add to the salad bowl; cut the other half into wedges for serving and transfer to a small bowl.
Season the salsa with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
Wrap the tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until heated through, 15 to 30 seconds.
Thinly slice the steak against the grain into strips.
To serve, divide the steak slices between the tortillas, top with the salsa, and crumble the goat cheese overtop. Serve with lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Steak with Turnip, Carrot & Apple Slaw

instructions.text: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, prepare slaw dressing by whisking together garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper.
Season steak with salt and pepper.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and cover with foil.
Wash and dry turnip, carrot, apple, and green onions.

Trim ends and peel turnip and carrot; coarsely grate and add to bowl with dressing. Core, coarsely grate, and add apple to bowl. Trim and discard root ends of onions, thinly slice, and add to bowl. Toss salad.
Serve steak with slaw on the side and enjoy!

name: Steak Zucchini Rolls with Creamy Chili-Garlic Dip & Arugula Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and let rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place mayo, chili-garlic sauce, and garlic powder in a small bowl; whisk to combine the dipping sauce and set aside.
Trim, halve, and slice radishes into thin half-moons; place on another plate.
Trim zucchini and use a vegetable peeler to make thin ribbons; add to the plate with the radish and set aside for the zucchini rolls.
Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the arugula, and toss to combine the salad; set aside.
After the steak has rested, thinly slice against the grain and return to the plate.
To assemble the zucchini rolls, arrange zucchini ribbons on a flat surface; place a few pieces of steak and radish at one end and roll tightly to secure. (Assemble in batches if necessary.)
Divide zucchini rolls and salad between plates; serve with dipping sauce on the side and enjoy!

name: Sticky Asian Cauliflower Bites with Carrot & Snap Pea Slaw

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil and coat with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove leaves and thick stems from the cauliflower; separate the head into bite-sized florets.
Whisk eggs, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Add ⅓ of the cauliflower florets to the bowl and toss to dredge.

Transfer florets, shaking off excess egg, to another medium bowl; add ⅓ of the bread crumbs and toss to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Transfer to the baking sheet and repeat twice more with remaining cauliflower.
Place cauliflower in the oven and cook until golden and fork-tender, about 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, maple syrup, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; halve snap peas. Add both to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and additional garlic.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil, ginger, and garlic to the saucepan; cook, stirring often, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add broth, soy sauce, maple syrup, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce to the saucepan; whisk to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth. Add to the saucepan in a steady stream, while whisking constantly; continue to simmer, until thick, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide salad and roasted cauliflower between plates. Top cauliflower bites with sauce and enjoy!

name: Sticky Balsamic Chicken Drumsticks with Roasted Zucchini & Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Place oven racks in the upper and middle positions. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean-up easier (optional).
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and transfer to one of the baking sheets. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping chicken halfway, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, wash, dry, and large dice potato. Transfer to the other baking sheet, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer. Add baking sheet to the oven and roast until starting to soften, 10-12 minutes.

While the potatoes are roasting, place vinegar, ketchup, Dijon, sugar, and spices in a small saucepan. Set pan over medium-high heat and cook, whisking occasionally, until sauce is reduced by half, 2-3 minutes. Transfer sauce to a medium bowl and set aside for the chicken.
Wash, dry, trim, and large dice zucchini. Place in another medium bowl, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to coat.

When the potatoes are starting to soften, remove baking sheet from the oven. Add zucchini, toss to combine, and spread out in an even layer. Return to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are tender, 15 minutes more. Remove from oven.
When the chicken and veggies are done, change oven to broil on high.

Add roasted chicken to the bowl with the sauce, toss to coat, then return to the baking sheet. Place baking sheet on the top rack of the oven and broil until sauce is caramelized, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates. Enjoy!

name: Sticky Lemon-Pepper Wings with Creamy Kale & Brussels Sprout Salad

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a clean medium bowl. Juice lemon into another medium bowl and set aside for the wing sauce.
Add mayo, oil, Dijon, salt and pepper to the bowl with the lemon zest; whisk to combine the dressing.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice Brussels sprouts. Add to the bowl.
Using your hands, massage the greens with dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes. Set aside.
Add honey, pepper, and salt to the bowl with the lemon juice, then whisk to combine the sauce.
When the wings are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Sticky Maple-Dijon Wings & Apple Caesar Salad with Crispy Bread Crumbs

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, place maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the maple-Dijon sauce and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until golden and crispy, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic. Mince anchovy fillet. Place both in another clean medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic and anchovy.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl along with mayo, oil, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
When the wings are almost done, separate lettuce into leaves, tearing larger leaves into pieces as needed. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apple. Add to the bowl, gently toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
When the wings are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl with the maple-Dijon sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Top salad with crispy breadcrumbs and enjoy!

name: Sticky Sesame Pork Meatballs with Chili-Garlic Zucchini Noodles

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim zucchini; use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and bake, tossing halfway through, until zucchini is tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with pork, bread crumbs, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the pork mixture into meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
While the meatballs are cooking, place water, soy sauce, sesame seeds, honey, vinegar, and cornstarch in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
When the meatballs are done, add sauce to the skillet. Continue to cook, turning meatballs occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a clean small bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the garlic, along with oil and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the chili oil.
When the zucchini is done, drizzle with chili oil and toss to coat.
To serve, divide zucchini noodles and meatballs between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Sticky Soy-Glazed Steak Tacos with Spicy Broccoli Slaw & Peanuts

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash, dry, peel and mince ginger; peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger and garlic to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, about 1 minute.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add soy sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper to the pan and cook, stirring frequently, until thickened and reduced by half, 3-4 minutes. Remove glaze from the heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, peel, and grate carrot. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the broccoli slaw; toss to combine and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak to the pan and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate along with half the glaze, and turn to coat. Loosely cover with foil.
Meanwhile, roughly chop peanuts.
Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional), 15-30 seconds.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; top with steak, remaining glaze, slaw, and peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Stir-Fried Pork, Pineapple & Bell Pepper with Basmati Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
In a medium bowl, whisk together soy sauce, vinegar, honey, and cornstarch.
Thinly slice pork into strips. Add to bowl with sauce and toss to coat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and mince or grate ginger. Peel and medium dice onion.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash bell pepper and pineapple. Seed and large dice the pepper. Cut off skin from pineapple, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add pork, reserving sauce in bowl, and stir fry until no longer pink, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Coat skillet with more oil. Add garlic, ginger, onion, and pepper. Stir fry until pepper is tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add pork, pineapple, and sauce to skillet. Toss to coat and stir fry for 1-2 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in cilantro.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
Place rice on a plate, top with stir fry, and enjoy!

name: Stovetop Macaroni & Cheese with Spinach & Mushrooms

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim off the discard the stem ends of the mushrooms; thinly slice the mushrooms lengthwise from cap to stem. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.

When the water in the saucepan comes to a boil, uncover the pan and season the water with salt, then add the pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook the pasta, uncovered, for 11 to 12 minutes (or according to package directions). Once done, drain the pasta in a colander.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and small dice the shallot (cut into ¼-inch pieces).
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shallots and mushrooms to the pan. Cook, stirring frequently, until the mushrooms release their water and begin to brown, 4 to 6 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over the mushroom mixture and stir to combine.
Slowly pour the milk into the pan and stir to combine; season with salt and pepper and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce the heat to low and simmer until the sauce is thickened, 4 to 6 minutes.
Coarsely grate 1 cup of cheddar.
Add the cheddar to the pan; stir until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth. Remove from the heat.
Add the pasta and spinach to the pan; stir until the pasta is thoroughly coated with the sauce and the spinach is wilted.
To serve, divide the macaroni and cheese between plates or bowls and season with freshly ground pepper (if desired). Enjoy!

name: Strawberry, Bacon & Spinach Salad with Feta & Poppy Seed Dressing

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Add the bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side.
Wash and dry the spinach. Wash the strawberries, trim the tops, and thinly slice.
In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together mayo, vinegar, honey, poppy seeds, salt, and pepper.
Measure out the almonds.
Once the bacon is cooked, crumble or chop into small pieces.
Arrange a bed of spinach on a plate, top with the strawberries, bacon, feta, and almonds, and drizzle with the dressing. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Strawberry & Black Bean Quinoa Bowl with Feta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa and broth; bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Drain and rinse the black beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes. Once done, remove the quinoa from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the lime into a medium bowl (that will be used to mix the strawberries and jalapeño pepper).
To the lime juice, add olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Trim off and discard the stem ends of the strawberries; medium dice the strawberries and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the strawberries; toss with the dressing.
Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork.
To serve, arrange the quinoa, black beans, strawberry- jalapeño mixture, and feta in a bowl. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Strawberry Cobb Salad with Bacon, Eggs, Avocado & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Place the eggs in a small saucepan and cover with cold water by about 1 inch. Cover with a lid and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.

Trim off and discard the root end of the lettuce and remove any blemished leaves; halve the head lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Wash and spin dry the lettuce in salad spinner, or wash in a colander, spread out on a clean towel, and pat dry. Transfer to a large bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Wash and dry the remaining fresh produce.
Once the skillet is hot, add the bacon strips. Cook until the bacon is crispy, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate lined with paper towels.
Once the water is boiling, remove the pan from the heat and let the eggs sit, covered, for 6 minutes. Once done, drain and run the eggs under cold water for 1-2 minutes to stop the cooking process.
Trim off and discard the stem ends of the strawberries; quarter the strawberries lengthwise and transfer to a medium bowl.
Remove the avocado pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a small bowl.
Place the feta in a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
In a small bowl, combine and whisk together the minced garlic, olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Roughly chop the bacon and transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and roughly chops the eggs.
To serve, arrange a bed of lettuce on a plate, then add the strawberries, avocado, bacon, eggs, and feta in rows over top. Drizzle with the dressing and enjoy!

name: Strawberry Panzanella (Italian Bread Salad) with Chicken, Feta & Mint

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with spices on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Trim and quarter strawberries. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl and set aside. (Reserve remaining mint for serving.)
Cut or tear bread into bite-sized pieces.

Return skillet (with drippings) to low heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread and cook, stirring occasionally, until croutons are golden and toasted, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add croutons to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
Slice chicken into thin strips.
To serve, divide panzanella salad between plates; top with chicken, feta, and reserved mint. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Strawberry-Peach Quinoa Salad with Cucumber, Goat Cheese & Pistachio

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa, water, and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and slice strawberries lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Quarter peach lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pit. Medium dice the flesh and add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pistachios and add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl and set aside.
When the quinoa is done, transfer to a baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes. Once cool, add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Shrimp Arugula Salad with Feta, Almonds & Herb Vinaigrette

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Drain shrimp in a colander and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Spread out on a clean towel and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce (skip the arugula if it came pre-washed).
Trim off the stem ends and slice the strawberries; add to a medium salad bowl along with the arugula.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle; add to the bowl with the strawberries and toss to combine.
Juice lemon into a small bowl; add oil, Dijon, vinegar, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shrimp and garlic to the skillet; cook until shrimp are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
To serve, divide the salad between the plates, top with feta, sliced almonds, and shrimp. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Strawberry, Spinach & Quinoa Salad with Balsamic Vinaigrette

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry spinach and basil. Thinly slice the leaves into ribbons and transfer to a large bowl.
Wash, trim and discard stem ends, and slice strawberries. Add to bowl with spinach and basil.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add almonds and, stirring constantly, cook until golden brown, 1-2 minutes.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork. Drain any excess liquid and add to bowl with other ingredients. Toss salad.
To serve, arrange salad on a plate, crumble goat cheese over top, sprinkle with almonds, and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Strip Steak & Bell Pepper Fajitas with Guacamole & Butter Lettuce

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry bell peppers. Seed, slice into thin strips, and transfer to a bowl.
Peel, thinly slice into half rings, and add onion to bowl with peppers. Peel and mince garlic; add ½ to bowl with vegetables and place the other ½ into a medium bowl for preparing guacamole.
Halve avocado and remove pit; scoop out the flesh into bowl with garlic.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ to bowl with avocado and save the rest for garnishing.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Add lime juice, salt, and pepper to avocado. Mash with a fork until smooth. Set aside.
After steak has been transferred add more oil to skillet. Add peppers, onion, and garlic from bowl. Stirring frequently, cook until peppers are tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Wash and dry lettuce.
Cut remaining ½ lime into wedges.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Return steak slices and any juices to skillet. Season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir and cook for 1-2 minutes.
To serve, fill lettuce leaves with fajita mix. Garnish with guacamole, remaining cilantro, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Strip Steak & Bell Pepper Fajitas with Guacamole

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry bell peppers. Seed and slice into thin strips. Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings. Peel and mince garlic.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.

Once the steak has been transferred, reduce the heat to medium and add sliced onion, peppers, and ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the guacamole) to the skillet. Stirring frequently, cook until vegetables are tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Wash and dry cilantro and lime. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.

Halve and pit avocado; medium dice the flesh while still in skin and scoop out into a medium bowl. Add ½ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing), remaining garlic, lime juice, salt, and pepper. Mash with a fork until smooth.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Add steak slices and any juices to skillet. Season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir and cook for 1-2 minutes.
In another skillet or pan, warm tortillas for 20-30 seconds per side if desired.
Cut remaining lime into wedges.
To serve, place tortillas on a plate and fill with fajita filling. Garnish with guacamole, remaining cilantro, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Strip Steak & Brussels Sprouts Stir Fry with Jalapeño Pepper

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash brussels sprouts, carrot, jalapeño, and green onions.
Trim, peel, and slice carrot on the diagonal into ¼ inch rounds. Transfer to a bowl.
Halve, seed, and thinly slice jalapeño crosswise. Peel and mince garlic. Peel and mince or grate ginger. Transfer all to a small bowl.
Trim green onion root ends and slice on the diagonal. Add whites to bowl with jalapeño, garlic, and ginger; transfer the greens to a separate bowl and save for garnishing.
Trim rough ends of brussels sprouts and halve lengthwise. Transfer to a separate bowl.
In a small bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together coconut aminos, vinegar, water, and arrowroot.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Thinly slice steak into strips.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak strips in a single layer and cook until browned, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Add more oil to skillet, followed by brussels sprouts. Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to plate with steak.

Add more oil to skillet, followed by green onion whites, jalapeño, garlic, and ginger. Stir and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add carrot and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 2-3 minutes.
Return steak and sprouts to skillet and add sauce. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, place stir fry on a plate and garnish with remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Strip Steak with Classic Mozzarella, Tomato & Basil Caprese Salad

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the grape tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and tear the leaves into smaller pieces. Transfer to a small bowl.
Tear the mozzarella into bite-sized chunk and place them in a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Thinly slice the steak against the grain into strips.

To serve, divide the tomatoes between plates (placing them on one side and leaving room for the steak on the other side), scatter the mozzarella chunks and basil leaves on top, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper. Place the steak beside the salad. Enjoy!

name: Strip Steak with Fried Egg, Bell Pepper-Onion Medley & Jalapeño Aioli

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion; add to the baking sheet with the bell pepper. Drizzle veggies with oil, season with salt and pepper, then toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring veggies halfway through, until fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest. (Reserve skillet for later use.)

Meanwhile, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and place in a small bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Add mayo, garlic powder, and salt to the bowl with the jalapeño. Stir to combine the aioli and set aside.
When the steak is done, wipe the reserved skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add additional oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide, steak, veggies, fried eggs, and aioli between plates. Enjoy!

name: Strip Steak with Roasted Hot Honey Butternut Squash & Arugula Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until squash is golden and fork-tender, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
When the squash is done, remove from the oven, then drizzle with honey and hot sauce. Stir to coat and set aside to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Add arugula and cooled squash to the bowl with the dressing, then toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Strip Steak Sandwich with Chive Yogurt Spread & Radish-Arugula Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, chop chives into small pieces. Place in a small bowl along with yogurt, mayo, Dijon, and spices. Stir to combine the yogurt spread and set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add half to the bowl with the dressing. (Reserve remaining onion for the sandwiches.)
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Set aside a handful of arugula for the sandwiches. Add remaining arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Toast bread if desired.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To assemble the sandwiches, spread each bread slice with chive yogurt. Layer half of the slices with steak and reserved onion and arugula; close with remaining slices and cut in half.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Strip Steak Sandwich with Creamy Fennel & Red Cabbage Slaw

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, poppy seeds, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the slaw, and set aside.
Toast bread if desired.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.

To assemble the sandwiches, layer half of the bread slices with steak and a small portion of the slaw; close with remaining bread slices and cut in half. Serve with remaining slaw on the side and enjoy!

name: Strip Steak with Spicy Asian-Style Roasted Brussels Sprouts & Cashews

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and halve Brussels sprouts lengthwise; transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt, and stir to coat. Spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until Brussels sprouts are golden and fork-tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in a small bowl.

Juice lime into the bowl with the shallot and garlic. Add soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar, then stir to combine the dressing. Transfer half of the dressing to a medium bowl and set aside. (Reserve remaining dressing for serving.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, thinly slice chili pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the medium bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop cashews. Add to the bowl.
Add roasted Brussels sprouts to the bowl and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Divide steak and Brussels sprouts between plates. Serve with reserved dressing for dipping steak and enjoy!

name: Strip Steak Tacos with Cilantro Chimichurri Sauce & Grape Tomatoes

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the cilantro.
Cut the lime in half; juice one ½ and add to the bowl with the cilantro and garlic; cut the other ½ into 4 wedges and transfer to a small bowl.
To the bowl with the cilantro, garlic, and lime juice, add olive oil, crushed red pepper, salt, and pepper; whisk the mixture together (or blend with a hand blender for a smoother consistency).
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
While the steak cooks, quarter the grape tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel and microwave until heated through, 15 to 30 seconds.
Thinly slice the steak against the grain into strips.
To serve, divide the steak slices between the tortillas, top with the tomatoes, drizzle with the chimichurri sauce, and garnish with the remaining lime wedges. Enjoy!

name: Striploin with Charred Green Onion Sauce & Lemon-Parsley Roasted Beets

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and trim beets; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until beets are fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, trim green onions. Place on a plate, drizzle with oil, and season with salt.
Once the pan is hot, add green onions. Grill until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side; return to the plate. (Reserve grill pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on another plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Return the pan to medium-high heat and coat with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Add to the plate with the green onions, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, water, and spices in a small bowl, then whisk to combine the sauce.
Mince grilled green onions. Add to the bowl with the yogurt sauce and whisk once more to combine. Set aside.
Juice lemon into another small bowl. Add oil, honey, Dijon, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide green onion yogurt and beets between plates; top yogurt with steak and drizzle beets with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Striploin Steak with Balsamic Bell Peppers

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter the bell peppers lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Cut the quarters lengthwise into ¼-inch-thick strips. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; cut lengthwise into ¼-inch-thick wedges. Add to the bowl with the bell peppers.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the peppers and onion.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
Once the steak has been transferred, reduce the heat to medium and add more coconut oil to the skillet.

Add the peppers, onion, and garlic to the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the peppers are just tender and lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat.
Drizzle the peppers with balsamic vinegar and toss to coat.
To serve, divide the steak and bell peppers between plates.

name: Striploin Steak with Bell Pepper, Tomato & Basil Panzanella Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a large salad bowl.
To the garlic, add olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together and set aside.
Quarter the bell peppers lengthwise; remove and discard the stems, seeds, and membranes. Large dice the peppers (cut into ¾-inch cubes) and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Cut the bun into 1-inch cubes.
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and the bread cubes. Cook, tossing occasionally, until the bread is crisp and lightly browned, 4 to 6 minutes. Once done, transfer to a bowl.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the bread cubes have been transferred, increase the heat to medium-high. Once heated, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
Once the steak has been transferred, add the bell peppers to the skillet. Cook, tossing occasionally, until just tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, return to the bowl.
Halve the grape tomatoes crosswise and add to the salad bowl.

Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves into a chiffonade by stacking them and rolling tightly into a cigar, then slicing crosswise into thin ribbons. Add to the salad bowl.
Add the bell peppers and bread to the salad bowl; toss to combine.
Slice the steak against the grain into thin strips.
To serve, divide the steak strips and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Striploin Steak with Couscous, Spinach & Feta Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Grate all of the zest from the lemon, then juice the lemon; add both to a large salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the salad bowl.
To the salad bowl, add olive oil, salt, and pepper; whisk together and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add the pine nuts; cook, stirring constantly, until they are golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Once done, add to the salad bowl.
Once the pine nuts have been transferred, add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
Add the broth and water to a small saucepan; bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In batches, stack the spinach leaves and roll tightly into a cigar, then slice crosswise into a chiffonade (thin ribbons). Transfer to the salad bowl.
Once the liquid comes to a boil, add couscous and salt; give it a stir and cover with a lid. Remove from the heat and let it stand for 5 minutes.
Add the feta to the salad bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Place the steak on a cutting board and thinly slice against the grain into strips.
Uncover the couscous and fluff with a fork; add to the salad bowl and toss to combine.
To serve, divide the steak and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Striploin Steak with Mashed Potatoes & Garlicky Spinach Sauté

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and quarter the potatoes lengthwise (into wedges); transfer to a small saucepan. Cover with hot water (from the tap) by about 1 inch and bring to a boil over high heat.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate, leaving any juices in the skillet, and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce the heat to medium and cook until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife, 8 to 12 minutes. Once done, reserve about ½ cup of liquid and drain the rest. Cover the saucepan to keep warm.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.

Once the steak has been transferred, reduce the heat to medium and add the garlic and spinach to the skillet; season with salt and pepper. Stir until the spinach is just wilted, 1 to 2 minutes, then remove from the heat.
Add ½ of the reserved liquid, butter, salt, and pepper to the potatoes; mash with a potato masher until smooth. Add more liquid to thin out the mash if needed.
To serve, divide the mashed potatoes between plates and top with the spinach sauté, then add the steak on the side. Enjoy!

name: Striploin Steak with Roasted Carrot, Beet & Feta Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F. Place the rack in the center position.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel the carrots, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Cut the carrots into ¼-inch-thick rounds (at an angle). Transfer the carrots to a baking sheet.

Trim off and discard the ends of the beets; peel and cut the beets into ¼-inch thick wedges. (To avoid staining, line your cutting board with paper towels before handling the beets.) Transfer the beets to the baking sheet.

One by one, holding a sprig of thyme at its top, run you fingers down it to remove the leaves. Discard the sprigs and chop the leaves. Sprinkle ¾ of the leaves over the carrots and beets (save the rest for garnishing).
Drizzle the carrots and beets with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then arrange in a single layer.
Place the baking sheet in the oven and roast until the carrots and beets are tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
Measure out the feta.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, place the steak on a plate, arrange the roasted vegetables on the side and sprinkle with the feta and remaining thyme. Enjoy!

name: Striploin Steak with Warm Potato, Corn & Snap Pea Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Place the rack in the center position.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Medium dice the potatoes (cut into ½-inch cubes) and transfer to a baking sheet.
Add the corn to the potatoes.
Drizzle the potatoes and corn with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then arrange in a single layer.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the sheet in the oven and roast, tossing halfway through cooking time, until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork, 20 to 25 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a medium bowl (that is big enough to hold the potato salad).
Add mayonnaise, paprika, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic and mix together.
Cut the sugar snap peas crosswise (at an angle) into ¼-inch pieces and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise (at an angle) into ¼-inch pieces and add to the salad bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
Once the potatoes are tender, remove them from the oven and transfer to the salad bowl. Gently mix the ingredients together.
Slice the steak against the grain into strips.
To serve, divide the salad and steak slices between plates. Enjoy!

name: Striploin Steak with Warm Potato, Snap Pea & Dill Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Quarter potatoes, transfer to a baking sheet pan, and drizzle with oil. Season with salt and pepper, toss to combine, and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until starting to soften, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl, then add mayo, vinegar, Dijon, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
While the steak is cooking, peel, halve, and slice shallot into ¼-inch thick half-moons.

When the potatoes have started to soften, remove from the oven. Add shallot and snap peas, toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer. Return to the oven and roast until veggies are fork-tender, 10-12 minutes more. Remove from oven.
When the veggies are done, add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the potato salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and warm potato salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Striploin Steak with Zucchini, Feta & Pine Nut Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the lemon and transfer to a large bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the lemon juice.
To the lemon juice and garlic, add olive oil, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Trim off and discard the ends of the zucchini; cut the zucchini crosswise into ¼-inch-thick rounds at an angle. Add to the large bowl and toss until well coated with the oil mixture.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan / skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the grill pan / skillet is hot, coat the bottom with coconut oil.

Carefully place the steak in the grill pan / skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak until desired doneness (5 to 7 minutes for medium-rare). (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
