Once the steak has been transferred, add the zucchini slices to the grill pan / skillet. Cook until they are tender and browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate. Cook in batches if necessary.
Measure out the pine nuts and transfer to a small bowl.
Measure out the feta and transfer to a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide the steak and zucchini slices between plates, then top the zucchini with feta and pine nuts. Enjoy!

name: Stuffed Acorn Squash with Apple & Bacon

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F and place the rack in the center position.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut squash in half lengthwise. Scoop out seeds; discard. Slice a small piece off the bottom of each squash half just enough so that they will sit level.
Drizzle cut-side with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Flip squash halves, scooped sides down, in cast iron skillet (or a baking sheet). Bake until golden and fork-tender, 30-35 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat a nonstick skillet to medium-high heat. Chop bacon into ¼-inch pieces and cook until almost crispy. Drain most of the fat.
Peel and dice onion. Add to pan, stirring to combine. Sprinkle with thyme and sage. Cook together until onion is soft and caramelized.
Core, peel, and medium dice the apple. Add to pan, drizzle with maple syrup and a pinch of salt. Cook 2-3 minutes until apple just starts to soften.
Add pine nuts and cook for 1 minute.
Remove the squash from the oven. Stuff each half with the bacon mixture.
To serve, divide squash halves between plates. Enjoy!

name: "Stuffed Bell Pepper" Soup with Turkey, Rice, Spinach, Dill & Parmesan

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey, salt, and pepper to the pan; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes. Transfer turkey to a plate and set aside. (Reserve saucepan for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and small dice celery; peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Place both in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper into thin strips, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the celery and carrot.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; add to the bowl.
Return the saucepan to medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; sauté, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Return turkey to the pan along with broth, tomatoes, and rice; stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until rice is soft and veggies are tender, about 12 minutes.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, roughly chop spinach and place in the reserved bowl.
Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the spinach and set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan and set aside.
When the soup is done, add spinach and dill to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from the heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Stuffed Mexican Sweet Potatoes

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F and place the rack in the center position.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Cut sweet potato in half lengthwise. Rub the inside and outside of the potato with oil and season with salt. Place cut side down on a baking sheet pan and pierce skin all over with a fork. Bake for 25 minutes until sweet potatoes are fork tender.
Meanwhile, preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat. When heated, add butter to the pan.
Peel and small dice the onion. Peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to onions and garlic to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander. Add to pan with the onion and garlic.
Drain diced tomatoes using the colander and discard juice. Add tomatoes to pan.
Season the bean mixture with chili powder, cumin, salt, and cayenne pepper. Stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Turn heat up to medium-high and cook, stirring occasionally, until the beans are warmed through and tender, 5 minutes. Mash some of the beans with a potato masher.
Remove the sweet potatoes from the oven when fork-tender. Let cool for 5 minutes.
Scrape out the flesh of the sweet potatoes, leaving the skins intact and a thin layer of potato inside, set skins aside.
Add the sweet potato flesh to a bowl with the bean mixture, stir to combine.
Grate cheddar cheese.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice avocado crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Trim and discard root ends of green onions, and chop.
To serve, return the bean mixture to the sweet potato skins. Top with cheese, avocado, cilantro and green onion. Squeeze lime over top. Enjoy!

name: Stuffed Peppers with Spiced Indian Beef & Cucumber-Corn Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; arrange cut-side down. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and divide between a small and medium bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the small bowl with the jalapeño, along with tomato paste and spices. Stir to combine the spice paste and set aside.
Juice lime into the medium bowl with the jalapeño. Add honey, cumin, and salt, then stir to combine the dressing.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and mince onion. Add half to the medium bowl with the dressing and set aside for the salad. (Reserve remaining onion for the next step.)
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add reserved onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until beginning to soften and brown, 3-4 minutes.
Add beef to the skillet and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside. (Reserve remaining cilantro for later use.)
When the beef is done, add spice paste to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add peas, water, vinegar, and reserved cilantro to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until peas are warmed through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Stuff pepper halves with beef mixture, then divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Sun-Dried Tomato Chicken with Broccoli, Pine Nuts & Parmesan

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash the broccoli and cut the florets into bite-sized pieces. Peel and small dice (or julienne) the stems.

Once the water comes to a boil, uncover, add broccoli florets and stems, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until crisp-tender, about 3 minutes. Once done, drain in a colander and then lay the broccoli on a clean towel and pat dry.
Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces. Season with spices and toss to coat.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. When the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the pieces are browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes.
Add oil, onion, garlic, tomatoes, and crushed red peppers to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until onions are translucent, about 3 minutes.
Finely grate Parmesan.
Add the broccoli and chicken to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring continuously, until broccoli and chicken are heated through, about 2 minutes.
To serve, divide between plates and top with Parmesan cheese and pine nuts. Enjoy!

name: Sun-Dried Tomato & Chicken Pasta with Spinach & Goat Cheese

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain, reserving ¼ cup pasta water, and return to saucepan.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, mix together basil, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Sprinkle with spices.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
Wash and dry spinach.
Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes. Measure out olives.
One pasta has been drained, add tomatoes, olives, spinach, and reserved pasta water to saucepan. Toss until spinach is wilted.
Slice chicken into strips.
To serve, place pasta in a bowl, add chicken slices, and crumble goat cheese over top. Enjoy!

name: Sun-Dried Tomato Fettuccine with Olives, Pine Nuts, Arugula & Parmesan

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ¼-cup of cooking water before draining.) Return pasta and reserved cooking water to the pot.
Meanwhile, wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Set aside.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon into a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Roughly chop olives and sun-dried tomatoes. Add both to the bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl along with pine nuts, oil, and spices; stir to combine the pasta seasoning.
When the pasta is done, add pasta seasoning to the pot. Set over medium heat and cook, stirring often, until warmed through and sauce coats pasta, 1-2 minutes.
Add arugula to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Sun-Dried Tomato Pasta with Spinach & Fresh Basil

instructions.text: Boil water in a kettle. (If you do not have a kettle, boil water in a saucepan, starting with hot tap water.)
In a small bowl, pour boiling water over cashews and set aside to soak.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Halve the tomatoes and set aside in a small bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes, setting some aside to use as garnish.
Thinly slice the sun-dried tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Juice the lemon into a blender. Peel and mince garlic; add to the blender.
Add additional sun-dried tomatoes, oil, salt, and pepper to the blender.
Add cashews, and the water you soaked them in, to the blender. Blend on high speed for several minutes until smooth.

Place spinach in a large colander in the sink. When the pasta is cooked, carefully empty into the colander over the spinach to drain and to wilt the spinach. Return the pasta and spinach to the pan and stir in the cashew-cream, dried and fresh tomatoes, and basil.
To serve, divide pasta between plates, garnish with reserved basil, and enjoy!

name: Sun-Dried Tomato Turkey Meatballs with Sautéed Garlicky Kale & Ricotta

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan. Place in a small bowl along with ricotta, salt, and pepper; stir to combine. Set aside.
Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve the other half for serving.)

Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the parsley along with half of the cheese mixture, turkey, bread crumbs, egg, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine. (Reserve remaining cheese mixture for serving.)
Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place in the baking dish.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until meatballs are lightly browned and nearly cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and place in a clean medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the bowl with the kale.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring frequently, until the kale is tender, 1-2 minutes more. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Add vinegar, crushed red pepper, and salt to the skillet with the kale; stir to combine. Remove from heat and cover with a lid to keep warm.
Place tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, and additional crushed red pepper in the reserved bowl. Stir to combine the sauce.

When the meatballs are lightly browned, remove from oven. Pour tomato sauce over meatballs, return to oven, and continue to bake until the sauce is warm and meatballs are cooked through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide meatballs, sauce, kale, and reserved cheese mixture between plates or bowls. Top with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: "Supreme Pizza" Pasta with Prosciutto, Mushrooms, Bell Pepper & Olives

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms; transfer to a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Peel and mince onion and garlic; add both to the bowl along with the spices. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of each sausage. Peel off casings and discard.
Once the skillet is hot, add the prosciutto and cook until crispy, about 1 minute per side. Remove prosciutto to a plate and set aside.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat. Add sausage meat and cook, breaking apart with a wooden spoon, until browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
Add veggies and spices to the skillet with the sausage. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, thinly slice olives.
Add olives and tomato sauce to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes more.
Crumble or chop the prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
Drain pasta in a colander and return to the pan.
Add the "Supreme Pizza" sauce to the pan with the pasta and gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between bowls and top with crumbled prosciutto. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Chili Salmon Sandwich with Avocado & Ginger-Tahini Dressed Salad

instructions.text: Place vinegar, sugar, water, chili-garlic sauce, and salt in a small saucepan; whisk to combine. Set over medium-high heat and bring to a boil, whisking occasionally.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.

Once the sauce is boiling, add cornstarch slurry to the pan in a steady stream while whisking quickly. Cook, whisking constantly, until the sweet chili sauce thickens, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat salmon dry with paper towels and place skin-side down on a plate; season the top side with salt and pepper.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add salmon, skin-side down, and cook, flipping once, until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger; place in a medium bowl. Add tahini, vinegar, soy sauce, oil, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and thinly slice. Add to the plate with the salmon.
Toast buns if desired.
Separate lettuce leaves; set aside two leaves per sandwich. Chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces, then add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies. Toss to combine the salad.
Place the bottom half of a bun on each plate. Top with salmon, sweet chili sauce, avocado, and reserved lettuce leaves; close with the top half of each bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Sweet 'n' Sour Chicken Stir-Fry with Plums, Bok Choy & Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, juice orange into a small bowl. Add vinegar, ketchup, soy sauce, sugar, and cornstarch, then whisk to combine the sauce. Set aside.
Halve plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into ¼-inch thick slices. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and cut bok choy crosswise into ½-inch strips. Add to the bowl with the plums and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, chicken, salt, and pepper; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Add sauce, plums, and bok choy to the skillet. Stir-fry until plums and bok choy are just tender and sauce is thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Sweet 'n' Sour Pork with Broccoli, Carrot & Bell Pepper over Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the broccoli.
Peel, trim, and halve carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl.
Trim green onions and mince the white parts; add to the bowl. Cut green parts crosswise into ¼-inch pieces and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add sausage and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer sausage to a plate (leaving drippings in the skillet) and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, place ketchup, vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.
Once the sausage is done, return the skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat; add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
When the veggies are done, return cooked sausage to the skillet; add sauce, stir to combine, and cook until sauce is warmed through and sausage is coated, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, sweet 'n' sour pork, and veggies between plates or bowls; top with reserved green onions. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Onion, Potato & Blue Cheese Flatbread with Grape-Arugula Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Slide rosemary leaves off sprigs; discard sprigs and mince the leaves. Transfer to a medium bowl.

Cut potatoes into ⅛-inch thick slices; add to the bowl with the rosemary along with oil, salt, and pepper. Toss potatoes to coat, then arrange on the sheet pan in a single layer. Wipe the bowl clean with a paper towel and reserve for later use.
Place potatoes in the oven and bake until fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onions and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until onions are soft and golden brown, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into the reserved bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Carefully remove cooked potatoes from the sheet pan by lifting the corners of the foil and transferring the whole sheet to a flat surface.

Arrange flatbreads on the sheet pan. Layer with potato slices, onions, and crumbled blue cheese. Place in the oven and cook until flatbreads become golden around the edges, and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Meanwhile, slice grapes in half and add to the bowl with the dressing. Add arugula and toss to combine the salad.
Slice flatbreads and divide between plates. Serve with arugula salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato-Apple Gratin Stacks with Kale, Walnut & Cranberry Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel sweet potatoes and slice into ¼-inch thick rounds. Transfer to the baking sheet, arranging the slices in a single layer; season with salt and pepper.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until sweet potatoes start to soften, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice orange into a medium bowl. Add nutritional yeast, oil, Dijon, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apple.
Thinly slice cheese.

Remove the partially cooked sweet potatoes from the oven. Layer half the sweet potato slices with half the apple and cheese. If needed, use tongs to repeat layering with remaining sweet potato, apple, and cheese, ending with a cheese slice on top.
Return baking sheet to the oven; bake until sweet potatoes are fork-tender and cheese is melted, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Coarsely chop walnuts and add to the bowl along with the cranberries; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide sweet potato stacks and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato & Beef Chili with Avocado

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice the onion; transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the saucepan warms up, peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Add the ground beef to the saucepan; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until crumbly and browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the beef to a bowl and leave the juices in the saucepan.
Once the beef has been transferred, add the onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
While the onion cooks, peel and medium dice the sweet potatoes; leave on cutting board.
Add the garlic and sweet potatoes to the saucepan and stir to combine; cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 to 4 minutes.
Return the ground beef to the saucepan; season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the diced tomatoes to the saucepan and stir to combine. Cook the chili until the sweet potatoes are tender, 5 to 7 minutes.
While the chili cooks, halve the avocado lengthwise and twist to open, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a small bowl.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Stir half into the chili and transfer the rest to a small bowl.
To serve, spoon the chili into a bowl and garnish with avocado and remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Chili with Avocado

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces; transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Drain and rinse the beans; set aside.
Once the saucepan is warm, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
While the onion cooks, peel and medium dice the sweet potatoes into ½-inch cubes; leave on cutting board.
Add the garlic and sweet potatoes to the saucepan and stir to combine; cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 to 4 minutes.
Add the beans to the saucepan and season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.

Add the diced tomatoes to the saucepan and stir to combine. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and cover with a lid. Cook the chili until the sweet potatoes are tender, 5 to 7 minutes.
While the chili cooks, halve the avocado lengthwise and twist to open, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a small bowl.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Stir half into the chili and transfer the rest to a small bowl (for garnishing).
To serve, spoon the chili into a bowl and garnish with the avocado and remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Salad with Avocado Dressing & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F and place the rack in the center position.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Peel and medium dice the sweet potatoes into ½-inch cubes; transfer to a medium bowl.
Drizzle the potatoes with olive oil and season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper; toss to coat. Transfer the mixture to a sheet pan and spread out in a single layer.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the potatoes in the oven and roast, tossing once halfway through cooking time, until the potatoes are tender and lightly browned, 15 to 20 minutes.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Scoop out the avocado flesh and transfer to a medium bowl; mash with a fork until smooth.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the mashed avocado.
Juice the lime and add to the bowl.
Add olive oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl; mix the dressing until well combined. Alternatively, use a hand blender to make a very smooth dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place the feta in a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Transfer to a large salad bowl.
Add the sweet potatoes and beans to the salad bowl; toss to combine.
To serve, divide the mixed greens between dishes, top with the salad and feta, and drizzle with the dressing. Mix together and enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato & Brussels Sprouts Hash with Fried Eggs

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and large dice the sweet potatoes into ¾-inch cubes; transfer to a bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the sweet potatoes and onion to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender, 6 to 8 minutes.
While the potatoes and onions cook, trim off and discard the stems ends of the Brussels sprouts, then remove the outer layer of leaves; quarter the sprouts lengthwise.
Add the garlic and Brussels sprouts to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until tender, 3 to 5 minutes.
Add olive oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Gently crack the eggs into the skillet. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, separate the eggs. Cook in batches if necessary.
Season the hash with salt and pepper; stir to combine and remove from the heat.
To serve, divide the hash between plates, top with the fried eggs, and season with additional salt and pepper if desired. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato Burrito Bowl with Kidney Bean Chili, Cheddar & Avocado

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and cut sweet potato lengthwise into 1-inch thick wedges (4-6 pieces per potato, depending on size), then transfer to the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place sweet potato wedges in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and corn; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
While the veggies are cooking, trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper.
Add beans, bell pepper, tomatoes, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine the chili and bring to a simmer.
Once the chili is simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender and sauce has thickened, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese.
Halve and pit avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide sweet potato wedges between plates or bowls; top with chili, cheese, and avocado. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato Chickpea Bowls with Maple-Tahini Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel the sweet potatoes and onions; cut both into 1-inch pieces. Transfer a medium bowl; add oil, salt, and pepper, and toss to coat. Place veggies on a baking sheet and bake, until softened, about 10 minutes. Reserve bowl for later use.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse the chickpeas; set aside to drain further.

Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place broccoli in the medium bowl, add oil, salt, and pepper, and toss to coat. Add to baking sheet with the sweet potatoes, tossing to combine; bake until cooked through, about 10 more minutes. Reserve bowl for later use.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Combine spices in a small bowl.
When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add chickpeas and spices to the skillet and toss to coat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until chickpeas are golden and fragrant, about 10 minutes. When done, set aside.

Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the medium bowl; add oil, salt, and pepper and toss to combine. Add to the baking sheet and cook until wilted, about 5 more minutes.
Juice lemon into a small bowl; add tahini, maple syrup, and water, whisking to combine the dressing. Add additional water as needed to reach a drizzling consistency.
To serve, divide roasted vegetables and chickpeas between bowls. Drizzle with tahini-maple dressing and enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato-Edamame Rice Bowl with Broccoli Slaw & Almond-Lime Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potato; transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing once, until sweet potatoes are fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the sweet potatoes are roasting, place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Set aside to drain.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a small bowl.

Juice lime into the bowl with the ginger and garlic; add almond butter, water, and soy sauce. Whisk to combine the sauce, adding additional water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if necessary, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set sauce aside.
Trim, seed, and cut bell pepper into thin strips; transfer to a plate.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the plate with the bell pepper.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the rice is done, add cilantro and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice, roasted sweet potatoes, broccoli slaw, edamame, bell pepper, and green onions between bowls. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato Fritters with Smoky Tahini Sauce, Broccoli & Cauliflower

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and coarsely grate sweet potato. Transfer to a colander and sprinkle with salt. Place the colander in a bowl to catch the excess moisture and set aside.

Separate broccoli and cauliflower into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer both to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until the veggies are fork-tender, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a small bowl. Add tahini, water, maple syrup, and spices, then whisk to combine the tahini sauce and set aside.
Using paper towels or a clean cloth, squeeze excess moisture from the grated sweet potato, then place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the sweet potato along with egg, flour, soy sauce, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine the batter.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Using a scant ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; flatten slightly with the back of a spoon. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.

Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in a clean medium bowl (reserving a small handful for serving) along with half of the tahini sauce. (Reserve remaining tahini sauce for serving.)
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl with the dill and tahini sauce along with raisins and pumpkin seeds. Stir to combine.
To serve, divide broccoli, cauliflower, and fritters between plates or bowls. Drizzle fritters with remaining tahini sauce, sprinkle with reserved dill, and enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato & Lentil Stew with Crusty Bread

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic and ginger.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Rinse lentils under cold water.
Wash potatoes and tomato. Peel and large dice the potatoes. Medium dice the tomato.
Add garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric, curry, coriander, and salt to saucepan. Stir for about 1 minute.
Add potatoes, tomatoes, lentils, and broth. Bring to a simmer and cook until potatoes and lentils are tender, 15-20 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Toast bread.
To serve, add stew to a bowl and have with bread on the side. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato-Onion Quesadilla with Corn, Tomato & Lime Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Peel and small dice sweet potato. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potatoes are browned and fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-low heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft and golden brown, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the onion is cooking, juice lime into a medium bowl. Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with pumpkin seeds, and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese.

Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide onion, sweet potato, and cheese between them, arranging the filling on one half of each tortilla; fold in half to close. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add quesadillas and cook until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden, 2½-3 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, add mixed greens to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates; serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato "Patatas Bravas" with Spinach, Beans & Garlic Aioli

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and large dice sweet potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Peel and mince garlic. Add half to the baking sheet with the sweet potatoes, along with nutritional yeast, oil, and spices; toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer. Place remaining garlic in a small bowl and set aside.
Place sweet potatoes in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until fork-tender, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lime into the bowl with the garlic; add mayo and whisk to combine the aioli. Set aside.
Small dice tomato. Peel and small dice shallot.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.

Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes, shallot, vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, paprika, and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until tomatoes have softened and reduced, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add beans to the pan and stir to combine. Continue to cook until heated through, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide sweet potatoes and veggie-bean sauté between bowls. Drizzle with aioli and enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato Patties with Smoked Salmon & Creamy Greek Salad

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: In a medium bowl, whisk the egg.
Wash, peel, and coarsely grate the sweet potatoes. Use a paper towel or a clean cloth to squeeze out the excess moisture and add to the bowl with the egg.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl along with flour, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Using a ¼ cup measure, form the potato mixture into patties. Working in batches if necessary, add patties to the skillet and flatten into ½-thick circles using the back of a spatula. Cook, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a knife, shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Add yogurt, feta, vinegar, capers, and honey to the bowl with the dill; whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Halve olives and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise and add to the bowl.
Trim cucumber; quarter lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide patties, salmon, and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato & Spinach Coconut Curry with Quinoa

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine broth and quinoa; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until liquid is fully absorbed, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash, dry, peel, and small dice sweet potatoes.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sweet potato, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until sweet potato is golden brown and tender, 10-12 minutes.

Add coconut milk and broth to the skillet, then stir to combine the curry and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until curry is slightly thickened, 4-5 minutes more.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Roughly chop.

When the curry is thickened, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook until fully wilted, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide quinoa and curry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato, Spinach & White Bean Curry with Quinoa

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa, salt, and water; bring to a boil over high heat.
While the liquid comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes. Once done, remove the quinoa from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel and medium dice the potatoes (cut into ½-inch cubes); transfer to a bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces).
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until it is softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
While the onion cooks, trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger.
Add the garlic, ginger, and curry powder to the onion; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.

Add the sweet potatoes, tomato sauce, broth, and salt to the skillet; stir to combine and reduce the heat to medium-low. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes before adding the remaining ingredients.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the curry cooks, using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Drain and rinse the beans.
Add the beans, spinach, ¾ of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing), and yogurt to the curry; stir to combine and continue cooking until the potatoes are tender, another 5 to 7 minutes.
Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place the quinoa on a plate or in a bowl, top with the curry, and garnish with the remaining parsley leaves. Enjoy!

name: Sweet & Sour Coconut Popcorn Chicken with Ginger-Garlic Green Beans

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and discard ends of the green beans; transfer to one half of the baking sheet, in a single layer.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger; sprinkle both over the green beans. Set aside.
Place coconut and almond flour in a medium bowl; whisk to combine.
Whisk egg in a second medium bowl.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces; season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Toss chicken in the egg to coat. Working in batches, transfer chicken to the coconut mixture and turn to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Place chicken on the other half of the baking sheet, in a single layer.
Drizzle oil over the beans and chicken. Place in the oven and bake until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, and beans are fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice orange into a small saucepan. Add ketchup, oil, soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar; whisk to combine. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: In a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.
Add cornstarch slurry to the saucepan in a steady stream while whisking quickly. Cook, whisking often, until sweet and sour sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Drizzle sweet and sour sauce over the baked chicken and gently toss to coat.
To serve, divide chicken and beans between plates. Sprinkle chicken with sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Sweet & Sour Meatballs with Pineapple & Bell Pepper

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine beef, bread crumbs, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Peel and medium dice onion. Wash, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Cut off skin from pineapple, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Form beef mixture into small meatballs and place on a plate.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add meatballs and, turning often, cook until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
In a small bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together broth, vinegar, honey, soy sauce, and cornstarch.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Return skillet to stove and add more oil. Add onion and bell peppers. Stirring frequently, cook until tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
Stir in pineapple and cook for about 1 minute.
Pour in sauce and return meatballs to skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and cook until sauce is thickened, 3-4 minutes.
To serve, place in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Sweet & Sour Shrimp with Rice Noodles, Carrots and Peppers

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Then drain in a colander and rinse.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel the carrots; then using the peeler, run it along the carrot to make long, noodle-like strips. Seed and slice bell pepper into thin strips. Trim ends of celery and slice into small pieces. Transfer all to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into small pieces. Add half of the onions to the bowl with the sliced vegetables (reserving the rest for garnish).
Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Peel and mince the garlic.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the sliced vegetables, ginger, garlic, and black pepper to the pot. Sauté until soft, 4-5 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise.
Add the cabbage and shrimp to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage softens and shrimp is cooked through, 2-3 minutes.
Juice the lime into a small bowl. Add the cornstarch and whisk together.

Juice the orange into the pot; add broth, sugar, soy sauce, and fish sauce. Bring to a boil over high heat, then stir in the cornstarch mixture. Reduce heat to low, add rice noodles, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Divide between bowls, garnish with remaining green onion, and enjoy!

name: Sweet & Sour Thai Chicken Vegetable Soup

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces, set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Heat coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Add both to the pot.
Add to the pot turmeric and crushed red pepper, stirring until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add chicken pieces to pot, stirring occasionally.
Peel and thinly slice carrot on the bias. Cut the bell pepper lengthwise into quarters; remove and discard the seeds and white membrane then slice thinly. Add veggies to the pot.
Remove the stems from the mushroom and carefully scrape out the gills with a spoon, making sure not to damage the rim of the mushrooms. Cut cap in half, thinly slice and add to the pot.
Cook chicken and vegetables, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender, about 5-7 minutes.
Add broth, coconut milk, fish sauce, honey, and vinegar and stir to combine.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Bring soup to boil and then reduce heat to low. Simmer for 8-10 minutes, allowing the chicken to cook fully and flavors to blend.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Juice the lime and add to the pot right before serving, stir to combine.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and garnish with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Soy Beef Stir-Fry with Peaches, Tomatoes, Basil & Rice

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels, place on a cutting board, and slice crosswise into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beef and stir-fry until just cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Large dice and place in a medium bowl.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the peaches and set aside.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add peaches and tomatoes to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes more. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)

Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place half in the reserved bowl, along with soy sauce and sugar, then whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)

When the peaches and tomatoes are softened, return steak strips (and any accumulated juices) to the skillet, then add stir-fry sauce. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce has thickened and steak is warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Top with reserved basil and enjoy!

name: Swiss Chard-Carrot Salad with Chickpeas, Dates, Almonds, Feta & Mint

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Place vinegar, honey, and salt in a small bowl, then stir to combine the pickling liquid. Set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Add stems to the bowl with the pickling liquid and stir to combine; place leaves in another small bowl. Set both aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, roughly chop almonds.
Once the skillet is hot, add almonds and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly browned, 2-3 minutes. Set aside to cool.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop dates. Add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl along with feta, pickled chard stems, and chard leaves. Toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with toasted almonds. Enjoy!

name: Taco Lettuce Wraps with Cheddar

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce (skip the lettuce until the next step).
Trim off and discard the root end of the lettuce; separate the leaves, then wash and dry them. Transfer to a plate.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle and transfer to a small bowl.
Quarter the grape tomatoes and transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces).
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper to the onion; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the ground beef to the skillet and; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4 to 5 minutes.
Coarsely grate ½ cup of cheddar.
To serve, double up the lettuce leaves and fill with the ground beef mixture, tomatoes, cheddar, and green onions. Alternatively, combine all of the ingredients in a bowl to make a salad. Enjoy!

name: Tahini-Glazed Halloumi with Roasted Squash, Leeks & Pecans

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit, then slice crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the baking sheet with the squash.

Zest orange over the veggies, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer. Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until squash is golden and fork-tender, about 25 minutes. (Reserve orange for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger. Place in a medium bowl, along with spices, then stir to combine the spice rub.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat halloumi dry with paper towels; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the halloumi in half horizontally, then cut each half lengthwise into 1-inch thick strips. Add to the bowl with the spice rub and turn to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the halloumi and cook, turning halfway through, until golden brown on both sides, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in the reserved bowl.
Juice reserved orange into the bowl with the garlic, then add tahini, sugar, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the glaze and set aside
Roughly chop pecans.
When the halloumi is done, transfer to the bowl with the glaze and gently toss to coat.
To serve, divide squash, leeks, and glazed halloumi between plates or bowls. Top with pecans and drizzle with any leftover glaze in the bowl. Enjoy!

name: Tandoori Chicken Burger with Cucumber Raita & Spinach-Apple Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic.
Add chicken, bread crumbs, and spices to the bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the chicken mixture into 2 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, trim and coarsely grate cucumber. Use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated cucumber.
Place cucumber in a small bowl, then add yogurt and salt. Whisk to combine the raita and set aside.
Juice lime into in a clean medium bowl. Add oil, honey, and salt; whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apple. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the spinach, and toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired.
To assemble the burgers, spread the bottom half of each bun with half of the raita. Layer with burger patties and remaining raita, then close with the top half of the buns.
Divide burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Tandoori-Style Fish Tacos with Cucumber Raita, Pickled Onion & Avocado

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Juice half of the lime into the bowl with the ginger and garlic (set aside remaining lime for later use). Add yogurt, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat cod dry with paper towels, then cut crosswise into 1-inch thick fingers. Add to the bowl with the marinade and stir to coat. Set aside.
Place vinegar, honey, and salt in a small bowl. Stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.

Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6 inches from the top. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional), then coat with a thin layer of oil. Set aside.
While the broiler is heating, juice reserved lime into another small bowl.

Using a clean cutting board, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the lime juice. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.

Peel, trim, and coarsely grate cucumber. Use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated cucumber. Add to the bowl along with additional yogurt, honey, and salt; stir to combine the raita and set aside.

Transfer fish to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, turning the fish pieces halfway through, until golden and flesh flakes with a fork, 5-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin pieces. Season with salt.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with raita, avocado, fish, and pickled onion. Enjoy!

name: Tangy Peanut Soba Noodle Salad with Crispy Tofu

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain and medium dice (cut into ¾-inch cubes) the tofu; place the cubes on paper towels and pat dry.
Once the skillet is hot, add sesame oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the tofu to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 5 to 6 minutes. Once done, transfer the tofu to a plate.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add the noodles; cook according to package directions, about 5 to 7 minutes. Once done, drain the noodles in a colander and rinse under cold water; set aside.
Juice the lime into a small bowl (that will be used for the salad dressing).
Peel and grate or mince the ginger; add the ginger to the small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic and add to the small bowl.

Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop about ¾ of the leaves (save the rest for garnishing). Add the chopped cilantro to the small bowl.
To make the dressing, add peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, and crushed red pepper to the small bowl; whisk the ingredients together.
Peel the carrots, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Using a box grater, coarsely grate the carrots and transfer to a large bowl.
Halve the sugar snap peas at an angle and add to the large bowl.
Add the noodles and tofu to the large bowl with the carrots and peas and pour the dressing over top; toss until everything is well coated with the sauce.
To serve, place the noodle mixture into a bowl and garnish with the remaining cilantro leaves. Enjoy!

name: Tempeh Couscous Bowl with Cauliflower, Spinach & Tahini Drizzle

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl, along with oil and spices, then stir to combine the spice paste.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the spice paste.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tempeh. Add to the bowl and stir to combine.
Once the skillet is hot, add tempeh, cauliflower, and any spice paste left in the bowl; cook stirring occasionally, until tempeh is golden and cauliflower is tender-crisp, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a small bowl. Add tahini, water, and salt, then whisk to combine the sauce. Set aside.
When the tempeh and cauliflower are done, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide couscous, tempeh, and veggies between bowls. Drizzle with tahini sauce and enjoy!

name: Tempeh Tacos with Tomato-Radish Salsa & Cilantro Lime Aioli

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime. Divide between a small and medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between the bowls. (Set medium bowl aside for later use.)
Add mayo and spices to the small bowl, then stir to combine the lime aioli. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and mince onion. Add half to the medium bowl with the lime and cilantro, then set aside. (Reserve remaining onion for the next step.)

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Using your fingers, crumble tempeh into the skillet, then add reserved onion, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the tempeh is browned and onion is soft, about 5 minutes.

Reduce heat to medium. Add tomato sauce, water, nutritional yeast, and spices to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.

Meanwhile, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the medium bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Trim and halve radishes, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, along with salt and pepper, then stir to combine the salsa. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in another skillet or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with saucy tempeh and salsa. Drizzle with lime aioli and enjoy!

name: Teriyaki Chicken with Bok Choy, Cashews & Coconut Rice

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Heat a medium saucepan over high heat. Add coconut milk, water, and salt and bring to a boil.
amounts: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir in the rice, and reduce the heat to low. Cover and cook until the rice is tender and all liquid has been absorbed, about 12 minutes.
Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
In a medium bowl, create a slurry by whisking together water and cornstarch until smooth. Add soy sauce, honey, and the minced garlic and ginger to make the teriyaki sauce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
amounts: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Wash bok choy, trim ends, and chop into 1-inch pieces.

Add the bok choy to the skillet; cook, tossing frequently, until the bok choy is wilted and tender, 2-4 minutes. Add the teriyaki sauce. Cook, stirring often, until the sauce is slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls, top with the stir fry, and sprinkle with cashews. Enjoy!

name: Teriyaki Chicken Drumsticks with Sautéed Sugar Snap Peas

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F, position rack in the centre, and place a baking sheet inside to warm up.
Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
In a medium bowl, whisk together water and arrowroot. Add the minced garlic and ginger, honey, rice vinegar, and coconut aminos; whisk again.
Add the chicken to the sauce and toss to coat.
Remove baking sheet from the oven and line with foil. Add the chicken, reserving the sauce in the bowl.
Place in the oven and bake until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Spoon teriyaki sauce over the chicken a couple times during cooking until there is no more sauce left.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash the snap peas.
Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the peas and season with salt and pepper. Cook, tossing occasionally, until bright green and tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Serve chicken drumsticks with sugar snap peas on the side. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Teriyaki Chicken Wings with Veggie Sticks & Ranch Dip

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 500°F and position rack in the centre. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the chicken wings on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat. Spread out in a single layer.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed
½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Place in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through cooking time, until cooked through, 15-20 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare the ranch dip by mixing together lemon juice, mayo, onion powder, garlic powder, dill, salt, and pepper. Place in the fridge to chill.
Wash and dry the carrots, celery, and cucumber. Peel carrots, trim ends, and cut into sticks. Trim ends and cut celery into sticks. Cut cucumber into sticks.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger.

In a small saucepan, prepare the teriyaki sauce by combining water, soy sauce, honey, ginger, and garlic powder. Bring to a boil and allow to boil until the mixture has reduced and thickened, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
Once the wings are cooked, transfer them to a bowl and pour the teriyaki sauce over top; toss to coat.
Serve wings with veggie sticks and ranch dip. Enjoy!

name: Teriyaki Mushroom  Bowl with Carrots & Quick Pickled Cucumbers

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
In a medium bowl, combine vinegar, sugar, and salt. Thinly slice the cucumber, add to the bowl, and toss to coat.
Peel and mince the garlic and the ginger; place in a small bowl. Add soy sauce, brown sugar, and sesame oil to make the teriyaki sauce.
Remove the stems of the portobello mushrooms; scrape out the gills using a spoon. Cut mushrooms in half and then slice crosswise into thin strips.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the yellow onions and cook for about 2 minutes. Add the mushrooms and continue cooking until the mushrooms have started to soften, about 6 minutes.
Add beans and teriyaki sauce to the skillet and cook 3 minutes more.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Peel and coarsely grate the carrot.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork, and drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Fold the oil and seeds into the rice.
To serve, divide rice between bowls and top with mushrooms, cucumbers, carrots, and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Teriyaki Salmon Meatballs with Broccoli, Carrot & Rice Pilaf

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: traditional style wild pink salmon
ingredients.display: 1 (7.5 oz) can wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince the onion. Transfer half to a large bowl and set aside. Transfer the rest to a medium saucepan.
Chop broccoli into small pieces. Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Add both to the saucepan with the onion.
Add rice and broth to the pan with the veggies, stirring to combine. Bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, drain salmon and place in the bowl with the onion. Add bread crumbs, egg, salt, and pepper; mix well to combine.
amounts: 1 (7.5 oz) can wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, scrape down the edges of the saucepan so that all of the rice grains are in the liquid. Cover the saucepan, reduce heat to low, and cook until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of oil. Form the salmon mixture into 2-inch rounded meatballs and place them in the baking dish. Place the dish in the oven and bake until set, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and ginger.
Combine garlic, ginger, soy sauce, honey, and vinegar in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook until slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes.
In a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.
Add cornstarch slurry to the saucepan in a steady stream while stirring quickly. Cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Once the salmon meatballs are done, pour the teriyaki sauce over the meatballs and gently toss to coat.
To serve, divide rice and salmon meatballs between plates. Garnish with sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Teriyaki Turkey Burger with Grilled Onions & Pineapple-Broccoli Slaw

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a small saucepan.
Add broth, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce to the saucepan with the ginger and garlic; whisk to combine. Place over high heat and bring to a boil.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth. Once the liquid in the saucepan comes to a boil, add slurry in a steady stream while whisking quickly. Let boil for 1 minute, then remove teriyaki sauce from heat and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and slice onion crosswise into thin rings. Transfer to a plate, drizzle with oil, and season with salt on both sides.
