Carefully turn the tofu planks over. Season with remaining spice mix and bread crumbs. Press down lightly with your hands to help the breadcrumbs adhere.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
When the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the tofu and cook until golden brown on one side, 3-4 minutes.
Using a spatula, carefully flip the tofu over and top each piece with Parmesan cheese. Cook until the other side has turned golden brown and the cheese has melted, 2-3 minutes.
Add the pasta back to the saucepan with the sauce and toss until well coated. Cook until heated through, 2-3 minutes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Divide pasta and sauce between bowls or dishes. Top with tofu and parsley. Enjoy!

name: Tofu & Soba Noodle Stir Fry with Spinach & Mushrooms

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water and bring to a boil. Add salt and noodles and stir for a few seconds. Cook according to package directions. Drain and rinse under cold water.
amounts: 6 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) soba (buckwheat) noodles

instructions.text: Drain and medium dice tofu; place on paper towels and pat dry. Transfer to a medium bowl, drizzle with soy sauce, and toss to combine.
Wash and dry spinach, mushrooms, and green onions. Thinly slice the mushrooms. Trim root ends and chop onions. Peel and mince garlic and ginger.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add tofu and, stirring occasionally, cook until browned, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
In a small bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together soy sauce, sesame oil, and honey.
Return skillet to stove and add more oil. Add garlic, ginger, and crushed red pepper. Cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add mushrooms and cook until just tender, 2-3 minutes. Add spinach and gently stir until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Return tofu to skillet. Add soba noodles, green onions, and sauce. Stir to combine and cook until heated through, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, place stir fry in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Tomato-Basil Soup with Cheddar Grilled Cheese

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Remove butter from fridge and allow to soften in the microwave or on the counter.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add onion and garlic; begin cooking while you chop the carrot and celery.
Wash and thinly slice carrot and celery; add to saucepan. Stirring occasionally, cook until carrots and celery have softened, 6-7 minutes.
Wash and medium dice tomatoes.
Wash basil. Pick leaves off the stems; discard the stems and thinly slice the leaves into ribbons.
Add fresh and canned tomatoes, broth, salt, and pepper to saucepan. Stir and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for about 10 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Heat a skillet over medium-low heat.
Grate ½ cup of cheddar.
Spread butter onto 1 side of each bread slice and place buttered-side down on a flat surface.

Divide cheddar between 2 of the bread slices and top with the other slices. Place in the skillet and gently press down with a spatula. Cook until cheese is melted and bread is golden brown, 2-4 minutes per side.
Add basil to the soup and stir. Purée soup until smooth using a hand or regular blender.
Pour soup into a bowl and service with grilled cheese on the side. Enjoy!

name: Tomato, Kale & Cannellini Bean Skillet with Parmesan Polenta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth and water to a boil. Reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta in a thin steady stream, while whisking, until the polenta is incorporated into the liquid. Cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and the texture is creamy, 15-25 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic; place both in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Add beans, tomatoes, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine, and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.
Add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 3-5 minutes.
While the kale cooks, finely grate Parmesan.
Add half the Parmesan, salt, and pepper to the polenta and stir to combine. If the polenta is too firm, add hot water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until you reach a desired consistency.
To serve, divide polenta between bowls; top with veggie-bean skillet and remaining Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Tomato, Mushroom & Kalamata Olive Penne with Parmesan

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain.
Wash tomatoes and mushrooms. Halve the tomatoes. Thinly slice the mushrooms. Peel and mince garlic.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic and crushed red pepper and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
amounts: about 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add tomatoes, mushrooms, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Stirring occasionally, cook until mushrooms are tender and tomatoes are juicy, 2-3 minutes.
Shave or grate Parmesan cheese.
Add olives and pasta to pan and toss to combine.
To serve, place pasta on a plate or in a bowl and garnish with Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: Tomato-Peach Spaghetti with Arugula, Olives, Almonds & Goat Cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ¼-cup cooking water before draining and set aside.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice, place in a small bowl, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add peaches, tomatoes, vinegar, and spices to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until peaches soften and tomatoes start to burst, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, roughly chop olives and place in the reserved bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl with the olives. (Set remaining basil aside for serving.)
Add pasta, reserved pasta water, olives, basil, and almonds to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly, 1-2 minutes more.
Add arugula to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the arugula to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and crumble goat cheese over top. Garnish with reserved basil and enjoy!

name: Tomato-Ricotta Toasts with Prosciutto & Arugula-Apricot Salad

instructions.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add prosciutto and cook until crispy, about 1 minute per side. Remove to a plate and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve apricots lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into ¼-inch thick slices and add to the bowl with the dressing. Set aside.
Slice tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds. Place on a plate, season with spices, and set aside.
Arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Spread toasted bread with ricotta, then top with tomatoes, basil, and crispy prosciutto.
Add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and apricots, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide toasts and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Tomato-Spinach Orzo with Ground Turkey, Parmesan & Parsley

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince shallot.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot, turkey, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.

Add broth, tomato sauce, and orzo to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed and orzo is desired firmness, 10-15 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in a small bowl.
Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the Parmesan, stir to combine, and set aside.
Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
When the orzo is done, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add half of the Parmesan-parsley mixture to the skillet and stir to combine. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining Parmesan mixture for serving.)
To serve, divide orzo between plates or bowls; top with reserved Parmesan mixture. Enjoy!

name: Tomato-White Bean Soup with Orzo, Kale & Parmesan

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 20 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is soft, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans.
Peel and thinly slice garlic.
When the onions are soft, add garlic and crushed red pepper to the pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add beans, tomatoes, and broth to the pan. Bring the soup to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
amounts: 20 fl oz (2 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
When the soup is slightly thickened, add orzo. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta is almost tender, 5-6 minutes more.
While the soup is cooking, finely grate Parmesan.

When the orzo is almost done, add kale to the pan in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the kale and orzo are tender, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Add vinegar and half of the Parmesan to the soup, then stir to combine. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Top with reserved Parmesan and drizzle with oil. Enjoy!

name: Tossed Skillet Lasagna with Zucchini, Carrot, Ricotta & Basil

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Break lasagna noodles into thirds. Once the water in the pan is boiling, uncover, add salt and broken noodles, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Once done, drain in a colander and set aside.
While the noodles are cooking, trim the zucchini and carrot. Run the peeler along the zucchini and carrot to make long, noodle-like strips. Place both in a medium bowl.
Medium dice tomato; add to the bowl with the zucchini and carrot.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Coarsely grate mozzarella.

When the veggies are done, add lasagna noodles, half of the basil, and tomato sauce to the skillet; stir to combine and continue to cook until heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Top lasagna with dollops of ricotta and sprinkle with mozzarella.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until the mozzarella is melted and golden, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide lasagna between plates or bowls and top with reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Tropical Fruit & Quinoa Salad with Honey-Lime Dressing

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Cut off skin from pineapple, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a large mixing bowl.

Wash mango, kiwifruit, bell pepper, and jalapeño. Peel the mango, slice flesh away from pit, and medium dice. Peel and medium dice the kiwifruit. Seed and medium dice bell pepper. Seed and mince jalapeño. Peel and small dice onion. Add ingredients to bowl with pineapple.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small mixing bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, lime juice, oil, honey, salt, and pepper.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Uncover quinoa, fluff with a fork, and add to bowl.
Pour dressing over top salad and toss.
To serve, divide salad between bowls and top with green onions. Enjoy!

name: Tuna Fritters with Basil-Scallion Sauce & Crunchy Carrot Avocado Salad

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and mince green onions; add half to the bowl with the dressing. (Place remaining green onions in a small bowl and set aside for the sauce.)
Peel, trim, and julienne or coarsely grate the carrots; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.

Halve chili pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl. (Be careful with chili peppers; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the bowl along with the pumpkin seeds. Gently stir to combine the salad and set aside.
Drain tuna, place in another medium bowl, and flake with a fork.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the tuna.
Add egg, bread crumbs, yogurt, and spices to the bowl; stir well to combine the tuna mixture.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, using a ⅓-cup measure, form the tuna mixture into ½-inch thick fritters; place on a plate.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fritters and cook until golden and warmed through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.

While the fritters are cooking, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add basil, yogurt, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the remaining green onions. Stir to combine the sauce.
To serve, divide fritters, salad, and sauce between plates. Enjoy!

name: Tuna-Gnocchi Skillet with Zucchini, Tomato, Fresh Mozzarella & Basil

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water in the pan is boiling, add salt and gnocchi; cook, stirring frequently, until cooked through, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
While the gnocchi are cooking, trim and medium dice zucchini. Place in a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the zucchini.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, capers, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until zucchini and onion soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, drain tuna, place in the reserved bowl, and flake with a fork.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Halve grape tomatoes and add to the bowl with the tuna.

When the veggies are soft, juice lemon into the skillet. Add cooked gnocchi, tuna, and tomatoes, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, medium dice mozzarella.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add mozzarella and basil to the skillet with the gnocchi, then stir to combine.
To serve, divide tuna-gnocchi skillet between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: "Tuna Melt" Fritters with Chopped Veggie Salad & Lemony Yogurt Sauce

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between a medium and a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Divide between the bowls. (Set small bowl aside for later use.)
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the medium bowl.
Drain tuna, add to the bowl, and flake with a fork.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Coarsely grate cheese. Add to the bowl along with egg, mayo, almond flour, chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the fritter mixture.
Using a ¼-cup measure, form the tuna mixture into ½-inch thick fritters and place on a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fritters and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into the small bowl with the parsley and garlic. Add yogurt, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the yogurt sauce.
Transfer ⅓ of the yogurt sauce to a clean medium bowl, add oil, and whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining yogurt sauce for serving.)

Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad.

name: "Tuna Melt" Quesadillas & Tomato-Carrot Soup with Parsley

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; peel and small dice onion. Place both in a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the garlic and onion.

Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, onion, carrot, and spices to the pan; cook, stirring often, until veggies begin to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Meanwhile, mince capers. Place in the reserved bowl along with mayo, vinegar, cumin, and pepper; stir to combine.

Add tomatoes, broth, and sugar to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and let simmer until veggies are completely soft, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the soup is cooking, drain tuna; flake into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the mayo mixture (do not mash).
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Trim, and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl (reserving the rest for the soup).
Grate cheese and add to the bowl; gently stir to combine the tuna filling.
Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide the tuna filling between them. Move the filling onto one half of each tortilla; fold in half to close.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add quesadillas and cook, flipping once, until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden, 1½-2 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, using a hand (or regular) blender, purée the soup until smooth. Alternatively, use a potato masher to crush the tomatoes (the soup will be chunkier).
Divide soup between bowls and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Serve with quesadillas on the side and enjoy!

name: Tuna Noodle Casserole with Peas & Creamy Mushroom Sauce

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and small dice onion. Wash and slice mushrooms.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Melt butter in pan. Add onion and mushrooms. Stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Sprinkle onion and mushrooms with flour; stir to coat.
Add milk, and stirring constantly, cook until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
Add tuna, peas, Parmesan, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir until well combined. Remove from heat.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Add pasta and toss to coat. Place in the oven and broil until golden, 3-4 minutes.
To serve, place pasta in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Tuna, Quinoa & Avocado Salad with Tomatoes, Cucumber & Feta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa and broth; bring to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces on an angle. Transfer to a large salad bowl.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes. Once done, remove the quinoa from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and large dice the flesh (cut into ¾-inch cubes). Add to the salad bowl.
Halve the grape tomatoes crosswise and add to the salad bowl.
Juice the lemon into a small bowl (that will be used to make the dressing).
To the lemon juice, add olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Drain the tuna and flake with a fork (while still in the can). Add to the salad bowl.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Add the feta to the salad bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork. Add to the salad bowl.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls and season with additional salt and pepper if desired. Enjoy!

name: Tuna Salad Lettuce Wraps with Avocado & Bell Pepper

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Separate the lettuce into leaves; wash and spin dry in a salad spinner. Alternatively, wash in a colander, then transfer to a clean towel and pat dry. Set aside.
Wash and dry the the remaining fresh produce.
Drain the tuna and transfer to a large salad bowl; flake with a fork.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Small dice the pepper (cut into ¼-inch cubes) and add to the salad bowl.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and small dice the flesh (cut into ¼-inch cubes). Add to the salad bowl.

Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add about ¾ of the cilantro to the salad bowl and save the rest for garnishing.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Add to the salad bowl.
Juice the lime and add to the salad bowl.
Add mayonnaise, Dijon, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper to the salad bowl; mix the salad until thoroughly coated in the dressing.
To serve, make the lettuce wraps by spooning the tuna salad into the doubled up lettuce leaves, then garnishing with the remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Tuna Salad Nicoise with Lemon-Caper Vinaigrette

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and large dice potato. Place potato and eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until potato can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash green beans and trim ends. Once water is boiling, uncover saucepan and add beans. Cook until bright green, 2-3 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water. Set aside.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon, parsley flakes, salt, and pepper. Stir in capers and set aside.
Wash and dry lettuce. Chop crosswise into 1 inch strips. Wash and halve tomatoes.
Measure out olives.
Drain and flake tuna.
amounts: 1 (6 oz) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Peel and quarter eggs.
To serve, arrange lettuce, potato, tomatoes, eggs, tuna, and olives in long sections on a plate and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Tuna Tossed Salad with Avocado, Artichoke, Tomato, Cucumber & Croutons

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut bread into 1-inch cubes.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread cubes and cook, stirring occasionally, until croutons are golden and toasted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the parsley. Add mayo, oil, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Medium dice tomato. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl.
Drain tuna and flake with a fork. Add to the bowl, along with mixed greens and cooled croutons, then toss to combine the salad.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Turkey, Artichoke, Dill & Feta Stuffed Peppers with Spinach Salad

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then arrange cut-side down.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are tender and charred, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and onion; cook, stirring often, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add ground turkey and spices to the skillet; continue to cook, breaking the turkey apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the turkey is cooking, using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the skillet with the cooked turkey.
Mince olives and artichokes; add both to the skillet along with half the feta (reserving the rest for topping the peppers). Stir to combine the filling.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Divide turkey filling between pepper halves and top with reserved feta. Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until cheese is golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 2 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Mince walnuts. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the spinach; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide peppers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Turkey Bacon Burgers with Napa Cabbage & Carrot Sesame Slaw

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings. Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 4-5 minutes. Once done, transfer onions to a bowl and return skillet to medium heat.
Finely chop bacon.
In a medium bowl, combine turkey, bacon, paprika, garlic powder, ground cumin, and black pepper. Mix well and form into 4 patties.
Place the patties in the skillet; cook until they are cooked through and browned, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer patties to a plate.
In a salad bowl, whisk together soya sauce, apple cider vinegar, honey, sesame oil, and sesame seeds.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise and add to the salad bowl.
Trim the ends and peel the carrot; discard the trimmings and coarsely grate the carrots. Add to the salad bowl and toss to combine.
Separate the lettuce head into leaves. Slice the tomato crosswise into ¼-inch-thick rounds.
To serve, place each patty on a lettuce leaf and top with a slice of tomato and grilled onions, arrange salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Turkey "Banh Mi" Rice Bowl with Pickled Veggies, Cilantro & Mint

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and halve radishes lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, stir to coat, and set aside.
Zest and juice lime into a small bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the herbs to the bowl with the lime juice. (Reserve remaining herbs for serving.)
Add fish sauce, mayo, and chili-garlic sauce to the bowl. Stir to combine the lime-herb sauce and set aside.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onion and garlic; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add turkey, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Once the turkey is done, add the lime-herb sauce and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide the turkey, rice, and pickled veggies between bowls. Top with reserved herbs and enjoy!

name: Turkey-Basil Fettuccine with Bell Peppers & Broccoli

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes; drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper into thin strips; place in a medium bowl.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add turkey and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
While the turkey is cooking, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
When the turkey is done, add veggies to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the veggies are done, sprinkle with flour and continue to cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add milk, salt, and pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens, 4-5 minutes.
Add drained pasta and basil to the skillet; toss to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Turkey, Brussels Sprout & Goat Cheese Pita with Beet-Arugula Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and thinly slice Brussels sprouts; place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add garlic, turkey, and spices. Cook, breaking the turkey apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.

Once the turkey is done, add Brussels sprouts and cranberries to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the sprouts are just tender, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
Meanwhile, zest lemon into a small bowl and set aside. (Reserve lemon for the next step.)
Juice lemon into the reserved bowl; add mayo, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, peel, and coarsely grate beet; add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
When the sprouts are done, crumble goat cheese into the skillet, add lemon zest, and stir to combine the turkey filling.
Cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets; stuff each pocket with turkey filling.
To serve, divide pita pockets and salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: Turkey Burger Lettuce Wrap with Special Sauce, Blue Cheese & Mushrooms

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.text: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Place turkey, egg, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 2 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the mushrooms, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are soft, 8-10 minutes.
While the mushrooms are cooking, place mayo, ketchup, Dijon, and cayenne in another small bowl. Whisk to combine the special sauce and set aside.
When the mushrooms are done, add additional vinegar and cook until dry, 15-30 seconds. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, until golden underneath, about 5 minutes; flip patties, and cook an additional 5-6 minutes, until cooked through. Add burgers to the plate with the mushrooms and re-cover with foil.
Meanwhile, place additional oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, and separate lettuce into leaves. Set aside two leaves per burger and chop (or tear) remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Pile lettuce leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, on each plate; top with special sauce, burgers, mushrooms, blue cheese, and pickled onions. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: "Turkey Burger" Salad with Avocado, Tomato, Cheddar & Thousand Island

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; mince capers. Place both in a small bowl along with yogurt, ketchup, mayo, vinegar, water, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Halve tomatoes and place on a plate.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the plate with the tomatoes.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the plate.
Coarsely grate cheese and add to the plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince additional garlic.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ground turkey, garlic, and spices to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: ¾ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, chop or tear romaine leaves into bite-sized pieces.
Divide the romaine between plates or bowls; top with tomato, avocado, cheese, and turkey crumble. Sprinkle with green onions and serve with dressing on the side. Enjoy!

name: Turkey Burger Salad with Spinach, Mango, Avocado & Spicy Lime Aioli

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Place turkey, bread crumbs, egg, and spices in a medium bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, zest and juice lime into a small bowl. Add mayo and spices, then whisk to combine the aioli. Set aside.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, until golden underneath, about 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-6 minutes, until cooked through. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Place on a clean plate.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; thinly slice the flesh. Add to the plate with the bell pepper.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the plate.
To serve, divide spinach between plates or bowls. Top with bell pepper, mango, avocado, and burger patties. Drizzle with aioli and enjoy!

name: Turkey Chili-Style Soup with White Beans, Peppers & Bread Crumbs

Add beans, broth, tomatoes, and hot sauce to the pan; stir to combine the soup, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.

name: Turkey Cranberry Burger with Onion, Goat Cheese & Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is soft and caramelized, 15-20 minutes.

instructions.text: Meanwhile, roughly chop cranberries and place in a medium bowl.
Add turkey, bread crumbs, and spices to the bowl with the cranberries. Mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, place vinegar, oil, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, quarter, and core apple; small dice. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl, along with additional cranberries, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: When the onions are done, add vinegar and Worcestershire to the pan, then stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Toast buns if desired.
Crumble goat cheese into a small bowl.

Place bottom half of each bun on a plate; layer with burger patties, onions, goat cheese, and a small portion of the salad. Close with the top half of each bun and serve with remaining salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Turkey "Egg Roll in a Bowl" with Spicy Mayo

instructions.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the ground turkey to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon until nearly cooked through, 3-4 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice onion. Add both to the skillet.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Add to the skillet with the turkey and sauté for 30 seconds.
Peel the carrots and trim off the ends, then julienne or coarsely grate. Add to the skillet.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into shreds and add to the skillet.
Season veggies and turkey with soy sauce and crushed red pepper; stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage and carrots have softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle, set aside.

When cabbage is cooked, drain off excess liquid, and turn the heat down to low. Make a well in the center of the skillet and crack the egg into it. Scramble until no longer runny, 1-2 minutes, then stir to combine.
In a small bowl mix together chili-garlic sauce, salt, and mayo.
To serve divide egg roll mixture between bowls, top with green onions, sesame seeds and spicy mayo. Enjoy!

name: Turkey-Feta Meatballs with Lemony Tahini Sauce, Roasted Carrots & Mint

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Drizzle carrots with oil and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until carrots are tender and golden brown, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Divide between a medium and a small bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems. Mince half of the leaves and add to the medium bowl. Roughly chop (or tear) remaining leaves and add to the small bowl; set aside for serving.

Add turkey, feta, bread crumbs, egg, and spices to the medium bowl; use your hands to combine the turkey mixture. Using a tablespoon measure, form the mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning often, until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Remove from heat.
When the carrots are golden, remove from the oven and toss. Add meatballs to the baking sheet, nestling them into the carrots.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until the carrots are deep brown and meatballs are cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice half of the lemon into another small bowl. Cut remaining lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Add tahini, water, and spices to the bowl with the lemon juice. Whisk to combine the sauce.
Divide carrots and meatballs between plates; drizzle meatballs with tahini sauce and top veggies with reserved green onion and mint. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!

name: Turkey Fried Rice with Carrots, Peas & Scallions

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel the carrots, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Small dice the carrots into ¼-inch cubes. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the carrots.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger. Add to the bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Transfer to a small bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the ground turkey to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a bowl, leaving some of the juices in the skillet.
In a small bowl, whisk the egg.
Once the turkey has been transferred, add the carrots, onion, ginger, garlic, and peas to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until the carrots are tender, 2 to 4 minutes.
Move the vegetables to one side of the skillet and pour the egg on the other side. Scramble the egg until cooked and mix with the vegetables.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
Add the rice, turkey, ½ of the green onions (save the rest for garnishing), and soy sauce to the vegetables. Stir until well combined and heated through, 1 to 2 minutes.
To serve, divide the fried rice between bowls and garnish with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!

name: Turkey Lasagna Soup with Zucchini, Spinach, and Ricotta

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Add ground turkey, garlic, onion powder, and crushed red pepper to the pot. Cook, breaking apart the meat with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3 to 4 minutes.
Small dice the zucchini.
Add the zucchini, tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, broth, and spices to the pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Break the lasagna noodles into bite-sized pieces. Add to the pot and stir; cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful; cook until fully wilted, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and top with a large spoonful of ricotta and parsley. Enjoy!

name: Turkey "Meatball" Pita Pizza with Creamy Oregano & Olive Romaine Salad

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place mayo, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, halve lengthwise, and cut cucumber crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
Halve olives lengthwise and add to the bowl; set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince shallot and garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot, garlic, turkey, and spices; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate mozzarella and set aside.
Add tomato sauce to the skillet with the turkey and stir to combine. Remove from heat.

Arrange pitas on a baking sheet pan. Divide turkey mixture between the pitas and top with cheese. Place in the oven and bake until the cheese is melted, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into wedges.
Meanwhile, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the veggies.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl (reserving the rest for the pizzas) and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pizzas and salad between plates. Sprinkle pizzas with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Turkey Meatball Quinoa Bowl with Romaine, Basil Dressing & Pine Nuts

instructions.text: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add pine nuts and cook, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
In a small saucepan, combine water, quinoa, and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between a medium and another small bowl. (Set small bowl aside for the dressing.)

Add turkey, bread crumbs, and spices to the medium bowl with the basil. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Use a tablespoon measure to form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and shallot. Add both to the small bowl with the basil along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the lettuce and toss to combine.
To serve, divide quinoa, meatballs, lettuce, and tomatoes between bowls. Drizzle with dressing, sprinkle with pine nuts, and enjoy!

name: Turkey Meatballs with Baked Zucchini Noodles, Cream Sauce & Parsley

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.

Wash, dry, and trim zucchini; run a vegetable peeler along the length of the zucchini to make ribbons. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and bake, tossing halfway through, until zucchini is tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a medium bowl (reserve remaining parsley for serving).
Add turkey, bread crumbs, egg, and spices to the bowl with the parsley; use your hands to combine. Using a tablespoon measure, form the mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning often, until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer meatballs to a clean plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for next step.)

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add broth, cream, Worcestershire, Dijon, and salt. Whisk to combine the sauce and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 4-5 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: Return meatballs to the skillet along with any juices from the plate. Gently stir to cover with sauce.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until meatballs are cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide zucchini noodles, meatballs, and sauce between plates. Top with remaining parsley and enjoy!

name: Turkey Meatballs with Cherry Sauce & Sweet Pea-Mint Rice Pilaf

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash, dry, and pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining mint for the rice.)
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the mint along with turkey, egg, bread crumbs, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Once done, transfer to a clean plate (leaving the cooking juices in the skillet) and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, place cherries in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw; transfer to a cutting board and roughly chop.

Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat; add cherries, water, honey, and spices. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer; reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened slightly, about 5 minutes.
Return meatballs to the skillet and continue to cook, turning occasionally, until warmed through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Place peas in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw; set aside to drain.
Once the rice is done, add peas and reserved mint; gently stir to combine the rice pilaf.
To serve, divide rice pilaf, meatballs, and cherry sauce between plates. Enjoy!

name: Turkey Meatballs with Sautéed Kale & Lemon Parsley Dressing

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Peel and mince garlic; set aside in a small bowl.
Peel and small dice the shallot and add to a large bowl.
Add ⅓ of the minced garlic, ground turkey, egg, almond flour, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the shallot and mix with your hands until well combined.

Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of olive oil. Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place in the dish. Place in the oven and bake until cooked through, about 18 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.
Wash and dry lemon, then zest into the bowl with the parsley; add oil and ⅓ of the garlic and stir to combine the dressing. Save the lemon to juice later.
Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the remaining ⅓ of the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Juice the lemon into the skillet; add kale and spices. Cook, stirring frequently, for 1-2 minutes.
Add broth, cover with a lid, and cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Top kale with meatballs, then remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, divide kale and meatballs between dishes and top with parsley dressing. Enjoy!

name: Turkey Patties over Tex-Mex Caesar with Black Beans & Tortilla Chips

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Trim and mince green onions; place both in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the herbs along with turkey and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined.
Using a ⅓-cup measure, form turkey mixture into ½-inch thick patties. Place on a plate.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, place corn in a colander. Drain beans in the colander with the corn, rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw, and set aside to drain further.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add turkey patties to the pan and cook, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, cut each tortilla into bite-sized strips and place on a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with chili powder and salt, and toss to coat; spread out in a single layer. Place in the oven and bake, flipping once, until golden and crispy, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
While the tortilla chips are baking, finely grate Parmesan; place in another medium bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic; add to bowl with the Parmesan.
Juice lime into the bowl; add yogurt, oil, Worcestershire, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl along with the corn and beans. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with turkey patties and tortilla chips. Enjoy!

name: Turkey Patties with Roasted Potatoes & Garlic Green Beans

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.

Wash, dry, and quarter potatoes. Place on one half of a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake for 15 minutes.
Wash, trim, and mince green onions. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Add turkey, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the onion and garlic; mix until well combined.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Place almond meal on a plate. Using a ¼ cup measure, portion and form the turkey mixture into ½-inch thick patties and add to the plate. Dredge patties to coat, pressing gently to adhere.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add turkey patties and cook, turning once, until golden and almost cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to another baking sheet pan and place in the oven; bake until cooked through, 8 minutes more.
Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with the oil, salt, and pepper.
Wash, dry, and trim beans. Add to the bowl with the garlic oil and toss to coat.
Remove the first baking sheet pan from the oven and toss the potatoes. Add beans and return to the oven. Bake until veggies are fork-tender, stirring once, about 8 minutes.
To serve, divide turkey patties, potatoes, and beans between plates. Enjoy!

name: "Turkey Piccata" Meatball Skillet with Chard, Capers & Roast Potatoes

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve new potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until potatoes are golden and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, place turkey, bread crumbs, egg, and spices in a medium bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs. Place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Roughly chop capers. Place both in a small bowl.

Fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Add stems to the small bowl with the shallot and capers; reserve leaves for later use.

Return skillet to medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot, capers, chard stems, and flour; cook, stirring frequently, until chard stems soften, about 2 minutes.

Zest and juice lemon into the skillet, then add broth, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 2-3 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the sauce has thickened, add chard leaves to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for them to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat, add meatballs and half of the parsley, then stir to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
To serve, divide meatballs, sauce, and potatoes between plates. Top meatballs with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Turkey Shepherd's Pie with Mixed Vegetables & Parmesan Potatoes

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 10 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice the potatoes.
Add the potatoes to a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer, 10-12 minutes, until potatoes are fork-tender.
Peel and mince the onion. Peel and small dice the carrot.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the carrot and onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add the ground turkey to the skillet and break it apart with a spatula. Add half of the minced parsley and the spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is browned, 6-8 minutes.
Preheat oven to broil on high.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Add the Worcestershire sauce and garlic to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute.
Add the flour and tomato paste to the skillet. Stir well, then add the broth, peas, and corn. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the potatoes are done, drain and return to the saucepan. Add the butter, broth, garlic powder, and salt; mash with a potato masher until smooth.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Finely grate the Parmesan.
Transfer the turkey mixture to a small baking dish and spread evenly. Top with mashed potatoes and Parmesan. Place in the oven and broil for 2-3 minutes, until the cheese begins to brown.
To serve, divide the Shepherd's pie between plates and garnish with remaining parsley. Enjoy!

name: Turkey Smash Tacos with Guacamole & Pickled Onion-Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add half to the bowl with the pickling liquid. Place remaining onion in a medium bowl and set aside.
Trim and small dice cucumber. Add to the small bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Place turkey and spices in another medium bowl. Mix with your hands until well combined.

Arrange tortillas on a flat surface, then divide the turkey mixture between them (about 3 tablespoons per tortilla). Using a knife (or your hands), spread the turkey mixture over the surface of each tortilla in an even layer.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add tacos, meat-side down. Cook, pressing down once with the bottom of a spatula halfway through cooking, until the turkey is cooked through, about 3 minutes.
Flip tacos, turkey-side up, and continue to cook until tortillas are golden underneath, 1 minute more. Transfer to a plate and carefully fold in half to form tacos.
Meanwhile, juice half of the lime into the medium bowl with the onion (cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving).
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Add to the bowl along with salt and pepper. Mash with a fork or potato masher until guacamole is smooth.
Small dice tomato. Add to the bowl with the guacamole and stir to combine.
Divide tacos between plates; fill with guacamole and a small amount of salad. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Turkey-Spinach Meatballs with Rotini Pasta, Mixed Veggie Sauce & Basil

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Finely chop half of the spinach and place in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining spinach for the sauce.)
Finely grate Parmesan and add to the bowl with the chopped spinach.
Add turkey and spices to the bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Using a ¼-cup measure, form turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs to the skillet and cook, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Once done, transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
While the meatballs are cooking, peel and mince onion and garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Trim and small dice celery; add both to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
When the pasta is done, drain in a colander. Return pasta to the pan, cover, and set aside to keep warm.
Return the skillet to medium heat. Add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add the veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Add tomato sauce, water, and spices to the skillet with the veggies and stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half of the basil to the sauce and stir to combine (set remaining basil aside for garnish).
Add reserved spinach to the sauce in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Return meatballs to the skillet with the sauce, stir gently to combine, and simmer until warmed though, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide pasta, sauce, and meatballs between bowls. Top with remaining basil and enjoy!

name: Turkey Stew with Carrot, Celery, Parsley & Peas over Rice

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice carrots; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a small bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the carrot and celery.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey, veggies, and spices; cook, breaking the turkey apart with a spoon, until the veggies are softened and turkey is browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the turkey is done, add tomatoes, broth, peas, and soy sauce to the pan; stir to combine and bring the stew to a boil.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, in the reserved bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.
Once the stew is boiling, reduce heat to medium, and add the slurry in a steady stream while stirring. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 2 minutes more.
Add half of the parsley to the stew, stir to combine, and remove from heat. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
To serve, divide rice and stew between bowls; sprinkle with reserved parsley and enjoy!

name: Turkey Taco Pita Pizza with Lime Crema & Mango-Tomato Mixed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine; set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add the turkey, spice mix, and half of the green onions (reserving the rest for garnish). Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, arrange pitas on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 5 minutes.
Remove pitas from oven and evenly spread with tomato sauce; top with turkey. Return baking sheet to the oven and bake until pizzas are warmed through, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.

While the pizzas are baking, juice half of the lime into the reserved bowl (set remaining lime aside for the dressing). Add yogurt and additional spices, then whisk to combine the lime crema; set aside.
Juice remaining lime into a medium bowl; add oil and additional spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; small dice and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Add mixed greens to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pizzas and salad between plates; drizzle pizzas with lime crema and top with reserved green onion. Enjoy!

name: Turkey Taco Rice Bowl with Pico de Gallo & Avocado Slices

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Quarter the grape tomatoes and transfer to a medium salad bowl (that will hold the pico de gallo salsa).
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Juice the lime and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces. Transfer one ½ of the diced onion to the salad bowl and the other ½ to a small bowl.
Add coconut oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
In a small bowl, combine and mix together chili powder, cumin, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add the remaining onion; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the ground turkey to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the spice mixture to the onion and turkey; stir until fragrant and well combined into the mixture, 15 to 30 seconds.
Season the pico de gallo with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
Remove the pit from the avocado with a knife or spoon; thinly slice the flesh crosswise (without piercing the skin) and scoop out. Transfer to a small bowl.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, arrange the rice, ground turkey, pico de gallo, and avocado slices in bowls. Enjoy!

name: Turkey & Vegetable Chili with Avocado, Cheddar & Cilantro

instructions.text: Peel and small dice onion; transfer to a medium bowl. Peel and mince garlic; add to bowl.
Wash bell pepper, celery, and jalapeño. Seed and small dice bell pepper. Trim ends and small dice celery. Seed and mince jalapeño.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add oil to saucepan and swirl to coat bottom. Add onion, garlic, bell pepper, celery, and jalapeño. Cook, stirring frequently, until vegetables have softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add ground turkey to the vegetables and cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
Add chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Add tomatoes and stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until chili is slightly reduced in volume, 8-10 minutes.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and chop the leaves. Stir about ½ into the chili and save the rest for garnishing.
Halve and pit avocado. Scoop out the flesh and medium dice.
Grate ½ cup of cheddar.
Cut lime into wedges.
Serve chili in a bowl and garnish with avocado, cheddar, cilantro, and lime. Enjoy!

name: Turkey Vegetable Stir-Fry with Carrot & Cilantro-Tossed Rice Noodles

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, halve, and small dice zucchini; trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Place both in a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies, turkey, and pepper. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; place in the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the carrot and set aside.

When the turkey is done, add soy sauce, honey, and chili-garlic sauce to the skillet; stir to combine. Continue to cook until veggies are tender and sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes more; remove from heat.
When the noodles are done, drain and rinse under cool water. Add to the bowl with the carrot and cilantro.
Juice lime into the bowl, add oil, and toss to combine.
To serve, divide noodles and turkey vegetable stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Turkey-Zucchini Patty, Roast Pepper & Lemon-Feta Yogurt Pita Pockets

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
