Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Transfer both to a baking sheet pan.

Trim and halve zucchini crosswise. Quarter one half of the zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the baking sheet with the onion and pepper. (Reserve the other half of the zucchini for the patties.)
Peel and mince garlic. Sprinkle over the veggies, then drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't need to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate the remaining zucchini and place in a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the zucchini along with turkey and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined.
Using a ¼-cup measure, form turkey mixture into ½-inch thick patties. Place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the patties and cook, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a small bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with feta, yogurt, Italian seasoning, and salt. Stir to combine the sauce and set aside.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets. Spread each pocket with yogurt sauce, then stuff with roasted veggies and patties.
To serve, divide pita pockets between plates. Enjoy!

name: Turkish-Spiced Bell Peppers with Garlic Yogurt, Eggs, Chili Oil & Pita

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.

Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the baking sheet with the peppers. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are browned and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add spices and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Carefully transfer hot oil to a small bowl and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Zest and juice half of the lemon into another small bowl. (Reserve remaining lemon for later use.)
Add yogurt, garlic powder, and salt to the bowl with the lemon. Whisk to combine the garlicky yogurt and set aside.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt.
Meanwhile, pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Add mint to the baking sheet with the roasted veggies, then squeeze reserved lemon over top and stir to combine.
Toast pita breads (if desired), then cut into wedges.
Divide garlicky yogurt between plates or bowls. Top with roasted veggies and eggs, then drizzle with chili oil. Serve with pita on the side and enjoy!

name: Turkish Steak Wrap with Arugula, Tomato, Cucumber & Olive Salad

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and cook, flipping once, until desired doneness, 4-5 minutes for medium-rare. Transfer to a clean plate and cover loosely with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and slice shallot into thin rings. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, dill, and salt.
Small dice tomato and add to the bowl.
Trim cucumber, quarter lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl.
Halve olives and add to bowl.
Add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Return the grill pan to medium-high heat. Working in batches if necessary, place tortillas in the pan and warm, flipping occasionally, until lightly charred, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Place tortillas on a flat surface and spread evenly with yogurt. Divide steak and ⅓ of the salad between them; roll tightly to close and cut in half.
Divide wraps between plates; serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Tuscan Bread Salad (Panzanella) with Bacon, Peaches & Fresh Mozzarella

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate, leaving the drippings in the skillet.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Using a clean cutting board, cut or tear bread into bite-sized pieces.
Return skillet (with bacon drippings) to low heat. Add bread and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and crisp, 4-5 minutes. Remove from the heat.
While the croutons are cooking, peel, halve, and slice shallot into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; halve tomatoes. Add both to the bowl.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice each quarter and add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl.
Medium dice mozzarella and add to the bowl along with the croutons; toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with bacon and enjoy!

name: Tuscan Kale & White Bean Soup with Toast

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off the ends and peel the carrots; discard the peels and trimmings. Small dice the carrots (cut into ¼-inch cubes) and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and add to the bowl with the carrots.
Open the can of beans, but don't drain.
Add olive oil to the saucepan and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the carrots and onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables have softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
One by one, holding a sprig of rosemary at its top, run you fingers down it to remove the leaves. Discard the sprigs and chop the leaves; transfer the leaves to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the minced garlic and crushed red pepper to the saucepan; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the beans and their liquid, broth, rosemary, salt, and pepper to the saucepan. Increase the heat to high and bring to a boil.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: When the soup comes to a boil, reduce the heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 10 minutes.
While the soup cooks, fold each kale leaf lengthwise, slice away and discard the stems, and chop the leaves into 1-inch pieces.
Finely grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Uncover the saucepan, stir in the kale and ½ of the Parmesan (save the rest for garnishing), then cover again and continue to cook until the kale is wilted, 2 to 3 minutes.
Slice the bun in half and toast (optional).
To serve, ladle the soup into a bowl and garnish with the remaining Parmesan. Serve with the toasted bun on the side. Enjoy!

name: Tuscan Onion Soup (Carabaccia) with Sourdough Toast, Fried Egg & Salad

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-low heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are very soft but not brown, 12-15 minutes. (Reduce heat, if necessary, to keep the onions from browning.)
Meanwhile, place almond flour, vinegar, and cinnamon in a small bowl. Stir to combine.
When the onions are done, add almond mixture to the pan and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 1 minute more. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Add broth to the pan with the onion, stir to combine the soup, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until flavors are blended, 7-8 minutes.
amounts: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan, place in the reserved bowl, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread slices and pan-fry until toasted on one side, about 1 minute.

Remove bread to a plate and add more oil to the skillet. Return bread to the skillet, toasted-side up, and continue to pan-fry until toasted on the other side, 1 minute more. Return to the plate. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)

Return skillet to medium-high heat and add more oil. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, place additional oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: When the soup is done, add Parmesan, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide soup between bowls, then top with toasted bread and eggs. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: Tuscan Panzanella Salad with White Beans

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans; set aside to drain further.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a large salad bowl.
To the garlic, add olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces at an angle. Add to the salad bowl.
Halve the grape tomatoes and add to the salad bowl.

Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves into a chiffonade by stacking them and rolling tightly into a cigar, then slicing crosswise into thin ribbons. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds. Add to the salad bowl.
Large dice the mozzarella into ¾-inch cubes and add to the salad bowl.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Add olive oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Large dice the bun or roll into ¾-inch cubes.
Once the skillet is hot, add the bread cubes and cook, stirring frequently, until toasted and browned, 4 to 6 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.
Once the bread has been transferred, add the beans to the skillet and season with salt and pepper; cook until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the beans and bread cubes to the salad bowl; toss to combine.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Two-Cheese Chicken, Spinach & Artichoke Melts

ingredients.name: marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Cut chicken into thin strips.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add chicken and spices to the skillet; sauté until golden brown and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Transfer chicken to a medium bowl and cover with foil.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic.
Wash, dry, and finely chop spinach. (Skip washing if it came pre-washed.)
Grate mozzarella and Parmesan.
Drain and finely chop artichokes.
amounts: ½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.text: Return skillet to medium heat. Add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add garlic to the skillet and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.

Add mozzarella, Parmesan, artichokes, yogurt, and salt to the skillet. Stir until combined and cheese has melted. Transfer mixture to the bowl with the chicken and stir to combine. Wipe skillet clean and return to medium heat.
Place bread slices on a flat surface. Top half the slices with the spinach-chicken mixture. Cover sandwiches with remaining bread slices.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes.

Remove sandwiches to a plate and add more butter to the skillet; return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side-up, and cook until golden brown on the other side, 2-4 minutes more. Once done, transfer to a cutting board.
To serve, cut sandwiches in half and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: Two-Cheese Eggplant Bake with Marinara & Parsley

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, and trim eggplant; slice into ¼-inch thick rounds.
Place eggplant in a medium bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Arrange eggplant in a single layer on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and roast, flipping halfway through, until eggplant is soft, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half the parsley in a small bowl (setting the rest aside for garnish).
Add tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, and salt to the bowl with the parsley; stir to combine.
Grate mozzarella. Finely grate Parmesan.

Pour a thin layer of tomato sauce in the bottom of a small baking dish. Place half the roasted eggplant slices in the dish, arranging them in a single layer; top with half of the remaining sauce and half of the mozzarella and Parmesan. Repeat with the remaining eggplant, sauce, and cheese.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until eggplant is warmed through and cheese is melted and bubbly, about 10 minutes.
Remove dish from the oven and top with remaining parsley.
To serve, divide eggplant bake between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: Two Cheese Spinach & Chicken Bake with Roasted Zucchini

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Add to a medium bowl along with the oil and spices. Stir to combine and set aside.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry the spinach (skip if it came pre-washed).
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add garlic and spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful; cook until the spinach is fully wilted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Coarsely grate the mozzarella.
Coat the bottom of a baking dish with oil. Place chicken fillets in the dish.

Spread ricotta over the top of each chicken fillet. Top each with spinach and mozzarella. Place the baking dish in the oven and cook until the cheese is melted and the chicken is cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and medium dice the zucchini; place in a medium bowl. Add the oil, Italian seasoning, and salt; stir to combine.
Spread the zucchini in a single layer on a baking sheet and place in the oven. Cook until zucchini is fork-tender, 12-15 minutes.
To serve, divide the chicken and zucchini between plates. Enjoy!

name: Two Cheese Spinach & Mushroom Baked Quesadillas

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Wash, dry, and slice mushrooms.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add mushrooms and garlic to the skillet; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the mushrooms are soft, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and roughly chop spinach. (Skip washing if the spinach came pre-washed.)
Grate the cheeses.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove skillet from heat.
To assemble the quesadillas, lay the tortillas on a flat surface; divide cheeses and veggie mixture between them, arranging the filling on one half of the tortilla.
Fold tortillas in half and transfer to the baking sheet. Coat tops of the quesadillas with half the oil, carefully flip, and coat the other side with remaining oil.
Place quesadillas in the oven and bake for 5 minutes. Remove from the oven, carefully flip, and continue to bake until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden brown, 5-6 minutes more.
Cut quesadillas into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with a side of yogurt for dipping. Enjoy!

name: Unstuffed Cabbage Rolls

instructions.text: Rinse the rice in a colander and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until liquid is absorbed, 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from the heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 1-inch pieces and transfer to a large bowl.
Peel and small dice the onion.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince the garlic.
Add the beef, onion, and garlic to the skillet; cook, breaking apart the meat into smaller pieces, until the beef is browned and the onion is tender, 3 to 5 minutes.

Add the diced tomatoes and cabbage and season with salt and pepper. If the cabbage doesn't fit, cook it down and add the rest after. Reduce heat to medium and cover. Cook until the cabbage is softened, 10 to 15 minutes.
Trim the stem ends and peel the carrot; discard the trimmings and coarsely grate the carrot.
Once the cabbage is softened, add the grated carrots and rice to the skillet; stir to combine. Cook until the carrots are softened, 1 to 2 minutes.
Divide the lazy cabbage rolls between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container). Enjoy!

name: Upside-Down Beef "Cottage Pie" with Spinach, Peas & Sweet Potato Mash

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and medium dice sweet potato. Place in a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the liquid in the saucepan is boiling, reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer until sweet potato is tender, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally until softened, about 5 minutes.
While the onion is cooking, peel, trim, and small dice carrot. Trim and small dice celery.
Once the onion is soft, add the carrot and celery. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 2-3 minutes.
While the veggies are cooking, peel and mince garlic.
Add garlic, beef, and spices to the skillet. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until the beef is browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
When the sweet potatoes are done, drain and return to the pan. Add oil and spices; using a potato masher, mash until smooth. Cover to keep warm and set aside.
When the beef is done, add peas and vinegar to the skillet. Stir to combine.

Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine, and continue to cook until peas are warmed through, 1 minute more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide sweet potato mash between plates or bowls; top with beef-veggie filling. Enjoy!

name: Vegan Beet "Poke" Bowl with Edamame, Snap Peas, Carrots & Sesame Mayo

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Trim, peel, and cut beets into ½-inch cubes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to coat.
Spread beets out in an even layer; place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and roast, stirring halfway through, until fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain further.
Peel and grate carrots; transfer to a plate.
Cut snap peas crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle; add to the plate.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out onto the plate. Set veggies aside.
Place mayo, water, tahini, and salt in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sesame mayo and set aside.
Mince chives. Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with vinegar, soy sauce, and maple syrup. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Transfer roasted beets to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the "poke."
To serve, divide rice between bowls. Arrange beet "poke," edamame, and veggies on top. Drizzle with sesame mayo and enjoy!

name: Vegan "BLT" Salad with Tofu Bacon, Avocado & Garlic Croutons

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Place soy sauce, maple syrup, oil, and spices in a baking dish; whisk to combine the marinade.
amounts: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Cut tofu into ¼-inch thick planks along the short side; sandwich the slices between clean towels or paper towels and gently press to remove excess water. Add to the marinade in a single layer, turn to coat, and set aside.
While the tofu bacon marinates, peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil and spices; whisk to combine the garlic oil.
Cut bread into cubes and add to the bowl with the garlic oil. Toss to combine the croutons, transfer to a baking sheet pan, and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake, tossing halfway through, until the croutons are golden and crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Add the baking dish to the oven and bake until tofu bacon is firm and marinade has been absorbed, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear the romaine into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
Right before serving, add croutons to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, top with tofu bacon, and enjoy!

name: Vegan Caesar Salad with Kale, Kidney Beans & Herbed Croutons

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Grate zest from the lemon into a salad bowl. Add oil and spices, then whisk to combine.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to the bowl.
Cut or tear the bun into bite-sized pieces and place in the bowl; toss to coat. Transfer croutons to a baking sheet pan. Reserve bowl for later use.
Place croutons in the oven and cook, tossing halfway through, until golden and crisp, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a blender.

Peel garlic; add to blender along with cashews, water, nutritional yeast, capers, soy sauce, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Blend until smooth; adding water, 1 tbsp at a time, if needed, to make a thick dressing; transfer to the salad bowl.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until slightly softened.
Chop or tear romaine leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl.
Add beans to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with croutons. Enjoy!

name: Vegan "Cheeseburger" Salad with Veggie Ground, Tomato & Mushrooms

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and medium dice onion.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, veggie ground, and spices; cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place nutritional yeast, oil, vinegar, soy sauce, water, sugar, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and cut crosswise into thin slices.
To serve, divide salad between bowls, then top with veggie ground and avocado. Enjoy!

name: Vegan "Mac & Cheese" with Roasted Mushrooms, Tomatoes, Peppers & Basil

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.

Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat and drain in a colander. (Reserve pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Thinly slice mushrooms and transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the baking sheet with the mushrooms.
Add tomatoes to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, tossing once, until veggies are tender and tomatoes start to burst, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.

When the pasta is done, place almond milk, nutritional yeast, oil, arrowroot starch, Dijon, onion powder, and garlic powder in the reserved saucepan; whisk until smooth. Place the pan over medium heat and bring the sauce to a simmer, whisking occasionally.
amounts: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) almond milk, unsweetened

instructions.text: Once the sauce is simmering, continue to cook, whisking constantly, until the sauce becomes thick and stretchy, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Return drained pasta to the pan with the cheese sauce, add half of the basil (reserving the rest for serving), and stir to combine.
If needed, warm the mac & cheese over medium heat, stirring constantly, until heated through, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide mac & cheese between plates or bowls; top with roasted veggies and reserved basil. Enjoy!

name: Vegetable & Cashew Stir Fry with Basmati Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash broccoli, bell pepper, and sugar snap peas.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets, cut stem into smaller pieces, and transfer to a large bowl. Seed, medium dice, and add bell pepper to bowl. Halve peas and add to bowl.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and mince or grate ginger.
In a small bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together soy sauce and cornstarch.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic, ginger, and crushed red pepper. Cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add all the vegetables from the bowl to skillet. Stir fry until tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Add sauce and cashews to skillet. Stir fry until vegetables and cashews are well coated with sauce, 1-2 minutes.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
Place rice in a bowl and top with stir fry. Enjoy!

name: Vegetable Soup with Edamame, Water Chestnuts & Cilantro-Coconut Broth

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince the ginger and garlic; transfer both to a medium bowl.
Peel and medium dice carrot and potato; add both to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and small dice shallot; add to the bowl.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper to the pan; cook, stirring often, until they begin to soften, 3-4 minutes.
While the veggies cook, seed and slice bell pepper into thin, bite-sized strips.
Add the bell pepper, broth, coconut milk, soy sauce, and sugar to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Meanwhile, drain and rinse the water chestnuts in a colander.
Once the soup comes to a boil, add water chestnuts, edamame, and corn. Return to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer until edamame is heated through and veggies are tender, 5 minutes more.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems. Add cilantro to the pan, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!

name: Vegetarian Cobb Salad with Chickpeas

instructions.text: Place the eggs in a small saucepan and cover with cold water by about 1 inch. Cover with a lid and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.
While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the root end of the lettuce and remove any blemished leaves; halve the lettuce lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1-inch pieces and transfer to a medium bowl.
Once the water is boiling, remove the pan from the heat and let the eggs sit, covered, for 6 minutes. Once done, drain and run the eggs under cold water for 1-2 minutes to stop the cooking process.
Halve the tomatoes and transfer to a small bowl.
Halve the avocado lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and medium dice the flesh. Transfer the avocado to a small bowl.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas; set aside in the colander.
In a small bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, honey, salt, and pepper.
Peel and roughly chop the eggs.
To serve, arrange the lettuce on a plate, top with the tomatoes, avocado, chickpeas, and eggs, and drizzle with the dressing. Enjoy!

name: Vegetarian Mushroom & Bell Pepper "Cheesesteak" Toasts with Arugula

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Remove stems from portobello mushrooms; thinly slice. Add to the baking sheet with the peppers.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place veggies in the oven and bake, stirring halfway through, until softened and starting to color in spots, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Coarsely grate mozzarella.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven. Change oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Sprinkle veggies with cheese. Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Carefully remove cooked veggies from the baking sheet by lifting the corners of the foil and transferring the whole sheet to a flat surface. (Reserve baking sheet for the next step.)
Arrange bread on the reserved baking sheet. Place bread in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
To serve, divide dressed arugula and toast between plates; top the toast with cheesy mushrooms and peppers. Enjoy!

name: Vegetarian Mushroom Tomato Sauce over Crisp Zucchini Noodles

instructions.text: Rinse lentils under cold water and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer, cover with a lid, and cook until the lentils are tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onions and garlic; sauté, until onions are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and slice the mushrooms.
Add mushrooms, more oil, and salt to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5-10 minutes, until the liquid released by the mushrooms has mostly cooked off.
Add tomatoes and their juices, tomato paste, oregano, and thyme; stir to combine. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 3-5 minutes.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Stir the lentils and basil into the sauce and continue to simmer.
Wash zucchini, trim ends, and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Use paper towel or a clean dish cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the zucchini noodles.
Finely grate Parmesan.
To serve, divide noodles between plates; top with the hot sauce to warm the noodles. Sprinkle with cheese and enjoy!

name: Vegetarian Niçoise Salad with Lemony Chickpeas & Dijon Vinaigrette

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Halve potatoes and transfer to a medium saucepan. Cover with hot water (from the tap), season with salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas; transfer to a small bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the chickpeas; add turmeric and salt. Stir to combine and set aside to marinate.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook until the potatoes are almost tender, about 10 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Halve tomatoes and thinly slice olives; transfer both to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Trim and halve the green beans.
When the potatoes are almost done, add green beans and edamame; continue to cook, until veggies are fork-tender, about 4 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water.
Transfer green beans, edamame, potatoes, and marinated chickpeas to the bowl with the dressing. Add mixed greens and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy.

name: Vegetarian Shepherd's Pie with Lentils, Mushrooms & Carrots

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 14 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and quarter the potatoes; transfer to a small saucepan.
Cover the potatoes with hot water (from the tap); bring to a boil over high heat.
Peel the carrot, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Small dice the carrot (cut into ¼-inch cubes) and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and add to the carrot.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the carrot and onion.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the carrot, onion, and garlic to the pan; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables are slightly softened, 2 to 3 minutes.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce the heat to medium and cook until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife, 15 to 20 minutes. Once done, drain the potatoes and return to the saucepan; cover to keep warm.
Trim off and discard the stem ends of the mushrooms; small dice the mushrooms (cut into ¼-inch cubes).
Add the mushrooms to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until slightly softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Rinse the lentils in a colander or strainer.

Add the rinsed lentils and broth to the pan; season with salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer, cover with a lid, and cook until the lentils are just tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: One by one, holding a sprig of thyme at its top, run your fingers down it to remove the leaves. Discard the sprigs and chop the leaves. Stir about ¾ of the thyme into the lentil mixture and save the rest for garnishing.
Once the lentils are tender, stir in the green peas.
Add butter, broth, salt, and pepper to the potatoes; mash with a potato masher until smooth.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, divide the lentil mixture between plates or bowls, top with the mashed potatoes, and sprinkle with the remaining thyme leaves. Enjoy!

name: Vegetarian Spicy Portobello "Carnitas" Tacos with Beans & Chili Mayo

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice orange into a medium bowl. Juice half the lime into the same bowl; cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the citrus juice, along with soy sauce, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Remove mushroom stems and discard; cut mushrooms in half and then crosswise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the marinade.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half moons. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms and toss to combine.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the mushrooms, onions, and any leftover marinade. Cook, stirring often, until veggies become soft and golden, and the marinade has reduced, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, whisk together mayo and chili powder in a small bowl and set aside.
Thinly slice jalapeño into rounds and set aside. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon and set aside.
Drain and rinse the beans. Add to the skillet with the mushrooms and continue to cook, stirring often, until beans are warmed through, about 2 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Stir half the cilantro into the skillet and remove from the heat. (Reserve remaining cilantro for garnish.)
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional), 15-30 seconds.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates and fill with the portobello "carnitas" mixture. Top with avocado, chili mayo, jalapeños, and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Vegetarian White Bean Chili with Peppers, Carrots, Mozzarella & Yogurt

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and small dice celery; peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place both in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl with the celery and carrot.

Quarter jalapeño lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 7-8 minutes.
While the veggies cook, drain and rinse beans.

Add beans, broth, and tomatoes to the pan; stir to combine the chili and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies and beans are soft, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Coarsely grate mozzarella.
When the chili is done, remove from heat, add half of the parsley, and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for garnish.)
To serve, divide chili between bowls and top with mozzarella, yogurt, and reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Veggie Burrito Bowl with Salsa, Guacamole & Cheddar

instructions.text: Rinse rice in a colander until water runs clear, then transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until liquid is absorbed, 16-18 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out the flesh into a small bowl.
Wash and small dice tomatoes. Transfer to a different small bowl.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Wash, seed, and mince jalapeño. Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add ½ of the cilantro (save the rest for the rice), ⅓ of the garlic (save the rest for the salsa and beans), lime juice, salt, and pepper to avocado. Mash and mix until well combined. Set aside.
Add ½ of the onion, ½ of the remaining garlic, ½ of the jalapeño, lime juice, salt, and pepper to tomatoes. Mix and set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Drain and rinse beans.

Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add beans, water, remaining onion, garlic and jalapeño, cumin, oregano, salt, and pepper. Stirring occasionally, cook until water is evaporated and beans are heated through, 2-3 minutes.
Finely grate ½ cup of cheddar.
Add remaining cilantro and lime juice to rice. Stir to combine.
Place rice in a bowl and top with beans, salsa, guacamole, and cheddar. Enjoy!

name: Veggie Orzo Soup with Carrot, Zucchini, Parsley & Crispy Chickpeas

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and pat dry with paper towels. Drizzle with oil and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until chickpeas are golden and crispy, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and medium dice carrots. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and medium dice celery. Add to the bowl with the carrots.
Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the veggies are softened, add parsley, broth, and orzo to the pan. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat and simmer until the orzo is tender, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with crispy chickpeas. Enjoy!

name: Veggie-Packed Cajun "Dirty Rice" with Beef, Celery, Peppers & Carrots

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots; add to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the veggies and cook, stirring often, until they begin to soften, 5-6 minutes.
Once the veggies are soft, add ground beef and spices to the skillet. Continue to cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until the beef is browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes more.
Add cooked rice and additional broth to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: To serve, divide "dirty rice" between plates or bowls and enjoy!

name: Veggie Soup with Eggplant, Zucchini, Kale, Yogurt & Curry Breadsticks

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a small bowl, along with the spices, and set aside.
Trim and medium dice eggplant and zucchini; place both in a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add eggplant and zucchini; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and place in the reserved bowl; set aside.
Once the veggies start to soften, add ginger, garlic, and spices to the pan. Cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add broth to the pan and stir to combine the soup; cover and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are soft, 4-5 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: While the soup is cooking, drizzle oil over the flatbread and season with spices; cut into 1½-inch wide strips and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and bake until crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.

When the veggies are soft, add kale to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the kale is tender, 2-3 minutes more.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add cilantro to the soup, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide soup between bowls; top with yogurt and almonds. Serve with breadsticks on the side and enjoy!

name: Vietnamese Baked Chicken Wings with Rice, Pickled Veggies & Peanuts

ingredients.name: split with tips removed chicken wings
ingredients.display: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
amounts: 1 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.text: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
While the rice and wings are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and halve radishes lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Peel and mince garlic. Place in another medium bowl.
Zest and juice lime into the bowl with the garlic. Add fish sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar, then whisk to combine the sauce.
When the wings are almost done, roughly chop peanuts. Add half to the bowl with the pickled veggies and stir once more to combine. (Reserve remaining peanuts for serving.)
When the wings are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings, rice, and pickled veggies between plates. Top wings with reserved cilantro and peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Vietnamese Cod with Rice Noodles, Bok Choy, Snap Peas, Dill & Peanuts

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Trim and cut bok choy crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut snap peas crosswise into ½-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the bok choy.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bok choy, snap peas, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 5 minutes. Return veggies to the bowl and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the garlic. Add water, fish sauce, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce; whisk to combine the "nuoc cham" dressing and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and additional garlic. Place both in another medium bowl along with oil, fish sauce, and spices. Stir to combine the spice oil.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Pat cod dry with paper towels. Cut into 2-inch pieces, add to the bowl with the spice oil, and stir to coat.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat. Add fish and spice oil; cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and just cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim and cut green onions crosswise into 1-inch pieces.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
When the fish is done, add green onions and dill to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until the dill is wilted and green onions have softened, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice noodles, veggies, and fish between plates or bowls; drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Vietnamese Grilled Steak Banh Mi with Pickled Carrots & Cucumber

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Peel and mince shallot. Peel and mince the garlic.
Add shallot, garlic, fish sauce, maple syrup, and pepper to a small bowl; whisk together.
Cut the steak into 3-inch sections, then thinly slice each section against the grain into ¼-inch strips; add to the bowl with the marinade. Turn to coat and set aside to marinate.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off and discard the ends of the carrot and cucumber. Using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the carrot and cucumber into thin noodle-like sticks. Transfer the carrot to a small saucepan and the cucumber to a medium bowl.

Thinly slice the jalapeño into rounds; add to the saucepan with the carrot. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Add vinegar, maple syrup, and salt to the saucepan with carrot and jalapeño. Bring to a boil over high heat; immediately remove from heat, stir in 2 ice cubes (or ¼ cup water) and set aside to cool.
Heat a grill pan (or skillet) over medium-high heat.
Halve the lettuce head lengthwise, then chop crosswise into thick, bite-sized, pieces; set aside.
Coat grill with oil. Then place steak on the grill and cook until desired doneness, about 1½ minutes per side for medium-rare. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Slice rolls in half. Place on grill, cut side down, and toast until browned, about 2 minutes. Alternatively, you can toast the rolls in a toaster.

Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Add cilantro to the bowl with the cucumber. Reserving the pickling liquid, remove carrot and jalapeño from the saucepan using tongs or a fork, and add them to the bowl; toss to combine.
To assemble the sandwiches, spread mayonnaise on bottom slices of rolls; top with steak, some of the pickled carrot, cucumber, jalapeño, and cilantro. Close sandwiches with tops of the rolls.
Add lettuce to the bowl with carrot, cucumber, jalapeño, and cilantro; drizzle with 2-3 tbsp of the reserved pickling liquid, and toss to coat.
To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!

name: Vietnamese Noodle Bowl with Crispy Tofu, Lettuce, Cucumber & Cilantro

instructions.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice limes into a small bowl. Add water, sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce; whisk the dressing until sugar is dissolved.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl. Whisk to combine and set aside.

Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse under cold water; set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, large dice tofu and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and gently toss to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and cook, turning every few minutes, until golden brown and crispy, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; transfer to a plate.
Halve lettuce lengthwise, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the plate with the green onion.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the plate.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot. Add to the plate.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide noodles, veggies, and tofu between bowls. Pour dressing over top and sprinkle with cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Vietnamese-Style Caramelized Salmon with Edamame, Broccoli Slaw & Rice

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger; place in a medium bowl.
Zest and juice lime into the bowl with the ginger. Add sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, and water; whisk to combine the sauce.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Cut salmon into equal portions, pat dry with paper towels, and place on a plate; drizzle skin-side with oil, then sprinkle with salt and pepper on both sides. Pour sauce into an ovenproof skillet, then place salmon, skin-side down, in the sauce. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place skillet in the oven and broil until salmon is just opaque, about 5 minutes. Flip salmon and continue to broil until the skin is crispy, about 3 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the salmon cooks, place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Set aside to drain.
Place oil, vinegar, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, trim green onions and cut crosswise into thin pieces; add half to the bowl with the dressing. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl along with the broccoli slaw and edamame. Toss to combine the slaw.
When the salmon is done, transfer to a clean plate.
Place skillet over medium-high heat and cook, stirring frequently, until sauce begins to thicken and caramelize, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, salmon, and slaw between bowls; spoon sauce over salmon and top with reserved green onion. Enjoy!

name: Vietnamese-Style Noodle Bowl with Tofu, Mushrooms & Pickled Veggies

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, trim, and cut carrot crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
Place fish sauce, soy sauce, oil, sugar, and crushed red pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Medium dice tofu and add to the bowl with the marinade. (Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels and reserve for the next step.)
Quarter mushrooms, add to the bowl with the tofu, and gently stir to combine. Transfer tofu and mushrooms to the reserved baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until mushrooms are tender and tofu is golden, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water.
While the noodles are soaking, juice lime into the reserved bowl.
Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the lime juice along with fish sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.

Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. When the tofu and mushrooms are done, add half of the mint to the baking sheet, then stir to combine. (Reserve remaining mint for serving.)
Roughly chop peanuts.
Divide noodles between bowls; top with tofu, mushrooms, pickled veggies, reserved mint, and peanuts. Serve with dressing on the side and enjoy!

name: Waldorf Chicken Salad Pitas with Mixed Greens & Red Grape Salad

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Place chicken in a medium saucepan. Cover with 1-inch of water and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Once the water in the pan is boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes.

While the chicken is cooking, juice half of the lemon into a medium bowl (reserve remaining lemon for the mixed green salad). Add yogurt, mayo, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the creamy dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, quarter, core, and small dice apple; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl.
Halve grapes and add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining grapes for the mixed green salad.)
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl; set aside.
When the chicken is done, drain and transfer to a plate; set aside to cool, 5 min.
Meanwhile, juice the remaining lemon into another medium bowl; add oil, additional Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the vinaigrette.
Add mixed greens and reserved grapes to the bowl with the vinaigrette; toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Shred the chicken using two forks; use one fork to hold the chicken and the other fork to pull and shred the meat. Add to the bowl with the creamy dressing and stir to combine the chicken salad.
Cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets; stuff each pocket with the chicken salad.
To serve, divide pitas and mixed green salad between plates. Enjoy!

name: "Waldorf" Tuna Salad Lettuce Wraps with Apple, Grapes & Walnuts

ingredients.name: chunk light tuna in water
ingredients.display: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add mayo and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain tuna, add to the bowl with the dressing, and flake with a fork.
amounts: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.text: Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Halve grapes and add to the bowl.
Quarter, core, and small dice apple. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop walnuts, add to the bowl, and stir to combine the tuna salad.
Separate lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates, then fill with "Waldorf" tuna salad. Enjoy!

name: Walnut Crusted Salmon with Greek-Style Kale, Dill & Feta Sauté

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Mince walnuts. Place in a small bowl along with bread crumbs, oil, and salt; stir to combine the coating.

Pat salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on the baking sheet; season the top side with salt and pepper. Spread the fish with mayo, then sprinkle evenly with the coating, pressing gently to adhere. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until salmon is cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice half of the lemon into the reserved bowl. Cut remaining lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice and set aside.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise. Add to the bowl with the kale.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add kale and green onions to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring frequently, until the kale is tender, 1-2 minutes.
Add lemon juice, dill, feta, crushed red pepper, and salt to the skillet with the kale. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: To serve, divide salmon and kale between plates, then squeeze lemon over top. Enjoy!

name: Warm Asparagus Salad with Roasted Peppers, Black Beans & Fresh Mozza

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Cut peppers into large pieces and toss in a medium bowl with oil, oregano, salt, and pepper. Spread in a single layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet and roast in the oven, until beginning to soften, about 10 minutes. Save bowl for use in the next step.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus. Place in the medium bowl with additional oil and oregano; toss to coat and set aside.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice into chunks while still in the skin, then scoop out into a blender. Juice lime into the blender.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the blender along with oil, salt, and pepper; purée until smooth, 30-60 seconds. Add water to thin out the dressing if necessary.
Remove peppers from the oven and toss. Lay the asparagus on top of the peppers and return to the oven; roast until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Peel and thinly slice the shallot into rings.
Cut mozzarella into bite sized pieces.
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
To serve, divide roasted peppers and asparagus between plates and top with beans, shallots, cheese, and basil; drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: Warm Avocado-Dill Potato Salad with Asparagus, Edamame & Pine Nuts

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and chop the potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Place on a baking sheet pan along with the edamame; drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and spread out in a single layer.
Place the potatoes and edamame in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until potatoes are fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into a medium bowl. Mash well with a fork or potato masher.
Using a knife, shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice the lemon into the bowl. Add water, salt, and pepper, and whisk to combine the dressing; add more water, 1 Tbsp at a time, if needed to reach a creamy, dressing-like consistency.
Trim and cut asparagus into 2-inch pieces. Spread in an even layer on a second baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Remove potatoes and edamame from the oven and toss; return them to the oven, along with the sheet of asparagus. Cook until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Remove potatoes, edamame, and asparagus from the oven and carefully add to the bowl with the dressing; toss well to combine.
To serve, divide potato salad between dishes, top with pine nuts, and enjoy!

name: Warm Bacon, Potato, Leek, Goat Cheese & Arugula Salad with Thyme

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Halve potatoes, transfer to a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium, and cook until fork-tender, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Set skillet with drippings aside for later use).

Meanwhile, trim off the root ends and the dark green tops of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons.
Peel and mince shallot.
Return skillet to medium heat. Add leeks, shallot, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until leeks begin to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Add vinegar to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the liquid is reduced by about half, 3-4 minutes.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in thyme.
When the potatoes are done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Add drained potatoes to the skillet and toss with the warm dressing.
To serve, divide arugula between plates or bowls; top with potatoes, warm dressing, and bacon. Crumble goat cheese over top and enjoy!

name: Warm Beef, Cabbage & Carrot Salad with Soy-Lime Dressing

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels and slice into thin strips; place in a small bowl.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the steak, toss to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the green onion (reserving a small handful for garnish) and cook, stirring constantly, until browned, about 1 minute. Transfer to a medium bowl.

Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak strips and garlic; cook, stirring frequently, until the beef is just cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Juice lime into the skillet with the beef. Add soy sauce, sugar, and pepper; stir to combine, then transfer beef and sauce to the bowl with the green onion.
Trim off and discard root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide beef and cabbage salad between plates or bowls; top with reserved green onion and enjoy!

name: Warm Beet-Sweet Potato Salad with Chickpeas, Arugula & Tahini Yogurt

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and pat dry with paper towels.
Peel, trim, and medium dice beets. Add to the baking sheet with the chickpeas.
Peel and medium dice sweet potato. Add to the baking sheet.
Drizzle chickpeas and veggies with oil, then season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until chickpeas are crisp and veggies are fork-tender, about 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest and juice half of the lemon into a small bowl (set remaining lemon aside for the next step). Add yogurt, tahini, and salt; whisk to combine the tahini yogurt. Set aside.
Juice remaining lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
When the chickpeas and veggies are done, remove from the oven. Add half of the parsley to the baking sheet and toss to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
Add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
To serve, spoon the tahini yogurt over the bottom of each plate. Top with the dressed arugula, chickpea-veggie mixture, and reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Warm Cauliflower-Chickpea Salad with Arugula, Pine Nuts & Lemon Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to the baking sheet with the cauliflower, then drizzle with oil and season with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until cauliflower is golden and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice, along with mayo, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the sauce. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add pine nuts and cook, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the pine nuts, along with arugula and cranberries.
When the cauliflower and chickpeas are done, add both to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

name: Warm Chicken, Quinoa & Spicy Cashew Salad with Ginger-Lime Dressing

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine water, quinoa, and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place cashews, oil, and spices in a small bowl; stir to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add the cashews and cook, stirring constantly, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Return cashews to the bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, flipping once, until cooked through and golden, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a medium bowl.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with oil, soy sauce, maple syrup, and chili garlic sauce; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage, halve lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise. Add to the bowl along with quinoa, spicy cashews, and spinach, then toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with chicken and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Warm French Lentil Salad with Goat Cheese

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Rinse lentils under cold water and transfer to a small saucepan. Cover with broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and, stirring occasionally, cook until just tender, 15-20 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash carrots and celery. Peel and small dice carrots. Small dice celery.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and thinly slice shallot crosswise; separate into rings.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add shallot and, stirring occasionally, cook until it begins to soften, 2-3 minutes.
