amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add carrots and celery to skillet and season with salt and pepper. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes more.
Peel and mince garlic. In a large bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together garlic, olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, thyme, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add vegetables and parsley to bowl with vinaigrette.
Drain lentils and add to bowl. Toss salad.
Serve on a plate and crumble goat cheese over top. Enjoy!

name: Warm Green Bean Salad with Tempeh, Carrot, Cucumber & Peanut Dressing

instructions.text: Place vinegar, maple syrup, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel and slice shallot crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tempeh. Place in a medium bowl, drizzle with soy sauce, and stir to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tempeh and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 5-7 minutes. Transfer tempeh to a plate, season with salt, and cover with foil; set aside. (Reserve skillet and bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger. Place in the reserved bowl along with peanut butter, vinegar, soy sauce, water, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Trim and halve green beans crosswise.

Return the skillet to high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green beans and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until blistered and tender, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the other veggies. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
When the green beans have cooled slightly, add to the bowl along with pickled shallots. Stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with crispy tempeh and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Warm Macaroni Salad with Sausage, Bell Pepper, Corn, Tomato & Parsley

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place corn in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw; transfer to a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally until golden brown and almost cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate, leaving the cooking juices in the skillet.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons; add to the bowl with the corn.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.

Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat; add veggies and Italian seasoning. Stir to combine, then nestle sausages into the veggies; cover and cook until the veggies are charred and sausages are cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the pasta is done, drain in the colander and return to the pan.
Zest and juice lemon into the pan with the pasta. Add the parsley (reserving a small handful for serving), oil, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Cut sausages crosswise into rounds; add to the pan along with charred veggies and any cooking juices. Stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

name: Warm Pasta Salad with Butternut Squash, Apple, Goat Cheese & Pecans

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter and core apple, then cut each quarter into ¾-inch cubes; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim and peel squash. Halve lengthwise, scrape out seeds, and cut into ¾-inch cubes; add to the baking sheet with the apple.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Sprinkle leaves over the apple and squash, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until apple and squash are golden and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse in a colander.
While the pasta is cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and mince garlic and shallot; add both to the bowl with the dressing. Stir to combine and set aside.
Roughly chop pecans and set aside.
When the apple, squash, and pasta are done, add to the bowl with the dressing; gently stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide warm pasta salad between plates or bowls. Crumble goat cheese over top and sprinkle with pecans. Enjoy!

name: Warm Pasta Salad with Chickpeas, Tomato, Kale, Kalamata Olives & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Medium dice tomatoes and place in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice olives crosswise and add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add vinegar, capers, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine and set aside.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces, place in another medium bowl, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-low heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add chickpeas to the skillet, season with spices, and stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chickpeas are warmed through, about 2 minutes.
When the chickpeas are warm, add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine, then transfer to the bowl with the tomatoes.
When the pasta is done, drain and add to the bowl; stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls and top with feta. Enjoy!
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Warm Rice Salad with Chicken, Broccoli, Pumpkin Seeds & Goat Cheese

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water, chicken, salt, and pepper; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
amounts: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.text: Once the liquid comes to a boil, cover the saucepan and reduce heat to low. Cook until liquid is fully absorbed and chicken is cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion and garlic. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion starts to soften, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop broccoli into small pieces.
Once the onion is soft, add broccoli to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the broccoli is tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add cooked veggies and pumpkin seeds to the bowl with the dressing, radish, and parsley.
Using tongs, transfer the cooked chicken to a cutting board. Shred the chicken using two forks; use one fork to hold the chicken and the other fork to pull and shred the meat.
Add shredded chicken and warm rice to the bowl with the dressing and veggies; stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between bowls and crumble goat cheese over top. Enjoy!

name: Warm Roasted Caesar Salad with Baked Salmon

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. Leave the lettuce intact while washing.
Peel and mince garlic and transfer to a small bowl for the dressing. Mince the anchovy fillets and add to the bowl. Add salt and stir to combine.
Juice the lemon and add to the dressing bowl. Add mustard, olive oil, and pepper; whisk together.
Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, on a sheet pan (that is also big enough to hold the lettuce). Rub the salmon with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place the salmon in the oven and roast for 5 minutes while you prepare the lettuce.
Cut romaine lengthwise and rub with ¾ of the dressing. After the salmon has been cooking for 5 minutes, remove from the oven, and add the lettuce to the opposite end of the pan.
Return the sheet pan to the oven for an additional 7-10 minutes until the salmon is cooked through and the tops of the lettuce begin to char.
Finely grate ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Remove the pan from the oven. Sprinkle the lettuce with the Parmesan cheese. Chop the lettuce into 1-inch pieces.
To serve, arrange a bed of romaine on a plate, top with salmon and drizzle with remaining dressing. Serve immediately, enjoy!

name: Warm Sausage-Rice Salad with Spinach & Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ¼ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, add the sausages, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed and sausages are cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Juice the lemon into a medium salad bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the bowl.
Add oil, Dijon, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Small dice the cucumber; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Seed and small dice the bell pepper; add to the bowl.
When the rice is done, carefully remove the sausages. Allow them to cool slightly; cut lengthwise and then crosswise into thin half-moons.
Add sausage and rice to the bowl with the veggies and dressing. Toss to combine.
To serve, divide spinach between plates and top with sausage and rice salad. Sprinkle feta over top and enjoy!
amounts: ¼ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

name: Warm Shrimp Salad with Mixed Veggies, Avocado & Lemon Caper Dressing

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raw peeled shrimp
ingredients.display: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas
ingredients.display: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas
½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals (if using fresh shrimp, skip this step). Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
amounts: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.text: Juice lemon into a small bowl. Shave leaves off the parsley stems; discard stems, mince the leaves, and add to the bowl.
Finely chop the anchovy fillet. Add to the bowl along with mayo, capers, oil, Dijon, and salt; whisk to combine dressing and set aside.
Halve grape tomatoes. Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle; place both in a medium bowl and set aside.
Cut snap peas crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Trim zucchini, halve lengthwise, and cut crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-rounds.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peas, zucchini, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, about 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic.
Remove peas and zucchini to the bowl with the tomatoes. Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add shrimp, garlic, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook, stirring often, until cooked through and slightly golden, about 4 minutes; remove from the heat.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide mixed greens between plates; top with shrimp, vegetables, avocado, and dressing. Enjoy!

name: Warm Smoked Salmon & Dilly Baby Potato Salad with Avocado

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Cut potatoes in half and place in a medium saucepan. Cover with hot water (from the tap) by 1-inch and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook until fork-tender, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a small bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the dressing, stir to combine, and set aside. Reserve the other half for the potatoes.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice thinly while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Add peas to the potatoes during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Drain potatoes and peas in a colander, then return to the pan. Add oil and reserved dill; toss to combine.
Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide arugula between plates and top with dilly potatoes, avocado, green onions, and salmon. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

name: Warm Spinach Salad with Mushrooms, Avocado & Bacon Mustard Dressing

instructions.text: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and thinly slice the onion. Slice the mushrooms.
Once the bacon is cooked, use a slotted spoon to transfer to a plate lined with paper towels; pat to remove excess oil. Crumble or chop into small pieces.

Return skillet (with bacon fat) to the stove over medium heat. Add the onions, mushrooms, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables soften, 4-5 minutes. Leaving bacon fat in the skillet, transfer the vegetables to a plate; set aside.

Return the skillet to medium heat. Add the vinegar, brown sugar, oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk vigorously, scraping the bottom of the skillet to incorporate any browned bits. Bring to a simmer and reduce heat, whisking occasionally, until dressing thickens, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Peel and slice the eggs.
In a large bowl, combine the spinach, bacon, onion, mushrooms, avocado, and dressing from the skillet. Toss to combine.
Divide the salad between plates or bowls. Top with the sliced egg and enjoy!

name: Warm Sweet Chili Steak Salad with Snap Peas, Spinach & Sesame Seeds

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and snap peas; cook, stirring occasionally, until snap peas are soft and steak is cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, sugar, water, chili-garlic sauce, and salt in a small saucepan; whisk to combine. Set over medium-high heat and bring to a boil, whisking occasionally.
While the sauce comes to a boil, in a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.

Once the sauce is boiling, add cornstarch slurry to the pan in a steady stream while whisking quickly. Cook, whisking constantly, until the sweet chili sauce thickens, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and trim carrot; run a vegetable peeler along the length of the carrot to make ribbons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add spinach to the bowl. Using your hands, massage spinach and carrot until wilted, about 30 seconds.
Add sweet chili sauce to the skillet with the steak and snap peas. Stir to coat.
To serve, divide spinach salad between plates or bowls. Top with steak and snap peas, then sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Warm Thai Beef Salad with Fresh Herbs, Tomato, Cucumber & Peanuts

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

ingredients.name: striploin (new york strip) steak
ingredients.display: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, crushed red pepper, and black pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot into half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing, toss to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
amounts: ¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.text: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; add steak to the pan and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-moons; halve tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Roughly chop peanuts.
Right before serving, thinly slice steak against the grain. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and sprinkle with peanuts. Enjoy!

name: Weeknight Beef & Cabbage Stir Up

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add the ground beef to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4 to 6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Once done, transfer to a medium bowl, leaving juices in the skillet.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion.
Peel and mince or press the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
Return the skillet to the stove over medium heat and add oil. Once oil is melted, add onion, garlic, and ginger. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise then thinly slice crosswise.
Add the cabbage to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until the cabbage is softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Juice the lime into a small bowl.
Return the beef to the skillet with the cabbage and season with soy sauce, sesame oil, lime juice, and chili-garlic sauce.
To serve, divide the beef mixture between bowls and enjoy!

name: Welsh Rarebit (Cheddar Toasts) with Tomato, Chives & Dressed Greens

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Place eggs, Dijon, Worcestershire, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk until smooth.
Coarsely grate cheese. Add to the bowl with the egg mixture and whisk once more to combine. Set aside.
Arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Divide cheesy egg mixture between toast slices, spreading it to the edges. Return toast to the oven and broil until topping is golden and bubbling at the edges, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, chop chives into small pieces. Place half in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat. Set aside.
Slice tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds. Divide between toasts, then season with salt and pepper.
Divide Welsh rarebit between plates and sprinkle with reserved chives. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

name: West African Peanut Soup with Baby Spinach

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash, peel, and medium dice potatoes. Wash and medium dice tomatoes.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic and ginger.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add onion and stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger. Cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add broth, coconut milk, potatoes, tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and, stirring occasionally, simmer until potatoes are tender, 10-12 minutes.
amounts: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.text: Wash and dry spinach.
Remove ½ cup of the soup liquid from saucepan and pour into a small bowl. Add peanut butter and whisk until smooth.
Add peanut butter mixture and spinach to saucepan. Stir and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Roughly chop peanuts.
To serve, pour soup into a bowl and garnish with cilantro and peanuts. Enjoy!

name: "Western Omelet" Frittata with Bacon, Corn, Bell Pepper & Cheddar

instructions.text: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate; set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry bell peppers. Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and medium dice the peppers. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are golden and tender, 6-8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate cheese. Set aside.
Place eggs and spices in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine.

When the veggies are done, reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 3-5 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese and bacon over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until the top is set and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: White Bean-Cauliflower Soup with Tomato, Fresh Basil & Garlic Sticks

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and medium dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion, garlic, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 4 minutes.

Meanwhile, separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add cauliflower and water to the pan with the onion; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, while preparing the tomatoes.

Halve tomatoes; add to the pan along with the beans and broth. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and mince additional garlic; place in a small bowl along with oil and spices. Stir to combine the garlic oil.
Place flatbread on a baking sheet pan and spread garlic oil over top; place in the oven and broil until golden and crisp, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven and slice crosswise into sticks.
While the garlic bread is toasting, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the soup is done, add vinegar, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide soup between bowls and top with basil. Serve with breadsticks on the side and enjoy!

name: White Bean-Chard Sauté with Seared Scallops, Leeks, Lemon & Parmesan

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Thinly slice crosswise and place in a small bowl.

Fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in a medium bowl and add stems to the bowl with the leek. Set the leaves aside.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the small bowl and set aside.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add scallops in a single layer; cook until golden brown and opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.

Return skillet (with any cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leek, chard stems, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring often, until softened, 1-2 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Add chard leaves to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add beans and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until chard is tender, 2-3 minutes more.
Add broth to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened slightly, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, zest lemon into the reserved bowl. Cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add half to the bowl with the lemon zest and stir to combine. Add remaining Parmesan to the skillet, along with pumpkin seeds, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide bean and chard sauté between plates or bowls. Top with scallops, lemon zest, and Parmesan. Enjoy!

name: White Bean-Chicken Chili with Bell Pepper, Corn & Tortilla Strips

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Slice tortillas in half, then crosswise into ½-inch strips. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; toss to coat and spread out in a single layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until tortilla strips are golden and crispy, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and medium dice celery. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the celery.
Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, chicken, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans. Set aside to drain further.
When the chicken is done, add veggies, corn, and flour to the pan. Stir to combine and continue to cook until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.

When the veggies are done, add beans and broth to the pan; stir to combine the chili and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender and chili thickens slightly, 10-12 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: When the chili is done, juice lime into the pan. Add cilantro and yogurt, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide chili between bowls and top with crispy tortilla strips. Enjoy!

name: White Bean-Cranberry Roll Ups with Roasted Parsnips & Carrots

ingredients.name: spring mix (mixed greens)
ingredients.display: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
amounts: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.text: Peel, trim, and cut carrots and parsnips lengthwise into quarters, then crosswise into 2-inch long pieces; transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Drizzle the veggies with oil and season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing once, until veggies are fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander. Place in a small bowl and mash with a potato masher or fork until semi-smooth.
Add mayo, Dijon, and spices to the bowl with the beans; stir to combine.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with the cranberries, and stir to combine the bean filling.
Place tortillas on a flat surface, spread evenly with the bean filling, and top with mixed greens; roll tightly to close, then cut in half.
To serve, divide roll ups and roasted veggies between plates. Enjoy!

name: White Bean Frittata with Broccoli, Artichokes & Sun-Dried Tomatoes

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Coarsely grate cheese. Place on a plate and set aside.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6-7 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Place eggs and spices in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts and sun-dried tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the egg.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
When the veggies are done, add beans to the skillet and stir to combine.

Reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 3-5 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese over frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, sprinkle frittata with reserved basil, then cut into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!

name: White Bean-Gnocchi Gratin with Spinach & Tomato Sauce

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the spinach. (Skip this step if it came pre-washed.)
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel and thinly slice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add gnocchi and salt. Stir and cook 2-3 minutes, or until the gnocchi begin to float to the surface. Drain in the colander with the beans.
Return the saucepan to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate the cheese.
Stirring constantly, add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add beans, gnocchi, tomato sauce, and spices to the pan. Cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, about 3 minutes.
Pour the gnocchi mixture into a small baking dish and sprinkle with cheese. Place in the oven and bake until the cheese is bubbly and golden, 10-12 minutes.
To serve, divide gnocchi gratin between plates and enjoy!

name: White Bean-Kale "Cassoulet" with Parmesan Bread Crumbs & Lemon Sauce

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.

Trim off the root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Thinly slice crosswise and place in a small bowl.
Peel, trim, and medium dice carrots; trim and thinly slice celery. Add both to the bowl with the leek.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the veggies.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and salt to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.

When the veggies have softened, add kale, beans, broth, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until beans and kale are tender, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic; finely grate Parmesan. Place both in the reserved bowl along with bread crumbs, oil, and pepper; use your hands to combine the bread crumb mixture.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
When the beans and kale are tender, remove from the heat, and top with an even layer of the bread crumb mixture. (Reserve bowl for lemon sauce.)
Place skillet in the oven and broil until bread crumbs are golden brown and crisp, about 1 minute. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wipe the reserved bowl clean with paper towels. Zest and juice lemon into the bowl, then add mayo, parsley flakes, and salt; whisk to combine the lemon sauce.
To serve, divide "cassoulet" between plates or bowls and drizzle with lemon sauce. Enjoy!

name: White Bean-Leek Soup with Spinach, Crispy Artichokes & Sourdough

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into thin pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the leek.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leek, thyme, onion, garlic, nutritional yeast, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans.

When the veggies are tender, add beans and broth to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies and beans are very soft, 8-10 minutes.
amounts: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and roughly chop artichokes.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add artichokes, nutritional yeast, pepper, and salt; cook, turning occasionally, until golden and crispy, 4-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, roughly chop spinach.
When the soup is done, add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat, juice lemon into the pan, and stir to combine the soup.
Toast bread (if desired), then cut in half.
Divide soup between bowls and top with crispy artichokes. Serve with bread and enjoy!

name: White Bean Pasta Salad with Tomato, Cucumber, Avocado & Pine Nuts

instructions.text: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Add mayo and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice cucumber; add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse beans, then add to the bowl.
Add cooked pasta and pine nuts to the bowl, then stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

name: White Bean Purée with Asparagus & Fried Eggs

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the asparagus.
Drain and rinse the beans.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Finely grate ½ cup of Parmesan.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Once the saucepan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the garlic to the saucepan; cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the beans and ½ of the broth to the saucepan; bring to a boil, then mash the beans with a hand blender or potato masher.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add the remaining broth, most of the Parmesan (save a little for garnishing), salt, and pepper to the bean purée; stir to combine. Remove the saucepan from the heat and cover to keep warm.
amounts: 2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Add butter to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
Gently crack the eggs into the skillet. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, separate the eggs and transfer to a plate.
While the eggs cook, snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears into 1-inch pieces at an angle.
Once the eggs have been transferred, add more butter to the skillet.

Add the asparagus to the skillet and season with salt and pepper; cook, tossing frequently, until the asparagus is bright green and just tender, 4 to 6 minutes. Once done, remove the skillet from the heat.
To serve, spoon the bean purée into a bowl, top with the asparagus and fried eggs, sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan, and season with additional salt and pepper if desired. Enjoy!

name: White Bean-Quinoa Salad with Citrus, Bell Pepper, Avocado & Spinach

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Zest lemon into a small saucepan (set lemon aside for later use).

Add quinoa and broth to the saucepan with the zest, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Juice the lemon into a medium bowl, then add oil, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Peel and slice shallot into thin rings; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.

Cut off skin and white pith from the orange and grapefruit. Slice between the membranes to release segments; cut into bite-sized pieces and add both to the bowl, along with the beans. Stir to combine and set aside.
Transfer the cooked quinoa to a baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; scoop the flesh out with a spoon and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the dressing and citrus fruit.
Add cooled quinoa to the bowl and gently stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide spinach between plates and top with salad. Enjoy!

name: White Bean Soup with Caper-Almond Pesto

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Drain and rinse the beans in a colander.
Peel and roughly chop the onion; peel and mince the garlic.
In a blender, combine beans, onion, garlic, broth, almond milk, and spices. Blend on high until smooth.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
8 fl oz (1 cup) almond milk, unsweetened

instructions.text: Pour soup into a medium saucepan, cover and place over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through and fragrant, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise, and mince. Place in a small bowl.
Finely chop the almonds and capers; add both to the bowl with the basil.
Add oil and spices to the bowl with the basil and capers. Stir to combine the pesto.
To serve, divide soup between bowls; drizzle with olive oil and top with pesto. Enjoy!

name: White Bean, Spinach & Tomato Sauté over Polenta with Olive Tapenade

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, bring broth and water to a boil. Reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta in a thin steady stream, while whisking, until the polenta is incorporated into the broth. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and the texture is creamy, 15-25 minutes.
amounts: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Zest lemon into a small bowl. Cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Mince olives, sun-dried tomatoes, and capers; add to the bowl with the lemon zest.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl along with the oil. Stir to combine the tapenade and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; peel and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, onion, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans.
Add beans and tomatoes to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add oil, salt, and pepper to the polenta and stir to combine; if the polenta is too firm, add hot water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until you reach a desired consistency.
To serve, divide polenta and veggie sauté between bowls; top with olive tapenade and fresh basil. Serve with lemon wedges and enjoy!

name: White Chili-Style Chickpea Soup with Corn, Zucchini & Bread Crumbs

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and place in a medium bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the jalapeño.
Trim and medium dice zucchini. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add flour to the pan with the veggies. Cook, stirring frequently, for 1 minute.

Add beans with their liquid (do not drain) and broth to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender and soup thickens slightly, 10-12 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.

Once the skillet is hot, add bread crumbs and toast, stirring frequently, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Transfer toasted bread crumbs to the bowl with the cilantro, along with salt, and stir to combine. Set aside.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice.
When the soup has thickened, add cream and corn to the pan, then stir to combine. Remove from heat.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: To serve, divide soup between bowls; top with bread crumbs and avocado. Enjoy!

name: Winter Panzanella Salad with Butternut Squash & Apples

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F and position rack in the centre.
Wash squash, trim ends, and peel. Halve lengthwise, scape out seeds, and medium dice the flesh.
Place squash on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt, pepper, and cumin; toss to coat. Place in the oven and roast until tender, 15-20 minutes.
Cube bread into 1 inch pieces. Peel and mince garlic.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Finely grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
Melt butter in skillet. Add garlic and sage; stir until fragrant. Add bread cubes and toast, tossing often, until they begin to brown, 4-5 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together olive oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Add Parmesan, pumpkin seeds, salt, and pepper to croutons; continue to toss until bread is golden brown and crispy, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a salad bowl.
Wash, core, and thinly slice apple; add to salad bowl. Peel and thinly slice shallot; add to salad bowl.
Add squash, croutons, and pumpkin seeds to salad bowl; toss to combine.
To serve, arrange salad on a plate and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

name: Zesty Avocado Mac 'n' Cheese with Zucchini & Jalapeño

instructions.text: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Coarsely grate the cheddar cheese and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the lime into a medium bowl. Peel and mince or press the garlic into the same bowl.
Halve the avocado and remove pit; scoop out the flesh into the medium bowl. Mash with a fork, mixing it into the lime juice and garlic.
Slice the zucchini into ½-inch half moons and set aside.

Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeño with a spoon. Finely dice and set aside. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat and add butter, swirling to coat the bottom.
Add the zucchini and jalapeños to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the zucchini begins to brown; 4-5 minutes. Pour contents of skillet into a medium bowl and set aside.
Return the skillet to medium-low heat and add butter. Once melted, whisk in the flour and cook for 2 minutes.
Whisk in the milk and cook, stirring constantly, until smooth and thick, about 3-4 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the grated cheese to the skillet and stir until melted. Remove skillet from heat.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.
Add the avocado mixture to the skillet and stir until combined. Fold in the cooked pasta, veggie mixture, and cilantro.
Divide between plates, serve immediately, and enjoy!

name: Zesty Chickpea Kale Salad with Sun-Dried Tomatoes & Pumpkin Seeds

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
amounts: 8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Meanwhile, drain and rinse the chickpeas in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Grate the zest from the lemon and transfer to a salad bowl; juice the lemon into the same bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to the bowl.
Add vinegar, oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to the bowl and whisk to combine.
Fold the kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Finely chop leaves and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Grate the carrots and add to the bowl with the kale.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle and transfer to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork.
Thinly slice the sun-dried tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Add the cooked quinoa and the chickpeas to the bowl; toss until well combined.
To serve, divide salad between bowls and top with pumpkin seeds. Enjoy!

name: Zucchini & Beef Skillet

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the ends of the zucchini; halve the zucchini lengthwise, then cut the halves crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-rounds at an angle. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the zucchini and onion.
Add coconut oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a bowl, leaving some of the juices in the skillet.
Once the beef has been transferred, add the zucchini, onion, and garlic to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned, 4 to 6 minutes.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.
Add chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper to the skillet; stir to combine.
Return the ground beef to the skillet and add in about ¾ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing); stir to combine.
Divide the meal between plates and garnish with the remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

name: Zucchini & Black Bean Tacos with Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the ends of the zucchini; medium dice the zucchini (cut into ½-inch cubes) and transfer to a medium bowl.
Drain and rinse the black beans; set aside to drain further.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces).
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper to the skillet; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the zucchini to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until just tender, 3 to 5 minutes.
Place the feta in a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Add the black beans to the skillet; cook until the mixture is heated through, 1 to 2 minutes.
Wrap the tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until heated through, 15 to 30 seconds.
To serve, divide the zucchini and black bean mixture between the tortillas and top with the feta. Enjoy!

name: Zucchini, Corn & Beef Chili with Greek Yogurt

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the ends of the zucchini; quarter the zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces) and transfer to a small bowl.
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the bowl with the onion.
Add the ground beef to the saucepan; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a bowl, leaving some of the juices in the saucepan.
Once the beef has been transferred, add the onion and jalapeño to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the onion cooks, trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, chili powder, and cumin to the saucepan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the zucchini to the saucepan and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.

Return the beef to the saucepan, then add in the diced tomatoes, tomato paste, corn, and cilantro; season with salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
To serve, divide the chili between bowls and top with spoonfuls of Greek yogurt. Enjoy!

name: Zucchini-Feta Turkey Fritters with Garlicky Yogurt & Cucumber Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and coarsely grate zucchini; transfer to a medium bowl.
Add turkey, half the feta, bread crumbs, and spices to the bowl with the zucchini. Mix with your hands until well combined. (Set remaining feta aside.)
Using a ⅓-cup measure, form turkey mixture into ½-inch thick fritters. Place on a plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fritters to the skillet and cook, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Transfer to a small bowl.
Zest lemon into the bowl with the garlic; add yogurt, mayo, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the garlic-yogurt sauce and set aside.
Juice lemon into a clean medium bowl. Add oil, salt, pepper, and remaining feta; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice cucumber. Transfer to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Divide salad and fritters between plates; serve with garlic-yogurt sauce on the side. Enjoy!

name: Zucchini Frittata with Tomato Basil Salad

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Trim ends from the zucchini and grate coarsely.
Add zucchini and salt to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until zucchini is tender and most of the liquid has evaporated, 5-6 minutes. Use a spoon to remove excess liquid if necessary.
Meanwhile, grate mozzarella. Whisk eggs in a medium bowl; add half the cheese and stir to combine.

Spread the zucchini evenly in the skillet. Reduce heat to medium-low and pour in the egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Slice tomatoes into wedges and place in a medium salad bowl; drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Sprinkle remaining cheese over the frittata; place skillet in the oven and broil until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
Pick leaves off the stems of the basil, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes and toss to combine.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates with the tomato salad on the side. Enjoy!

name: Zucchini Noodle "Carbonara" with Bacon, Parmesan & Parsley

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and roast, tossing halfway through, until zucchini is tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan; add to the bowl with the parsley, stir to combine, and set aside.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in another small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the skillet is hot, add onion, garlic, and bacon; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is soft and bacon is crisp, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, zest lemon into the reserved bowl. Using a clean cutting board, cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.

Add half of the Parmesan-parsley mixture to the bowl with the lemon zest, along with eggs, cream, water, salt, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the egg mixture. (Reserve remaining Parmesan-parsley mixture for serving.)
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.text: When the bacon is done, let skillet cool slightly before returning to low heat. Add egg mixture to the warm skillet (adjusting heat as needed to ensure the egg does not scramble), and cook, stirring frequently, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Divide zucchini noodles between plates or bowls; top with sauce and sprinkle with reserved Parmesan-parsley mixture. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing and enjoy!

name: Zucchini Noodles with Sausage, Spinach & Parmesan-Lemon Sauce

ingredients.name: chicken or vegetable broth
ingredients.display: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
amounts: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Arrange sausages on the baking sheet and place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated); roast, flipping once, until sausages are golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a plate.
Finely grate Parmesan and add to the plate with the parsley (keeping them separate); set aside.
Trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles; place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a skillet.
Juice lemon into the skillet with the garlic.
Mince pine nuts and add to the skillet along with broth, oil, and spices; set over medium-high heat and bring to a simmer.
amounts: 4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.text: Once the liquid in the skillet comes to a simmer, add zucchini noodles and cook, stirring often, until just tender, 2-3 minutes.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add parsley and half of the Parmesan (reserve remaining cheese for serving) to the skillet; stir to combine and remove from heat.
When the sausages are done, transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into rounds.
To serve, divide saucy zucchini noodles and sausage between bowls; top with remaining Parmesan and enjoy!

name: Zucchini & Potato Fritters with Lentil, Bell Pepper & Goat Cheese Salad

instructions.text: Rinse lentils under cold water and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until tender, 15-25 minutes.
Wash and dry zucchini, potato, bell pepper, and parsley.
Coarsely grate the zucchini. Peel and coarsely grate the potato. Place both in the middle of a clean tea towel, bring the corners together, and squeeze out excess moisture. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Add oil, flour, salt, and pepper to bowl and mix.
amounts: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Once the skillet is hot, add oil to coat the bottom. Using a ¼ cup measure, form the zucchini mixture into patties. Working in batches if necessary, add patties to the skillet and flatten into ½-thick circles using the back of a spatula. Cook, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.

Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. In a small bowl, prepare sauce by mixing together ½ of the minced parsley (save the rest for the salad), yogurt, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
amounts: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.text: Add remaining parsley to bowl with dressing. Seed bell pepper, cut into small strips, and add to the bowl.
Drain lentils, add to bowl, and toss salad.
To serve, divide lentil salad and fritters between plates. Crumble goat cheese over the salad and top fritters with yogurt sauce. Enjoy!

name: Zucchini Shakshuka (North African-Style Egg Dish) with Feta

ingredients.name: crumbled feta cheese
ingredients.display: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into ¼-inch pieces).
Once the pan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until slightly softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
While the onion cooks, trim off and discard the ends of the zucchini; halve the zucchini lengthwise, then cut the halves crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-rounds at an angle.
Add the zucchini to the pan and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4 to 5 minutes.
While the zucchini cooks, trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the minced garlic, paprika, and cumin to the pan; cook, stirring, until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes to the pan and stir to combine; simmer for 5 to 6 minutes.
While the tomatoes simmer, using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves.
Stir about ¾ of the parsley into the tomato mixture (save the rest for garnishing); stir to combine.
Break the eggs into the saucepan.
Season the eggs with salt and pepper.
Reduce the heat to low and cover the pan; cook until the egg whites are set and the yolks are still runny, 5 to 7 minutes.
Place the feta in a small bowl.
amounts: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Uncover the pan and garnish the shakshuka with feta and the remaining parsley.
To serve, divide the shakshuka between plates. Enjoy!
